job.title: SOC / NOC Analyst
job.snippet:
Radware is a global leader of cyber security and application delivery solutions for physical, cloud, and software defined data centers.
At Radware, we live and breathe cybersecurity. It is our passion. Each day, our international team works to earn the trust of more than 12,500 organizations around the globe. Keeping them safe is our mission. To that end, we go head-to-head with politically motivated hacktivists, dangerous nation-state threat actors and other notorious cyber attackers -these are not your average adversaries. Backed by nearly 30 years of experience, Radware is best known for its technical excellence and innovative network and application security solutions. That is why it is so important that we build our team with bold and bright talent.
What is the job:
Radware Cloud Service Center Team provides immediate and direct support for our cloud customers, and acts as the first line of response for all Radware’s cloud customers ensuring the continued functioning of protected services and, ultimately, customer satisfaction. The
Cloud Service Center Engineer (SCE)
fuels the success of customers by serving as the primary contact for Radware related issues, you will be the first line of response for our customers, ensuring the smooth operation of their cloud services. Your primary responsibilities will include monitoring Radware cloud customer services, performing basic troubleshooting, and providing timely support to resolve issues. If you are an energetic, upstart engineer who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and interacting with people under pressure, this could be the position for you.
What you need:
Good understanding of network design (e.g. LAN/WAN, switches/routers, routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF) and protocols (e.g., IPv4, TCP/IP, VPN, IPSec, HTTP, DNS)
Good understanding of and experience with Layers 3,4, and 7 network & security fundamentals
Wireshark, Kali Linux
Familiarity with OWASP Top 10 web application security
Experience in a customer facing/support role
Excellent troubleshooting and diagnosis capabilities
Knowledge and troubleshooting experience in network communications – Routing – BGP, TCP, packet analyzing.
Willing to be on alert during off-work hours including weekends
Excellent communication skills and teamwork
Excellent time management, multi-tasking, and prioritization skills
Ability to collaborate, sync and manage processes with other teams to achieve incident resolution
Create and follow runbooks to assure system health and KPI
Perceptive, fast learner, and able to perform well under pressure
Ability to support the following:
Experience in similar positions/companies
BSc/BA in Computer Science or equivalent
Why you should join us:
Employees from more than 40 countries have chosen Radware as a place where they can belong. Radware has been recognized by Glassdoor and BDI as one of the World’s Best Places to Work, ranking among the top 100 companies across the globe in the IT category. Radware has also been named a Gold Winner for Application Security in the 2023 Globee Cybersecurity Awards, by Forrester a Leader in DDoS Protection, and has been named a Leader in WAF Market by Quadrant Knowledge Solutions. We are equally committed to our people. We strive to create a dynamic work environment that celebrates diversity, promotes equality, and thrives on the unique contributions of each individual. If you are ready to be part of a global-minded company that is inspired to create a better, safer future; and if and want to fight for the good guys and be at the forefront of helping companies protect their most critical assets from today’s cyber adversaries, then you’ve found the right fit at Radware.
Primary Location
IL-IL-Tel Aviv
Work Locations
Radware Israel, Tel Aviv
Job
Information / Cyber Security

job.title: Infrastructure Engineer - Core Systems
job.snippet:
Job Description
Build, operate, and improve production infrastructure, with a focus on AWS, Kubernetes, and CDN and caching systems.
Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across Linux, networking, Kubernetes, and content delivery.
Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management to make deployments consistent and reliable.
Develop monitoring and alerting, investigate production incidents, and implement improvements that prevent recurrence.
Collaborate with development, support, and QA teams to improve infrastructure reliability and performance.
Propose and implement improvements that benefit our infrastructure, teams, and users.
Participate in the team’s on-call rotation to resolve production incidents and restore service availability.
Qualifications
4+ years of experience operating production infrastructure, with strong Linux administration, networking, and troubleshooting skills.
Strong understanding of AWS fundamentals, including compute, networking, load balancing, and auto scaling.
Practical experience administering and troubleshooting production Kubernetes clusters, including cluster upgrades, networking, and scaling.
Experience operating CDN and HTTP caching infrastructure using Varnish, NGINX, or similar technologies, with a solid understanding of HTTP, DNS, TLS, cache behavior, and invalidation.
Experience automating infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Terraform and tools such as Ansible, Chef, or equivalents.
Experience using Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent tools for monitoring, incident investigation, and performance troubleshooting.
Experience with on-premises infrastructure, private clouds, hypervisors, or bare-metal servers is an advantage.
At Wix, we believe our best work happens together. Our work model is fully in person, with 5 days a week from our office. Flexibility remains a core value at Wix and special requests are handled thoughtfully at the team level.
Additional Information
We are Wix’s Infrastructure Guild. We’re at the core of building and maintaining the production and CI/CD environment. Our mission is to improve production performance and resilience to ensure 99.99% uptime for millions of users and drive our developer velocity. We also design, develop and operate cutting-edge services and robust tools for the entire developer community—both Frontend and Backend.
We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Wix was built around the idea that everyone has the right to be successful, online. This same vision defines us as an employer: creating a work environment where everyone is welcome, and anyone has the right to succeed.

עבודה עם מערכות ממוחשבות וכלי עבודה ייעודיים.

גישה טכנית ויכולת למידה מהירה.

job.title: IT Engineer
job.snippet:
Factory 54 (Irani Group) i
s a global fashion and lifestyle group, headquartered in Tel Aviv and Amsterdam, with extensive operations across Israel and Europe. Part of the Irani Group, Factory 54 is one of Israel’s leading luxury fashion and lifestyle retailers.
The company imports, markets, and operates more than 150 international fashion, footwear, accessories, and beauty brands, alongside a large-scale retail operation that includes flagship stores, a leading E-commerce platform, and a premium customer experience.
Our headquarters includes over 450 employees across technology, digital, E-commerce, marketing, logistics, finance, HR, content, PR, and commercial operations. Nearly all core activities are managed in-house, including an advanced technology team of +30 developers driving innovation and smart retail solutions.
We're looking for an
IT Engineer
to join our Technology Department and support, maintain, and improve our IT infrastructure, systems, and daily operations across the organization.
Location:
Tel Aviv, full-time, at least 5 days a week in the office. Reports to the Development Team Lead.
Growth path:
Opportunity to grow into the organization.
Responsibilities
Manage and maintain the company’s on-premise environment, including servers, virtualization, storage, and backup.
Administer Microsoft environments: Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, File Servers, and Windows Server.
Manage and configure network infrastructure, including firewalls, switches, routers, VLANs, VPN, and Wi-Fi, across HQ, logistics centers, and retail branches.
Administer and maintain Check Point firewalls: security policies, NAT, VPN, and troubleshooting.
Ensure network availability and performance for retail operations, including POS connectivity, store communications, and WAN/MPLS/ISP links.
Monitor systems and networks proactively, handle incidents, and perform root cause analysis.
Implement and maintain information security best practices, patch management, and access control.
Plan and execute backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures.
Manage relationships with external vendors, ISPs, and service providers, and oversee SLAs.
Support IT help desk escalations.
Document infrastructure, procedures, and network topology.
Requirements
4+ years of experience in IT infrastructure / network and systems administration.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Active Directory and Windows Server environments –
Proven experience managing Check Point firewalls
Experience with Microsoft 365 / Azure AD (Entra ID) and hybrid environments.
Experience configuring and managing switches and network equipment (Cisco, HP/Aruba, Fortinet, or similar).
Solid understanding of networking: TCP/IP, VLAN, routing, VPN, DNS, DHCP, QoS.
Experience managing on-premise server environments (VMware / Hyper-V).
Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to work under pressure.
Experience in retail, logistics, or multi-branch organizations. -
Advantage
Familiarity with POS and store IT environments. -
Advantage

job.title: AI & Digital Transformation Team Lead
job.snippet:
חטיבת IT באסם‑נסטלה מגייסת מנהל/ת צוות AI וחדשנות דיגיטלית להובלת הטרנספורמציה הדיגיטלית של הארגון בתחום הבינה המלאכותית כיכולת ליבה עסקית וארגונית.
זהו תפקיד אסטרטגי, חוצה ארגון, המשלב הבנה עסקית עמוקה, הובלת שינוי חוצה ארגון, הטמעת טכנולוגיות AI מתקדמות והאצת אימוץ AI בארגון.
התפקיד כולל אחריות רחבה והשפעה מערכתית משמעותית, בשותפות עם ההנהלה הבכירה, האגפים העסקיים ופונקציות המטה.
תחומי אחריות מרכזיים
גיבוש חזון AI ארגוני והובלת אסטרטגיית AI כוללת לאסם‑נסטלה.
בניית מפת דרכים שנתית (AI Roadmap) הכוללת תעדוף יוזמות, יעדים עסקיים ומדדי הצלחה.
הובלת פורטפוליו פרויקטי AI בארגון – משלב זיהוי הצורך העסקי ועד להטמעה בפועל.
ניהול תחום הGovernance בעולם הAI- יישום מדיניות , Responsible AI תוך התייחסות לאבטחת מידע, הגנת הפרטיות ורגולציה, בשיתוף היחידות הרלוונטיות בארגון.
הובלה מקצועית של קהילת AI חוצת ארגון (Center of Excellence) הכוללת נציגי AI ביחידות העסקיות השונות.
שותפות מקצועית עם נסטלה העולמית בתחומי,AI דיגיטל וחדשנות, כולל חיבור ליוזמות גלובליות, שימוש ב‑ Best Practices והטמעת פתרונות וסטנדרטים בינלאומיים בהתאמה לצרכים המקומיים.
שותפות שוטפת עם הנהלה בכירה לזיהוי הזדמנויות, תרגום אתגרים עסקיים לפתרונות AI והצגת ערך עסקי (ROI)
אחריות על פיתוח יכולות AI בארגון, כולל מסלולי הכשרה, הטמעת שגרות עבודה חדשות וקידום תרבות מבוססת נתונים.
דיווח שוטף להנהלת החברה. דרישות התפקיד
ניסיון משמעותי (7+ שנים) בהובלת תהליכי חדשנות, טרנספורמציה או שינוי ארגוני בארגון גדול.
הבנה מעשית בעולמות , Generative AI, אוטומציה וכלי AI עסקיים בסביבת Microsoft.
ניסיון מוכח בעבודה מול הנהלה בכירה וריבוי ממשקים.
יכולות גבוהות בהובלת פרויקטים, תהליכי שינוי, רתימה והשפעה.
השכלה אקדמית רלוונטית – יתרון.
אנגלית ברמה גבוהה

job.title: Full-Stack Engineer | Early-Stage Startup
job.snippet:
About MANNA
MANNA – Recipes & Cooking is building a new home for food, recipes, and culinary creators.
Our platform turns food inspiration from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and the web into recipes people can save, organize, discover, and cook. MANNA also includes personal recipe collections, menus, discovery features, and AI-powered cooking tools.
MANNA has an existing product and technology stack, and we are now expanding the core team to support the company’s next stage of growth.
The Role
We are looking for a
Full-Stack Engineer
to join MANNA’s growing development team and take meaningful ownership of the product’s continued development.
This is a hands-on, early-stage role working as part of the engineering team, in close collaboration with the founder and other team members across the mobile app, backend, APIs, data, infrastructure, and AI integrations.
You will help:
Build and improve core product features
Contribute to technical and architectural decisions
Improve reliability, performance, and maintainability
Develop across mobile and backend systems
Integrate AI-powered capabilities
Help shape the technical roadmap
Establish strong engineering practices as the team grows
The product and backend already exist — this is
not an MVP-from-scratch role
.
Current Technology
Flutter / Dart
Supabase / PostgreSQL
TypeScript / Deno Edge Functions
APIs and third-party integrations
Google Gemini and other AI services
Android & iOS
Experience with the exact stack is helpful but not required. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to work effectively with an existing product are more important.
What We’re Looking For
Strong hands-on software development experience
Experience building and maintaining production software
Good technical judgment and problem-solving skills
Ability to work across product, architecture, and implementation
Experience with mobile, backend, or full-stack development
Familiarity with APIs, databases, and cloud services
High ownership and comfort working in an early-stage environment
Ability to collaborate effectively as part of a growing engineering team
Experience with consumer apps, AI, social products, recommendation systems, or startups is a plus.
Stage & Compensation
This is an
early-stage, equity-based core-team role
.
There is currently
no salary attached to the position
. Equity and vesting will be structured based on responsibility, commitment, experience, and long-term involvement.

job.snippet:
אנו מחפשים מנהל/ת IT ואבטחת מידע בכיר/ה ובעל/ת 'ידיים על', שיוביל/תוביל את פעילות ה-IT של החברה, התשתית הפנימית, פעולות האבטחה ותהליכי הציות. זהו תפקיד בעל אחריות מלאה המשלב תמיכה יומיומית בעובדים עם שיפורי תשתית, ניהול סביבת מיקרוסופט, רשתות AWS בשיתוף פעולה הדוק עם צוותי DevOps, SSO ותחזוקת תקני SOC 2 / ISO 27001.
בתפקיד יחידני זה, תהיה/תהיי אחראי/ת על כלל היבטי ה-IT והאבטחה, תוך התמודדות עם אתגרים טכנולוגיים מגוונים בסביבת SaaS מודרנית. תעבוד/תעבדי עם טכנולוגיות מובילות מבית מיקרוסופט, AWS ופתרונות אבטחה וזהות מתקדמים, ותוודא/תוודאי עמידה בתקני אבטחה בינלאומיים. תפקיד זה אינו תפקיד DevOps.
תחומי האחריות:
ניהול והובלת פעילות IT ארגונית מקצה לקצה, פלטפורמות SaaS, ניהול גישה ותפעול אבטחה.
מתן תמיכת IT מעשית לעובדים, בעיקר בישראל, כולל קליטה, עזיבה, ציוד, חשבונות, הרשאות ורישיונות.
ניהול ומיטוב סביבת מיקרוסופט, כולל Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Intune, Defender, MFA ומדיניות אבטחה.
ניהול ושיפור רשתות ארגוניות, כולל VPN, Wi-Fi, גישה מרחוק וקישוריות.
עבודה צמודה עם צוותי DevOps בנושאי רשת ותשתית ב-AWS, כולל VPCs, Subnets, Route Tables ו-Security Groups.
תחזוקה ומוכנות לתקני SOC 2 ו-ISO 27001, כולל איסוף ראיות, מדיניות, בקרות וביקורות.
זהו תפקיד מאתגר ובעל השפעה רבה, המאפשר צמיחה מקצועית משמעותית והובלת תחום קריטי בחברה. הצטרף/הצטרפי לצוות דינמי שמעריך מקצועיות, חדשנות ואחריות אישית.

job.title: Project Finance Analyst
job.snippet:
Location:
Ramat Gan, Jabotinsky St. 2, Atrium Building
Position Type:
Full-time position.
Work Model:
On-site.
About us
Energix Renewables is a publicly traded, global renewable energy company operating across the United States, Poland, and Israel. Since its founding in 2009, Energix has grown into one of Israel's leading renewable energy platforms, driven by long-term vision, operational excellence, and a commitment to sustainable impact. We operate as a fully integrated renewable energy company, leading the entire lifecycle of solar (PV), wind, and energy storage projects - from origination and development through construction and long-term ownership. As listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and as part of the Alony-Hetz Group, Energix combines financial strength, global scale, and entrepreneurial spirit to accelerate the transition to clean energy worldwide.
About the role
Energix is seeking a highly motivated and analytical Project Finance Analyst to join its Project Finance team. The role provides an opportunity to work on large-scale and complex financing transactions, primarily in the renewable energy sector, and to be involved throughout the full financing process—from financial analysis and structuring through due diligence, documentation, and financial closing. This is a demanding, hands-on position that requires strong analytical capabilities, attention to detail, excellent English, and a high level of commitment. The successful candidate will work closely with our Project Finance teams across the different markets in which we operate, as well as with financial institutions, investors, advisors, and other external counterparties on significant financing transactions. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, taking ownership of complex assignments, and putting in the effort required to successfully execute major transactions.
Key Responsibilities
Support the structuring and execution of large-scale project finance transactions, including debt and tax equity financings.
Build, review, and analyze complex financial models, including debt sizing, tax equity structures, sensitivities, and financing scenarios.
Participate in all stages of financing transactions, from initial structuring and lender/investor discussions through due diligence, documentation, and financial close.
Analyze project economics, financing alternatives, transaction structures, and key commercial and financial risks.
Coordinate and work closely with banks, investors, legal counsel, financial advisors, consultants, and other transaction counterparties.
Manage and analyze significant amounts of financial, commercial, technical, and contractual information as part of transaction due diligence.
Review financing documentation and support the negotiation and execution of key commercial and financial terms.
Work closely with Energix's business development, legal, engineering, accounting, and management teams to successfully execute transactions.
Prepare financial analyses, presentations, transaction materials, and management updates.
Take ownership of assigned workstreams and deliver accurate, high-quality work under tight deadlines.
Support multiple transactions and priorities simultaneously in a high-intensity, execution-oriented environment.
Requirements
Prior experience in project finance – minimum 2 years.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or another relevant quantitative field.
Excellent analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to understand and analyze complex financial and commercial issues.
Strong financial modeling and Excel skills.
Excellent English, both written and spoken – required. The role involves extensive interaction, documentation, and negotiations in English.
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy and quality.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage demanding workloads and tight transaction deadlines.
Strong work ethic and willingness to put in the effort required to execute complex financing transactions.
Ability to independently manage tasks and take ownership while working effectively as part of a broader transaction team.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Experience working with international banks, investors, or financing transactions – an advantage.
Experience in renewable energy or infrastructure financing – an advantage.
Employment Type:
Full-time position.
On-site work from the company's offices.

As listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and as part of the Alony-Hetz Group, Energix combines financial strength, global scale, and entrepreneurial spirit to accelerate the transition to clean energy worldwide.
About the role
Energix is seeking a highly motivated and analytical Project Finance Analyst to join its Project Finance team. The role provides an opportunity to work on large-scale and complex financing transactions, primarily in the renewable energy sector, and to be involved throughout the full financing process—from financial analysis and structuring through due diligence, documentation, and financial closing. This is a demanding, hands-on position that requires strong analytical capabilities, attention to detail, excellent English, and a high level of commitment. The successful candidate will work closely with our Project Finance teams across the different markets in which we operate, as well as with financial institutions, investors, advisors, and other external counterparties on significant financing transactions. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, taking ownership of complex assignments, and putting in the effort required to successfully execute major transactions.
Key Responsibilities
Support the structuring and execution of large-scale project finance transactions, including debt and tax equity financings.
Build, review, and analyze complex financial models, including debt sizing, tax equity structures, sensitivities, and financing scenarios.
Participate in all stages of financing transactions, from initial structuring and lender/investor discussions through due diligence, documentation, and financial close.
Analyze project economics, financing alternatives, transaction structures, and key commercial and financial risks.
Coordinate and work closely with banks, investors, legal counsel, financial advisors, consultants, and other transaction counterparties.
Manage and analyze significant amounts of financial, commercial, technical, and contractual information as part of transaction due diligence.
Review financing documentation and support the negotiation and execution of key commercial and financial terms.
Work closely with Energix's business development, legal, engineering, accounting, and management teams to successfully execute transactions.
Prepare financial analyses, presentations, transaction materials, and management updates.
Take ownership of assigned workstreams and deliver accurate, high-quality work under tight deadlines.
Support multiple transactions and priorities simultaneously in a high-intensity, execution-oriented environment.
Requirements
Prior experience in project finance – minimum 2 years.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or another relevant quantitative field.
Excellent analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to understand and analyze complex financial and commercial issues.
Strong financial modeling and Excel skills.
Excellent English, both written and spoken – required. The role involves extensive interaction, documentation, and negotiations in English.
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy and quality.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage demanding workloads and tight transaction deadlines.
Strong work ethic and willingness to put in the effort required to execute complex financing transactions.
Ability to independently manage tasks and take ownership while working effectively as part of a broader transaction team.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Experience working with international banks, investors, or financing transactions – an advantage.
Experience in renewable energy or infrastructure financing – an advantage.
Employment Type:
Full-time position.
On-site work from the company's offices.

job.title: Director of Engineering
job.snippet:
We are seeking an exceptional
Engineering Leader
to direct and scale our high-throughput, revenue-critical platform engine. In this hands-on executive position, you will lead a lean, highly senior engineering organization where architecture directly impacts bottom-line business metrics. Working at the intersection of conversion optimization, distributed systems, and modern AI-driven development, you will balance deep technical execution with strategic commercial ownership.
Core Responsibilities
Commercial Impact & Conversion Ownership:
Drive engineering strategies that optimize funnel velocity, data intake quality, and conversion yields. Partner with product leadership to eliminate efficiency leaks across the technology stack.
Hands-on Technical Leadership:
Maintain high technical currency by designing critical system architecture, writing core platform components, leading incident responses, and prototyping next-generation features.
AI-First Software Delivery:
Deeply integrate modern AI coding assistants, autonomous agents, and AI-native workflows into the R&D lifecycle (targeting 50-70% AI-assisted execution).
System Health Tracking & Resilience:
Establish robust Service Level Objectives (SLOs), automated telemetry, and proactive system health tracking to identify quiet operational failures before they impact business partners.
Team Scaling & Engineering Culture:
Build, mentor, and elevate a high-density team of senior engineers, maintaining elite talent standards and fostering high accountability.
Architectural Prudence:
Make high-stakes architectural decisions that balance rapid deployment with long-term maintainability, managing technical debt strategically.
What You’ll Bring
10+ years
of total software engineering experience, with at least
5+ years
in direct engineering leadership roles.
Commercial Mission-Criticality:
Proven experience running engineering for platforms where system failures carry immediate financial implications (e.g., high-volume transaction processing, ad-tech, billing, lead-gen engines, or digital checkout ecosystems).
Polyglot Technical Mastery:
Strong architectural judgment across diverse backend and data stacks (Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, SQL, and modern cloud infrastructure).
AI Tooling Mastery:
Advanced practical expertise leveraging state-of-the-art AI development tools and agents to radically accelerate development velocity.
Commercial Acumen:
Strong fluency in digital business metrics—unit economics, conversion performance, user acquisition flows, and LTV/margin dynamics.
Team Construction Track Record:
Demonstrated success building high-performing R&D teams from scratch, raising engineering bars, and managing performance proactively.

job.title: Director Of Supply Chain
job.snippet:
At
D-Fend Solutions
, our people are our greatest strength — and technology is our passion. Our team of innovators and subject matter experts, including veterans of elite military intelligence technology units, is transforming the way organizations protect themselves from drone threats.
As the global leader in
cyber-takeover counter-drone technology
, we design and deliver advanced, software-defined solutions that empower our customers to detect, take control, and safely land unauthorized drones — with precision and reliability.
Every day, we push the boundaries of innovation to meet real-world security challenges across industries and environments. We’re proud of our cutting-edge technology, our global reach, and the impact we make in securing the skies.
We’re seeking passionate professionals who thrive in a fast-paced, creative, and collaborative environment — those who want to be part of the next generation of airspace security innovation.
Join D-Fend Solutions and help make the world a safer place.
Become a D-Fender!
Work with the world’s leading cyber-takeover counter-drone technology provider and shape the future of safe airspace.
We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and hands-on Director of Supply Chain to lead end-to-end supply chain operations for mission-critical defense hardware products. Reporting directly to the VP Operations, you will be responsible for orchestrating a complex global supply chain ecosystem that spans multiple Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) facilities, and Third-Party Logistics (3PL) hubs globally, and internal operational departments including Supply Planning, Logistics & Warehouse Management, and Import/Export Compliance.
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in high-reliability manufacturing, advanced multi-site EMS governance, strict international trade compliance (ITAR/EAR), and proven leadership in scaling complex supply chain operations.
Key Responsibilities & Core Accountabilities
Supply & Operations Planning (SIOP/S&OP): Own the global Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, aligning commercial demand forecasts with manufacturing capacity. Lead the Planning department in developing robust Master Production Schedules (MPS), Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and material availability strategies for long-lead mechanical and electronic components
Global EMS Management & Governance: Direct oversight and operational accountability for global EMS manufacturing partners. Drive capacity planning, production scheduling, on-time delivery (OTD), first-pass yield, and cost optimization across all sites
3PL & International Warehousing: Manage global 3PL operations across 2 international sites. Optimize inventory positioning, warehouse throughput, buffer stock management, and hub-and-spoke distribution networks
Leadership: Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing supply chain team covering, planning, CM management, inventory and logistics. Establish robust supply chain analytics, KPIs (OTD, inventory turns, lead times), and digital tools AI/ERP integrations
Logistics & Warehouse Operations: Direct internal warehouse management teams, receiving/kitting workflows, inventory accuracy (cycle counts), and internal logistics to support production execution
Trade Compliance & Import/Export: Lead the Import/Export department to guarantee 100% regulatory compliance with ITAR, EAR, ECCN classifications, Country of Origin (COO) rules, customs clearance, and military export licenses across operating jurisdictions
Strategic Planning & Component Risk Mitigation: Develop active risk mitigation strategies for long-lead electronic components, single/sole-source items, and End-of-Life (EoL) parts to safeguard production continuity
Efficiency and KPI Driving: Establish and drive rigorous supply chain KPIs (OTD, Inventory Turns, Schedule Attainment, Freight Cost % of Sales, Carrying Costs) and lead continuous cost reduction initiatives
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, Sales, Operations Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and Production leads during New Product Introduction (NPI) to ensure design-for-supply-chain readiness and smooth transitions
Qualifications & Technical Requirements:
Education: B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related technical field. Master's degree or MBA is highly preferred
Experience: 15+ years of progressive supply chain leadership experience in high-tech manufacturing, with Defense, Aerospace, or Mission-Critical Hardware industry (advantage)
EMS & 3PL Expertise: Proven track record managing international EMS partners (tier-1/tier-2) and global 3PL logistics facilities across multiple countries
Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge: Deep working knowledge of military trade regulations (ITAR, EAR), customs procedures, ECCN, and international import/export laws.( advantage)
Technical Hardware Literacy: Strong understanding of complex electro-mechanical hardware assemblies, PCBAs, mechanical enclosures, and long-lead component sourcing
Location & Presence: Ability to work on-site at our corporate offices in Ra'anana, Israel, with occasional global travel to vendor and manufacturing sites
Languages: Native/Fluent Hebrew and full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken)
ERP/MRP & Systems Proficiency: Expertise in tier-1 ERP systems (Netsuite, SAP, Oracle, Priority) and advanced PLM/WMS systems
Expected Performance Metrics (KPIs):
Delivery Performance: On-Time Delivery (OTD) > 95% across all sites and customer order fulfillments
Inventory Optimization: Achieve target inventory turns while maintaining zero line-down events due to material shortages
Demand Planning, Inventory & Logistics
Own the global Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, aligning commercial demand forecasts with manufacturing capacity and material availability
Optimize inventory levels across multiple hubs to balance cash flow, lead-time reduction, and target customer fulfillment levels
Oversee international trade compliance, import/export controls, customs clearance, freight optimization, and global logistics networks
Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment
Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing supply chain team covering, planning, CM management, inventory and logistics
Establish robust supply chain analytics, KPIs (OTD, inventory turns, lead times), and digital tools AI/ERP integrations
3PL & Warehouse Efficiency: Order fulfillment SLA > 98% and inventory count accuracy > 99.5%
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

job.title: Mechanical Engineer - Maker
job.snippet:
About Us
Tevel develops autonomous flying robots for fruit harvesting, combining drones, AI and robotics to address the labor shortage in agriculture.
About the Role
We are looking for a curious, creative and hands-on Maker to join our development team and play a key role in developing, improving and testing our products and technologies, from concept to field. This is a role for doers: someone who enjoys taking things apart, building, improving, and finding creative solutions for the company's future products.
Responsibilities
Design, build and assemble prototypes and mechanical assemblies for drones
Develop and continuously improve mechanisms, structures and mechanical interfaces
Manufacture parts using a variety of technologies, such as 3D printing, machining and composite materials
Conduct tests and experiments, and troubleshoot issues in the lab and in the field
Work closely with software, mechanical, electronics and field operations teams
Propose new ideas and solutions to improve performance, reliability and maintainability
Requirements
Mechanical engineering technician or mechanical engineer
Hands-on experience with drones or RC aircraft (professional or as a serious hobby)
Experience in robotics, product development and prototyping
Proficiency in SolidWorks or equivalent
Experience with workshop tools, 3D printing and manufacturing processes
Ability to work independently as well as part of a team in a dynamic environment
Advantages
Familiarity with propulsion systems, flight controllers and basic electronics
Experience working with composite materials
Field experience or background in the agricultural industry
Participation in robotics competitions, independent projects or Maker communities
Mental flexibility: adapts quickly to change and enjoys unfamiliar challenges
Creative, out-of-the-box thinker with a bent for practical solutions
Positive attitude, initiative and a strong sense of commitment
Curious and a fast learner, with a genuine passion for technology and building

job.title: Commissioning Engineer – Data Centers
job.snippet:
‏מגייסים מנהל/ת CxA (Commissioning Authority)
‏חברת הנדסה וייעוץ טכנולוגי מובילה, המתמחה בתכנון ובניהול פרויקטים רחבי היקף של מתקנים קריטיים וחוות שרתים לעידן ה-AI, מגייסת מנהל/ת CxA. החברה מלווה ארגונים מובילים מהמגזר הציבורי, הביטחוני והעסקי, בישראל ובעולם.‏
תיאור התפקיד‏
‏התפקיד כולל הובלה של תהליכי ה-Commissioning בפרויקטים של חוות שרתים ומתקנים קריטיים, ואחריות מלאה על תהליך ה-Cx לאורך כל מחזור חיי הפרויקט: מהתכנון ועד המסירה והתפעול.‏
‏תחומי אחריות‏
‏▪️ הובלת תהליך ה-Commissioning בכל השלבים (L1–L5), מהתכנון ועד ה-IST‏
‏▪️ כתיבת Cx Plan, ביצוע OPR/BOD Review והכנת תוכניות בדיקה (FAT, SAT, Functional Tests, IST)‏
‏▪️ ביקורת תכנון בהיבטי Cx ואמינות, וזיהוי סיכונים ונקודות כשל‏
‏▪️ תיאום וניהול ממשקים מול מתכננים, קבלנים, ספקים ונציגי הלקוח‏
‏▪️ ניהול Issues Log ומעקב אחר ליקויים עד לסגירתם‏
‏▪️ הפקת דוחות סטטוס, דוחות בדיקה ותיק מסירה (Cx Final Report)‏
‏▪️ ניהול צוות מהנדסי Cx, ובקרה על איכות העבודה ועל עמידה בלוחות הזמנים‏
דרישות חובה‏
‏▪️ תואר מהנדס/ת בחשמל, במכונות או בתחום רלוונטי אחר‏
‏▪️ הסמכה מקצועית בתחום ה-Commissioning (CxA, CCP או מקבילה)‏
‏▪️ ניסיון של 5 שנים לפחות בתחום המערכות במתקנים קריטיים‏
‏▪️ ניסיון מוכח בביצוע Commissioning בחוות שרתים או במתקנים קריטיים‏
‏▪️ ניסיון בפרויקטים בהיקף של מעל 5MW‏
‏▪️ ניסיון בעבודה עם תוכנות Cx כגון CxAlloy‏

job.snippet:
For a Leading, Established, and Innovative Cosmetics & Brand, We Are Looking for a Product Development Specialist
Are you looking for a meaningful role in the cosmetics industry where you can have a real impact on products from the idea stage through to launch?
This is your opportunity to join a leading company and manage end-to-end product development processes.
What Will You Do?
Develop and lead product concepts in line with marketing strategy and market trends.
Work closely with manufacturers and suppliers in Israel and abroad.
Adapt formulations to components and packaging (stability, compatibility, and performance).
Build and manage complete product files (specifications, ingredients, regulatory documentation, and costs).
Manage and monitor product costs and pricing processes.
Oversee quality, stability, and product performance testing through to launch.
Requirements:
Relevant degree in Chemistry, Biology, or a related field.
1-2 years of experience in cosmetic product development – mandatory.
Experience working with packaging/components and matching them to formulations.
Familiarity with regulatory requirements and product file processes.
Experience writing professional briefs.
Ability to analyze costs and manage pricing processes.
If beauty and product development run through your veins, this is the place for you!

job.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
job.snippet:
Company Overview:
Manta Air is a leading developer of parachute recovery systems for military and civil UAVs. With over 20 years of expertise, we deliver innovative, reliable solutions from design and prototyping to production and field testing.
Role Description:
We are seeking a skilled Mechanical Design Engineer to join our innovative R&D team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating detailed mechanical designs and drawings for our recovery systems, ensuring precision, functionality, and manufacturability. You will collaborate closely with testing teams, production teams, and other stakeholders to turn concepts into high-quality products, supporting the full product development cycle from concept to production release.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop detailed mechanical designs, CAD models, and engineering drawings.
Translate engineering concepts and requirements into manufacturable designs.
Support prototyping, testing, and validation activities.
Collaborate with production to ensure smooth transition from design to manufacturing.
Maintain accurate documentation and version control of design files.
Qualifications:
Formal engineering education or equivalent practical experience in mechanical design.
2+ years of experience in mechanical design and drafting.
Proficiency in SolidWorks and CAD tools.
Knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and tolerances.
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
Skills and Attributes:
Ability to manage multiple design tasks simultaneously.
Hands-on experience in prototyping and assembly.
Creative approach to solving technical challenges.
Background in RC modeling is a plus.
Familiarity with 3D-printed prototyping.
Why Join Manta Air?
Make an impact in aerospace innovation.
Work on mission-critical UAV systems.
Be part of a small, agile, and supportive team.
Manta Air is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
Location: Industrial Park, Caesarea
Employment Type: Full-time

תיאור משרה
תיאור התפקיד:
אנו מחפשים מפעיל/ה לצוות תחנה המונה כ 20 עובדים שמחציתם מפעילים/ות.
המפעיל\ה יחלק את יומו בין ישיבה בחדר הבקרה לבחינת מדדים במערכות השונות לבין יציאה לאתר עצמו, סיור בתחנה וביצוע משימות שונות.
אנו מחפשים אדם שמחפש/ת עבודה לטווח ארוך, מוצא/ת שתחום האנרגיה מרתק, אוהב/ת לעבוד בצוות ובמשמרות, אדם שמחפש/ת את הבית השני שלו.
העבודה כוללת:
* סיורים באתר עצמו לרבות עלייה במדרגות צפות וכמו כן ישיבה בחדר הבקרה לצפייה במסכים.
* באחריות המפעיל/ה לעקוב על תהליכים שונים המתבטאים בחדר הבקרה
* העבודה מחולקת באופן כללי ל- 30% שהות בחדר הבקרה ומעקב אחריי מדדים ובקרים במערכות השונות
* וכן 70% סיורים באתר התחנה, מעקב אחר צ'ק ליסט למשימות השונות, ביצוע בדיקות ודגימות שונות ברחבי התחנה.
* אחריות לביצוע פרוצדורות טכניות שונות, הכוללות ניתוח מידע ועריכת דוחות על בסיס המידע שנאסף.
* יכולת לעבודת צוות הכוללת שיתוף מידע ועדכונים שוטפים. יודגש כי התפקיד תחת ראש צוות.
* ביצוע עבודות אחזקה בסיסיות הקשורות למתקן עצמו.
* משמרות: יום ולילה הכוללות עבודה בשבתות וחגים - חובה.
הגעה עצמאית.
דרישות התפקיד
* השכלה טכנולוגית: לימודים טכנולוגיים בתחומים כמו חשמל, מכונות, מכנטרוניקה, מכשור, כימיה או אלקטרוניקה - יתרון.
* ניסיון בעבודה במשמרות - חובה.
* ניסיון קודם: ניסיון כמפעיל/ה או ראש/ת צוות הפעלה במפעלים תהליכיים או תחנות כוח - יתרון.
* ניסיון בתחום טורבינות: ניסיון בטורבינות גז, קיטור, משאבות, גנראטורים או מדחסי אוויר - יתרון.
* נדרש ידע טכני קודם, לרבות ניסיון אישי.
* היכרות עם מערכות DCS : הכרות עם מערכות מחשוב ומידע תהליכי.
* עבודה בסביבה ממוחשבת עם שליטה בסיסית בתוכנות Office ומערכות מידע טכניות.
* אנגלית ברמה טובה- חובה
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

אשדוד

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
מהנדס/ת או הנדסאי/ת בקרה ומכשור לתפקיד Resident Engineer משמעותי ומאתגר בתחנת כוח באשדוד.
התפקיד מהווה חלק ממערך השירות של החברה וכולל עבודה בסביבה טכנולוגית מתקדמת עם מערכות בקרה ומכשור של טורבינות גז.
במסגרת התפקיד תהיה/,תהיי בעל אחריות מקצועית ישירה על איתור, אבחון ופתרון תקלות,
ביצוע תחזוקה ותמיכה טכנית במערכות קריטיות, תוך עבודה מול הלקוח ובשיתוף פעולה שוטף עם צוותי מומחים בארץ ובחו"ל.
תחומי אחריות :
איתור, אבחון ופתרון תקלות מורכבות במערכות בקרה ומכשור.
עבודה מעשית עם מערכות PLC/HMI, כולל קריאת לוגיקות בקרה, דיאגנוסטיקה ואיתור תקלות.
עבודה עם חיישנים, משדרים (Transmitters), שסתומי בקרה ומערכות עזר תעשייתיות.
ביצוע תחזוקה מונעת ומתקנת במערכות קריטיות.
ביצוע בדיקות פונקציונליות, שינויים והתאמות במערכות בקרה.
ביצוע תהליכי דיאגנוסטיקה ו-Root Cause Analysis לצורך ניתוח תקלות ומניעת הישנותן.
תמיכה בפעילויות Commissioning, Start-up והשבתות מתוכננות.
מתן מענה טכני מקצועי ושוטף ללקוח באתר.
עבודה משותפת עם צוותי Engineering ו-Product Support בישראל ובחו"ל.
הכנת דוחות טכניים ותיעוד פעילויות השירות.
השתתפות בכוננויות ומתן מענה לקריאות שירות בהתאם לצורכי האתר.
דרישות התפקיד
מהנדס/ת או הנדסאי/ת חשמל, בקרה, מכשור, אלקטרוניקה, מכטרוניקה או תחום טכני רלוונטי.
ניסיון מעשי בתחומי בקרה, מכשור, אחזקה או שירות בסביבה תעשייתית.
ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות PLC/HMI קריאת לוגיקות בקרה, דיאגנוסטיקה ואיתור תקלות.
היכרות מעשית עם מכשור תעשייתי, חיישנים, Transmitters ושסתומי בקרה.
יכולת קריאה והבנה של שרטוטי חשמל, בקרה ומכשור.
יכולת עצמאית לאיתור ופתרון תקלות, מהציוד בשטח ועד למערכת הבקרה.
אוריינטציה טכנית גבוהה ויכולת Hands-On.
אנגלית טכנית ברמה טובה מאוד, קריאה, כתיבה ודיבור.
התפקיד כולל השתתפות בסבב כוננויות והקפצות לאתר, לרבות בשעות לא שגרתיות, סופי שבוע וחגים.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.title: Director of Construction – Europe
job.snippet: Description: We are looking for a Director of Construction – Europe to lead a team of project managers delivering large-scale solar, wind, and energy storage projects across multiple European countries. The role requires multidisciplinary management expertise spanning infrastructure, engineering, finance, and commercial aspects. | Responsibilities: Lead the team of project managers responsible for large-scale solar, wind, and energy storage projects, from financial close through construction, commissioning, and commercial operation (COD). Own the department’s project budgets, including budget development, cost control, monitoring, and forecasting. Lead cross-functional collaboration with internal teams, including Development, Engineering, Procurement, and Finance, and with external stakeholders, including contractors, global equipment suppliers, owner’s engineers, project management and supervision firms, and business partners. Monitor key project milestones, identify contractual risks and exposures, and lead negotiation strategies to proactively resolve issues and protect the company’s interests. Represent the projects and regularly report on their status and progress to senior management, partners, and other stakeholders. | Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering, or another relevant field – required. At least 10 years of experience managing renewable energy and/or infrastructure projects, including civil works, electrical infrastructure (including substations and grid connection), and the management of contractors, consultants, and engineering designers – required. Proven experience managing international projects across multiple countries – required. Experience managing budgets and the financial and commercial aspects of complex infrastructure projects – required. Proven experience leading and developing teams of project managers – required. Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and workstreams simultaneously. Strong technical orientation combined with strategic, big-picture thinking. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and MS Project – required. Full professional proficiency in English, both spoken and written – required. Willingness and ability to travel frequently to project sites across Europe. Experience working remotely with geographically distributed teams and/or collaborating with Israeli companies – an advantage.

job.title: Junior Software Engineer
job.snippet:
Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company!
As a Junior Software Engineer in the Emerging Growth group in our Tel Aviv office, you'll play a vital role in building one of Taboola's newest and most strategic growth domains: a self-service platform that lets advertisers and partners independently build, optimize and scale their campaigns.
We're an AI-native team. AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor are part of how we design, build, test, review and operate our systems every day, and we build our own agents, skills and automated workflows on top of them. We're looking for someone early in their career who learns fast, takes on new languages and challenges without hesitation, and uses AI to multiply their impact.
Our Tech Stack
AI: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, MCP, Langfuse and much more
Backend: Java, Spring, Python, Kafka, MySQL, Cassandra, Vertica, HDFS, BigQuery, Druid, Docker, K8S, Grafana
Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS, Jest, Playwright
To Thrive In This Role, You'll Need
B.Sc in Computer Science or equivalent
1–2 years of hands-on software development experience in a production environment, as an intern, in a student position or full-time
Hands-on AI: you use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) as part of your daily development workflow, and you know how to check and verify what they produce
Fast learner: you pick up new languages, frameworks and domains quickly, and you aren't afraid to dive into what you don't know
The ability to juggle several workstreams and switch context well, including coordinating multiple AI agents working in parallel
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
A product-driven mindset and a passion for working close to the business
Bonus Points If You Have
Experience with Java or other object-oriented languages (C#, Kotlin, C++ or similar)
Experience building AI agents, MCP servers, custom skills or automated workflows on top of AI coding tools
Full-stack experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML and CSS
Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (MySQL, Vertica, Cassandra)
Exposure to large-scale distributed systems, Kafka, Docker or Kubernetes
Experience with big data tools (Spark, BigQuery, Airflow)
Graduated with honors
How You'll Make An Impact
Have end-to-end ownership: design, build, ship, measure and maintain frontend and backend services in a brand-new product domain
Work AI-first: use AI coding agents every day to plan, code, test, review and debug, often running several agents in parallel on different tasks
Build AI agents, skills and workflows that multiply the team's capabilities, such as automated code reviews, data analysis, production investigation and feature validation
Develop at unimaginable scale, serving thousands of requests per second
Influence directly on the way billions of people discover the internet
Collaborate closely with the brightest engineers, product managers and business teams
Work on innovative projects that are the next growth engines for Taboola
Why Taboola?
About
If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:
Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.
Well-being: Enjoy comprehensive benefits and well-being programs tailored to the region, a fully stocked kitchen, and location-specific perks.
Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office, with an option to come in more often if desired.
Work with some of the biggest names: Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Condé Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Honda, Pinterest, and Expedia.
Ready to realize your potential?
Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.
Learn more about #TaboolaLife on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, & the Taboola Life Blog.
About Taboola
Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.
Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.

job.title: Controller
job.snippet:
Landa seeks an enthusiastic Controller to join its Finance department and oversee accounting operations. In this role, you will be responsible for financial and tax reporting for multiple subsidiaries and support consolidation-level reporting.
Responsibilities:
Manage the monthly and quarterly financial closing processes, including quality control over financial transactions and financial reporting.
In charge of bookkeeping and supporting day-to-day finance operations of multiple subsidiaries, including communication with external accounting firms.
Review the monthly account reconciliations, including preparing more complex and critical month-end journal entries.
Monitor and review inventory transactions.
Support complex accounting matters that require judgment.
Assist in developing, implementing and maintaining key financial policies and procedures.
Responsibility for multiple subsidiaries' statutory reporting and filing requirements, including required tax filing.
Assist with ongoing tax matters.
Support for projects, including automation projects and process improvements.
Requirements:
CPA from a Big 4 accounting firm
Experience of up to 2-3 years in the high-tech industry – advantage
Experience in inventory and COGS accounting – advantage
Knowledge and experience in IFRS
Strong analytical skills
Knowledge and experience working with ERP systems – specifically QAD – advantage
Experience with general ledger functions and month/quarter/year-end close processes
Strong software skills with knowledge of Excel
Attributes:
Strong and proactive team player
Excellent interpersonal skills
Ability to work in fast-paced work environment and work under pressure
Attention to detail and good time management skills
Strong organizational skills
Fluency in English (spoken and written) – must

job.title: Mechanical Engineer
job.snippet:
About the Job
Thank you for your interest in Krausz Industries, part of Mueller Water Products.
About Krausz Industries
Krausz Industries, the repair and installation business unit of Mueller Water Products, is based in Israel and develops innovative products for the repair and installation of water infrastructure.
For more than 165 years, Mueller Water Products has been developing products and solutions that help communities deliver clean, safe drinking water. Driven by a commitment to innovation, excellence, and safety, Mueller brings together teams across its businesses to address critical water infrastructure challenges and make a lasting impact.
The Opportunity
We are looking for an
experienced
Mechanical Engineer
to join our Product Development team and take ownership of the mechanical design and development of innovative products for critical water infrastructure.
This is a hands-on engineering role offering the opportunity to work across the entire product development process, from initial concept and design through validation and transfer to manufacturing, while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and seeing your work translated into real-world solutions.
What You’ll Do
Take ownership of the mechanical design and development of products, components, and mechanisms, from initial concept through design validation and transfer to manufacturing (NPI).
Develop new products and improve existing products by applying innovative engineering solutions.
Ensure compliance with technical requirements, applicable standards, and safety regulations throughout the product lifecycle.
Perform engineering calculations, analyses, and simulations, as well as cost and risk assessments.
Select appropriate manufacturing and assembly technologies, incorporating standard components and design-for-manufacturing principles.
Collaborate closely with Engineering, Project Management, Product Management, Procurement, Quality, and Operations.
Support manufacturing processes and the introduction of new products into production.
Identify and implement product and component improvements.
What You’ll Bring
B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering – required; M.Sc. – an advantage.
At least 5 years of experience in mechanical product development within an industrial environment.
Strong knowledge of mechanical design and strength of materials.
Proficiency in SolidWorks, including advanced modules such as Simulation and PDM.
Experience with engineering calculations, simulations, and technical analyses.
Proven experience in New Product Introduction (NPI), from development through transfer to manufacturing.
Knowledge of manufacturing technologies involving metal, plastic, and rubber components.
High-level English, both written and spoken.
Advantages
Experience with 3D scanning and 3D printing.
Familiarity with Priority ERP.
Position Details
Location:
Rosh HaAyin, Israel
Work Model:
Hybrid

job.title: IT & Technical Support Specialist
job.snippet:
About MAX Security
MAX Security provides intelligence, protection, and operational support for organizations operating in complex and high-risk environments.
With a global network, 24/7 monitoring capabilities, and experienced intelligence and operations teams, MAX helps decision-makers understand risk, protect people and assets, and respond effectively when conditions change.
Services include real-time intelligence, custom risk reporting, protective intelligence, executive and traveler protection, crisis response, contingency planning, and on-ground support in over 160 countries.
MAX works with corporate security teams, business continuity leaders, travel risk managers, family offices, and executives who require trusted information, reliable support, and precise action in high-stakes situations.
We’re looking for a hands-on
IT & Technical Support Specialist
to join our team in Tel Aviv.
This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys solving problems, working across different IT environments, and being the go-to person when something needs to work — quickly, smoothly, and securely.
You’ll support our employees and IT environment across Microsoft 365, end-user devices, networking, security tools, and infrastructure, while working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
What you’ll do
Provide day-to-day Help Desk and technical support to employees.
Install, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain end-user workstations.
Manage and support the company’s Microsoft 365 environment, including:
Microsoft Entra ID
OneDrive & SharePoint
Microsoft 365 Admin Center
Outlook / Exchange Admin
Intune
Microsoft Defender
Microsoft Purview
Microsoft Security Center and Mail & Collaboration
Support Google Workspace tools, including Gmail and Google Drive.
Troubleshoot network and connectivity issues.
Maintain switches, perform firmware upgrades, activate network ports, and support network infrastructure.
Perform basic PC hardware troubleshooting and maintenance.
Support additional IT, infrastructure, and information security systems.
Requirements
What we’re looking for
At least 1 year of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID.
Strong technical troubleshooting skills.
Practical knowledge of networking and IT infrastructure.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks at the same time.
A proactive, resourceful, and service-oriented approach.
Strong self-learning skills and the ability to meet deadlines.
Fluent spoken English – mandatory, with good written English.
Nice to have
Experience with UniFi.
Familiarity with Check Point 9200.
Experience with CCTV and access control systems.
Experience with Windows Server 2022 or later.
System administration experience.
Experience with Linux servers.
Familiarity with accounting software such as Hashavshevet, Hashavit, or Kol Naton.
If you’re someone who likes to understand how things work, solve technical challenges, and take ownership from issue to resolution, we’d love to hear from you.
The position is open to all genders.

This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys solving problems, working across different IT environments, and being the go-to person when something needs to work — quickly, smoothly, and securely.
You’ll support our employees and IT environment across Microsoft 365, end-user devices, networking, security tools, and infrastructure, while working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
What you’ll do
Provide day-to-day Help Desk and technical support to employees.
Install, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain end-user workstations.
Manage and support the company’s Microsoft 365 environment, including:
Microsoft Entra ID
OneDrive & SharePoint
Microsoft 365 Admin Center
Outlook / Exchange Admin
Intune
Microsoft Defender
Microsoft Purview
Microsoft Security Center and Mail & Collaboration
Support Google Workspace tools, including Gmail and Google Drive.
Troubleshoot network and connectivity issues.
Maintain switches, perform firmware upgrades, activate network ports, and support network infrastructure.
Perform basic PC hardware troubleshooting and maintenance.
Support additional IT, infrastructure, and information security systems.
Requirements
What we’re looking for
At least 1 year of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID.
Strong technical troubleshooting skills.
Practical knowledge of networking and IT infrastructure.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks at the same time.
A proactive, resourceful, and service-oriented approach.
Strong self-learning skills and the ability to meet deadlines.
Fluent spoken English – mandatory, with good written English.
Nice to have
Experience with UniFi.
Familiarity with Check Point 9200.
Experience with CCTV and access control systems.
Experience with Windows Server 2022 or later.
System administration experience.
Experience with Linux servers.
Familiarity with accounting software such as Hashavshevet, Hashavit, or Kol Naton.
If you’re someone who likes to understand how things work, solve technical challenges, and take ownership from issue to resolution, we’d love to hear from you.
The position is open to all genders.

job.title: HRIS Specialist
job.snippet:
We are hiring
HRIS Specialist
will take ownership of Zim’s global Human Capital Management (HCM) platform, workforce structure management, data integrity, and HR systems interfaces. The HRIS Specialist will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth functioning of our HR systems, managing accurate employee data and supporting various HR processes across the organization.
Main Tasks:
HR Information Systems Management
Oversee the administration, implementation, configuration, and maintenance of the global HCM platform and HR information systems (HRIS), ensuring data accuracy, system availability, and user support.
Troubleshooting Systems Bugs
Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, analyse problems, and lead technical solutions in collaboration with implementors, development and support teams.
Data Integrity and Compliance
Establish data governance practices to maintain the integrity and accuracy of HR data within the HR information systems. Regularly audit and cleanse up data to minimize errors and discrepancies.
Monitor and address data integrity issues and ensure compliance with data protection regulations.
Interface Management
Monitor and manage the smooth functioning of interfaces between the HCM platform and other HR systems.
Process Efficiency
Identify and implement process improvements to enhance user experience and operational efficiency.
User Support and Training
Provide user support and training to HR teams and employees on the functionality and usage of the HCM platform and related systems.
Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in industrial engineering and management, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics / Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent diploma in a relevant discipline).
1-2 years of hands-on experience with Information Systems (IS)- including system administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and user support, preferably in a global enterprise environment.
Open to recent graduates with relevant experience gained during their studies
Strong understanding of systems integration concepts, interfaces, and data flows across enterprise applications.
Basic understanding of data governance and compliance regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with advanced expertise in Excel, including complex functions.
Strong analytical skills- ability to analyse data, generate business insights, and draw conclusions.
Fluent in English – a must

job.snippet:
אנחנו מגייסים בוחני חיובים עם תנאים שווים במיוחד
פורסם: 20.9.23
עודכן: 4.1.26
תיאור
תאור התפקיד:
קביעה וחיוב ארנונה לנכסים, כולל עדכון נתוני שומה במערכת.
מתן מענה איכותי ומקצועי בערוצי התקשורת השונים.
ביצוע סיורים וביקורות בנכסים על פי הצורך.
ייצוג העירייה בפני ועדת ערר ובתי משפט.
קיום קשרי עבודה עם גורמים שונים (פנים-ארגוניים וחוץ-ארגוניים).
דרישות המשרה:
השכלה אקדמית, כולל ידע וניסיון בקריאת שרטוטי מבנה.
עבודה במערכות ממוחשבות והפעלת יישומי OFFICE.
תודעת שירות גבוהה ויחסי אנוש טובים.
כושר ביטוי טוב בכתב ובעל-פה.
תנאים:
זכאות להחזר מלא עבור ביטוח רכב שנתי.
זכאות להחזר חודשי עבור הוצאות רכב.
היתכנות לעבודה מהבית, יום בשבוע.
טווח שכר – 7,500-8,000 ₪ ברוטו.
הערות:
המועמדים יישלחו למבחן אמינות
על פי חוק ההנדסאים והטכנאים המוסמכים, התשע"ג2012-" ,הנדסאי" או "טכנאי מוסמך" כהגדרתם בחוק זה פטורים מדרישת השכלה זו.
עיריית תל אביב-יפו מקדמת את עיקרון השוויון והתעסוקה, ובכלל זה שואפת לייצוג הולם ומקנה העדפה לזכאים לכך על פי דין. אם אתה נמנה על אחת הקבוצות הבאות: אתה או שאחד מהוריך נולדו באתיופיה, בן האוכלוסייה הערבית, הדרוזית, או הצ'רקסית, בן האוכלוסייה החרדית, עולה חדש (מי שעלה לישראל בהיותו בגיר וטרם חלפו 12 שנים מיום עלייתו) או שאתה אדם עם מוגבלות כמפורט בסעיף 25.35 בתקשי"ר.
מובהר כי מדובר במשרה שיועמ"ש העירייה קבע לגביה כי נדרשת בדיקת עברו הפלילי של מועמד כתנאי להתמנות לה, וכי אישור היועמ"ש בדבר היעדר הרשעות המונעות לשמש במשרה מהווה תנאי לאיוש המשרה ולמינוי לתפקיד .
הסדרי תנועה וחניה
פרטים נוספים
להגשת מועמדות
להורדה

אנחנו מגייסים מנהל מוצר עסקי לתחום התשלומים והבנקאות 📣
📍
תל אביב
מחפשים את האתגר הבא בניהול מוצר? נשמח להכיר!

התפקיד משלב חשיבה עסקית ואסטרטגית, הבנת צרכי לקוח, ניתוח נתונים וניהול ממשקים מרובים בארגון, לרבות עבודה שוטפת מול יחידות טכנולוגיה, דיגיטל, שיווק, מכירות, תפעול, סיכונים ומשפטית.

job.snippet:
About the role
In this position you will Support global servers, storage, networking, and infrastructure operations across on-premises environment. You will also serve as the senior technical escalation point for infrastructure and enterprise systems.
You will partner with R&D and engineering teams to ensure high availability, scalability, and performance of business-critical systems.
Drive infrastructure modernization, automation initiatives, and continuous improvement programs.
Oversee backup, recovery, monitoring, and operational resilience across the organization.
Responsibilities
Administer and support physical and virtual servers across global environments.
Manage company-wide on-premises and cloud backup solutions, ensuring data protection and recovery readiness.
Configure, maintain, and support LAN infrastructure across worldwide office locations.
Evaluate, implement, and promote automation solutions to improve operational efficiency and service delivery.
Monitor infrastructure health and performance, ensuring the integrity and availability of servers, storage systems, applications, and critical services.
Troubleshoot incidents, perform root-cause analysis, recover from system failures.
5+ years of Hands-on experience as a system administrator
Full Microsoft proficiency with AD, DNS, DHCP, CA etc.
Scripting (Python/VB/PowerShell etc.)
VMware
At least CCNA network level knowledge

הראל ביטוח ופיננסיים היא אחת מקבוצות הביטוח והפיננסים הגדולות בישראל. החברה נוסדה בשנת 1935 ומספקת פתרונות ביטוחיים ופיננסיים מקיפים, לרבות ביטוחי בריאות, חיים, עסקים ורכב, וכן שירותי השקעות כמו פנסיה וקרנות נאמנות.
למרות היותה חברה ציבורית, הראל שומרת על ערכים משפחתיים, תוך דגש על שירות אישי ואמינות. אסטרטגיית החברה כוללת דיגיטציה של תהליכים וניצול אנליטיקות לשיפור מהירות ואיכות השירות. בנוסף, הראל מבטחת את הסניפים הישראליים של חברות רב-לאומיות רבות ומשמשת כשותפה גלובלית של תאגידי ביטוח גדולים ברחבי העולם.
לחברתנו דרוש/ה מדריך/ה מקצועי/ת ומנוסה בתחום SAP FI (Financial Accounting) להדרכה והטמעה של מערכת SAP בארגונים מובילים במשק.
תיאור התפקיד
מתן תמיכה מקצועית והדרכה פרונטלית למשתמשי SAP במודול FI
כתיבת חומרי הדרכה, מצגות, מדריכים למשתמש ותסריטי עבודה.
ליווי והטמעה של תהליכים פיננסיים במערכת.
דרישות התפקיד
ניסיון של לפחות 2-3 שנים בהדרכה/הטמעה של מודול SAP FI – חובה.
היכרות עמוקה עם תהליכים פיננסיים כגון: הנהלת חשבונות, ספקים, התאמות בנקים ודיווחים.
ניסיון בכתיבת חומרי הדרכה .
תודעת שירות גבוהה ויכולת בין-אישית מצוינת.
ניסיון עם InsightZAP - יתרון
תואר ראשון – יתרון.
מיקום המשרה: רמת-גן, מתחם הבורסה יום היברידי

job.title: R&D Project Manager
job.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Rehovot,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
R&D Project Manager
We are looking for an ETP project manager to join us and lead our key divisional technical projects. You will own the project plan and budget, manage its execution and control timely, and on budget, deliveries while partnering with multidisciplinary teams.
What’s in it for you?
Have an impact on some of our key and top priority project’s success, shaping our future roadmap and technology excellence and enabling PDC growth. Own multi M$ projects, work closely with cutting-edge engineering and science fields
,
guide diverse groups to reach shared goals and make project related decisions to enable end-to-end execution success.
Our Group:
Group of divisional project managers who own, manage and lead divisional projects and other operational infrastructures roadmap.
What you'll be doing:
R&D project execution control - Validate resources are allocated, all activities are mapped, linked and planned for, drive to resolve gaps that holds execution
Manage work plans to meet timelines, highlight gaps/risks and work to resolve, assure work plans are complete, manage routing RERs to assure alignment and timely deliveries
Manage and optimize R&D Project’s Budget – Plan and control budget, highlight risks, manage optimizations
Interface with technical Module Owners, Sys Eng., Disciplinary owners, Product Lines focals, Operation, ICT and Finance
What you should have?
B.Sc in in engineering or science field, M.Sc is an advantage.
More than 5 years’ experience in working on complex multidisciplinary projects. More than 3 years’ experience as a project manager or direct team management
Methodological skills, PM now-how, multi-disciplinary approach.
Strong multidisciplinary technical product and system understanding
Strong management skills in a complex and dynamic Marix environment
Ability to motivate teams, overcome obstacles, manage conflicts and risks
Internally driven – highly motived and fast learning, flexible and independent
PjM tools knowledge (smartsheet, AI, PDP etc.)
Excellent inter-personal skills, can lead without authority
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
Yes, 10% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
No
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

job.title: Infrastructure Engineer (10296)
job.snippet:
VMware, Microsoft & Storage Infrastructure Expert
We are looking for an experienced IT Infrastructure Expert to join our team and work with complex Enterprise environments.
The role involves designing, implementing, and upgrading Datacenter infrastructures, leading infrastructure projects and migrations, troubleshooting complex issues, and providing technical support to Enterprise customers.
Key Responsibilities
Design and implement VMware, Microsoft, and Storage infrastructures.
Lead end-to-end infrastructure projects, including migrations and upgrades.
Perform advanced troubleshooting and performance optimization.
Implement and maintain High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions.
Prepare technical documentation, including HLD and LLD documents, and automate infrastructure processes.
Requirements
Strong hands-on experience with VMware technologies, including vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, and vSAN.
Extensive experience with Microsoft and Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Failover Clustering.
Experience with Enterprise Storage solutions, particularly NetApp ONTAP.
Experience with SAN/NAS technologies and protocols, including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, and NFS.
Experience leading infrastructure projects and migrations in complex Enterprise environments.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with Enterprise customers.
Experience with Dell PowerStore and/or Pure Storage – an advantage.
Experience with PowerShell and/or PowerCLI – an advantage.

job.title: Help Desk Support Specialist
job.snippet:
We are seeking a
Help Desk Support Specialist
to provide technical support to end users in a cloud-based IT environment, with a strong focus on
Microsoft 365
.
The role includes troubleshooting user issues, managing service requests, supporting cloud-based systems, and delivering professional, responsive, and customer-oriented technical support to employees across the organization.
Responsibilities:
Provide ongoing technical support to organizational users.
Handle Help Desk tickets from initial request through resolution and closure.
Provide support for the Microsoft 365 environment, including: Outlook / Exchange Online/ Teams/ OneDrive/ SharePointץ
Troubleshoot login issues, password-related problems, and access permissions.
Manage users and groups within the Microsoft 365 / Azure AD environment.
Provide support for end-user devices, laptops, and peripheral equipment.
Install, configure, and maintain organizational software and applications.
Troubleshoot basic network issues, printers, and internet connectivity.
Assist users in working with cloud-based systems and applications.
Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, and solutions within the service management system.
Collaborate with vendors and additional technical teams as required.
Requirements:
Previous experience in a Help Desk / Technical Support role – required.
knowledge in the Microsoft 365 environment.
Hands-on experience with Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.
Familiarity with Active Directory / Azure Active Directory.
Experience managing users, permissions, password resets, and setting up new computers.
Basic knowledge of Windows operating systems.
Ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
Strong customer service orientation and the ability to work effectively with users and within a team in a dynamic environment.
Good technical English skills.

job.title: Senior Hardware Engineer
job.snippet:
At AITAN, we accelerate the delivery of the most advanced drones and AI capabilities directly into the hands of warfighters.
Our universal controller lets one operators seamlessly orchestrate multiple drones, shifting risk to machines and keeping soldiers safer while providing superior intelligence and situational awareness.
We are looking for a senior, versatile hands-on Hardware Engineer to independently own PCB development from architecture and component selection through schematic design, layout, bring-up, debugging, and release to production.
This role requires someone who is comfortable doing the work hands-on, while serving as a technical focal point through design reviews, mentorship, and close collaboration with software, mechanical, and system engineers.
What you'll do
Own board-development projects end to end - components choice and electrical system definition, schematic design, hands-on PCB layout, transfer to production, hands-on board bringup, testing, debugging and validation
Serve as a professional focal point for PCB design across digital, mixed-signal, RF, and power domains, leading schematic and layout design reviews
Collaborate closely with mechanics, embedded software and system engineers during design, integration and testing
Expand to broader technical initiatives outside of core PCB design, such as embedded software, RF system-level work, and other areas of additional expertise
Requirements
Ability to independently drive rapid board iterations while collaborating effectively with hardware, software, mechanical, and system engineering counterparts
6+ years of relevant hardware engineering experience
Proven experience delivering PCB designs from concept to production
Extensive hands-on PCB layout experience using professional ECAD tools
Strong digital and mixed-signal design fundamentals; experience with digital interfaces such as USB, Ethernet, MIPI, and CAN bus
Experience with basic RF circuit design and RF PCB layout, including controlled impedance, matching networks, grounding, and shielding
Hands-on experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and spectrum analyzers
B.Sc. in electrical or electronics engineering, or equivalent experience
Bonus Points
Embedded software development experience
RF front-end design, antenna integration, RF measurements, or VNA experience
KiCad experience
Experience with military, industrial, or similar certification processes
