job.title: Site Management Associate (Clinical Trials)
job.snippet:
PSI is a leading Contract Research Organization with more than 30 years in the industry, offering a perfect balance between stability and innovation to both clients and employees. We focus on delivering quality and on-time services across a variety of therapeutic indications.
Job Description
Join our international team and be the key support to clinical research projects, streamlining communication, maintaining systems and managing documents & information. You will focus on facilitating research projects of novel medicinal products, while taking a step further in your professional career.
Office-based role in Ra'anana, Israel
The scope of responsibilities will include:
Performs site management activities, documents and trackers management, and communication with the sites and study vendors.
Site Management and Communication
Exchanges data, documents and other project relevant information between investigative sites, site vendors and the project team, and with other PSI departments
Ensures order, receipt, inventory storage, distribution, return/recall and reconciliation of clinical supplies
Ensures regulatory and ethics committee submissions and notifications
Ensures proper administration of sites and vendors payments, as applicable
Coordinates preparation for and follow-up on site, TMF and systems´ audits and inspections
Reviews and coordinates site-specific EDC completion and provides the site Monitor with regular updates on the completion status
Supports the organization of internal team meetings including preparation of agendas and minutes, and also of Investigator’s Meetings
Maintains study-specific and corporate tracking systems
Document Management
Maintains Trial Master File and performs TMF oversight at country/site level
Prepares, distributes, and updates Investigator Site Files and ISF checklists
Revises and checks translation status
Safety Management
Ensures proper safety information flow with investigative sites
CTMS Management
Updates CTMS with project information
Supports Monitors in completion of all subject and site events information in CTMS, and meeting deadlines for site visits and visit reports
Qualifications
College/University Degree (Life Sciences)
Prior administrative experience in Clinical Research / CRO environment, preferably in an international setting
Full working proficiency in Heberw and good English skills
Proficiency in standard MS Office applications (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
Good organizational and planning skills, problem-solving abilities, flexibility
Detail-oriented, able to multi-task and work effectively in a fast-paced environment
Team-oriented with excellent customer service and interpersonal skills, including a positive attitude to tasks and projects
*Please send your CV in English
Additional Information
As a privately owned mid-size CRO, we are constantly growing, offering plenty of opportunities for personal and professional growth.
Our extensive onboarding and mentorship program will prepare you to fulfil your tasks with the highest standards, offering you:
Excellent and flexible working conditions
A unique combination of team collaboration and independent work
Competitive salary and benefits package
Opportunities for personal and professional growth
Make the right call and take your career to a whole new level. Join a company that focuses on its people and invests in their professional development and success.

job.title: Junior Financial Controller | AdTech
job.snippet:
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Financial Controller (CPA) to join a growing global AdTech company.
This is a great opportunity for a CPA with 1–2 years of relevant experience who is looking to take the next step in their career and gain hands-on financial experience in a dynamic technology environment.
The role combines financial reporting, accounting, financial analysis, and day-to-day finance operations, with exposure to international business activities and collaboration with senior finance professionals and management.
Key Responsibilities
Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing and reporting processes.
Assist in preparing financial statements, management reports, budgets, and forecasts.
Perform financial analysis, variance analysis, and account reconciliations.
Monitor revenue, expenses, cash flow, and financial performance.
Support accounts receivable, accounts payable, and revenue recognition processes.
Assist with financial reporting related to international operations and multiple currencies.
Work with external auditors, accountants, and tax advisors.
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accurate financial reporting and data integrity.
Support improvements in financial processes, internal controls, and reporting tools.
Assist with financial automation initiatives and the implementation of new systems.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Accounting and CPA certification – mandatory.
1–2 years of relevant experience in accounting, auditing, or financial reporting.
Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial statements.
Excellent Excel skills.
Strong analytical abilities, attention to detail, and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently, learn quickly, and manage multiple priorities.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Fluent English, both written and spoken.
Availability to work on-site in Tel Aviv.
Advantages
Experience at a Big 4 or other leading accounting firm.
Experience auditing or working with technology companies.
Familiarity with IFRS or US GAAP.
Experience with ERP systems and financial reporting tools.
Exposure to international financial operations and multiple currencies.
Interest in AdTech, digital advertising, or technology-driven businesses.
Familiarity with automation, BI tools, or AI-driven financial solutions.
Who We're Looking For
A sharp, analytical, and highly motivated CPA who is eager to develop professionally and grow into a broader financial controller role.
Someone who combines strong accounting fundamentals with a proactive approach, business curiosity, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, international technology environment.

job.title: R&D Technician Engineer
job.snippet:
CaPow is growing! We are looking for a highly skilled, creative and responsible Technician to join our
R&D team and take part in developing our ultra-deep-tech innovative products and solutions for
wireless energy transfer systems for autonomous robotics. The team deals with multidisciplinary R&D
tasks for developing in-house solutions and platforms. Come work with us in a dynamic working
environment with high responsibility, joining us, you’ll have the chance to develop unique products from
scratch to mass production.
Key Responsibilities:
● Assemble, build and install test setups and development platforms.
● Utilize debug tools and cutting-edge lab equipment to support sophisticated,
multidisciplinary debug activities.
● Perform mechanical reworks.
● Prepare various parts for tests and internal end-to-end system integration (soldering
parts/PCBs, electro-mechanical parts, cables, antennas etc.)
● Maintain and organize lab equipment, in-house stock handling, and continuously look
for ways to improve lab processes.
Requirements:
● 3+ years experience in practical electronics.
● Technical degree in relevant fields: electrical/electronics/mechanical.
● The position requires strong technical capabilities - soldering, cables assembly, electrical
box assembly, mechanical constructing and testing.
● Travel to customer sites (domestic and abroad)
● PCB soldering, bring up and debug - understand electrical schematics, layout, electrical
components, ICs.
● Experience in setting up lab test equipment for signal measurement with the ability to
interpret schematics (oscilloscope, logic analyzer, signal generator, etc.)
Contact: ilana@capow-tech.com

job.title: AI Engineer
job.snippet:
About Unframe
Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months.
We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping Fortune 500 companies move from idea to production faster than anyone else in the market.
Backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV Partners with $50M in Series A funding, we’re building a fast-growing, revenue-generating company working with some of the biggest enterprises in the world.
About The Role
We're looking for an exceptional AI Engineer who sees the bigger picture - someone who can understand how entire teams and departments operate and fundamentally improve the way they work through AI and automation.
You'll work across the organization to identify inefficiencies, rethink complex processes, and design and build AI-powered systems that drive meaningful operational change.
This is a highly autonomous, hands-on role. We need someone who doesn't wait for requirements but identifies opportunities, takes ownership, and turns ambitious ideas into production-ready solutions.
Your mission: Make Unframe dramatically more efficient, scalable, and AI-native.
What You'll Do
Analyze and transform end-to-end workflows across departments, identifying opportunities for AI-driven automation and improvement.
Design and build sophisticated AI agents, multi-agent systems, and automation workflows.
Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that span multiple teams, platforms, and business processes.
Integrate AI solutions with internal systems, APIs, databases, and development tools.
Own initiatives end-to-end - from problem discovery and architecture to hands-on implementation, deployment, and adoption.
Build reusable AI capabilities and infrastructure that scale across the organization.
Challenge existing processes, drive innovation, and deliver measurable improvements in efficiency and productivity.
What We're Looking For
5+ years of software engineering experience, including building complex, production-grade systems.
2+ years of hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, agents, and automation workflows.
Exceptional systems thinking - the ability to understand complex processes, connect the dots, and see the bigger picture.
Strong ownership and independence - capable of turning ambiguous, cross-organizational challenges into working solutions.
Strong proficiency in Node.js / TypeScript and backend system architecture.
Deep experience with agentic AI, including tool calling, orchestration, context management, and multi-agent systems.
Familiarity with frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, MCP, and AI evaluation and observability tools.
Hands-on experience with AI-native coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex.
Strong business and product mindset, with excellent communication skills and the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
Why join us?
Real ownership from day one. Drive decisions, shape ideas and make them work.
Your fastest learning years. Build alongside founders and VPs in a space that moves weekly.
You'll have the opportunity to write and build what comes next.

job.title: R&D Director
job.snippet:
KMS Lighthouse is seeking an experienced
R&D Director
to lead our global engineering organization and drive the execution of our technology strategy.
This role is responsible for leading multiple engineering teams through experienced managers, scaling engineering excellence, and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality, enterprise-grade SaaS solutions.
The ideal candidate is a strong people leader with extensive experience managing large-scale engineering organizations in a global environment.
They will play a key role in accelerating AI adoption across the engineering organization, embedding AI-driven development practices, and leveraging AI technologies to improve productivity, software quality, and innovation.
Responsibilities:
Lead and scale the global engineering organization through engineering managers, fostering a high-performance culture.
Define and execute the engineering strategy in alignment with business and product objectives.
Drive AI adoption across engineering by integrating AI-powered tools and development practices that improve productivity, software quality, and delivery.
Develop engineering leaders through coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and organizational growth.
Partner with Product, Architecture, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership to deliver scalable enterprise SaaS solutions.
Drive engineering excellence by improving development processes, operational efficiency, quality, and execution.
Oversee planning, prioritization, resource allocation, and execution across multiple engineering initiatives.
Stay ahead of emerging technologies and industry trends to ensure continuous innovation.
Requirements:
10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant leadership of large engineering organizations.
Proven experience managing global engineering teams through engineering managers.
Strong background in enterprise SaaS and modern cloud technologies.
Demonstrated success driving AI adoption and modern engineering practices.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience building and developing high-performing engineering organizations.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is an advantage.

Electronics Practical Engineer –
R&D Team
Join Redler Technologies’ R&D Team
Redler Technologies is an established technology company specializing in advanced
motion control, smart energy management, and intelligent protection systems
.
We develop and manufacture advanced solutions for motor control, energy management, and smart protection applications for both the
defence and industrial markets
.
We are looking for a
hands-on Electronics Practical Engineer
to join our R&D team in a diverse technical role involving development support, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of advanced electronic systems.
This is a great opportunity to grow professionally while working closely with experienced engineers on challenging, cutting-edge projects.
What You’ll Do
Provide hands-on support to the R&D team throughout development, integration, and testing processes.
Perform hardware testing and troubleshoot electronic boards and systems.
Analyze hardware failures, perform
Root Cause Analysis
, and propose solutions.
Read and interpret electrical drawings and electronic schematics.
Perform measurements and testing using lab equipment, including
oscilloscopes, DMMs, power supplies, spectrum analyzers
, and other measurement tools.
Conduct laboratory and compliance testing of products and systems.
Support
Verification, Qualification, and Validation
activities.
Document test results, failures, findings, and solutions.
Write and update technical documentation, test instructions, and reports.
Collaborate closely with hardware, software, and system engineers.
What We’re Looking For
Practical Engineer diploma in
Electrical/Electronics Engineering – required
. Candidates with a B.Sc. in Electrical/Electronics Engineering will also be considered.
Good understanding of
analog and digital electronics
.
Ability to read and understand electrical drawings and electronic schematics.
Hands-on experience in
hardware troubleshooting – required
.
Experience working with electronic lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, DMMs, power supplies, spectrum analysers, and similar tools.
Good technical English.
The Right Person for This Role
Strong hands-on technical skills and a practical approach to problem-solving.
Independent learning ability and curiosity for new technologies.
Strong analytical skills, systematic thinking, and attention to detail.
Ability to write and maintain clear technical documentation.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Comfortable working in a dynamic and challenging environment.
What We Offer
Hands-on work with
advanced products and technologies
.
A professional, high-quality, and challenging engineering environment.
Close collaboration with a
multidisciplinary R&D team
.
Exposure to diverse development, integration, and testing activities.
A real opportunity to contribute to the development of new products and
grow professionally within R&D
.
This is a
full-time, on-site position
, Sunday–Thursday, at our offices in the
Kfar Saba Industrial Zone, Israel
.
Looking for a hands-on role where you can learn, develop, and work closely with advanced electronic systems? We’d love to hear from you.

iditlp@redlertechnologies.com

job.title: Unity Developer
job.snippet:
Unity Developer – Multiplayer 3D Web Game
About the project
We're building a multiplayer 3D world that runs straight in the browser – on desktop and on mobile, with nothing to install. Players choose an avatar, explore the world, meet other players, and play games together. The game is playable today and in active development, shipping in small frequent updates.
The role
This is a full-time role building the game from A to Z.
You'll own the whole product – gameplay, multiplayer, the web layer and the backend – and take every feature from idea to a playable build that works on desktop and on a phone.
What you'll do
Build gameplay and UI in Unity 6 and C#: avatars and wardrobe, emotes, interactive objects, NPCs, missions and rewards.
Keep the WebGL build fast and stable on desktop and mobile browsers – load time, memory, frame rate, touch input and screen sizes.
Build multiplayer with Photon PUN: rooms, syncing, and what other players see.
Build the web layer around the game: the HTML/JavaScript page, .jslib plugins, and the bridge to third-party games embedded in an iframe.
Build the game's backend: player accounts, in-game currency, purchases, daily rewards and missions.
Test every change on real builds, track down bugs, and ship regular updates.
Requirements
5+ years of professional Unity and C# development.
At least one shipped game on WebGL or mobile, and real knowledge of its limits: memory, load size, browser quirks, touch.
Profiling and optimising WebGL builds for load time, memory and frame rate on phones.
Strong JavaScript and browser APIs – iframes, postMessage, fullscreen, audio and input on mobile browsers.
Hands-on multiplayer experience – Photon (PUN or Fusion) or similar.
Experience building backend services for games: accounts, in-game economy, server-side validation.
Solid with Unity's lifecycle, prefabs and scenes, async code (async/await, UniTask) and Addressables.
Animation, Timeline and Shader Graph, and integrating ready-made 3D asset packs.
Able to own a project end to end and work independently.
Reproduces a bug before fixing it, and tests on real devices – phones included – before calling something done.
Nice to have
Integrating third-party games or SDKs into a web game.
CI for Unity builds (GitHub Actions, GameCI).

job.title: Business Development Director
job.snippet:
LSports is a world-leading sports data provider, trusted by sportsbooks worldwide to deliver real-time data with unmatched accuracy and reliability. Our technology drives smarter trading and deeper engagement, empowering bookmakers to grow, innovate, and stay ahead of the game.
We're looking for a Business Development Director to open new growth paths for LSports: new revenue streams, new products, new markets, and new partnerships. You'll report directly to the Chief Commercial Officer and work across the business to turn opportunity into revenue.
What You'll Do
Create new revenue streams from LSports' new and existing products.
Bring new products and initiatives to LSports' potential customers: existing customers,
and customers within our industry and TAM.
Lead the search for M&A opportunities, in line with management's decisions and
strategic direction.
Structure, negotiate, and manage partnerships that create new revenue streams.
Support LSports' entrance into new markets and verticals.
Lead new business initiatives from concept through execution.
Work closely with Product, Trading, Marketing, and Customer Success to turn
opportunities into results.
Track industry trends and competitor activity to surface new opportunities early.
Requirements:
Strong background in B2B SaaS, Data, or Technology companies is required. 10+ years of experience in commercial roles (business development, strategy, partnerships, corporate development, or similar).
At least 5 years specifically in business development, with a track record of building new revenue streams or launching new business lines.
Experience evaluating or working on M&A (sourcing, due diligence, or integration) is an advantage; hands-on deal experience is not required.
Background in sports betting or iGaming is a strong advantage, not a requirement.
Strong commercial instincts: able to identify opportunities, build the case, and drive them to execution.
Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Comfortable working independently and driving initiatives with limited oversight.
Willingness to travel occasionally as the role requires.
English required.
Life at LSports:
We’re honest with each other and open to new ideas. We challenge ourselves to excel, knowing that good relationships never come at the expense of professionalism. We’re dynamic, always growing and improving to stay on top.
Come join a team that’s all about winning together, with integrity and heart.
All the Extras You Deserve:
Hybrid work model
Work From Anywhere – up to 30 days a year
Extended parental leave for both mothers and fathers
Quarterly recharge days – company-wide shutdown to fully unplug
Health insurance
Birthday day off
And yes — we also care about the little things:
Cibus
Holiday eves off
Team & company social events
Dog-friendly office
Kids summer camp
Access to the Group Hug wellbeing platform

job.title: Capacity Installation Technician, Data Center, Infrastructure Delivery
job.snippet:
Description
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
The Worldwide Sustainability (WWS) organization capitalizes on Amazon’s scale, speed, ability to build, invent, and simplify a resilient and sustainable company. We manage our social and environmental impacts globally, and drive solutions that enable our customers, businesses, and the world to become more sustainable.
We are expanding our technician teams and have openings for Installation Technicians. This is an entry level position and a unique opportunity to work in some of the most innovative and fast paced data centers in the world. The Infrastructure Delivery team is responsible for the scaling and physical deployment of new data center infrastructure. As part of that team, you will be primarily tasked with installing cabling and new racks within the data centers. You must be able to perform repetitive tasks and adhere to standard processes and best practices. You will be working in a team environment and must be able to communicate and promote cross-team functionality.
Key job responsibilities
Basic build and troubleshooting of network devices.
Creating/attaching labels and barcodes.
Managing inventory of related materials.
Adhering to defined escalation processes and standard operating procedures.
Physical Requirements
This position has a physical component and may require working in cramped spaces or elevated locations.
Manual handling and lifting of equipment may be required (weight limits in accordance with regulations)
Regularly work at heights and from ladders.
Work in noisy areas with hotter and colder temperatures than standard office environmental conditions.
Personal car and ability to travel within geographical work area is required.
About The Team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic Qualifications
1+ years of computer networking experience
High school or equivalent diploma
Preferred Qualifications
Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
technical certification in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering)
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

- Amazon Data Services Israel

• Experience with Priority ERP - an advantage
• Willingness to work overtime, as required
The role is office based 08:00-17:00 Sunday to Thursday.

job.title: Field System QA
job.snippet:
At
D-Fend Solutions
, our people are our greatest strength — and technology is our passion. Our team of innovators and subject matter experts, including veterans of elite military intelligence technology units, is transforming the way organizations protect themselves from drone threats.
As the global leader in
cyber-takeover counter-drone technology
, we design and deliver advanced, software-defined solutions that empower our customers to detect, take control, and safely land unauthorized drones — with precision and reliability.
Every day, we push the boundaries of innovation to meet real-world security challenges across industries and environments. We’re proud of our cutting-edge technology, our global reach, and the impact we make in securing the skies.
We’re seeking passionate professionals who thrive in a fast-paced, creative, and collaborative environment — those who want to be part of the next generation of airspace security innovation.
Join D-Fend Solutions and help make the world a safer place.
Become a D-Fender!
Work with the world’s leading cyber-takeover counter-drone technology provider and shape the future of safe airspace.
Scope:
We are looking for Field System QA.
Our ideal candidate is a proactive learner with excellent problem-solving skills and a strong desire to work hands-on with system testing and verification.
While no prior professional experience is necessary, a natural curiosity for how systems work and an enthusiasm for tackling challenges in diverse, outdoor settings are highly valued.
This role is highly hands-on and field-oriented, with the majority of time spent conducting outdoor system tests in real-world environments. You will be actively involved in end-to-end validation of complex hardware and software systems, troubleshooting issues on-site, and working closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure optimal performance.
The position requires adaptability, independence, and a proactive approach, as you will operate in dynamic, fast-changing conditions and take ownership of testing activities from execution through reporting.
What will your job look like?
Verifying system features and functionality
Outdoor system performance tests
Working in a young, dynamic & demanding environment on cutting edge technology
Conduct end-to-end testing of integrated hardware and software components, ensuring seamless operation
Provide detailed bug reports, logs, and reproducible steps for issues found in the field
Generate regular reports on field QA activities, system performance trends, and key findings
Requirements:
Experience working with command & control, embedded, radio, or drone systems - Advantage
Willingness to work on Fridays and travel abroad (approximately 15% of the time) - Must
Previous experience with field activity - Must
This role requires significant hands-on involvement, with approximately 70% of the time dedicated to outdoor testing
High sense of ownership
Comfortable taking initiative
Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-changing, and multidisciplinary environment
Highly motivated, self-driven, independent, and detail-oriented
B.Sc. - Advantage
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

job.title: 🚀 Senior Fullstack Engineer | Build Technology That Makes an Impact!
job.snippet:
Love building products end-to-end, solving complex engineering challenges, and seeing your code make a real difference?
We're looking for a
Senior Fullstack Engineer
to join a growing and innovative EdTech company in Tel Aviv.
This is an opportunity to work on a product used by thousands of people, take ownership of meaningful features, and play a key role in shaping the architecture and technical direction of the platform.
You'll work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams, combining hands-on development with technical leadership in a modern production environment.
What You'll Do
Own and develop complex features end-to-end, from design to production.
Build scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript.
Develop modern frontend experiences with React and TypeScript.
Work with GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
Integrate AI and LLM capabilities into the product.
Drive technical architecture decisions and improve system performance.
Take responsibility for code quality, CI/CD, monitoring, security, and production reliability.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
What We're Looking For
5+ years of professional Full Stack development experience in production environments.
Strong hands-on experience with Node.js, TypeScript, and React.
Experience with GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
Experience working with AWS and/or GCP.
Hands-on experience with Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, and production maintenance.
Proven ability to independently lead development and make technical decisions.
Strong understanding of software security and data privacy.
A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and a passion for building great products.
Nice to Have
Experience in EdTech or SaaS environments.
Experience building AI/LLM-powered products.
Familiarity with WhatsApp Business API or Twilio.
Experience with Keystone, Prisma, Socket.IO, or Vite.
Experience working with public-sector or regulated organizations.
Why Join?
✨ Build a meaningful product used by thousands of people.
✨ Take real ownership of features and technical decisions.
✨ Work with a modern tech stack and explore AI-powered capabilities.
✨ Collaborate with talented Product, Design, and Engineering teams.
✨ Make a direct impact in a growing EdTech company.
📍 Tel Aviv, Israel
If you're a Senior Fullstack Engineer who enjoys taking ownership, building scalable systems, and turning complex challenges into real products, we'd love to meet you!
Apply Now!

job.title: CPP Team Lead
job.snippet:
We are seeking an outstanding
C++ Software Team Lead
to direct a core R&D team building enterprise-grade, high-availability storage platforms. In this hands-on technical leadership role, you will architect ultra-low latency, clustered server-side environments designed for extreme throughput, high scalability, and cyber resilience. You will lead a dedicated group of 2–8 engineers, balancing complex C++ system design, file system IO optimization, and legacy refactoring with elite people management.
Core Responsibilities
Engineering Leadership:
Lead, mentor, and build a high-performing team of 2–8 C++ software engineers, driving execution, career growth, and technical standards.
Low-Level Server-Side C++:
Write and optimize highly concurrent, multi-threaded C++ code operating in Linux clustered environments.
File System IO Performance:
Architect high-level and detailed designs for next-generation storage features, optimizing IO pipelines, throughput, and system health tracking.
Architectural Refactoring:
Own legacy code maintenance, structural refactoring, and core kernel/file system integration.
Agile Execution:
Lead team delivery using modern Agile/Scrum methodologies, driving sprint planning, design reviews, and continuous operational excellence.
What You’ll Bring
5+ years
of proven hands-on experience in
C++ over Linux
systems engineering (experience with
Go or Python
is also highly relevant) –
Mandatory
.
Leadership Track Record:
Proven experience leading a software development team or sub-group in a high-tech R&D organization –
Mandatory
.
Academic Credentials:
B.Sc. in Computer Science or Computer Engineering from a recognized academic institution –
Mandatory
.
Core Systems Mindset:
Strong problem-solving capabilities, low-level concurrency mastery, and an ability to drive complex technical initiatives independently.

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
חילן הינה חברה מובילה בישראל בפיתוח פתרונות תוכנה כשירות (SaaS) ומציעה פתרון מקיף לניהול ההון האנושי בארגון.
אנחנו מגייסם מפעיל/ת מחשב להשתלבות בצוות התפעול.
התפקיד כולל אחריות על הפעלה, בקרה וניטור של מערכות המחשוב הארגוניות, תוך שמירה על רציפות תפעולית ומתן מענה מהיר לתקלות.
תחומי אחריות:
•	הרצת תהליכי Batch ובקרה על תקינותם.
•	הפעלה ובקרה של מערכות Mainframe (MF) ומערכות תומכות.
•	ניטור תהליכים וזיהוי תקלות בזמן אמת.
•	טיפול ראשוני בתקלות והעברתן לגורמים הרלוונטיים במידת הצורך.
•	עבודה מול צוותי פיתוח, תשתיות ותמיכה להבטחת רציפות תפעולית.
•	תיעוד תקלות ותהליכי עבודה בהתאם לנהלים.
דרישות התפקיד
ניסיון קודם כמפעיל/ת מחשב או בתפקיד דומה – יתרון.
ניסיון בסביבת NOC או חדר בקרה – יתרון.
היכרות עם סביבת Mainframe (MF) – יתרון.
אחריות אישית, יכולת עבודה תחת לחץ וחשיבה תפעולית.
כולת עבודה בצוות ויחסי אנוש מצוינים
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.title: מנהל/ת אגף שכר
job.snippet:
מנהל/ת אגף שכר
עמותת לביא
ירושלים
5-6 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 3 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
מחפשים אתגר ניהולי עם עשייה בעלת ערך?
בואו להוביל את אגף השכר בתאגיד "לביא"!
ל"לביא" - תאגיד החינוך העירוני בירושלים, העוסק בפיתוח החינוך בעיר דרוש/ה מנהל/ת אגף שכר. הזדמנות להשתלב בארגון הנמצא בתנופה וצמיחה, סביבת עבודה דינאמית ומאתגרת המאפשרת למידה והתפתחות מקצועית בתחומים מגוונים.
תיאור התפקיד:
גיבוש, התווייה וביצוע מדיניות העמותה בתחום השכר ובכלל זה:
•	ניהול מערך השכר - אחריות מלאה על הכנת השכר לכלל עובדי העמותה, לרבות עובדים בשכר מדורג, שכר חודשי ושכר שעתי. פיקוח ובקרה על חישובי שכר, ניכויים, הפרשות סוציאליות, דיווחים לרשויות, קליטות ועדכונים שוטפים.
אחריות על דיוק הנתונים והפקת תלושי שכר בהתאם לחוק ולהסכמים החלים.
•	הפרשות ותשלומים - אחריות על ביצוע הפרשות פנסיוניות, קרנות השתלמות, ביטוח לאומי, מס הכנסה וכלל התשלומים הנלווים. בקרה שוטפת על דיווחים והתאמות מול גופים מוסדיים ורשויות.
•	ממשקי עבודה - ניהול ותכלול ממשקי עבודה מול עובדים, הנהלה ולקוחות העמותה בכל הנוגע לשכר. מתן מענה מקצועי לפניות עובדים בנושאי שכר, זכויות, חישובים ותשלומים.
עבודה שוטפת מול גורמי כספים, הנהלת חשבונות וגורמים חיצוניים רלוונטיים.
•	תהליכי סיום העסקה - אחריות על ביצוע תהליכי גמר חשבון לעובדים מסיימים.
חישוב וביצוע פדיון ימי חופשה והשלמות נדרשות.
הכנה וחתימה על טופס 161 בהתאם לדרישות הדין.
ליווי מקצועי של התהליך מול העובד והגופים המוסדיים.
•	 ניהול ובקרה - קיום שגרות ניהול שוטפות, לרבות פגישות עבודה קבועות עם חשבות השכר ומנהלת תחום השכר.
הובלת תהליכי בקרה, שיפור וייעול תהליכי עבודה באגף.
ניהול צוות מקצועי, חניכה ופיתוח עובדים בתחום השכר.
•	  אחריות מקצועית ורגולטורית - עדכון שוטף בשינויי חקיקה ופסיקה בתחום דיני העבודה והמיסוי. יישום שינויים נדרשים במערכות ובנהלים.
שמירה על סודיות, אתיקה וסטנדרטים מקצועיים גבוהים.
דרישות התפקיד
דרישות המשרה:
תנאי סף:
•	השכלה: בעל/ת תואר אקדמי,  שנרכש במוסד המוכר על ידי המועצה להשכלה גבוהה, או שקיבל הכרה מהמחלקה להערכת תארים אקדמיים בחוץ לארץ
או הנדסאי/ת או טכנאי/ת רשום בהתאם לסעיף 39 לחוק ההנדסאים והטכנאים המוסמכים, התשע"ג-2012
או תעודת סמיכות לרבנות ( "יורה יורה")  לפי אישור הרבנות הראשית לישראל או אישור לימודים בתכנית מלאה בישיבה גבוהה או בכולל, שש שנים לפחות אחרי גיל  18 ומעבר שלוש בחינות לפחות מתוך מכלול הבחינות שמקיימת הרבנות הראשית לישראל (שתיים משלוש הבחינות יהיו בדיני שבת ודיני איסור והיתר(.
•	ניסיון מקצועי: בעל/ת ניסיון מוכח בתחום דומה בארגון:
עבור בעל/ת תואר אקדמי או השכלה תורנית כאמור לעיל: חמש שנות ניסיון בתחום העיסוק הרלוונטי
עבור הנדסאי רשום: שש שנות ניסיון בתחום העיסוק הרלוונטי
עבור טכנאי רשום: שבע שנות ניסיון בתחום העיסוק הרלוונטי
•	ניסיון ניהולי: שלוש שנות ניסיון בניהול צוות עובדים מקצועיים בכפיפות ישירה
דרישות מקצועיות:
•	בעל/ת תעודת חשב שכר מוסמך- יתרון
•	ניסיון בהובלת תהליכי רוחב
•	שליטה מלאה בדיני עבודה, הסכמים וחוזים
•	ניסיון בתשלום שכר באופנים שונים: דירוגים שונים, שכר חודשי ושעתי
כישורים ומיומנויות:
•	חדשנות, פרואקטיביות, יצירתיות וחשיבה מחוץ לקופסא
•	יחסי אנוש מעולים, יכולת הקשבה ושת"פ
•	אסרטיביות ויכולת התמודדות עם שינויים
•	הבנה עסקית ומערכתית
•	שליטה מלאה בכל תוכנות האופיס
•	נכונות למשרה מלאה ומאומצת
תנאי העסקה:
חוזה אישי, 100% משרה
מתח דרגות – 70%-60% נגזרת משכר מנכ"ל העמותה
כפיפות:  סמנכ"ל משאבי אנוש ושכר
*עדיפות תינתן לאנשים עם מוגבלויות*
* המשרה מיועדת לנשים וגברים כאחד*
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.
קטגוריה
כספים / שוק ההון
תחומים
חשב/ת שכר

רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
לחוות שרתים (Data Center) מתקדמת, אנו מגייסים ראש/ת צוות NOC תשתיות לניהול מוקד הניטור והתפעול של התשתיות הקריטיות במתקן:
•	ניהול צוות בקרים/טכנאים במשמרות, חלוקת משימות, בקרת איכות ותהליכים.
•	פיקוח רציף על מערכות הבקרה, חשמל, מיזוג והסביבה - ניטור ובקרה רציפה במערכות BMS, EPMS ו-DCIM, ניהול מערכת הקריאות וגיבוש תמונת מצב תפעולית אחודה.
•	ניהול אירועים ותקלות בזמן אמת, פתיחת קריאה, הפעלת כוננים, עדכון לקוח והנהלה בהתאם לנוהל
•	בקרה ותחזוקת נהלים, עמידה ב- SLA, תחזוקת Runbooks, נהלי SOP/EOP ותרגילי חירום.
•	תיאום הדוק מול צוותי Facilities, צוותי IT NOC וגורמי אבטחה ובטיחות
דרישות התפקיד
•	הנדסאי/ת או תואר ראשון בתחומי ההנדסה/טכנולוגיה (חשמל, מכונות, בקרה, אנרגיה, תעו"נ)
•	לפחות 4 שנות ניסיון ב-NOC תשתיות, בקרת BMS/EPMS, אחזקה ו/או תפעול מתקנים קריטיים (Mission Critical), חובה ניסיון כר"צ/מנהל/ת משמרת במוקד בקרה.
•	ניסיון מעשי במערכות BMS/EPMS/DCIM ומערכות ניהול קריאות (ITSM/CMMS)- חובה
•	נדרשת אנגלית ברמה גבוהה (עבודה מול מערכות, נהלים וספקים בינלאומיים)
•	ניסיון בעבודה בדאטה סנטר – יתרון משמעותי
•	נדרשת דייקנות וירידה לפרטים, כריזמה ותקשורת בין אישית טובה
•	ראש גדול ואחריות, יכולת קבלת החלטות תחת לחץ
•	מיקום: מרכז

job.title: Director of Construction – Europe
job.snippet: Description: We are looking for a Director of Construction – Europe to lead a team of project managers delivering large-scale solar, wind, and energy storage projects across multiple European countries. The role requires multidisciplinary management expertise spanning infrastructure, engineering, finance, and commercial aspects. | Responsibilities: Lead the team of project managers responsible for large-scale solar, wind, and energy storage projects, from financial close through construction, commissioning, and commercial operation (COD). Own the department’s project budgets, including budget development, cost control, monitoring, and forecasting. Lead cross-functional collaboration with internal teams, including Development, Engineering, Procurement, and Finance, and with external stakeholders, including contractors, global equipment suppliers, owner’s engineers, project management and supervision firms, and business partners. Monitor key project milestones, identify contractual risks and exposures, and lead negotiation strategies to proactively resolve issues and protect the company’s interests. Represent the projects and regularly report on their status and progress to senior management, partners, and other stakeholders. | Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering, or another relevant field – required. At least 10 years of experience managing renewable energy and/or infrastructure projects, including civil works, electrical infrastructure (including substations and grid connection), and the management of contractors, consultants, and engineering designers – required. Proven experience managing international projects across multiple countries – required. Experience managing budgets and the financial and commercial aspects of complex infrastructure projects – required. Proven experience leading and developing teams of project managers – required. Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and workstreams simultaneously. Strong technical orientation combined with strategic, big-picture thinking. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and MS Project – required. Full professional proficiency in English, both spoken and written – required. Willingness and ability to travel frequently to project sites across Europe. Experience working remotely with geographically distributed teams and/or collaborating with Israeli companies – an advantage.

job.title: Field Service Technician
job.snippet:
About Xerox Holdings Corporation
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
Overview:
Join Xerox as a Field Service Technician and become part of a growing Technical Services organization focused on delivering an exceptional customer experience. In this hands-on role, you will use your electro-mechanical expertise to troubleshoot, repair, and maintain customer equipment while helping maximize device availability and performance. Xerox provides technical training to help you build the product knowledge and skills needed to successfully support your assigned territory.
Why Join This Team:
Receive technical training from certified instructors through online and instructor-led learning
Build your expertise in electro-mechanical troubleshooting and equipment repair
Access career development and growth opportunities within Technical Services
Receive comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness credits, and a company contribution to a Health Savings Account
Participate in a 401(k) program with company matching
Receive paid time off, holidays, and personal days
What You Will Do:
Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain customer equipment using electrical and mechanical knowledge
Deliver professional, responsive customer service while helping minimize equipment downtime
Use diagnostic tools, including a multimeter, and interpret electrical schematics to identify and resolve equipment issues
Manage assigned service calls and territory responsibilities while meeting established productivity, response time, quality, and cost expectations
Maintain the equipment, parts, and inventory required to effectively support customers within your assigned territory
What You Need to Succeed
:
Electro-mechanical troubleshooting experience with the ability to use a multimeter and interpret electrical schematics
Strong customer service, time management, problem-solving, and organizational skills
Ability to work independently in a field-based environment while reliably meeting customer and service commitments
Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and regularly walk, stand, squat, bend, and drive for more than 50 percent of the workday
This position requires a valid driver's license, current automobile insurance coverage meeting company-specified minimums, and the ability to meet the company's motor vehicle safety standards.
How We Set You Up for Success:
Structured new-hire and technical training designed to prepare you for independent field service work
Training on Xerox equipment, troubleshooting procedures, inventory requirements, and customer service expectations
Clear expectations regarding service call volume, territory responsibilities, and customer satisfaction
Hands-on preparation to independently complete service calls accurately and efficiently
Supportive and collaborative environment with opportunities for continued career development

job.title: Head of R&D - Software, AI & Genomics
job.snippet:
We are a pioneering biotech company specializing in the development of technological platforms for the analysis and interpretation of Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS), Pharmacogenomics (PGx), Personalized Medicine, and Longevity, alongside complex software systems supporting the company's medical and business operations.
We are looking for a technological talent to lead the company's entire research and development activities.
The role includes leading and professionally managing an existing development team, responsibility for system design and architecture, developing complex technological solutions and algorithms, tackling technological challenges, and demonstrating exceptional problem-solving abilities within short timeframes.
Responsibilities
Manage and lead the development team and all technological development activities within the company.
Design architecture, develop, and upgrade complex software systems, including CRM, medical systems, Backend, and integrations.
Develop advanced algorithms for genomic data analysis and interpretation, including WGS, variant classification, PGx, and PRS.
Develop and implement AI-based solutions, data analysis, and automation.
Drive technological innovation, solve complex engineering challenges, and maintain hands-on involvement in development.
Requirements
Strong software development skills
, particularly in Python, while working with AI.
Exceptional algorithmic and analytical thinking.
Experience developing complex systems and designing system architectures.
Ability to lead a development team and take responsibility for complex projects.
Familiarity with AI, data analysis, and automation.
Experience in bioinformatics / genomics.
Significant experience working in an AWS environment.
﻿
Highly attractive compensation package, including a competitive high salary, bonuses, performance-based rewards, and the possibility of a stock options plan.
We are looking for a brilliant individual with exceptional technological capabilities, who can lead people, solve problems that others struggle with, and build the next generation of our technologies.
If this sounds like you, send your CV to Jobs@levhai.com

job.title: ראש.ת תחום מבצעים
job.snippet:
:קצת על התפקיד
ראש.ת תחום מבצעים מוביל.ה את תחום המבצעים במערך הסייבר הארגוני ואחראי.ת על בניית, הפעלה ושיפור מתמיד של יכולות ההגנה, הזיהוי והתגובה לאיומי סייבר. התפקיד משלב אחריות ניהולית, טכנולוגית ומבצעית רחבה, תוך ניהול מספר צוותים מקצועיים הפועלים להגנת הארגון ולשמירה על רציפותו התפעולית. במסגרת התפקיד מוביל.ה ראש.ת התחום את פעילות ה-SOC הארגוני, תהליכי ניטור ותגובה לאירועי סייבר 24/7, פיתוח יכולות זיהוי מתקדמות, אוטומציה של תהליכים מבצעיים והטמעת טכנולוגיות חדשות. בנוסף, התפקיד כולל עבודה שוטפת מול גורמי פיתוח, תשתיות, IT, ספקים והנהלה, לצורך מתן מענה לאיומים מתפתחים ושיפור החוסן הסייברי של הארגון.
מטרת התפקיד היא להבטיח מערך מבצעי מתקדם, אפקטיבי ופרואקטיבי, המסוגל לזהות, לנתח ולסכל איומי סייבר בזמן אמת ולהגן על נכסי המידע והתשתיות הקריטיות של הארגון.
מה אנחנו מחפשים?
תואר ראשון במדעי המחשב, הנדסת תוכנה, מערכות מידע או תחום רלוונטי.
;ניסיון של לפחות 7 שנים בתחום הסייבר ההגנתי.
ניסיון של לפחות 3 שנים בניהול צוותים גדולים וראשי צוותים בארגון בינוני או גדול.
ניסיון מעשי באחד או יותר מהתחומים: SOC, Incident Response, Threat Detection, Threat Hunting.
ניסיון בהובלת תהליכי תגובה לאירועי סייבר ובחקירת אירועי אבטחת מידע מורכבים.
ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות SIEM, EDR ופתרונות ניטור והגנה מתקדמים.
ניסיון בהובלת פרויקטים טכנולוגיים חוצי ארגון ובניית תוכניות עבודה ותקציבים.
בעל.ת היכרות מעמיקה עם תשתיות IT, תקשורת, סביבות ענן ומערכות הפעלה.
ניסיון בהקמה או בניהול של SOC ארגוני- יתרון
ניסיון ביצירת DETECTIONS וניסיון בפיתוח אוטומציות, סקריפטים וכלי סייבר- יתרון
ניסיון בעבודה בסביבות AWS, Azure או GCP- יתרון
בעל.ת הסמכות מקצועיות כגון CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, Azure Security או הסמכות מקבילות- יתרון

job.title: R&D CREO Intern
job.snippet:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
PTC is a global software company that enables manufacturers and product innovators to transform the way products are designed, manufactured, and serviced. With industry-leading solutions in CAD, PLM and other technologies, PTC empowers companies worldwide to accelerate innovation and drive digital transformation.
We are looking for a
Computer Science Student
to join our R&D center in
Herzliya
. You will become part of the team developing
Creo
, one of the world's leading 3D MCAD (Mechanical Computer-Aided Design) solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to work alongside experienced software engineers on a large-scale, highly sophisticated product used by customers around the globe.
Requirements
Second year or above of B.Sc. in Computer Science
Strong knowledge in C/C++
Mathematical background (Linear algebra, Calculus 1&2 and diffential geometry) will be a plus
Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.
If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?
We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here."

job.title: Network Operations & Infrastructure Specialist- 242598
job.snippet:
We are looking for a hands-on Network Infrastructure Technician to support, maintain, and expand enterprise communication environments.
This role combines active networking, passive infrastructure, telephony, and field-level technical work. You will configure network switches, connect users and endpoints, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and maintain the physical infrastructure behind reliable network operations.
What You’ll Be Doing
Configure and maintain network switches
Work with VLANs, Trunks, access ports, and VLAN interfaces
Connect users and endpoints to the organizational network
Perform fiber and copper patching
Maintain communication cabinets, patch panels, and network outlets
Support IP telephony and communication systems
Diagnose network and physical connectivity issues
Work with internal teams, vendors, and field technicians
Perform occasional hands-on installations, including communication channels, displays, and equipment
What We’re Looking For
Practical experience in networking, telecommunications, or IP telephony
Basic hands-on experience configuring network switches
Understanding of VLANs, Trunks, interfaces, and TCP/IP
Experience with passive network infrastructure, including cabling, patching, and fiber connectivity
Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills
Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team
Hands-on mindset and willingness to perform field work when needed
Strong motivation to learn, grow, and take ownership
Experience with Cisco environments is an advantage.

מפעל אסם שדרות מגייס מהנדס/ת אחזקה למחלקת תשתיות לתפקיד שכולל
מטרת התפקיד
אחריות מקצועית על תפעול, תחזוקה ושיפור מערכות החשמל והתשתיות במפעל, תוך הבטחת זמינות, אמינות ורציפות תפעולית, בטיחות והתייעלות אנרגטית.
תחומי אחריות עיקריים
אחריות מקצועית על מערכות החשמל והתשתיות במפעל.
תמיכה בתפעול ובתחזוקה, איתור תקלות וקידום פתרונות.
תכנון ובקרה על תחזוקה מונעת ובדיקות תקופתיות.
ליווי פרויקטים הנדסיים ועבודה מול קבלנים וספקים.
מעקב וקידום תהליכי התייעלות אנרגטית ושיפור ביצועים.

יכולת ניתוח תקלות והובלת פתרונות הנדסיים.
ניסיון בליווי פרויקטים ובעבודה מול קבלנים וספקים.
היכרות עם מערכות אנרגיה, מיזוג אוויר וקירור, אוויר דחוס, מים ושפכים – יתרון.

תמה היא חברה גלובלית מובילה בתחום פתרונות האריזה לחקלאות, עם כ-1,700 עובדים ברחבי העולם ו-11 אתרי ייצור, מתוכם ארבעה בישראל. החברה בבעלות הקיבוצים משמר העמק וגלעד, ומשלבת פעילות גלובלית עם תרבות ארגונית של שותפות וגובה העיניים.
אנחנו מחפשים מנהל.ת חשמל ובקרה
תחומי אחריות עיקריים:
• הובלה מקצועית של תחומי החשמל והבקרה בחברה, בארץ ובחו"ל
• ניהול, הובלה ופיתוח הצוות
• הגדרת סטנדרטים והובלת פרויקטים ותוכניות עבודה
• מתן מענה מקצועי ועבודה מול ממשקים, ספקים וקבלנים
• קידום שיתוף ידע וחיבור מקצועי בין המטה לאתרי החברה
דרישות התפקיד:
• מהנדס.ת או הנדסאי.ת בתחומי החשמל, בקרה, מכטרוניקה, מכונות או תחום טכנולוגי

• ניסיון משמעותי בניהול, הובלת אנשים ופיתוח צוות
• ניסיון והבנה מקצועית משמעותית בעולמות החשמל, הבקרה והאוטומציה, ברמה
המאפשרת הובלה מקצועית של התחום
• ניסיון בהובלת פרויקטים ותוכניות עבודה, תיעדוף ועבודה מול מגוון ממשקים
• ראייה מערכתית ויכולת עבודה בסביבה מרובת ממשקים ואתרים
• אנגלית ברמה טובה, המאפשרת ניהול שיחה ותקשורת בכתב

job.title: Brand Designer
job.snippet:
Description
About Frame:
Frame is on a mission to build the future of Human Security in the AI era. With significant funding, a seasoned cybersecurity team building the right product, and a huge market opportunity, we are just getting started.
Our AI engine develops security awareness training and attack simulations that empower every employee to make smarter security decisions and eliminate human risk. Frame is trusted by leading global organizations on their journey to prevent AI-driven, human-centric attacks across email, voice, video, and beyond. We believe that security starts with humans as the strongest line of defense.
Who are we looking for?
We're looking for someone with real taste: the kind of person who can walk past a rack at a luxury brand and explain why the stitching, the type, and the restraint make it work. Bring that instinct to cybersecurity, a category that rarely has it. Make enterprise buyers feel they're looking at the category leader.
What You'll Do
The visual world of Frame end-to-end: swag, booths, print, every physical and digital surface where we show up.
A design system built to outlast: templates, component libraries, and brand guidelines sharp enough that sales, marketing, and product ship on-brand work without ever pinging you.
The materials that close deals: decks, one-pagers, proposals, case studies, event collateral, polished to the point that buyers stop treating the deal as a risk.
An AI-accelerated design pipeline: use AI tools to compress the cycle from weeks to days, then productize what works into workflows the team runs without you.
The brand itself, as we scale: consistent and unmistakable across every team and surface, wowing rooms full of stakeholders along the way.
The story behind the product: turn dense, technical material (AI-personalized training, deepfake attack simulations, human risk scoring) into visuals people want to look at and say wow.
Requirements
4+ years of brand/graphic design in B2B SaaS, an agency, or an in-house brand team, with a portfolio that shows real range across decks, print, web, and digital.
Figma mastery.
Fluency across the major presentation tools.
Typography and layout instincts sharp enough to take a dense technical story and make it clear and beautiful down to the last detail.
An obsessive eye for detail: you notice the 2px misalignment, the inconsistent kerning, the off-brand blue before anyone else in the room does.
Hands-on fluency with AI design and content tools, and a track record of building systems and templates, not one-off deliverables.
A taste for ambiguity and speed: you scope your own work, ship, and iterate without much process propping you up.
﻿Why Frame
High Impact: Build and own processes from start to finish that directly impact our product and customers, affecting millions of people.
Early-Stage Advantage: Join at the ground floor of a category-defining company. The decisions you make today will shape how the world thinks about Human Security tomorrow.
Built to Win: Frame is backed by world-class investors, operating in a market undergoing a fundamental shift, and has the right team and product.
Competitive Salary and Meaningful Equity: Our success is your success. Everyone has a meaningful stake in the company.

job.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager, ADAS
job.snippet:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
Here’s what this particular role covers.
🛠️ About Our ADAS Team
Our ADAS team is bringing Wayve’s end-to-end AI driving to production-grade advanced driver assistance, working directly with our OEM partners. Recent partnership deals mean we’re now delivering ADAS into production programs, and it’s one of Wayve’s top priorities. The team is scaling quickly, and the next 18 months will be focused on getting it right for the first SOP. This is a chance to sit at the heart of the work that drives Wayve’s upcoming business.
🧠 Your day-to-day
Splitting your time roughly 60% management and 40% hands-on, leading a team of around seven ML engineers, made up of new hires and an existing sub-team
Acting as tech lead across multiple workstreams, setting the vision for how problems get solved, in what order, and with which dependencies
Reviewing and approving delivery plans for the tasks you own
Partnering with TPMs on planning and execution, and with Product to help shape priorities
Coaching and developing the ML engineers on your team, supporting their growth as the team scales
🧩 What You’ll Be Working On
Taking our end-to-end AI driving approach into ADAS for a specific OEM production programme
Bringing ML models from proof of concept through to production on embedded automotive hardware
Optimising runtime and inference so the right model runs well on constrained hardware, rather than defaulting to the biggest one
Building and scaling a new team during a high-priority growth phase, with plenty of room to shape how it works
Working across system boundaries with software, embedded and product teams to deliver a coherent product
👤 You Should Apply If
Expert background in developing ML, specifically computer vision
You are/have been a people manager and enjoy developing engineers
You’ve worked across systems with software developers and product teams, particularly on embedded software
You have hands-on experience with embedded runtime and inference optimisation, and make pragmatic trade-offs on model size and performance
You communicate clearly and thoughtfully with colleagues across sites and cultures
You stay steady and keep your team moving when requirements are unclear or change often
🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
More About Wayve
🚗 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.
How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working:
Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.
📋 The Interview Process
✏️
Recruiter: please update this section for the specific role before publishing.
Our Process Is Clear And Respectful Of Your Time
Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)
Competency Interview (Technical Leadership & System Design; 2 hours)
Deep Dive (On-site visit in Herzilya; 1 hour)
Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour)
We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
What’s in it for you (Location dependent):
💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partner discounts and more
A quick, honest note before you apply.
Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.
If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.
At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.
For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve
DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

job.title: Grid & Interconnection Coordinator
job.snippet:
We are seeking a coordinator to join our Renewable Energy Development Department to serve as a central function within the department’s electrical sector, acting as a grid and interconnection coordinator in the electricity field.
The coordinator will work closely with project managers, engineering teams, advisors, and senior management, providing operational support to the department's electrical sector, managing documentation and ongoing follow-up with the IEC, Noga, and design consultants.
Responsibilities:
Managing and tracking grid connection requests, including Distribution System Operator (DSO) responses, connection surveys, technical coordination, and various procedures with the IEC and Noga.
Documenting, consolidating, and archiving connection files, electrical design documents, schematics, and inspection reports, including management via the Israel Electric Corporation (IEC) ordering portal.
Handling administrative processing of IEC and Noga vouchers and fees, bank guarantees, and contractual engagements in coordination with IEC representatives and internal finance departments.
Coordinating internal and joint site visits with the IEC, scheduling working meetings, and conducting routine status updates with the IEC and Noga.
Requirements:
1–3 years of experience in operational or administrative roles within an engineering, infrastructure, electrical, or planning company.
Bachelor's degree / Practical Engineer in Industrial Engineering & Management or Electrical Engineering – an advantage.
Experience in engineering, infrastructure, or electrical design – an advantage.
Experience working with Israel Electric Corporation (IEC) / Noga mechanisms, including familiarity with terms and forms for electrical facilities and energy storage systems – a significant advantage.
Hands-on experience with the Israel Electric Corporation (IEC) ordering portal – a significant advantage.
Full proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) and CRM/ERP systems (Priority, Monday).
Basic ability to read engineering and electrical documentation.

job.title: Tender
job.snippet:
Company Description
Shevet Binyamin Ltd. is a contracting and engineering company focused on delivering innovative, high-quality global projects, with a specialization in designing and building advanced office spaces. Led by CEO Shay Gindi, who brings over 20 years of experience in the construction field, the company has earned a strong reputation for consistent, exceptional project outcomes. The team of around 30 professionals operates with a family-like culture, emphasizing transparency, collaboration, and mutual support. Combining project management expertise with specialized technical teams, Shevet Binyamin drives projects from concept through completion, maintaining a firm commitment to quality and continuous innovation. The company values a can-do attitude, adaptability, and close partnership with clients to successfully overcome challenges.
Role Description
The Tender role is a full-time, on-site position based in Holon. The Tender professional will be responsible for preparing, reviewing, and submitting tender documents and proposals for construction and engineering projects, ensuring compliance with client requirements and industry standards. Day-to-day activities include analyzing project specifications, coordinating with project managers and engineers, collecting and validating cost estimates, and managing bid timelines. The role involves close collaboration with internal stakeholders to gather technical and commercial information, risk assessment of potential projects, and maintaining detailed records of tender submissions and outcomes. The Tender professional will also support continuous improvement of tender processes, contribute to pricing strategies, and help strengthen relationships with clients and partners through clear, accurate, and timely documentation.
Qualifications
Experience in tender preparation, bid management, or proposal coordination within construction, engineering, or related industries.
Strong analytical and numerical skills, including the ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and cost estimates.
Proficiency with office productivity tools (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with project management or ERP systems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in en_US; ability to present complex information clearly and accurately.
Detail-oriented mindset with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, including project managers, engineers, and finance staff.
Relevant academic background such as engineering, construction management, economics, business administration, or a related field.
Knowledge of local construction regulations, standards, and contracting practices is an advantage.
Prior experience working in a small to mid-sized company with a collaborative, hands-on culture is beneficial.

job.title: Senior 3D Graphics & GPU Software Engineer
job.snippet:
We are seeking an exceptional
Senior 3D Graphics & GPU Software Engineer
to develop advanced graphics engines, 3D algorithms, and GPU-accelerated software.
This is a hands-on engineering position requiring strong mathematical foundations, deep technical expertise, and a passion for solving complex computational problems.
The role is primarily intended for a highly capable
individual contributor
, with opportunities to evolve into broader system architecture, technical leadership, or other responsibilities as the company grows.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop high-performance, real-time 3D graphics engines and visualization systems.
Develop advanced rendering pipelines using modern graphics APIs, shader technologies, and GPU architectures.
Research, implement, and optimize sophisticated 3D algorithms, including point-cloud processing, surface reconstruction, and mesh generation.
Develop computational geometry algorithms, including Ball Pivoting, Poisson Surface Reconstruction, triangulation, mesh processing, and geometric optimization.
Design GPU-accelerated algorithms using CUDA, compute shaders, and parallel computing techniques.
Apply advanced 3D mathematics, linear algebra, numerical methods, and geometric transformations.
Optimize rendering performance, memory utilization, computational efficiency, and CPU/GPU data processing.
Evaluate and incorporate emerging graphics technologies, GPU capabilities, and computational methods.
Take ownership of complex technical challenges from concept through implementation and optimization.
Required Qualifications
BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
Excellent programming skills in
C++
.
Significant hands-on experience in 3D graphics engine development, rendering systems, or computational geometry.
Experience with modern graphics APIs such as
Vulkan, DirectX 12, Metal, or OpenGL
.
Strong understanding of GPU rendering pipelines, shader programming (GLSL, HLSL, or equivalent), and graphics architecture.
Strong mathematical background in
3D geometry, linear algebra, coordinate transformations, and numerical methods
.
Experience implementing and optimizing complex 3D algorithms.
Solid understanding of parallel computing, GPU architectures, and performance optimization.
Demonstrated ability to independently design, implement, debug, and optimize complex software systems.
Preferred Qualifications
CUDA programming and GPU-accelerated numerical computation.
Experience with compute shaders, WebGPU, OpenCL, SYCL, or other modern GPU computing technologies.
Experience implementing Ball Pivoting, Poisson Surface Reconstruction, Delaunay triangulation, or similar computational geometry algorithms.
Point-cloud registration, ICP, spatial indexing, KD-trees, octrees, and mesh optimization.
Advanced rendering techniques, including physically based rendering, transparency, volumetric rendering, and GPU-based visualization.
Experience with multi-threaded programming, low-latency processing, and real-time systems.
Familiarity with modern GPU architectures and efficient CPU/GPU memory management.

job.title: Electrical & Motion Control Engineer
job.snippet:
UAN - 59C348
📍 About the Role
We are seeking an Electrical & Motion Control Engineer to join MVG’s Engineering team, focusing on the electrical design, integration, and commissioning of control systems and precision motion systems for complex industrial and measurement equipment. This role is ideal for a hands-on engineer who enjoys working across control cabinets, servo drives, motors, PLCs, sensors, motion controllers, and automation components while collaborating closely with mechanical, software, and systems engineers. The position contributes directly to reliable, high-performance systems and may include occasional international travel for integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support.
🏢 About MVG
MVG – Microwave Vision Group – is the global leader in electromagnetic field measurement solutions. With 400+ employees, offices across 4 continents, and over 25 years of consecutive growth, we help the world's most innovative companies test, validate, and push the boundaries of wireless technology. Our mission: Testing Connectivity for a Wireless World.
Join us to shape the future.
🚀Responsibilities
- Develop electrical schematics for control cabinets and industrial systems, including wiring, grounding, shielding, EMC practices, and panel-layout support.
- Define and integrate key automation components such as servo drives, motors, PLCs, power supplies, safety devices, sensors, encoders, and field-wiring interfaces.
- Implement motion-control systems, including servo motors, drives, encoders, motion controllers, feedback systems, motion profiles, and operating parameters.
- Optimize motion-control performance through configuration, tuning, analysis, and troubleshooting of positioning, stability, synchronization, speed, accuracy, and repeatability.
- Collaborate with mechanical, software, systems, and engineering teams during design meetings, system integration, commissioning, validation, and design reviews.
- Ensure accurate technical documentation, including electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, installation, commissioning, maintenance documentation, and design records.
- Drive continuous improvement in electrical and motion-control designs, component selection, reliability, manufacturability, best practices, and evaluation of new technologies.
✅ Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering field.
- Experience in electrical design of control cabinets, industrial electrical systems, or similar equipment.
- Practical experience with electrical and control-system integration, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting.
- Familiarity with servo drives, motors, PLCs, sensors, encoders, industrial automation components, and electrical CAD tools.
- Understanding of grounding, shielding, EMC, industrial wiring practices, motion-control principles, PID control, feedback loops, acceleration/deceleration profiles, and system dynamics.
- Strong analytical, systematic troubleshooting, communication, and technical documentation skills.
- Practical, hands-on approach with the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering environment and motivation to develop expertise in electrical and motion-control technologies.
🌟 Nice to Have
- Experience configuring or tuning servo drives, motion controllers, and broader motion-control systems.
- Familiarity with EtherCAT or other industrial fieldbus networks.
- Experience with PLC programming, control-system software, safety circuits, and relevant standards.
- Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering environments on complex industrial or measurement equipment.
