job.title: Infrastructure Team Lead
job.snippet:
We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Professional to join a large, leading organization in Haifa.
In this role, you will be responsible for managing, maintaining, and operating the organization’s IT infrastructure, while also leading a technology team.
What You’ll Do:
Manage, maintain, and operate enterprise computing infrastructure.
Work in complex virtualized environments.
Manage servers, operating systems, and endpoints.
Design and manage VDI environments and publish virtual applications.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.
Work with vendors in Israel and abroad.
Write technical documentation and installation procedures.
Lead and mentor a technology team.
Requirements:
At least 4 years of experience in IT infrastructure, including experience managing a technology team - a must.
B.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Hands-on experience installing and managing Windows Server 2016-2022 and Windows 10/11 workstations.
Experience managing Active Directory and Group Policy (GPO) in a large, multi-user environment.
Experience with DNS and DHCP.
Experience with virtualization, with an emphasis on Nutanix, AHV, and VMware.
Experience designing, installing and managing multi-user VDI systems, preferably Citrix CVAD.
Experience managing and publishing virtual applications, and familiarity with App-V and XenApp.
Familiarity with Thin/Zero Clients and software management and distribution systems.
Work model: Hybrid (2 days work-from-home).

job.title: System Architect – Deep-Tech / Multidisciplinary Robotic Systems
job.snippet:
System Architect – Deep-Tech / Multidisciplinary Systems
We are a cutting-edge Defense-Tech startup developing complex multidisciplinary systems. We are looking for a strong System Architect to lead the architectural domain. We highly welcome candidates coming from the Automotive (ADAS), Advanced Imaging, or Deep-Tech sensors industries who are looking to bring their expertise into the defense sector.
This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who can take real ownership over system definition and drive complex systems from concept to working product and mass production.
Role Overview End-to-end responsibility for system architecture — from marketing/system requirements and concept, through system decomposition, interface definition, to integration, validation, and manufacturability. The role includes leading the architectural effort (including close work with FPGA, Hardware, and Optics engineers), and driving critical engineering decisions across the system.
Responsibilities
Lead the system architecture of complex multidisciplinary products (Hardware, Optical, Mechanical, and Software).
Define and write System Requirements, Architecture Docs, ICDs,
and simulation models
.
Translate system needs into clear, implementable subsystem definitions.
Drive engineering trade-offs (performance / cost / risk / complexity /
manufacturability
).
Work closely with FPGA, hardware, electro-optics, algorithms, integration, and validation teams.
Support system modeling and develop simulators to evaluate system performance (e.g., using MATLAB).
Define interfaces and ensure architectural consistency.
Support integration, debugging, and system-level validation.
Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, certifications, and safety standards.
Requirements
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering / Physics / Systems Engineering or similar.
~8+ years of experience in complex multidisciplinary systems.
Experience as a System Architect / Senior System Engineer.
Strong background in the imaging world / electro-optical systems: LiDAR, ToF, Structured Light, RGB/IR cameras, or DVS .
Strong understanding of FPGA, real-time processing, signal chains, and board-level hardware design.
Experience driving a product from the definition phase to Mass Production, including cost reduction and EoL testing methodologies.
Proven ability to write clear system-level documentation.
Ability to operate both at a system-wide and deep tech

job.title: איש/אשת תמיכה טכנית חברה מובילה בתחומה!
job.snippet:
חסוי
איש/אשת תמיכה טכנית חברה מובילה בתחומה!
- חסוי -
פתח תקווה
1-2 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 7 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
רוצה להשתלב בחוד החנית של עולם ה-RF, הרובוטיקה והרחפנים? מקומך איתנו!
חברה מובילה המייבאת מערכות תקשורת אלחוטית מתקדמות (RF) בתחומי ה-IoT, הרובוטיקה והרחפנים מחפשת איש/אשת תמיכה טכנית להצטרפות לצוות! זהו תפקיד מרתק ומגוון הכולל עבודה מול המגזר הביטחוני ועיסוק בטכנולוגיות חדשניות ומתפתחות.
תחומי אחריות:
- מתן תמיכה טכנית והדרכה מקצועית ללקוחות החברה.
- אחזקת ותפעול מערכות תקשורת ו-IT פנים-ארגוניות.
פרטי המשרה:
- סוג המשרה: מלאה ומשרדית (א'-ה'), שעות 09:00–18:00.
- מיקום המשרדים: פתח תקווה.
דרישות התפקיד
- ניסיון בתקשורת ורשתות: ניסיון בניהול רשתות – חובה!
- השכלה: תעודת הנדסאי/ת חשמל או אלקטרוניקה – יתרון משמעותי.
- רקע נוסף: ניסיון או היכרות עם תחומי תקשורת רחפנים – יתרון.
- שפות: שליטה טובה באנגלית (דיבור).
- כישורים אישיים: חוש טכני מפותח ותודעת שירות גבוהה במיוחד.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

התפקיד כולל:

לא נדרש ניסיון תעסוקתי קודם בפיתוח!

נכונות ללמוד טכנולוגיות חדשות ולהתמודד עם אתגרים מורכבים.
ניסיון מעשי בפיתוח במסגרת פרויקטים אישיים או אקדמיים - יתרון

היכרות עם C / C ++ או ניסיון בשפות תכנות אחרות - יתרון.

job.title: SOC Manager
job.snippet:
The
Information Technology Center (ITC)
is looking for a
SOC Manager
.
The Role Includes
End-to-end responsibility for the
24/7/365 detection, monitoring, investigation, and response to cyber incidents (Incident Response)
across complex and classified technological environments.
Leading the organization’s
operational cyber defense
against advanced threat actors targeting information assets and infrastructure.
Managing and leading the team: recruiting, training, mentoring, and directly managing
Tier 1–3 analysts, forensic investigators, and incident response specialists
. Defining shifts and operational workflows.
Cyber Incident Response:
directly leading the investigation and containment of complex cyber incidents, managing crises and exceptional events in real time, including activating teams outside regular working hours.
Developing and improving methodologies: writing, updating, and implementing operational policies and procedures, contingency plans, and
automation-based Playbooks (SOAR)
.
Defining and implementing advanced monitoring and protection tools; strengthening the technological and operational capabilities of the Cyber Center and its systems, including
SIEM, XDR, SOAR, and EDR
, while adapting them to cloud environments and isolated
On-Premise / Air-Gapped
environments.
Threat Intelligence & Hunting:
integrating relevant cyber threat intelligence feeds and leading proactive activities to identify malware and hidden threats across organizational networks.
Regulatory compliance and audits:
ensuring the SOC complies with stringent security standards and guidelines issued by the Security Officer (CISO/Chief Security Officer) and relevant regulatory bodies.
Cyber Threat Intelligence (
TI
) monitoring and collection, and
Threat Hunting (TH)
across organizational networks.
Network systems monitoring and control.
Managing
supply chain security incidents
, including coordination with internal organizational units and external suppliers regarding cyber incidents within the supply chain.
Providing support to customers and company employees regarding service requests originating from suspected cyber incidents.
Producing professional reports on Cyber Center activities and investigated incident suspicions for senior management.
What We’re Looking For
Academic degree in
Information Systems and/or Computer Science
, or completion of at least
300 hours of professional cybersecurity training
, or graduate of a technological unit such as
Unit 8200, Ofek, Lotem, Mamram
, or equivalent units – mandatory.
Recognized professional certifications such as
CISSP, CISM, or CISA
– advantage.
Experience working in
physically segregated / Air-Gapped environments
– advantage.
At least
5 years of proven experience in Cyber Security
, including at least
2 years as a Senior Analyst (Tier 3), SOC Team Lead, or SOC Manager
in a medium-to-large organization – mandatory.
At least
3 years of proven experience managing and leading a technological team of at least 10 employees
in an operational environment – mandatory.
In-depth knowledge of
cyber threats and threat actors
, including attack groups and large-scale international cyber incidents – mandatory.
Proven experience leading cyber incidents in large organizations, including
defense and response strategies and forensic investigations
– mandatory.
Advanced training in
communications and operating systems
– advantage.
Knowledge and experience with information security products:
SIEM, IPS/IDS, AV, EDR, Firewall, SOAR
– mandatory.
Technical English
(reading and writing) – mandatory.
In-depth understanding of
TCP/IP communication protocols, network architecture, Windows/Linux operating systems, and common attack techniques such as MITRE ATT&CK
– advantage.
Willingness to work overtime – mandatory.
About the Cyber Center
The Cyber Center provides comprehensive
active and proactive monitoring and protection
, including a senior team responsible for managing and responding to cyber incidents across the organization.
The
Cyber Monitoring and Control
domain is responsible for monitoring the organization’s cybersecurity and information security, as well as collecting cyber intelligence. The team monitors and controls security systems and protects the network against cyber threats and defined threat scenarios.
The Cyber Center Manager leads a team of analysts operating
24/7
, protecting the organization’s assets through advanced security tools,
automation processes, and AI
.

job.title: Corporate Development Director
job.snippet:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As the Corporate Development Director, you'll help influence how GitLab invests to win: what we build, what we buy, where we partner, and what we should not pursue. This role sits within the Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships team, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships.
This role straddles strategy and M&A engagements. You'll lead research that frames GitLab's options: mapping the markets in and around our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, testing where we have a right to win, and turning that into clear recommendations for the executive team. When the answer is to acquire, you'll drive the deal process end to end, from outreach through close and integration.
Success here is not measured by deal count. It looks like sharper strategic choices: a well-reasoned point of view on our priority markets, investment theses that product and executive leaders rely on, acquisitions that speed up the roadmap when buying is the right answer, and an educated no when it isn't. You'll own the wider market perspective rather than individual product categories, and work with the team's Analyst on the research behind it.
What you'll do
Strategy and research
Own the wider market view. Research the broader market GitLab competes in, beyond specific product categories: competitive dynamics, AI-native entrants, technology shifts and where value is moving. Collaborate with the team's Analyst on the research and turn the findings into a clear point of view on where GitLab should play.
Build an investment thesis for each focus area. Work with Product and Engineering leaders to define the problems worth solving, the capabilities GitLab needs, and what it would cost in time and money to get there on our own.
Own the competitive and landscape view. Maintain market maps and a current read on GitLab's competitors: their strategy, product direction, positioning, pricing, and M&A and funding activity. Produce competitor analyses that show where we lead, where we're exposed and how rivals are likely to move. Flag shifts by competitors, hyperscalers and AI labs that change our options, and bring the implications to Product and the executive team.
Define where GitLab should not play. Identify adjacencies that dilute focus and markets where the economics or competition work against us. Make the case for a no with the same rigor as a yes.
Build, buy or partner
Run the build, buy, partner analysis. For each strategic gap, compare the options side by side on speed, cost, risk, control and strategic fit, and bring a clear recommendation.
Deliver strategic clarity to executives and the Board. Produce short strategy memos/decks and business cases that set out the decision, the trade-offs and what we give up with each path.
Feed company strategy and planning. Bring an outside-in view of the market and the inorganic options available into annual and long-range planning.
Work hand in hand with Strategic Partnerships. When partnering is the right answer, frame the opportunity and hand it to the partnership owner with a clear thesis. When it isn't, explain why.
Deal execution and integration
Own end-to-end deal process management. Validate target fit against GitLab's our target profile, product roadmap and other criteria, and build the acquisition rationale and business case. Drive our M&A process from intro call through the various steps through to closing and integration.
Evaluate the deal. Develop valuation, commercial integrity assessment, impact on GitLab's business and provide negotiations assistance to the VP and the executive team.
Lead cross-functional diligence. Run pre-LOI validation and diligence across Product, Engineering, Security, Finance, Legal and People, and communicate findings clearly.
Drive deal documents with Legal. Prepare NDAs, LOIs and purchase agreements with GitLab Legal and outside counsel.
Own integration outcomes. Lead post-acquisition integration as the DRI, measured against the roadmap and business goals in the business case. Bring lessons learned back into the strategy work.
Build the external network. Maintain relationships with founders, executives, investors, bankers and advisors that bring us early insight and pipeline.
What you'll bring
Strategy and deal experience. 8+ years across corporate development, corporate strategy, strategy consulting or technology investing, including 5+ years leading acquisitions end to end in enterprise software.
Structured strategic thinking. You form a point of view from incomplete information, test it against data, and change your mind when the evidence says so. You're as comfortable recommending that we stay out of a market as that we enter it.
Market research depth. Skilled in market sizing, competitive analysis and landscape mapping, and in turning research into a recommendation, not a report.
Deal craft. Skilled in valuation, financial modeling, deal structuring, negotiation and integration planning, with experience across varied consideration structures.
Technical fluency. A working understanding of software development, DevSecOps and the AI landscape, enough to hold substantive conversations with product and engineering leaders about roadmaps and architecture.
Clear executive communication. You write short, decision-ready updates and present trade-offs plainly to executives and the Board, in an async-first environment.
Influence without authority. You build trust across Product, Engineering, Finance and Legal and move decisions forward across functions.
Ownership with collaboration. You own the strategic view and the recommendation, and partner closely with the team's Analyst on research and analysis.
Preferred: familiarity with the DevSecOps, security, AI and open source ecosystems.
You value the all remote lifestyle and share our values.
About The Team
The Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships team helps GitLab decide how to grow beyond what we build on our own. We own inorganic strategy: acquisitions, strategic partnerships with hyperscalers and AI labs, and the research that tells us which to pursue and which to pass on.
We work across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal and the executive group. We set direction and do the detailed work ourselves, with a high degree of ownership and transparency in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

job.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As the Corporate Development Director, you'll help influence how GitLab invests to win: what we build, what we buy, where we partner, and what we should not pursue. This role sits within the Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships team, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships.
This role straddles strategy and M&A engagements. You'll lead research that frames GitLab's options: mapping the markets in and around our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, testing where we have a right to win, and turning that into clear recommendations for the executive team. When the answer is to acquire, you'll drive the deal process end to end, from outreach through close and integration.
Success here is not measured by deal count. It looks like sharper strategic choices: a well-reasoned point of view on our priority markets, investment theses that product and executive leaders rely on, acquisitions that speed up the roadmap when buying is the right answer, and an educated no when it isn't. You'll own the wider market perspective rather than individual product categories, and work with the team's Analyst on the research behind it.
What you'll do
Strategy and research
Own the wider market view. Research the broader market GitLab competes in, beyond specific product categories: competitive dynamics, AI-native entrants, technology shifts and where value is moving. Collaborate with the team's Analyst on the research and turn the findings into a clear point of view on where GitLab should play.
Build an investment thesis for each focus area. Work with Product and Engineering leaders to define the problems worth solving, the capabilities GitLab needs, and what it would cost in time and money to get there on our own.
Own the competitive and landscape view. Maintain market maps and a current read on GitLab's competitors: their strategy, product direction, positioning, pricing, and M&A and funding activity. Produce competitor analyses that show where we lead, where we're exposed and how rivals are likely to move. Flag shifts by competitors, hyperscalers and AI labs that change our options, and bring the implications to Product and the executive team.
Define where GitLab should not play. Identify adjacencies that dilute focus and markets where the economics or competition work against us. Make the case for a no with the same rigor as a yes.
Build, buy or partner
Run the build, buy, partner analysis. For each strategic gap, compare the options side by side on speed, cost, risk, control and strategic fit, and bring a clear recommendation.
Deliver strategic clarity to executives and the Board. Produce short strategy memos/decks and business cases that set out the decision, the trade-offs and what we give up with each path.
Feed company strategy and planning. Bring an outside-in view of the market and the inorganic options available into annual and long-range planning.
Work hand in hand with Strategic Partnerships. When partnering is the right answer, frame the opportunity and hand it to the partnership owner with a clear thesis. When it isn't, explain why.
Deal execution and integration
Own end-to-end deal process management. Validate target fit against GitLab's our target profile, product roadmap and other criteria, and build the acquisition rationale and business case. Drive our M&A process from intro call through the various steps through to closing and integration.
Evaluate the deal. Develop valuation, commercial integrity assessment, impact on GitLab's business and provide negotiations assistance to the VP and the executive team.
Lead cross-functional diligence. Run pre-LOI validation and diligence across Product, Engineering, Security, Finance, Legal and People, and communicate findings clearly.
Drive deal documents with Legal. Prepare NDAs, LOIs and purchase agreements with GitLab Legal and outside counsel.
Own integration outcomes. Lead post-acquisition integration as the DRI, measured against the roadmap and business goals in the business case. Bring lessons learned back into the strategy work.
Build the external network. Maintain relationships with founders, executives, investors, bankers and advisors that bring us early insight and pipeline.
What you'll bring
Strategy and deal experience. 8+ years across corporate development, corporate strategy, strategy consulting or technology investing, including 5+ years leading acquisitions end to end in enterprise software.
Structured strategic thinking. You form a point of view from incomplete information, test it against data, and change your mind when the evidence says so. You're as comfortable recommending that we stay out of a market as that we enter it.
Market research depth. Skilled in market sizing, competitive analysis and landscape mapping, and in turning research into a recommendation, not a report.
Deal craft. Skilled in valuation, financial modeling, deal structuring, negotiation and integration planning, with experience across varied consideration structures.
Technical fluency. A working understanding of software development, DevSecOps and the AI landscape, enough to hold substantive conversations with product and engineering leaders about roadmaps and architecture.
Clear executive communication. You write short, decision-ready updates and present trade-offs plainly to executives and the Board, in an async-first environment.
Influence without authority. You build trust across Product, Engineering, Finance and Legal and move decisions forward across functions.
Ownership with collaboration. You own the strategic view and the recommendation, and partner closely with the team's Analyst on research and analysis.
Preferred: familiarity with the DevSecOps, security, AI and open source ecosystems.
You value the all remote lifestyle and share our values.
About The Team
The Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships team helps GitLab decide how to grow beyond what we build on our own. We own inorganic strategy: acquisitions, strategic partnerships with hyperscalers and AI labs, and the research that tells us which to pursue and which to pass on.
We work across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal and the executive group. We set direction and do the detailed work ourselves, with a high degree of ownership and transparency in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

job.title: Security Operations Engineer
job.snippet:
Description
We recruit for a high-traffic social gaming platform running on AWS and GCP.
You'll join the Platform team and own day-to-day security across the cloud, identity, edge and endpoints. You'll automate that work with AI, and work with engineering to stop bot abuse and fraud before it costs money.
Responsibilities
Cloud security (AWS + GCP): Enforce least-privilege IAM and org guardrails (SCPs and GCP org policies). Monitor and triage cloud security findings and audit logs. Harden the EKS clusters.
Identity and access: Run JumpCloud and Google Workspace as the identity layer: SSO, MFA, access reviews and device policies.
Edge protection: Own Cloudflare WAF, bot management, rate limiting and Zero Trust Access. Tune rules against signup bots, credential stuffing and abuse.
Browser and endpoint security: Manage Island Enterprise Browser policies, including DLP, data boundaries and access to sensitive admin tools.
Detection and response: Build alerts and write runbooks. Lead security incidents alongside SRE on-call, and follow through on post-incident fixes.
Build AI agents that triage security alerts, enrich them with context and suggest or apply a response.
Requirements
2+ years in SecOps, cloud security, or SRE/DevOps with a strong security focus
Hands-on experience with AWS IAM and AWS security services, plus working knowledge of GCP
Admin experience with an identity provider (JumpCloud, Okta or Google Workspace), including SAML/OIDC SSO, MFA and SCIM
Experience with Cloudflare (WAF, rules, Zero Trust) or a comparable edge security platform
Terraform, Git and Python, plus hands-on experience building automation with LLMs or AI agents (such as Claude, OpenAI or MCP-based tools)
Advantages
Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification
Island or another enterprise browser, or MDM tools
Kubernetes/EKS security: RBAC, network policies and image scanning
Fighting bots or fraud in gaming, fintech or e-commerce
SIEM or detection engineering experience
Other certifications such as AWS Security Specialty, Security+ or CCSK

job.title: Technical Support Engineer- Tier 1
job.snippet:
Technical Support Engineer – Tier 1 (Entry-Level)
Fireberry is an end-to-end business management platform tailored for business-specific needs.
From marketing to sales to customer service and more, Fireberry makes it easy for the entire business to work together.
Each department is powerful on its own, but together they can be explosive.
Fireberry was built from the ground up by developers who already knew back in 2011 that there had to be a better way to improve customer relations and decided to develop software aimed at keeping customers delighted.
After conquering the local market with more than 2,000 satisfied Israeli customers from various industries, we are ready to go global.
Are you up for the challenge?
About the role:
We’re looking for a Tier 1 Technical Support Engineer to join our team. This is an entry-level position, ideal for someone looking to start their career in technical support within a SaaS company. You’ll be the first point of contact for customers, helping resolve common technical issues and escalating more complex cases to experienced team members.
As a Tier 1 Technical Support Engineer at Fireberry, you will:
Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries via email and chat, providing first-line technical support.
Work to meet internal SLAs.
Identify and troubleshoot common software issues and guide customers through step-by-step resolutions.
Escalate complex technical issues to senior support team members, ensuring clear documentation and follow-up.
Collaborate with other teams to address customer concerns and provide effective solutions.
Document customer interactions, issues, and actions taken in the ticketing system.
Help customers understand product features and best practices.
Contribute to the team’s knowledge base and suggest improvements to support workflows.
Deliver a positive support experience and contribute to strong customer satisfaction results.
Continuously develop your knowledge of Fireberry’s platform and troubleshooting practices.
To succeed in this role, you’ll need:
An interest in technology and a desire to begin a career in technical support.
Basic technical understanding and an aptitude for learning software systems and troubleshooting.
Excellent communication and customer service skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
The ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
A willingness to learn, follow established support procedures, and work as part of a team.
High proficiency in English — mandatory, both verbal and written.
Previous experience in technical support or customer service — an advantage, but not required.
Familiarity with ticketing systems, SaaS platforms, or CRM software — an advantage.

EUBAM Rafah - Vacancy Announcement – Various positions (4 posts)
23.10.2026 New opportunity
Teaser
Application deadline : 13 November 2026.
Text
The
European Union Border Assistance Mission for the Rafah Crossing Point
–
EUBAM Rafah
– was launched on 24 November 2005 to monitor the operations of the border crossing point between the Gaza Strip and Egypt, after Israel and the Palestinian Authority concluded an Agreement on Movement and Access on 15 November 2005. The Council of the European Union approved that the EU should undertake the third-party role proposed.
EUBAM Rafah
is currently seeking dynamic, highly skilled candidates for immediate recruitment to fill the following
Four (4) vacancies:
MSDL 11 Procurement Officer (1 post): Provides procurement and contracting support to the Mission, ensuring compliance with applicable procurement rules and procedures. The position supports tendering, purchasing, contracting and related procurement administration, including coordination with relevant Mission units and stakeholders.
MSDL 12 Driver – Fleet Operator (1 post): Provides transportation, vehicle and fleet support to Mission members and external officials, contributing to the safe and efficient operation of the Mission’s vehicles and related transport activities.
MSDL 10 Logistics and Transport Assistant (1 post): Provides logistical and transport support to Mission staff, contributing to the effective management and distribution of Mission assets, supplies and transport resources.
HoML 03 Press & Public Information Officer / Graphic Designer / Editor / Social Media (1 post): Supports the Mission’s press and public information activities through graphic design, photography, video production, editing and social media management, producing visual and audiovisual content to communicate the Mission’s mandate, activities and achievements to relevant audiences.
Employment regime:
Locally Contracted Staff hired under Israeli Local Labor Law
Duty Station:
Ramat Gan - Tel Aviv
Opening Date: 23 October 2026
Closing Date: 13 November 2026
General employment/eligibility requirements:
Education and professional experience, as well as proficiency in English, Arabic and Hebrew, as specified in the relevant Job Description; a valid identification document permitting employment and unrestricted movement within the Mission’s area of operations; medical fitness for work; and a clean criminal record.
IMPORTANT:
Work is expected to be performed physically at the Mission offices in Ramat Gan, Monday through Friday. Candidates must be able to make the necessary arrangements to travel to and from the office premises on a daily basis. Applicants must hold a valid local identification document or work permit authorising employment at the Mission.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION FOR THE APPLICANTS
Applicants are reminded that the work of the Selection Committee is strictly confidential. Therefore, applicants must not contact, either directly or indirectly, any member of the Selection Committee, nor request that any other person do so on their behalf.

job.title: מבקר/ת איכות בכיר/ה – עיבוד שבבי מדויק | Senior QC Inspector
job.company: IDEA Machine Development Design & Production Ltd
job.snippet:
מבקר/ת איכות בכיר/ה – עיבוד שבבי מדויק | Senior QC Inspector
מיקום: אזור התעשייה קיבוץ שילר, רחובות
היקף: משרה מלאה | עבודה באתר החברה
יש לכם ניסיון עשיר בבקרת איכות בעיבוד שבבי מדויק, שליטה ב־CMM ורצון להעביר את הידע הלאה? הצטרפו לצוות האיכות של IDEA.
על החברה
IDEA מתמחה בפיתוח, ניהול שרשרת אספקה וייצור של מערכות אלקטרו־אופטיות מורכבות לתעשיות המוליכים למחצה, המכשור הרפואי, התעופה והביטחון.
מפעל העיבוד השבבי שלנו נמצא בתנופת צמיחה ומייצר חלקים אופטו־מכאניים ברמת דיוק גבוהה. המפעל מצויד במכונות CNC של Okuma ו־Mazak ובמכונות מדידה CMM של Hexagon ו־Mitutoyo.
על התפקיד
אנחנו מחפשים מבקר/ת איכות בכיר/ה לתפקיד מקצועי מרכזי, המשלב עבודה מעשית ברצפת הייצור, תכנות והפעלת CMM, שיתוף פעולה עם צוותי הייצור וההנדסה וחניכה מקצועית של חברי הצוות.
תחומי אחריות
• בחינת שרטוטים ובניית תוכניות מדידה, בחירת כלי מדידה ובדיקת זמינות מדידים.
• ביקורת ואישור סטאפים וחלקים ראשונים, ביקורת בתהליך וביקורת סופית לחלקים בעלי טולרנסים הדוקים.
• תכנות, כיול והפעלת מכונות CMM למדידת חלקים בעלי גיאומטריות מורכבות.
• שימוש בכלי מדידה ידניים, לרבות מד גובה, מיקרומטר, קליבר, פינים ומדידי הברגות.
• ניתוח תוצאות מדידה עם הכווננים/ות ומתן משוב מקצועי עד להשגת חלק תקין.
• הדרכה וחניכה של מהנדסים/ות, סטודנטים/ות ומפעילי/ות CNC.
דרישות התפקיד
• 5–10 שנות ניסיון כמבקר/ת איכות במפעל עיבוד שבבי מדויק – חובה.
• ניסיון מוכח בתכנות ובהפעלת מכונות CMM – חובה.
• שליטה מלאה בכלי מדידה ידניים ומסורתיים.
• יכולת גבוהה בקריאת שרטוטים הנדסיים מורכבים והבנה מעמיקה ב־GD&T.
• יחסי אנוש מעולים, סבלנות ויכולת לעבוד בשיתוף פעולה הדוק עם צוותי הייצור וההנדסה.
• רצון ללמד, לחנוך ולשתף ידע, לצד נכונות לעבוד בסביבה דינמית.
מה מחכה לכם אצלנו?
עבודה על חלקים מורכבים לתעשיות מתקדמות, ציוד מדידה מהמתקדמים בשוק, צוות תומך שמעודד למידה ושיתוף ידע, ואפשרויות להתפתחות מקצועית ולקידום.
להגשת מועמדות
מלאו את הטופס וצרפו קורות חיים:
https://wkf.ms/4A11E95
המשרה פונה לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

job.title: Power Electronics Engineer – Fusion Systems
job.snippet:
At nT-Tao, we are building a compact magnetic confinement fusion power system: a modular, repeatable unit designed to deliver clean electricity on-site, on- or off-grid. Getting there means solving hard, open problems in plasma physics, and that is the work our physicist's lead.
Founded in 2019, nT-Tao raised $34 million to date from Honda, East X Ventures, Delek US, NextGear Ventures, and others. The Israel Innovation Authority has awarded us repeated grants, most recently to build our next compact fusion demonstrator.
Position Overview
We are looking for a
hands-on Power Electronics Engineer
to join our multidisciplinary R&D team and take an active role in the design, development, integration, and commissioning of high-power and pulsed-power systems for our fusion prototypes and laboratory infrastructure.
You will be involved in developing advanced power electronics systems operating at high voltages, high currents, and demanding pulsed conditions.
You will work closely with physicists, mechanical engineers, software engineers, and laboratory teams, taking systems from initial requirements and conceptual design through detailed engineering, manufacturing, testing, and experimental operation.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and commission high-power and pulsed-power systems operating at tens of kV, tens of kA, and multi-MW peak power levels.
Design power converters, inverters, charging systems, switching circuits, capacitor banks, and energy-storage systems.
Develop gate drivers, control circuits, protection systems, and supporting electronics for high-power switching applications.
Design and integrate power electronics systems driving magnetic coils, inductive loads, and other experimental equipment.
Perform electrical circuit analysis, simulations, component selection, and system-level optimization.
Design and develop PCBs, including high-voltage, high-current, and control electronics.
Select and evaluate power semiconductor devices, magnetic components, capacitors, and other electrical components.
Take an active hands-on role in prototype assembly, integration, commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, and optimization.
Collaborate with physics, mechanical engineering, software, and laboratory teams to support experimental operations and system integration.
Prepare electrical schematics, design documentation, BOMs, technical specifications, and test reports.
Support the transition from experimental R&D prototypes toward reliable, scalable, and manufacturable power electronics systems.
Required Qualifications and Skills
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.
4+ years of experience in power electronics design and development.
Strong understanding of power electronics fundamentals, including switching converters, inverters, power semiconductor devices, and circuit analysis.
Familiarity with power semiconductor technologies such as MOSFETs, IGBTs, SCRs, SiC, or GaN devices.
Experience with power conversion, gate driving, protection circuits, and control electronics.
Understanding of magnetic components, including transformers and inductors.
Experience with PCB design, electrical schematics, and component selection.
Experience using circuit simulation tools such as LTspice, PSIM, PLECS, or similar software.
Proven hands-on capabilities in circuit assembly, testing, debugging, and troubleshooting.
Good communication, documentation, and teamwork skills.
Advantages
Experience with resonant converters, soft-switching techniques (ZVS/ZCS), and high-frequency power conversion.
Experience designing high-power inverters and drivers for inductive or resonant loads.
Experience with high-voltage insulation, electrical clearances, parasitic inductance, and electromagnetic interference (EMI/EMC).
Experience with RF power systems, impedance matching, or high-frequency power electronics.
Experience with MATLAB, Python, or similar tools for simulation, automation, and data analysis.
Experience working with suppliers, subcontractors, and manufacturing partners.

job.snippet:
קבוצת אורמש מגייסת איש/אשת רישוי להובלת תהליכי רישוי והיתרי בנייה, משלב הכנת תיק המידע ועד לקבלת היתר בנייה.
מה כולל התפקיד:
* בחינת נתוני המגרש, תנאי השטח, המצב הקיים ודרכי הגישה, והכנת תכניות הגשה בהתאם לדרישות התכנון.
* עבודה עצמאית במערכת רישוי זמין: הגשת תיקי מידע ובקשות להיתר, לרבות הכנת גרמושקות.
* ריכוז מסמכים, תצהירים ואישורים הנדרשים להליך הרישוי.
* טיפול בבקשות מול הוועדות המקומיות, לרבות מענה להערות, ביצוע תיקונים והשלמות עד לקבלת היתר.
* תיאום מול יועצים חיצוניים, בעלי מקצוע, מודדים מוסמכים ולקוחות.
* קידום אישורים, הצעות מחיר, אגרות ותשלומים מול הגורמים הרלוונטיים בחברה.

job.title: IT & ERP Manager
job.company: מ.ש. אלומיניום בע"מ / M.S. Aluminum Ltd
job.snippet:
About the Role:
M.S. Aluminum, a leading manufacturer and contractor of advanced aluminum and building envelope systems, is seeking an experienced IT & Priority Applications Manager to lead our IT infrastructure and enterprise systems. The role involves end-to-end management of technological projects, ERP enhancements, infrastructure administration, and the implementation of innovative solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Managing, developing, and implementing the Priority ERP system (process characterization, reports, and system integrations).
Leading cross-organizational technological projects end-to-end.
Administering IT infrastructure: servers, cloud environments, networking, and end-user hardware.
Providing continuous technical support to internal users.
Ensuring information security, regular data backups, and user permissions management.
Identifying and deploying automation, workflow enhancements, and AI tools to drive organizational efficiency.
Providing solutions for all IT and information system challenges across the company.
Requirements:
B.Sc. in Information Systems / Industrial Engineering & Management (IS specialization) / Computer Science or a related academic degree – Mandatory.
At least 3 years of hands-on experience in implementing, managing, or leading projects in Priority ERP – Mandatory.
At least 3 years of experience in IT / Information Systems roles within a business organization.
Hands-on proficiency with Microsoft Windows, Microsoft 365 environments, networking, endpoints, and permissions management.
Prior experience in an industrial, manufacturing, or engineering enterprise – Significant advantage.
High-level Hebrew and solid technical English.
Location & Type:
Full-time, On-site (Mishor Adumim).
To Apply:
Please send your CV to: LEE@MS-ALUM.CO.IL

job.title: NOC
job.snippet:
Founded in 2002, AU10TIX is a global leader in AI-driven identity verification and management, protecting the world’s largest brands against advanced fraud. Our future-proof product portfolio helps businesses provide frictionless customer onboarding and verification in 4–8 seconds, while staying ahead of emerging threats and evolving regulatory requirements.
The NOC’s top priority is to ensure that everything is functioning properly and that our systems are available and reliable 24/7. You will be responsible for monitoring our data center infrastructure, servers, networks, services, and logs, as well as supporting our worldwide B2B customers by providing an initial technical response, including:
Identifying, monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving issues independently, while following the appropriate escalation procedures.
Responding to customer issues and inquiries in a timely manner, according to documented SLAs.
Providing reliable and professional technical assistance to our customers.
Developing a broad understanding of customer needs and providing effective support.
Monitoring systems and services to identify potential issues and ensure operational continuity.
Working closely with internal teams to investigate and resolve technical issues.
Requirements
Working is in shifts 24/7, nights, weekends, and Holidays – MUST.
Fluent English with strong verbal (phone) and written (e-mail) communication skills – MUST.
The ability to work in a stress situations, Self-control, and calm – MUST.
Excellent customer service skills – MUST.
Advanced analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Quick learner & details oriented.
Require mobility.

job.title: Machine Operator- מפעיל.ת מכונה עפולה
job.snippet:
Job Description
הצטרפו לצוות שמאחורי מותגים אייקוניים כמו Huggies® ®, , Depend®
בקימברלי-קלארק, הכל כאן בשבילכם , חדשנות, צמיחה והזדמנות לעשות השפעה אמיתית.
נוצרת כדי ליצור טיפול טוב יותר לעולם טוב יותר: זו ההזדמנות שלך להפעיל מכונה שמייצרת מוצרים מהשורה הראשונה לרבע מאוכלוסיית העולם. תזכה להכרה לעיתים קרובות על ידי המנהל שלך, לתמוך בצוות שלך, ולראות את המוצרים שאתה מייצר משמשים את המשפחה שלך בסופו של דבר. זה מתחיל איתך.
עליך:
באחד מתפקידי הייצור שלנו, תתמקד בניצחון עם הצרכנים והשוק, תוך שמירה על בטיחות, כבוד הדדי וכבוד האדם במרכז.
תחומי אחריות עיקריים:
הפעלת המכונה
הזנת חומרי גלם
פתרון תקלות
תחזוקה בסיסית
אחריות על סדר וניקיון בסביבות העבודה.
התנהלות ישירה מול מנהל המכונה ומחלקות האחזקה במקרים של תקלות.
כדי להצליח בתפקיד זה, תצטרך את ההסמכות הבאות
השכלה – 12 שנות לימוד.
ניסיון קודם בהפעלת מכונה – יתרון.
רישיון מלגזה – יתרון
ניסיון של שנה לפחות בתפקיד דומה - יתרון
עבודה בשלוש משמרות : שבוע בוקר 07:00-15:30 , שבוע ערב 15:00-23:30 , שבוע לילה 23:00-07:30 ,
בנוסף עבודה בימי שישי )כשעובדים משמרת בוקר באותו שבוע ) - 07:00-12:00
ומוצ"ש - כשעובדים באותו שבוע משמרת לילה 23:00-07:30
בהובלת מטרה. מונע על ידך.
הטבות:
קליטה לחברה מהיום הראשון
סביבת עבודה תומכת ומתגמלת
סל רווחה - מתנות בחגים , ימי כיף לעובדי החברה
חדר אוכל פעיל במפעל
מערך הסעות מהאזור
להגשת מועמדות
לחץ/י על כפתור הגשת מועמדות והשלם/י את הגשת המועמדות שלך. צוות הגיוס שלנו יבחן את הבקשה שלך ויהיה איתך בקשר אם נראה שאת/ה מתאים/ה לתפקיד זה.
בינתיים, אנו מזמינים אותך להיכנס לאתר אתר הקריירה שלנו, שם תוכל/י למצוא מידע נוסף ומשרות נוספות.
האותיות הקטנות:
כדי שקימברלי-קלארק תמשיך לצמוח ולשגשג, עלינו להיות ארגון המיישם את הניסיון המגוון של חברי הצוות שלו למותגים שמשפרים את חייהם של אנשים ברחבי העולם. אנו פועלים באופן פעיל לבניית כוח עבודה מגוון המשקף את חוויות הצרכנים שלנו. כאשר את/ה מביא/ה את החשיבה המקורית שלך לקימברלי-קלארק, את/ה תורמ/ת להצלחה המתמשכת שלנו. אנו מחויבים להיות מעסיק שוויוני המאפשר לכל המועמדים המתאימים לקבל הזדמנות להעסקה ללא קשר לגזע, צבע, דת, מין, מוצא לאומי, מצב נכות, מעמד ותיק מוגן, נטייה מינית, זהות מגדרית, גיל, הריון, מידע גנטי, מעמד אזרחי או כל מאפיין אחר המוגן על פי חוק.
ההצהרות הנ"ל נועדו לתאר את האופי הכללי ורמת העבודה המבוצעת על ידי עובדים המשויכים לסיווג זה. ההצהרות אינן מיועדות להיחשב כרשימה ממצה של כל החובות, האחריות והכישורים הנדרשים לתפקיד זה.
Primary Location
Afula Plant
Additional Locations
Worker Type
Employee
Worker Sub-Type
Regular
Time Type
Full time

job.title: Application System Engineer
job.snippet:
Company Description
Nanomotion's solutions while identifying new business opportunities.
Nanomotion is seeking a motivated
Application Engineer
to support the integration, deployment, and optimization of advanced EO/IR payloads for UAV and drone applications.
This customer-facing role combines application engineering, technical support, and customer engagement. The successful candidate will work closely with customers, R&D teams, and business stakeholders to ensure successful product implementation and customer satisfaction.
Key Responsibilities
Support the integration of EO/IR payloads on UAV, UAS, drone, and robotic platforms.
Provide technical support to customers and partners throughout the product lifecycle.
Perform system configuration, troubleshooting, testing, validation, and field investigations.
Conduct customer demonstrations, acceptance tests, and field trials.
Deliver technical training to customers, distributors, and system integrators.
Develop technical documentation, application notes, and integration guides.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary R&D teams, including mechanical, electrical, software, and systems engineers.
Support pre-sales and post-sales activities, including technical presentations, workshops, and RFI/RFP responses.
Identify customer needs and provide technical recommendations to support business growth.
Requirements
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in Application Engineering, Systems Engineering, Technical Support, Field Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
Strong system-level understanding and troubleshooting capabilities.
Experience working directly with customers and international partners.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Willingness to travel internationally as required.
Advantages
Experience with electro-optical systems, imaging systems, sensors, cameras, or EO/IR payloads.
Familiarity with UAV/UAS platforms, drones, or robotics applications.
Knowledge of communication interfaces and system integration methodologies.
Experience with field testing, validation, and debugging tools.
Background in defense, aerospace, homeland security, or robotics industries.
Experience with Python or MATLAB.
Pilot or drone operator certification.
Personal Attributes
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented.
Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable working in a dynamic international environment.

job.title: Theoretical Plasma Physicist – Fusion Research
job.snippet:
About Us
At nT-Tao, we are building a compact magnetic confinement fusion power system: a modular, repeatable unit designed to deliver clean electricity on-site, on- or off-grid. Getting there means solving hard, open problems in plasma physics, and that is the work our physicist's lead.
Founded in 2019, nT-Tao raised $34 million to date from Honda, East X Ventures, Delek US, NextGear Ventures, and others. The Israel Innovation Authority has awarded us repeated grants, most recently to build our next compact fusion demonstrator.
Position Overview
We are looking for a
Theoretical Plasma Physicist
to join our multidisciplinary R&D team and contribute to the physics design, modelling, simulation, and optimization of our fusion systems.
The role combines theoretical research, numerical modelling, close collaboration with experimental physicists and engineers, and close collaboration with leading academic groups.
You  will investigate fundamental plasma processes, develop predictive models, interpret experimental observations, and translate theoretical insights into practical design requirements and R&D decisions.
The position offers an opportunity to work on challenging plasma physics problems while directly influencing the development of experimental fusion prototypes and future fusion energy systems.
Key Responsibilities
Develop theoretical and computational models of magnetically confined plasmas, including plasma equilibrium, stability, transport, confinement, and heating.
Perform numerical simulations to investigate plasma behaviour and optimize magnetic configurations and operating conditions.
Study plasma heating and current-drive mechanisms, including inductive, RF, and other relevant heating methods.
Investigate plasma dynamics, electromagnetic interactions, nonlinear phenomena, and their implications for confinement and performance.
Translate theoretical predictions and simulation results into physical requirements, engineering specifications, and experimental recommendations.
Collaborate closely with experimental physicists to design experiments, interpret measurements, and validate theoretical models against experimental observations.
Conduct literature reviews, evaluate new theoretical approaches, and apply relevant developments in plasma and fusion research.
Document and present theoretical results, technical conclusions, and recommendations to the R&D team and management.
Collaborate with academic and research partners in Israel and internationally.
Required Qualifications and Skills

job.description:
About Us
At nT-Tao, we are building a compact magnetic confinement fusion power system: a modular, repeatable unit designed to deliver clean electricity on-site, on- or off-grid. Getting there means solving hard, open problems in plasma physics, and that is the work our physicist's lead.
Founded in 2019, nT-Tao raised $34 million to date from Honda, East X Ventures, Delek US, NextGear Ventures, and others. The Israel Innovation Authority has awarded us repeated grants, most recently to build our next compact fusion demonstrator.
Position Overview
We are looking for a
Theoretical Plasma Physicist
to join our multidisciplinary R&D team and contribute to the physics design, modelling, simulation, and optimization of our fusion systems.
The role combines theoretical research, numerical modelling, close collaboration with experimental physicists and engineers, and close collaboration with leading academic groups.
You  will investigate fundamental plasma processes, develop predictive models, interpret experimental observations, and translate theoretical insights into practical design requirements and R&D decisions.
The position offers an opportunity to work on challenging plasma physics problems while directly influencing the development of experimental fusion prototypes and future fusion energy systems.
Key Responsibilities
Develop theoretical and computational models of magnetically confined plasmas, including plasma equilibrium, stability, transport, confinement, and heating.
Perform numerical simulations to investigate plasma behaviour and optimize magnetic configurations and operating conditions.
Study plasma heating and current-drive mechanisms, including inductive, RF, and other relevant heating methods.
Investigate plasma dynamics, electromagnetic interactions, nonlinear phenomena, and their implications for confinement and performance.
Translate theoretical predictions and simulation results into physical requirements, engineering specifications, and experimental recommendations.
Collaborate closely with experimental physicists to design experiments, interpret measurements, and validate theoretical models against experimental observations.
Conduct literature reviews, evaluate new theoretical approaches, and apply relevant developments in plasma and fusion research.
Document and present theoretical results, technical conclusions, and recommendations to the R&D team and management.
Collaborate with academic and research partners in Israel and internationally.

•

experience with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, networking, virtualization (VMware) and backup solutions..

• Proven ability to manage vendors and projects independently..
• Strong personality, high ownership and the ability to perform under pressure and make quick decisions..
• Excellent communication skills in Hebrew and English..
Advantages:
• Experience in retail and POS environments..
• Experience in a publicly traded company..

job.title: Brand & Customer Product Manager
job.snippet:
Job Description
Job Description
The Product Manager will lead brand strategy and the planned 2027 launch in Israel for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
This hands-on role requires strong marketing capabilities to translate scientific evidence, pulmonologist insights, and patient needs into differentiated positioning against current and future competitors.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the integrated launch plan, defining readiness milestones, accountabilities, timelines, and performance measures through post-launch optimization.
Develop and execute strategic and tactical brand plans, using market insights, pulmonologist segmentation, and patient needs to define differentiated positioning and value propositions.
Coordinate launch execution across Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Sales, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and Supply Chain, aligning workstreams and resolving barriers.
Build relationships with pulmonologists, respiratory KOLs, and healthcare stakeholders to inform educational and compliant engagement plans with Medical Affairs.
Partner with regional and global teams to represent Israeli needs, adapt strategy and assets locally, and share launch progress, risks, and early-market learnings.
Partner with Market Access to address coverage and reimbursement barriers.
Develop educational and communication initiatives for pulmonologists and all pre- and post-launch marketing and communication materials for the field team, ensuring evidence-based messaging, approved labeling, and appropriate review and approval.
Initiate and deliver creative digital and field-based projects addressing stakeholder needs and brand priorities.
Map the patient journey from prescription and insurance approval to ongoing use; address access and adherence barriers.
Monitor launch readiness, brand performance, market trends, access effectiveness, and aggregated patient support outcomes, including initiation and adherence where permitted, to guide optimization.
Ensure full compliance with regulatory requirements, company policies, and market-specific standards across all product-related activities.
Own forecasting, P&L, and budgets, with rigorous tracking and reporting to maximize return on investment.
Required Qualifications
Strong scientific understanding and ability to translate complex data into compelling business and marketing narratives.
At least 2 years of pharmaceutical product management experience, with ownership of brand planning and execution.
Proven cross-functional leadership and ability to influence without direct authority and mobilize teams around shared objectives.
Strong strategic and analytical thinking, emotional intelligence, and interpersonal skills.
Experience building professional collaborations with specialist physicians, KOLs, and healthcare stakeholders.
Ability to navigate regulatory and patient access processes and partner with Market Access to address barriers.
Creative, proactive, commercially minded, and solution-oriented, with strong judgment and ownership.

job.snippet:
IT Operations Specialist | Entry-Level Opportunity
Looking to start your career in IT? Your technical background could be your first step into IT Operations!
A leading organization in Central Israel is looking for a motivated
IT Operations Specialist
to join its technology operations team.
This is an excellent opportunity for candidates with a technical background from academic studies, professional training, or military service who want to gain hands-on experience working with IT systems, infrastructure, and enterprise technology environments.
Previous professional IT experience is not required.
We're looking for candidates with a solid technical foundation, strong problem-solving abilities, and a genuine interest in developing a career in IT Operations.
What You'll Do
Monitor and support the daily operation of IT systems and services.
Track system availability, operational processes, and infrastructure performance.
Identify technical issues, perform initial troubleshooting, and escalate incidents when needed.
Work with operating systems, servers, and monitoring tools.
Document technical incidents, service requests, and operational activities.
Collaborate with System, Networking, Infrastructure, and Information Security teams.
Perform routine IT operational tasks according to established procedures.
Learn new technologies, tools, and enterprise systems as part of the role.
Requirements
Relevant technical background from academic studies, professional training, or military service.
Basic familiarity with operating systems and IT environments.
Technical orientation and basic troubleshooting abilities.
Strong motivation to begin or develop a career in IT.
Ability to learn independently and adapt quickly to new technologies.
Organized, systematic, and detail-oriented working approach.
Strong personal responsibility and teamwork skills.
Good interpersonal communication and customer service mindset.
Advantages
Professional training or certification in System Administration, Networking, or IT.
Familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems.
Basic knowledge of Active Directory.
Understanding of fundamental computer networking concepts.
Familiarity with IT monitoring tools.
Relevant technical experience gained during military service.
Position Details
Location:
Central Israel
Employment Type:
Full-time
Experience Level:
Entry-level – No previous professional IT experience required.
If you're technically curious, enjoy solving problems, and want to build your career in IT infrastructure and operations, we'd love to hear from you!

job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.snippet:
Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era.
As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents.
Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide.
About The Role
We’re building a new product at the intersection of AI and data security - with startup speed, real ownership and Cato’s enterprise scale behind us. Join Cato DataSec to turn complex security data into a product that helps enterprises adopt AI with confidence.
This is an opportunity to shape a product from its earliest stages: solve open engineering problems, make architectural decisions and get working software into customers’ hands. You’ll build on Cato’s global SASE cloud, with real customers and real data from day one.
The engineering spans distributed systems, high-volume data processing, advanced analytics and the frontend experience that brings them together. The challenge is turning fragmented signals into intelligence that customers can act on - quickly, reliably and at scale.
What You'll Do
Ship complete features. Own capabilities end to end, from data pipelines and backend services through APIs and frontend implementation, rollout and iteration.
Find connections in complex data. Develop correlation and analytical capabilities that turn large volumes of security events into meaningful insights.
Build for scale. Design and operate streaming and batch pipelines, balancing throughput, latency, correctness and cost.
Shape the architecture. Make decisions across backend services, data processing and analytics, and validate them against production behaviour.
Stay close to the customer problem. Work with Product, Research, Data Science and security teams to turn emerging needs into shipped capabilities.
Own what you ship. Investigate issues, improve performance and reliability, and keep raising the quality of the product.
Our stack includes Java/Spring Boot, Kafka, Spark/Flink, ClickHouse/Athena and AWS.
Who We're Looking For
You’ve built something substantial and stayed with it after launch. You can explain the decisions you made, the constraints you worked around and what changed once real users arrived.
You’ve taken an unclear problem, worked out a practical approach and shipped a useful first version. You make progress without waiting for every detail to be specified, and you know which
assumptions need testing before moving ahead.
You want to remain hands-on across the product: writing backend code, building frontend flows and owning production outcomes. You follow a feature through to a usable customer experience,
including work outside your strongest area.
Your background might be a startup, a large-scale platform, a technology unit or research. Math, engineering and other non-CS paths are welcome. What you’ve built - and how you approached it - matters more than a perfect CV.
Requirements
5+ years of hands-on backend or software engineering, including production delivery.
Built and operated a data-intensive system, pipeline or analytics service.
Production experience with distributed systems and event-streaming infrastructure.
Shipped a user-facing feature end to end, with hands-on contributions to both backend and frontend implementation.
Can explain technical tradeoffs using concrete examples involving scale, reliability, performance or data correctness.
Can walk through a production issue you diagnosed and how you verified the fix.
Advantages
Correlation, similarity or entity resolution: matching, identity graphs or near-duplicate detection.
Data or AI security: DLP, CASB, DSPM, insider risk or AI-security systems.
Spark plus ClickHouse/Athena: pipeline development and analytical performance.
Flink or systems processing billions of events per day.
AWS, privacy engineering or production ML capabilities.
Startup, founding-team or zero-to-one product experience.
Why join
Build at an early stage with the reach of an established security platform. You’ll influence the architecture, work through problems without a ready-made playbook and see your decisions
tested by enterprise use.
If you want your next role to include “built it from scratch” and “owned it in production,” we’d like to hear from you.

The engineering spans distributed systems, high-volume data processing, advanced analytics and the frontend experience that brings them together. The challenge is turning fragmented signals into intelligence that customers can act on - quickly, reliably and at scale.
What You'll Do
Ship complete features. Own capabilities end to end, from data pipelines and backend services through APIs and frontend implementation, rollout and iteration.
Find connections in complex data. Develop correlation and analytical capabilities that turn large volumes of security events into meaningful insights.
Build for scale. Design and operate streaming and batch pipelines, balancing throughput, latency, correctness and cost.
Shape the architecture. Make decisions across backend services, data processing and analytics, and validate them against production behaviour.
Stay close to the customer problem. Work with Product, Research, Data Science and security teams to turn emerging needs into shipped capabilities.
Own what you ship. Investigate issues, improve performance and reliability, and keep raising the quality of the product.
Our stack includes Java/Spring Boot, Kafka, Spark/Flink, ClickHouse/Athena and AWS.
Who We're Looking For
You’ve built something substantial and stayed with it after launch. You can explain the decisions you made, the constraints you worked around and what changed once real users arrived.
You’ve taken an unclear problem, worked out a practical approach and shipped a useful first version. You make progress without waiting for every detail to be specified, and you know which
assumptions need testing before moving ahead.
You want to remain hands-on across the product: writing backend code, building frontend flows and owning production outcomes. You follow a feature through to a usable customer experience,
including work outside your strongest area.
Your background might be a startup, a large-scale platform, a technology unit or research. Math, engineering and other non-CS paths are welcome. What you’ve built - and how you approached it - matters more than a perfect CV.
Requirements
5+ years of hands-on backend or software engineering, including production delivery.
Built and operated a data-intensive system, pipeline or analytics service.
Production experience with distributed systems and event-streaming infrastructure.
Shipped a user-facing feature end to end, with hands-on contributions to both backend and frontend implementation.
Can explain technical tradeoffs using concrete examples involving scale, reliability, performance or data correctness.
Can walk through a production issue you diagnosed and how you verified the fix.
Advantages
Correlation, similarity or entity resolution: matching, identity graphs or near-duplicate detection.
Data or AI security: DLP, CASB, DSPM, insider risk or AI-security systems.
Spark plus ClickHouse/Athena: pipeline development and analytical performance.
Flink or systems processing billions of events per day.
AWS, privacy engineering or production ML capabilities.
Startup, founding-team or zero-to-one product experience.
Why join
Build at an early stage with the reach of an established security platform. You’ll influence the architecture, work through problems without a ready-made playbook and see your decisions
tested by enterprise use.
If you want your next role to include “built it from scratch” and “owned it in production,” we’d like to hear from you.

job.title: CISO for Startups & Technology Companies
job.snippet:
About the Opportunity
At Up Security, we're expanding our CISO services for startups and technology companies.
We're looking for an experienced CISO who knows how to take full ownership of a company's information security program, work directly with leadership teams, and translate security challenges into practical business decisions.
This opportunity is for someone who enjoys professional independence, working with technology companies, and making a real impact across different business environments.
What You'll Do?
Serve as a trusted CISO and security advisor for technology companies and startups.
Independently lead information security programs, from strategy and risk management to execution and ongoing oversight.
Work directly with CEOs, management teams, and business stakeholders.
Lead security governance, compliance, and risk management initiatives, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
Oversee information security, IT security, privacy, and customer security requirements.
Collaborate with Up Security's Product Security specialists to provide comprehensive security coverage.
Translate business and regulatory requirements into actionable security roadmaps.
What We're Looking For?
Proven experience as a CISO, Head of Information Security, or in an equivalent security leadership role.
Previous or current experience leading information security in startups, SaaS, product companies, or other technology-driven organizations.
Demonstrated ability to independently own and lead end-to-end information security activities.
Experience working directly with executives and communicating security priorities to business stakeholders.
Broad understanding of security governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, IT security, and technology environments.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.
Experience managing multiple clients as a fractional or virtual CISO - advantage.
Why Join Up Security?
Work with technology companies facing meaningful security and business challenges.
Take ownership of client security programs and influence key decisions.
Enjoy professional autonomy while collaborating with a dedicated team of security specialists.
Gain exposure to diverse environments and security challenges.
We are open to both employment and independent consulting arrangements.

job.title: Senior Field Operations Manager EMEA
job.snippet:
Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era.
As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents.
Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide.
We are looking for a Field Operations EMEA Manager to join our Revenue Operations team, partnering with Sales leadership and executives to drive pipeline analysis, sales cadence, forecasting, and productivity insights - playing a critical role in optimizing GTM processes and enabling strategic, data-driven decisions across a rigorous sales operating rhythm.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as the operational counterpart to sales leaders in executing against sales KPIs and business objectives.
Translate data into actionable insights and recommendations that improve sales productivity and performance.
Use AI tools and automation to streamline recurring work, accelerate analysis, and improve decision-making.
Support strategic planning and regional initiatives.
Monitor sales performance, track success metrics, and measure improvements.
Identify early warning signs and partner with sales leaders on preventative actions and corrective plans.
Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across reporting.
Monitor forecasts, identify risks and opportunities, and improve forecast accuracy.
Support regional budget planning, territory planning, target setting, and ramp-up planning.
What You’ll Do
Pipeline & Forecast Analysis: Own analysis of the sales pipeline from leads through closed deals. Prepare bookings reports, pipeline analyses, and dashboards that highlight trends, coverage, funnel risks and opportunities, and progress toward targets. Partner with sales managers on forecast calls to ensure accurate data, current forecasts, and informed decisions.
Operational Cadence & Reporting: Support sales operating rhythms, including manager check-ins, weekly pipeline reviews, forecast reviews, and Quarterly Business Reviews. Consolidate data from multiple sources into performance reviews that explain the story behind the numbers. Clearly communicate findings and recommended actions to regional VPs and the executive team.
Territory & Capacity Planning: Support regional leadership with budget planning, territory design, target setting, and ramp-up planning. Evaluate sales capacity, identify areas requiring investment or management attention, and recommend how to distribute resources across teams.
Sales Performance Insights: Analyze key sales metrics, including pipeline generation, coverage, win rates, conversion rates, sales cycle length, and retention. Identify trends and bottlenecks, investigate underlying causes, and recommend actions that improve sales productivity and outcomes.
AI & Process Improvement: Identify and implement practical uses of AI and automation across sales operations. Examples include accelerating analysis, summarizing pipeline and forecast changes, drafting business review narratives, and automating recurring reporting tasks. Measure the impact on time saved, accuracy, or business outcomes, and document effective workflows so others can use them.
Visualization & Storytelling: Maintain dashboards and reports that give stakeholders timely visibility into business performance. Translate complex findings into clear executive presentations, highlighting what changed, why it matters, and what action to take.
Data Quality & Validation: Maintain reliable reporting and CRM data. Validate AI-generated analyses, calculations, and summaries against source data, apply business judgment, and use company-approved tools in accordance with data privacy and security requirements.
Requirements
Demonstrated hands-on experience and results are required; a college degree is not required.
3–4 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Field/Sales Operations, or a similar role in a B2B environment. Experience in SaaS or a high-growth technology company is a plus.
Practical experience using AI tools in business workflows, with the ability to describe specific use cases, your approach, and the results achieved. Relevant examples include analysis, reporting, research, business review preparation, or process automation.
Ability to frame clear questions for AI tools, provide relevant context, refine outputs, and independently verify accuracy. Know when additional analysis or human judgment is needed.
A continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to identify repetitive work and build repeatable workflows using AI, automation, and existing business systems.
Excellent analytical skills, strong attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy. Ability to turn complex data into actionable recommendations and communicate the story behind the results.
Understanding of go-to-market strategy, B2B sales processes, and basic financial principles.
Solid understanding of SaaS and sales performance metrics, including pipeline coverage, sales cycle length, win rates, conversion rates, and retention.
Strategic thinking and a results-oriented approach to operational excellence.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including experience partnering with sales leaders, account executives, and cross-functional teams.
Strong presentation, data visualization, and executive storytelling skills.
High proficiency in spoken and written English.
Proficiency in Excel, SQL, and Tableau for analysis and visualization; Salesforce CRM, including report and dashboard creation and data quality management; and Clari or a similar forecasting and pipeline management tool.

job.title: FP&A Analyst
job.snippet:
Location:
Ramat Gan, Jabotinsky St. 2, Atrium Building
Work Model:
On-site
About us
Energix Renewables is a publicly traded, global renewable energy company operating across the United States, Poland, and Israel. Since its founding in 2009, Energix has grown into one of Israel's leading renewable energy platforms, driven by long-term vision, operational excellence, and a commitment to sustainable impact. We operate as a fully integrated renewable energy company, leading the entire lifecycle of solar (PV), wind, and energy storage projects - from origination and development through construction and long-term ownership. As listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and as part of the Alony-Hetz Group, Energix combines financial strength, global scale, and entrepreneurial spirit to accelerate the transition to clean energy worldwide.
As we continue to grow, we're looking for an FP&A Analyst to join our Finance team and play a key role in supporting strategic decision-making across our global business.
What you'll do
Lead annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and long-term planning processes.
Analyze financial performance and explain variances against budget and forecast.
Support long-term business planning and strategic initiatives.
Support Board, Executive Management, lenders, and investor reporting.
Monitor KPIs and operational performance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Build reports by integrating data from Oracle ERP, automate recurring financial and operational reports.
Work closely with other business teams across different territories.
Perform ad hoc financial analyses for strategic initiatives and investment decisions.
What we're looking for
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
At least 3 years of experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Financial Consulting, or Business Analytics.
Advanced Excel skills (must).
Experience working with Oracle ERP or other enterprise financial systems.
Experience building management dashboards, data visualization, and reporting automation.
Excellent English (written and spoken).
Self-starter with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Experience in energy, infrastructure, or real estate is a plus.
What we offer
Opportunity to work in one of Israel's leading renewable energy companies.
Exposure to international projects across Israel, US and Europe.
Gain exposure to executive management and strategic decision-making.
Be part of a collaborative team that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Significant professional growth and learning opportunities.
