job.title: Delivery Project Manager- Israel
job.snippet:
Your mission
Delivery Project Manager - Israel- JD
We are seeking a Project Manager
to join our team, overseeing and commissioning projects while ensuring their successful execution. This role demands a highly organized individual with a data-driven mindset, substantial experience in managing complex projects, and the ability to lead effectively in a dynamic, multicultural environment. The ideal candidate will exhibit strong technical acumen, adaptability, and excellent problem-solving skills, alongside the capacity to work independently and collaboratively under pressure.
Your Mission
As a Project Manager, you will be at the forefront of ensuring the successful delivery of diverse projects, aligning with organizational goals, and fostering a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.
Responsibilities
Develop and execute comprehensive project plans, ensuring timely delivery within scope, budget, and quality standards.
Coordinate internal and external resources for seamless project execution.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders.
Oversee critical project milestones, including FAT, commissioning, SAT, and handovers.
Monitor project performance, manage KPIs, and create detailed documentation.
Resolve technical and operational issues in coordination with relevant divisions.
Ensure timely collection of payments aligned with project milestones.
Manage project resources, including engineers, contractors, and equipment.
Lead on-site supervision of delivery and commissioning processes.
Drive continuous improvement and development of organizational processes.
Your profile
At least 3 years of experience in project management, particularly in complex and large-scale environments.
Highly organized and data-driven with strong tracking and analytical capabilities.
Self-motivated with the ability to lead projects independently and manage without formal authority.
Strong problem-solving skills, with a wide perspective and strategic thinking.
Flexible, assertive, and thrives under pressure in a global, multicultural, matrix organization.
Proficient in tools such as Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Visio, MS Project, and Monday.
Technical background or inclination, with experience in renewable energy, power electronics, IT, electricity, or civil engineering being a significant advantage.
Fluent in Hebrew and English (C1 level), with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Engineering degree in electrical, mechanical, or electronics fields is a strong advantage.
Why us?
Why Sungrow Israel?
Industry Leadership: Be part of a company that’s driving the future of renewable energy and shaping a more sustainable world.
Exceptional Work Environment: Collaborate with top professionals in a supportive and dynamic culture.
Excellent Terms and Conditions: We offer competitive compensation packages and outstanding benefits that rank among the best in the industry.
Growth Opportunities: From career development to skill-building, Sungrow Israel provides the tools and support you need to succeed.
The true topic for this decade Is RENEWABLE ENERGY！
We are more than happy to state that not only we are leading this discourse, but we also offer the fitting solutions for it. We have the strongest PV-Inverter R&D there is and became the world`s biggest Inverter
Manufacturer, which we are extremely proud of! And now, for this decade, we are increasing our game, and you might become part of it!
Besides That, Many Things Await You
Opportunities for Career advancement
Bonus payment based on pre-agreed and signed KPI agreements
A multinational team awaits You with lots of european and transeuropean exchange!
Possibility for technical and commercial knowledge increasement in regard to string inverters, central inverters, inverter stations including transformer and switch gear and storage solutions
Technical and commercial training in our headquarter in Germany and even visits to the big R&D facility in China!
Join us in shaping the renewable energy landscape.
Apply to contribute to our success and be a vital part of our global team.
About Us
We are a green tech company with young creative minds.
We are fighting every day to make our mission happen –
Clean Power for All
!
With 870+GW of clean power presently installed worldwide, we are on the road to success!
Welcome at Sungrow
Founded in 1997 by University Professor Cao Renxian, Sungrow is a leader in the research and development of solar inverters with the largest dedicated R&D team in the industry and a broad product portfolio offering PV inverter solutions and energy storage systems for utility-scale, commercial & industrial, and residential applications, as well as internationally recognized floating PV plant solutions, NEV driving solutions, EV charging solutions and renewable hydrogen production systems.
Want to know more? Check out what working with us is like!

job.title: Commercial Project Manager כלכלן/ית בקרה תקציבית לפרוייקטים
job.snippet:
Commercial Project Manager
The Commercial Project Manager is responsible for managing the project throughout its life cycle,
ensuring financial accuracy, compliance, risk management, and effective stakeholder communication.
Project Management
:
Support the PM in identifying, evaluating, and assessing risks & opportunities,
strategies, and response activities according to FRG and PM Guide.
Ensure adherence to NCM regulations and internal controls (RIC, ICFR).
Manage and coordinate all contractual, administrative, legal, tax, accounting,
and financial aspects of business execution in partnership with the PM.
Financial Management:
Ensure the accuracy of cost and pricing calculations and overall project books and records.
Prepare commercial documentation for regular project status meetings and
ensure the accuracy of commercial project data (e.g., FC, MIKA, cash flow).
Perform asset management.
Initiate invoicing according to project progress and contractual terms, and ensure proper payment allocation.
Ensure compliance with Siemens Energy FRG and local GAAP requirements.
Manage financial guarantees, bonds, and project securities.
Support the PM in minimizing non-conformance costs and implementing lessons learned.
Risk & Contract Management :
Ensure compliance with LoA guidelines for commercial aspects and conduct contract,
claim, and change order negotiations.
Set up and manage contract and claim management processes, including involvement of the assigned CM if required.
Identify, assess, respond to, monitor, report, and escalate all commercial risks (e.g., calculation, tax, insurances, currency).
Communicate relevant commercial contractual obligations and conditions to the project team.
Review, approve, or reject change requests and enforce legitimate claims while fending off unjustified claims.
Perform credit risk analysis for potential customers and supervise the purchasing service to ensure compliance with the P2P process.
Compliance Management:
Lead commercial project members to act according to Business Conduct Guidelines and establish a culture of trust and integrity.
Ensure compliance with relevant tax regulations, export control regulations, and hedging/currency regulations.
Support the PM in setting up a framework for regular compliance checks in the project.
Empowerment:
Drive own empowerment with adequate signature authorization and project target
agreement to manage the project as a commercial project entrepreneur.
Support the PM in managing and optimizing targeted financial results.
Stakeholder Management:
Support the PM in conducting stakeholder analysis and ensure efficient communication with all
relevant internal and external stakeholders (e.g., HR, Quality Management, EHS, customers, suppliers, consortium partners).
Ensure proper execution of all tasks with relevant stakeholders (e.g., SFS, CF, RIC, Legal and Compliance, HR, ECC, Customs, external auditors).
Foster effective communication, manage conflicts, and interact with stakeholders to ensure project financing execution.
Customer Management:
Gather information on customer strategies, requirements and targets regarding commercial topics.
Communicate with senior commercial representatives of the customer and manage the resolution of commercial issues.
Build relationships with the customer's senior commercial management and manage customer expectations with the PM.
Perform lessons learned activities on commercial aspects and feed results into project and organizational lessons learned activities.
Strategic Development:
Act as an advisor for senior commercial management regarding all project issues.
Support the PM in developing and considering strategic targets for the project in alignment with business strategy.
Represent the project in relevant decision boards internally and externally.
Identify and create additional opportunities out of the project.
Competencies:
Project Management
Claim Management
Risk Management
Coaching & Teamwork
Conflict Management
Specialist in Management Control and Finance
Knowledge of Accounting, Tax, Legal, HR, Purchasing, Logistics
Knowledge of International Trade Rules
Fluent English
Note:
Some Siemens Energy units differentiate the commercial responsibility between Sales/Offer and Execution phase. Accordingly, some of the above defined mandatory tasks where the CPM is fully responsible for may not apply, while others might be further specified in respective guidelines.
The above defined responsibilities are standardized from a Siemens Energy point of view. This job profile is a standard for Commercial Project Managers, while further specification is in principle foreseen.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than
90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community
is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy
transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of
what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus
on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative
energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender,
age, reJobs & Careers: https://jobs.siemens-energy.comligion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
Jobs & Careers: https://jobs.siemens-energy.com

job.title: Director Of Data
job.snippet:
We’re looking for a Director of Data to lead the data department and own the company’s data platform, reporting, analytics and data products. The role reports to the EVP Technology. You’ll set the direction for how Tenengroup uses data, including AI.
You’ll own the full chain, from data collection to the numbers leadership uses to make decisions. You’re accountable for the data being available on time and being
correct
, not just for the pipelines running. You’ll work daily with Marketing, Finance, Merchandising, Product and senior management. You’ll turn their questions into reliable data products and help the business decide how to grow revenue.
Responsibilities:
Strategy and leadership:
Set the data and analytics vision and roadmap. Prioritize a large, competing backlog against business impact, and partner with senior management on growth strategy.
Team:
Lead and grow the department: Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, and a Data Product Manager. Hire, coach and build a strong engineering and analytics culture.
Lakehouse platform:
Own the cloud lakehouse (Databricks / Unity Catalog), plus ingestion, orchestration and CI/CD for data pipelines. Drive a clear medallion/gold-layer architecture, and manage platform cost and performance.
Data trust and reliability:
Own production SLAs, monitoring and incident response. Build data-quality gates that check business logic, not just job success. Make sure a pipeline that “succeeded” but loaded bad or missing data gets caught before it reaches a dashboard.
Marketing measurement:
Own the data behind media spend, ROAS, attribution and the A/B testing framework, and make sure the statistics are sound. Be the trusted arbiter of “what’s working.”
BI and self-service:
Own the BI layer (Tableau). Build governed, certified datasets and one shared set of metric definitions. Keep content, access and licences under control, and move reporting off ad-hoc sources.
AI and a semantic layer:
Lead adoption of AI across the data stack. That covers a governed semantic layer that makes natural-language and LLM querying reliable, plus AI-assisted engineering and analysis inside the team.
Documentation and governance:
Keep lineage, ownership, documentation and data access policies current.
Requirements:
5+ years in a data leadership role
People-management experience, preferably including managing team leads
Proven experience building and running a modern cloud data platform (Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery), including data modeling, orchestration (e.g. Airflow) and data pipelines in production
Strong hands-on SQL, and the ability to review code and data models, not just delegate them
Deep BI experience (Tableau preferred) and a track record of governed, self-service analytics
Solid grounding in experimentation and statistics, and in marketing measurement (attribution, incrementality, ROAS)
A track record of making data trustworthy: data-quality frameworks, observability and SLAs
Clear communicator who can challenge and influence senior stakeholders with data
Advantages:
B2C / D2C e-commerce experience, especially multi-brand or multi-site
Experience with GA4, web event tracking and streaming ingestion (e.g. Kafka)
Hands-on experience applying LLMs to analytics (semantic layers, text-to-SQL, AI agents)
Experience managing platform cost (FinOps)

job.snippet:
אנוש מחפשת מנהל.ת חשבונות נלהב.ת שרוצה להגיע לתפקיד בעל ערך ומשמעות עבור האחר. במסגרת תפקידך, תקבל.י את ההזדמנות לעבוד בסביבה תומכת ומעוררת השראה ולתרום ממקצועיותך לשיפור חיי אנשים רבים.
העמותה הישראלית לבריאות הנפש, אשר מעניקה מגוון שירותי שיקום ושילוב פורצי דרך למתמודדי נפש.
• רישום פקודות יומן
• רישום חשבוניות ספקים
• הכנת תשלומים לספקים
• הכנת קופות קטנות
• ביצוע התאמות בכרטיסים
• טיפול בפרויקטים שונים במחלקה
• עבודה מרובת ממשקים, פנים וחוץ ארגוניים
מה אנחנו מחפשים?
• מנהל.ת חשבונות סוג 2 – חובה
• ניסיון קודם בתפקיד מנהל.ת חשבונות של שנה- חובה
• ידע בסיסי בEXCEL – חובה
• ניסיון בתוכנת PRIORITY – יתרון
• יחסי אנוש מעולים ויכולת עבודה בצוות, תקשורת ושירותיות ברמה טובה
• סדר, ארגון יסודיות ויכולת לירידה לפרטים ועמידה בזמנים
משרה מלאה במטה העמותה בכפר סבא
יום עבודה מהבית לאחר תקופת הכשרה

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Team
job.snippet:
We’re a global team of over 400 people, working together to push the boundaries of open-source technology and multi-cloud solutions. Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone.
The Role
The team is at the center of Aiven's move into agentic AI. We build the platform and tooling that let AI agents and developers work with data on Aiven, from the agent runtimes and the interfaces that connect large language models to real systems, to the product experiences on top of them. Our work ships fast, reaches customers and AI agents directly, and defines how Aiven's data platform is used in an AI-first world.
We are looking for an experienced full-stack engineer to help design and build these AI and agentic products end to end. You'll be part of a small, senior team that owns its work from idea to production. Our backend services are written in Python and TypeScript, our agents run on frontier LLMs, and our frontend uses React and TypeScript, all on top of Aiven's own data platform.
What You'll Do: Writing high quality, maintainable code and releasing quality features Contributing to technical planning and backlog management Helping investigate and resolve customer issues Mentor and empower other engineers around you What We're Looking For:
Must-have
Excellent development skills in Python, TypeScript, and React Excellent understanding of Agentic AI systems Ability to independently solve challenges, break tasks and push to desired outcome Ability to write good automated tests Experience using Linux in development Fluency in English, verbal and written Deep, daily use of AI agents in your own development workflow: you go beyond Cursor or Claude Code as autocomplete, and build your own MCP servers, skills, custom tools and automated agent workflows to multiply your output.
Nice To Have
Distributed systems knowledge
Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t line up perfectly – we still encourage you to apply! We believe in investing in our crabs’ professional growth.
Amazing! What’s next:
If you think Aiven is the place for you and that our Values align with yours, send us your resume and we’ll get in touch!
Global Benefits
Our global benefits are designed to help you thrive and grow, personally and professionally:
Benefits
Participate in Aiven’s equity plan. Balance work and life with our hybrid work policy. Choose the equipment you need to set yourself up for success. Use your Professional Development Plan budget for learning opportunities. Receive holistic wellbeing support through our global Employee Assistance Program. Inquire about our Global Time Off Commitment (Parental and Sick Leave, as well as Personal Time) Enjoy country-specific benefits for our global cast. How to Recognize and Avoid Employment Scams:
There has been a rise in fake job postings used by scammers to get personal information. At Aiven, all of our emails relating to recruitment come from an @aiven.io, @greenhouse.io or @eu.greenhouse.io domain and all of our interviews are conducted by video call or in person. Our interviews will never occur via text or chat. If you’re unsure of the legitimacy of a job opportunity/offer pertaining to Aiven, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at recruitment@aiven.io.
Equal Opportunities
Aiven provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants for employment without regard to age, gender identity, national or ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, physical and mental ability, marital and family status or without regard to any other similar personal attributes. Aiven complies with applicable local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company operates. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, training and any other terms and conditions related to employment.
At Aiven we are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities or special needs in our working environment and job application procedures. We make all reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities or who otherwise need support to thrive in the workplace. We are committed to continuously improving workplace accessibility. There is an option to request a discussion in the application process but if you have any questions before applying please write to us at recruitment@aiven.io.

job.title: Senior Brand & Digital Designer (Motion & Video)
job.snippet:
About Encore AI
Encore AI helps enterprises turn customer interactions into revenue by scaling the expertise of their best people. Our platform analyses customer conversations to uncover missed opportunities, identify what top performers do differently, and turn those insights into AI that acts.
Through Wingman, we guide customer-facing teams in real time. Through Autopilot, our AI agents run customer journeys end to end across channels. Together, they help organizations improve conversion, capture more revenue opportunities, and continuously strengthen performance.
We work with banks, lenders, insurers, and other enterprises in regulated industries, bringing AI into complex customer journeys where trust, accuracy, and measurable business results matter.
The Role
We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Brand & Digital Designer to bring Encore AI’s story to life and set the visual standard across the company.
Our customers are banks, insurers, and large financial institutions. Your work will make complex AI capabilities clear and compelling, combining a distinctive creative voice with the credibility and polish these audiences expect.
You’ll build on our existing brand and push it further, turning complex technology into compelling visual stories. Across digital design, motion, video, and presentations, you’ll own the work from concept to final delivery, bringing strong creative judgment and hands-on execution to every project.
Your influence will extend across the company, from the materials we put in front of customers to internal communications and the platform’s visual language, working closely with product and engineering.
This is an individual contributor role with broad creative ownership. You’ll spend most of your time making, while building templates and practical guidelines that help others maintain the same standard. We’re looking for someone who brings fresh ideas, works independently, and cares about the details of everything that ships.
What You’ll Do
Own visual quality and consistency.
Apply and evolve our existing brand across internal and external materials, setting a high standard for everything the company produces.
Design our digital presence.
Rethink and redesign website pages, including our homepage and landing pages, shaping visual storytelling, content hierarchy, and responsive layouts in partnership with marketing and development.
Create enterprise-facing materials.
Design sales decks, proposals, one-pagers, case studies, reports, and event collateral that make complex products and business value easy to understand.
Produce video and motion content.
Take product demos, explainers, launch videos, and social content from concept and storyboard through design, editing, animation, and final delivery.
Support company-wide design needs.
Bring the same care to social posts, internal presentations, company documents, and executive communications.
Connect the brand to the platform.
Partner with product design and engineering to align the platform’s visual expression with our brand.
Build reusable design systems.
Create templates, asset libraries, and practical guidelines that help teams produce consistent work independently.
Use AI in your workflow.
Apply AI tools to explore ideas, accelerate production, and improve iteration while maintaining control over quality and detail.
Lead projects through delivery.
Clarify briefs, prioritise requests, present design decisions, and collaborate with external specialists when a project requires additional expertise.
Requirements
5+ years of experience in brand, visual, or digital design, with experience in B2B technology companies or agencies serving enterprise clients.
A strong portfolio showing range across brand and digital design, including websites, presentations, and motion and video work you personally created.
Strong typography, layout, and visual storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex technical content clear and compelling for enterprise audiences.
Proficiency in Figma, motion design and video editing tools such as After Effects and Premiere Pro, and presentation tools such as PowerPoint or Google Slides.
Practical experience using AI tools in creative workflows, with strong judgment about quality and where they add value.
Ability to own projects from concept to delivery, work within an established brand, and collaborate across teams while managing priorities independently.
Strong English communication skills.
Nice to Have
Experience with financial services, cybersecurity, or other regulated enterprise industries.
Experience creating product visualisations and explaining AI or complex software through design.
Experience directing freelancers, studios, or video production partners.
Why Join Encore AI
You’ll have direct influence over how Encore AI is seen by some of the world’s most demanding enterprise buyers. With an established brand foundation and a broad range of work to shape, you’ll have room to bring your own ideas, improve our digital presence, and turn complex technology into clear, compelling visual stories.
To Apply
Please share your portfolio, including website work, enterprise-facing materials, and motion or video examples. For each project, tell us what you personally owned and produced.

job.title: Clinical & Technical Support Specialist
job.snippet:
Company Description:
Dormotech Medical Ltd. is a fast-growing digital health company developing innovative solutions for sleep diagnostics.
Our flagship technology, DormoVision X™, is a next-generation home PSG system designed to provide high-quality multi-channel sleep recordings in a simple, patient-friendly setup. Dormotech works with sleep centers, clinics, and research institutions worldwide.
We are looking for a motivated and technically oriented team member who enjoys working with customers, solving problems, and learning new technologies.
Role Description:
We are looking for a Junior Clinical & Technical Support Specialist to join our team.
This is a customer-facing role focused on technical support, troubleshooting, customer training, onboarding, and ongoing assistance. You will work directly with international customers and collaborate with internal Product, R&D, Clinical, and Operations teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Provide technical support to international customers using Dormotech devices and software.
Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for customer questions, technical issues, and system-related support.
Troubleshoot device, application, connectivity, setup, and recording issues remotely.
Guide customers through device installation, configuration, and proper system use.
Provide online and on-site training to sleep technicians, clinicians, and other medical staff.
Assist customers with basic review of recording quality and help identify possible setup or signal-related issues.
Document, track, and follow up on customer support cases until resolution.
Escalate software, hardware, or product issues to the relevant internal teams and coordinate follow-up.
Work closely with R&D, product, operations, and clinical teams to investigate customer-reported issues.
Collect customer feedback and communicate recurring issues or improvement opportunities internally.
Help create and update user guides, troubleshooting materials, FAQs, and training documentation.
Support customer onboarding and implementation of Dormotech systems at new sites.
Maintain a high level of customer responsiveness and provide occasional support outside standard working hours when required.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in a technical, scientific, biomedical, or clinical field, or relevant experience.
Strong technical orientation and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and customer service skills.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Ability to learn new systems quickly and work independently.
Organized, responsible, and comfortable managing multiple support cases.
Advantages:
Experience in technical support, help desk, or customer success.
Experience with medical devices or healthcare technology.
Familiarity with sleep medicine, PSG, HST, or physiological signals.
Experience with Jira or similar ticketing systems.
What We Offer:
Hands-on experience in medical technology and digital health.
Direct work with international customers.
Close collaboration with Product, R&D, and Clinical teams.
A dynamic environment with opportunities to learn and grow.

job.title: Flight Control Engineer
job.snippet:
We're looking for a
Senior Flight Control Algorithms Engineer
to join an innovative startup developing cutting-edge autonomy technology for
drone
operations in complex real-world environments.
This is an opportunity to join the company at an early stage, work directly with the CTO, and become one of
two senior algorithm engineers
shaping the core technology behind the product. As the company grows, you'll have the opportunity to influence both the technical direction and the future of the engineering organization.
What you'll do
Design and develop F
light Control algorithms
for autonomous drone systems
Develop navigation, estimation and sensor fusion algorithms using GNSS, IMU, Radar, LiDAR and additional sensors
Build simulations, analyze flight performance and validate algorithms
Participate in flight testing, log analysis and continuous algorithm improvement
Collaborate closely with software, electronics and mechanical engineers to bring algorithms into production
We're looking for someone with
Proven experience developing navigation algorithms for autonomous systems (UAV experience is highly preferred)
Strong understanding of control theory, navigation and state estimation
Hands-on experience with sensor fusion and real-world autonomous systems
Experience taking algorithms from concept and simulation through testing and deployment
B.Sc. or higher in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
Experience with ROS, PX4 or ArduPilot is an advantage, but strong algorithmic fundamentals and real-world GNC experience are far more important.
Why join?
Join at a pivotal stage before significant company growth
Work directly with the CTO and a small, highly experienced core engineering team
Own a critical part of the autonomy stack
Build technology that goes from mathematical design to real-world flight
Help shape both the product and the future of the company

job.title: DevOps Technical Lead
job.snippet:
Company Description
FlightOps.io develops the FlightOps Drone Operating System, a cloud-based platform that enables drone service providers to scale operations efficiently and safely. The system delivers high levels of autonomy, removes traditional range limitations, and supports synchronized operations in shared airspace. FlightOps.io focuses on enabling certification and control of multiple drones operating beyond visual line of sight, particularly in complex urban environments. The company’s technology is designed for providers who want to expand commercial drone services while maintaining reliability, compliance, and operational excellence.
Role Description
The DevOps Technical Lead will be a full-time, on-site team member based in Herzliya, responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable cloud infrastructure for the FlightOps Drone Operating System. This role includes leading the adoption and optimization of CI/CD pipelines, implementing infrastructure as code practices, and ensuring system reliability, performance, and security. The DevOps Technical Lead will collaborate closely with software developers, system administrators, and product teams to streamline deployments, troubleshoot production issues, and improve observability and automation across environments. Day-to-day responsibilities also include mentoring team members, establishing best practices, and contributing to architectural decisions that support highly available and resilient drone operations.
Qualifications
Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and practices, such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar.
Proficiency in Software Development, preferably in languages commonly used for backend or DevOps tooling (e.g., Python, Go, or similar).
Hands-on expertise in Continuous Integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or comparable systems.
Solid background in System Administration and Linux, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
Experience with enterprise on-prem and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization/orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Knowledge of networking, security best practices, and high-availability architectures for distributed systems.
Proven ability to lead technical initiatives, mentor engineers, and collaborate in cross-functional teams.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with real-time, mission-critical, or IoT systems is an advantage, especially in aviation or robotics domains.

job.title: נציגת תפעול
job.snippet:
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team of Operation Support Agents.
Who We Are
FedEx is the largest express transportation company in the world, connecting more than 220 countries and territories. We work every moment to deliver the most important package of someone’s day. Our team of passionate people know their day-to-day work is invaluable in delivering outstanding experience to our customers. 530,000 team members strong, we are as diverse as the world we serve. We love what we do, and we do it well. Our reach is big, and so are our dreams. Join us and let's write our next chapter together.
What You Will Be Doing
Ensuring that customers' urgent packages get to the right place, on time
Answering incoming calls from customers in relation to shipment collection requests and delivery inquiries
Checking and investigating failed shipments deliveries or collections when needed; prioritising and reallocating any failed deliveries for the next day delivery
Entering data into our in-house tracking system
Running clear and effective communication and collaboration with the team, your manager, and other operations stations
Adhering to FedEx processes, procedures and controls, and regulatory requirements
What Do You Bring With You
Good communication and social skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with strict timelines
Ability to manage own time effectively with attention to detail
What Do We Offer
Attractive compensation package
Training to get you started and on-the-job learning opportunities
Extensive learning resources to further develop your skills and knowledge
Tuition Assistance Program (*applicable for FedEx positions with a permanent contract)
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family in difficult life situations
Employee reduced-rate shipping
Great career opportunities
FedEx is one of the worlds most admired companies and trusted brands year after year
Bring your ideas, individuality, and dreams to our global community. Feel good about where you work. Choose your career path - we’re ready to invest in your development. Join FedEx.
FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce in which we provide growth opportunities for all
Our Company
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
Our Philosophy
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
Our Culture
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.
Equality, Opportunity & Diversity (EO&D)
Our greatest asset at FedEx is our people. We are committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, and offer equal opportunities, fairness, and respect to all regardless of who you are. We encourage you to apply even if you feel your experience does not align with all aspects in the job description as you could be exactly who we need for this or another opportunity.
We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, age, genetic information, citizenship, disability, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other characteristic protected under international and national laws and regulations. We reasonably accommodate team members and third parties to ensure equal access, inclusion, and fairness across all protected characteristics.

job.title: Logistics Coordinator
job.snippet:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
Group/Division
KLA's Global Supply Chain (GSC) oversees sourcing, supplier contracting and management, materials management, direct and indirect procurement, and logistics and trade compliance. GSC leads activities to establish and manage an innovative, reliable, efficient, effective and compliant global supply chain and logistics structure that strengthens KLA's competitive advantage.
What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
Position Summary:
The Logistics Coordinator is accountable for supporting the effective movement, storage, inventory control, and distribution of semiconductor equipment, spare parts, and materials across international logistics operations. The position is responsible for enabling timely shipment execution, maintaining high service standards, supporting inventory accuracy, ensuring compliance with applicable logistics and trade requirements, and contributing to operational excellence in close collaboration with internal stakeholders, suppliers, freight providers, customs brokers, and third-party logistics partners.
Scope:
The role covers inbound and outbound logistics operations, spare parts availability, warehouse management, transportation execution, customs and trade compliance support, customer and service requirements, and continuous improvement activities across regional and global logistics networks.
Key Responsibilities:
Coordinate inbound, outbound, urgent, and critical shipments between manufacturing sites, suppliers, distribution centers, depots, repair facilities, field stocking locations, and customer sites.
Oversee shipment status, delivery performance, Proof of Delivery updates, and service-level adherence; address transportation, order, receiving, and warehouse-related exceptions in a timely manner.
Manage warehouse activity, spare parts order execution, returns, replenishment activity, inventory movements, cycle count support, reconciliations, and stock investigations to safeguard material availability and inventory accuracy.
Collaborate with service, planning, customer support, procurement, suppliers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and third-party logistics providers to support customer commitments and business continuity.
Support import/export execution, shipping documentation, controlled shipments, and the timely resolution of customs or regulatory matters in accordance with company and regional compliance requirements.
Ensure accurate transactions in SAP/ERP systems and support data accuracy, KPI reporting, dashboards, metrics, and process improvement initiatives.
Escalate shipment delays, compliance concerns, service failures, and operational risks, and support corrective actions with relevant stakeholders and logistics partners.
Minimum Qualifications
Degree or formal qualification in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or equivalent professional logistics experience.
Minimum five years of experience in logistics, transportation, warehouse operations, inventory control, or international supply chain environments.
Solid understanding of transportation, warehousing, inventory management, import/export activity, customs processes, and logistics service execution.
Proficiency in ERP/SAP and Microsoft Office; experience with Excel, Outlook, Power BI, WMS, TMS, or shipment tracking platforms is preferred.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and organizational capabilities.
Customer-oriented, detail-focused, accountable, adaptable, self-driven, and capable of working independently and collaboratively across international teams.
Working Environment:
The position operates within a dynamic semiconductor logistics environment supporting manufacturing sites, service operations, repair centers, customer locations, and regional/global distribution networks. A high level of responsiveness, diligence, ownership, and judgment is required to sustain customer uptime, material availability, compliance, and operational excellence. Domestic travel will be required approximately 1–2 times per month.
About KLA
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
Use of AI Statement
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.
KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Position Summary:
The Logistics Coordinator is accountable for supporting the effective movement, storage, inventory control, and distribution of semiconductor equipment, spare parts, and materials across international logistics operations. The position is responsible for enabling timely shipment execution, maintaining high service standards, supporting inventory accuracy, ensuring compliance with applicable logistics and trade requirements, and contributing to operational excellence in close collaboration with internal stakeholders, suppliers, freight providers, customs brokers, and third-party logistics partners.
Scope:
The role covers inbound and outbound logistics operations, spare parts availability, warehouse management, transportation execution, customs and trade compliance support, customer and service requirements, and continuous improvement activities across regional and global logistics networks.
Key Responsibilities:
Coordinate inbound, outbound, urgent, and critical shipments between manufacturing sites, suppliers, distribution centers, depots, repair facilities, field stocking locations, and customer sites.
Oversee shipment status, delivery performance, Proof of Delivery updates, and service-level adherence; address transportation, order, receiving, and warehouse-related exceptions in a timely manner.
Manage warehouse activity, spare parts order execution, returns, replenishment activity, inventory movements, cycle count support, reconciliations, and stock investigations to safeguard material availability and inventory accuracy.
Collaborate with service, planning, customer support, procurement, suppliers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and third-party logistics providers to support customer commitments and business continuity.
Support import/export execution, shipping documentation, controlled shipments, and the timely resolution of customs or regulatory matters in accordance with company and regional compliance requirements.
Ensure accurate transactions in SAP/ERP systems and support data accuracy, KPI reporting, dashboards, metrics, and process improvement initiatives.
Escalate shipment delays, compliance concerns, service failures, and operational risks, and support corrective actions with relevant stakeholders and logistics partners.
Minimum Qualifications
Degree or formal qualification in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or equivalent professional logistics experience.
Minimum five years of experience in logistics, transportation, warehouse operations, inventory control, or international supply chain environments.
Solid understanding of transportation, warehousing, inventory management, import/export activity, customs processes, and logistics service execution.
Proficiency in ERP/SAP and Microsoft Office; experience with Excel, Outlook, Power BI, WMS, TMS, or shipment tracking platforms is preferred.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and organizational capabilities.
Customer-oriented, detail-focused, accountable, adaptable, self-driven, and capable of working independently and collaboratively across international teams.
Working Environment:
The position operates within a dynamic semiconductor logistics environment supporting manufacturing sites, service operations, repair centers, customer locations, and regional/global distribution networks. A high level of responsiveness, diligence, ownership, and judgment is required to sustain customer uptime, material availability, compliance, and operational excellence. Domestic travel will be required approximately 1–2 times per month.
About KLA
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
Use of AI Statement
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.
KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: Paid Acquisition Manager
job.snippet:
About Humanz
Humanz is a leading startup revolutionizing the creator economy. We are changing how brands and influencers around the world collaborate using proprietary technology and advanced AI. Our platform leverages the power of creators to help businesses grow, providing real-time data from impressions to sales and ROAS. We work with global enterprises and DTC brands to optimize performance by treating each creator as a unique channel. Watch us in action: https://youtu.be/qnGZPcqK_H4
The Opportunity
We are looking for a sharp, data-driven Paid Acquisition Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to build new growth channels, managing substantial budgets across Meta & TikTok for a diverse portfolio of top-tier global and local brands operating in the Israeli market.
Build & Scale: Establish and grow a new paid acquisition channel for our portfolio of global brands, including major enterprises and DTC leaders
Campaign Management: End-to-end management of paid campaigns on Meta (Facebook/Instagram) & TikTok. Hands-on execution from strategy and setup to optimization and scaling is a must
Content-Driven Performance: Leverage Humanz's massive stream of high-quality creator content to fuel your campaigns. You'll move beyond static banners, using the most advanced Meta & TikTok ad models to run high-velocity creative testing and scale authentic video content
Creative Performance Analysis: Utilize strong analytical skills to track, measure, and report on campaign performance. You should be able to identify which creative hooks and formats drive results and use these insights to guide future production and optimizations
Strategic Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams and management to align advertising strategies with broader company marketing objectives
Global Execution: Plan and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns tailored for diverse business types, geographies, and audience segments
Requirements
Experience: 3+ years of hands-on media buying experience, preferably within a global e-commerce brand or a top-tier media agency
Platform Mastery: Deep knowledge and proven experience with Meta Ads Manager & TikTok Ads & Google Ads
Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and draw actionable insights
Education: B.A in Economics, Marketing, or equivalent practical experience
Soft Skills: A natural leader and problem-solver who is driven by insights and results. Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
Advantage:
Experience with influencer marketing or the creator economy
Familiarity with other ad platforms and Direct Media Buying ( Keshet, IDX, TA/OB, DV360 etc)

job.title: Director of Engineering ,Automation, Performance & AI Quality
job.snippet:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
So, what’s the role all about?
We are looking for a visionary engineering leader to architect and lead our quality engineering discipline into the AI era. You will own automation infrastructure, performance engineering, and all AI-driven quality initiatives — building and mentoring high-performing teams of engineers and architects who set the standard for how modern software is validated at scale.
This is not a maintenance role. You will disrupt legacy testing paradigms, champion agentic test generation, and embed AI-quality thinking into every stage of the SDLC — from the first commit to production monitoring. You will be the organizational bridge between engineering velocity and product reliability.
How will you make an impact?
AI Quality Strategy
Define and lead all AI-augmented quality initiatives across the organization
Deploy LLM-powered test generation, triage, and root-cause analysis tooling
Build frameworks for validating AI/ML model outputs and non-deterministic behaviors
Evaluate and integrate emerging AI quality toolchains (GitHub Copilot, Claude, agents)
Champion responsible AI testing practices, coverage standards, and governance models
Automation Engineering
Own the full automation strategy across UI, API, and integration layers
Architect scalable, maintainable test frameworks
Drive shift-left testing embedded in CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
Establish coverage KPIs, flakiness SLAs, and automation ROI metrics
Lead adoption of self-healing and AI-assisted test maintenance
Performance Engineering
Lead performance and load testing strategy at enterprise scale
Define SLOs/SLAs and partner with SRE on reliability thresholds
Design continuous performance validation integrated into delivery pipelines
Drive root-cause analysis for regressions, bottlenecks, and latency spikes
Oversee toolchain including k6, JMeter, Gatling, and APM integrations
People & Org Leadership
Lead and grow teams of automation engineers, performance engineers, and architects
Set technical direction, OKRs, and career ladders for the quality engineering org
Hire senior ICs and architect-level talent; build succession depth
Foster a culture of ownership, engineering craft, and continuous learning
Partner cross-functionally with Product, DevOps, and R&D leadership
Have you got what it takes?
12+ years in software engineering or QA, with 5+ years in engineering leadership at the Director level or senior Staff+ with direct reports
Deep hands-on background in test automation architecture — you've built frameworks from scratch, not just inherited them
Proven track record leading performance engineering at scale (10,000+ concurrent users, distributed systems, cloud-native environments)
Experience shipping or operating AI/ML systems and understanding the unique quality challenges they introduce
Prior success managing multi-team orgs with both IC engineers and architects (10–40+ total headcount)
Enterprise software domain experience strongly preferred (SaaS, CCaaS, fintech, or similar high-uptime/regulated environments)
AI & Technical Acumen
Working knowledge of LLM capabilities and limitations relevant to software testing (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic workflows)
Experience evaluating or integrating AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or equivalents) in engineering workflows
Comfort with statistical testing concepts: model drift detection, data validation, behavioral testing for non-deterministic outputs
Proficient in at least one scripting/programming language (Python, TypeScript, Java) and modern CI/CD tooling
Familiarity with observability and APM tools (Datadog, Grafana, Dynatrace, New Relic)
Leadership
Exceptional communicator — able to translate deep technical concepts into executive-level strategy and roadmaps
Strong organizational influencer who shapes culture and engineering standards beyond your direct org
Data-driven decision maker: you measure quality outcomes, not just activity
Bias for hiring and developing senior talent; you build teams that outlast you
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity in fast-moving environments
What’s in it for you?
Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!
Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.
Requisition ID: 10834
Reporting into: Senior Director, Engineering, CX
Role Type: People Manager
About NiCE
NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.
Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.
NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.

job.title: Senior Algorithms Engineer - Estimation & Navigation
job.snippet:
Senior Algorithms Engineer – Estimation & Navigation
Full-time | R&D
About Us
Smart Shooter is looking for an experienced Mechanical Engineer with strong capabilities in mechanical and opto-mechanical design for leading development projects, product design, and working in a multi-program, highly multidisciplinary environment.
The Role
We are looking for an experienced algorithms engineer to join our R&D team and take a leading role in developing navigation, estimation and data-fusion algorithms.
Develop and validate navigation and estimation algorithms
Design statistical data-fusion solutions that combine multiple sources
Model, simulate and analyze algorithm performance
Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams
Requirements:
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical, Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field
At least 4–7 years of hands-on experience developing algorithms

job.title: Senior Product Manager and Builder
job.snippet:
About Pic-Time:
Pic-Time helps professional photographers deliver their work and turn their photos into the best experience for clients and business value for them. We are looking for a passionate and experienced
Senior Product Manager and builder
to lead a significant product domain within our platform.
You’ll own product direction and outcomes in your area, from identifying opportunities and setting priorities to launch and continuous improvement. You’ll work directly with AI tools to build solutions, partnering closely with Design, Engineering, Customer Support, and Marketing to bring them to customers.
What You will Do (Key responsibilities):
Understand how photographers run their businesses and how they use our platform, using customer conversations, product data and market insight to identify valuable problems.
Set product priorities and success measures, balancing customer value, business impact and delivery effort.
Evaluate existing flows, explore alternatives and simplify the experience through thoughtful UX and clear copy.
Use Claude and other AI tools to build product solutions, from early prototypes through implementation. Work hands-on alongside Design and Engineering to bring solutions into production, validate them and iterate.
Own delivery through launch and adoption. Make decisions, manage dependencies, surface blockers early and verify the experience works as intended.
Work closely with Design, Engineering, Marketing and Customer Support to launch effectively, measure results and improve the product.
Communicate progress to internal stakeholders
Stay updated on industry trends and competitive landscape
What You will Bring (Qualifications)
5+ years of product management experience
Proven experience owning B2C SaaS products from an ambiguous problem through launch and measurable results.
Strong product judgment and customer understanding, with the ability to choose a focused problem and explain the trade-offs behind your solution.
Strong UX instincts, attention to user understanding and an ability to write clear product copy.
Extensive practical experience building with Claude or similar AI tools - giving clear direction, challenging the output, troubleshooting, and refining what you build.
Technical fluency to discuss data, APIs, integrations, permissions and implementation constraints with engineers.
Clear communication and methodological.
Independent ownership with a sense of urgency and a strong get-things-done attitude. You drive everyone, set the destination and deadline, keep others aligned and focused start to finish.
Resilient, with the ability to adapt quickly to changes, while working remotely
Proficient in English
Advantages:
Experience with products for small businesses, growth products or the photography industry
Experience with products across desktop and mobile platforms
Familiarity with professional photography or a passion for art and photography
Equal  Opportunities
At Pic-Time, we prioritize diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. We make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time
IG Account
https://www.instagram.com/pictime_us/

job.title: Mechanical R&D Design Engineer – Precision Mechanisms
job.snippet:
An established medical device company, with several years of intensive R&D and a mature, well-advanced product design, is seeking an outstanding
Mechanical R&D Design Engineer
to join its development team.
The company has developed a sophisticated, multidisciplinary product with a high level of design maturity and is progressing toward manufacturing readiness.
We are looking for a highly capable, energetic, and hands-on engineer with strong expertise in precision mechanics, excellent engineering fundamentals, and a passion for solving complex mechanical challenges.
The role focuses on detailed mechanical design, design optimization, hands-on engineering, and advancing component and assembly designs toward mass production through DFMA activities.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop precision mechanical components and assemblies involving plastics, metals, springs, and miniature mechanisms.
Create detailed 3D CAD models and production-ready 2D drawings, including GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis.
Design for low-volume manufacturing technologies, including CNC machining and laser cutting.
Design for mass-production technologies, including plastic injection molding and metal stamping.
Lead technical Design Reviews (DR), evaluate design alternatives, and implement improvements.
Perform hands-on assembly, testing, troubleshooting, and evaluation of mechanical components and assemblies.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), identify design weaknesses, develop solutions, and implement engineering improvements.
Work closely with the Mechanical Team Leader on DFMA activities, manufacturing feasibility, supplier technical feedback, and production readiness.
Requirements
B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering from Technion, Ben-Gurion University, or Tel Aviv University – Mandatory.
Proven experience in mechanical design, particularly precision components and mechanisms.
Excellent SolidWorks proficiency, including 3D modeling and detailed 2D manufacturing drawings.
Proven experience participating in DFMA processes.
Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles, materials, manufacturing technologies, GD&T, and tolerance analysis.
Practical experience designing plastic and metal components for manufacturing.
Strong analytical capabilities, engineering creativity, and independent problem-solving skills.
High energy, fast execution, attention to detail, and strong personal ownership.
A genuine hands-on approach, with the ability and willingness to assemble, test, troubleshoot, and improve mechanical designs.
Advantages
Experience with miniature mechanical mechanisms, precision assemblies, and springs.
Experience designing products for high-volume manufacturing.
Familiarity with injection molding, metal stamping, and MIM.
Experience in medical device development.
The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for an engineer who combines
deep technical knowledge, outstanding mechanical design skills, creativity, and execution speed
.
Someone who enjoys turning engineering challenges into practical solutions, takes ownership from detailed design through manufacturing readiness, and is equally comfortable working with CAD models, engineering drawings, and physical assemblies in the lab.
This is an individual contributor role, focused entirely on engineering, with no management or team leadership responsibilities.
LinkedIn Screening Questions
1. Education – Yes / No
Do you hold a B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering from Technion, Ben-Gurion University, or Tel Aviv University?
Required answer: Yes
2. Mechanical Design & DFMA Experience – Yes / No
Do you have proven hands-on experience in precision mechanical design, including 3D CAD modeling, production-ready 2D drawings, and active participation in DFMA processes?
Required answer: Yes
3. Location & On-Site Availability – Yes / No
Are you willing and able to work full-time on-site in the Yoqneam area?
Required answer: Yes

אנחנו מחפשים אחראי/ת תפעול משל"ט לתפקיד משמעותי בסביבה טכנולוגית מתקדמת, הכולל עבודה מול טכנאים ואנשי שטח ומתן פתרונות בזמן אמת.
התפקיד כולל:
מתן תמיכה ומענה בדיגיטל לטכנאים בבית לקוח בנושא אינטרנט וטלוויזיה.
מתן מענה מלא ושירותי לטכנאים ואנשי השטח, הפונים בערוצי המענה במשל"ט.
תודעת שירות גבוהה ותפעול מספר מערכות במקביל.
הפעלת שיקול דעת והוצאת שיחה טלפונית בפניות מורכבות.
הפעלת ממשקים בכירים לקבלת מענה המקדם טיפול בלקוח ובטכנאי.
בנוסף תיהנו ממענק חד פעמי בסך של עד 6,000!! (ברוטו) שישולם לאחר 6 חודשי עבודה מלאים בפועל, בהיקף משרה של 65% לפחות בכל חודש, ממועד תחילת העבודה!!
אצלנו תקבלו כלים להתפתחות וקידום מקצועי, שירותי תקשורת וטלוויזיה בתנאים מיוחדים, ארוחות מסובסדות, נופשים, אירועי חברה סופר מושקעים והטבות שוות נוספות.
משמרות בין הימים א-ה השעות,08:00-22:00 ו' 08:00-16:00  מינימום 2 משמרות ערב,
משמרת שישי לסרוגין.
*ההטבות מוענקות לעובדים זכאים בהתאם למדיניות החברה ו/או להסכם הקיבוצי החל בה, חלקן בשיתוף עם ארגון העובדים.
*המענק למשרה בהתאם לתנאי הסכם המענק ומוצע לזמן מוגבל. מהמענק ינוכה מס כדין.

דרישות חובה:
תודעת שירות גבוהה.
היכרות עם יישומי מחשב.
יכולת ביצוע מספר משימות בו זמנית.
אוריינטציה טכנית, עבודה על מחשב ומערכות אינטרנט וטלוויזיה.
שירותיות ברמה גבוהה
יכולות עבודה עם מספר מערכות במקביל.
יכולת עבודה בתנאי לחץ.
אחריות ומוסר עבודה גבוה.
כושר ביטוי בכתב ובע"פ.
דרישות המהוות יתרון לתפקיד:
היכרות עם מערכת הצאט גלסיקס.
ידיעה מערכות ה סאפ / אמדוקס/JET/.
ניסיון בעולם המוקדים עדיפות למוקד טכני.
המשרה מיועדת לכל המינים והמגדרים.
סלקום מעודדת ותומכת בהעסקת עובדים עם מוגבלויות.
המידע שיימסר על ידך ישמש את קבוצת סלקום ו/או מי מטעמה כדי לבחון את מועמדותך למשרה וכן למשרות נוספות, לפעולות תפעוליות ולמטרות נוספות. לא חלה עליך חובה למסור את המידע, אך אם תבחר שלא למסרו, לא ניתן יהיה לבחון את התאמתך.
למידע נוסף, כולל אודות המידע שנאסף והשימושים בו, למי המידע עשוי להימסר וזכויותיך לעיון ותיקון מידע אישי, ראה מדיניות הפרטיות של סלקום באתר קריירה.

job.title: Sr MSIAM SOC Engineer (Unit 42)
job.snippet:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
Who We Are
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
Job Summary
As a Senior SOC Engineer within Unit 42 at Palo Alto Networks, you will drive the creation, validation, and optimization of custom detection rules and automated playbooks across our global customer base. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will collaborate closely with clients to maximize their security posture using Cortex XSIAM and Unit 42 expertise. This highly analytical role leverages your deep understanding of detection lifecycles, proactive automation, and threat intelligence to secure enterprise environments. You will architect end-to-end security lifecycles that seamlessly connect data ingestion with high-fidelity detection engineering.
Key Responsibilities
Own the full lifecycle of custom detections and response automations, deploying them as high-fidelity Cortex XSIAM correlation rules and playbooks through a rigorous engineering process of development, testing, staging, and soft implementation.
Drive the continuous refinement of correlation rules to ensure strict standards for performance, accuracy, and operational relevance.
Translate Unit 42 threat intelligence research and emerging adversary TTPs into actionable, robust detection logic.
Champion proactive automation by engineering sophisticated playbooks to resolve emerging security challenges and optimize operational workflows ahead of demand.
Architect the end-to-end security lifecycle within Cortex XSIAM, seamlessly connecting data ingestion, high-fidelity detection engineering, and sophisticated response automation.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
5+ years of hands-on experience in a Senior SOC, Detection Engineering, or Security Architecture role utilizing SIEMs, firewalls, EDR, sandboxes, and SOAR platforms in complex enterprise environments.
Proven mastery of the Detection Engineering lifecycle, including experience with rule testing frameworks, soft-deployment strategies, and continuous tuning.
Demonstrated experience reviewing and QA-ing detection logic written by others, with the ability to provide constructive optimization feedback.
Exceptional consultative and communication skills, with the confidence to guide enterprise customers through complex architectural and workflow decisions.
Proactive engineering mindset with a track record of designing complex automation playbooks (Cortex XSOAR or similar) based on anticipated threat vectors, not just reactive requests.
Strong background in incident response, threat hunting, and translating threat intelligence into actionable defense mechanisms.
Software development experience with a strong proficiency in Python for security automation and scripting.
Preferred Qualifications
Previous hands-on experience utilizing and optimizing Cortex XSIAM.
Our Commitment
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

5+ years of hands-on experience in a Senior SOC, Detection Engineering, or Security Architecture role utilizing SIEMs, firewalls, EDR, sandboxes, and SOAR platforms in complex enterprise environments.
Proven mastery of the Detection Engineering lifecycle, including experience with rule testing frameworks, soft-deployment strategies, and continuous tuning.
Demonstrated experience reviewing and QA-ing detection logic written by others, with the ability to provide constructive optimization feedback.
Exceptional consultative and communication skills, with the confidence to guide enterprise customers through complex architectural and workflow decisions.
Proactive engineering mindset with a track record of designing complex automation playbooks (Cortex XSOAR or similar) based on anticipated threat vectors, not just reactive requests.
Strong background in incident response, threat hunting, and translating threat intelligence into actionable defense mechanisms.
Software development experience with a strong proficiency in Python for security automation and scripting.
Preferred Qualifications
Previous hands-on experience utilizing and optimizing Cortex XSIAM.
Our Commitment
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

job.title: Financial Planning Analyst
job.snippet:
About The Role
We are looking for a motivated and analytical FP&A Specialist to join our Care Delivery finance team. In this role, you will be the financial backbone of our operations, delivering the accurate insights and strategic analysis necessary to drive efficiency, manage costs, and support key decision-making.
You will work closely with our Finance Business Partner and cross-functional teams (including Accounting, Procurement, and Operations) to turn complex data into actionable business intelligence. This is an ideal opportunity for a finance professional who is passionate about process improvement, automation, and high-impact reporting.
Key Responsibilities
Financial Planning & Forecasting: Develop and maintain sophisticated financial models for budgeting, forecasting, and long-term planning.
Performance Analysis: Partner with operational leaders to analyze budget deviations, identify trends, and uncover risks and growth opportunities.
Reporting Excellence: Lead the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, including detailed variance and trend analysis.
Strategic Support: Conduct scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and ad hoc financial studies to support strategic initiatives and investment evaluations.
Process Improvement & Automation: Actively seek efficiency gains by leveraging AI tools and automation to streamline reporting and month-end workflows.
Collaboration: Act as a key bridge between finance and business units, ensuring alignment between operational goals and financial reality.
Compliance: Maintain strong internal controls and ensure all financial processes adhere to corporate policies and SOPs.
Qualifications & Experience
Experience: A minimum of 3 years of relevant professional experience in a Finance or FP&A function.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, or a related field.
Certifications: A CPA, ACCA, CMA, CIMA, or equivalent accounting certification is considered a strong plus.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (financial modeling and data analysis) and PowerPoint (advanced presentations).
Working knowledge of SAP.
Familiarity with BI tools and planning/forecasting software (e.g., Anaplan) is highly desirable.
Language: Fluency in English.
Personal Competencies
Analytical Mindset: You enjoy solving complex problems and have a natural curiosity to improve existing processes.
Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to translate financial data into insights for diverse stakeholders.
Collaborative Spirit: A true team player who thrives in cross-functional environments and is eager to share knowledge with the wider team.
Agility: Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while meeting tight deadlines.
Proactive Attitude: A positive, "can-do" approach to challenges and a passion for continuous learning.
