job.title: Field Service Technician
job.snippet:
About Xerox Holdings Corporation
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
Overview:
Join Xerox as a Field Service Technician and become part of a growing Technical Services organization focused on delivering an exceptional customer experience. In this hands-on role, you will use your electro-mechanical expertise to troubleshoot, repair, and maintain customer equipment while helping maximize device availability and performance. Xerox provides technical training to help you build the product knowledge and skills needed to successfully support your assigned territory.
Why Join This Team:
Receive technical training from certified instructors through online and instructor-led learning
Build your expertise in electro-mechanical troubleshooting and equipment repair
Access career development and growth opportunities within Technical Services
Receive comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness credits, and a company contribution to a Health Savings Account
Participate in a 401(k) program with company matching
Receive paid time off, holidays, and personal days
What You Will Do:
Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain customer equipment using electrical and mechanical knowledge
Deliver professional, responsive customer service while helping minimize equipment downtime
Use diagnostic tools, including a multimeter, and interpret electrical schematics to identify and resolve equipment issues
Manage assigned service calls and territory responsibilities while meeting established productivity, response time, quality, and cost expectations
Maintain the equipment, parts, and inventory required to effectively support customers within your assigned territory
What You Need to Succeed
:
Electro-mechanical troubleshooting experience with the ability to use a multimeter and interpret electrical schematics
Strong customer service, time management, problem-solving, and organizational skills
Ability to work independently in a field-based environment while reliably meeting customer and service commitments
Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and regularly walk, stand, squat, bend, and drive for more than 50 percent of the workday
This position requires a valid driver's license, current automobile insurance coverage meeting company-specified minimums, and the ability to meet the company's motor vehicle safety standards.
How We Set You Up for Success:
Structured new-hire and technical training designed to prepare you for independent field service work
Training on Xerox equipment, troubleshooting procedures, inventory requirements, and customer service expectations
Clear expectations regarding service call volume, territory responsibilities, and customer satisfaction
Hands-on preparation to independently complete service calls accurately and efficiently
Supportive and collaborative environment with opportunities for continued career development

Teaser
Application deadline : 13 November 2026.
Text
The
European Union Border Assistance Mission for the Rafah Crossing Point
–
EUBAM Rafah
– was launched on 24 November 2005 to monitor the operations of the border crossing point between the Gaza Strip and Egypt, after Israel and the Palestinian Authority concluded an Agreement on Movement and Access on 15 November 2005. The Council of the European Union approved that the EU should undertake the third-party role proposed.
EUBAM Rafah
is currently seeking dynamic, highly skilled candidates for immediate recruitment to fill the following
Four (4) vacancies:
MSDL 11 Procurement Officer (1 post): Provides procurement and contracting support to the Mission, ensuring compliance with applicable procurement rules and procedures. The position supports tendering, purchasing, contracting and related procurement administration, including coordination with relevant Mission units and stakeholders.
MSDL 12 Driver – Fleet Operator (1 post): Provides transportation, vehicle and fleet support to Mission members and external officials, contributing to the safe and efficient operation of the Mission’s vehicles and related transport activities.
MSDL 10 Logistics and Transport Assistant (1 post): Provides logistical and transport support to Mission staff, contributing to the effective management and distribution of Mission assets, supplies and transport resources.
HoML 03 Press & Public Information Officer / Graphic Designer / Editor / Social Media (1 post): Supports the Mission’s press and public information activities through graphic design, photography, video production, editing and social media management, producing visual and audiovisual content to communicate the Mission’s mandate, activities and achievements to relevant audiences.
Employment regime:
Locally Contracted Staff hired under Israeli Local Labor Law
Duty Station:
Ramat Gan - Tel Aviv
Opening Date: 23 October 2026
Closing Date: 13 November 2026
General employment/eligibility requirements:
Education and professional experience, as well as proficiency in English, Arabic and Hebrew, as specified in the relevant Job Description; a valid identification document permitting employment and unrestricted movement within the Mission’s area of operations; medical fitness for work; and a clean criminal record.
IMPORTANT:
Work is expected to be performed physically at the Mission offices in Ramat Gan, Monday through Friday. Candidates must be able to make the necessary arrangements to travel to and from the office premises on a daily basis. Applicants must hold a valid local identification document or work permit authorising employment at the Mission.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION FOR THE APPLICANTS
Applicants are reminded that the work of the Selection Committee is strictly confidential. Therefore, applicants must not contact, either directly or indirectly, any member of the Selection Committee, nor request that any other person do so on their behalf.

job.title: Electronics Lab Technician | R&D | Medical Device
job.snippet:
About the Company
Magenta is a medical device company developing the world’s smallest heart pump, meant to provide minimally invasive support to the heart during acute episodes of dysfunction. The Elevate™ System is multi-disciplinary, involving mechanical engineering, materials science, electrical engineering, software, algorithms, and state-of-the-art catheter fabrication techniques.
We are looking for the best people possible who can help us propel the Elevate™ System forward and save more lives.
About the Role
We are seeking a hands-on and detail-oriented
Electronics Engineering Technician
to join our
R&D Software and Hardware Development team
.
This role supports the development, integration, testing, and manufacturing of advanced medical electronic systems throughout the product lifecycle.
The position combines hands-on electronics work with close collaboration alongside hardware, software, system, and manufacturing engineers.
Responsibilities
Provide hands-on support for Magenta controller manufacturing activities, including assembly, in-process inspection, and final inspection.
Support maintenance and organization of the electrical laboratory and ESD-controlled area in compliance with company procedures.
Review electronic designs and provide technical feedback to the Hardware and R&D teams.
Provide electrical engineering support as part of the product risk management process.
Support maintenance and operation of electrical equipment and test systems used for development, testing, and production activities.
Perform manufacturing, inspection, and labeling activities along the production process according to approved procedures and work instructions.
Work collaboratively with R&D, manufacturing, and quality teams to ensure product compliance and reliability.
Assemble, wire, solder, and debug electronic prototypes and production units.
Perform electrical testing, calibration, and verification using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and signal generators.
Support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of hardware failures during development and production.
Maintain laboratory equipment, tools, components inventory, and test stations.
Execute incoming inspection and verification of electronic components and assemblies.
Support verification and validation activities for electronic systems and interfaces.
Ensure compliance with ESD, safety, cleanliness, and quality procedures in the laboratory and production environment.
Support production and troubleshooting activities for electronic assemblies and systems.
Participate in hardware/electronics design, development, integration, and testing of company products.
Qualifications
Practical Engineering degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in electronics manufacturing, testing, or R&D support.
Required Skills
Experience working in multidisciplinary hardware/software development environments.
Strong understanding of production procedures, work instructions, drawings, and electrical schematics.
Experience with laboratory test equipment and electronic troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience in soldering, wiring, assembly, and debugging of electronic systems.
High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
Experience in the medical device industry.
Familiarity with medical device standards, including IEC 60601.
Experience working in regulated environments and quality-driven processes.
Knowledge of ESD procedures and electronic manufacturing best practices.

job.company: נגה - החברה לניהול מערכת החשמל Noga - Israel Independent System Operator
job.snippet:
אחראי/ת גיוס פנים ארגוני/ת
תיאור התפקיד:
אחריות כוללת על הובלת תחום גיוס עובדי מיקור חוץ בארגון, תוך ניהול עצמאי של תהליכי הגיוס מקצה לקצה, ליווי מנהלים מגייסים, ניהול ממשקי עבודה עם חברות מיקור חוץ והובלת משא ומתן מסחרי, במטרה להבטיח איוש איכותי, יעיל ומהיר של משרות בהתאם לצורכי הארגון.
דרישות התפקיד:
תואר ראשון במדעי ההתנהגות, פסיכולוגיה, משאבי אנוש או תחום רלוונטי אחר – חובה.
ניסיון של 3 שנים לפחות בתחום הגיוס. ניסיון כרכז/ת גיוס בארגון – יתרון משמעותי מאוד.
ניסיון בניהול תהליכי גיוס מקצה לקצה.
ניסיון בעבודה מול מנהלים ומנהלות מגייסים.
ניסיון בעבודה מול חברות השמה ו/או מיקור חוץ – יתרון
ניסיון בניהול משא ומתן מול ספקים – יתרון
ניסיון בניתוח נתונים והפקת תובנות לצורך קבלת החלטות ושיפור תהליכים – יתרון
יכולת התמודדות עם ריבוי משימות, בסביבה דינמית ומרובת ממשקים, תוך שמירה על עמידה ביעדים ובלוחות זמנים צפופים.
יוזמה וגישה פרואקטיבית לפתרון בעיות.
ייצוגיות, שירותיות, יכולת גבוהה ביצירת קשר בינאישי.

job.title: Technician for Elevator and Escalator Modernization
job.snippet:
🇮🇱 ISRAELI CITIZENS ONLY |
Company: Khasin On Time LTD (חסין בזמן בע"מ)
Location: Central District, Israel Employment
Type: Full-Time
About the Job
Khasin On Time LTD is looking for skilled and motivated technical professionals to join our team specializing in elevator and escalator modernization.
We especially encourage Russian-speaking professionals with hands-on technical experience to apply! We welcome candidates from various technical backgrounds, including mechanics, electrical work, electronics, equipment repair, and industrial maintenance.No previous experience with elevators or escalators is required!
We provide full professional training at the company's expense.
Key Responsibilities:
Participate in elevator and escalator modernization projects.
Replace, upgrade, and install mechanical and electrical components.
Perform technical work in accordance with established quality and safety standards.
Diagnose technical issues and assist in troubleshooting.
Work alongside an experienced team of technical professionals.
Requirements:
Israeli citizenship is mandatory.
Practical experience in mechanics, electrical systems, electronics, equipment repair, industrial maintenance, or related technical fields.
Strong technical aptitude and hands-on experience with tools.
Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and equipment.
Responsible, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a team.
Russian and/or Hebrew communication skills for professional interaction.
Experience with elevators or escalators is an advantage but NOT required.
What We Offer:
Competitive salary.
Full professional training paid for by the company.
Company vehicle for eligible candidates.
Stable, long-term, full-time employment.
Professional development and career growth opportunities.
Hands-on experience with modern technical equipment.
Supportive and professional working environment.
Preferred Locations: We especially welcome candidates living in: Rishon LeZion, Rehovot, Ramla, Ness Ziona, Yavne, Bat Yam, and surrounding areas in Central Israel.
Interested in Joining Our Team?
If you are an Israeli citizen, speak Russian and/or Hebrew, have a technical background, and are looking for a stable career opportunity, we would love to hear from you!
Apply through LinkedIn and take the next step in your technical career. Company Website: www.dragnoa.com

job.title: OT Cyber Security Architect
job.snippet:
We are looking for an experienced
OT/ICS Cyber Security Architect
to lead and design security architectures for industrial control systems, manufacturing environments, and
critical infrastructure.
The role focuses on securing OT environments, designing industrial network architectures, managing cyber risks, and ensuring secure IT/OT integration while maintaining operational continuity and system availability.
What You'll Do:
Design secure industrial network architectures, including network segmentation and the Purdue Model.
Conduct OT security risk assessments and map industrial networks and systems across manufacturing and critical infrastructure facilities.
Define security requirements for SCADA, PLC, and HMI systems.
Design secure remote access solutions for vendors and maintenance teams.
Evaluate and approve industrial security solutions, including testing and integration in sensitive production environments.
Develop OT security policies and procedures in accordance with international standards.
Collaborate with control engineers, automation teams, integrators, and IT/security professionals.
Requirements:
At least 5 years of Cyber Security experience, including
3+ years in OT Security Architecture.
Deep understanding and hands-on experience with industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, and PROFINET.
Experience securing industrial control systems, including Siemens S7 PLCs.
Hands-on experience with industrial network security equipment, including configuration and rule design (e.g., Cisco ISA 3000).
Strong knowledge of industrial cybersecurity standards, particularly IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82.
Deep understanding of IT/OT security differences,
with an emphasis on operational continuity and system availability.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across engineering, production, IT, and cybersecurity teams.
Advantages:
Bachelor's degree from a recognized academic institution.
Experience building virtual environments and testing labs for OT integration.
Certifications such as GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC 62443, or CISSP.
Familiarity with industrial network anomaly detection and monitoring solutions.
Experience in manufacturing, process industries, or critical national infrastructure.
Apply now or send us your CV:
📩noyg@youcc.net

job.title: Maintenance Manager
job.snippet:
תיאור היחידה/המחלקה
מחלקת האחזקה אחראית על תחזוקת מתקני הייצור והציוד הקריטי במפעל, במטרה להבטיח רציפות תפעולית, זמינות גבוהה של המערכות, בטיחות ותמיכה ביעדי הייצור ואיכות הסביבה.
תחומי אחריות
ניהול והובלת מערך האחזקה במפעל, כולל אחזקת שבר, אחזקה מונעת, אחזקה מתוכננת ופרויקטים.
אחריות על זמינותם ותקינותם של מתקני הייצור והציוד הקריטי.
הובלת צוותי אחזקה ומהנדסי אחזקה/אמינות, לרבות פיתוח מקצועי, הכשרה וניהול ביצועים.
ניהול ותכנון עבודות אחזקה ויישום תהליכי עבודה מתקדמים בתחום האחזקה.
ניהול תקציב אחזקה וקבלני שירות.
הובלת תחום הנדסת האחזקה והאמינות, כולל תחזוקה מונעת, פתרון תקלות שורש, שיפור זמינות ציוד ופרויקטים לשיפור אמינות.
הטמעת טכנולוגיות ושיטות עבודה מתקדמות בתחומי האחזקה, ההנדסה והבטיחות.
אחריות על עמידה בנהלי בטיחות ואיכות הסביבה והובלת פעילויות לשיפור מתמיד בתחומים אלו.

ניסיון של לפחות 5 שנים כמהנדס/ת אחזקה ו/או אמינות בתעשייה - חובה.
ניסיון בניהול עובדים טכניים ו/או הנדסיים בתעשייה - יתרון.
ניסיון בניהול פרויקטי אחזקה - יתרון.
הסמכת ממונה בטיחות - יתרון.
שליטה במערכת SAP (מודול אחזקה) וביישומי Office - חובה.
ניסיון בהובלת תהליכי שיפור, אמינות ותחזוקה מונעת - יתרון.

job.title: Junior Supply Chain Planner
job.snippet:
ODDITY
is a global beauty and technology company redefining the beauty experience through innovative products, data, and technology.
IL MAKIAGE
, part of ODDITY, is a fast-growing, tech-driven beauty brand.
Role Description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Junior Supply Chain Planner to manage sales forecasting, inventory planning, inventory management,
and supplier relationships across our fast-paced global supply chain. This role requires a detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive
individual who can work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams in Israel and the U.S.
Key Responsibilities:
Inventory planning. Analyze global sales and geography; translate demand forecasts into supplier-specific forecasts reflecting inventory
levels, production lead times, and shipping transit times.
Inventory management. Perform daily inventory monitoring — track stock levels, balance inventory across multiple warehouses. Work
with Priority ERP, WMS, and BI tools (e.g., Looker) to keep systems updated on an ongoing basis.
Inventory analysis. Conduct BOM analysis, profitability assessments, and quantitative analysis to understand inventory position and
financial metrics.
Supplier management. Issue and manage purchase orders to global suppliers. Monitor production schedules and delivery timelines,
coordinate quality checks, and handle payment follow-ups — working to achieve better prices and accurate inventory reporting.
Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in an analytical field (MBA is a plus but not required).
• Advanced proficiency in Excel (mandatory) with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Advanced English language skills (both written and verbal).
• Self-motivated, able to work independently, and an effective team player.
• Ability to multitask and manage multiple projects under pressure.
• Attention to detail; strong work ethic; ability to prioritize in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
• Passion for learning is essential.
We will be investing significant time and effort in training and coaching our Junior Supply Chain Planner.
We seek someone who wants to grow with us long-term, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and develop deep analytical skills and strategic supply chain knowledge.

job.snippet:
Continuous Improvement & Routines:
Lead processes and daily routines to continuously improve food safety standards across all regional facilities (covering HACCP, sanitation, pest control, and regulatory frameworks).
Policy Implementation:
Roll out and enforce organizational food safety policies, updates, and guidelines across all division sites.
Audits & Training:
Establish and oversee routine monitoring, track execution of safety tasks, and develop comprehensive food safety training modules.
External Audits & On-Site Support:
Accompany external regulatory and certification audits, provide hands-on support during on-site food safety events, and evaluate the overall effectiveness of the food safety system.

Monitor key performance indicators, including safety drills, audit scores, and corrective action plans (CAPA).
Documentation & Risk Assessment:

Assists in the development of means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc.
Analyzes information, forecasts sales against expenses and creates annual budget plans.
Compiles information, analyzes and monitors actual sales against projected sales.
Analyzes differences between actual budget wages and forecasted wages for more efficient budget planning.
Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.
Assists in the creation of the annual operating budget for the property.
Provides analytical support during budget reviews to identify cost saving and productivity opportunities for property managers.
Assists in the implementation of a system of appropriate controls to manage business risks.
Ensures a strong accounting and operational control environment to safeguard assets, improve operations and profitability.
Analyzes financial data and market trends.
Assists in the development and implementation of a comprehensive annual business plan which is aligned with the company’s and brand’s strategic direction.
Provides on going analytical support by monitoring the operating department’s actual and projected sales.
Produces accurate forecasts that enable operations to react to changes in the business.
Assisting in Leading Finance & Accounting Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Communicates the strategic goals, the focus and the owner priorities to subordinates in a clear and precise manner.
Oversees internal, external and regulatory audit processes.
Provides excellent leadership by assigning team members clear accountability backed by appropriate authority.
Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
Anticipating and Delivering on the Needs of Key Stakeholders
Attends meetings and communicating with the owners, understanding the priorities and strategic focus.
Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc.).
Communicates financial concepts in a clear and persuasive manner that is easy to understand and drives desired behaviors.
Demonstrates an understanding of cash flow and owner priorities.
Manages communication with owners in an effective manner.
Manages property working capital and cash flow in accordance with brand SOPs and owner requirements.
Facilitates critique meetings to review information with management team.
Developing and Maintaining Finance and Accounting Goals
Ensures Profits and Losses are documented accurately.
Monitors all taxes that apply, ensuring that taxes are current, collected and/or accrued.
Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.
Develops and supports achievement of performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
Improves profit growth in operating departments.
Reviews audit issues to ensure accuracy.
Managing Projects and Policies
Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.
Reconciles balance sheet to ensure account balances are supported by appropriate documentation in accordance with SOPs.
Ensures that the P&L is accurate (e.g., costs are properly matched to revenue, costs are recorded in the proper accounts).
Ensures compliance with management contract and reporting requirements.
Ensures compliance with standard and local operating procedures (SOPs and LSOPs).
Ensures compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
Ensures team members are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
Ensures new hires participate in the department’s orientation program.
Ensures new hires receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Creates appropriate development plans which develop team members based on their individual strengths, development needs, career aspirations and abilities.
Conducts performance review process for employees.
Participates in hiring activities as appropriate.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.
At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.
Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.
Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.
In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International.

where you can do your best work,

your purpose,
belong
to an amazing global team, and
become
the best version of you.

job.title: מנהל/ת מחלקת תכנון ורישוי פרויקטים
job.snippet:
דוראל אורבן – חברה יזמית מובילה בתחום האנרגיה המתחדשת, המתמחה בפתרונות אגירה במרחב האורבני (בבעלות קבוצת דוראל ואמפא) – נמצאת בצמיחה משמעותית ומזמינה אותך להוביל את תחום התכנון והרישוי בחברה.
זוהי הזדמנות מצוינת להצטרף לחברה חזקה, צומחת ודינמית, ולהוביל תפקיד מפתח בעל השפעה ישירה על עתיד האנרגיה בישראל. התפקיד כולל עשייה משמעותית מול גורמי רגולציה, רשויות, ולקוחות מובילים במשק מעולמות הנדל"ן, המסחר והתעשייה.
תחומי אחריות מרכזיים:
הובלה וניהול צוות תכנון ורישוי
: סמכות מקצועית וחונכת לצוות, יצירת סטנדרטיזציה, הטמעת תהליכי עבודה סדורים וגיבוש מתודולוגיית Best Practice מחלקתית.
נ
יהול תהליכי הרישוי מקצה לקצה:
אחריות מלאה על כלל תהליכי הרישוי וההיתרים בחברה – החל משלב הגשת הבקשה למידע ועד לקבלת היתר בנייה ותעודת גמר.
שילוב בין ראייה אסטרטגית לעבודת Hands-On:
ידע ויכולת לנוע בין תמונת רוחב ואסטרטגיה לבין ירידה לפרטים הקטנים, הובלת תהליכים רוחביים לצד ניהול פרויקטים אסטרטגיים, נכונות לפתרון בעיות בשטח ופתרון חסמים בזמן אמת.
ניתוח תכנוני וסטטוטורי:
מיפוי וניתוח שטחים פוטנציאליים למיזמי אנרגיה מתחדשת ואגירה. ניהול תקציבי: אחריות מלאה לעמידה בתקציבי הייזום והתכנון של הפרויקטים.
ניהול ממשקים פנים-ארגוניים:
עבודה צמודה ושוטפת מול צוותי פיתוח עסקי, אופרציה, הנדסה, פרויקטים, אינטרקונקשן וגורמי ניהול נוספים.
עבודה מול גורמים ויועצים חיצוניים:
הובלת עבודת היועצים (עורכי בקשה, אדריכלים, יועצים משפטיים, יועצי סביבה ויועצים מקצועיים בתחום התכנון והבנייה).
עבודה מול גופים סטטוטוריים:
ניהול מערכות יחסים ועבודה שוטפת מול ועדות לתכנון ובנייה, מהנדסי ועדות, ועדות מחוזיות, רשות מקרקעי ישראל (רמ"י) ורשויות מקומיות.
דרישות:
תואר ראשון – חובה, תואר ראשון עם אוריינטציה הנדסית/ אדריכלית – יתרון.
ניסיון מקצועי: ניסיון של 3 שנים לפחות בניהול תהליכי תכנון ורישוי, לרבות הובלה והפקה של היתרי בנייה – חובה.
ניסיון ניהולי: ניסיון בהובלה, חניכה וניהול צוותים – חובה.
עבודה מול רשויות: ניסיון מוכח בעבודה מול רשויות מקומיות, ועדות מקומיות וגופים סטטוטוריים – חובה.
ניסיון בתחום: ניסיון בעבודה בתחום האנרגיה המתחדשת/אגירה בישראל – יתרון משמעותי.
כישורים אישיים ומקצועיים:
יחסי אנוש מעולים, יכולת הובלה, חניכה וגישה פרואקטיבית ("Can-Do Attitude").
חשיבה אסטרטגית ומערכתית לצד ירידה לפרטים, סדר, ארגון ויכולת מעקב גבוהה.
יכולת מוכחת להסרת חסמים, קיצור זמנים והובלת תהליכים מורכבים במקביל.
כישורי תקשורת, ניסוח וביטוי ברמה גבוהה (בכתב ובעל פה).
יכולת גבוהה ליצירת אמון, רתימה ועבודה מול שותפים עסקיים וממשקים מרובים.
היקף המשרה: מלאה.
המשרה כוללת רכב ודורשת נסיעות ברחבי הארץ.

job.snippet:
הצטרפו לחטיבת התעופה המובילה שלנו באתר עטרות ירושלים, בתפקיד טכני ומעשי המשפיע באופן מהותי על זמינות מסוקי חיל האוויר. אנו מחפשים משפצ/ת ומתקנ/ת אביזרים דינאמיים עם 'ידיים טובות' ורקע טכני חזק.
בתפקיד זה תבצעו תהליך מקיף של שיפוץ ממסרים, החל מפירוק, ניקיון והסרת צבע, דרך מדידות ובדיקות אל הרס, ועד ביקורת סופית ושחרור ניירת. העבודה דורשת דיוק מרבי, הקפדה על נהלים קפדניים ויכולת עבודה על פי מסמכי יצרן ותקנים מקצועיים. בנוסף, תספקו תמיכה חיונית לטייסות וליחידות בשטח, כולל טיפול בתקלות מורכבות בבסיסים ובמסגרת צוותי שיגור.
תחומי האחריות:
שיפוץ ותיקון של ממסרים דינאמיים למסוקי חיל האוויר.
ליווי וביצוע תהליך השיפוץ המלא: פירוק, ניקיון, הסרת צבע, מדידות ובדיקות אל הרס.
ביצוע ביקורת סופית ושחרור ניירת מקצועית.
מתן תמיכה טכנית לטייסות הטיסה וליחידות בשטח.
טיפול בתקלות מורכבות בבסיסים ובמסגרת צוותי שיגור.
זוהי הזדמנות להשתלב בסביבת עבודה מאתגרת ובעלת השפעה, המשלבת עבודה דינאמית עם אחריות רבה. בואו להיות חלק מצוות מקצועי ומוביל בחזית הטכנולוגיה האווירית.
Requirements:
אנו מחפשים מועמדים/ות בעלי/ות יכולות טכניות גבוהות ומוטיבציה להשתלב בתפקיד מאתגר ומשמעותי.
תעודת טכנאי/הנדסאי מכונות ממוסד מוכר
– חובה.
אנגלית טכנית
ברמה טובה מאוד, לצורך קריאת מסמכי יצרן – חובה.
נכונות ומוכנות לעבודה מאומצת, כולל שעות נוספות במקרה הצורך – חובה.
שירות משמעותי בחיל האוויר בתפקיד טכנאי/מנוען – יתרון בולט.
ניסיון קודם בתפקידי הובלה או עבודה ברצפת ייצור – יתרון.
הסמכת שלב 10 – יתרון.

Product Application Engineer Digital Power
Location: Israel
Job Description:
The Digital Power Product Application Engineer (PAE) provides advanced technical pre-sales, application, and enablement support for Schneider Electric Digital Power offers. The role helps sales teams, partners, consultants, panel builders, system integrators, and end customers select, specify, design, and position effective Digital Power architectures. By combining strong product expertise, customer engagement, and disciplined opportunity support, the PAE accelerates adoption of connected products, power management software, power quality, protection, automation, and related services while ensuring solutions are aligned with customer outcomes, technical requirements, and Schneider Electric standards.
What will you do?
Provide technical pre-sales support for Schneider Electric Digital Power solutions, partnering with sales teams, customers, and partners to design and recommend the best solutions.
Analyze customer requirements and develop compliant system architectures, technical proposals, and application recommendations.
Act as a trusted advisor on Digital Power technologies, including power monitoring, automation, power quality, protection, and EcoStruxure solutions.
Identify new business opportunities, support sales growth, and promote solutions that improve energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability.
Deliver technical presentations, training sessions, workshops, and product demonstrations for customers, partners, and internal teams.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality solutions, share best practices, and support partner enablement.
Maintain expertise in Digital Power technologies, market trends, and competitor offerings.
Accurately document customer interactions, technical activities, and opportunities in CRM systems while ensuring compliance with company policies.
What makes you successful?
Quality, responsiveness, and business impact of technical pre-sales support.
Contribution to pipeline creation, specification, opportunity progression, conversion, and adoption of priority Digital Power offers.
Accuracy and completeness of solution architectures, bills of material, compliance responses, and technical recommendations.
Growth of technical competency across sales teams, partners, customers, and the PAE community.
Number and reusability of validated architectures, application assets, training modules, and shared best practices.
Quality of CRM data, activity reporting, follow-up discipline, and stakeholder feedback.
Adherence to technical, commercial, cybersecurity, ethical, and safety requirements.
Requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Automation, Energy Management, or a related technical field.
Strong practical knowledge of electrical distribution applications and of the assigned Digital Power portfolio; ability to read electrical drawings and technical specifications and convert requirements into solution architectures.
Experience with connected products, communication networks and protocols, edge-control architectures, power management software, or protection and automation systems is expected according to the assigned portfolio) an advantage (.
Ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to customers, partners, consultants, and sales teams and to adapt the message to different levels of technical maturity.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, presentation, training, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
Customer-first mindset, ownership, curiosity, integrity, and ability to operate effectively in a matrix and multicultural environment.
Professional English; local language proficiency is required for customer-facing work.
Digital fluency with CRM, collaboration, documentation, configuration, and productivity tools, plus willingness to travel within the assigned geography.
What we offer:
International team with the possibility for training & upskilling
Learning & Development for each employee
Having a chance to be mentored by any worldwide expert inside Schneider Electric
The financial, legal, and psychological assistance program
Family policy – Parental leave and Care leave
Recognition culture through our own StepUp platform & annual bonus
Building a career in the #1 world sustainable multinational company

job.title: Operations Team Member
job.snippet:
Airobotics, a global leader in autonomous unmanned aerial systems (UAS), is seeking skilled and motivated professionals to join our Deployment and Technical Support team. The role includes deploying advanced autonomous systems at customer sites, operating the systems in day-to-day field activities, and providing direct technical support across civilian and defense projects.
Responsibilities:
Install, deploy, and operate autonomous systems at customer sites in Israel and occasionally abroad.
Perform system operation tasks during missions, demos, and routine activities.
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical issues in the field.
Provide ongoing technical support to customers, including documentation and follow-up of solutions.
Requirements:
Strong technical aptitude with excellent hands-on skills and fine motor abilities.
Fast learner with the ability to quickly understand new systems and technologies.
Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
Willingness to work in demanding field conditions, including overnight stays outside home.
Service-oriented, proactive, positive attitude, and “can-do” mindset.
High-level English (speaking, reading, writing) – mandatory.
Valid driver’s license (B) – mandatory.
Significant Advantages
Previous drone operation/flying experience.
CAAI (IAA) remote pilot license up to 25 kg.
Background in industrial or defense environments.
Foreign passport – strong advantage for international project readiness.

job.title: Engineering Technician - R&D
job.snippet:
Helios is seeking a hands-on Engineering Technician to build and support the mechanical systems behind our chemical process R&D platforms - and to own the workshop that makes that possible. You'll set the standards for how work gets done on the floor, and you'll hold the team to them.
About Helios
Helios develops cutting-edge iron refining technologies that minimize environmental impact and maximize resource efficiency. We operate at the intersection of materials science, chemical engineering, and mechanical innovation. If you're passionate about building systems that shape the future of sustainable industry, we'd love to meet you.
What You'll Do
Build and Fabricate
Assemble mechanical prototypes based on CAD models, drawings, or experimental needs - custom vessels, fixtures, and assemblies for high-temperature, high-pressure, and chemically reactive environments.
Fabricate custom jigs, frames, piping, and related assemblies to support R&D system builds and experiments.
Apply thermal solutions, including integration of heating elements and insulation, for prototype and test systems.
Collaborate with engineers to translate design intent into physical builds and iterate quickly based on test results.
Own the lab and pilot ticketing system, managing and resolving service and maintenance requests.
Run the Workshop
Keep the workshop organized and functional: sensible layout, tools where people can find them, clear storage and labeling, and good housekeeping habits.
Operate and maintain workshop tools and equipment (drills, 3D printers, lathe, mill, TIG/MIG), keeping them serviced and in working order.
Set up simple, practical working methods - basic procedures, checklists, and tool-use rules - and make sure the team follows them.
Promote safe working practices by writing clear work procedures and enforcing PPE use.
Manage consumables, raw stock, and assembly hardware - know what we have and reorder before it runs out.
Handle purchasing of workshop and build materials and interface with suppliers, machine shops, and fabricators locally and internationally, so builds aren't held up waiting on parts.
Help expand workshop capability over time by identifying gaps and suggesting new tools and equipment.
What You Bring
Core
Technical diploma or engineering degree in mechanical, mechatronics, or related field.
3+ years of hands-on experience in metal prototyping, fabrication, and mechanical assembly.
Experience keeping a workshop or lab organized and stocked, or a clear readiness to take that on.
Comfort managing consumables and coordinating orders with suppliers.
Strong familiarity with workshop tools and fabrication techniques.
Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings and BOMs.
Familiarity with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Onshape) for jig design and 3D printing.
Basic electrical skills (e.g., wiring, sensor setup).
Comfortable working in a fast-paced R&D environment with evolving requirements.
Professional fluency in English (spoken and written).
Advantage
Experience with inventory or purchasing tools of any kind, including a well-run spreadsheet system you built yourself.
Hand milling, lathe work, or CNC machining.
Practical welding experience for prototyping and fabrication work.
Licensed Electrician

job.title: Senior Guidance Engineer
job.snippet:
We are seeking a Senior Guidance Engineer to play a critical role in the development of next-generation drone platforms.
This position focuses heavily on guidance and mission-level decision-making for high-performance aerial systems operating in dynamic, real-world environments.
You will design and deploy guidance and motion planning algorithms that enable precise, high-speed maneuvers and complex mission execution. This role blends analytical rigor with creativity, tackling problems that often have no textbook solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with hardware, embedded software, and perception teams to bring advanced autonomy from concept to flight.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and optimize guidance and motion planning algorithms for autonomous drones
Define mission-level behaviors and guidance logic, balancing performance, safety, and robustness
Implement real-time control interfaces to execute trajectories reliably in uncertain conditions
Work closely with embedded software, mechatronics, and perception teams to ensure seamless integration
Identify and address edge cases and failure modes, building resilience and graceful degradation
Stay current with advancements in drone autonomy, guidance, motion planning, and control
Requirements:
BSc or MSc in Mechanical, Aerospace, or related engineering fields.
3+ years of experience
in GNC, guidance, autonomy, or related aerospace/robotics fields
Strong experience with
AI tools, guidance algorithms, trajectory generation, and motion planning
Solid understanding of
system-level constraints
affecting real-world aerial platforms
Hands-on experience with
real-world drone development, debugging, and iteration
Strong collaboration skills across
software, hardware, and deployment teams
A creative, problem-solving mindset with a passion for advanced aerial missions
Nice to Have / Advantage
Strong foundation in
control theory
Experience with
state estimation techniques
, including
Extended Kalman Filters (EKF)
Experience using
ROS 2, PX4, ArduPilot
, or similar drone/robotics frameworks
Proficiency in
C++ and Python
Why Join Us?
Work on
cutting-edge drone guidance and autonomy systems
with real-world impact
Join a
fast-paced, highly skilled team
that values ownership and technical excellence
See your ideas progress from
whiteboard → simulation → real-world deployment
Be part of a culture that thrives on solving hard problems and
pushing the limits of engineering

job.title: AI Developer Builder
job.snippet:
At Classiq Technologies, we’re shaping the future of quantum computing.
Our mission is to make quantum computing practical and impactful by bridging the gap between hardware and real-world applications. Our platform enables developers and enterprises to design, optimize, and deploy quantum algorithms at scale, automating complex processes and supporting teams from beginners to experts across diverse architectures.
Classiq is trusted by Fortune 500 leaders and global governments. We accelerate the quantum era with a platform that transforms bold quantum ideas into working applications.
We're looking for someone to make Classiq AI-native. You'll build agentic systems that do real SDLC work, find the bottlenecks in our processes and build the AI tooling that removes them. Agentic pipelines, internal tools, whatever the work demands. High ownership and a direct say in what gets built next.
What You'll Do
Own the SDLC pipeline: ticket sync → planning → implementation → PR
Design agentic systems: prompts, tools, evals, guardrails, human-in-the-loop approvals, cost/latency tradeoffs
Build integrations across Jira, GitHub, Figma, and LLM providers
Own the roadmap, rollout, and adoption of internal AI tooling
Who You Are
5+ years of relevant professional experience
BSc degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field.
Strong TypeScript/Node and/or Python
Production LLM/agent experience: tool calling, orchestration, context pipelines, evals
Ability to own a workstream from requirements through iteration and drive adoption without a team under you
Bonus points
﻿durable workflows (Restate/Temporal), React internal tools, agent tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP), Kubernetes/Datadog, interest in quantum.
Stack
TypeScript/Python, Restate, PostgreSQL, Anthropic/Bedrock/LiteLLM, Jira & GitHub APIs, AWS, Terraform.

job.title: CTO Office Team Member
job.snippet:
About Us
Zenity is the leader in AI Agent Security and the first company to bring an agent-centric security platform to market. As enterprises accelerate AI agent adoption, we are establishing the security framework for how AI agents are secured and governed at enterprise scale.
We deliver full-lifecycle visibility, governance, detection, prevention, and response for AI agents from build time to runtime, across SaaS, home-grown platforms, and end-user devices. Backed by $180M+ in total funding, including a $125M Series C led by Norwest, with participation from SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and Microsoft's M12, Zenity is trusted by Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises worldwide.
Join us in shaping how AI agents are secured at enterprise scale.
About The Team
The CTO Office is Zenity’s core discovery engine, dedicated to navigating the rapid evolution in AI agent security and “building the lighthouse.” We are a high-agency team of ICs with integrated Engineering, Research, and Product mindsets. Our mission: incubate new ideas, define the approach to emerging attack classes, and build working POCs that prove technical reality.
Guided by the CTO, Product, and GTM, we validate hard, open problems and actively support the Product organization by opening new development paths and seamlessly handing over advanced capabilities through research, prototyping, and customer validation.
What You’ll Do:
Responsibilities:
Take an ambiguous security challenge from "this might be possible" to a working POC that proves the Zenity approach, grounded in technical reality.
Research the customer need, cybersecurity gap, and technical feasibility behind an idea before and while you build.
Own the end-to-end execution loop: scope the problem, build the prototype, evaluate it, document the approach, and ship it.
Partner closely with Product, R&D, and GTM. Don’t just write about emerging problems. POC the solutions so customers see something real.
Make the calls on architecture, tooling, and tradeoffs, moving quickly from ambiguity to a tangible prototype.
When a POC succeeds, lead the transition to Engineering and Product so it can receive the resources required for productization.
Stay ahead of the rapid evolution in AI and proactively bring relevant insights into the team.
Requirements:
Requirements
Technical execution. Substantial hands-on experience in Engineering or Security Research. You can investigate an unfamiliar problem, form a point of view, and build the solution to prove it works.
AI. Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI agents. You understand how they work, where they fail, and how to reason about them. You are fluent with AI-assisted coding.
Cybersecurity. Strong understanding of attack paths and defensive controls. You can earn credibility with researchers and engineers alike through technical leadership.
Product mindset. You can hold “is this the right thing to build?” in tension with “is this technically feasible?” and decide both. You care about what pain a capability solves.
Agency. Comfortable starting from a blank page, working without a spec, and being the one who defines what “done” looks like. You move fast and tell the story.
Communication. You can explain your reasoning, present prototypes to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and document the work well enough for others to continue it.
Advantages
Experience building or researching cybersecurity products
Experience with AI agents or AI agent security
Experience in an early-stage startup or zero-to-one environment
Previous leadership experience as a team lead or tech lead
Public technical output: blog posts, conference talks, open source contributions, or published papers

job.title: RMA & Supply Chain Specialist
job.snippet:
About Us:
AudioCodes (Nasdaq: AUDC) is a global leader in enterprise voice technology and Voice AI innovation for the digital workplace and customer experience. We help organizations unlock the full value of voice, transforming every conversation into a strategic asset that drives smarter decisions, better experiences and business growth. Our portfolio spans secure voice infrastructure, unified communications and contact center, with next-generation AI-powered voice solutions. With over 30 years of expertise and presence in more than 100 countries, AudioCodes is trusted by 65 of the Fortune 100 to power intelligent, agile and future-ready interactions across businesses worldwide.
About the position:
AudioCodes is looking for an RMA & Supply Chain Specialist who will be
responsible for managing the complete Return Material Authorization process, from the initial customer request through product repair and return. The role coordinates customers, field engineers, repair teams, logistics providers and subcontractors to ensure efficient service operations and high customer satisfaction. It also includes planning replenishment, service warehouse management, shipment tracking, contract verification, KPI analysis and support of global service operations.
Manage the end-to-end RMA process, including replenishment, hardware issue identification, case handling, order creation, repair coordination and customer returns.
Open and manage service orders according to contract type and service entitlement.
Coordinate and monitor import and export shipments related to RMA activities.
Operate and manage global service warehouses.
Provide timely updates to customers and field engineers in Israel and abroad.
Work daily with Oracle ERP and Cloud Console systems.
Review and update service contracts, credits and geographic contract coverage.
Analyze quarterly performance indicators and prepare KPI reports.
Develop and implement new internal, departmental and global processes and projects.
Manage subcontractor customer activity, including PO-based order creation, shipment reporting, follow-up and expediting.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Industrial Management, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
Previous experience in planning, customer service, order entry, order management or operations within a high-tech company - Advantage
Previous experience in international shipping, freight forwarding, or logistics companies will be considered - Strong Advantage.
Experience working with ERP systems and business applications is required. Familiarity with Oracle ERP -Advantage.
Familiarity with Cloud Console - Advantage.
Working knowledge of Outlook, Excel and PowerPoint - Must
Basic understanding of hardware products and repair processes.
Highly proficient in English, with the ability to communicate independently and effectively, both verbally and in writing - Must
Willingness to work full time and provide overtime when required.

job.title: Technical Project Manager
job.snippet:
About the Company
ESP 710 develops and manufactures cutting-edge loitering munitions and tactical reconnaissance drones at the forefront of defense technology.
About the Role
We are seeking a high-impact Technological Project Manager with deep systems understanding and strong execution capabilities to lead full-lifecycle development and delivery programs for advanced defense-grade unmanned systems. This is NOT a traditional process-oriented PM role. We are looking for a Builder, not a Coordinator—a hands-on technical leader who takes complete end-to-end ownership of a program: from understanding operational needs and defining requirements, through R&D, system integration, and field testing, to transition-to-production, client acceptance, and delivery.
Responsibilities
End-to-End Ownership:
Own full program responsibility from initial order/requirement definition through development, testing, and final client delivery.
Requirements Translation:
Translate operational needs and client expectations into concrete engineering work plans and execution roadmaps.
Multidisciplinary Leadership:
Lead cross-functional project teams spanning software, electronics, mechanics, RF communications, integration, and systems engineering.
Integration & Field Testing:
Drive system integration processes, lab validations, and field flight trials until system maturity is achieved.
Risk & Change Management:
Proactively identify technical, operational, and supply bottlenecks; manage engineering change orders (ECOs) and task prioritization.
Cross-Functional Synchronization:
Serve as the central hub connecting R&D, procurement, vendors, integration, manufacturing, and field ops.
Client & Stakeholder Management:
Act as the primary technical interface for defense clients, operational end-users, and executive management.
Qualifications
Multidisciplinary PM Experience:
Proven track record in managing complex, multidisciplinary technology projects involving hardware, software, electronics, mechanics, and communications.
Technical & Systems Depth:
Strong technical background enabling lead complex projects with the engineering teams and system trade-off decisions.
Full-Lifecycle Execution:
Hands-on experience leading projects through R&D, integration, field testing, and delivery.
Multi-Tasking & Drive:
Exceptional ability to manage parallel workflows in a fast-paced, high-tempo defense environment.
Total Ownership:
Proven experience owning program outcomes (scope, schedule, analysis risk, budget, quality, and field performance) rather than just project administration.
Required Skills
Experience in Defense-Tech, unmanned systems (UAVs/drones), robotics, or autonomous systems.
Experience working directly with defense clients (Ministry of Defense, IDF, law enforcement, or international defense partners).
Background in transitioning products from R&D/prototype to serial production (NPI).
Familiarity with Embedded systems, RF communications, C2 systems, Computer Vision/AI, or Electro-Optics.
Academic degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Aeronautical, Software, Industrial, etc.).

Junior Embedded Firmware Engineer
experience to join our dynamic team. This role offers an opportunity to work on innovative technology, collaborating with experts across multiple disciplines.

Solid understanding of system and hardware design principles.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent teamwork skills, flexibility, ability to handle multiple tasks and commitment.
Ability to communicate effectively in English or Hebrew (spoken and written).
Advantage
Experience in debugging and integrating hardware-software systems during the development phase.
Familiarity with RTOS environments such as FreeRTOS, Zephyr, ThreadX or Micrium.
Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

job.title: Senior Brand & Digital Designer (Motion & Video)
job.snippet:
About Encore AI
Encore AI helps enterprises turn customer interactions into revenue by scaling the expertise of their best people. Our platform analyses customer conversations to uncover missed opportunities, identify what top performers do differently, and turn those insights into AI that acts.
Through Wingman, we guide customer-facing teams in real time. Through Autopilot, our AI agents run customer journeys end to end across channels. Together, they help organizations improve conversion, capture more revenue opportunities, and continuously strengthen performance.
We work with banks, lenders, insurers, and other enterprises in regulated industries, bringing AI into complex customer journeys where trust, accuracy, and measurable business results matter.
The Role
We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Brand & Digital Designer to bring Encore AI’s story to life and set the visual standard across the company.
Our customers are banks, insurers, and large financial institutions. Your work will make complex AI capabilities clear and compelling, combining a distinctive creative voice with the credibility and polish these audiences expect.
You’ll build on our existing brand and push it further, turning complex technology into compelling visual stories. Across digital design, motion, video, and presentations, you’ll own the work from concept to final delivery, bringing strong creative judgment and hands-on execution to every project.
Your influence will extend across the company, from the materials we put in front of customers to internal communications and the platform’s visual language, working closely with product and engineering.
This is an individual contributor role with broad creative ownership. You’ll spend most of your time making, while building templates and practical guidelines that help others maintain the same standard. We’re looking for someone who brings fresh ideas, works independently, and cares about the details of everything that ships.
What You’ll Do
Own visual quality and consistency.
Apply and evolve our existing brand across internal and external materials, setting a high standard for everything the company produces.
Design our digital presence.
Rethink and redesign website pages, including our homepage and landing pages, shaping visual storytelling, content hierarchy, and responsive layouts in partnership with marketing and development.
Create enterprise-facing materials.
Design sales decks, proposals, one-pagers, case studies, reports, and event collateral that make complex products and business value easy to understand.
Produce video and motion content.
Take product demos, explainers, launch videos, and social content from concept and storyboard through design, editing, animation, and final delivery.
Support company-wide design needs.
Bring the same care to social posts, internal presentations, company documents, and executive communications.
Connect the brand to the platform.
Partner with product design and engineering to align the platform’s visual expression with our brand.
Build reusable design systems.
Create templates, asset libraries, and practical guidelines that help teams produce consistent work independently.
Use AI in your workflow.
Apply AI tools to explore ideas, accelerate production, and improve iteration while maintaining control over quality and detail.
Lead projects through delivery.
Clarify briefs, prioritise requests, present design decisions, and collaborate with external specialists when a project requires additional expertise.
Requirements
5+ years of experience in brand, visual, or digital design, with experience in B2B technology companies or agencies serving enterprise clients.
A strong portfolio showing range across brand and digital design, including websites, presentations, and motion and video work you personally created.
Strong typography, layout, and visual storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex technical content clear and compelling for enterprise audiences.
Proficiency in Figma, motion design and video editing tools such as After Effects and Premiere Pro, and presentation tools such as PowerPoint or Google Slides.
Practical experience using AI tools in creative workflows, with strong judgment about quality and where they add value.
Ability to own projects from concept to delivery, work within an established brand, and collaborate across teams while managing priorities independently.
Strong English communication skills.
Nice to Have
Experience with financial services, cybersecurity, or other regulated enterprise industries.
Experience creating product visualisations and explaining AI or complex software through design.
Experience directing freelancers, studios, or video production partners.
Why Join Encore AI
You’ll have direct influence over how Encore AI is seen by some of the world’s most demanding enterprise buyers. With an established brand foundation and a broad range of work to shape, you’ll have room to bring your own ideas, improve our digital presence, and turn complex technology into clear, compelling visual stories.
To Apply
Please share your portfolio, including website work, enterprise-facing materials, and motion or video examples. For each project, tell us what you personally owned and produced.

job.title: מהנדס.ת חשמל למפעל מוביל באשדוד
job.snippet:
מהנדס.ת חשמל למפעל מוביל באשדוד
אשדוד התפלה תפעול בע"מ
אשדוד
5-6 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 14 דקות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
לחברת תשתיות מובילה דרוש/ה מהנדס/ת חשמל להשתלבות בצוות האחזקה וההנדסה של מתקן מתקדם הכולל תחנת כוח לייצור חשמל.
תחומי אחריות
אחריות על מערכות החשמל במתח נמוך, מתח גבוה ומתח עליון (בהתאם להסמכה).
תכנון, פיקוח וליווי עבודות אחזקה מונעת ואחזקת שבר.
ניהול ותיאום עבודות קבלנים ונותני שירות.
טיפול בתקלות מורכבות, ביצוע ניתוחי כשל והובלת פעולות מתקנות.
תכנון וביצוע שדרוגים ושיפורים במערכות החשמל והבקרה.
עבודה מול גורמי תכנון, ספקים ורשויות.
הכנת מפרטים טכניים, נהלים ודוחות הנדסיים.
הקפדה על עמידה בדרישות בטיחות, איכות ורגולציה.
השתתפות בכוננויות בהתאם לצורכי האתר.
דרישות התפקיד
תואר ראשון בהנדסת חשמל – חובה.
רישיון מהנדס/ת חשמל בתוקף – חובה.
ניסיון בתחנות כוח, מפעלי תעשייה או מתקני תשתית – יתרון משמעותי.
ניסיון במערכות מתח גבוה, שנאים, לוחות חשמל, גנרטורים, מנועים וממסרי הגנה.
ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות בקרה ו-SCADA – יתרון משמעותי.
יכולת קריאת שרטוטים ותיעוד טכני.
שליטה בעברית ובאנגלית טכנית.
יכולת עבודה עצמאית, קבלת החלטות, עבודה בצוות ויחסי אנוש מצוינים.
יתרונות
ניסיון בתחנות כוח קונבנציונליות או במחזור משולב.
היכרות עם מערכות חלוקה והולכת חשמל.
ניסיון בניהול פרויקטים הנדסיים.
רישיון חשמלאי מהנדס או הסמכה מתאימה לעבודה במתח גבוה.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

ניסיון בתכנון או ניהול מתכננים/יועצים.

לקבוצת YSB דרוש/ה מנהל/ת פרויקט להובלת פרויקטים בתחום האנרגיה הסולארית, הכוללים מתקנים קרקעיים ומערכות אגירה, משלב הייזום והתכנון ועד לחיבור לרשת החשמל והמסירה.
תחומי אחריות:
• ניהול מלא של מחזור חיי הפרויקט – משלב התכנון ההנדסי, דרך ההקמה בשטח ועד למסירה והפעלה סופית.
• ניהול תקציב, תזרים מזומנים ולוחות זמנים.
• ניהול ופיקוח על קבלני ביצוע, ספקים ויועצים.
• ניהול ממשקים ומתן מענה מקצועי לפתרון בעיות בשטח.
• עבודה מול רשויות, גופי תכנון, רשויות מקומיות וחברת החשמל.
• קידום תהליכי רישוי וחיבור הפרויקטים לרשת החשמל.
• הובלת צוותים וניהול משימות בסביבה דינמית ובשטח.
הזדמנות להצטרף לחברה גדולה ויציבה עם אפיקי קידום!
עובד/ת חברה מהיום הראשון!
דרישות התפקיד
• מהנדס/ת או הנדסאי/ת חשמל, מכונות, אזרחי או תעשייה וניהול – חובה.
• רקע בתחום החשמל – יתרון משמעותי.
• ניסיון של 2–3 שנים לפחות בניהול פרויקטים – חובה.
• ניסיון בפרויקטי תשתיות / אנרגיה / אנרגיה מתחדשת / סולארי – יתרון משמעותי.
• יכולת הובלה וניהול צוותים.
• ראייה מערכתית והבנה טכנית וכלכלית.
• יכולת ארגון גבוהה וניהול מספר משימות במקביל.
• יכולת עבודה בתנאי שטח והתמודדות עם לוחות זמנים ועומס.
?? עבודה באזור עוטף עזה ועד אילת

ניהול ברמת system Admin של תוכנות NAC

תמיכה וסיוע למוקד בפתרון תקלות כדרג 2.
חיבור/ניתוק נקודות תקשורת בכלל המבנים במפעל.
הגדרה, אכיפה וכתיבת נהלי עבודה בנושאי עדכוני גרסאות הקשחות מתגים והפעלת כלי ניטור.

בעל/ת תעודת הסמכה בתחום תקשורת/ הנדסה / תוכנה.
ניסיון איש תקשורת- חובה.

עדיפות לבעלי ניסיון בתמיכה כלי ניטור, ניהול תקשורת, NAC, IMC.
אנגלית ועברית ברמה גבוהה.

job.title: MainFrame Operator
job.snippet:
Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
The Role
Your Role
As a Mainframe Operator, you will sit at the core of mission-critical delivery, operating and safeguarding high-availability IBM z/OS environments that run enterprise-scale customer workloads. You will oversee production health, batch cycles, and system performance, ensuring that core business operations run seamlessly, securely, and reliably around the clock.
In this role, you will act as a vital operational anchor—proactively catching anomalies before they impact the business and driving fast, structured incident triage when issues arise. Collaborating closely with cross-functional infrastructure, database, application, and network engineering teams, you will champion operational excellence and uphold rigorous enterprise standards.
What You Will Do
Monitor and operate IBM Mainframe production environments via console management to maintain optimal system health, uptime, and performance.
Manage end-to-end daily operations, including batch job scheduling, workload execution, console commands, and system health checks.
Detect, triage, and resolve production operational incidents rapidly, coordinating escalations and root-cause investigations where necessary.
Oversee business-critical processing schedules to guarantee the successful, timely completion of essential enterprise workloads.
Partner with database, storage, networking, and application support squads to orchestrate incident mitigation and service continuity.
Execute scheduled maintenance windows, system IPLs, change requests, and enterprise disaster recovery exercises.
Maintain and enhance standard operating procedures, operational runbooks, and shift handover documentation.
Participate in rotating shift patterns and on-call support schedules to ensure robust 24/7 coverage for critical production events.
Your Future at Kyndryl
Becoming a Mainframe Operator at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications. You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas, or move vertically into senior leadership or specialized domain roles. There are many different types and flavors of roles at Kyndryl, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.
Who You Are
Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Required Skills And Experience
10+ years of direct, hands-on operational experience supporting enterprise IBM Mainframe environments running z/OS.
In-depth expertise with core mainframe utilities and console navigation, including JES2/JES3, TSO/ISPF, and SDSF.
Proven background managing automated workload schedulers such as CA-7, Control-M, Tivoli Workload Scheduler (IWS/TWS), or direct equivalents.
Demonstrated experience with operational incident triage, console alerts, performance monitoring, and rapid fault resolution in live production.
Sound working knowledge of enterprise mainframe subsystems and security frameworks, including CICS, DB2, IMS, and RACF.
Solid practical understanding of mainframe backup, restore, and business disaster recovery protocols.
Demonstrated readiness to work rotating shift schedules to provide 24/7/365 production operational support.
Preferred Skills And Experience
Hands-on experience executing live Disaster Recovery (DR) simulations and Mainframe IPL procedures.
Practical exposure to Rexx or CLIST scripting for automating routine operational tasks.
Familiarity with ITIL framework practices, specifically Incident, Problem, and Change Management workflows.
Experience supporting modernization initiatives or hybrid-cloud integrations connected to zSystems.

job.title: NOC Technician
job.snippet:
abra's Infrastructure division is seeking a NOC Technician to join our team in Haifa. We are looking for an experienced NOC Technician who will operate and monitor computing systems at the IT Operations Center (ITOC) and handle systemic faults in real time. The role requires experience providing support for software and applications at Tier 2 level and above, in-depth knowledge of computing environments (operating systems, Office, mobile, VDI, Active Directory), and the ability to work morning/evening/night shifts.
Key Responsibilities:
Ongoing monitoring and supervision of computing systems at the IT Operations Center (ITOC).
Identifying, documenting, and handling systemic faults until resolution or escalation to the relevant party.
Providing technical and application support at Tier 2 level and above to organization users.
Providing phone support to customers in the computing environment and meeting service level targets (SLA).
Managing the shift at the contact center, including proper reporting and shift handover.
Troubleshooting issues in operating systems, Office applications, mobile, VDI, and Active Directory.
Requirements:
At least 3 years of experience working in a NOC/ITOC contact center
Proven experience of 3 years or more working in a NOC/ITOC contact center, including shift management and handling systemic faults
3 years or more of experience providing support for software and applications at Tier 2 level and above
In-depth knowledge and familiarity with computing environments: operating systems, Office applications, mobile, VDI, and Active Directory
Meeting educational threshold requirements: a bachelor's degree student in computer science/computer engineering from second year onward, or another bachelor's degree plus a computerized information systems course of at least 100 hours, or a practical engineer in computers/technology track, or advanced information systems courses of at least 150 hours, or a discharged soldier from the IDF/Mamram in a technological field
Ability to work shifts: morning 07:00-14:00, evening 14:00-21:00, night 21:00-07:00
Ability to handle pressure at all hours of the day, good interpersonal skills, and ability to work in a team
High verbal and written communication skills and ability to learn independently
Experience working with: Active Directory, VDI, Microsoft Office, Windows operating systems, mobile
Advantages:
Organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks
Positive recommendations from companies in the computing field
Experience working in large organizations (over 500 computing users)
Proven experience in phone support for customers in a computing environment
location: Haifa (office)

job.title: מיישם/ת מערכות MES ו SCADA | רקע ב IT או ERP
job.snippet:
דרוש/ה מיישם/ת מערכות MES ו SCADA עם רקע ב IT או ERP וידע בתכנות
יש לך רקע בתמיכת IT, ביישום או בתמיכה במערכות ERP, לצד ידע בתכנות?
זו ההזדמנות שלך להתפתח לתפקיד טכנולוגי מגוון המשלב יישום מערכות, כתיבת קוד וסקריפטים, פתרון בעיות ועבודה עם טכנולוגיות מתקדמות בעולם התעשייה והבקרה.
רפק פתרונות הנדסיים (Rapac Engineering Solutions)
מגייסת מיישם/ת מערכות MES ו SCADA להשתלבות בפרויקטים טכנולוגיים אצל חברות מובילות בתעשייה הישראלית.
מה כולל התפקיד?
• יישום, הגדרה והטמעה של מערכות MES ו SCADA לניהול ייצור, בקרה ואיסוף נתונים.
• בנייה והתאמה של מסכים, תהליכי עבודה ולוגיקה במערכת.
• כתיבת סקריפטים והתאמות תוכנה בהתאם לצורכי הפרויקט.
• עבודה עם מסדי נתונים וממשקים בין מערכות.
• ביצוע התקנות, בדיקות, אבחון תקלות ומתן תמיכה והדרכה ללקוחות.
דרישות התפקיד
• ניסיון באחד מהתחומים: תמיכת IT, תמיכה אפליקטיבית, סיסטם, יישום או תמיכה במערכות ERP.
• ידע בסיסי מעשי בתכנות ויכולת לקרוא, להבין ולכתוב קוד.
• חשיבה לוגית והבנה של תהליכים ומערכות מידע.
• יכולת למידה עצמית, אבחון תקלות ופתרון בעיות.
• אחריות, שירותיות ויכולת עבודה עצמאית ובצוות.
• אנגלית טכנית ברמה המאפשרת קריאת תיעוד מקצועי.
יתרון למועמדים עם
• ידע ב SQL ועבודה עם מסדי נתונים.
• ניסיון בכתיבת סקריפטים, אוטומציות או ממשקים.
• היכרות עם סביבת Windows, רשתות ותקשורת.
• ניסיון בתהליכי ייצור, מלאי או תפעול במערכות ERP.
• היכרות עם מערכות MES, SCADA או HMI.
השכלה
הנדסאי/ת תוכנה, תואר במערכות מידע או במדעי המחשב, או הכשרה מקצועית רלוונטית בתחומי ה IT והתכנות. יתרון.
מיקום:
נתניה, עבודה מהמשרד, משרה מלאה.
רוצה לקחת את הניסיון הטכנולוגי שלך צעד קדימה ולהשתלב בעולם האוטומציה התעשייתית?
נשמח להכיר אותך!

job.snippet:

Company: Khasin On Time LTD (חסין בזמן בע"מ)
Location: Central District, Israel Employment
Type: Full-Time
About the Job
Khasin On Time LTD is looking for skilled and motivated technical non-professionals to join our team specializing in elevator and escalator modernization.
We especially encourage Russian-speaking professionals with hands-on technical experience to apply! We welcome candidates from various technical backgrounds, including mechanics, electrical work, electronics, equipment repair, and industrial maintenance.No previous experience with elevators or escalators is required!
We provide full professional training at the company's expense.
Key Responsibilities:
Participate in elevator and escalator modernization projects.
Replace, upgrade, and install mechanical and electrical components.
Perform technical work in accordance with established quality and safety standards.
Diagnose technical issues and assist in troubleshooting.
Work alongside an experienced team of technical professionals.
Requirements:
Israeli citizenship is mandatory.
Practical experience in mechanics, electrical systems, electronics, equipment repair, industrial maintenance, or related technical fields.
Strong technical aptitude and hands-on experience with tools.
Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and equipment.
Responsible, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a team.
Russian and/or Hebrew communication skills for professional interaction.
Experience with elevators or escalators is an advantage but NOT required.
What We Offer:
Competitive salary.
Full professional training paid for by the company.
Company vehicle for eligible candidates.
Stable, long-term, full-time employment.
Professional development and career growth opportunities.
Hands-on experience with modern technical equipment.
Supportive and professional working environment.
Preferred Locations: We especially welcome candidates living in: Rishon LeZion, Rehovot, Ramla, Ness Ziona, Yavne, Bat Yam, and surrounding areas in Central Israel.
Interested in Joining Our Team?
If you are an Israeli citizen, speak Russian and/or Hebrew, have a technical background, and are looking for a stable career opportunity, we would love to hear from you!
Apply through LinkedIn and take the next step in your technical career. Company Website: www.dragnoa.com

job.title: Support Operations & AI Automation Engineer
job.snippet:
Established in 2022, Guardz rapidly emerged as a noteworthy player in the cybersecurity sphere, securing $85M in funding and rallying a dedicated team of 120 industry professionals. Our vision is to foster a safer digital landscape for small and medium businesses across the globe. To this end, we introduced our comprehensive all-in-one platform, and continue to grow and expand our team, our partnerships and our revenue.
As our Support Systems & AI Engineer, you'll own the systems behind Guardz's AI-first support: Guardy, our support agent; the support platform it runs on; and the AI agents that classify escalations, investigate issues, and draft fixes that make Guardy smarter. You'll also be Support's Tier 4 escalation point, taking strategic customer bugs from root cause to a tested, merged fix.
As the first hire in this role, you'll report to the Director of Support.
Responsibilities:
Support AI Performance: Own Fin Guidance, Procedures, Data Connectors and escalation rules, batch-testing and simulating every change before it goes live, and own the Support AI roadmap.
Knowledge Architecture: Own the Help Center and internal knowledge as one structured source of truth for people and AI, kept current with every release.
Knowledge Review Gate: Approve every knowledge change our agents propose until each class of change earns the right to ship on its own.
Intercom Administration: Own Intercom workspace configuration, permissions, ticket types, attributes and workflows.
Integrations: Build and maintain integrations through the Intercom API and webhooks, connecting Fin to the Guardz platform, Linear, Slack, HubSpot and our data warehouse.
Agent Operations: Operate and extend the Support AI agents infrastructure built around Intercom, keeping them scheduled, monitored and cost-aware, with prompts and skills managed as versioned code.
Evaluation & Trust: Build the evaluation sets that prove each agent works, set trust thresholds per intent class, and own the safety rails: audit log, rollback and kill switches.
New Capabilities: Partner with Engineering to let Guardy gather customer context and platform configurations, and empower it to use this context to resolve a greater variety of requests.
Strategic Bug Resolution (T4): Be Support's final escalation point for high-impact customer bugs, owning them from reproduction and root cause through code, tests, pull request and production verification.
AI-Assisted Fixes: Validate agent-generated RCAs and pull requests and drive them to merge with the owning team, who review every change. Hand back fixes that outgrow a few days' scope with findings and a proposed approach.
Supportability: Ship changes that prevent repeat tickets: clearer errors, better logging and safer retries.
Requirements:
4+ years in support, escalation or software engineering, CX operations or automation engineering, with 2+ in B2B SaaS.
Hands-on helpdesk administration (Intercom, Plain or Pylon preferred; Zendesk counts): workflows, data model, APIs.
LLM-powered workflows or agents you've run in production, including prompt and skill design, tool use and evaluations.
TypeScript/Node.js or Python, SQL (PostgreSQL), REST APIs, webhooks, Git, pull requests and automated tests.
Proven ability to debug production systems you didn't write, using logs, traces and database queries.
Clear structured writing: a help article, a Fin Guidance rule and a technical spec, equally well.
A habit of measurement: you baseline a metric, change something, and show whether it moved.
Working knowledge of IT security and MSP environments (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, identity, endpoint, email).
Excellent communication skills in English, and the ability to work independently as the owner of a function.
Advantages
: Intercom Fin configuration, Claude Code, Agent Skills or MCP, n8n or Make, NestJS, Sentry, an MSP, MSSP or cybersecurity vendor background, and experience founding a small function.
