Agent Operations: Operate and extend the Support AI agents infrastructure built around Intercom, keeping them scheduled, monitored and cost-aware, with prompts and skills managed as versioned code.
Evaluation & Trust: Build the evaluation sets that prove each agent works, set trust thresholds per intent class, and own the safety rails: audit log, rollback and kill switches.
New Capabilities: Partner with Engineering to let Guardy gather customer context and platform configurations, and empower it to use this context to resolve a greater variety of requests.
Strategic Bug Resolution (T4): Be Support's final escalation point for high-impact customer bugs, owning them from reproduction and root cause through code, tests, pull request and production verification.
AI-Assisted Fixes: Validate agent-generated RCAs and pull requests and drive them to merge with the owning team, who review every change. Hand back fixes that outgrow a few days' scope with findings and a proposed approach.
Supportability: Ship changes that prevent repeat tickets: clearer errors, better logging and safer retries.
Requirements:
4+ years in support, escalation or software engineering, CX operations or automation engineering, with 2+ in B2B SaaS.
Hands-on helpdesk administration (Intercom, Plain or Pylon preferred; Zendesk counts): workflows, data model, APIs.
LLM-powered workflows or agents you've run in production, including prompt and skill design, tool use and evaluations.
TypeScript/Node.js or Python, SQL (PostgreSQL), REST APIs, webhooks, Git, pull requests and automated tests.
Proven ability to debug production systems you didn't write, using logs, traces and database queries.
Clear structured writing: a help article, a Fin Guidance rule and a technical spec, equally well.
A habit of measurement: you baseline a metric, change something, and show whether it moved.
Working knowledge of IT security and MSP environments (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, identity, endpoint, email).
Excellent communication skills in English, and the ability to work independently as the owner of a function.
Advantages
: Intercom Fin configuration, Claude Code, Agent Skills or MCP, n8n or Make, NestJS, Sentry, an MSP, MSSP or cybersecurity vendor background, and experience founding a small function.

job.title: Controller
job.snippet:
Description
Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced, analytical Controller to lead finance activities for our Israel operations. This individual will own the Israel financial results, provide meaningful business insights to management, ensure compliance with local statutory and tax requirements, and support strategic decision-making through high-quality financial analysis.
The ideal candidate combines strong accounting expertise with analytical capabilities, business partnering experience, and a hands-on approach to managing financial performance.
Key Responsibilities
Israel Financial Ownership
Own the Israel entity's financial results, including P&L, balance sheet, and operating expenses.
Ensure accurate, complete monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.
Review and analyze financial performance, identifying risks, trends, and opportunities.
Serve as the primary finance partner for Israel leadership and functional managers.
Drive accountability for financial results across the organization.
Financial Planning & Analysis
Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes.
Provide insightful analysis of actual-versus-budget and forecast performance.
Develop financial models and business cases to support strategic decision-making.
Monitor key business metrics and provide actionable recommendations.
Partner with business leaders to improve operational and financial performance.
Tax & Statutory Compliance
Own and coordinate local tax reporting requirements, including corporate tax filings, VAT reporting, and other statutory submissions.
Manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, and regulatory authorities.
Support year-end audits and statutory financial statement preparation.
Ensure compliance with Israeli financial, tax, and regulatory requirements.

Strong organizational skills

job.title: Senior Product Manager – Chargeback Recovery & Dispute Management
job.snippet:
About the role:
Forter's Chargeback Recovery (CBR) and Dispute Management products help the world's largest merchants autonomously win back revenue lost to chargebacks. We are looking for a
Senior Product Manager
based in
Tel Aviv
to own this domain end-to-end, reporting to our Product Director, Risk Platform.
This is a unique opportunity to own a product that sits at the intersection of payments, integrations and AI transformation. You'll own the strategy and roadmap for how Forter ingests disputes from payment service providers (PSPs), builds and submits evidence, and recovers revenue for merchants. That includes our transition toward in-house dispute capabilities and a growing ecosystem of PSP integrations. You’ll work alongside Engineering and Decision Science teams in building the product capabilities, and alongside Sales, Implementation, and Customer Success to bring it to market and make it land with enterprise merchants.
If you know how a chargeback moves from a cardholder's bank to a merchant's representment letter, you want to build the product that automates that entire lifecycle and you’re excited about taking your offerings to market, this role was built for you.
What you'll be doing:
Roadmap & Strategy: Define the vision and long-term roadmap for Chargeback Recovery and Dispute Management. You'll make the hard calls on build vs. partner, automation vs. manual operations, and where to invest in improving the customer experience.
Platform Ownership: Own the full product surface: the merchant-facing UI and experience, dispute ingestion (webhooks, APIs, batch/SFTP), dispute submission, and core capabilities like our evidence recommendation engine, automation rules, evidence API and letter generation.
PSP Ecosystem & Orchestration: Set the strategy for how Forter connects to direct PSPs and processors to ingest and dispute chargebacks at scale.
AI transformation: Lead the evolution of our Dispute Agent and related AI capabilities. You'll identify where multi-step AI can replace manual work for merchants and our internal teams, and translate that into features with measurable efficiency gains.
End to End Ownership and Leadership: Own releases end-to-end: requirements, internal training, rollout, adoption monitoring, and feedback. You'll run a regular Dispute Management Product Council with GTM stakeholders to keep the field informed and feed their input back into the roadmap.
GTM Enablement & Deal Support: Act as the primary product point of contact for Sales, Presales, Implementation, and Customer Success. You'll support complex enterprise deals from first call through go-live, help Implementation navigate tricky merchant integrations, and step in on escalations post-launch. You'll also work directly with strategic enterprise merchants through recurring product syncs.
Documentation & Collateral: Own the product's knowledge layer, including public docs, the Help Center, internal enablement content, education courses, and implementation playbooks for both covered and uncovered/mixed merchant models. Alongside Product Marketing, you'll create one-pagers, ROI frameworks, and customer-facing presentations that make recovery value tangible to a merchant CFO.
What you'll need:
Domain Expertise: Proven experience in the chargebacks/disputes ecosystem, ideally with time spent at or working directly with large e-commerce merchants, PSPs or dispute vendors. You understand reason codes, representment, card network programs, and you know how dispute data actually flows between issuers, acquirers, PSPs, and merchants.
Product Ownership: 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with a proven track record of owning a domain end-to-end: defining roadmaps, shipping complex capabilities, and driving commercial outcomes.
Technical & Integration Fluency: You don't need to be an engineer, but you're comfortable defining requirements for systems that talk to other systems. You understand webhooks, APIs, batch file processing, and third-party integration architectures, and you can hold your own in a technical design review.
Communication and Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences from across the globe. You can write a PRD for Engineering in the morning, run a merchant call in the afternoon, and present a strategy to the C-suite by end of week.
Self-Starter Mentality: High autonomy is a feature of this role. You take initiative, prioritize ruthlessly across competing GTM and product demands, and hold yourself accountable without needing close management.
About Us:
Commerce is evolving faster than the systems built to support it. Agentic AI is redrawing how people buy. Customer expectations have a new ceiling. And bad actors are evolving alongside every advancement.
Forter was built to meet this moment — and stay ahead of it.
We are a human-first, AI-built company. Our technology analyzes patterns across a network of over 2 billion shoppers, delivering identity intelligence across the entire commerce journey — from sign-up to checkout to returns — that protects revenue and unlocks great customer experiences simultaneously. With Forter, businesses know who to trust, whether it’s humans or the agents shopping for them. The result: zero friction for the customers who matter. No revenue left behind.
The world's most trusted brands — Nordstrom, Instacart, Priceline, Adobe, ASOS, and eBay among them — rely on Forter to get this right. Since 2013, we've raised $525M from investors including Tiger Global, Bessemer, Sequoia Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and today we power commerce decisions for nearly 1 million businesses globally. We're more than fraud, payments and orchestration – we make trust a competitive advantage.
Trust is backed by data – Forter is a recipient of over 10 workplace and innovation awards, including:
Great Place to Work Certification (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)
Fortune’s Best Workplaces in NYC (2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025)
Forbes Cloud 100 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025)
Anti-Fraud Solution of the Year at the Payments Awards (2024)
Life as a Forterian:
Forterians are, genuinely, some of the best people you'll work with. Smart, curious, and deeply good humans who care about the work and each other. That's not an accident — it's something we've been intentional about since day one, and it's the thing people mention most when they talk about why they stay. When you're surrounded by people like this, doing work that actually matters, it changes what a job can feel like.
Forter was built on a simple but powerful conviction: when AI does its job, humans can do theirs better. That philosophy shapes our products and shapes how we work. AI is core to our workflows — not as a shortcut, but as a force multiplier that gives Forterians the space to focus their energy where human judgment is irreplaceable.
We're a global team of 500+ people, with regional headquarters in New York, Tel Aviv, London, and Singapore, and employee presence across the US, Canada, Germany, France, Japan, China, and Australia. Our teams are cross-functional by design, and the work you do here is visible, consequential, and connected to the outcomes that matter.
You'll have real ownership here and proximity to decisions. And we back that with investment in your growth — RSU offerings, L&D programs built around AI tools, and a culture of recognition rooted in our 4.5 day weeks (aka Forter’s Appreciation Fridays and Sundays). From team outings to local cultural celebrations, we mark the moments that matter — wherever you are in the world. We don't want Forter to be just another job. We want it to be the place you build.
If you're ready to work on a problem that sits at the intersection of AI, commerce, and human trust, this is it.
Forter is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that will consider all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, national origin, genetics, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at interviewaccommodation@forter.com. This information will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of determining an appropriate accommodation for the interview process.
Hybrid work:
At Forter, we embrace a hybrid work model that blends in-person connection with the flexibility of remote work. Team members based near our key hubs are expected to work from the office at least three days per week. We believe that regular face-to-face collaboration fuels professional development, strengthens our culture, and builds the relationships that help teams thrive.
Forter's Applicant Privacy Policy

job.title: Field Service Technician
job.snippet:
About Xerox Holdings Corporation
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
Overview:
Join Xerox as a Field Service Technician and become part of a growing Technical Services organization focused on delivering an exceptional customer experience. In this hands-on role, you will use your electro-mechanical expertise to troubleshoot, repair, and maintain customer equipment while helping maximize device availability and performance. Xerox provides technical training to help you build the product knowledge and skills needed to successfully support your assigned territory.
Why Join This Team:
Receive technical training from certified instructors through online and instructor-led learning
Build your expertise in electro-mechanical troubleshooting and equipment repair
Access career development and growth opportunities within Technical Services
Receive comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness credits, and a company contribution to a Health Savings Account
Participate in a 401(k) program with company matching
Receive paid time off, holidays, and personal days
What You Will Do:
Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain customer equipment using electrical and mechanical knowledge
Deliver professional, responsive customer service while helping minimize equipment downtime
Use diagnostic tools, including a multimeter, and interpret electrical schematics to identify and resolve equipment issues
Manage assigned service calls and territory responsibilities while meeting established productivity, response time, quality, and cost expectations
Maintain the equipment, parts, and inventory required to effectively support customers within your assigned territory
What You Need to Succeed
:
Electro-mechanical troubleshooting experience with the ability to use a multimeter and interpret electrical schematics
Strong customer service, time management, problem-solving, and organizational skills
Ability to work independently in a field-based environment while reliably meeting customer and service commitments
Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and regularly walk, stand, squat, bend, and drive for more than 50 percent of the workday
This position requires a valid driver's license, current automobile insurance coverage meeting company-specified minimums, and the ability to meet the company's motor vehicle safety standards.
How We Set You Up for Success:
Structured new-hire and technical training designed to prepare you for independent field service work
Training on Xerox equipment, troubleshooting procedures, inventory requirements, and customer service expectations
Clear expectations regarding service call volume, territory responsibilities, and customer satisfaction
Hands-on preparation to independently complete service calls accurately and efficiently
Supportive and collaborative environment with opportunities for continued career development

Job Description
מפעיל/ת מכונות בחדר נקי
מטרת התפקיד:
הפעלת מכונות וציוד ייצור בסביבת חדר נקי לייצור מוצרים ותתי־מכלולים, בהתאם להוראות עבודה, מפרטים ודרישות איכות, בטיחות ו־cGMP

:
השכלה תיכונית
יכולת לקרוא הוראות באנגלית ולעבוד במדויק לפי נהלים כתובים
יכולת הפעלה ואיתור תקלות בסיסיות בציוד
הזנת נתונים במערכות ממוחשבות
אחריות, גמישות ותקשורת טובה.
ניסיון של שנה עד שנתיים בייצור, במיוחד בסביבה פרמצבטית, מהווה יתרון.

עבודה בשלוש משמרות, בסופי שבוע ובשעות נוספות לפי הצורך. העבודה כוללת לבוש מגן ייעודי,
עמידה ממושכת, תנועות חוזרות ופעולות הרמה, משיכה ודחיפה.

job.title: Junior R&D Chemist / Materials Engineer
job.snippet:
Massivit 3D Printing Technologies Ltd.
develops innovative large-format 3D printing solutions. We are looking for a curious, practical, and highly hands-on R&D Chemist / Materials Engineer to join our Materials R&D team. This junior-level position combines laboratory work with material testing, printing trials, and application-oriented problem solving in a multidisciplinary environment.
What You Will Do?
Prepare, mix, and evaluate polymer formulations and experimental material samples according to defined test plans.
Perform hands-on laboratory characterization, including rheological, thermal, mechanical, and physical testing.
Plan and execute printing trials; assess material behavior, print quality, processability, and end-use performance.
Operate laboratory equipment and support troubleshooting of material-, process-, and printing-related issues.
Collect and analyze experimental data, document results, and prepare clear technical summaries and test reports.
Work closely with R&D, engineering, production, and quality teams to translate lab findings into practical improvements.
What We Are Looking For?
B.Sc. in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a closely related field - required.
Early-career candidate with strong practical laboratory skills; relevant academic or industrial lab experience is welcome.
A genuine hands-on mindset, technical curiosity, and willingness to work directly with materials, equipment, and printing systems.
Basic understanding of polymers, material properties, and experimental testing; ability to follow and improve test procedures.
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a systematic approach to troubleshooting.
Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating effectively with a multidisciplinary team.
Good written and spoken English, including technical documentation.
An Advantage (Not Required)
Hands-on experience with polymer or resin formulation, adhesives, coatings, or photopolymers / UV-curable systems.
Familiarity with material characterization methods such as rheometry, DSC, FTIR, or mechanical testing.
Exposure to 3D printing, dispensing processes, composite materials, scale-up, or product-oriented industrial R&D.
The ideal candidate
enjoys being in the lab, learning new technologies, running experiments, and turning material data into working solutions.

job.title: Mechanical Engineer
job.snippet:
Job description:
We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer to design process equipment according to the company knowhow and procedures and follow up relevant fabrication and installation.
You will co-ordinate with the other mechanical engineers as well as engineers from other disciplines in the best interest of the projects your are assigned to.
The position reports to the Mechanical Engineering Department Manager.
You will carry out the following activities:
* Prepare and check technical documents, including:
Modeling and calculations
Drawings
Specifications
Vendor documents
Technical Tabulations
Technical bid evaluation
* Co-ordinate with companies supplying engineering services
* Participate in internal meetings and in meetings with clients and suppliers
* Supervision of fabrication at vendor shops in Israel & worldwide might be required
Required profile:
* B.Sc.in Mechanical Engineering
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in a similar role preferably within the industry (Engineering company, Chemical Process/Oil & Gas industries)
* Proficiency in SolidWorks
* Proficient in MS Office applications
* Fluent English spoken and written
* Specific knowledge in GRP/FRP is advantageous
* Competency in FEA is advantageous
* Knowledge of ASME codes for vessels is advantageous
* Knowledge of composite materials is advantageous
* Basic knowledge of QA/QC requirements is advantageous
* Well organized professional with excellent communication skills, capable of multitasking and maintaining a high standard of quality under pressure.
What we offer
* The opportunity to contribute to TAT activities with a direct impact on business performance in worldwide projects
* An international environment where ideas are valued and innovation is encouraged
* Continuous learning opportunities through exposure to new technologies and design.
* Hybrid working model according to company policy and role requirements
* Performance Management through an annual appraisal and development process
* Well-being initiatives to support employees

job.title: Genetic Product Team Lead
job.snippet:
Company Description
Enzootic is a vertically integrated Biotechnology venture headquartered in Singapore, with its Genetics and Innovation hub in Israel and commercial production facilities in Thailand. Based in Kibbutz Ruhama, our Israeli hub develops advanced genetic and biotechnological solutions for inland freshwater prawn production, leveraging cutting-edge science to drive sustainable aquaculture.
Role Description
Enzootic is looking for a talented Life Sciences graduate to lead our Genetics and Production team in Kibbutz Ruhama. No prior managerial experience is required—we provide full, comprehensive training! This role offers a unique opportunity to take professional ownership of our genetic and production processes in an advanced technological environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Daily Operations & Control:
Manage day-to-day operations at the production facility and oversee the life-cycle management of aquatic animals in closed water systems.
Genetic Process Leadership:
Provide end-to-end professional responsibility for genetic and production processes.
Advanced Production Procedures:
Execute complex procedures including cell manipulations, write SOPs, and submit performance reports.
Molecular Laboratory Work:
Perform molecular quality control (QC), including DNA extraction and RT-PCR.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree (B.Sc.) in Biology, Life Sciences, Marine Biology, or Biotechnology –
Mandatory.
Residence in southern Israel and availability for full-time work (5 days a week) + participation in Friday shift rotations –
Mandatory.
Passion, capability, and willingness for hands-on work with aquatic animals –
Mandatory.
Background in molecular laboratories or aquaculture –
A significant advantage!
Looking for a meaningful hands-on opportunity in biotechnology and sustainable aquaculture? We’d love to hear from you!
Job Type:
Full-time
Location:
Kibbutz Ruhama (On-site)
How to apply:
Send your CV to
dana@enzootic.com

job.title: Technical Support Engineer – Night Shifts (Student )
job.snippet:
About The Role
Novidea is seeking a motivated
Student Technical Support Engineer
to join our global Support team and provide technical coverage during
night hours
.
This is an excellent opportunity for a Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or similar student who wants to gain hands-on experience working with enterprise software, Salesforce, APIs, integrations, databases, and real customer production environments.
You will be responsible for monitoring and handling incoming customer cases from the Asia / Australia region, performing initial technical investigations, identifying and resolving known issues, and escalating complex cases with the relevant technical information.
Work schedule: Sunday night - Friday Morning 02:00–09:00, 2-3 shifts a week.
What You'll Do
Monitor and manage incoming customer cases during the night shift.
Perform initial technical investigation and troubleshooting.
Gather relevant logs, error messages, screenshots, and reproduction steps.
Investigate application configuration and data-related issues.
Use internal tools and knowledge resources to resolve known issues.
Perform basic data investigation using queries and troubleshooting tools.
Assist with API and integration troubleshooting.
Identify urgent or high-impact issues and follow the appropriate escalation process.
Escalate complex issues to senior Support Engineers or Senior CS with clear and complete technical information.
Communicate clearly with customers and internal teams.
Document solutions and contribute to the Support knowledge base.
What You Need
Current student in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or another relevant technical field.
Familiarity with Salesforce.
Strong technical aptitude and curiosity - you enjoy understanding why something isn't working.
Basic understanding of programming concepts.
Basic understanding of databases and SQL.
Familiarity with web technologies, APIs or JSON is an advantage.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Ability to work independently and make decisions during night hours.
Availability to work regular 02:00–09:00 shifts (Sunday night - Friday Morning)
Nice to Have
Previous experience in technical support, IT, QA, NOC, or a technical customer-facing role.
Experience using SQL or querying data.
Familiarity with REST APIs or Postman.
Experience with Jira or similar ticketing systems.
What You'll Learn
Hands-on troubleshooting of a complex enterprise SaaS application.
Salesforce Platform fundamentals.
API and integration troubleshooting.
Production incident and case management.
Working with logs, data, and technical diagnostic tools.
How Support, Product, and Engineering collaborate to resolve complex customer issues.

job.title: Head of Information Security (CISO)
job.snippet:
Description
Enlight is looking for a Head of Information Security (CISO) to lead the development and implementation of the company’s cybersecurity strategy, governance, and risk-management framework. The role will ensure that Enlight’s IT and operational technology (OT) environments, critical assets, data, and business operations are appropriately protected as the company grows and expands internationally.
The CISO will establish and continuously improve the company’s information security capabilities, prioritizing initiatives based on risk exposure and business impact while enabling business growth and maintaining uninterrupted operations across renewable energy assets and corporate systems.
Responsibilities:
Cybersecurity Strategy & Governance: Define and implement the company-wide cybersecurity strategy, policies, standards, and governance framework, aligned with business priorities and risk exposure.
IT & OT Security: Assess and mitigate cybersecurity risks across corporate IT systems, renewable energy assets, operational technology, and critical infrastructure, while maintaining production continuity.
Risk Management & Business Impact: Lead Business Impact Analysis (BIA), identify and prioritize critical assets and vulnerabilities, and develop risk-based mitigation plans.
Security Operations & Incident Response: Establish and oversee Security Operations Center (SOC) capabilities, security monitoring, incident response, and recovery processes.
Security Architecture & Access Management: Define security requirements for infrastructure, applications, cloud environments, identity and access management, and remote access.
Policies & Procedures: Develop and implement security policies, standards, procedures, and controls, ensuring they are practical, adopted, and regularly reviewed.
Third-Party & Supply Chain Security: Assess and manage cybersecurity risks associated with vendors, service providers, technology partners, and critical infrastructure components.
Incident Preparedness & Resilience: Establish incident response plans, conduct security assessments and exercises, and strengthen business continuity and recovery capabilities.
Compliance & Assurance: Ensure alignment with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, contractual obligations, and internal audit recommendations.
Security Awareness: Develop employee awareness and training programs to strengthen secure behaviors and accountability across the organization.
Technology & AI Security: Define security requirements for the adoption of AI, automation, and emerging technologies, enabling their safe and responsible use.
Requirements:
10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, IT/OT security, or a related field, including leadership responsibility.
Proven experience developing and implementing cybersecurity strategies, policies, governance frameworks, and risk-mitigation plans, and familiarity with relevant cybersecurity frameworks and standards.
Strong understanding of IT and OT security, preferably in critical infrastructure, energy, industrial environments, or other operationally sensitive industries.
Experience with security risk assessments, Business Impact Analysis (BIA), asset criticality assessments, establishing SOC, IR, Suply Chain risks.
Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA, or equivalent) – preferred.
Experience in renewable energy, power generation, construction, infrastructure, or industrial environments – preferred.

job.title: Director of Construction – Israel
job.snippet:
We are looking for a
Director of Construction – Israel
to lead a team of project managers delivering large-scale solar, wind, and energy storage projects across Israel. The role requires multidisciplinary management expertise spanning infrastructure, engineering, finance, and commercial aspects.
Responsibilities:
Lead the team of project managers responsible for large-scale solar, wind, and energy storage projects, from financial close through construction, commissioning, and commercial operation (COD).
Own the department’s project budgets, including budget development, cost control, monitoring, and forecasting.
Lead cross-functional collaboration with internal teams, including Development, Engineering, Procurement, and Finance, and with external stakeholders, including contractors, global equipment suppliers, owner’s engineers, project management and supervision firms, grid operators and regulatory authorities, and business partners.
Monitor key project milestones, identify contractual risks and exposures, and lead negotiation strategies to proactively resolve issues and protect the company’s interests.
Represent the projects and regularly report on their status and progress to senior management, partners, and other stakeholders.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering, or another relevant field – required.
At least 10 years of experience managing renewable energy and/or infrastructure projects, including civil works, electrical infrastructure (including substations and grid connection), and the management of contractors, consultants, and engineering designers – required.
Familiarity with Israeli regulatory, permitting, and grid connection processes, including work with the Israel Electric Corporation (IEC) and Noga – an advantage.
Experience managing budgets and the financial and commercial aspects of complex infrastructure projects – required.
Proven experience leading and developing teams of project managers – required.
Previous experience in the renewable energy sector – a significant advantage.
Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and workstreams simultaneously.
Strong technical orientation combined with strategic, big-picture thinking.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and MS Project – required.
Native-level Hebrew and full professional proficiency in English, both spoken and written – required.
Willingness and ability to travel frequently to project sites across Israel, with occasional international travel as required.
Experience working with international teams and/or global equipment suppliers – an advantage.

job.title: SUPERVISOR IN JERUSALEM
job.snippet:
Waxman Group is Israel’s leading company in infrastructure, construction, and complex civil engineering.
We specialize in the planning, management, and execution of national-scale mega-projects that reshape the country’s landscape, redefine its skyline, and build the strategic infrastructure of tomorrow. The Group manages a diverse portfolio of complex projects – from commercial and residential towers to transportation infrastructure, energy, and advanced urban development – all at the core of national activity, impacting the lives of millions of people every day.
Responsibilities
The role entails responsibility for all engineering aspects during the project execution phase, including schedule management, budget control, and work based on specific project management methodologies.
It is a dynamic and challenging position offering opportunities for learning, training, advancement, and professional growth within the organization.
Requirements
Registered Civil Engineer – Mandatory
Proficiency in computerized systems – Mandatory
Two years of experience in construction execution/supervision
Managerial skills, commitment, and ability to prioritize tasks
Strong interpersonal skills and high motivation
Why take your next step at Waxman Group?
Unlimited learning and personal development: We believe in your growth. Our in-house academy offers a wide range of courses, professional training, advanced seminars, and personal development programs that give you the tools to lead and to stay at the forefront of the industry.
A top-tier employee experience, social life, and welfare: We work hard here — and celebrate even harder. Our package includes lavish company events, an unforgettable annual company retreat, toasts and get-togethers, birthday and personal milestone celebrations, and especially generous gifts for the holidays and special occasions.
Impact on national mega-projects: You will have the opportunity to work at the very heart of the most complex and influential engineering and infrastructure projects in Israel, and to leave a personal mark on the face of the country.
The stability of a large company with the agility of a start-up: A precise balance between strong financial backing, job security, and stability, and a dynamic, fast-paced, bureaucracy-free work environment that encourages initiative and out-of-the-box thinking.
A down-to-earth organizational culture: We combine uncompromising professionalism with a warm, supportive, family atmosphere. Our managers and colleagues are true partners — approachable, always with an open door, and genuinely collaborative both in the office and in the field.
This position is open to women and men alike.
Location
The company's site in Jerusalem

job.title: Postdoctural Researchers Wanted – Design, Engineering & Fabrication
job.snippet:
Company Description
Technion – Israel Institute of Technology is a leading global university for science, engineering, and technology, founded in 1912 on Mount Carmel in Haifa. Over more than a century, Technion has become a pioneer in fields such as biotechnology, stem cell research, space, computer science, nanotechnology, and energy. With 18 faculties, over 14,000 students, 135 academic programs, and 60 research institutes, Technion City is a dynamic hub of innovation and interdisciplinary research. Four Technion professors have received Nobel Prizes, reflecting the institute’s culture of excellence and impact. Technion alumni play a central role in Israel’s “Startup Nation,” driving technological advances that benefit communities worldwide.
Role Description
Postdoctoral Researchers in Design, Engineering & Fabrication will contribute to cutting-edge research at the intersection of design, human-computer interaction, and advanced fabrication at Technion in Haifa. This full-time, on-site role involves designing and prototyping new interactive systems and services, conducting user-centered studies, and collaborating with engineering and design teams to translate research insights into tangible outputs. Day-to-day tasks include planning and executing experiments, analyzing qualitative and quantitative data, preparing publications for high-impact conferences and journals, and presenting research outcomes within the Technion community and internationally. The role also includes mentoring students, contributing to grant applications, and participating in collaborative projects across faculties.
Qualifications
Strong foundation in Service Design and Design Thinking, with the ability to structure complex problems and develop practical, user-centered solutions.
Expertise in Human-Computer Interaction, including designing, prototyping, and evaluating interactive systems and interfaces.
Experience in User Research and Ethnography, with skills in qualitative methods such as interviews, observations, and field studies.
Doctoral degree (PhD or equivalent) in design, HCI, engineering, computer science, or a closely related discipline.
Proven research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations.
Hands-on skills in digital fabrication, prototyping tools, or relevant engineering/design software are highly beneficial.
Ability to work collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams and to communicate research clearly in spoken and written English.
Interest in applying research to real-world challenges, contributing to innovation aligned with Technion’s mission to benefit humanity.

job.title: Workplace & Talent Partner
job.snippet:
Tonkean is the world’s first totally customizable process experience platform. With Tonkean, you can create intelligent, personalized automations that integrate with every app or system your organization uses. You can cultivate an employee experience that democratizes access to innovative technologies traditionally only available to highly trained developers. You can enable employees to focus more fully on high-value tasks, because you can enable them to automate low-value tasks. You can create inbox solutions that automatically analyze, prioritize, and route unstructured requests coming from any source, and you can track the status of action items as employees collaborate across teams to complete them. And you can design processes that employees are guaranteed to adopt and benefit from no matter their technical acumen, because Tonkean meets employees where they are—eliminating the need for change management—and is 100% no-code.
ABOUT YOU
We’re looking for a proactive, organized, and people-oriented Workplace & Talent Partner to join our team in Israel for a maternity leave replacement.
In this role, you’ll be responsible for creating a great workplace experience while supporting our talent acquisition efforts and working closely with team leads to support the company’s hiring needs.
3+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, preferably in tech companies and startups, with experience recruiting for technical roles.
Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment processes across different roles.
Hands-on experience with HR operations and employee lifecycle processes.
Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
A proactive, resourceful, and hands-on approach, with a strong sense of ownership.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across all levels of the organization.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
A positive, can-do attitude, with a hands-on and solution-oriented approach.
A team-oriented individual with strong collaboration skills and a proactive approach.
Experience working with global teams and HR systems is an advantage.
Fluency in Hebrew and English, both written and spoken.
WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
Talent Acquisition
Work closely with team leads and hiring managers to understand hiring needs, define role requirements, and develop recruitment strategies.
Own the end-to-end recruitment process, including new headcount requests and approval coordination, candidate sourcing and screening, interview coordination, and offer management.
Build and maintain strong talent pipelines through proactive sourcing, primarily using LinkedIn and other relevant channels.
Maintain a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
Coordinate with hiring managers and relevant stakeholders to keep recruitment processes moving forward.
Workplace & HR Operations
Own the day-to-day operations of our Tel Aviv office, ensuring everything runs smoothly and efficiently.
Work closely with suppliers, vendors, and service providers to manage ongoing services and ensure a high standard of service.
Coordinate office maintenance, facilities, and operational needs, including cleaning, repairs, and food orders.
Plan and execute happy hours, team events, birthday celebrations, and holiday gifts.
Manage office inventory, supplies, and purchasing, ensuring the office is fully equipped and well maintained.
Manage office-related expenses, invoices, and ongoing administrative processes.
Manage employee onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth experience for employees and hiring managers.
Serve as the go-to person for day-to-day administrative and operational needs, working closely with HR, Finance, Legal, and other teams when needed.

job.title: Technical Support Engineer
job.snippet:
An innovative Israeli MedTech company developing an advanced AI-powered medical diagnostic platform for the automated detection and classification of cancer cells.
The company integrates high-precision optical hardware and complex imaging systems with proprietary deep learning algorithms, enabling clinical laboratories and hospitals worldwide to elevate diagnostic precision and streamline critical pathological workflows.
Operating on a global scale, the firm bridges cutting-edge multidisciplinary engineering with direct clinical impact across premier healthcare institutions.
The office is located adjacent to the train station, supporting global customer deployments.
Role Description
Serving as a Global Field Service & Technical Support Engineer, serving as the technical authority and primary point of contact for international clinical customers.
Performing on-site system installations, system calibrations, preventive maintenance, and complex troubleshooting at customer sites worldwide.
Delivering professional on-site and remote technical training sessions for laboratory teams, clinical operators, and biomedical engineers.
Diagnosing and resolving multidisciplinary hardware, software, and electro-optical issues in complex Windows-based production environments.
Operating in an international, English-speaking ecosystem with extensive global travel to hospitals and clinical laboratories.
Participating in an on-call rotation schedule (including occasional remote Friday shifts, compensated with compensatory rest days).
Requirements-
B.Sc. in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Computer, or Biomedical) or a Practical Engineering degree – Mandatory
Exceptional, fluent written and verbal English communication skills for global customer interactions – Mandatory
Hands-on technical background in assembling, integrating, and troubleshooting complex multidisciplinary systems – Mandatory
Deep technical understanding of PC hardware architecture and Windows OS environments – Mandatory
Proven background in technical support (Tier 2/3) or field service engineering – Mandatory
Demonstrated track record delivering front-facing technical training and onboarding to clients – Mandatory
Strong customer-centric mindset, excellent analytical troubleshooting skills, and multitasking abilities – Mandatory
Full proficiency in MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) – Mandatory
Prior professional experience within the Medical Device or clinical technology domain – Significant Advantage
Practical experience working with microscopy systems, imaging devices, or digital pathology scanners – Significant Advantage

job.title: IT Infrastructure Engineer
job.snippet:
At Infinidat, a Lenovo company, we empower enterprises and service providers with cutting-edge storage platforms that redefine performance, reliability, and cyber resilience at scale.
We’re looking for an experienced IT infrastructure engineer to run and evolve our infrastructure, from the physical data center up through storage, virtualization, and operating systems. You’ll be a key infrastructure partner for technical teams across the company, balancing day-to-day support with improving how things are built and automated.
Responsibilities:
Manage and maintain Linux servers running Rocky Linux, CentOS, RHEL and Ubuntu
Administer Windows servers and Active Directory
Operate our virtualization platforms, based on VMware and Harvester
Manage enterprise storage and connectivity over NFS, SMB, and Fibre Channel
Manage backup and recovery
Maintain physical servers and data center infrastructure, including hardware, racking, and cabling
Drive automation and desired state configuration (DSC) using Ansible
Monitor systems and services using Zabbix
Handle day-to-day tickets across a variety of infrastructure topics, supporting technical teams throughout the company.
Requirements:
At least 5 years of experience in IT infrastructure or systems engineering in a production environment.
Strong hands-on experience with Linux (Rocky Linux, CentOS, RHEL, Ubuntu), including OS hardening and security best practices
Hands-on experience with Windows Server and Active Directory
Strong hands-on experience with VMware; experience with Kubernetes and Harvester is an advantage
Hands-on experience with Ansible for automation and configuration management
Extensive experience with enterprise storage, including NFS, SMB, and Fibre Channel
Solid networking knowledge, including DHCP, routing, VLANs, and general network troubleshooting, with familiarity with Cisco switches
Experience with Python for scripting and automation
Experience with Zabbix or similar monitoring tools
Experience designing and operating backup and recovery solutions
Preferred Qualifications-
Experience with InfiniBox storage
Experience with HashiCorp Vault
Experience with identity providers (IdPs) such as Okta
Experience with IBM AIX.
About Infinidat
Infinidat’s enterprise storage portfolio provides global Fortune 500 enterprises and service providers with best-in-class solutions for primary storage, next-generation data protection, disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience. Infinidat’s acclaimed InfuzeOS is the one of the most flexible and complete enterprise software-defined storage architectures in the industry. We recently announced powerful enhancements, an extensive expansion, and the dynamic evolution of our award-winning G4 enterprise cyber and AI storage solutions! Not only did Infinidat win over 40 awards in 2025, but was named a Gartner® Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer Award for Primary Storage for the 7th time!

job.title: CISO
job.snippet:
Enlight is looking for a Head of Information Security (CISO) to lead the development and implementation of the company’s cybersecurity strategy, governance, and risk-management framework. The role will ensure that Enlight’s IT and operational technology (OT) environments, critical assets, data, and business operations are appropriately protected as the company grows and expands internationally.
The CISO will establish and continuously improve the company’s information security capabilities, prioritizing initiatives based on risk exposure and business impact while enabling business growth and maintaining uninterrupted operations across renewable energy assets and corporate systems.
Responsibilities:
Cybersecurity Strategy & Governance: Define and implement the company-wide cybersecurity strategy, policies, standards, and governance framework, aligned with business priorities and risk exposure.
IT & OT Security: Assess and mitigate cybersecurity risks across corporate IT systems, renewable energy assets, operational technology, and critical infrastructure, while maintaining production continuity.
Risk Management & Business Impact: Lead Business Impact Analysis (BIA), identify and prioritize critical assets and vulnerabilities, and develop risk-based mitigation plans.
Security Operations & Incident Response: Establish and oversee Security Operations Center (SOC) capabilities, security monitoring, incident response, and recovery processes.
Security Architecture & Access Management: Define security requirements for infrastructure, applications, cloud environments, identity and access management, and remote access.
Policies & Procedures: Develop and implement security policies, standards, procedures, and controls, ensuring they are practical, adopted, and regularly reviewed.
Third-Party & Supply Chain Security: Assess and manage cybersecurity risks associated with vendors, service providers, technology partners, and critical infrastructure components.
Incident Preparedness & Resilience: Establish incident response plans, conduct security assessments and exercises, and strengthen business continuity and recovery capabilities.
Compliance & Assurance: Ensure alignment with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, contractual obligations, and internal audit recommendations.
Security Awareness: Develop employee awareness and training programs to strengthen secure behaviors and accountability across the organization.
Technology & AI Security: Define security requirements for the adoption of AI, automation, and emerging technologies, enabling their safe and responsible use.
Requirements:
10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, IT/OT security, or a related field, including leadership responsibility.
Proven experience developing and implementing cybersecurity strategies, policies, governance frameworks, and risk-mitigation plans, and familiarity with relevant cybersecurity frameworks and standards.
Strong understanding of IT and OT security, preferably in critical infrastructure, energy, industrial environments, or other operationally sensitive industries.
Experience with security risk assessments, Business Impact Analysis (BIA), asset criticality assessments, establishing SOC, IR, Suply Chain risks.
Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA, or equivalent) – preferred.
Experience in renewable energy, power generation, construction, infrastructure, or industrial environments – preferred.

job.title: Senior Product Manager
job.snippet:
About In-House Health
In-House Health is building the
AI-powered clinical workforce OS
for healthcare's biggest problem: there aren't enough nurses, and the ones we have are burning out.
Our platform lets nursing teams run their own schedules with flexibility they've never had before. Predictive algorithms match the right nurse to the right shift, so facilities stay staffed and clinicians get their lives back.

job.title: Customer Success Support- Student Position
job.snippet:
Role Overview
Cemento is growing, and we are looking for a tech-savvy, highly motivated student to join our Customer Success team. In this role, you will be the bridge between our innovative AI-driven platform and our leading global construction clients. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced SaaS startup and build a career path toward Project Management or Customer Success.
Key Responsibilities
Customer Interface:
Provide high-level support and guidance to our clients, ensuring they maximize the value of the Cemento platform.
System Operations:
Master our advanced technological system to troubleshoot, configure, and optimize workflows.
Cross-Team Collaboration:
Work closely with Project Managers and R&D to relay client feedback and drive product improvements.
Data Management:
Assist in onboarding new projects and maintaining data quality using Excel and internal tools.
Requirements
Student for B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering & Management or B.A. in Information Systems with 3 semesters left - Must.
Technical or analytical foundation from military service, academic projects, or previous experience.
Ability to work 3 days a week- Must
Excel- High proficiency (vlookup, pivot tables, etc.)
English- Good level of English (verbal and written) for communication in a global environment
Soft Skills- Strong analytical capabilities, service-oriented approach, and a "can-do" attitude
About Us
Cemento Technologies is a fast-growing SaaS company revolutionizing the way construction projects are managed. Our AI-enhanced platform is trusted by thousands of projects across three continents, helping teams automate workflows, ensure compliance, and drive project success. We’re an Israeli-global startup at the forefront of technology, leveraging intelligent data to reshape how large-scale projects are delivered.
📍 Location
: Ramat Gan- Bursa district, walk from Savidor Central train station.

job.title: Senior Global Organizational Development Partner
job.snippet:
At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevSecOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate. Our team of industry-leading software security experts is a true pioneer, constantly pushing the boundaries with original research and technological innovation. JFrog is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit, and just all-around great people. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production – a concept we call “liquid software”. Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us on our journey?
As a Global Organizational Development Partner, you will design and implement strategic organizational, leadership, and talent development initiatives across the company worldwide. You will partner and collaborate with key stakeholders across all regions and ensure all programs are aligned with business goals. In addition to program design, you will personally facilitate executive and leadership team development, and lead complex change management efforts end-to-end.
As a Global Organizational Development Partner you will...
Design and deliver global organization development strategies and solutions that align with JFrog's business objectives and drive JFrog's growth across all regions.
Define and implement global strategies and approaches to identify, assess, and develop current and potential leaders.
Design and personally facilitate executive and leadership team development sessions, offsites, and workshops
Lead end-to-end change management for complex, cross-regional, multi-stakeholder initiatives — owning the strategy, plan, and execution.
Develop engaging and innovative global talent and leadership development programs.
Develop, improve, and reinforce global strategies, structures, and processes — such as employee surveys, engagement processes, performance management, and more.
Drive JFrog's unique culture transformation globally through targeted programs and initiatives.
Collaborate with HR and business partners across regions to deliver consistent, integrated solutions.
Coach and advise senior business partners and leaders on organization development topics.
Capture and share standards, best practices, external benchmarks, and innovative practices related to culture, change management, team effectiveness, strategy operationalization, organizational design, and organizational diagnosis.
To be a
Global Organizational Development Partner you need...
10+ years of experience in organizational development in a global high-tech organization.
Proven, hands-on experience designing and personally facilitating executive and leadership-team development sessions.
Significant, demonstrated depth in change management able to independently lead complex, cross-regional change efforts from strategy to execution.
Experience operating globally across multiple regions and cultures in a dynamic, complex environment.
Outstanding communication, facilitation, interpersonal, and presentation skills, including with senior executives.

job.title: Operations Manager-5707
job.snippet:
We are looking for an experienced
Operations Manager
to lead complex technology and infrastructure projects, manage project managers and execution teams, and drive operational excellence and business profitability.
This is a key leadership role involving end-to-end project management, resource planning, financial oversight, and collaboration with strategic clients across data centers, national infrastructure, healthcare facilities, and other complex environments.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead and oversee multiple complex projects from handover to final delivery.
Manage, mentor, and develop project managers and field teams.
Oversee project budgets, cost control, resource utilization, and profitability.
Manage relationships with clients, contractors, consultants, and suppliers.
Implement operational processes, KPIs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Requirements:
7+ years of experience managing complex technology projects in control systems, low-voltage systems, electrical, or electromechanical fields.
3+ years of experience in operations management, project portfolio management, or leading teams of project managers.
Proven experience in budget management, cost control, and project profitability.
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.
Advanced Excel skills.
Relevant technical education or equivalent professional experience.
Nice to Have:
Experience in BMS/BAS, low-voltage systems, smart building technologies, or systems integration.
Engineering or practical engineering background in Electrical, Control, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering.
Experience with ERP systems, particularly Priority.
Experience managing large-scale infrastructure projects.
If you're a results-driven leader with strong technical expertise, business acumen, and a passion for operational excellence, we'd love to hear from you!

job.title: Commercial Project Manager כלכלן/ית בקרה תקציבית לפרוייקטים
job.snippet:
Commercial Project Manager - EXT Hiring
The Commercial Project Manager is responsible for managing the project throughout its life cycle,
ensuring financial accuracy, compliance, risk management, and effective stakeholder communication.
Project Management :
Support the PM in identifying, evaluating, and assessing risks & opportunities,
strategies, and response activities according to FRG and PM Guide.
Ensure adherence to NCM regulations and internal controls (RIC, ICFR).
Manage and coordinate all contractual, administrative, legal, tax, accounting,
and financial aspects of business execution in partnership with the PM.
Financial Management:
Ensure the accuracy of cost and pricing calculations and overall project books and records.
Prepare commercial documentation for regular project status meetings and
ensure the accuracy of commercial project data (e.g., FC, MIKA, cash flow).
Perform asset management.
Initiate invoicing according to project progress and contractual terms, and ensure proper payment allocation.
Ensure compliance with Siemens Energy FRG and local GAAP requirements.
Manage financial guarantees, bonds, and project securities.
Support the PM in minimizing non-conformance costs and implementing lessons learned.
Risk & Contract Management :
Ensure compliance with LoA guidelines for commercial aspects and conduct contract,
claim, and change order negotiations.
Set up and manage contract and claim management processes, including involvement of the assigned CM if required.
Identify, assess, respond to, monitor, report, and escalate all commercial risks (e.g., calculation, tax, insurances, currency).
Communicate relevant commercial contractual obligations and conditions to the project team.
Review, approve, or reject change requests and enforce legitimate claims while fending off unjustified claims.
Perform credit risk analysis for potential customers and supervise the purchasing service to ensure compliance with the P2P process.
Compliance Management:
Lead commercial project members to act according to Business Conduct Guidelines and establish a culture of trust and integrity.
Ensure compliance with relevant tax regulations, export control regulations, and hedging/currency regulations.
Support the PM in setting up a framework for regular compliance checks in the project.
Empowerment:
Drive own empowerment with adequate signature authorization and project target
agreement to manage the project as a commercial project entrepreneur.
Support the PM in managing and optimizing targeted financial results.
Stakeholder Management:
Support the PM in conducting stakeholder analysis and ensure efficient communication with all
relevant internal and external stakeholders (e.g., HR, Quality Management, EHS, customers, suppliers, consortium partners).
Ensure proper execution of all tasks with relevant stakeholders (e.g., SFS, CF, RIC, Legal and Compliance, HR, ECC, Customs, external auditors).

Perform asset management.
Initiate invoicing according to project progress and contractual terms, and ensure proper payment allocation.
Ensure compliance with Siemens Energy FRG and local GAAP requirements.
Manage financial guarantees, bonds, and project securities.
Support the PM in minimizing non-conformance costs and implementing lessons learned.

claim, and change order negotiations.
Set up and manage contract and claim management processes, including involvement of the assigned CM if required.

Communicate relevant commercial contractual obligations and conditions to the project team.
Review, approve, or reject change requests and enforce legitimate claims while fending off unjustified claims.

Lead commercial project members to act according to Business Conduct Guidelines and establish a culture of trust and integrity.
Ensure compliance with relevant tax regulations, export control regulations, and hedging/currency regulations.

agreement to manage the project as a commercial project entrepreneur.

job.snippet:
alle Standorte
Internes Projektmanagement
Das Tätigkeitsfeld umfasst die Koordination komplexer und anspruchsvoller Generalplanungs-Projekte für öffentliche Auftraggeber:innen.
Welche Aufgaben erwarten dich?
Übergeordnetes Definieren, Steuern und Sicherstellen von Kosten-, Termin- und Qualitätszielen von Planungs- und Bauleistungen vor allem im Rahmen von Generalplanungen
Abstimmen und Festlegen der Projektziele, der wirtschaftlichen Abwicklungsprozesse und Aufbau der projektspezifischen Organisationsstrukturen
Mitwirken bei der Auswahl von weiteren Projektbeteiligten wie Fachplanungsbüros, Berater:innen und ausführenden Firmen
Vertragsgestaltung und Abstimmung mit den Nachunternehmen im Generalplanungsteam
Aufstellen von Abrechnungskalendern, Abstimmen und Synchronisieren der Abrechnungsstände im Außen – und Innenverhältnis
Vorbereiten, Führen und Steuern von Projektbesprechungen sowie der Austausch mit den Projektbeteiligten und weiteren Schnittstellen (intern/ extern) in Zusammenarbeit mit Projektleiter:innen
Was solltest du mitbringen?
Lösungsorientiertes Denken, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein hohes Maß an Selbstorganisation
Abgeschlossenes Studium der Architektur / Bauingenieur / Betriebswirtschaft
Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrung in den allen Leistungsphasen nach HOAI und AHO
Sicheres Auftreten im Umgang mit Bauherrn und der Kommunikation mit Projektbeteiligten
Fundierte Kenntnisse in AVA- und Projektmanagement-Programmen, vorzugsweise iTwo und PowerProject
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, mindestens Niveau C1
Was bieten wir dir?
Mitarbeit an anspruchsvollen, interessanten und nachhaltigen Projekten
Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben in einem angenehmen und kollegialen Arbeitsumfeld
Leistungsgerechtes Einkommen in unbefristeter Festanstellung (Teil- oder Vollzeit)
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Arbeitszeitmodelle
Offene Kommunikation bei flachen Hierarchien
Individuelle Weiterentwicklungsperspektiven und regelmäßige Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten
Die Möglichkeit der Mitgliedschaft unserer Firmenfitness-Angebote
Teilnahme am JobRad-Programm
Gemeinsame Aktivitäten, Firmenfeste, Teamevents, uvm.
Attraktiven Arbeitsplatz in modernen Büroräumen zentral in allen Standorten - direkte Anbindung an den ÖPNV (Stadtmitte)

job.snippet:
🚀 יודעים לקחת מערכת משלב הרעיון ועד שהיא באמת עובדת בשטח? התפקיד הבא שלכם אולי כאן!
אני מחפשת מנהל/ת מוצר ומערכות מידע לתפקיד שמשלב אפיון, ניהול פרויקטים טכנולוגיים, עבודה מול ספקים והובלת תהליכים מקצה לקצה.
🎯 מה מחכה לכם בתפקיד?
🔹 הובלת מוצר ומערכות מידע משלב הגדרת הצורך ועד להטמעה אצל משתמשי הקצה.
🔹 כתיבת אפיונים עסקיים, ניהול ותעדוף משימות והובלת שיפורים.
🔹 ניהול פרויקט משמעותי מול ספקים חיצוניים וממשקים פנים-ארגוניים.
🔹 הובלת בדיקות קבלה, הדרכות והטמעת תהליכים חדשים.
🔹 טיפול בתקלות, פתרון בעיות ושיפור מתמיד של המערכת.
מה חשוב להביא איתכם?
✔️ לפחות 3 שנות ניסיון בניהול מוצר או מערכות מידע טכנולוגיות.
✔️ ניסיון בכתיבת אפיונים עסקיים ובהובלת מוצר או מערכת מקצה לקצה.
✔️ ניסיון בניהול פרויקטים טכנולוגיים מול ספקים ובהטמעת מערכות.
✔️ יכולת אנליטית, ראייה מערכתית ויכולת להניע ממשקים ולעבוד מול צוותי פיתוח.
💡 ניסיון בעולמות הפיננסים והאשראי? היכרות עם מערכת תפנית? אלה בהחלט יתרונות משמעותיים!
אם אתם אוהבים לחבר בין צרכים עסקיים, טכנולוגיה ואנשים, להוביל תהליכים ולראות תוצאות בשטח- אשמח להכיר אתכם!

job.title: Chief Facility Electrical Engineer ׂ(Data Center) JB-5488
job.snippet:
A leading company in the Data Center industry is seeking a Chief Facility Engineer for a key engineering role responsible for the facility's critical infrastructure systems throughout their entire lifecycle – from construction, commissioning, and certification through ongoing operations, upgrades, and performance improvements.
The role combines professional engineering responsibility, hands-on involvement with facility systems, and leading initiatives to improve reliability, availability, and energy efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
Provide engineering support throughout the facility's construction, commissioning, and certification stages.
Participate in planning, implementing operational requirements, and supervising electrical and infrastructure works.
Participate in Commissioning and Integrated Systems Testing processes and system acceptance following FAT/SAT.
Take responsibility for the availability and proper operation of critical electrical systems, including MV, LV, UPS, and generators.
Analyze failures and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA), implement lessons learned, and lead improvement actions.
Oversee preventive and planned maintenance activities and manage engineering changes (MOC).
Identify operational and engineering risks and lead optimization and performance improvement initiatives.
Analyze operational data, loads, trends, and failures to improve facility reliability and efficiency.
Lead expansion, upgrade, and Retrofit projects and integrate new systems into an operational facility.
Work closely with and manage interfaces with contractors, suppliers, and operations and maintenance teams.
Develop engineering standards and procedures, maintain documentation, update As-Built drawings, and train operations teams.
Collaborate with electrical and HVAC teams to coordinate IT, electrical, and cooling loads and improve energy efficiency (PUE).
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering – mandatory.
At least 4 years of relevant professional experience.
Experience working with critical infrastructure systems.
Knowledge and understanding of electrical systems, including MV, LV, UPS, and generators.
System-level understanding of electrical and cooling systems and their interdependencies.
Experience in failure analysis and performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Experience supporting maintenance, modifications, and upgrades of engineering systems.
Ability to analyze operational data, loads, and trends.
Strong systems-level perspective and ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
Ability to collaborate with and lead coordination among operations teams, contractors, and suppliers.
Advantages
- Experience with Commissioning, FAT/SAT, and Integrated Systems Testing processes.

מחפשים איש/אשת מקצוע עם ניסיון ב-Dynamics 365 CRM, להובלת תהליכי הדרכה, הטמעה ותמיכה במערכת, בסביבות Cloud ו-On-Premises, בדגש על מודול Marketing.
מה כולל התפקיד?
• הדרכה והטמעה פרונטלית של מערכת Dynamics 365 CRM למשתמשים עסקיים.
• מתן תמיכה שוטפת למשתמשים וטיפול בתקלות ובעיות תפעוליות.
• תחקור תקלות, שחזורן, ביצוע בדיקות וניתוח ראשוני של מקור הבעיה.
• עבודה מול צוותי המערכת (קו שני) עד לפתרון התקלות.
• ליווי משתמשים והעברת ידע למשתמשים ברמות טכנולוגיות שונות.
• עבודה מול ממשקים עסקיים וטכנולוגיים בארגון.
דרישות התפקיד:
• לפחות 5 שנות ניסיון בתחום.
• ניסיון בעבודה עם Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.
• היכרות וניסיון עם מודול Marketing של Dynamics 365.
• ניסיון מעשי בהדרכה ובהטמעת מערכות.
• ניסיון בתמיכה במשתמשים עסקיים ובטיפול בתקלות.
• יכולת תחקור תקלות, שחזורן וביצוע בדיקות.
• יכולת הדרכה, שירותיות גבוהה ויחסי אנוש מצוינים.
• נכונות להגעה פרונטלית לאתרי הארגון לצורך הדרכות והטמעות.

• ניסיון בתהליכי שליחת Email/SMS.
• היכרות עם תהליכי בדיקות תוכנה.
• ניסיון בעבודה מול צוותי פיתוח.
• היכרות עם JIRA והתאמות במערכת Dynamics 365.

job.title: Campaign Operations Manager
job.snippet:
PaybackTime is an AI-based growth solution for mobile gaming, built to lead the market. Some of the biggest names in mobile gaming already grow with us. We run lean on purpose - a small team powered by AI agents we built ourselves - and we're looking for the next person to help us scale.
No gaming or coding experience needed
- we teach the business. We care more about how you think than what you've done.
This is an entry-level role, built for someone at the start of their career - ideally a first job in tech. You take real responsibility within weeks and grow with the company.
What you'll do
Analyze campaign performance and turn the numbers into clear insights that drive our business growth
Be the day-to-day contact for our partners - the biggest names in the gaming industry and the top publishers in the rewarded space
Build new campaigns and optimize live ones - which traffic sources to scale, pause or fix
Start each day by reviewing what our AI agents flagged, and decide what needs action
Build your own tools and shortcuts on top of our AI infrastructure
Work in Claude Code every day alongside dozens of AI agents: run them, check them, make them better
Who we're looking for
Hungry to succeed - all in, eager to learn, grow and win
Owns it - takes responsibility without hesitation, executes and delivers
Loves numbers - and turns them into decisions
Passionate about AI - already uses tools like Claude, Codex or others every day
Learns fast and moves forward without waiting to be pushed
Organized - juggles several tasks at once and finishes what they start
Clear, confident English, written and spoken
A degree (or finishing one) in industrial engineering, economics, statistics, information systems, business or similar
Nice to have
An internship or project in marketing, e-commerce, ad-tech or gaming
Experience in a customer- or partner-facing role
What you'll get
Real responsibility and impact from your first weeks
Hands-on experience in performance marketing and mobile gaming, one of the most data-driven industries
An AI-first way of working that most companies are still only talking about
A role that grows with the company: more scope, more ownership, a bigger say in how we work
Fully remote, Sunday to Thursday, start immediately
How we hire
Apply - your CV, plus a few lines about one thing you've built or solved with AI
Five short written questions (30-40 minutes)
A practical take-home task (up to 3 hours, you set the deadline - AI tools encouraged)
Interview with Asaf, Head of AI Growth Operations (45 minutes)
Final interview with Roee, CEO (45 minutes)
Apply here on LinkedIn or send your CV to analytics@paybacktime.io
The role is open to all candidates.

job.title: Software Engineer, Systems
job.snippet:
Meta is seeking a Software Engineer to design, build, and scale the foundational systems infrastructure that powers products used by billions of people worldwide. In this role, you will work across the systems stack — spanning distributed systems, storage, networking, runtime environments, and platform services — to deliver reliable, high-performance infrastructure that enables product teams to move quickly and safely at scale. You will own technical design and execution across complex, cross-cutting systems projects, partnering closely with engineers across the organization to drive engineering excellence and long-term platform health.
Software Engineer, Systems Responsibilities:
Design and implement scalable, reliable systems infrastructure components spanning distributed computing, storage, networking, or runtime environments
Own end-to-end technical design for systems-level projects, evaluating architectural trade-offs and driving decisions that balance performance, reliability, and maintainability
Instrument systems with telemetry, dashboards, and alerting to establish visibility into performance bottlenecks, reliability regressions, and failure modes
Lead incident response and root cause analysis for production systems issues, authoring retrospectives and driving follow-up improvements to prevent recurrence
Define and enforce service level objectives for owned systems, building debugging runbooks and mitigation playbooks to reduce mean time to resolution
Collaborate with cross-functional partners across product engineering, infrastructure, and security to ensure systems designs meet privacy, security, and integrity requirements
Drive engineering efficiency by identifying development bottlenecks, building internal tooling and automation, and completing migrations that eliminate legacy technical debt
Mentor other engineers on systems design principles, coding standards, and operational best practices, and contribute to recruiting and technical program efforts
Analyze performance profiles using instrumentation and profiling tools to identify hotspots and drive targeted optimizations across the systems stack
Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and project status clearly to stakeholders across engineering levels and cross-functional roles
Minimum Qualifications:
6+ years of experience in systems software engineering, including work on distributed systems, storage systems, networking infrastructure, or operating system-level components
Experience designing and implementing large-scale, production systems with well-defined reliability, performance, and operational requirements
Experience debugging complex, non-reproducible systems issues using advanced tooling such as profilers, static analyzers, tracing frameworks, or custom instrumentation
Experience establishing observability for production systems through metrics, dashboards, alerting, and service level objectives
Experience driving cross-team technical projects from design through production, including dependency coordination, staged rollout planning, and post-launch monitoring
Preferred Qualifications:
Familiarity with resiliency testing methodologies such as overload testing, chaos engineering, or fault injection for distributed systems
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
Experience with systems programming languages such as C, C++, Rust, or Go in a production environment
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
Experience contributing to platform or infrastructure projects that are consumed by multiple product or engineering teams
Track record of improving developer productivity through tooling, automation, or codebase modernization efforts at an organizational scale
Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
About Meta:
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about  benefits  at Meta.
