job.title: Lead software engineer  / Hands-on Software Architect (Stealth ConTech Startup)
job.snippet:
About the Role:
An early-stage ConTech startup (operating in stealth mode) is looking for a Lead Developer / Hands-on Software Architect to lead our core engine development, spatial algorithms, and overall system architecture.
We are solving a major, high-impact engineering challenge in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry—sitting at the intersection of 3D spatial algorithms, computational optimization, and real-time distributed systems.
Founded by an experienced industry engineer, the startup already has an initial client-facing prototype in place. We are now looking for an experienced technical leader with strong architectural vision and deep algorithmic chops to take ownership of the core system, lead the technology roadmap, and mentor/guide our existing development team in a hands-on capacity.
Key Responsibilities:
- Architectural Leadership: Design a scalable, lightweight system combining a spatial algorithm engine, constraint-handling rules, and seamless integration between cloud services and engineering CAD/BIM environments.
- Core Algorithmic Development (Hands-on): Personally architect and develop the core logic for 3D pathfinding, spatial collision detection, and multi-variable optimization.
- Team Guidance & Code Quality: Define technical milestones, break down architectural challenges into actionable tasks, conduct code reviews, and guide our existing developer (who focuses on client integrations and BIM APIs).
- Advanced Technology Integration: Evaluate and incorporate AI/Generative Design methodologies alongside deterministic, rule-based engineering engines.
Requirements:
- Proven Architectural Track Record (5+ years): Substantial experience designing complex software architectures, with a deep understanding of performance optimization, multi-threading, and real-time event-driven communication (WebSockets, pub/sub).
- Spatial & Algorithmic Foundations: Strong practical experience in computational geometry, 3D spatial algorithms, graph search/pathfinding (A*, Dijkstra), or game/physics engine mechanics.
- Hands-on Mastery in at least one of the following domains:
- C# / .NET: Solid experience in high-performance desktop or service backends (experience with Revit API or engineering CAD plugins is a major advantage).
- 3D Graphics / Spatial Computing: Hands-on work with Three.js, WebGL, WebGPU, or processing open engineering formats (e.g., IFC).
- C++ / Mathematical Python: Experience developing simulation, geometry, or optimization engines.
- Technical Mentorship: Prior experience as a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or Software Architect—able to mentor junior/mid-level engineers and turn complex concepts into clear execution steps.
- Startup Mindset: Highly autonomous, comfortable navigating ambiguity, proactive problem-solver, and excited by zero-to-one challenges.
What We Offer:
- A core leadership position with complete influence over our tech stack and technology direction.
- A flexible compensation model including significant equity/options.
- The opportunity to tackle a massive, tangible problem in a multi-billion-dollar global industry eager for disruption.
📩 To apply or learn more (confidentially):
Please send your CV / LinkedIn profile / GitHub link to:
office@maof-pm.co.il
(Full details on the product, roadmap, and vision will be shared during the interview process under an NDA).

job.title: Principal Engineer
job.snippet:
About Brandlight
Brandlight is the leading enterprise AI visibility platform, built to help the world’s leading brands understand, manage, and optimize how they appear across AI-driven search, commerce, and advertising.
As AI rapidly becomes a trillion-dollar marketing and distribution channel, Brandlight is defining the systems that decide how brands are surfaced, trusted, and chosen.
Join our team and help build the next generation of tools shaping the future of brand management in an AI-first world.
About The Role
We’re looking for a Principal Engineer who combines strong product instincts, deep engineering skills, and the ability to move fast without compromising on execution quality.
You’ll be a primary technical driver, taking significant product modules from concept through design, architecture, implementation, and production. You won’t just implement finished specifications, you’ll partner with product and design to shape the solution, make technical decisions, and own delivery end to end.
Your work will turn complex, large-scale data into fast, intuitive products for Fortune 500 marketing teams. You’ll build across the data and application stack - from data ingestion and ETL pipelines to scalable backend services and the APIs that power our product experience. This role combines strong backend development with hands-on data engineering, owning how data is collected, transformed, stored, and served to make exploring datasets with billions of records feel effortless. Whether your strength is backend or full-stack, you’ll have room to contribute across the product.
This is a hands-on role for someone who has driven meaningful product development in a fast-growing startup and is comfortable taking ownership before every requirement has been defined.
Responsibilities
Own complete product modules from concept to production.
Build and own production data pipelines.
Design scalable data models and APIs.
Build fast, reliable services that power data-intensive product experiences.
Drive performance across the system, from data layer to user experience.
Ensure data quality and reliability.
Create reusable product foundations.
Own production reliability and safe delivery.
Lead through hands-on execution.
Requirements
5+ years of experience as a backend or full-stack engineer, building and shipping data-intensive production web applications, with strong hands-on backend development skills.
A proven track record as a primary technical driver at a fast-growing startup.
Strong backend engineering skills, including API design, service architecture, caching, asynchronous processing, and integrating external systems.
Hands-on data engineering experience, including building, deploying, and maintaining production ETL/ELT pipelines.
Strong SQL and data modeling skills, with experience preparing and serving large datasets for analytical workloads.
Demonstrated ability to diagnose and improve performance across the system.
Experience deploying and operating applications and data pipelines in a cloud environment, including CI/CD, automated testing, containerization, logging, monitoring, and production debugging.
Strong product judgment, clear communication, and proactive ownership.
Nice to Have
Frontend experience building polished, data-intensive interfaces and visualizations.
Why join us
At Brandlight, you’ll build and shape a new category at the intersection of AI, marketing, and commerce.
We’re a fast-growing startup led by repeat entrepreneurs, world-class engineers, and marketing leaders, all driven to reinvent how brands are built, discovered, and chosen in the age of AI.

job.title: Lab Technician Student, Annapurna Labs
job.snippet:
Description
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) roles engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.
Join Annapurna Labs and take major part redefining the future of AWS cloud. We’re searching for a Lab Technion Student who will be responsible for the installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of our Linux-based server infrastructure, as well as managing various network services and components.
Student will have at least 4 semesters remaining in their degree. The ideal candidate will posses a strong passion for learning new things and the ability to quickly put that new knowledge and skills into practice. You will have the ability to perform basic troubleshooting for hardware, software, and networking issues without guidance.
Are you ready to join the future?
To learn more about Annapurna you're welcome to watch the following videos from the recent re:Invent conference:
AWS re:Invent 2024 - Dive deep into the AWS Nitro System
AWS re:Invent 2024 - Monday Night Live with Peter DeSantis
AWS re:Invent 2024 - CEO Keynote with Matt Garman
*To apply please submit your CV with your grades sheet combined into 1 PDF*
A day in the life
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Early Career Talent
When you join Amazon Web Services as a student or recent graduate, you’ll have the chance for your voice to be heard and amplified. That’s because our teams are looking to learn as much from you as you’ll learn from them. Whether you’re graduating with a high school or equivalent diploma, associate degree, bachelor’s degree, MBA, or PhD, we offer a range of early career opportunities across the globe.
Basic Qualifications
Must be a student for technical degree (CS, EE, etc) with at least 4 semesters remaining and available for 3 work days per week. Ability to support needs in both Haifa and Tel Aviv
Familiarity with protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, TFTP, HTTP, SSH; additional familiarity with PC and servers HW
Capable of independently lifting and handling servers when required.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
Prior experience with Network and Linux systems (CentOS, Red Hat, Ubuntu) for 1-3 years is an advantage.
Experience with PXE is a Plus
Knowledge in Virtual systems such as Proxmox, VMware is a Plus Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: Product Manager
job.snippet:
An innovative Israeli-American Digital Health and Surgical AI startup pioneering intelligent intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring platforms for complex surgical interventions.
Collaborating strategically with tier-one global MedTech corporations, the company develops AI-driven clinical decision-support software designed to safeguard critical neurological pathways and elevate patient outcomes in real time within operating rooms.
Operating with a high-caliber multidisciplinary team across Israel and the US, the enterprise bridges sophisticated Machine Learning, clinical neuroscience, and strict medical device compliance.
The culture offers exceptional entrepreneurial autonomy, direct ownership over transformative life-saving technologies, and close engagement with international clinical partners.
Located in the Misgav / Karmiel area, operating on a hybrid model with two days working from home.
Role Description
Serving as the Solo Product Lead / Senior Product Manager, acting as the sole product function in the company with full end-to-end ownership over product vision, strategy, and roadmap execution.
Translating complex clinical workflows, surgical requirements, and feedback from neurosurgeons and clinical partners into actionable product specifications and user stories.
Spearheading the end-to-end product lifecycle for medical AI and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) solutions within a heavily regulated healthcare environment.
Collaborating cross-functionally across Core R&D, Data Science, QA/RA (Regulatory & Quality), Clinical Affairs, and executive leadership, as well as global strategic MedTech partners.
Driving user experience and design processes (UX/UI), creating intuitive interfaces tailored for time-critical, high-stress surgical room environments.
Leading sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and iterative product delivery adhering to Agile/Scrum methodologies and regulated Design Controls frameworks.
Requirements-
Significant, proven professional experience in Product Management or leading technical product lifecycles for Medical Devices or Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) – Mandatory
Deep, practical understanding of regulated product development processes adhering to ISO 13485 and FDA Design Controls (21 CFR 820.30) – Mandatory
Proven track record defining products end-to-end across the entire lifecycle (concept, clinical definition, V&V, deployment, and post-market) – Mandatory
Demonstrated experience working closely with strategic commercial partners, clinical stakeholders, or B2B healthcare enterprises – Mandatory
Proven background managing UX/UI design processes and backlog prioritization in Agile/Scrum development environments – Mandatory
Ability to operate autonomously as a sole product leader in a dynamic, high-velocity startup setting – Mandatory
Full-time commitment to working in a hybrid model (3 days on-site in the Northern District / Karmiel area, 2 days remote) – Mandatory
Fluent, professional technical and clinical communication capabilities in English (written and verbal) – Mandatory

job.title: Tech Lead - Penetration Testing, Red Team, Cloud, and ICS/OT
job.snippet:
We are seeking an experienced Tech Lead to manage the Domain Experts covering penetration testing, red teaming, cloud security, and ICS/OT (SCADA) security. This role is dedicated to the quality of intent analysis for cybersecurity prompts that an AI system could not confidently classify as benign or malicious, across the domains of the team.
You need to be a hands-on expert in your own field, with enough working knowledge of penetration testing, red teaming, and cloud security to judge prompts and guidelines that cross into the other team's domains. You also need to be independent, organized, and able to lead technical experts.
What you'll do:
Lead and manage the Domain Experts of the team (Enterprise Red Teaming, Web Application Security, Cloud Redteaming, ICS/OT (SCADA): priorities, workload, and performance
Route incoming rows to the team's domains and rebalance freelancer capacity inside the team as row volume shifts
Track team quality (agreement and disagreement rates, QA findings) and throughput, and report to the Group Manager
Resolve escalated edge cases and prompts that span several domains, and work with the other Tech Lead when a prompt crosses into their field
Keep the annotation guidelines consistent across the team's domains and propose updates
Annotate or review directly when needed to unblock the team
Requirements:
Minimum of 7 years of proven, hands-on experience in penetration testing, red teaming, cloud security, or ICS/OT (SCADA) security, with deep expertise in at least one of them
Working knowledge across all domains of the team, including ICS/OT protocols (Modbus, DNP3, S7comm, OPC UA) and PLC and SCADA architectures, enough to assess and coach the Domain Experts in each
Solid working knowledge of the other team's fields: penetration testing, red teaming, and cloud security, including common attack paths, tooling, and how their techniques appear in real intrusions
At least 2 years of experience leading or mentoring technical specialists (team lead, tech lead, or senior reviewer)
Experience with quality processes such as QA sampling, calibration sessions, and quality metrics
Strong analytical judgment: able to infer a user's underlying goal from a short prompt and separate defensive, educational, and research use from attack preparation
Clear written and verbal communication in English
Nice to have:
OSEP, GCPN, GIAC GICSP
Demonstrated online achievements, write-ups, or contributions on platforms such as HackTheBox, Pwn2Own, TryHackMe, Bug Bounty programs, or published security research.
Alice is a trust, safety, and security company built for the AI era. We safeguard the communicative technologies people use to create, collaborate, and interact- whether with each other or with machines.
In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice provides end-to-end coverage across the entire AI lifecycle. We support frontier model labs, enterprises, and UGC platforms with a comprehensive suite of solutions: from model hardening evaluations and pre-deployment red-teaming to runtime guardrails and ongoing drift detection.
Alice is widely considered a global leader in online safety and AI security. We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate minds in the world working to safeguard over 3 billion users across the largest AI and tech platforms.
If you're creative and driven to secure the future of AI, we want to hear from you!

job.title: Integration & Test Engineer – Part-Time JB-5623
job.snippet:
A marine startup focused on underwater applications – autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and advanced underwater sensing – with a successful early-stage funding round, is seeking an Integration & Test Engineer.
The role: Assembly, integration and testing of autonomous systems, from the lab bench to sea trials. A hands-on position at the intersection of hardware, software and communications, working closely with the mechanical, electrical and software teams.
Responsibilities:
Assembly and integration of hardware and software subsystems in autonomous systems
Performing tests in the lab and in the field, including sea trials
Identifying and repairing faults in hardware, software and communication interfaces
Writing test procedures and documenting results
Ongoing work with the mechanical, electrical and software development teams
Practical electronics technician, or a student of mechanical or electrical engineering (third year or above) – required
Linux knowledge and familiarity with Ethernet and RS-485/RS-232 (IP addresses, baud rates, etc.) – required
Experience working with measurement equipment (oscilloscope, multimeter) and the ability to read electrical schematics, wiring diagrams and ICDs – required
Practical skills: soldering, crimping, cable and wiring harness construction, and basic mechanical assembly – required
Proven experience or strong interest in robotics and autonomous systems, and a systematic approach to troubleshooting – required
Availability for field work and sea trials – required
Good technical English (datasheets and documentation) – required
Ability to work independently and under pressure in a multidisciplinary team – required
Advantages:
ROS
Marine systems
RF systems
IMU and GPS
CAN and Modbus buses
Git
Power systems (batteries, power supplies, DC-DC, grounding and EMI)
Writing acceptance test procedures (ATP) and test reports

job.title: Junior Infrastructure Software Engineer
job.snippet:
Back
Junior Infrastructure Software Engineer
Department: Operations
Location: Tel Aviv
Workplace Type: Hybrid
Employment: Fulltime
About Raft
Raft Technologies is revolutionizing global connectivity by harnessing radio frequency cutting-edge Skywave technology to create the world’s fastest low-latency wireless network, pushing the boundaries of communication speed to approach the ultimate limit of light itself. Raft operates ultrafast data links connecting key destinations across continents, with a focus on transatlantic routes, linking major financial hubs worldwide.
About The Position
RAFT is looking for a Junior Infrastructure Software Engineer to join our engineering team and help develop, maintain and improve the software systems that support our production environment, customer operations and internal teams.
This position offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience with backend development, production systems, automation, monitoring and infrastructure engineering. The ideal candidate is curious, eager to learn and excited to work on real-world systems that directly impact customers and operations.
As part of the role, responsibilities and ownership will grow over time alongside professional development and experience.
Key Responsibilities
Software & Infrastructure Development
Develop and maintain internal tools and services supporting production operations.
Assist in maintaining production databases and backend services.
Contribute to the development of monitoring, reporting and operational management tools.
Participate in maintaining and improving existing production software systems.
Monitoring & Operations
Support monitoring, alerting and log analysis systems.
Help investigate production issues and participate in troubleshooting activities.
Contribute to improving system observability and reliability.
Assist in implementing automated detection and resolution mechanisms.
Automation & Engineering Tools
Develop automation solutions that reduce manual operational tasks.
Participate in creating internal APIs and services for engineering and operational teams.
Assist in designing scalable tools supporting production growth.
Learn and apply best practices in software engineering and infrastructure management.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with R&D, NOC, Support and QA teams.
Support production releases and operational projects.
Collaborate with senior engineers on infrastructure and automation initiatives.
Gradually take ownership of systems and services as experience grows.
Responsibilities
Must Have
2-3 years of experience in software development, infrastructure engineering, DevOps or a similar technical role.
Knowledge of at least one programming language (Python preferred).
Familiarity with Linux environments.
Basic understanding of networking concepts and TCP/IP.
Familiarity with SQL and relational databases.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Ability and motivation to learn new technologies quickly.
Nice to Have
Experience with Docker or containerized environments.
Familiarity with monitoring and observability platforms.
Experience developing REST APIs.
Knowledge of CI/CD concepts.
Exposure to cloud or production environments.
Understanding of automation and scripting principles.

job.snippet:
‫קומנט מגייסת מנהל/ת מערכות (System Administrator) למשרה מלאה!‬
‫קומנט היא חברת שירותי IT מנוהלים (MSP) שפועלת מאז 2006 ומעניקה לעסקים פתרון מחשוב מלא – תמיכה, שרתים, Microsoft 365, אבטחת מידע, גיבויים וענן.‬
‫תיאור התפקיד:‬
‫• ניהול ותחזוקה של תשתיות IT בסביבות לקוחות מגוונות – מעסקים קטנים ועד ארגונים בינוניים‬
‫• הקמה ותחזוקה של שרתי Windows וסביבות וירטואליזציה Hyper-V‬
‫• ניהול Microsoft 365 – משתמשים, הרשאות, Exchange Online, SharePoint ו-Entra ID‬
‫• אבטחת מידע – EDR, MFA, ניהול הרשאות, GPO וחומות אש‬
‫• ניהול גיבויים ושחזור, כולל בקרה שוטפת על הצלחת הגיבויים‬
‫• פתרון תקלות רשת ותקשורת מול לקוחות וספקים‬
‫• טיפול בתקלות מורכבות ותמיכה בדרג 2–3‬
‫דרישות חובה:‬
‫• ניסיון מוכח כמנהל/ת מערכות‬
‫• Windows Server, Active Directory, GPO, DNS, DHCP‬
‫• וירטואליזציה – Hyper-V‬
‫• Microsoft 365, Exchange Online ו-Entra ID‬
‫• רשתות – LAN/WAN, VPN וחומות אש‬

‫• ניסיון ב-MSP או בעבודה מול מספר לקוחות במקביל‬
‫• Intune ו-Google Workspace‬

‫• SentinelOne / Microsoft Defender‬
‫• כתיבת סקריפטים ב-PowerShell‬
‫• הסמכות מקצועיות (CCNA, Microsoft)‬

job.snippet:
לחברה ביטחונית ביהוד דרוש/ה מתאם/ת לוגיסטי/ת שירות לקוח
תיאור המשרה
אחריות על ביצוע ותיאום כלל התהליכים הלוגיסטיים התומכים בשירות הלקוח, תוך עבודה שוטפת עם מערכות מידע ארגוניות, ניהול תהליכי RMA יבוא ויצוא, ומעקב אחר תנועת פריטים ומשלוחים. התפקיד כולל עבודה מול מנהלי תמיכת לקוח וממשקים פנים-ארגוניים, לצד הפקת דוחות, ניתוח נתונים ובקרה על הפעילות הלוגיסטית, במטרה להבטיח שירות איכותי, עמידה בלוחות זמנים ושיפור מתמיד של התהליכים.
תחומי אחריות
ביצוע וניהול תהליכי RMA במערכות SAP, CRM ופורטל שירות הלקוח.
פתיחת הודעות שירות, קליטת ציוד, זיהוי פריטים, צילום וקליטה במערכות.
השתתפות בתהליכי קבלת ציוד וניהול רשומות ודוחות מעקב.
ביצוע ותיאום תהליכי יצוא, לרבות פתיחת אספקות, הכנת משלוחים, תיאום אריזות, מסמכים נלווים ואישורים.
טיפול ומעקב אחר תהליכי יבוא, קידום הגעת חלקים מחו"ל ומעקב עד להשלמת התהליך.
הזמנת שינוע והובלות, לרבות העברות בקמפוס ומשלוחים פנים-ארציים.
עבודה שוטפת מול מנהלי תמיכת לקוח, מחסנים, שילוח, כספים וממשקים פנים-ארגוניים.
הפקת דוחות, ניתוח נתונים ובקרה באמצעות Excel ומערכות מידע.
קידום תהליכים לוגיסטיים ומתן מענה מקצועי לצורכי הלקוח.
דרישות התפקיד
ניסיון של לפחות שנתיים בתחום הלוגיסטיקה, שירות הלקוח או שרשרת האספקה.
ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות מידע ארגוניות.
ניסיון בעבודה במערכת SAP לרבות פתיחת הודעות שירות, קליטת וניפוק חלפים.
שליטה גבוהה ב Excel לרבות הפקת דוחות וניתוח נתונים.
יכולת עבודה מול ממשקים מרובים, סדר וארגון, חשיבה תהליכית ויכולת ניתוח נתונים.
יוזמה, שירותיות ויכולת עבודה בצוות.
נכונות לעבודה בשעות נוספות, בהתאם לצורכי התפקיד.
אנגלית ברמה טובה - קריאה, כתיבה ודיבור.
הכרת תהליכי RMA יבוא ויצוא - יתרון.
היכרות עם תהליכי שינוע בינלאומי - יתרון.

job.title: Import Coordinator
job.snippet:
Company Description
Gama Import Packaging was founded to provide high-quality import services with a strong focus on product excellence and competitive pricing. The company delivers packaging solutions for a wide range of industries in Israel and worldwide, working closely with many of Israel’s key trading partners. Gama supports customers throughout the entire import and packaging process, ensuring a thorough and reliable response to their needs. With extensive experience and a broad network of global suppliers, the company offers professional, personalized service backed by deep expertise in packaging. This environment provides team members with exposure to international trade, diverse industries, and long-term customer relationships.
Role Description
The Import Coordinator is a full-time, hybrid role based in Kfar Yehoshua, with the possibility to perform some duties from home. In this position, the coordinator manages the end-to-end import process, including preparing and reviewing documentation, coordinating with suppliers, freight forwarders, and customs brokers, and monitoring shipments by ocean and other modes. Day-to-day tasks include tracking delivery timelines, resolving shipment issues, updating internal systems, and communicating status to customers and internal stakeholders. The role also involves ensuring compliance with relevant regulations, supporting pricing and cost analyses, and collaborating with the packaging and logistics teams to meet service and quality standards. The Import Coordinator is expected to maintain clear communication, provide responsive customer service, and contribute to continuous improvement of import workflows.
Qualifications
Knowledge of import operations and processes, including experience with Import and Ocean shipment coordination.
Familiarity with Customs Brokerage procedures, documentation requirements, and regulatory compliance.
Strong Communication and Customer Service skills, with the ability to manage internal and external stakeholders professionally.
Attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines simultaneously.
Proficiency with office software and ERP or logistics systems; ability to maintain accurate records and reports.
Experience in international trade, logistics, or packaging sectors is an advantage.
Relevant vocational training or academic background in logistics, supply chain, business, or a related field preferred.
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a hybrid work environment, with strong problem-solving skills.

job.title: Logistics Coordinator
job.snippet:
Quantum Machines is a global leader in control systems for quantum computing, a field on the verge of exponential growth. Our innovative hardware and software mark a groundbreaking approach in quantum computer control, scaling from individual qubits to expansive arrays of thousands. At the core of QM lies a passionate and ambitious team committed to reshaping the construction and operation of quantum computers. Our work is fueled by a deep understanding of customer needs, driving us to deliver unparalleled solutions in this revolutionary field.
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Purchasing Specialist to join our Procurement team.
Hands-on responsibility for material flow across Israel operations, from receiving and inventory handling to order fulfillment and shipping. The role requires accurate ERP records, close cross-functional coordination, and flexibility in a fast-changing environment.
Key Responsibilities
Receive and verify purchased materials and finished goods; process transactions in Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O.
Manage internal material requests, picking, issuing, transfers, and local deliveries for R&D, Production and other teams.
Prepare and coordinate customer, loan and evaluation shipments, including packing, export documentation and carrier pickups.
Coordinate daily logistics with external warehouses, 3PL providers and carriers.
Maintain inventory and serial-number accuracy; support stock counts, discrepancy resolution, MRB, quarantine and scrap activities.
Requirements:
1–2 years of hands-on experience in logistics, warehouse operations or inventory management.
Knowledge of receiving, inventory and shipping processes; experience using ERP or inventory systems.
Good Excel / Microsoft Office skills and proficiency in Hebrew and English.
Organized, accurate and proactive, with strong ownership, service orientation and ability to manage changing priorities independently and across teams.
Advantages
Experience with Dynamics 365 F&O, manufacturing/electronics, external warehouses or 3PL providers, and international shipping documentation.

job.title: Senior Product Manager
job.snippet:
Techdin is Israel’s leading LegalTech company, transforming the legal sector through advanced artificial intelligence and deep legal expertise. The company delivers a comprehensive technology ecosystem that supports the entire legal lifecycle, from academic training and student development to complex litigation and law firm operations. Techdin’s platforms include AI-driven strategic legal research, next-generation legal education tools, and specialized practice management solutions tailored to the Israeli legal market. By bridging traditional legal practice with cutting-edge AI, Techdin equips legal professionals at all stages of their careers with powerful, data-driven tools.
We’re looking for a curious, hands-on Product Manager who knows how to take a complex customer or business need, ask the right questions, distill what really matters, and turn it into a clear product solution that can be built and delivered.
Someone who can look at a problem from different angles, explore and validate possible solutions, make informed trade-offs, and turn the chosen direction into a clear plan for execution.
What You’ll Do:
Own product initiatives from discovery through delivery.
Understand customer and business needs, challenge requirements and assumptions, and identify the real problem behind the request.
Explore and validate different solution approaches before deciding what and how to build.
Turn the chosen solution into clear features, user flows, business logic, requirements, and development-ready specifications.
Work closely with R&D and Data to assess feasibility and effort, refine scope, and make informed product and technical trade-offs.
Prioritize based on customer value, business impact, effort, and technical complexity.
Drive execution from planning through development and successful delivery.
Requirements:
5+ years of hands-on Product Management experience in complex technology products, preferably B2B SaaS.
Experience as a Product Manager in an AI-first/ AI-native product company.
Proven ability to take complex or ambiguous needs, structure them, evaluate possible solutions, and translate them into clear, executable product requirements.
Strong technical orientation and experience working closely with R&D and Data throughout the development process.
Strong product judgment and prioritization skills, including the ability to make decisions and trade-offs across customer, business, and technical considerations.
Independent and highly accountable, with a demonstrated ability to plan, execute, and deliver.
Experience in LegalTech or another complex, data-intensive domain- an advantage.

job.title: Field Infrastructure & Network Engineer
job.snippet:
Back
Field Infrastructure & Network Engineer
Department: Operations
Location: Tel Aviv
Workplace Type: Hybrid
Employment: Fulltime
About Raft
Raft Technologies is revolutionizing global connectivity by harnessing radio frequency cutting-edge Skywave technology to create the world’s fastest low-latency wireless network, pushing the boundaries of communication speed to approach the ultimate limit of light itself. Raft operates ultrafast data links connecting key destinations across continents, with a focus on transatlantic routes, linking major financial hubs worldwide.
About The Position
You will join our Field & Network Operations team and take a hybrid role that combines deep technical troubleshooting (Tier4) with hands-on work at our global sites.
You will work directly on Raft’s core communication infrastructure, ensuring our long-haul wireless network is stable, fast, and built to spec.
The role includes on-site work abroad for site deployments, maintenance and resolving issues that require advanced engineering skills and cannot be handled by local service providers.
Responsibilities
Tier4 Engineering
Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in RF, network and Linux-based systems.
Support the NOC with advanced configurations and analysis.
Work with R&D on escalated, system-level faults.
Field Work
Deploy and maintain communication sites worldwide.
Handle on-site issues beyond what local providers can resolve.
Build, activate and validate new sites and links.
Participate in on-call rotations.
Requirements
Minimum 5 years of experience in networking, field engineering or Tier3/4 support roles in communication or infrastructure environments.
Strong hands-on networking skills: configuration and troubleshooting of switches/routers, and solid understanding of DNS, DHCP, ARP, TCP/IP, VPN and NAT.
Proficient in Linux environments.
Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across hardware, RF components, software and network systems.
Familiarity with Python scripting.
Strong hardware background: antennas, RF equipment and basic electrical infrastructure (PDU, UPS).
Excellent problem-solving skills, communication and teamwork.
High level of English (written and spoken).
Willingness to travel up to 20%

job.title: Technical Project Manager
job.company: Sentrycs | Counter-Drone Solutions Adapting at the Speed of Threats
job.snippet:
Sentrycs’ mission is to enable a more drone-empowered future!
How?
With our integrated counter-drone solution, we support law enforcement agencies, prisons, critical infrastructures, airports, mass events, convoys, militarizes, and more, by providing them with 24/7 drone protection. With our fully autonomous, easily portable, and UTM-ready technology, detecting and mitigating unauthorized drones has never been more simple.
We work to keep society protected from unauthorized eyes in the skies so you can remain operational and ensure business continuity on the ground. Let’s build a drone-empowered future together!
Own the day-to-day execution of multiple R&D projects in a multidisciplinary environment. You will act as the primary bridge between Product and R&D, ensuring seamless synchronization across shared engineering teams and external 3rd-party partners.
Responsibilities:
Multi-Disciplinary Sync - Manage dependencies and timelines across HW, SW, and System workstreams to ensure cohesive delivery
Execution Management - Translate high-level roadmaps into detailed project plans, tracking milestones, risks, interfaces, resources loads and critical paths
Technical Oversight - Facilitate projects execution practices - from Discovery to Done, using metrics and data to monitor timelines, bottlenecks and workloads
Risk & Data Tracking - Proactively identify and reflect delivery risks early through execution metrics and KPI's
External Integration - Lead technical and operational coordination with 3rd party partners for strategic projects
Execution Forums: Run focused stand-ups, technical reviews, readiness checks, status meetings to keep the system moving
Requirements:
Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics or a related technical field
Experience: 5+ years of PM experience in R&D in multidisciplinary R&D environments - Defense or RF systems - advantage
Technical Fluency: Ability to engage in technical discussions with engineers and evaluate effort estimations and complexity
Cross-functional Skills - proven experience managing shared resources and external stakeholders in a matrix environment
Methodology: Practical experience with both Agile and Waterfall methodologies
Data-driven: Ability to master schedules, KPIs, dashboards, and data-driven execution tracking via Jira, Monday.com, MS Project, or equivalent tools

job.title: Senior Product Manager
job.snippet:
About Us
We're building a new B2C AI browser that will soon be in the hands of millions. Radically simple, delightfully fast, and enhanced by powerful AI features. Our mission is to simplify and improve daily online activities.
We've shipped a beta, and the user base keeps growing daily. The surface area ahead is wide: AI features, system-level interactions, and cross-platform experiences on desktop and mobile.
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to help define the next chapter of the browser. You’ll work closely with design, data, and engineering to explore new ideas, shape product strategy, and ship features that make everyday browsing feel simpler and smarter.
You’ll guide projects from concept to launch: clarifying problems, framing opportunities, running tests, tightening scope, aligning stakeholders, and keeping a steady, thoughtful pace.
The surface area is wide - AI features, system-level interactions, and cross-platform experiences, so you’ll have room to think big and execute with precision.
What You’ll Do
Own end-to-end product development across discovery, definition, execution, and iteration.
Translate broad opportunities into product briefs, sharply defined problems, and clear roadmaps.
Drive alignment across teams with clear communication and crisp documentation.
Monitor performance and user feedback to refine features post-launch.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to define how to make AI natural, unobtrusive, and genuinely helpful.
Requirements
5+ years of product management experience with consumer or large-scale complex digital products.
A track record of shipping thoughtful, user-centered features end-to-end and iterating based on concrete data.
Strong product sense: ability to simplify complexity, see around corners, and sweat details.
Experience working closely with design, data, and engineering around ambiguous problems and emerging technologies.
Clear, concise communication — written and verbal.
Ability to balance speed, quality, and scope without losing sight of the user experience.
Nice to Have
Experience scaling products from concept to mass market.
Experience with AI products, ML-powered features, or high-frequency tools.
Background in user research, prototyping, or technical exploration.

job.title: Research & Development Specialist
job.snippet:
Our client, a dynamic Amazon FBA business with a global presence, is looking for a middle-level
Research & Development Specialist
to support the R&D Team Lead. The specialist will be involved in work across all company brands, coordinating with suppliers, the Supply Chain team, Brand managers, and the Design team.
This role is ideal for someone with experience in product development, procurement, or Amazon e-commerce who can independently manage day-to-day execution while escalating strategic or non-standard decisions when needed.
About the company:
The company is specialised on developing and upscaling Amazon-based brands across the USA, Canada, Europe, and the UK. With deep expertise in eCommerce and Amazon FBA, the company excels in buying, developing, and scaling brands to their fullest potential. The company navigates the complexities of international markets and high-performance marketing, ensuring seamless scalability and growth.
The company's portfolio includes several Amazon brands, primarily in the home and kitchen category, as well as some electronics. Its international team of 17 world-class talents manages all operations today.
Responsibilities
Conduct market and competitor research for new product opportunities
Analyze demand, trends, sales volume, and competitor products
Communicate with suppliers regarding product specifications, pricing, and development
Prepare RFQs, compare quotations, and calculate product costs
Order and evaluate product samples
Coordinate product development projects across internal teams
Support packaging, certification, and compliance activities
Maintain project documentation and provide regular status updates
Requirements
2+ years of experience in e-commerce R&D / product development
Experience with Amazon research tools (Keepa, Helium 10, DataDive, etc.)
Strong understanding of Amazon FBA and Seller Central
Experience working with overseas manufacturers, samples, RFQs, and specification documents
Experience with product compliance and certifications, or a strong interest and willingness to learn Amazon compliance requirements
English - Upper-Intermediate or higher
Proficient in Excel and Google Sheets
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent organization and attention to detail
Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new processes
Strong communication and collaboration skills
Ability to manage multiple projects in a remote environment
Nice to have
Amazon compliance knowledge
Experience with supplements or regulated products
Experience working with Chinese manufacturers
Reports to R&D Lead
What We Offer:
A dynamic and supportive work environment with a team of dedicated professionals.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
Competitive and timely salary.
Full-time remote job (flexible hours).

job.title: Co-Founder & Chief Product Officer
job.snippet:
Carliba
is an advertising technology firm dedicated to empowering digital publishers with consultancy services aimed at optimizing their ad revenues.
Position Overview
We are looking for an exceptional individual with an entrepreneurial mindset to join us as a Co-Founder & Chief Product Officer. Join us if you would like to:
Join a winning team - Partner with two ad tech veterans with over 20 years of experience
Join a winning culture - Work in a fun, pro-active, and inclusive environment Join a winning enterprise - Well funded, profitable start-up with an existing revenue stream of over $1M in ARR
Join a winning opportunity - be a real driving force within a company, and define its product vision and GTM strategy.
Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with fellow co-founders to articulate and refine the company's vision, mission, and strategic direction.
Lead the formulation and execution of the company's product plan, encompassing market analysis, product development, and go-to-market strategy.
Determine and prioritize product features and enhancements through thorough market research, customer feedback, and competitive analysis.
Champion a customer-centric ethos throughout the product development lifecycle, ensuring that our offerings consistently meet and exceed the needs of our target audience.
Spearhead the assembly and management of a top-tier team, overseeing recruitment, hiring, and ongoing employee development initiatives.
Foster strategic alliances and partnerships to fuel the company's expansion and elevate its market presence.
Requirements
A deeply ingrained entrepreneurial spirit coupled with a fervent ambition to shepherd a startup from its inception to unprecedented heights.
A proven track record of leadership excellence, preferably in the context of a startup or high-growth environment.
Demonstrated expertise in ad-tech, with a comprehensive understanding of industry dynamics and emerging trends.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with an innate ability to inspire and motivate others.
A history of crafting and executing product strategies that drive revenue growth and catalyze market expansion.
Benefits
Equity ownership in the company, affording you a stake in our collective success.
The opportunity to shape the trajectory of a rapidly burgeoning startup, with unparalleled potential for personal and professional growth.
Flexible work arrangements, including the option for remote work, to accommodate your individual preferences and obligations.
A collaborative and inclusive work environment, where your contributions are valued and your voice is heard.
‍

job.title: Production Technician - Mechanical & Electronic Assembly
job.snippet:
CropX, a globally recognized AgTech company, is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Production Technician to join its Production team in Netanya, Israel.
CropX is an innovative ag-analytics company enabling significant savings in resources and improved yields. The company offers a user-friendly, cloud-based solution combining advanced hardware and software technologies to help farmers optimize irrigation, improve nutrient management, and enhance crop yields.
We are looking for a hands-on team player to perform mechanical and electronic assembly of products and components, ensuring high quality, precision, and compliance with production guidelines and timelines.

Perform mechanical and electronic assembly of products and components according to work instructions and quality standards
Conduct product testing and quality checks to ensure proper functionality
Use manual and power tools for assembly and production tasks
Identify and troubleshoot issues during assembly and testing processes
Maintain accuracy, organization, and attention to detail throughout the production process
Work both independently and as part of the Production team
Meet production targets and deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards
Requirements
Previous experience in manual assembly of products or electronic devices - Must
Experience working with manual and power tools - Must
Ability to read and understand assembly instructions - Advantage
Experience in testing electronic devices - Advantage
Soldering experience - Advantage
Previous experience in an electronic manufacturing environment - Advantage
Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
Fast learner with a hands-on approach and strong problem-solving skills
Ability to identify and resolve issues during assembly and testing
Patience and ability to perform delicate and precise assembly tasks
Ability to meet deadlines and complete assigned tasks efficiently

job.title: Junior Embedded Software & Integration Engineer
job.snippet:
Mentee Robotics, now part of Mobileye, brings world-class robotics expertise, together with Mobileye's decades of leadership in computer vision, machine learning, and autonomous driving technologies. Building on that foundation, Mentee by Mobileye is creating the "MenteeBot", the AI-first humanoid robot that combines perception, reasoning, learning, and advanced dexterous manipulation, designed to work alongside people in their everyday lives, at the workplace and in the home.
At Mobileye, our technologies power more than 230 million vehicles worldwide and have helped shape the future of autonomous mobility. With teams around the world, we continue to innovate at the forefront of autonomous systems, advancing the next generation of Physical AI for real life.
Your Role
We’re looking for a resourceful junior engineer to join our embedded team, combining firmware development with hands-on robot integration.
You’ll develop bare-metal firmware in C for STM32-based robotic systems, taking on focused projects in peripheral interfaces, communications, sensing, and diagnostics. Working alongside experienced engineers, you’ll learn to translate requirements into tested firmware and follow your work through integration on the robot.
As the team’s first responder for robot issues in the lab, you’ll also investigate unexpected behavior, run targeted tests, and identify which subsystem needs attention. You’ll resolve embedded issues within your scope and provide clear findings to electrical, mechanical, or other engineering teams when their expertise is needed. This direct exposure to robot behavior will inform your development work, helping you build more useful diagnostics and reliable firmware.
Our workflow makes extensive use of AI development tools. We’re looking for someone who learns quickly, asks good questions, and can turn tool-generated code into a solution they understand and have verified on hardware.
Responsibilities
Develop, test, and maintain bare-metal C firmware for STM32-based robotic subsystems.
Implement peripheral interfaces, communication functions, monitoring features, and diagnostics with guidance from experienced engineers.
Take assigned firmware projects from requirements through implementation, review, and hardware validation.
Use AI tools throughout development to explore solutions, generate code, and build tests, applying engineering judgment to verify the results.
Lead the initial investigation of robot issues in the lab, collecting logs, reproducing failures, and using targeted measurements to isolate the affected subsystem.
Address firmware issues within your scope and coordinate clear handoffs for electronics, mechanical, and complex system faults.
Verify fixes on the robot and turn recurring problems into improved firmware, self-tests, and troubleshooting procedures.
Collaborate with embedded, electrical, mechanical, and motion-control engineers throughout development and integration.
Requirements
Practical experience developing embedded C software for microcontrollers through professional work, military service, or substantial personal projects.
Ability to understand, modify, and debug C code, including code generated by AI tools.
Basic understanding of microcontroller peripherals, interrupts, timers, and communication interfaces such as UART, SPI, I²C, and CAN.
A structured approach to problem-solving and the curiosity to investigate how software and hardware interact.
Familiarity with schematics, datasheets, and basic electronic measurements.
Effective use of AI tools for technical work, with a habit of checking assumptions and validating results.
Clear communication, initiative, and a strong desire to develop as an embedded engineer.
We value demonstrated ability and practical experience more than formal credentials. An engineering degree is welcome but not required. This is a full-time junior position, not a student role.
Advantages
Experience with STM32 microcontrollers and hardware debuggers.
Familiarity with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and multimeters.
Experience with Git, unit testing, or structured firmware development.
Exposure to motors, encoders, robotics, EtherCAT, or CAN networks.
Python scripting for testing, diagnostics, or data analysis.

job.title: טכנאי/ת מעבדת הוראה
job.snippet:
א
טכנאי/ת מעבדת הוראה
אוניברסיטת תל אביב
תל אביב
1-2 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 3 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
טכנאי/ת מעבדת הוראה שנה א'- ביה"ס לפיזיקה ולאסטרונומיה
תפעול ותחזוקת מעבדות ההוראה בפיזיקה:• סיוע בתפעול המעבדה לרבות אחזקה שוטפת, תפעול ניסויים, הדרכה ותמיכה מקצועית במדריכי המעבדה.
• תפעול מערכות תשתית המעבדה ומעקב אחר אחזקה מתוכננת ואחזקת שבר.
• סיוע בתכנון, פיתוח ושיפור של סביבת העבודה - ניסויים וציוד מדעי.
• סיוע בניהול מערך מלאי של ציוד/מכשור/כימיקלים וכו', כולל ביצוע הזמנות, רכש ותכנון עתידי.
• הדרכה טכנית של מדריכי מעבדה (תלמידי תואר שני ושלישי) וסיוע לתלמידי התואר הראשון בזמן הקורס.
• סיוע בפיתוח ובקידום נושאי הליבה במעבדה בצמוד למנהל הטכני ולצוות האקדמי.
• ייזום ופיתוח פרויקטים שונים, לטובת קידום וחדשנות במעבדה.
• קיום קשר מקצועי רציף עם הצוות האקדמי.
• אחריות לנושא הבטיחות במעבדה.
• ביצוע מטלות נוספות ככל שיידרש.
דרישות התפקיד
• הנדסאי/ת / מהנדס/ת בתחומי אלקטרוניקה/מחשבים/מכטרוניקה, או תחום רלוונטי אחר. תואר ראשון בפיזיקה - יתרון.• ניסיון בעבודת מעבדה הכוללת הכרות ותפעול של צב"ד, ציוד מתקדם אלקטרוני ומכני ועזרי הוראה מגוונים.
• ניסיון בתפעול מערכות ממוחשבות ועבודה בסביבה ממוחשבת.
• יכולת זיהוי, ניתוח ופתרון תקלות ובעיות טכניות.
• יכולות ניהול פרויקטים מעבדתיים - הבנת הצורך, מחקר, אפיון, יישום והטמעה.
• יכולות פיתוח באלקטרוניקה ואלקטרו מכניקה.
• הכרות ויכולות פיתוח בשפות תכנות – PYTHON , C++ ועוד - יתרון.
• הכרות טובה עם חיישנים ותחום ה IOT - יתרון.
• ידיעת השפה העברית על בוריה וידיעת השפה האנגלית ברמה טובה מאד.
• יכולת למידה עצמית של תפעול ציוד חדש ומורכב, ויכולת התעדכנות מקצועית.
• יכולת עבודה עצמאית והשתלבות בצוות.
• יכולת התמודדות עם עומס משימות ולחץ.
• יכולות הדרכה.
• יצירתיות, יוזמה, יכולת הנעת תהליכים.
• תודעת שירות גבוהה ויחסי אנוש מעולים.
הערה: נדרשת נכונות לעבודה בשעות נוספות בהתאם לצורך, ובימי שישי (מס' פעמים במהלך שנת הלימודים).
כפיפות: למנהל הטכני מעבדה שנה א' ולמנהלת המערך המנהלי של בית הספר.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.snippet:
20614 - Integrator
QualityAI
חיפה
1-2 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 21 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
הצטרפו ל-QualityAI וקחו חלק בעשייה חדשנית ומשפיעה בעולמות הטכנולוגיה.
כשותפה אסטרטגית להנדסת איכות (Quality Engineering) מבוססת AI,  אנו מסייעים לארגונים לתכנן, לפתח ולתפעל במהירות ובביטחון מערכות ומוצרים קריטיים.
אצלנו תוכלו להשתלב בפרויקטים משמעותיים, להיחשף לטכנולוגיות מתקדמות ולהתפתח בסביבה יציבה, מקצועית ואנושית.
לצוות QualityAI בחברה גדולה בהעולם הבטחוני בחיפה אנחנו מחפשים Integrator.
במסגרת התפקיד:
1. מתן תמיכה טכנית למערכות אוויוניקה מורכבות בפלטפורמות של כלי טיס בלתי מאוישים (כטב"ם).
2. תפעול ותחזוקה של סביבות מעבדה, ציוד בדיקה ומערכי אינטגרציה.
3. ביצוע התקנות, הגדרות ותכנות בסיסי של רכיבי אוויוניקה.
4. השתתפות בניסויי קרקע ובניסויי טיסה בישראל ובחו"ל.
5. איתור ופתרון תקלות חומרה, תוכנה ותקשורת.
6. עבודה אפקטיבית בסביבה מטריציונית ושיתוף פעולה עם צוותים רב-תחומיים.
7. למידה מהירה של טכנולוגיות חדשות ומתן תובנות טכניות ברמת המערכת.
דרישות התפקיד
- הנדסאי/ת אלקטרוניקה– חובה.
- ניסיון בעבודה עם ציוד בדיקה סטנדרטי, כגון אוסצילוסקופ (Oscilloscope) ומד מתח דיגיטלי (DVM).
- היכרות עם רשתות ופרוטוקולי תקשורת, לרבות תקשורת IP ותקשורת טורית (Serial Communication).
- ידע בתכנות בשפת Python.
- היכרות עם תקשורת רדיו (RF).
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.title: Business and Execution Manager
job.snippet: Description: We are looking for a professional to join our team in a role that combines project execution oversight with financial performance analysis across all phases of the project lifecycle. The role operates horizontally across the division's departments - construction, engineering, procurement and asset management. Its primary objective is to provide division management with a single, unified, data-driven picture that supports informed decision-making and delivery against project milestones. The position combines analytical, control, and cross-functional responsibilities, requiring the ability to work independently while driving alignment across a wide range of stakeholders without direct authority. | Responsibilities: Data, Reporting & BI - Own the division's BI and reporting systems: monitor, control and develop them while ensuring data accuracy, consistency and timeliness; produce periodic reports, dashboards and tracking of KPIs defined from time to time. Business Modeling & Analysis - Build and maintain analytical and financial models for the division's projects; budget, cash flow, quantities, schedules and scenarios, including version control and documentation, and translate data into management insights and actionable recommendations. Performance Control & Trend Identification - Collect and analyze cross-portfolio data, perform plan-versus-actual gap analysis, and identify trends, risks and deviations at an early stage. Scheduling & Project Control - Support, monitor and control project schedules from early planning through construction, commissioning and handover; track project and portfolio progress, perform critical path analysis and monitor percentage of completion. Cross-Functional Coordination - Act as a key integrator within the division headquarters: coordinate inputs across engineering, procurement, construction and subcontractors to produce a single, up-to-date status picture; consolidate topics for cross-division forums; and drive solutions across inter-company and inter-departmental interfaces. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement - Lead improvement initiatives within the division and participate in those led by others; develop and embed procedures, tools and best practices; drive standardization of planning, reporting and control processes across departments; and capture and implement lessons learned. | Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Industrial Engineering and Management, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field - required. 4–6 years of experience in analysis, planning and control, project controls, coordination or operations - required. Advanced proficiency in Excel, including building and maintaining complex models, and in PowerPoint, with a proven ability to build executive-level presentations, Power BI, MS Project -  required. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into insights and actionable recommendations - required. Proven ability to operate in a matrix environment with multiple stakeholders at all levels, without direct authority - required. Highly organized, accurate and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in parallel in a dynamic environment - required. Fluency in English, spoken and written - required. Experience building reports, dashboards and BI tools - required Experience in a cross-functional corporate role and in preparing materials for management and the board - an advantage. Familiarity with budget control processes and finance interfaces - an advantage. Experience in construction, infrastructure or renewable energy projects (solar, storage) and in working with EPC contractors - a significant advantage.

job.title: Head of Information Security - CISO
job.snippet: Description: Enlight is looking for a Head of Information Security (CISO) to lead the development and implementation of the company’s cybersecurity strategy, governance, and risk-management framework. The role will ensure that Enlight’s IT and operational technology (OT) environments, critical assets, data, and business operations are appropriately protected as the company grows and expands internationally. The CISO will establish and continuously improve the company’s information security capabilities, prioritizing initiatives based on risk exposure and business impact while enabling business growth and maintaining uninterrupted operations across renewable energy assets and corporate systems. | Responsibilities: Cybersecurity Strategy & Governance: Define and implement the company-wide cybersecurity strategy, policies, standards, and governance framework, aligned with business priorities and risk exposure. IT & OT Security: Assess and mitigate cybersecurity risks across corporate IT systems, renewable energy assets, operational technology, and critical infrastructure, while maintaining production continuity. Risk Management & Business Impact: Lead Business Impact Analysis (BIA), identify and prioritize critical assets and vulnerabilities, and develop risk-based mitigation plans. Security Operations & Incident Response: Establish and oversee Security Operations Center (SOC) capabilities, security monitoring, incident response, and recovery processes. Security Architecture & Access Management: Define security requirements for infrastructure, applications, cloud environments, identity and access management, and remote access. Policies & Procedures: Develop and implement security policies, standards, procedures, and controls, ensuring they are practical, adopted, and regularly reviewed. Third-Party & Supply Chain Security: Assess and manage cybersecurity risks associated with vendors, service providers, technology partners, and critical infrastructure components. Incident Preparedness & Resilience: Establish incident response plans, conduct security assessments and exercises, and strengthen business continuity and recovery capabilities. Compliance & Assurance: Ensure alignment with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, contractual obligations, and internal audit recommendations. Security Awareness: Develop employee awareness and training programs to strengthen secure behaviors and accountability across the organization. Technology & AI Security: Define security requirements for the adoption of AI, automation, and emerging technologies, enabling their safe and responsible use. | Requirements: 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, IT/OT security, or a related field, including leadership responsibility. Proven experience developing and implementing cybersecurity strategies, policies, governance frameworks, and risk-mitigation plans, and familiarity with relevant cybersecurity frameworks and standards. Strong understanding of IT and OT security, preferably in critical infrastructure, energy, industrial environments, or other operationally sensitive industries. Experience with security risk assessments, Business Impact Analysis (BIA), asset criticality assessments,  establishing SOC, IR, Suply Chain risks. Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA, or equivalent) – preferred. Experience in renewable energy, power generation, construction, infrastructure, or industrial environments – preferred.

job.title: Senior Data Center Engineer
job.snippet: Description: Enlight is seeking for a Senior Data Center Engineer to lead the engineering aspects of its data center projects, from initial requirements definition and design through construction and handover to operations. Reporting to: VP of Engineering. Business Context: Enlight is expanding into data center development, leveraging its strengths in land development, grid connectivity, and renewable energy. Role Purpose: Build Enlight’s in-house engineering capabilities for data centers, establish technical specifications and design standards, select and manage consultants, designers, and suppliers, and ensure that projects meet customer requirements, budget, and schedule, while taking a lifecycle perspective on operational needs. | Responsibilities: 1. Requirements Definition and Basis of Design Translate customer requirements into engineering specifications, conduct technical feasibility assessments, and develop campus master plans and phased development strategies. Lead design processes in an environment of uncertainty, managing evolving customer requirements—even at advanced project stages—by evaluating alternatives and maintaining design flexibility. 2. Technical Specifications, Standards, and Design Reviews Develop technical and functional specifications across all engineering disciplines and establish Enlight’s data center design standards. Conduct design reviews, risk assessments, and value engineering; manage change orders (COs); and ensure compliance with relevant standards, including Uptime Tier, TIA-942, ASHRAE, and NFPA. Incorporate operational and maintenance considerations into the design, including system reliability and availability, maintainability, and future expansion requirements. 3. Consultant, Designer, and Supplier Selection Prepare and issue RFPs and select local and international designers and consultants, including MEP engineers and Owner’s Engineers. Select major equipment suppliers and long-lead items (LLIs), conduct technical evaluations, and provide recommendations to the Procurement Committee, considering cost, reliability, and operational requirements. 4. Construction Support and Handover to Operations Provide engineering oversight and support to EPC and MEP contractors, participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), and oversee quality control. Lead commissioning and handover to operations, including facility documentation, as-built drawings, and training. Ensure the facility is ready for long-term operation and maintenance, working closely with operations teams and incorporating their requirements throughout the design and construction phases. 5. Budget and Schedule Management Develop project budget estimates and monitor capital expenditures (CAPEX), operating expenditures (OPEX), and total cost of ownership (TCO) over the facility’s lifecycle. Conduct TCO analyses and evaluate engineering alternatives, assessing the impact of design and procurement decisions on energy consumption, maintenance, and operating costs. Monitor design costs and engineering schedules, including assessing the impact of changes in customer requirements. | Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering. At least 10 years of experience in the design and construction of mission-critical facilities, including at least 5 years in data centers. Experience supporting data center projects from design through commissioning and operational readiness, with an IT capacity of at least 10 MW. Extensive knowledge of critical power systems, UPS, generators, and cooling systems. Experience developing technical specifications, issuing RFPs, and managing designers, consultants, and contractors. Familiarity with relevant industry standards, including Uptime Tier, TIA-942, EN 50600, ASHRAE TC 9.9, and NFPA. Understanding of data center operations and maintenance requirements, along with experience in CAPEX and OPEX estimation and TCO analysis. Excellent written and spoken English. Preferred Qualifications Experience with high-density AI facilities, including direct-to-chip liquid cooling. Experience working with hyperscalers or for an international data center developer or operator. Experience at an engineering design consultancy specializing in mission-critical facilities. Professional certifications such as CDCDP, ATD, or PMP. Familiarity with connecting large facilities to Israel’s power grid and integrating renewable energy and energy storage. Experience in data center operations and maintenance. Key Competencies Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills. Ability to navigate uncertainty and evolving customer requirements by managing alternatives and making well-informed decisions. Systems-level thinking that integrates engineering, operational, and financial considerations. Ability to manage external suppliers and consultants effectively and work collaboratively as part of a team. Willingness to travel to project sites in Israel and supplier facilities abroad.

job.title: Head of SOC and Managed  Services for a cybersecurity company
job.snippet:
Head of SOC and Managed Security Services for a cybersecurity company
We are looking for a leader to own a growing managed security services operation. This is a senior role with responsibility for the teams, technology, service quality, and customer relationships that make the service work.
You will lead SOC and Security Engineering teams, guide incident response and detection capabilities, and serve as a trusted point of contact for customers. You will also shape how the operation grows: improving processes, introducing automation, and working across product, engineering, research, and sales.
What you’ll own
Lead the managed services operation, including delivery, performance, technical quality, and customer experience.
Manage and develop the SOC and Security Engineering teams.
Build relationships with senior customer stakeholders and lead communications during escalations and critical incidents.
Set and improve SLAs, KPIs, workflows, and service standards.
Advance detection engineering, incident response, and automation.
Support customer onboarding, renewals, expansions, and technical presales discussions.
Translate customer needs and operational insights into improvements across the business.
What you’ll bring
Leadership experience in managed security services, SOC operations, Security Engineering, or a closely related field.
Experience managing technical teams and complex, customer-facing services.
Strong knowledge of incident response, detection, SIEM technologies, and cloud environments, particularly AWS and Azure.
The ability to discuss technical issues clearly with both security teams and business leaders.
A track record of improving service quality, operational processes, and team performance.

job.title: Director of Accounting
job.snippet:
At Cognyte, we create investigative analytics software that helps customers accelerate investigations and detect and respond to security threats, including terror, crime, fraud, cyber threats and crypto crime.
We are looking for an experienced Director of Finance to lead our Finance operations and accounting for Israel region. This is a key leadership position within the Global Accounting organization, responsible for ensuring strong financial governance, accurate and timely reporting, effective internal controls, and efficient day-to-day finance operations.
The Director of Finance will work closely with Global Accounting, Business Finance and other functions across the organization, while continuously improving processes, strengthening controls and leveraging technology and automation to increase accuracy, visibility and efficiency.
As a Cognyter, you will:
Lead Finance operating and accounting teams, providing clear direction, professional leadership and development to the team while fostering accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Own the Israeli accounting function and ensure timely, accurate and compliant financial reporting in accordance with US GAAP and applicable Israeli statutory requirements.
Lead the monthly, quarterly and annual financial close processes for the Israeli entities, ensuring quality, accuracy and adherence to corporate reporting timelines.
Maintain a strong internal control environment, including SOX and internal controls over financial reporting, and continuously identify opportunities to strengthen and simplify controls.
Oversee key finance operations and ensure effective financial processes, controls and governance across areas under the Israel Finance organization.
Lead the Israeli statutory reporting and audit processes and coordinate with external auditors, tax advisors, legal counsel and other professional advisors.
Partner closely with Global Accounting, Business Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal and other stakeholders on business and finance matters.
Support budgeting and forecasting processes by providing accurate accounting, operational and financial information and working closely with Business Finance.
Identify and lead opportunities to standardize, simplify and automate finance processes, improving efficiency and reducing manual work while maintaining appropriate controls.
Drive initiatives to improve the speed and quality of the financial close, including improved processes, systems, reconciliations and reporting.
Lead and support cross-functional and global Finance projects, including implementation and optimization of financial systems, tools and processes.
Develop the capabilities of the Finance team through coaching, knowledge sharing, succession planning and professional development.
For this mission, you’ll need:
8+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including significant experience in a public-company or multinational environment and experience in a Controller, Finance Director or similar leadership role.
CPA qualification and a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
Strong knowledge of US GAAP, Israeli statutory accounting requirements and financial reporting.
Strong experience with SOX compliance and internal controls over financial reporting.
Experience managing accounting close, statutory reporting and external audits.
Demonstrated leadership experience, including the ability to lead, develop and motivate finance professionals.
Strong business partnering and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders across functions and geographies.
Strong understanding of financial systems and ERP environments, with demonstrated experience improving or implementing finance processes and systems.

job.title: Hardware / Board Design Engineer - Power, Control & Sensors
job.snippet:
Mentee Robotics, now part of Mobileye, brings world-class robotics expertise, together with Mobileye's decades of leadership in computer vision, machine learning, and autonomous driving technologies. Building on that foundation, Mentee by Mobileye is creating the "MenteeBot", the AI-first humanoid robot that combines perception, reasoning, learning, and advanced dexterous manipulation, designed to work alongside people in their everyday lives, at the workplace and in the home.
At Mobileye, our technologies power more than 230 million vehicles worldwide and have helped shape the future of autonomous mobility. With teams around the world, we continue to innovate at the forefront of autonomous systems, advancing the next generation of Physical AI for real life.
Your Role
We’re looking for a mid-level or senior hardware engineer to own custom electronics across our humanoid platform, with a strong emphasis on motor-drive and power electronics alongside embedded control, sensor interfaces, and communication boards.
You’ll take projects from requirements and architecture through circuit design, PCB implementation, bring-up, validation, and production transfer.
PCB layout is currently supported by external partners. You’ll define the constraints, guide implementation, review the results, and remain accountable for the complete board design. We welcome engineers who use AI-assisted design and verification tools effectively while applying sound electrical judgment and measurement-based validation.
Responsibilities
Own board requirements, architecture, circuit design, component selection, and schematic capture across multiple projects.
Design motor-drive electronics, gate-driver circuits, current sensing, protection, DC-DC conversion, and power distribution.
Develop MCU-based control boards, sensor interfaces, and mixed-signal circuits.
Design communication interfaces such as EtherCAT, Ethernet, CAN/FDCAN, RS-485, SPI, I²C, UART, and USB as required.
Define PCB stack-ups, placement and routing constraints, grounding, thermal requirements, and signal- and power-integrity considerations.
Guide external PCB layout partners and review placement, routing, manufacturing outputs, and DFM/DFT feedback.
Plan and execute board bring-up, characterization, fault investigation, and validation against requirements.
Collaborate with embedded software, motion control, mechanical, and test engineers on subsystem integration.
Own bills of materials, design documentation, release packages, engineering changes, and technical support for prototype and production builds.
Requirements
4+ years of relevant hardware-development experience, including independent ownership of boards through bring-up and validation.
B.Sc. in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or equivalent proven practical experience.
Strong foundations in analog, digital, mixed-signal, and power circuit design.
Proven experience with motor-drive or power-electronics circuits, including switching stages, gate drivers, sensing, and protection.
Experience with microcontroller-based systems, sensor interfaces, and digital communication circuits.
Ability to define and review multilayer PCB implementation, including high-current paths, grounding, thermal management, controlled impedance where needed, and EMI/EMC considerations.
Proficiency with schematic and PCB design tools; Altium Designer preferred but any CAD is sufficient.
Strong hands-on debugging skills using oscilloscopes, differential and current probes, multimeters, and other relevant lab equipment.
Ability to coordinate external design partners, manage concurrent projects, and maintain clear engineering documentation.
Advantages
Experience with compact BLDC/PMSM motor controllers and actuator electronics.
Precision current sensing, encoder interfaces, and low-noise analog design.
EtherCAT, Ethernet, and CAN/FDCAN hardware integration.
Advanced high-speed digital design, HDI, flex, or rigid-flex boards.
Circuit simulation, thermal analysis, and signal- or power-integrity analysis.
Experience with manufacturing test, EMC validation, component lifecycle management, and production transfer.
Effective use of AI tools for design review, analysis, verification, and engineering automation.
