Teaser
Application deadline : 13 November 2026.
Text
The
European Union Border Assistance Mission for the Rafah Crossing Point
–
EUBAM Rafah
– was launched on 24 November 2005 to monitor the operations of the border crossing point between the Gaza Strip and Egypt, after Israel and the Palestinian Authority concluded an Agreement on Movement and Access on 15 November 2005. The Council of the European Union approved that the EU should undertake the third-party role proposed.
EUBAM Rafah
is currently seeking dynamic, highly skilled candidates for immediate recruitment to fill the following
Four (4) vacancies:
MSDL 11 Procurement Officer (1 post): Provides procurement and contracting support to the Mission, ensuring compliance with applicable procurement rules and procedures. The position supports tendering, purchasing, contracting and related procurement administration, including coordination with relevant Mission units and stakeholders.
MSDL 12 Driver – Fleet Operator (1 post): Provides transportation, vehicle and fleet support to Mission members and external officials, contributing to the safe and efficient operation of the Mission’s vehicles and related transport activities.
MSDL 10 Logistics and Transport Assistant (1 post): Provides logistical and transport support to Mission staff, contributing to the effective management and distribution of Mission assets, supplies and transport resources.
HoML 03 Press & Public Information Officer / Graphic Designer / Editor / Social Media (1 post): Supports the Mission’s press and public information activities through graphic design, photography, video production, editing and social media management, producing visual and audiovisual content to communicate the Mission’s mandate, activities and achievements to relevant audiences.
Employment regime:
Locally Contracted Staff hired under Israeli Local Labor Law
Duty Station:
Ramat Gan - Tel Aviv
Opening Date: 23 October 2026
Closing Date: 13 November 2026
General employment/eligibility requirements:
Education and professional experience, as well as proficiency in English, Arabic and Hebrew, as specified in the relevant Job Description; a valid identification document permitting employment and unrestricted movement within the Mission’s area of operations; medical fitness for work; and a clean criminal record.
IMPORTANT:
Work is expected to be performed physically at the Mission offices in Ramat Gan, Monday through Friday. Candidates must be able to make the necessary arrangements to travel to and from the office premises on a daily basis. Applicants must hold a valid local identification document or work permit authorising employment at the Mission.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION FOR THE APPLICANTS
Applicants are reminded that the work of the Selection Committee is strictly confidential. Therefore, applicants must not contact, either directly or indirectly, any member of the Selection Committee, nor request that any other person do so on their behalf.

job.title: VP R&D & Engineering- Repair & Installation
job.snippet:
Thank you for your interest in Krausz Industries, part of Mueller Water Products.
About Krausz Industries
Krausz Industries, the repair and installation business unit of Mueller Water Products, is based in Israel and develops innovative products for the repair and installation of water infrastructure.
For more than 165 years, Mueller Water Products has been developing products and solutions that help communities deliver clean, safe drinking water. Driven by a commitment to innovation, excellence, and safety, Mueller brings together teams across its businesses to address critical water infrastructure challenges and make a lasting impact.
The opportunity
Mueller is looking for a VP R&D & Engineering to shape the technological direction of its Repair & Installation business in Israel.
Reporting to the General Manager and serving as a full member of the management team, you will own the path from product ideation to product development to market launch and technical support You will lead R&D, Product Engineering and Production Engineering, strengthening the existing portfolio while expanding into new and innovative products, solving complex engineering challenges, and advancing manufacturability and automation. The challenge to build an engineering organization that can deliver both the products of tomorrow and the engineering excellence the business needs today.
Scope
Three engineering groups: R&D, Product Engineering and Production Engineering
Ownership of the technology roadmap, new-product pipeline, engineering quality and reliability
A key role in business, product and investment decisions alongside the GM and leadership team
What you bring
Senior leadership experience in R&D, Engineering or Product Development, leading managers and multidisciplinary engineering teams
A strong track record of taking complex physical products from concept to market
Strong engineering depth and experience in manufacturing and production engineering
The ability to connect market needs, product strategy, technology and engineering execution
Strong business judgment and the ability to influence, build alignment and hold a clear position when priorities compete
A track record of developing engineering managers and building strong organizations
B.Sc. in Engineering, preferably Mechanical Engineering
Fluent professional English and the ability to work effectively in a global organization
Experience in water, flow control, industrial products or automation is an advantage, but not a requirement.
We value most your ability to set direction, make sound engineering and business decisions, build strong teams and turn strategy into products.
Location:
Rosh Haayin, Israel
If this is the kind of role you would consider, apply here or contact us directly for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Senior Robotics & Autonomy Engineer
job.snippet:
About Ottopia Defense
We're building the intelligence powering the Unmanned Ground Force.
Ottopia Defense, an Ondas company, is an AI-native Deep Tech company revolutionizing ground defense through software, hardware, robotics, and autonomy. Our technologies span autonomous navigation, resilient teleoperation, intelligent mission command, and human-machine collaboration, transforming fleets and robots into a coordinated, intelligent force. We combine the ambition, agility, and ownership of a startup with the resources and global reach of public US company. We hire AI-native people only: exceptional builders who embrace AI as a fundamental part of how they think, create, and solve problems. People who thrive on bold challenges, move fast, and are driven to build technology that changes the world.
About The Role
Ottopia Defense is looking for a Senior Robotics & Autonomy Engineer to develop autonomous capabilities for physical robotic platforms operating in complex real-world environments.
The role spans localization, navigation, motion planning, control, mission execution, and recovery behaviors.
You will work on multiple platform types, including UGVs, retrofitted vehicles, industrial machinery, and legged robots, with a strong focus on off-road environments and operation where GPS may be degraded, unreliable, or unavailable.
Responsibilities
Develop localization and navigation capabilities for robotic platforms.
Develop autonomy for GPS-denied and GPS-degraded environments.
Implement and integrate SLAM, visual/inertial localization, LiDAR localization, and sensor-fusion solutions.
Develop global and local path-planning algorithms.
Develop trajectory generation and obstacle-avoidance capabilities.
Build autonomous mission-execution capabilities such as waypoint navigation and multi-stage missions.
Implement recovery, replanning, and fallback behaviors.
Integrate autonomy algorithms with physical platform controllers.
Support transitions between autonomous operation and teleoperation.
Adapt algorithms to different platform dynamics and mobility constraints.
Support autonomous and teleoperated mission-planning workflows.
Test algorithms in simulation and on physical robots.
Analyze field failures and systematically improve robustness.
Requirements
Strong robotics background.
Strong C++ skills.
Experience with localization, navigation, planning, or control.
Strong understanding of coordinate systems, transformations, and 3D geometry.
Experience with sensor fusion.
Experience with ROS / ROS2.
Strong mathematical and algorithmic foundations.
Experience working with physical robotic systems.
Advantage
SLAM.
Visual Odometry / Visual-Inertial Odometry.
LiDAR-based localization.
EKF / UKF / factor graphs.
Nav2.
A*, Hybrid A*, RRT, or optimization-based planning.
MPC or other trajectory-control approaches.
Behavior Trees and mission planners.
GNSS / RTK.
Off-road autonomous navigation.
Autonomous mission planning.
UGVs or defense robotics.

job.title: Freight Forwarding Manager
job.snippet:
Edikted
is a premier Gen Z-oriented fashion brand, heavily influenced by street style and the latest runway trends. We are a fast-growing, digital-first label dedicated to making high-end aesthetics accessible to everyone. Our brand thrives at the intersection of pop culture, social media, and community, moving at the speed of the internet to deliver the "it-girl" wardrobe to our global audience. As we continue to dominate social feeds, we are looking for creative, data-driven individuals to join our movement.
Are you a highly operational, hands-on
Freight Forwarding Manager
ready to take full ownership of global shipping operations in a fast-paced environment? Join
EDIKTED
, a fast-growing global fashion brand, to take charge of our international logistics, establish tight tracking infrastructure, drive fast deliveries, and optimize our supply chain.
Responsibilities
End-to-End Operational Control:
Drive daily end-to-end management of all international shipments—from pickup through customs to final warehouse delivery—ensuring complete visibility and the fastest possible transit times.
Tracking & Infrastructure:
Build, maintain, and optimize real-time tracking systems and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to monitor high-volume weekly shipments seamlessly.
Vendor & Forwarder Operations:
Coordinate daily with global freight forwarders, ocean/air carriers, and logistics providers to enforce SLA compliance and resolve operational bottlenecks instantly.
Cost Optimization & Rates:
Conduct competitive bidding, negotiate spot/contract freight rates (air, sea, express), and optimize overall shipping spend without compromising speed.
Customs & Documentation:
Oversee import/export documentation, HS classification, and collaborate directly with customs brokers to eliminate clearance delays.
Financial Management & Auditing:
Verify, audit, and approve shipping invoices, manage logistics payments, and handle rate disputes.
Requirements
Experience:
3+ years of hands-on operational experience in international freight forwarding and global shipping—preferably in fashion, retail, or fast-moving e-commerce.
Industry Background:
Previous experience working within Freight Forwarding companies – Significant Advantage.
Hands-on & Detail-Oriented:
Strong execution mindset; thrives in the day-to-day weeds of tracking shipments, handling exceptions, and ensuring speed to destination.
Customs & Compliance:
Solid knowledge of customs clearance processes, import/export regulations, and Incoterms.
Technical Skills:
Advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets for daily operational tracking, data analysis, and reporting.
Languages:
Excellent written and spoken English.
Problem-Solving & Agility:
Strong ability to juggle multiple urgent priorities, resolve logistical crises under pressure, and drive continuous operational improvements.
Why You’ll Love Working at EDIKTED
High Impact & Speed:
Directly control the movement of products worldwide and directly impact customer delivery times and company growth.
Dynamic Environment:
Join an energetic, creative fashion brand where speed, initiative, and ownership are rewarded.

job.title: Practical Engineer
job.snippet:
Power the Future with Us!
At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 3,000 employees, offices in 34 countries, and millions of installations worldwide.
Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond.
As global electricity demand grows, so does the need for smart, clean energy solutions. SolarEdge offers exciting opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment spanning research and development, production, and customer delivery. Work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and help shape a sustainable future in an industry that continually evolves. Join a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work.
What Will You Be Doing?
Work at the company’s main site in Herzliya, with travel to additional sites as needed.
Build and support complex electrical test setups.
Install, wire, and assemble components and systems.
Identify, analyze, and resolve electrical faults.
Set up new laboratories and electrical infrastructure.
Build, maintain, and test dedicated test equipment and fixtures.
Collaborate closely with R&D teams, engineers, and technicians.
Requirements:
A valid Israeli Certified Electrician license (חשמלאי מוסמך) or higher — mandatory.
A Practical Electrical Engineering diploma — a significant advantage.
Hands-on experience installing and maintaining electrical systems.
Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics.
Experience working in R&D laboratories — an advantage.
Experience with solar systems and power equipment — an advantage.
Strong technical aptitude and excellent hands-on skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
A strong sense of responsibility, initiative, creativity, and problem-solving skills.

Project Engineer- Ashtrom Renewable Energy
Ashtrom Renewable Energy
, an international renewable energy developer, is looking for a
Project Engineer
to join our growing Engineering team.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and manage engineering activities throughout the entire project lifecycle from development and feasibility through construction and operation.
Manage engineering feasibility studies and ensure engineering deliverables are aligned with overall project schedules.
Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities and drive planning processes across all project phases.
Manage external engineering consultants and internal stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.
Work on project-financed renewable energy projects, including coordination with lenders' technical advisors.
Identify and assess technical risks and support commercial decision-making, particularly during early-stage due diligence processes.
Perform and review energy production simulations and technical analysis of
PV and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
.
Lead the design of
High Voltage (HV)
and
Extra High Voltage (EHV)
systems, including participation in technical discussions with transmission system operators and utility companies in Israel and abroad.
Lead ongoing coordination with planning authorities, regulatory bodies, government agencies, and other external stakeholders to support project development and permitting.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical Engineering preferred).
Minimum of
3 years' experience
as a Project Engineer.
Experience in the design and implementation of
project-financed renewable energy generation and energy storage facilities
.
Experience with
HV/EHV systems
– an advantage.
Proven experience managing complex engineering and planning processes.
Fluent English (spoken, written, and reading).
Hands-on experience with
CAD software
.
Proficiency in
PVsyst
.
Location
Bnei Brak, near Ayalon Mall
This is primarily an office-based position, with occasional field work in
Israel and internationally
.

job.title: Construction Supervisors
job.snippet:
Construction Supervisors – M3 Metro Project
Location:
M3 Metro construction sites across the Tel Aviv metropolitan area, including Bat Yam, Holon, Or Yehuda and Kiryat Ono.
MLEAD is hiring Construction Supervisors for the M3 Metro line, part of Israel’s largest and most significant infrastructure project.
This is an opportunity to develop expertise in a pioneering field with growing demand for experienced professionals.
About the Role
You will supervise and monitor contractors’ work at project sites, checking compliance with design, quality, safety and schedule requirements, in close collaboration with project management teams and other technical professionals.
Key Responsibilities
Supervise contractors’ on-site activities to verify compliance with drawings, technical specifications and project requirements.
Monitor work progress, execution quality and adherence to project schedules.
Identify and document deviations and non-conformities, and follow up on corrective actions.
Participate in site inspections, coordination meetings and technical reviews.
Work closely with project managers, engineers, designers, contractors and other professionals.
Prepare site supervision reports, document findings and report on work progress.
Use information systems and digital tools for project documentation, monitoring, control and information management.
Requirements
Essential:
At least five years of experience supervising construction or civil engineering works and/or managing projects in the construction or infrastructure sectors.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.
A good command of English, enabling you to read technical documentation and communicate in an international working environment.
Strong digital skills, including the ability to work with BIM systems, document management systems and digital tools for project documentation, monitoring and control.
Ability to work independently on site, with a strong sense of responsibility, good organisational skills and effective task follow-up.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with multiple professional stakeholders.
A significant advantage:
Experience on large, complex infrastructure projects.
Experience in tunnelling, underground works or transport infrastructure projects.
Experience working on behalf of a project owner or a project management and supervision consultancy.
Familiarity with digital systems for project management, document management and site reporting.
Why Join Us?
Join a pioneering national infrastructure project, work alongside leading professionals from Israel and around the world, and help build the future metro network of the Tel Aviv metropolitan area.

job.title: Customer Engineer - Kiryat Gat
job.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Kiryat Gat,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.
J
Job Description
We are looking for a highly talented customer engineer to join our account team & integrate within our field support group in
Kiryat Gat
to provide a unique customer experience by demonstrating outstanding technical capabilities and inter-personal skills.
What’s in it for you?
As a customer engineer at Applied Materials you’ll be working for a high growth international company, integrating into the heart of the manufacturing process of advanced digital devices. You’ll get the opportunity and practice to work on the most advanced semiconductor equipment while learning new skills or perfecting existing ones such as advanced trouble shooting and problem solving, project management, robotics, semiconductor device manufacturing processes and more. In addition, you’ll get advanced training on cutting edge hardware industry components.
Role Responsibilities:
Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
Use digital analytics for troubleshooting
Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
Minimum Qualifications:
B.Sc. or Practical Engineer in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering , field service experience, or trade certification
Willing to learn and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
Preferred Qualifications:
1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
Associate degree in electronics or engineering technologies
Knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics
Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
Work is located in Kiryat Gat in a cleanroom environment
Work in shifts including nights and weekends
Physical Requirements:
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
Yes, 25% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
No
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

A leading renewable energy development company is seeking an experienced
Electrical Engineer
for a Senior Project Engineer position, leading the engineering and design management of large-scale (Utility-Scale) energy projects.

job.company: Megayeset - Recruiting, Head Hunting and HR Consulting מגייסת - השמה ומשאבי אנוש
job.snippet:
Energy Trading Analyst
We are looking for an
Energy Trading Analyst
to join a leading renewable energy company.
The role involves preparing daily and periodic generation and consumption forecasts, analyzing operational performance to achieve techno-economic optimization, implementing electricity trading agreements with customers, and managing billing and customer service for business clients.
The position reports directly to the company's Trading Manager and involves close collaboration with internal departments, including Operations, Business Development, Finance, and others.
Key Responsibilities
Prepare daily and periodic electricity generation and consumption forecasts and submit them to Noga and Israel Electric Corporation (IEC) every morning.
Perform technical and economic optimization of power generation and energy storage facilities.
Handle monthly settlements, billing, and ongoing support for the company's business customers.
Manage and monitor Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs).
Develop and improve information systems supporting energy trading activities.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including Operations, Business Development, Finance, and other departments.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Industrial Engineering and Management, Mathematics, or another relevant field.
1–3 years of previous experience in an Analyst role.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
Familiarity with BI tools and statistical analysis tools.
Knowledge of the renewable energy sector and energy storage solutions – an advantage.
The position is based at the company's offices in the Sharon area, with one work-from-home day per week.

job.snippet:
אנחנו מגייסים בוחני חיובים עם תנאים שווים במיוחד
פורסם: 20.9.23
עודכן: 4.1.26
תיאור
תאור התפקיד:
קביעה וחיוב ארנונה לנכסים, כולל עדכון נתוני שומה במערכת.
מתן מענה איכותי ומקצועי בערוצי התקשורת השונים.
ביצוע סיורים וביקורות בנכסים על פי הצורך.
ייצוג העירייה בפני ועדת ערר ובתי משפט.
קיום קשרי עבודה עם גורמים שונים (פנים-ארגוניים וחוץ-ארגוניים).
דרישות המשרה:
השכלה אקדמית, כולל ידע וניסיון בקריאת שרטוטי מבנה.
עבודה במערכות ממוחשבות והפעלת יישומי OFFICE.
תודעת שירות גבוהה ויחסי אנוש טובים.
כושר ביטוי טוב בכתב ובעל-פה.
תנאים:
זכאות להחזר מלא עבור ביטוח רכב שנתי.
זכאות להחזר חודשי עבור הוצאות רכב.
היתכנות לעבודה מהבית, יום בשבוע.
טווח שכר – 7,500-8,000 ₪ ברוטו.
הערות:
המועמדים יישלחו למבחן אמינות
על פי חוק ההנדסאים והטכנאים המוסמכים, התשע"ג2012-" ,הנדסאי" או "טכנאי מוסמך" כהגדרתם בחוק זה פטורים מדרישת השכלה זו.
עיריית תל אביב-יפו מקדמת את עיקרון השוויון והתעסוקה, ובכלל זה שואפת לייצוג הולם ומקנה העדפה לזכאים לכך על פי דין. אם אתה נמנה על אחת הקבוצות הבאות: אתה או שאחד מהוריך נולדו באתיופיה, בן האוכלוסייה הערבית, הדרוזית, או הצ'רקסית, בן האוכלוסייה החרדית, עולה חדש (מי שעלה לישראל בהיותו בגיר וטרם חלפו 12 שנים מיום עלייתו) או שאתה אדם עם מוגבלות כמפורט בסעיף 25.35 בתקשי"ר.
מובהר כי מדובר במשרה שיועמ"ש העירייה קבע לגביה כי נדרשת בדיקת עברו הפלילי של מועמד כתנאי להתמנות לה, וכי אישור היועמ"ש בדבר היעדר הרשעות המונעות לשמש במשרה מהווה תנאי לאיוש המשרה ולמינוי לתפקיד .
הסדרי תנועה וחניה
פרטים נוספים
להגשת מועמדות
להורדה

job.snippet:

זו ההזדמנות שלך לעשות את הצעד הבא אחרי הביג4 או אחרי תפקיד עוזר/ת חשב ולהיכנס לתפקיד חשב/ת חברה!

job.title: Opto-Mechanics Technician
job.snippet:
About Lidwave
Lidwave is a Jerusalem and Modi’in based deep-tech startup building the sensing layer for Physical AI. We develop the world’s first and only 4D coherent LiDAR-on-a-chip, using our proprietary FCR™ technology on a Silicon Photonics platform - giving machines the ability to perceive the world in four dimensions at chip scale. Our Odem™ product family targets automotive, security and industrial markets. We’re building the next generation of machine perception.
The Role
We are looking for a hands-on Opto-Mechanics Technician / Practical Engineer to build the optomechanical core of our ODEM sensors - lens assemblies and multi-part optomechanical modules - for R&D prototypes and samples.
You’ll be part of the R&D team, directly alongside our optics, mechanical and systems engineers, improving the design toward production and integrating mechanics and electronics into a complete module, across the company’s product line. You’ll work with CAD, define assembly procedures and the tools and jigs they require, mount lenses and optical components in their housings, and bond with UV and thermal adhesives - often in a cleanroom environment.
Your assemblies move on to a dedicated calibration stage, so the quality of your build and of your documentation is what the next step depends on. As we scale toward production, the role grows with it - toward owning the assembly process and leading an assembly team.
Key Responsibilities
R&D builds and process improvement
•
Building of prototypes and engineering units side by side with our engineers, often before a written procedure exists.
•
Identification of problems in parts, drawings or process, and proposal of practical solutions for the LiDAR design and for the assembly and calibration tools.
•
Hands-on feedback on jigs, fixtures and assembly aids, and support in improving them.
•
Support in turning first builds into clear, repeatable work instructions as we move toward production.
•
Preparation of the relevant processes for the company’s scale-up.
Precision assembly
•
Assembly of multi-part optomechanical modules according to drawings, assembly procedures and work instructions.
•
Mounting of lenses and optical components into housings and mounts, with careful handling of optical surfaces.
•
Integration of mechanical and electrical sub-assemblies into a complete module, including fastening to torque specification
•
Application of UV-cure and thermal adhesives under a microscope - controlled volume and bond-line thickness, with no bleed-out or bubbles.
•
Setting of lens focus positions using dedicated jigs and fixtures.
•
Work in a cleanroom environment, with strict cleanliness and ESD discipline.
Documentation and handover
•
Documentation of every assembly - parts, lots, adhesive batches, and anything that deviated or was non-standard.
•
Handover of each module to the calibration stage with the information it needs, and maintenance of unit traceability.
Requirements
Must have
•
Technician or Practical Engineer (Handasai) diploma in mechanics, electro-optics, electronics or a similar field - or equivalent hands-on experience.
•
3+ years of proven hands-on experience assembling multi-part precision assemblies - complete products or modules, not only single components.
•
Optical or optomechanical assembly experience - defense electro-optics, medical devices, or electro-optical systems.
•
Ability to read mechanical drawings and schematics, including tolerances and datums.
•
Comfortable working to tolerances of tens of microns, and able to discuss the tolerances you’ve worked to.
•
A real understanding of tolerance stack-up - how assembly order affects the final result.
•
Accurate, clear documentation habits. Capable of writing assembly procedures.
•
Steady hands and patience for working under a microscope.
•
Experience with assembly jigs, fixtures and tools.
•
Hands-on experience with UV and thermal adhesive bonding.
•
Independent problem-solving, with concrete examples - comfortable in a small team, working directly with engineers, sometimes without a written procedure.
•
Technical English - able to read work instructions and datasheets.
Nice to have
•
Jig design and SolidWorks CAD experience.
•
Cleanroom experience.
•
Startup or NPI experience - moving a product from prototype to production.
•
Working within ISO 9001 or IPC process and documentation standards.
Location & Contact
Location: full-time, on-site, Har Hotzvim, Jerusalem/Modi’in.
Hiring process: interviews and a hands-on bench assessment.
Contact: Sari Heyman, sari@lidwave.com

job.title: Pipe Stress Engineer
job.snippet:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
Your impact
We are seeking a Pipe Stress Engineer to support complex and fast-paced Electronics facilities projects. In this role, you will be responsible for the analysis, design, and integrity assessment of piping systems while collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams to deliver high-performing solutions. This position includes regular attendance at client sites for field assessments, design reviews, and project coordination.
Key Responsibilities
Perform pipe stress analysis using AutoPIPE
Select pipe supports from standard vendor catalog and/or from internal support database
Design custom pipe supports based on project-specific requirements including load conditions, space constraints, and expected travel
Perform engineering calculations such as equipment nozzle load evaluations, trunnion design checks, weld adequacy assessments, etc
Prepare and maintain all pipe stress engineering deliverables and documentation

job.title: Senior AI Solutions Builder
job.snippet:
About The Role
We're looking for a Senior AI Solutions Builder to join our Product - CTO Ops team. In this role, you will design, build, and ship AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity and drive measurable business value across the organization.
You will operate at the intersection of AI, data, pricing and business - owning the end-to-end development of agents, copilots, and workflow automations that directly inform decisions and eliminate manual work.
You are both a builder and an enabler. You ship solutions yourself and raise the AI capability floor for the teams around you. You'll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, CS, Sales, and builders across the company to deliver outcomes that improve decision velocity, product and operational efficiency, and long-term growth.
What You Will Do
Design and ship AI-powered copilots, agents, and decision-support tools for the product team, starting with pricing
Build data pipelines and analytical models for pricing intelligence
Develop autonomous agents that automate recurring product tasks
Automate manual workflows across product tools so the right action happens when a signal fires
Build LLM-based scoring models that give roadmap and prioritization decisions a data backbone
Enable and upskill product teams through AI playbooks, sessions, and hands-on co-building
Collaborate with builders across Engineering, CS, GTM, and other teams to co-create solutions that scale
Define and track impact: time-to-insight, decision velocity, manual hours eliminated, and business outcomes
You Bring
Proven, hands-on experience building and shipping AI-powered tools, agents, or pipelines in production environments
Builder / vibe coder mindset uses AI-assisted tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, n8n) to ship independently without an engineering ticket
Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Finance, and go-to-market teams in a B2B SaaS environment
Ability to connect systems independently: APIs, webhooks, data pipelines
Strong communication and collaboration skills across diverse teams
Ability to prioritize, problem-solve, and navigate ambiguity in a dynamic environment
Comfortable learning and applying new technologies, tools, and methodologies
Nice To Have
Experience in pricing, monetization, revenue analytics, or usage-based commercial models
Background in Product work
Familiarity with causal inference, A/B experimentation, or uplift modeling
Comfortable with analytics platforms (Heap, GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude) and PM tools (Jira, Confluence, Productboard, etc.)
Experience working in a distributed, multicultural environment

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

job.title: Automation technician
job.snippet:
We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.
Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights.
Who We Are
We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company.
Global Benefits & Perks
You’ll be rewarded with a competitive salary plus receive entitlements and benefits unique to your country of hire.
What You’ll Also Get
Career Opportunity: Career paths aren’t linear here. Being part of our global company with 60+ brands gives you the chance to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.
Learning & Development:
Our lifelong learning philosophy means you’ll have access to a wealth of state-of-the-art learning resources, including our Lean Academy and online university (where you can get certificates and specializations from renowned colleges and universities).
Diverse & Inclusive Culture:
We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too.
Purpose-Driven Company:
You’ll help us continue to make positive changes in the local communities where we work and live as well as in the broader world through volunteerism, giving back and sustainable business practices.

job.title: Experienced Monitor / Clinical Research Associate (CRA)
job.snippet:
PSI is a leading Contract Research Organization with more than 30 years in the industry, offering a perfect balance between stability and innovation to both clients and employees. We focus on delivering quality and on-time services across a variety of therapeutic indications.
Job Description
As a Clinical Research Associate at PSI, you will enjoy a variety of monitoring tasks and work on clinical studies in different therapeutic indications, maintaining the highest quality standards in the industry.
You will:
Act as the main line of communication between the project team, sponsor, and the site
Build and maintain a good relationship with the site staff involved in the study conduct
Prepare, conduct, and report site selection, initiation, routine monitoring and close-out visits
Ensure that subject recruitment targets are timely defined, communicated, recorded and met, and project timelines are followed at site level
Ensure accurate and timely information flow with trial sites on Adverse Events and protocol/process deviations
Perform source data verification and follows up on data queries at site level; review and manage study risks on a site level
Ensure proper handling, use, accountability, reconciliation, and return of all Investigational Product(s) and clinical study supplies on sites
Review essential study documents and reconcile study Investigator Site File (ISF) / TMF at site level
Ensures quality (data integrity and compliance) at site level
Conduct site audit preparation visits and resolve site audit findings
Participate in study site audits and client onsite visits, as required
Ensure the flow of documents and study supplies between the project team, site and the Central/ Regional Laboratory/ Central Reviewer/ Warehouse
Conduct project-specific training of site investigators
Support preparation of Investigator newsletters
Assist Site Management Associates in maintaining study-specific and corporate tracking systems at site level
Support preparation of draft regulatory and ethics committee submission packages
Support collection of IP-RED packages at site/country level
Facilitate review and reconciliation of the study TMF on country and site levels
Qualifications
​​​​​College/University degree in Life Sciences or an equivalent combination of education, training & experience
At least 2 years of independent on-site monitoring experience in Israel and knowledge of the local clinical research environment are required
Experience in all types of monitoring visits, in phases I-III
Experience with Oncology indications preferred.
Full working proficiency in Hebrew and English
Proficiency in MS Office applications
Ability to plan, multitask and work in a dynamic team environment
Communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills
·Attention to detail, organizational and time-management skills
Valid driver’s license and ability to travel
Additional Information
This is a great opportunity for you to further develop your skills, widen your therapeutic area experience, and become an expert in clinical research.
We offer:
Excellent working conditions
Extensive training and friendly team
Competitive salary and benefits package
Opportunities for personal and professional growth
Make the right call and take your career to a whole new level. Join the company that focuses on its people and invests in their professional development and success.

job.title: AI Transformation Product Manager
job.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Rehovot,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
We are looking for a
AI Transformation
Product Manager
to join the GenAI Core Team, which is driving a transformative corporate initiative to achieve significant productivity improvement through AI adoption, starting with our software organization and expanding across the entire R&D landscape. The role involves validating implementation of AI productivity playbooks across product groups, tracking adoption metrics, gathering stakeholder feedback, and connecting insights to surface opportunities and gaps in our GenAI transformation journey.
What's in it for you?
This is an opportunity to be at the heart of Applied Materials' AI transformation, impacting the entire R&D organization while working with cutting-edge GenAI tools and methodologies. You'll gain exposure to multiple business units, collaborate with diverse stakeholders across the organization, and play a critical role in shaping how we adopt and measure AI-driven productivity improvements. Your insights and execution will directly contribute to ambitious organizational goals and drive real impact.
Our Group:
The
GenAI Core Team
is leading Applied Materials' corporate-wide AI-Driven Productivity Program. We develop methodologies, frameworks, AI tools, best practices (BKMs), and playbooks while defining adoption plans and measurement tools to achieve ambitious productivity improvement targets. We operate in a dynamic, matrix-management environment collaborating across PDC R&D centers in Israel and Bangalore, working closely with Applied Materials HQ AI leadership to align on strategy and best practices.
What you'll be doing:
Make Things Happen: Drive execution with a bias for action. We believe in delivery over endless planning - you'll be expected to take ownership, navigate obstacles, and ensure initiatives move from concept to reality.
Discovery & Gap Analysis: Create and maintain productivity heat maps per product, identify gaps between current practices and productivity goals, and surface insights that indicate missing capabilities or process improvements needed.
Voice of Customer: Act as the bridge between field teams and the GenAI Core Team by gathering feedback from managers, team leads, and product stakeholders, synthesizing patterns, and escalating issues to leadership.
Data-Driven Monitoring: Track adoption of metrics through dashboards and scorecards, monitor products against acceptance criteria, and provide regular status updates on playbook adoption and productivity improvements.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with managers, team leaders, product managers, and engineers across multiple groups to facilitate adoption, organize hackathons and adoption events, and ensure alignment on productivity goals.
Connect the Dots: Synthesize disparate feedback from various stakeholders to identify systemic issues, surface opportunities for new playbooks or tools, and contribute to the strategic direction of the productivity program.
Validate Implementation Across Groups: Track and validate the adoption of productivity playbooks across multiple product groups, ensuring implementations meet defined acceptance criteria and organizational standards.
What Should You Have?
B.Sc. in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field. MBA is an advantage.
8+ years of professional experience with demonstrated project management skills.
Technical background and previous transformation experience. AI is an advantage.
Product mindset - ability to think strategically about solutions, understand user needs, and drive product-oriented outcomes.
Get things done attitude - proven track record of executing initiatives, driving projects to completion, and delivering results with minimal supervision.
Data literacy with hands-on skills - ability to analyze metrics, interpret dashboards, derive actionable insights from data, AND technically connect to/extract data from ticketing systems, project management tools, and data sources for decision-making.
Stakeholder management - experience collaborating with diverse stakeholders across multiple teams and demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority.
Attention to detail while maintaining the ability to see the big picture - balance tactical execution with strategic thinking.
Connecting the dots - ability to synthesize feedback from multiple sources, identify patterns, and surface actionable insights.
AI mindset with hands-on experience - natural inclination to leverage GenAI tools in daily work, openness to AI-augmented workflows, and proven ability to build small projects or prototypes with AI tools. This role requires rolling up your sleeves and working directly with data and AI systems, not just coordinating meetings.
Fast learner and embrace change - ability to quickly understand technical concepts, adapt to new tools and methodologies, and operate comfortably in a fast-evolving environment where priorities shift, new AI capabilities emerge frequently, and agility is essential.
What Gives You an Advantage?
Analytics or data visualization experience.
Prior experience in semiconductor or technology industry.
Experience with leading AI transformation or any other transformation.
Who Are We?
Applied Materials Israel is home to the Process Diagnostics and Control business unit (PDC). Based in Rehovot, we develop, manufacture and market cutting-edge machine learning and computer vision-based metrology and inspection products that are essential elements in wafer fabrication. The AI revolution is manufactured using our tools - our technology enables the production of advanced semiconductors that power the next generation of AI systems. By playing a significant role in enabling the production of the next generation of microchips, our expertise enables our customers to transform possibilities into reality.
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
No
Relocation Eligible:
No
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

job.title: Head of Go-To-Market Engineering
job.snippet:
Sauce is a premier restaurant technology platform that helps businesses grow with our Commission-Free Delivery & Pickup structure and proprietary delivery optimization technology. We are serving a 105 billion dollar US local restaurant business. Headquartered in NYC and Tel-Aviv, Sauce wants restaurants to fulfill their highest potential, this means giving local establishments everything they need to connect directly with their customers. The Sauce team pools together decades of restaurant tech experience, along with seasoned tech, sales, marketing, product and operations executives who produce an industry-changing delivery system for successful local restaurants and chains.
Your mission is to architect and deliver hands-on, high-impact, tech-driven solutions that empower Sauce’s GTM engine to maximize customer value while scaling revenue and margins. As the lead architect of our AI-native GTM factory, you will scout, prototype, and maintain innovative revenue engines. By leveraging AI/LLM agents and low-code automations, you will transform our legacy tech stack and deploy revenue-generating systems in weeks rather than quarters.
What You'll Do:
Hands-on Delivery - Personally lead, scope, build, test, and ship production-ready GTM workflows and automations in a matter of days, acting as architect, builder, and QA until a team is in place.
Own the GTM product and tech stack (existing, buildout, Innovation): Marketing, Sales and customer success, making sure the entire GTM is aligned and synced.
Scale velocity and quality: Work with GTM teams to identify data-backed automations business workflows that support GTM business goals.
Idea-to-Outcome Ownership - Run the entire GTM innovation funnel (discovery → hypothesis → rapid build → experiment → signal) for every revenue project.
Revenue Factory Engineering - Design the end-to-end system for targeting, acquisition, and retention for thousands of tech-skeptical SMB owners.
Build and Train Agentic GTM Platform - Own the deployment of AI agents (SDR, CS, Support). You are responsible for rigorous training cycles and daily outputs, no “set and forget”.
Stakeholder Demo & Adoption - Run weekly "show-and-tell" sessions with execs and drive adoption of your tools by the GTM team as hard as you drive implementation.
What You Bring:
GTM & SMB Fluency: Marketing-Sales-CSM terminology (goals, KPIs, motions) and GTM business flows; Deep understanding of SMB behavior
Proven track-record building solutions, integrating and developing over MarTech, and SalesTech Stacks (at least 3/5):
Ad platforms (Meta, Google)
Data, Analytics, Dashboarding: GA4, GTM, Tableau, Hubspot, Databricks, Mongo.
Communication channels automation protocols: Hubspot, AirCall, Customer.io
Websites and forms building (performance, automation, dynamic content, security) over WordPress.
Bespoke and custom business applications.
3+ years of professional experience - A hybrid background across software engineering, product management, or growth marketing.
Technical Practitioner (AI-Native) - You are deep in the trenches with AI - not just reading about it. You are hands-on with Gen-AI stacks (Claude Code / OpenAI), automation platforms (n8n, Make, Zapier), and "vibe-coding" tools (Cursor).
Multi-hat Execution - Proven ability to play PM, architect, and builder simultaneously in a fast-paced startup setting.
Advantage
Former Founder / Entrepreneurial Background - You have built something from scratch and know how to deliver with limited resources,
“Getting things done” mentality - having the right mindset to crush impediments.
Data Literacy - Strong experience with data synthesis / SQL, mostly in the CRM hygiene area , structured data enrichment, and data warehouse intelligence to ensure the AI systems actually work.
What Success Looks Like:
By Month 3 - Data foundation live. First 2-3 centralized AI capabilities (e.g., automated targeting or scoring) measurably improving pipeline or rep productivity.
By Month 6 - At least 3 major tasks removed from human rep JDs and handled by the AI engine. Experimentation cadence established with "idea-to-signal" in days.
By Month 12 - First AI agents deployed and fully trained. Revenue per rep is 2-3x industry benchmarks for B2SMB.
What We Offer:
Strong & Competitive Compensation Package
Paid Parental Leave
Flexible Work Environment
Generous Paid Time Off Policy
The Opportunity to Build Something that Changes the Delivery Tech Industry for the Better!
Friendly environment where you can reach your full potential and grow your career
Open minded teams for innovation and self growth
Work from home for better life/work balance
Sauce is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy and related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability (physical or mental), gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, immigration status, or any other classification, category or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. We understand the importance of creating a more diverse and inclusive workplace and celebrate our employees for their differences.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

job.title: רכז.ת גיוס (17779)

למרכז הרפואי שיבא דרוש/ה מנהל/ת כספים ב-ARC Sheba
התפקיד כולל:
ניהול ואחריות שוטפת של הנהלת חשבונות והמערכת הפיננסית עד לרמת מאזן:
ניהול עבודה שוטפת מול ספקים ולקוחות בארץ ובחו"ל, הכוללת אישור הזמנות רכש, קליטת חשבוניות, מעקב אחרי גבייה והכנת תשלומים, לצד ביצוע התאמות בנק ורישום פקודות יומן ושכר, התחשבנויות עם חברות קשורות.
דוחות, דיווחים ובקרה:
הכנת דיווחים חודשיים לרשויות ובקרה על דיוק הנתונים במערכת, לצד הכנת דוחות כספיים, תקציביים ומס בהתאם לכללי החשבונאות המקובלים בישראל (Israeli GAAP).
שונות:
מעקב אחר תקציב מול ביצוע, ניהול העברות בנקאיות, עבודה מול חברת האם, רשויות מס ובנקים, והטמעת תהליכי עבודה חדשים במערכות SAP ו-אביב.
היקף המשרה: 100%
דרישות התפקיד:
הנהלת חשבונות סוג 2 – חובה/ סוג 3 – יתרון משמעותי
ניסיון של 3 שנים בניהול חשבונות וכספים בחברה עסקית או בפירמת ראיית חשבון
אנגלית ברמת גבוהה מאוד
יכולת עבודה בצוות במגוון רחב של פרויקטים במקביל ותחת לחץ
יחסי אנוש מצוינים

job.title: Planner
job.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Rehovot,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
What’s in it for you?
We are looking for sharp, analytical, and motivated professionals to join our planning team as either a
Material planner
or
Sales & Operations planner.
The planner's
responsibilities is ensure seamless alignment between supply chain, production, and business objectives. Planners play a critical role in delivering cutting-edge products to customers with 100% on-time delivery while optimizing resources and costs.
The planners make their plans happen – they actively pursue short term solutions for operative constrains and build the long-term capacity & responsiveness mechanisms to support their future plans.
What planners at applied do:
Lead, plan and control an integrative end-to-end operational plan to meet business needs while meeting Operations excellence targets.
Ensure tools are shipped in the required configuration, by accurate forecast and management of customers NSRs (nonstandard requests).
Work and lead in a cross functional environment with multiple interfaces (local and global; business, R&D, supply chain & manufacturing).
Integrate all executional activities (manufacturing, material, R&D) while optimizing teams’ resources.
Support NPI processes from R&D to production
Improve line performance, while solving cost issues and meeting inventory targets
Optimize product line clean room space
Work with SAP and other internal organizational information systems.
Ensure material responsiveness to production schedules and continuously improve performance metrics.
Oversee transitions between old and new products with minimal material impact
What you should have?
BSc in industrial engineering - Must
0-2 years years of experience in planning / operational roles - Advantage
Excellent English – speaking, reading and writing - Must
Very good analytical skills, sharp & fast thinking.
Customer orientation with the ability to influence and motivate internal and external interfaces
Ability to work under pressure, manage and prioritize multiple tasks in parallel and manage timelines & due dates independently.
Good verbal skills, ability to present and communicate key messages to management forums.
Ability to manage long term tasks in addition to the daily execution.
Advantage for strong understanding of manufacturing processes
Advantage for experience in project management
Who we are?
Applied Materials Israel
is home to the Process Diagnostics and Control business unit (PDC). Based in Rehovot, we develop, manufacture and market cutting-edge machine learning and computer vision-based metrology and inspection products that are essential elements in wafer fabrication. By playing a significant role in enabling the production of the next generation of microchips, our expertise enables our customers to transform possibilities into reality.
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
New College Grad
Travel:
Yes, 10% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
No
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

job.title: Manager, Finance (FP&A)
job.snippet:
We Role Purpose
Lead the FP&A function for Taro Israel (part of the Sun Pharma Group) and serve as a trusted business partner to site leadership. The role combines planning, forecasting, performance analysis, workforce economics, product costing and decision support, while leading the team’s transformation from reporting-focused activities toward business partnership, process excellence and data-driven decision-making. The position will also support SAP S/4HANA readiness and promote responsible use of AI, automation and digital tools.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the annual budget, forecasts and long-range planning processes, in coordination with business owners and regional and global Finance teams.
Analyze actual results against budget and forecast, identify key business drivers, and provide clear insights and actionable recommendations.
Lead workforce planning, labor-cost analysis and product costing, including profitability and manufacturing variance analysis.
Act as a Finance business partner to site leadership and key functions, challenging assumptions and supporting business decisions.
Prepare concise management reporting, KPIs, financial models and business cases for local and global reviews and strategic initiatives.
Drive process improvement, SAP S/4HANA readiness, automation and responsible use of AI and digital tools to reduce manual reporting and expand analytical capacity.
Strengthen FP&A processes, controls, documentation, data quality and governance.
Lead, coach and develop the FP&A team through change, building engagement, ownership, professional capabilities and effective backup coverage.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Economics and/or Accounting from a recognized university; an MBA is preferred.
More than 10 years of relevant experience in FP&A or an economics or finance department within global companies.
Proven experience in budgeting, forecasting, management reporting and actual-versus-budget analysis.
Strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to explain the story behind the numbers and translate analysis into clear management actions.
Proven experience leading and developing employees or professional teams.
Experience in manufacturing finance, product costing, finance transformation or system implementation is an advantage.
Experience with ERP and financial planning systems; SAP knowledge is an advantage.
Demonstrated ability to use AI and modern digital tools to improve analysis, reporting, forecasting and productivity.
High proficiency in English and Hebrew, with experience in a global, matrixed and changing environment.
Leadership Profile
Business-oriented and analytical, with both a broad strategic perspective and attention to detail.
Proven ability to lead people through change, build engagement and create commitment to new ways of working.
Can-do mindset, ownership, assertiveness and strong prioritization and execution skills.
Collaborative and resilient leader who can coach, influence and develop a high-performing team.
Curious and digitally oriented, with high integrity and commitment to effective controls and governance.
job.description:
We Role Purpose
Lead the FP&A function for Taro Israel (part of the Sun Pharma Group) and serve as a trusted business partner to site leadership. The role combines planning, forecasting, performance analysis, workforce economics, product costing and decision support, while leading the team’s transformation from reporting-focused activities toward business partnership, process excellence and data-driven decision-making. The position will also support SAP S/4HANA readiness and promote responsible use of AI, automation and digital tools.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the annual budget, forecasts and long-range planning processes, in coordination with business owners and regional and global Finance teams.
Analyze actual results against budget and forecast, identify key business drivers, and provide clear insights and actionable recommendations.
Lead workforce planning, labor-cost analysis and product costing, including profitability and manufacturing variance analysis.
Act as a Finance business partner to site leadership and key functions, challenging assumptions and supporting business decisions.
Prepare concise management reporting, KPIs, financial models and business cases for local and global reviews and strategic initiatives.
Drive process improvement, SAP S/4HANA readiness, automation and responsible use of AI and digital tools to reduce manual reporting and expand analytical capacity.
Strengthen FP&A processes, controls, documentation, data quality and governance.
Lead, coach and develop the FP&A team through change, building engagement, ownership, professional capabilities and effective backup coverage.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Economics and/or Accounting from a recognized university; an MBA is preferred.
More than 10 years of relevant experience in FP&A or an economics or finance department within global companies.
Proven experience in budgeting, forecasting, management reporting and actual-versus-budget analysis.
Strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to explain the story behind the numbers and translate analysis into clear management actions.
Proven experience leading and developing employees or professional teams.
Experience in manufacturing finance, product costing, finance transformation or system implementation is an advantage.
Experience with ERP and financial planning systems; SAP knowledge is an advantage.
Demonstrated ability to use AI and modern digital tools to improve analysis, reporting, forecasting and productivity.
High proficiency in English and Hebrew, with experience in a global, matrixed and changing environment.
Leadership Profile
Business-oriented and analytical, with both a broad strategic perspective and attention to detail.
Proven ability to lead people through change, build engagement and create commitment to new ways of working.
Can-do mindset, ownership, assertiveness and strong prioritization and execution skills.
Collaborative and resilient leader who can coach, influence and develop a high-performing team.
Curious and digitally oriented, with high integrity and commitment to effective controls and governance.

job.title: Content & Growth Manager | Early-Stage Startup
job.snippet:
About MANNA
MANNA – Recipes & Cooking is building a new home for food and recipes lovers.
The platform helps people turn food inspiration from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and the web into recipes they can save, organize, discover, and cook.
MANNA has an existing product and technology stack, and we are now expanding the core team to support the company’s next stage of growth.
The Role
We are looking for a
Content & Growth Manager
to join MANNA’s early core team and help shape the content, growth, and commercial side of the platform.
The role combines
content strategy, platform content, premium content, creators, and marketing
.
You will help define what users discover inside MANNA, build compelling content experiences, develop premium paid content, work with creators, and help bring that content to the right audiences.
Key areas may include:
Managing and curating recipes and culinary content across the platform
Building collections, categories, themes, and discovery experiences
Developing and managing premium paid content
Helping define free vs. premium content experiences
Working with creators and culinary professionals
Identifying content trends and opportunities
Supporting marketing and growth initiatives around content
Developing campaigns and ideas that drive discovery, engagement, and retention
Helping grow awareness of MANNA and its content
Working with product and engineering on content-related features and tools
Using data and user behavior to improve content and growth decisions
Helping build scalable content and marketing processes as MANNA grows
What We’re Looking For
Strong understanding of digital content, marketing, and consumer platforms
Good instinct for what makes content engaging and valuable
Ability to think about both user experience and commercial potential
Creative thinking combined with strong execution
Highly organized and detail-oriented
Strong communication and collaboration skills
Ability to work independently and take ownership
Interest in food, cooking, creators, digital media, and consumer technology
Comfort working in an early-stage environment where the role can evolve
Experience with content platforms, digital marketing, growth, premium content, subscriptions, creator ecosystems, social media, food media, or consumer apps is an advantage.
Stage & Compensation
This is an
early-stage, equity-based core-team role
.
There is currently
no salary attached to the position
. Equity and vesting will be structured based on responsibility, commitment, experience, and long-term involvement.

job.title: INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECT MANAGER
job.snippet:
Waxman Group is Israel’s leading company in infrastructure, construction, and complex civil engineering.
We specialize in the planning, management, and execution of national-scale mega-projects that reshape the country’s landscape, redefine its skyline, and build the strategic infrastructure of tomorrow. The Group manages a diverse portfolio of complex projects – from commercial and residential towers to transportation infrastructure, energy, and advanced urban development – all at the core of national activity, impacting the lives of millions of people every day.
Responsibilities
Management and control of planning and execution for a major infrastructure project
Managing the planning process and various project stages
Leading design teams
Ongoing liaison with the client
Managing schedules and budgets
Interfacing with government infrastructure companies
Managing multiple internal and external organizational interfaces
Requirements
Registered Civil Engineer – Mandatory
At least 5 years of project management experience – Mandatory
Experience in infrastructure, transportation, or roadworks – Mandatory
Prior experience with a project management firm – Significant advantage
Ability to lead client relations
Experience managing project teams
Proactive approach, leadership skills, and excellent interpersonal skills
Why take your next step at Waxman Group?
Unlimited learning and personal development: We believe in your growth. Our in-house academy offers a wide range of courses, professional training, advanced seminars, and personal development programs that give you the tools to lead and to stay at the forefront of the industry.
A top-tier employee experience, social life, and welfare: We work hard here — and celebrate even harder. Our package includes lavish company events, an unforgettable annual company retreat, toasts and get-togethers, birthday and personal milestone celebrations, and especially generous gifts for the holidays and special occasions.
Impact on national mega-projects: You will have the opportunity to work at the very heart of the most complex and influential engineering and infrastructure projects in Israel, and to leave a personal mark on the face of the country.
The stability of a large company with the agility of a start-up: A precise balance between strong financial backing, job security, and stability, and a dynamic, fast-paced, bureaucracy-free work environment that encourages initiative and out-of-the-box thinking.
A down-to-earth organizational culture: We combine uncompromising professionalism with a warm, supportive, family atmosphere. Our managers and colleagues are true partners — approachable, always with an open door, and genuinely collaborative both in the office and in the field.
This position is open to women and men alike.
Location
The company's offices in Bnei Brak are located about a 7-minute walk from the "Ben Gurion" light rail station

job.title: R&D Project Manager
job.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Rehovot,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
R&D Project Manager
We are looking for an ETP project manager to join us and lead our key divisional technical projects. You will own the project plan and budget, manage its execution and control timely, and on budget, deliveries while partnering with multidisciplinary teams.
What’s in it for you?
Have an impact on some of our key and top priority project’s success, shaping our future roadmap and technology excellence and enabling PDC growth. Own multi M$ projects, work closely with cutting-edge engineering and science fields
,
guide diverse groups to reach shared goals and make project related decisions to enable end-to-end execution success.
Our Group:
Group of divisional project managers who own, manage and lead divisional projects and other operational infrastructures roadmap.
What you'll be doing:
R&D project execution control - Validate resources are allocated, all activities are mapped, linked and planned for, drive to resolve gaps that holds execution
Manage work plans to meet timelines, highlight gaps/risks and work to resolve, assure work plans are complete, manage routing RERs to assure alignment and timely deliveries
Manage and optimize R&D Project’s Budget – Plan and control budget, highlight risks, manage optimizations
Interface with technical Module Owners, Sys Eng., Disciplinary owners, Product Lines focals, Operation, ICT and Finance
What you should have?
B.Sc in in engineering or science field, M.Sc is an advantage.
More than 5 years’ experience in working on complex multidisciplinary projects. More than 3 years’ experience as a project manager or direct team management
Methodological skills, PM now-how, multi-disciplinary approach.
Strong multidisciplinary technical product and system understanding
Strong management skills in a complex and dynamic Marix environment
Ability to motivate teams, overcome obstacles, manage conflicts and risks
Internally driven – highly motived and fast learning, flexible and independent
PjM tools knowledge (smartsheet, AI, PDP etc.)
Excellent inter-personal skills, can lead without authority
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
Yes, 10% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
No
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

job.snippet:
אנו מחפשים מנהל/ת IT ואבטחת מידע בכיר/ה ובעל/ת 'ידיים על', שיוביל/תוביל את פעילות ה-IT של החברה, התשתית הפנימית, פעולות האבטחה ותהליכי הציות. זהו תפקיד בעל אחריות מלאה המשלב תמיכה יומיומית בעובדים עם שיפורי תשתית, ניהול סביבת מיקרוסופט, רשתות AWS בשיתוף פעולה הדוק עם צוותי DevOps, SSO ותחזוקת תקני SOC 2 / ISO 27001.
בתפקיד יחידני זה, תהיה/תהיי אחראי/ת על כלל היבטי ה-IT והאבטחה, תוך התמודדות עם אתגרים טכנולוגיים מגוונים בסביבת SaaS מודרנית. תעבוד/תעבדי עם טכנולוגיות מובילות מבית מיקרוסופט, AWS ופתרונות אבטחה וזהות מתקדמים, ותוודא/תוודאי עמידה בתקני אבטחה בינלאומיים. תפקיד זה אינו תפקיד DevOps.
תחומי האחריות:
ניהול והובלת פעילות IT ארגונית מקצה לקצה, פלטפורמות SaaS, ניהול גישה ותפעול אבטחה.
מתן תמיכת IT מעשית לעובדים, בעיקר בישראל, כולל קליטה, עזיבה, ציוד, חשבונות, הרשאות ורישיונות.
ניהול ומיטוב סביבת מיקרוסופט, כולל Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Intune, Defender, MFA ומדיניות אבטחה.
ניהול ושיפור רשתות ארגוניות, כולל VPN, Wi-Fi, גישה מרחוק וקישוריות.
עבודה צמודה עם צוותי DevOps בנושאי רשת ותשתית ב-AWS, כולל VPCs, Subnets, Route Tables ו-Security Groups.
תחזוקה ומוכנות לתקני SOC 2 ו-ISO 27001, כולל איסוף ראיות, מדיניות, בקרות וביקורות.
זהו תפקיד מאתגר ובעל השפעה רבה, המאפשר צמיחה מקצועית משמעותית והובלת תחום קריטי בחברה. הצטרף/הצטרפי לצוות דינמי שמעריך מקצועיות, חדשנות ואחריות אישית.
