job.title: Creative Social
job.snippet:
Company Description
Publicis Group
Israel is Israel’s leading marketing and communications groups, bringing together over 450 professionals, across 13 specialized agencies covering advertising, media, digital, content, social, branding, production, strategy, and data.
The group includes four of Israel’s most recognized
advertising agencies:
Bauman Bar Rivnai BBR , Glikman Shamir Samsonov , Leo Burnett and Expert
Our Publicis Media and production companies working both inhouse and with clients.
Agencies specializing in Branding, Content, Digital, Social networks, Art, Sales promotion, Conferences, and Strategy planning:
C, Like a Rainbow, Social Lions, SuperPush, Fireworks, Mint, Mate, Adge.ai
Location
: Champion Towers, Bnei Brak (opposite Ayalon Mall)
Work Schedule
: Sunday–Thursday, 09:00–18:00
Hybrid Model
: One work-from-home day per week
Dog friendly offices
Overview
We're looking for a creative, social-first thinker who lives and breathes content.
As a
Social Creative
, you'll be responsible for turning ideas into engaging social content for some of the biggest brands in Israel.
From brainstorming concepts and building creative presentations to filming, editing, scriptwriting, and content creation – you'll play a key role in bringing social campaigns to life across multiple platforms.
Responsibilities
Develop creative concepts and social-first content ideas for leading brands
Create content calendars and social media plans aligned with brand and campaign strategies
Write copy, scripts, and creative briefs for video productions and social campaigns
Film and edit short-form content for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
Participate in creative brainstorming sessions and help build client presentations and creative decks
Stay on top of social trends, platform updates, creators, and emerging content formats
Collaborate closely with account managers, designers, creators, influencers, and clients
Lead and manage content production days from idea to execution
Qualifications
At least 1 year of experience creating social media content, preferably within a social media, digital, or advertising agency
Strong understanding of social platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X
Excellent copywriting and storytelling skills in Hebrew and English
Hands-on experience with content filming and video editing
Strong creative thinking and ability to turn insights and trends into engaging content
Familiarity with influencer marketing and creator collaborations
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Outlook
Advantage: Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, DALL·E, Runway, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, and other creative AI platforms

job.title: תקציבאי.ת למשרד פרסום
job.snippet:
Company Description
קבוצת פובליסיס
ישראל
היא קבוצת חברות בתחום השיווק והתקשורת המובילות בישראל,
ומאגדת מעל 450 אנשי מקצוע ב-14 סוכנויות.
הקבוצה כוללת שלושה
משרדי פרסום מוכרים:
באומן בר ריבנאי BBR , גליקמן שמיר סמסונוב , ליאו ברנט ואקספרט
חברות המדיה וההפקה שלנו פועלות הן בתוך החברה והן עם לקוחות.
בנוסף, סוכנויות המתמחות במיתוג, תוכן, דיגיטל, רשתות חברתיות, קידום מכירות, כנסים וטכנולוגיות
C, Like a Rainbow, Social Lions, SuperPush, Fireworks, Mint, Mate, Adge.ai
מיקום
: מגדלי צ'מפיון, בני בראק (מול קניון איילון)
לוח עבודה
: ראשון–חמישי, 09:00–18:00
מודל היברידי
: יום עבודה מהבית בשבוע
משרדים ידידותיים לכלבים
Overview
אנחנו מחפשים
תקציבאים/ות
שמעוניינים להיות בלב הפרסום, להשפיע ולהוביל קמפיינים של מותגי העל בישראל.
אם עולם הפרסום הוא התשוקה שלך, אם אתה מונע מאהבה ליצירתיות, חדשנות ויחסי לקוחות מעולים – המקום שלך איתנו! כסוכנות הפרסום הגדולה והמובילה בישראל, אנו מציעים הזדמנות ייחודית להיחשף לאתגרים חדשים מדי יום, להוביל קמפיינים פורצי דרך ולעבוד עם המותגים הגדולים והמשפיעים ביותר בישראל.
Responsibilities
הובלת פרויקטים של פרסום ומיתוג, פיתוח לוחות זמנים ותוכניות עבודה, וניהול משימות.
בניית ושימור קשרים יומיומיים וארוכי טווח עם לקוחות החברה, הבנת הצרכים שלהם ומתן פתרונות מקצועיים ויצירתיים.
השקה של קמפיינים פרסומיים מורכבים וחדשניים בפלטפורמות שונות.
תיאום ושיתוף פעולה מתמשך עם מחלקות פנימיות (קריאייטיב, אסטרטגיה, דיגיטל, הפקה ומדיה) וספקים חיצוניים.
ניהול תקציבי לקוחות ומעקב אחר רווחיות.
עבודה עצמאית, יוזמת, ועמידה ביעדים.
Qualifications
תואר אקדמי בתקשורת/שיווק או קורס מקצועי רלוונטי - חובה
יכולות ביטוי גבוהות בע"פ ובכתב
כישורים חברתיים, עם יכולת לעבוד כחלק מצוות
פרואקטיביות, אחריות ויכולת עבודה עצמאית.
כישורי ארגון וניהול זמן מצוינים.

job.title: SOC Quality and Reliability Engineer, Google Cloud
job.snippet:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
Haifa, Israel; Tel Aviv, Israel
.
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of experience in IC silicon quality or reliability.
Experience leading the product reliability lifecycle from post-tapeout through high-volume manufacturing.
Experience with semiconductor complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) technology, device physics, and failure mechanisms.
Preferred qualifications:
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or related field.
Expertise in statistical data analysis using tools such as JMP, Python, or JSL.
Knowledge of design-for-reliability (DfR) rules and implementation techniques.
Familiarity with electrical failure analysis (EFA) and physical failure analysis (PFA) techniques.
Track record with silicon reliability on process nodes and advanced packaging technologies.
About The Job
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.
Google’s data centers are the most advanced in the world. In this role, you will help build the SoC’s that power these data centers by driving quality and reliability processes from the integrated circuit perspective. You will create silicon and follow it into the field (and back) to drive improvements for the next generations of chips.
You will have an understanding of IC flows, wafer processing, testing, qualification, yield, reliability, and failure analysis. You will work with various cross functional teams to develop quality and reliability specifications, develop and deploy design guidelines, and develop and execute and test plans. Within the larger organization you will collaborate with global hardware quality and reliability teams, silicon design, validation and engineering teams.
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
Responsibilities
Drive the strategic definition and development of design-for-reliability (DfR) guidelines, collaborating with cross-functional subject matter experts to integrate reliability into early design stages.
Define and lead the development of qualification hardware and test methodologies, managing internal teams and external vendors to ensure silicon and package verification.
Execute comprehensive silicon and package qualification programs (including high-temperature operating life (HTOL), early life failure rate (ELFR), electrostatic discharge/latch-up (ESD/LU), biased highly accelerated stress test (b/HAST), etc.) and conduct failure analysis to resolve quality issues.
Extract and analyze data from qualification programs, high-volume manufacturing, and field returns to identify failure mechanisms and trends for yield and reliability optimization.
Develop and implement physics-based statistical Quality and Reliability models (e.g., ELF, time-dependent dielectric breakdown (TDDB), negative bias temperature instability (NBTI) to predict device failure mechanisms and lifetime behaviors.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

job.title: Principal Scientific Developer
job.snippet:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
The Role
As a Senior ML Algorithm Developer, you will play a pivotal role in developing innovative machine learning algorithms and data-driven models for the next generation of AspenTech’s subsurface and engineering solutions. We are seeking a sharp, disciplined, and highly quantitative individual with a passion for working with complex data and cutting-edge technologies, leveraging your expertise in machine learning to design, develop and enhance core algorithms for oil and gas industry.
This position presents unique challenges, including the adoption of machine learning methodologies for subsurface data, handling extremely large datasets, and optimizing parallel computing, all within a collaborative environment where team members share knowledge and work on joint projects. The role will leverage the capabilities of AI tools to enhance development efficiency, accelerate innovation, and address complex technical challenges.
Your Impact
Design and develop machine learning algorithms in the geophysical domain.
Research and evaluate advanced machine learning approaches and emerging technologies.
Optimize code for runtime acceleration of large-scale jobs (HPC).
Work in collaboration with various teams in R&D, Testing and Product.
Your Impact
Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and software developers to develop new machine learning applications for the subsurface exploration systems
Collaborate with customers, product managers and technical staff to develop technology strategies to promote continuous innovation in our geophysical domain
Investigate new and developing technologies as they appear in industry and academia and determine how to leverage these new technologies into our software applications
What You'll Need
BSc degree in Computer Science, Geo Science, Physics, Math, Statistics, or other similar scientific discipline
Experience in Machine Learning and Neural Networks
Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or scikit-learn
Experience in Geoscience or related fields such as medical imaging, computer vision, machine vision, remote sensing, or scientific imaging – Advantage
Programming experience in C++ - Advantage
Written and verbal fluency in English
Strong interpersonal, communication, writing, and presentation skills

job.title: Module Equipment / Operation Technician
job.snippet:
Job Details
Job Description:
The Role and Impact
As a Manufacturing Technician, you will play a vital role in our high-volume production process by operating, monitoring, and maintaining advanced equipment to ensure efficiency and quality standards are met. You'll have hands-on involvement in troubleshooting and optimizing tools, conducting quality checks, and ensuring the seamless assembly of products. Your efforts will directly contribute to producing top-tier products that drive Intel's success in the technology industry.
Business Group
Join Intel Corporation, a global leader in semiconductor innovation, where you will be part of a dynamic team dedicated to advancing manufacturing excellence. Our team collaborates to deliver high-quality products that empower progress and innovation worldwide. We operate in fast-paced environments, leveraging cutting-edge processes and technologies that support Intel's broader mission of shaping the future of computing and connectivity.
Key Responsibilities
Operate, monitor, and maintain advanced manufacturing equipment to achieve output targets.
Conduct online equipment adjustments and optimize processes to maintain production efficiency.
Perform quality control evaluations on raw materials and finished products to ensure compliance with industry standards.
Troubleshoot and resolve nonstandard events in the production line to ensure stable operations.
Collaborate with the Manufacturing Operations Manager and team peers to meet production schedules and escalate risks when necessary.
Support installation, qualification, and maintenance of new or reused production equipment.
Maintain accurate production logs and required documentation per Standard Operating Procedures.
Drive cost and quality improvements and assist in incorporating process enhancements.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
Practical Engineer in a relevant technical field such as Electronics, Mechatronics, Mechanical, or Hardware Engineering with hands-on experience gained through internships, academic projects, coursework, or hands-on training.
Proficiency in technical English to interpret manuals, document logs, and communicate effectively.
Ability to work in a demanding 12-hour shift schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Preferred Qualifications
Relevant technical experience in a semiconductor cleanroom environment (FAB/SORT).
Hands-on expertise in operating, maintaining, or troubleshooting manufacturing equipment.
Familiarity with data-driven systems for tool monitoring and online adjustments.
Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping the success of our manufacturing processes. We encourage you to bring your enthusiasm, technical skills, and dedication to this exciting opportunity to grow with Intel.
Job Type
Experienced Hire
Shift
Shift 1 C (Israel)
Primary Location:
Israel, Kiryat-Gat
Additional Locations:
Posting Statement
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.
Position of Trust
N/A
Work Model for this Role
This role will require an on-site presence. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change.

job.title: Customer Support Technician - Kiryat Gat
job.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Kiryat Gat,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
We are looking for a talented
customer support technician
to join our account team & integrate within our field support group in
Kiryat Gat
to provide a unique customer experience by demonstrating outstanding technical capabilities and inter-personal skills.
What’s in it for you?
As a customer support technician at Applied Materials you’ll be working for a high growth international company, integrating into the heart of the manufacturing process of advanced digital devices. You’ll get the opportunity and practice to work on the most advanced semiconductor equipment while learning new skills or perfecting existing ones such as advanced trouble shooting and problem solving, project management, robotics, semiconductor device manufacturing processes and more. job.title: Machine Learning Engineer
job.snippet:
Chips Talk, We Listen
proteanTecs is a game-changing startup that's giving advanced electronics the power to report on their own health. In a digital world built for autonomous driving, cloud computing, and AI, we depend on computing systems daily. But how can we guarantee their safety, reliability and functionality? proteanTecs is the first-ever company to provide visibility into next-gen chips while they are operating, based on the power of on-chip monitoring, machine learning, and data analytics.
Here at proteanTecs, you'll be part of a team that's unlocking deep insights to make electronics more reliable, efficient, and high-quality. We're trusted by industry leaders in data centers, automotive, communications, and consumer devices – we work with the world's largest and most notable companies in tech.
Why proteanTecs is a great place to work:
Fast-paced and impactful:
We're a mission-driven startup, so you'll tackle new challenges daily, wear many hats, and see your work directly influence the future of electronics.
Supportive company culture
: Learn from the best. Our 200+ team members are experts in their field with a proven track record of success, and they're committed to fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment.
International presence:
We're a multinational company with a diverse team across multiple locations around the globe. You'll collaborate on projects with international impact, gaining a global perspective of the tech industry.
Work with industry leaders:
Our solutions are used by the biggest names in tech. You'll be part of the team creating the next generation of groundbreaking products.
Cutting-edge playground:
We use the latest machine learning, platforms, and tools to push boundaries and achieve breakthroughs.
Real-world impact:
Our work keeps data centers, cars, and other critical systems running smoothly. Your work will directly contribute to safer, more reliable electronics.
We are here for the win:
Backed by industry veterans and leading investors, we offer a stable and secure work environment with plenty of room for growth.
We are looking for a
Senior Machine Learning Algorithm Engineer
who is passionate about solving complex, real-world problems at the intersection of hardware and software.
Location: Tel-Aviv in hybrid model.
Responsibilities:
Develop advanced ML algorithms using data from proteanTecs Agents embedded in silicon. Example domains include:
Lifetime predictions
Clustering and dimensionality reduction
Parametric modeling and screening
Time-series forecasting
Lead end-to-end algorithm lifecycle: ideation → research → POC → design → implementation → validation → deployment.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and directly with customers to continuously refine and enhance deployed solutions.
Drive integration of AI-enhanced tools and intelligent pipelines into ML workflows.
Requirements:
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering – MUST
5+ years experience in algorithm development, preferably in complex, data-intensive environments
Deep expertise in Python, including statistical and machine learning packages
Proven experience across all algorithm development phases: research, implementation, testing, deployment, and debugging· Familiarity with testing frameworks (e.g., unit tests, E2E tests, performance and memory profiling)
Intensive usage of AI coding tools like Cursor or equivalent (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeWhisperer)
Advantage
M.Sc. or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
Prior experience with:
HW/SW integration or ATE/Chip testing
Version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD tools
Distributed compute frameworks (e.g., Spark, MLRun)
Containerization and cloud orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes, cloud APIs)
Business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau or equivalent)
AI platforms and agents that interface with model training, data annotation, performance monitoring, or autonomous debugging
Familiarity with chip production or design methodologies

job.title: Director of Organization & Methods
job.snippet:
Enlight is looking for a
Head of Organization & Methods
to lead the development and continuous improvement of the company’s operating model, processes and ways of working. The role will ensure that cross-company processes are clear, effective, aligned with business needs and continuously evolving as the organization grows.
Responsibilities:
Define, standardize and continuously improve cross-company processes, governance and ways of working.
Ensure processes are up to date, practical and aligned with business needs.
Define clear ownership, R&R and decision-making authorities across key processes.
Establish and maintain process KPIs and performance measures.
Identify process gaps, inefficiencies and opportunities for simplification, automation and AI.
Lead cross-functional process improvement initiatives and drive adoption across the organization.
Establish mechanisms to ensure processes remain relevant as the business, organization and operating environment evolve.
Partner with business units and corporate functions to embed consistent and effective ways of working.
Requirements:
7+ years of experience in Organization & Methods, Business Operations, Process Excellence, Consulting or a similar role.
Proven experience designing and implementing cross-functional processes and operating models.
Strong understanding of governance, R&R, process management and organizational effectiveness.
Excellent stakeholder-management and influencing skills, with the ability to drive change without direct authority.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a pragmatic, business-oriented approach.
Experience with process automation, data and AI – advantage.
Experience in renewable energy, construction, infrastructure or water – preferred.
Ability to operate hands-on in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Relevant academic degree – preferred.
Excellent Hebrew and English.

job.title: PCBA Technologist for Engineering Team
job.snippet:
Job Description
Our Company is where we transform vision into reality. It's where ideas become technologies, and cutting-edge technologies become solutions for animal care and management.
We support farmers by providing real-time actionable information to help them manage their herds. It provides pet owners with smart devices and data that give them a better understanding of their pet's activity and health needs, enriching relationships. It helps conservationists safeguard natural environments and wildlife.
Leveraging decades of Technological Research & Development experience across many markets, technologies, and species, along with development environments and Quality Assurance procedures, we're always inventing new ways to look after the health and well-being of animals. Our decades of experience keep us ahead of the curve by leveraging advanced Technological Solutions from enhancing the precious bond between people and their pets, to advancing animal healthcare and wildlife preservation.
Position Summary
The Technologist is responsible for supporting the transition of products from development to manufacturing and sustaining production throughout the product lifecycle. The role focuses on PCB/PCBA technologies, manufacturing processes, supplier management, DFM/DFT reviews, failure analysis, engineering change implementation, and continuous process improvement.
The company is based in Netanya.
Responsibilities
Serve as the technical focal point for PCB and PCBA manufacturing technologies.
Work closely with the R&D and Lead DFM, DFA, reviews for new and existing products.
Support NPI activities and production transfer to manufacturing sites.
Review PCB stack-ups, materials, fabrication drawings, Gerber data, and manufacturing documentation.
Work closely with PCB and PCBA suppliers to resolve manufacturing issues and optimize yield.
Support engineering changes (ECO/ECR) and product lifecycle activities.
Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions for production and field failures.
Review and approve manufacturing documentation including INFO files, EQ files, specifications, and work instructions.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, cost, and manufacturability.
Support incoming quality requirements and supplier qualification activities.
Collaborate with R&D, Quality, Operations, , and Manufacturing teams worldwide.
Provide technical guidance regarding PCB technologies, materials, surface finishes, vias, stack-ups, and assembly processes.
Published effectively report results to peers and management
Manage the Spec and requirements of the Battery and NFC
Requirements
B.Sc. in Electronics Engineering.
Minimum 10 years of experience in PCB/PCBA manufacturing technologies.
Deep understanding of PCB fabrication and assembly processes.
Knowledge of IPC standards (IPC-A-600, IPC-A-610, IPC-6012, IPC-2221, etc.).
Experience working with PCB design tools and manufacturing validation tools (Valor, PCBflow, BluePrint, Altium, OrCAD, etc.).
Strong understanding of electronic components and manufacturing constraints.
Experience with supplier management and contract manufacturers.
Ability to analyze manufacturing defects and lead corrective actions.
Excellent communication skills in Hebrew and English.
Self-motivated, organized, and capable of working in a global matrix organization.
Advantages
Experience with RF products, batteries, NFC, or IoT devices.
Familiarity with compliance and certification requirements.
Experience supporting high-volume manufacturing environments.
Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.

Required Skills
Accountability, Communication, Electrical Engineering

job.title: Software Engineer, ML (Technical Leadership)
job.snippet:
The financial risk management (FRM) machine learning principal will be the most senior machine learning engineer and strategist for financial risk at Meta. The principal will enable the risk organization to deliver significant lift over current long range objectives for friction and leakage through the generation of new Machine Learning opportunities for the organization and support of successful delivery of the risk management ML architecture. This person will partner closely with the FRM engineering leader (Director level) and be part of Meta’s risk management leadership circle.
Software Engineer, ML (Technical Leadership) Responsibilities:
Address core business and technical machine learning opportunities: elevate the existing portfolio of machine learning solutions to be state-of-the-art for minimizing Meta’s financial losses (due to leakage, good revenues loss and friction). Following are a few examples of technical and business problems we aim to address. - Provide a solution for optimizing the risk machine learning model ensemble (covering the entire end-to-end advertiser funnel including detection, decisioning, enforcement and remediation) through optimization of the current model portfolio and individual models. - Minimize the impact of the prolonged financial fraud feedback loop. - Improve models’ measurement and performance. - Optimize data/label strategy. - Optimize balance between specific targeted model strategy and broad umbrella model strategy to optimize for short and long term benefits
Lead Research and Introduction of Advanced Technologies: - Collaborate with Financial Integrity's senior ML Engineers to lead the research and introduction of deep learning and Large Language Model (LLM) technologies. - Remain current on industry-wide advancements in ML and introduce relevant advancements in Financial Risk Management
Collaborate on Next-Generation ML Architecture: - Work closely with financial harms principals and risk management tech leads to deliver the next-generation ML architecture for Meta's risk management system. - Collaborate with Principal ML engineers from across the company to adopt best industry and Meta practices within the FRM team. - Resolve or mitigate design dilemmas, balancing business and technical trade-offs. - Identify and initiate opportunities for collaboration and impact with other organizations at Meta
Identify and Initiate New Business Opportunities: - Collaborate with Meta FinTech, Central Integrity and Core Ads Growth partnerships to identify and initiate new business opportunities based on third-party capabilities. - Conduct proof of concept for different opportunities and initiate integrations to enhance business performance
Grow Other Senior ML Engineers - Actively invest in the growth of other senior ML engineers through goal-driven formal and informal mentorship. Provide regular feedback to other engineers regarding their technical work
Minimum Qualifications:
Extensive experience in supporting and evolving a portfolio of ML models that deliver on critical business goals
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience working with ML models in financial risk or similar financial contexts
About Meta:
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about  benefits  at Meta.

Identify and Initiate New Business Opportunities: - Collaborate with Meta FinTech, Central Integrity and Core Ads Growth partnerships to identify and initiate new business opportunities based on third-party capabilities. - Conduct proof of concept for different opportunities and initiate integrations to enhance business performance

job.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Mig Ha'emek,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
Key Responsibilities
Performs standard Tier I procedures including wafer measurement.
Performs preventative maintenance and wet cleans independently. Assists senior engineers with corrective maintenance as needed.
Disassembles, cleans and rebuilds kits as part of kit management quality.
Learns and applies diagnostic techniques and use of documentation and test equipment with assistance from senior engineers.
Able to diagnose and resolve basic technical problems.
Strives to perform BKM’s. Uses knowledge management systems. Follows all IP guidelines.
Has the ability to represent Applied Materials to the customer. Uses good customer service skills at all times while maintaining a professional demeanor. Displays respect for the customer by maintaining a neat and orderly work area. Demonstrates a positive attitude in less than optimal customer situations.
Complies with all safety procedures and consistently demonstrates safety as a value.
Other Requirements
: This is a physically demanding position that often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Impact
Impacts the quality of own work

Uses communication skills to exchange of information

Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular

Yes, 10% of the Time

No

job.title: Production Planner
job.snippet:
Join UCT
and be part of
the fastest-growing sector in the world
! We indirectly touch every semiconductor chip that goes into every smartphone, smart car and device that uses artificial intelligence. This is a critical time for the semiconductor industry and for UCT - as technology evolves, we evolve with it. UCT is a diverse workplace where every talented employee is committed to continuous innovation, challenging the status quo and exceeding customer expectations. If you are a person with a relentless drive to succeed, a strong focus on quality with a passion for success -
join us today!
UCT
is looking for a talented
Production Planner
to join us in
Israel!
The Planner III is responsible for developing and maintaining production plans and master schedules to meet customer requirements and optimize resource utilization. This role performs advanced planning functions, including simulation modeling, scenario optimization, and capacity analysis, while reconciling material and production conflicts. The Planner III collaborates across engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery, quality compliance, and continuous improvement in a fast-paced, engineer-to-order environment.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Perform simulation modeling and scenario optimization to improve planning accuracy and efficiency.
Prepare and present Rough-Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP) and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) reports to senior management.
Manage production planning and control for assigned lines, ensuring schedule adherence and material availability.
Develop and maintain master production schedules based on engineering plans and specifications.
Create, release, monitor, and close work orders throughout the production cycle.
Analyze labor loading and capacity requirements to ensure schedule feasibility.
Troubleshoot production control issues and implement corrective actions promptly.
Monitor and resolve process shortages to maintain schedule integrity.
Collaborate with engineering, quality, purchasing, and operations to ensure specifications and quality standards are met.
Facilitate operations and material status meetings to communicate priorities and resolve issues.
Coordinate engineering change orders and update schedules accordingly.
Interface with customers as needed to confirm delivery schedules or address concerns.
Knowledge, Skills, Experience:
Expertise in production planning, scheduling, and capacity analysis.
Ability to read and interpret engineering bills of materials (BOM) and technical specifications.
Strong analytical skills for simulation modeling and scenario planning.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for internal and external interactions.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with MRP/ERP systems.
Meeting facilitation and stakeholder management skills to drive alignment and accountability.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in managing complex schedules.
Ability to build effective cross-functional relationships and work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Education, Certifications, Requirements:
5+ years of planning experience with working knowledge of quick-turn, low volume, engineer-to-order production environment.
5+ years of experience using advanced planning tools such as Kinaxis, APO or ASCP.

About the Role
Provide strong engineering leadership to a team of antenna and electromagnetics engineers. Define R&D objectives, drive technological innovation, mentor and develop team members, plan resources, assign priorities, and ensure technical excellence.
Lead the development of antennas and antenna arrays for airborne communication, navigation, and radar systems—from requirements definition and electromagnetic design through prototype manufacturing and laboratory/antenna range testing.
Perform and oversee electromagnetic simulations and system analyses using tools such as CST, MATLAB, and Link Budget calculations.
Lead antenna design activities within multidisciplinary programs from concept through production and system integration. Manage schedules, milestones, and deliverables, and prepare technical specifications and Statements of Work (SOW).
Collaborate closely with system engineering, mechanical engineering, quality, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and IT teams.
Manage subcontractors and work directly with external vendors and manufacturers.
Interface with customers, support production activities, and present technical data in design reviews and technical forums.
Requirements
M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering with specialization in Antennas or RF – Mandatory
Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering (Antennas/RF) – Advantage
At least 5 years of hands-on experience in antenna development – Mandatory
Minimum 4 years of managerial or technical leadership experience, with strong multitasking and prioritization skills
Experience presenting technical data to stakeholders and customers in design reviews and technical forums
Proven experience in the design and implementation of airborne antennas
Experience in designing antennas for data links, flight termination systems, and telemetry
Experience in GPS antenna array design – Advantage
Hands-on experience performing measurements in antenna ranges, including analysis and post-processing of measurement results
Proficiency in electromagnetic modeling and simulation tools such as CST, HFSS, FEKO
About Us
Our site is the leading center for advanced system development, design, and engineering.
The division leverages extensive experience and technological excellence to deliver some of the most advanced systems in the world. Our product portfolio includes air and missile defense systems, space and launch technologies, command and control systems, precision strike solutions, as well as simulation and training systems.
As a prime contractor and system integrator working with governments and armed forces worldwide, we provide full lifecycle solutions—from early concept analysis and R&D through manufacturing, integration, deployment, and long-term support.

job.title: Advanced Drone R&D Engineer
job.snippet:
Regulus is an agile defense-tech startup tackling the most complex challenges in counter-drone and uncrewed defense. With hundreds of combat-proven systems deployed by the IDF and global partners, we are now engineering the next generation of C-UxS (Counter-Uncrewed Systems). We leverage advanced electronic warfare and kinetic measures to detect and neutralize hostile threats. If you want to push technological boundaries while safeguarding Israel and our allies, join us at this pivotal stage of our growth.
This is a unique opportunity to join a company at a pivotal growth stage and help shape its products, culture, and future.
We are seeking a highly technical, hands-on
Advanced Drone R&D Engineer
to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for researching, assembling, and testing advanced drone technologies.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct in-depth research on drone hardware, datalinks, radios, and RF protocols (including ELRS, LoRa, and DJI systems).
Research and evaluate RF jamming techniques, spoofing, and anti-jamming solutions.
Assemble, wire, and integrate various drone components, payloads, and Linux-based companion computers using TCP/IP networking.
Configure and test multi-constellation GNSS systems, including RTK setups and satellite tracking optimization.
Perform precise soldering, wiring, and electronic troubleshooting in a lab environment.
Write clear, detailed technical reports on research findings, assembly procedures, and test results for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Requirements:
Strong understanding of drone flight controllers, datalinks, radios, and RF protocols
Familiarity with link budgets, antenna gain, signal attenuation, and GNSS/GPS tracking (ephemeris, cold starts).
Proficiency in Linux (command line) and TCP/IP networking.
Proven experience in drone assembly, including the ability to solder and work with small electronic components.
Excellent written communication skills with the ability to produce clear and concise technical reports.
Demonstrated ability to fly multirotor and/or fixed-wing drones - Advantage

job.title: Director of Support Engineering
job.snippet:
About Unframe
Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.
Backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV Partners with $100M in Series B funding, we’re building a fast-growing, revenue-generating company working with Fortune 500 customers globally.
About The Role
We're looking for a Director of Support Engineering to build and lead Unframe's technical support function from the ground up, based in our Tel Aviv office.
You'll be the founding leader of our Support Engineering organization, building the processes, tooling, and team that connect our enterprise customers with Product and Engineering. Reporting to the VP Product Growth, you'll combine deep hands-on technical expertise with building an AI-native support operation designed to resolve complex issues independently and scale efficiently.
What You'll Do
Build the Support Engineering function from scratch, including processes, workflows, SLAs, escalation paths, and tooling.
Lead technical support for global enterprise customers, owning complex issues, escalations, and customer communication.
Investigate technical issues hands-on, including debugging APIs and integrations, analyzing logs, and performing root cause analysis.
Hire and develop a team of Support Engineers capable of resolving issues independently, minimizing reliance on Engineering.
Build an AI-native support operation, leveraging LLMs, AI agents, and intelligent workflows to automate issue investigation, troubleshooting, and knowledge management.
Build and maintain a living knowledge base, partnering with Product and Engineering to identify recurring issues and drive continuous improvements.
What We're Looking For
6+ years of experience in technical support, support engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles, including experience leading technical teams.
Proven experience building or significantly improving support functions, ideally in a startup or scale-up environment.
Experience supporting global enterprise customers, ideally Fortune 500.
Strong hands-on technical capabilities, including troubleshooting production issues, APIs, integrations, logs, and complex system behavior.
Hands-on experience building AI-powered workflows or agents using LLMs and modern AI tools, with a strong understanding of how AI can transform technical support operations.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, strong ownership, and the ability to prioritize under pressure.
Comfortable combining hands-on technical work with team leadership.
Why join us?
You’ll have the opportunity to build and shape the support function at Unframe from the ground up, working directly with global enterprise customers and alongside Product, Engineering, and company leadership. This is a highly impactful role for someone who enjoys combining customer ownership, operational thinking, and technical problem-solving in a fast-moving AI company. If you like creating structure where none exists yet and want to influence both customer experience and product direction, this role will give you exactly that.

job.title: Technical Project Manager - Post training
job.snippet:
AI21 is an AI lab building frontier models and AI systems for the enterprise since 2017, and the only Israeli foundation lab that have trained LLMs from scratch.
Creator of the Jurassic and Jamba model families, AI21 today offers its lab-as-a-service for specialized intelligence: Forward-Deployed Researchers and a harness- and model-training platform that turn open foundations into models its customers own, delivered with the weights, recipes and evaluations that keep them theirs.
Role Overview
As an Applied AI Lead, you will be responsible for the successful design, execution and delivery of strategic, customer-facing AI projects from initial customer engagement and technical scoping through execution and production delivery. Operating at the intersection of technical customer leadership, AI expertise, and technical project management, you will guide an interdisciplinary team of engineers, algorithm developers, linguists, and infrastructure experts, driving alignment and execution. You are a technical leader and trusted customer partner, translating complex AI concepts, building deep client trust, and driving project scope, milestones, risks, and execution, while balancing resources, timelines, and quality.
Requirements:
Key Requirements
Deep Technical AI Expertise:
Strong technical understanding of modern AI/LLM systems and model training processes, with the ability to engage credibly with engineers and algorithm developers.
Ability to navigate technical trade-offs and provide sound technical judgment across the AI lifecycle, including training, evaluation, data and inference.
Project Management:
Ability to define and drive scope, milestones, priorities, dependencies and success criteria, while proactively managing risks and blockers.
Strong execution and communication skills, with the ability to create clarity in complex and ambiguous environments.
Orchestrating multiple high-stakes, expensive projects and navigating internal and external stakeholders under tight schedules and technical uncertainty.
Technical Customer Relations: Driven by a genuine interest in customer success, you possess exceptional client-facing skills with a talent for managing high-profile relationships, establishing healthy communication routines, understanding nuanced customer needs, and building lasting trust.
Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence:
Proven ability to lead without authority across diverse, interdisciplinary teams while fostering strong internal routines and collaboration.
Working with internal and external senior management, including legal and finance, across different resolutions and depths.
Product Definition: Ability to define what a "good" model output looks like. Experience writing data specs, resolving behavior tradeoffs, establishing success metrics, and curating golden datasets.
About Us:
AI21 is one of the leading, most experienced foundational AI labs in the world.
As companies start to deploy AI agents at scale, they face challenges rooted in missing expertise and ownership. We help companies scale their AI agents - sustainably. We automatically reduce token cost and waste without harming frontier quality, replacing weeks or months of manual tuning. This is achievable by applying advanced research and methodologies across the stack, from intelligent model routing and up to harness and model training.

job.title: Import Export Coordinator
job.snippet:
Get SAT is the leading provider of micronized satellite on-the-move terminals for ground, air, and maritime applications.
Our state-of-the-art flat panel technology, along with a powerful controller, creates the best in its class SWaP product line on the market.
Get SAT is looking for an
Import Export Coordinator
to join our operations department.
In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating the company's import and export activities, ensuring the timely delivery of components, equipment, and systems used in our satellite communication products. This position requires strong ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while managing multiple interfaces and priorities.
Responsibilities
Coordinate and monitor import and export shipments from order placement to final delivery.
Prepare and manage shipping, customs, and export documentation.
Work closely with freight forwarders, shipping companies, customs brokers, and suppliers.
Track purchase orders and deliveries, identify delays, and drive timely resolution.
Maintain accurate shipment records and provide ongoing status updates.
Support ongoing supply chain and operational activities.
Requirements
Minimum 3 years of experience in import/export and logistics.
High level of English
Bachelor's degree.
Experience with Priority ERP system
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Availability for full-time employment and overtime work.

job.title: IT Support Technician
job.snippet:
IT Field Support Technician | Windows & Networking
Prefer solving IT problems hands-on rather than over the phone?
A leading organization in Central Israel is looking for an experienced
IT Field Support Technician
to provide on-site technical support across its headquarters and field locations.
This role is ideal for an IT professional who enjoys working directly with hardware, Windows systems, network connectivity, and end users in a dynamic field environment.
You'll take ownership of technical issues, troubleshoot complex problems, and help keep computers, devices, and workplace IT systems running smoothly.
What You'll Do
Provide hands-on IT support to employees at headquarters and field locations.
Diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues involving PCs and laptops.
Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain computers and endpoint devices.
Troubleshoot printers, peripheral devices, and workstation equipment.
Investigate and resolve complex technical issues in Windows environments.
Work with Windows 10, Windows 11, and Windows Server 2016.
Support Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Office applications.
Manage user accounts and troubleshoot access-related issues using Active Directory.
Diagnose network connectivity problems involving IP, DNS, and DHCP.
Independently manage technical incidents and provide effective on-site solutions.
Requirements
At least 3 years of professional experience as a PC Technician, Network Technician, IT Field Technician, or in a comparable hands-on IT support role.
Hands-on experience troubleshooting and maintaining PCs, laptops, printers, and peripheral devices.
Strong knowledge of computer hardware and operating systems.
Proficiency in Windows 10 and Windows 11.
Experience working with Windows Server 2016.
Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and Office applications.
Familiarity with Active Directory and user administration.
Knowledge of IP networking, DNS, and DHCP.
Experience investigating and resolving complex technical issues.
Ability to work independently and provide technical support in field environments.
Valid driver's license.
Advantages
Previous experience supporting users in large enterprise organizations.
Professional certification or completed training in PC hardware or networking.
Position Details
Location:
Central Israel
Employment Type:
Full-time
Work Model:
On-site / Field-based
Experience Level:
3+ years of relevant technical experience
If you're an experienced IT technician who enjoys hands-on troubleshooting, networking, and solving technical challenges in the field, we'd love to hear from you!

הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
"לחוות שרתים בשוהם דרוש/ה טכנאי/ת NOC תשתיות קו ראשון לניטור תשתיות החשמל, הקירור והסביבה בדאטה סנטר. התפקיד מתמקד בזיהוי alarms, triage ראשוני, תיעוד מדויק, הפעלת נוהלי אסקלציה והקפצת צוותי השטח, ואינו מחליף את הסמכות המקצועית של טכנאי חשמל או מכונות •	ניטור רציף של BMS, EPMS, DCIM, leak detection ומסכי מערכת הקריאות.
•	סינון alerts והבחנה בין הודעת תחזוקה, warning ו-critical alarm לפי מטריצת חומרה מאושרת.
•	פתיחת ticket ותיעוד קוד התרעה, מערכת, מיקום, timestamp, פעולה שננקטה וגורם שהוקפץ.
•	מעקב אחר טמפרטורה, לחות, airflow, chilled-water loops, CRAC/CRAH, CDU ונתוני חשמל מרכזיים.
•	הפעלת EOP/SOP ראשוני, תקשורת בקשר/טלפון והקפצת טכנאי השטח המתאים.
•	הפקת עדכוני סטטוס, מעקב עד סגירת האירוע והעברת משמרת מלאה.
•	ביצוע צ’ק-ליסטים ורישום telemetry כגון fuel level, UPS battery status וצריכת חשמל. משרה מלאה 24/7 במשמרות"
דרישות התפקיד
"•	 הכשרה טכנית, טכנאי/הנדסאי חשמל, HVAC, בקרה או אוטומציה יתרון משמעותי.
•	0–2 שנות ניסיון בסביבה טכנית, אחזקה, תפקיד צבאי טכני או מוקד בקרה.
•	אוריינות מחשב, יכולת קריאת dashboards, gauges ותרשימים בסיסיים.
•	משמעת נהלים, ערנות, תיעוד מדויק ותקשורת רגועה בזמן לחץ.
•	נכונות מלאה למשמרות 24/7."

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
לחברה בינלאומית מוכרת ומובילה דרוש/ה אחראי/ת טכנאי שירות שטח לתפקיד משמעותי המשלב אחריות מקצועית ותפעולית, הובלת פעילות השירות בשטח ומתן מענה טכני ללקוחות החברה.
התפקיד כולל אחריות על ליווי והנחיה מקצועית של טכנאי השירות, טיפול בתקלות מורכבות, פיקוח על איכות ביצוע העבודה ועמידה בסטנדרטים מקצועיים וביעדי השירות. במסגרת התפקיד נדרשת יכולת להוביל תהליכים, לתעדף משימות, לתת מענה לאתגרים העולים מהשטח ולפעול בשיתוף פעולה שוטף עם ממשקי החברה
עתודה ניהולית
תיאור התפקיד:
אחריות על פעילות טכנאי השירות ומתן מענה מקצועי בשטח.
ביצוע קריאות שירות, אבחון תקלות וטיפול במערכות סולאריות ובמערכות שונות לחימום מים.
ליווי מקצועי של עבודת הטכנאים ומתן פתרונות לתקלות מורכבות.
ביצוע בדיקות תקופתיות ופעולות תחזוקה.
עבודה מול מחלקות התיאום, ההנדסה והמלאי.
אחריות על איכות השירות ועמידה בנהלי החברה ובהנחיות הבטיחות.
טיפול בקריאות שירות בשטח.
איתור ותיקון תקלות במערכות סולאריות ובמערכות חימום מים.
ביצוע בקרות תקופתיות.
מכירת והחלפת אביזרים נלווים.
תנאים והטבות:
רכב צמוד.
תמריצים חודשיים בהתאם לעמידה ביעדים.
השתתפות בארוחות.
קרן השתלמות.
טלפון נייד.
הכשרה צמודה ע"ח החברה
למה לעבוד איתנו?
משרה יציבה לטווח ארוך עם אפשרות לקידום
רכב חברה צמוד
תנאים: שכר גבוה, מענקים רבעוניים, סבסוד ארוחות (סיבוס), החזרי נסיעות, תנאים סוציאליים מלאים, קרן השתלמות
שעות עבודה גמישות
ימי הכשרה בתשלום מלא.
גיבושים וערבי צוות מפנקים!

job.title: Senior AI Scientist
job.snippet:
About Marquee
Marquee builds AI that helps professional football clubs make better decisions about recruitment, squad planning and match preparation. We combine football data, machine learning and generative AI to turn complex analysis into practical insights for coaches, analysts and recruitment teams.
The Role
We are looking for a Senior AI Scientist to develop the models behind our football intelligence platform. This is a
hands-on individual contributor role with ownership of research projects from problem definition and experimentation through production and ongoing evaluation. You will work closely with our data, engineering, product and football experts on questions such as how a player may perform in a new league, how well they fit a team's playing style, and how teams can prepare for different opponents.
What you will do
Lead applied AI research for player evaluation, performance forecasting, tactical fit and team analysis.
Turn open football questions into testable hypotheses and clear modelling objectives.
Design, train and improve models using match events, player and team histories, and spatial or tracking data where available.
Build rigorous evaluations with credible baselines, tests on later seasons and unseen competitions, and explicit checks for data leakage, uncertainty and failure cases.
Partner with engineers to bring models into production, monitor their performance and improve reliability, latency and inference cost.
Collaborate on LLM and agent workflows that retrieve verified data and use model outputs to produce traceable football analysis.
Help shape research priorities, review code and experiments, and share methods and findings with the team.
What you will bring
5+ years of relevant experience in machine learning, AI research or data science, or equivalent depth
through substantial applied research, with evidence of independently delivering complex projects.
Strong Python skills and practical experience with PyTorch, SQL and scientific computing tools such as pandas and NumPy.
Solid foundations in machine learning, deep learning, statistics and experimental design, with the judgement to select methods that fit the problem.
Experience building and evaluating predictive models using large, imperfect datasets, including an understanding of missing data, selection bias and changing data distributions.
Strong background in data structures, algorithms, and machine learning fundamentals, with a deep understanding of data science methodologies and best practices.
Experience working with complex, high-dimensional football and sports datasets, including event data, tracking data, and physical/biometric metrics.
Proficiency in building automated data pipelines, ETL processes, and validation checks for heterogeneous external and internal data sources.
A track record of turning research into working products, with reproducible experiments, maintainable code and collaboration with engineering teams.
The ability to explain technical findings and limitations clearly, work independently and learn from product colleagues and domain experts.
Nice to have
An MSc or PhD in computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering or a related field.
Experience with transformers, sequence modelling, representation learning or self-supervised learning.
Experience building and evaluating LLM applications, retrieval systems or tool-using agents.
Experience with ranking and recommendation systems, probabilistic modelling or causal inference.
Experience with sports analytics, event or tracking data, or a strong interest in football.
Why Marquee
You will own research that reaches professional football clubs and work closely with the people who use it. The role offers room to explore new methods, influence the product and judge success by whether your models help clubs make better decisions.
How to apply
Show us research that reached real use. Please include your CV and a short example of an AI project you took from research to practical use, explaining the problem, your contribution and how you evaluated the result.

job.title: Offer Manager - Home Solutions
job.snippet:
Home Solutions is Schneider Electric's residential business focused on electrical distribution, smart home automation, and home energy management. The division develops solutions that improve safety, comfort, energy efficiency, and sustainability for homeowners through connected technologies, smart controls, energy monitoring, and integration of solar, battery storage, and EV charging systems.
We are looking for an Offer Manager to manage the offer and profitability of the home solution product groups, (KNX smart home + prosumer + EV Charger develop strategy for growing the business to increase sales volume of products/solutions/services and represent one face of Schneider Electric towards customers and partners. The scope is territory of Israel.
We're looking for
Electrical Engineering graduates
to join a dynamic role at the intersection of
technology, energy, and business
.
This is an excellent opportunity for engineers completing their specialization in
Power Systems
who are looking to launch a career combining technical expertise, customer engagement, and commercial exposure.
The position is defined as a
Offer
Manager
role within the
Marketing Department
.
Responsibilities:
Develops and maintains business relationships with current and prospective customers to generate business for Schneider Electric’s products/solutions/service in domain of Power Systems products.
Following of all marketing activities – Product launches, offer update, pricing, trainings, promotions, catalogues, support sales, competitor’s analysis.
Strategy – continually improve the business with update of commercial policy and development of new channels, partnerships and product availability.
Promote Schneider products, solutions and services beside planned meetings, presentations and training courses, in close coordination with Sales representatives and specialists in country and in Zone.
Establish contact and build close relations with assigned Business developers, to boost the business in domain of products/solutions/service.
Develop and continually improve the long-term contracts with strategic (license) partners to secure their growth – Follow up closely within regular visits, meetings, find new opportunities for extension of cooperation and new partnerships.
Joint and teamwork with selected partner on projects – coordinate activities on all levels.
Supplies management within written and oral reports on customer needs, problems, interests, competitive activities, and potential for selling new solutions, products and services.
Make sure that business is driven correctly to build the highest and most sustainable customer satisfaction.
Have precise and satisfactory level of communication within business partners and internally in company.
Respect the different policies, procedures, guidelines, as well as the law and behave according to company interest and rules, even if not precisely decided. Specifically: EMS, QMS, OHSMS, principles of responsibilities, conflict of interest, securities rules, IT security guidelines, Schneider Electric Corporate rules available throw intranet.
Qualifications:
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering Power System
Specialization in Power Systems/High Voltage is preferred
Recent graduates and candidates with no prior industry experience are welcome
Strong analytical and communication skills
Good English proficiency, including written and verbal communication skills
Exposure to Power Systems, Renewable Energy, Energy Storage (BESS), Smart Grids, EV Charging, Smart home or related academic projects/internships is considered an advantage
What's in it for me?
Meaningful work that directly impacts product success and business growth
Career development opportunities to expand your skills across the product marketing spectrum
Supportive, innovative team culture that encourages creativity and collaboration
Visibility with leadership and exposure to strategic initiatives that shape your future
At Schneider, we believe that every employee is a talent who deserves equal opportunities. This means you matter. Every individual needs to feel valued, supported, and treated fairly to do their best work.
Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: “We see you. We value you”. It’s more than just pay and benefits – it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed for you to perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential to shine as an impact maker.
Schneider Electric is there when it matters most to you
Our Total Rewards package outlines all the benefits and support you’ll enjoy as part of the Schneider Electric team:
Care for Yourself and Your Family. We ensure you feel secure with benefits that help you and your family thrive: health insurance contribution, life insurance, paid time off, parental and care leave, flexible work options and confidential counseling for psychological support.
Invest and Plan Your Future. We help you plan and invest for the future with competitive pay and programs: your base salary, short-term incentives or sales incentives.
Grow Your Skills and Career. We commit to helping you grow with ongoing performance and development conversations, Senior Talent Program, global career opportunities, access to our Schneider Career Hub for new positions, projects, and mentors, and learning platforms like Coursera to equip you with the skills for today and tomorrow.
Team Up in the Workplace. We encourage teaming up through project opportunities on the Schneider Career Hub, smart ways to collaborate, celebrating contributions via a recognition program, sharing your voice in our engagement survey, and fostering an inclusive, caring workplace.
Support Your Community. We make a difference in your community with volunteer leave, programs through the Schneider Electric Foundation, and initiatives that support youth education.
Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?
When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.
IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.
We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.
Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!
€40 billion global revenue
+9% organic growth
150 000+ employees in 100+ countries
You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled.
Schneider Electric aspires to be the most inclusive and caring company in the world, by providing equitable opportunities to everyone, everywhere, and ensuring all employees feel uniquely valued and safe to contribute their best. We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate, and ‘inclusion’ is one of our core values. We believe our differences make us stronger as a company and as individuals and we are committed to championing inclusivity in everything we do.
At Schneider Electric, we uphold the highest standards of ethics and compliance, and we believe that trust is a foundational value. Our Trust Charter is our Code of Conduct and demonstrates our commitment to ethics, safety, sustainability, quality and cybersecurity, underpinning every aspect of our business and our willingness to behave and respond respectfully and in good faith to all our stakeholders. You can find out more about our Trust Charter here
Schneider Electric is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities in the areas of recruiting, hiring, training, transferring, and promoting all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, color, gender, disability, national origin, ancestry, age, military status, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristic or conduct.

job.title: مهندس ومطوّر برمجيات - طلاب وخريجون جدد
job.snippet:
الشركة:
Hazol – הזול
مكان العمل:
(Hybrid)
من نحن؟
Hazol هي شركة تكنولوجية متطوّرة تعمل على تطوير تطبيقات ومنتجات رقمية حديثة، باستخدام تقنيات برمجية متقدمة.
نؤمن بأهمية الإبداع، والتعلّم المستمر، والعمل الجماعي، ونسعى إلى توفير بيئة عمل تتيح للمطوّرين اكتساب خبرة عملية حقيقية، وتطوير قدراتهم التقنية والمهنية، والمشاركة في بناء منتجات يستخدمها أشخاص على أرض الواقع.
عن الوظيفة
نبحث عن
مهندسي ومطوّري برمجيات مبتدئين (Junior Full Stack Developers)
للانضمام إلى فريق التطوير لدينا.
الوظيفة مناسبة بشكل خاص
لطلاب علوم الحاسوب وهندسة البرمجيات، والخريجين الجدد، ولكل من يمتلك معرفة أساسية في البرمجة ويرغب في بدء مسيرته المهنية واكتساب خبرة عملية.
لا نبحث بالضرورة عن أشخاص يمتلكون سنوات من الخبرة، بل عن أشخاص لديهم الشغف بالتكنولوجيا، والقدرة على التعلّم، والرغبة في التطوّر والمشاركة في مشاريع برمجية حقيقية.
ماذا ستفعل معنا؟
تطوير وصيانة تطبيقات ويب حديثة.
بناء وتطوير واجهات المستخدم (Frontend).
تطوير الأنظمة والخدمات الخلفية (Backend).
التعامل مع قواعد البيانات وواجهات البرمجة (APIs).

Looking for the next challenge in the world of Embedded C++?
We are recruiting C++ developers for VxWorks and Linux systems in a multidisciplinary environment.

✅ Working on complex and distributed systems (Distributed Systems)
✅ Development in an OOP architecture and multi-threading environment
✅ Working with C++11/14/17

• Introduction to multidisciplinary systems
• Understanding of distributed systems-based software architectures
• Familiarity with ALM tools for development and testing management (Azure DevOps)
• Agile methodology

job.title: Efficient/Green-AI Researcher
job.snippet:
Home/Careers/Efficient/Green-AI Researcher
Core AI Research
Efficient/Green-AI Researcher
This role focuses on reducing the environmental impact of AI and improving computational efficiency.
Apply for this roleManage an applicationBack to careers
Overview
This role focuses on reducing the environmental impact of AI and improving computational efficiency.
Responsibilities
Optimize model architecture: Design energy-efficient algorithms and hardware-aware model structures.
Develop compression techniques: Work on quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation to reduce resource consumption.
Evaluate carbon footprint: Measure energy usage of training and inference and propose ways to minimize it.
Collaborate with infrastructure teams: Work with HPC engineers and systems architects to implement efficient training pipelines.
Qualifications
PhD or master's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related fields.
Experience in model optimization, hardware accelerators, and environmental impact assessment.
Equal opportunity
TAIRC evaluates candidates using role-related evidence and documented review criteria. Employment decisions must not be based on protected personal characteristics.
Engagement pathways and compensation status
TAIRC is currently building its funding base. Opportunities identified as volunteer or unpaid do not provide compensation at this stage. Any future paid appointment would require available funding, organizational approval, applicable legal compliance, and a separate written agreement. Participation does not guarantee future employment or compensation.
Volunteer contribution interest may be reviewed only as a voluntary, scoped pathway.
Educational internship interest requires separate supervision, educational purpose, and legal review.
Advisory expressions of interest are not board or formal advisory appointments.
Future compensated employment is contingent on funding, approval, legal compliance, and a separate written offer.
Accessibility and accommodations
For an accommodation or alternate submission format, contact hr@tairc.com. The application form does not request medical documentation or sensitive identity documents.

Status Open

job.snippet:
Join RAFT's Operations team and work directly on our global communication infrastructure.
This hybrid role combines advanced technical troubleshooting (Tier 4) with hands-on field engineering at sites worldwide. You'll be responsible for resolving complex network, RF and Linux-related issues while supporting the deployment and operation of our long-haul wireless network.
What You'll Do
Troubleshoot complex RF, networking and Linux-based issues
Support the NOC with advanced analysis and escalated incidents
Work closely with R&D on system-level investigations
Deploy, upgrade and maintain communication sites worldwide
Build, activate and validate new network links and infrastructure
Travel internationally for installations, maintenance and critical field activities
Participate in on-call rotations
Requirements
Experience in Networking, Telecommunications or Infrastructure Engineering
Strong troubleshooting skills
Knowledge of Linux environments
Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols
Ability to work independently in field environments
Willingness to travel internationally
Nice to Have
RF / Wireless communication experience
Experience working with service providers and field deployments
NOC or Tier 3/4 support experience
Scripting or automation skills

job.title: Planning Specialist
job.snippet:
Natasha Denona Makeu
p is a globally recognized beauty brand founded by internationally renowned makeup artist Natasha Denona. Known for its innovation, premium-quality products, and trend-setting creativity, the brand has become a leading name in the global beauty industry, with a strong presence across international retail channels, e-commerce platforms, and strategic partnerships worldwide.
We are looking for a talented
Planning Specialist
to join our Supply Chain team!
In this role, you will combine strong analytical thinking with business understanding to ensure high forecast accuracy, healthy inventory levels, and exceptional customer service.
You will work closely with Supply Chain, Account Management, R&D and Finance to drive data-driven planning and support our continued growth.
Day To Day:
Drive end-to-end planning and inventory management processes.
Analyse large, complex datasets and translate insights into concrete business actions.
Challenge assumptions using data to continuously optimize processes.
Collaborate cross-functionally across departments to align forecasts and operational targets.
Support data-driven decision-making in a fast-moving operational environment.

3-5 years of experience
in Planning and inventory management principles.
Proven experience in building sales forecasts in a manufacturing company
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and hands-on experience with ERP systems (
SAP preferred
) as well as forecasting tools/planning systems.
Exceptional analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills; proven ability to analyze large datasets.
Fluent English (written and spoken) with excellent cross-functional communication skills.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, able to prioritize multiple tasks, and a true team player with a continuous improvement mindset.
Advantages:
Experience with BI tools (
Power BI, Tableau, Looker
).
Prior experience in the
Cosmetics
or
FMCG
industries.
Experience with
S&OP
(Sales and Operations Planning) processes.
