job.title: ADMS Solution Integrator
job.snippet:
Job Description Summary
Bietet Know-how für nachhaltigen Kundenerfolg und Wachstum im Post-Sales-Kundenlebenszyklus durch Schulung, professionellen Service, technischen Support, Verlängerungen, Erreichung von Ergebnissen, Bindung, Erweiterung und Kundenbetreuung mit digitalem Fokus. Verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung des Abteilungsbetriebs oder konzentriert sich auf die Ausführung von beruflichen Tätigkeiten innerhalb einer technischen Disziplin.Hat eine gewisse Autonomie, wird jedoch von festgelegten Richtlinien oder der Überprüfung der Endergebnisse geleitet.
Die Stelle ermöglicht die Änderung von Arbeitsabläufen und Praktiken, sofern die Endergebnisse den Standards der Akzeptanz (Qualität, Umfang, Aktualität usw.) entsprechen.
Job Description
Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten
Tragen zur Implementierung von MES-Lösungen unter Verwendung der Software-Suite bei. Übernehmen während des gesamten Lebenszyklus der Projekte die Verantwortung für technische Leistungen. Beteiligen sich während des gesamten Lebenszyklus von zugewiesenen Projekten an Entscheidungen bezüglich Architektur, Design und Funktionalität, um Programme hinsichtlich Budget, Zeit und Kundenerwartungen innerhalb des vorgegebenen Rahmens zu halten. Arbeiten eng mit dem Kunden zusammen, um dessen Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und Strategien zu entwickeln, die mittels Standortbewertungen auf seine Organisation zugeschnitten sind. Geben zudem während des Implementierungsprozesses gegenüber Kunden Standardempfehlungen zu Workflow, Anwendung, Benutzeroberfläche, Berichten, Tests und Uploads ab. Tragen die Verantwortung für die Bereitschaft und den Support für die Inbetriebnahme sowie für die Nachuntersuchungen und müssen mit internen Teammitgliedern und Kunden zusammenarbeiten, um die Kundenzufriedenheit zu gewährleisten
Nutzt vertiefte Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin sowie analytisches Denken und technische Erfahrung zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien.
Hat Kenntnisse über Best Practices und darüber, wie sich der eigene Bereich in andere integriert; ist sich des Wettbewerbs und der Faktoren bewusst, die das Unternehmen auf dem Markt auszeichnen
Nutzt ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, um kompliziertere Herstellungsprozesse mit technischer Vielfalt und/oder voneinander abhängigen Produktionszyklen anzugehen.Verwendet technische Erfahrung und analytisches Denken.Verwendet mehrere interne und begrenzte externe Quellen außerhalb der eigenen Teams, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Dient als Ressource für Kollegen mit weniger Erfahrung.Kann kleine Projekte mit geringen Risiken und Ressourcenanforderungen leiten.Erklärt Informationen; Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten, um Teammitglieder zu einem Konsens über Themen innerhalb des Feldes zu bewegen.Vermittelt Leistungserwartungen und kann vertrauliche Themen behandeln.
Grundqualifikationen
Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).
Gewünschte Eigenschaften
Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.
Additional Information
The job is open to men and women equally
Relocation Assistance Provided:
No

job.title: IT Service Specialist
job.snippet:
eToro is the trading and investing platform that empowers users to invest, share and learn. We were founded in 2007 with the vision of a world where everyone can trade and invest in a simple and transparent way. We have created an investment platform that is built around collaboration and investor education. On our platform, users can view other investors’ portfolios and statistics, and interact with them to exchange ideas, discuss strategies and benefit from shared knowledge.
We have 40 million registered users from 75 countries and our platform is available in 20 languages. eToro is an innovative, fast growing business and listed on Nasdaq in May 2025. We have over 1,500 employees across more than 10 offices around the globe, strategically positioned to serve the needs of users. You can find out more about eToro here.
We are constantly growing and are excited to share that we are looking for an It Specialist to join our fantastic team!
What you'll be doing?
Diagnose and resolve IT technical issues involving internet connectivity, Servers issues (VM and cloud), email clients, VPN, and various operating systems.
Leverage AI tools and assistants to streamline support workflows, automate routine tasks, and improve troubleshooting efficiency.
Monitor and resolve customer incidents, ensuring accurate classification and timely updates. Adhere to customer SLAs for swift service restoration. Expertly
Manage users and permissions in Active Directory, AZURE AD, G-suite, Terminal Services, and address hardware, software, and network-related issues.
Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, printers, meeting rooms, and other IT equipment.
Write scripts to optimize automation across the organization.
Troubleshoot software applications and operating system issues for seamless IT operations.
Look for trends occurring in the environment, gather evidence and facts to raise these to the attention of the team, so the problem can be identified and resolved, and future recurring issues can be avoided and collaborate with other IT team members to escalate and resolve complex technical issues.
Create procedures and create new documentation for both technical and end-user roles.
Stay current with the ongoing expansion and development of the company - be aware of system information, changes, and updates.
Provide troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving issues while maximizing customer satisfaction.
Provide comprehensive support to our entire organization, both locally and remotely.
Collaborate with vendors to procure hardware and software solutions as needed.
Stay updated on industry trends and advancements to recommend improvements in IT systems.
Requirements:
Want to join? You'll need:
UP to 3 years of proven experience as an IT Support Specialist or similar role.
Strong technical abilities in diverse technical fields (Windows, Mac environment, Networking, Security and Monitoring System)
Proficient in managing end users and permissions in Active Directory Servers, Office 365, Microsoft Intune, and Azure.
Knowledge of scripting (PowerShell / JSON / Jenkins)
Proven experience with AI tools in daily tasks and workflows.
Experience with managing systems on Virtual platforms (including clouds)
Basic understanding of networking concepts and protocols.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
Experience working with global teams, able to work both independently and collaboratively.
Ability to multitask.
Ability to work effectively under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and consistently meet SLA targets.
Customer-focused with a strong commitment to providing exceptional support.
Team Player.

job.title: Automation Engineer
job.snippet:
Arad Technologies is the development center for Arad Group, a world leader in IoT smart water measurement and management systems. Arad products are sold in more than 60 countries.
With millions of users worldwide, Arad water management software is a world-leading enterprise completely cloud-based SaaS.
Arad Technologies employs over 100 engineers and researchers, including Software, Firmware, Radio, hardware, hydraulics, mechanics, and more.
The Role
We are looking for a passionate, driven Automation Development Engineer to join our small, high-quality Automation Team. You will play a key role in designing and developing the software that automates Embedded SW Pipelines and V&V testing processes
for embedded IoT devices and systems, increasingly leveraging agentic AI workflows.
You will also take part in the development of SW Tools for internal usage and production lines.
This role offers the opportunity to design and implement a cutting-edge, AI-enhanced automation platform that will support the next generation of our IoT products.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop an automation platform for Embedded SW Pipelines and V&V testing processes, integrating agentic AI capabilities to enable smarter, autonomous workflows.
Take full ownership of your domain, working proactively to anticipate technical needs, address bottlenecks, and deliver comprehensive solutions without waiting for direction.
Maintain and enhance existing software to ensure robustness, stability, and performance.
Work closely with the Embedded Software and V&V teams to ensure implementation is accurate and aligned with priorities.
Analyse failures to identify root causes and implement effective, AI-assisted solutions.
Success in This Role Looks Like
Delivering high-performance, robust, stable software for Automation Solutions and Tools, including autonomous agentic AI implementations.
Taking complete ownership of your projects and operating in a proactive mode to drive them to successful completion.
Proactively identify areas for improvement and drive their implementation using both traditional and AI-driven approaches.
Demonstrate commitment to quality, testing, and continuous improvement.
Priorities in the First Few Months
Get up to speed on Arad's systems and products, current projects, and existing Automation platform architecture.
Become proficient with our development environments, tools, workflows, and AI integration strategies.
Make meaningful contributions to the development of automation capabilities and agentic workflows.
Requirements:
3+ years of software development experience using Python, C#, or another object-oriented programming language.
Proven experience building and deploying AI agentic projects, with a strong ability to design autonomous workflows, integrate LLMs, and leverage agent-based architectures for advanced automation.
Strong sense of personal ownership over your work, paired with a highly proactive, self-driven mindset.
Familiarity with embedded systems and hardware interfaces such as UART, GPIO, and ADC.
Strong understanding of CI/CD processes and tools for continuous integration and deployment.
Excellent analytical skills to identify problems and propose solutions.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills within cross-functional engineering teams
Nice-to-Haves (Preferred But Not Required)
Hands-on experience testing or automating tests for embedded, multidisciplinary products is a significant advantage.
Proficient in additional scripting languages, such as Bash or similar.
Hands-on experience with networked systems, including client/server architecture, cloud-based communication, and distributed systems.
Familiarity with Azure DevOps for source control, build pipelines, and project management
What We Offer
An opportunity to drive innovation in cutting-edge automation solutions that contribute to long-term sustainability.
A supportive, mission-driven team environment that values collaboration and shared success.
A meaningful role in shaping the future of water management technologies and smart infrastructure.

job.title: Operations Team Member
job.snippet:
Airobotics, a global leader in autonomous unmanned aerial systems (UAS), is seeking skilled and motivated professionals to join our Deployment and Technical Support team. The role includes deploying advanced autonomous systems at customer sites, operating the systems in day-to-day field activities, and providing direct technical support across civilian and defense projects.
Responsibilities:
Install, deploy, and operate autonomous systems at customer sites in Israel and occasionally abroad.
Perform system operation tasks during missions, demos, and routine activities.
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical issues in the field.
Provide ongoing technical support to customers, including documentation and follow-up of solutions.
Requirements:
Strong technical aptitude with excellent hands-on skills and fine motor abilities.
Fast learner with the ability to quickly understand new systems and technologies.
Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
Willingness to work in demanding field conditions, including overnight stays outside home.
Service-oriented, proactive, positive attitude, and “can-do” mindset.
High-level English (speaking, reading, writing) – mandatory.
Valid driver’s license (B) – mandatory.
Significant Advantages
Previous drone operation/flying experience.
CAAI (IAA) remote pilot license up to 25 kg.
Background in industrial or defense environments.
Foreign passport – strong advantage for international project readiness.

job.title: Financial Controller - FinOps & Financial Innovation
job.snippet:
About us
Energix Renewables is a publicly traded, global renewable energy company operating across the United States, Poland, and Israel. Since its founding in 2009, Energix has grown into one of Israel's leading renewable energy platforms, driven by long-term vision, operational excellence, and a commitment to sustainable impact. We operate as a fully integrated renewable energy company, leading the entire lifecycle of solar (PV), wind, and energy storage projects - from origination and development through construction and long-term ownership. As listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and as part of the Alony-Hetz Group, Energix combines financial strength, global scale, and entrepreneurial spirit to accelerate the transition to clean energy worldwide.
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Financial Controller to join our Finance team and take a leading role in driving process optimization, automation, and the integration of AI tools across the department.
This is a unique role that combines day-to-day accounting responsibilities with a strong process- and technology-oriented mindset. It is ideal for someone who wants to make an impact not only on financial outcomes, but also on the way financial processes are managed, analyzed, and delivered.
The role is designed for a Financial Controller with a strong technological and process-oriented mindset, who will be responsible for identifying, designing, and leading improvements to financial processes through automation, data, and AI, alongside ongoing accounting responsibilities.
Key Responsibilities
Accounting & Financial Reporting
Manage monthly and quarterly closing processes.
Prepare financial statements and support the financial reporting process.
Work regularly with the company’s financial systems, including Oracle.
Prepare and produce financial reports.
Process Optimization & Automation
Map manual processes and identify automation opportunities across accounting, collections, payments, and financial reporting.
Design and implement more efficient workflows by leveraging existing tools and introducing new solutions where needed.
Implement AI-based solutions within financial processes.
Manage tasks and monitor processes to ensure effective execution and follow-through.
Document and analyze financial processes, define business requirements, and translate financial needs into technological solutions.
Continuous Improvement
Define KPIs for financial processes and monitor their effectiveness and efficiency.
Identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement, taking end-to-end ownership from problem identification and solution design through implementation and measurement of the actual business impact.
Work with external system and technology vendors as needed.
Requirements
Previous experience in an accounting and/or finance operations role - required.
Familiarity with Oracle - significant advantage.
Experience with monday.com or a similar task/project management tool - advantage.
Previous experience implementing automation processes or AI tools within a financial environment - advantage.
Strong process-oriented thinking, with the ability to identify problems and develop practical solutions.
Strong interest and curiosity in automation and AI tools; formal programming experience is not required.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across departments.
Advanced Excel skills - required.
Strong data analysis capabilities - required.
Experience with Power BI, Python, and/or SQL - advantage.

job.title: Assistant Controller
job.company: Harmoniz - The Art of Seed Innovation
job.snippet:
Company Description:
Harmoniz - The Art of Seed Innovation is a global agtech company specializing in breeding greenhouse seeds. The company is focused on developing innovative, great-tasting, and virus-resistant tomatoes, expanding into pepper and cucumber seed development.
Main Purpose of the Role
:
Provide financial and operational support to the Finance Department, contributing to the company's business objectives through accurate financial management, reporting, and process improvement. The role requires a high level of professionalism, accuracy, and collaboration, ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
Responsibilities
:
Oversee, monitor, and control the day-to-day activities of the Accounting Department.
Prepare periodic financial statements and management reports for senior management and investors.
Monitor and oversee the financial activities of the company's subsidiaries.
Manage and control the company's cash flow on an ongoing basis.
Lead the annual budgeting process and perform continuous budget monitoring and variance analysis (budget vs. actual).
Oversee statutory reporting to government authorities (VAT, Income Tax) and ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements.
Manage procurement-related financial processes, supplier payments, customer collections, and withholding tax administration.
Maintain ongoing communication with external stakeholders, including banks, external auditors, legal counsel, and government authorities.
Manage and monitor payment methods, including checks and corporate credit cards.
Maintain and oversee the company's fixed asset register.
Lead and coordinate the annual financial audit process.
Work closely with the Payroll Department on attendance reporting, payroll-related reporting, and statutory deductions.
Prepare, submit, and monitor applications for government grants and incentives.
Manage corporate agreements and company documentation.
Provide ongoing support to the Controller and assist with the Finance Department's day-to-day operations.
Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor's degree in Accounting and Certified Public Accountant (CPA) qualification.
Completion of an internship with distinction at a Big 4 accounting firm.
Bachelor's degree in Law or Economics – an advantage.
MBA – an advantage.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, with advanced Excel skills required.
Experience with Priority ERP – a significant advantage.
Fluent Hebrew and English (written and spoken).
Spanish – an advantage.
Competencies:
High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and organizational skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Fast learner with the ability to work independently.
Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under pressure.
High professional ethics, integrity, and customer-service orientation.

job.title: AI & Software Infra Engineer
job.snippet:
BioCatch is the leader in Behavioral Biometrics, a technology that leverages machine learning to analyze an online user’s physical and cognitive digital behavior to protect individuals online. BioCatch’s mission is to unlock the power of behavior and deliver actionable insights to create a digital world where identity, trust and ease seamlessly co-exist. Today, BioCatch counts over 35 of the top 100 global banks as customers who use BioCatch solutions to fight fraud, drive digital transformation, and accelerate business growth. BioCatch’s Client Innovation Board, an industry-led initiative including American Express, Barclays, Citi Ventures, and National Australia Bank, helps BioCatch to identify creative and cutting-edge ways to leverage the unique attributes of behavior for fraud prevention. With over a decade of analyzing data, more than 80 registered patents, and unparalleled experience, BioCatch continues to innovate to solve tomorrow’s problems. For more information, please visit www.biocatch.com.
We are looking for a proactive and skilled
AI & Software Infra Engineer
with a strong
Agentic AI focus
to join our team. In this role, you will design and build the infrastructure, tooling, and AI-powered automation that keep our engineering systems reliable, scalable, and intelligent.
You will be responsible for embedding GenAI and agentic capabilities into our internal developer platforms and CI/CD workflows - creating frameworks, libraries, and multi-agent systems that accelerate automation, improve system stability, and unlock new levels of engineering productivity. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives at the intersection of infrastructure engineering and applied AI.
The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in Python (FastAPI) and/or TypeScript, Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), containerization, and cloud infrastructure - combined with hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, agents, MCP servers, and RAG pipelines.
What you'll be doing:
AI Platform Development:
Design and build internal AI platforms, reusable SDKs, libraries, tools, and MCP servers for agentic applications.
Agentic Workflow Development:
Develop single- and multi-agent workflows covering planning, tool selection, delegation, state and memory management, execution, retries, fallbacks, error recovery, and human-in-the-loop approval.
AI-Powered Infrastructure & CI/CD:
Integrate AI capabilities into Kubernetes infrastructure and Jenkins/GitHub Actions pipelines to improve development, testing, deployment, and operational workflows.
AI Observability & Evaluation:
Implement agent tracing, prompt and tool-call logging, latency and error monitoring, token and cost tracking, regression testing, and failure analysis.
AI Security & Governance:
Apply guardrails, access controls, auditability, and governance practices to ensure agents operate safely and reliably.
End-to-End Platform Ownership:
Own AI platform capabilities from architecture through production and build reusable solutions that accelerate adoption across engineering teams.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Collaborate with engineering and business teams to identify high-impact AI opportunities and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
AI Research & Innovation:
Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, models, and cloud technologies and promote their adoption where they provide measurable value.
Requirements:
AI & GenAI
AI Experience
— Mandatory:
Minimum of 1 year of hands-on production experience building LLM-powered applications, AI agents, multi-agent systems, or internal AI platforms.
Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, and OpenAI and/or Anthropic APIs.
Strong understanding of agent architecture, including planning, tool selection, delegation, state and memory management, retries, fallbacks, error recovery, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Experience with prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, and structured outputs.
Experience building and integrating MCP servers and clients, including tool schemas, permissions, reliable execution, and error handling.
Experience implementing AI evaluations and regression tests that measure agent quality, task completion, tool usage, behavioral changes, and failure modes.
Experience with AI observability, including traces, prompts, tool calls, latency, errors, token consumption, costs, and production debugging.
Understanding of AI guardrails, security controls, auditability, governance, and safe agent execution.
Ability to build reusable AI platform capabilities that accelerate adoption across engineering teams.
Critical thinking and apply sound judgment to AI inputs
﻿Core Engineering
Minimum of 2 years of hands-on development experience with Python and/or TypeScript.
Experience building asynchronous backend services and APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent modern framework.
Infrastructure & DevOps
Strong experience with Kubernetes and Helm, including deployment, networking, resource management, autoscaling, troubleshooting, chart development, templating, versioning, and release management.
Strong experience with Docker, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and AWS and/or Azure.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and Git-based collaborative workflows.

job.title: Project Interface Engineer for Signaling and SCADA
job.snippet:
PURPOSE OF THE JOB
The Project Interface Engineer for Signaling and SCADA in Haifa-Nazareth(NofiT) LRT Line Project is responsible for managing and coordinating all technical interfaces between these systems and other subsystems(e.g., ocs, power, com, rolling stock). The role ensures smooth integration, timely resolution of interface issues and compliance with project requirements, safety standards and delivery timelines.The engineer leads interface management and oversees both offshore and onshore coordination with internal teams, stakeholders, and clients. To ensure that all interfaces are handled efficiently and meet both contractual and technical requirements, including the preparation and review of implementation-ready designs.The role involves actively monitoring and tracking the resolution of interface issues, ensuring that all involved parties contribute to timely and effective solutions.
ORGANISATION
Organization structure (job belongs to...)
HN NofIT RSY / Signaling and Scada
Reports directly to:
Signaling and SCADA Project manager
Other reporting to:
Project Technical Manager (PTM) for Signaling and SCADA
Network & Links
Internal
RSY Organization
EPC Interface and Integration Managers
CSD/BIM Manager
Project Core Team
PrEM and technical representative for each solution deployed
Installation Manager
T&C Manager
Project EHS Manager
External
Customer and his technical representative
Suppliers and sub-contractors for External interfaces
Main Responsabilities
Key accountabilities:
Interface Management: Identify, define, and manage all technical interfaces between Signaling, SCADA, and other subsystems (e.g., ocs, power, com, rolling stock).
Cross-Functional Coordination: Facilitate communication and coordination between internal teams, external contractors, and suppliers to ensure alignment on interface requirements.
Compliance & Standards: Ensure all interface designs comply with relevant industry standards, safety regulations, and project specifications.
Documentation: Develop and maintain Interface Control Documents (ICDs), Interface Requirement Specifications (IRS), and Interface Management Plans.
Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify interface-related risks and resolve conflicts or design mismatches to avoid delays.
Testing & Commissioning Support: Assist in integration testing, validation, and commissioning to ensure interface functionality.
ICD Development: Define and develop ICDs related to Signaling and SCADA systems and ensure they reach the resolution state per the Interface Management Plan.
Timely Resolution: Ensure all Signaling and SCADA interfaces are resolved promptly to prevent delays in the construction schedule.
Design Modifications: Coordinate and follow up on modifications related to Signaling and SCADA with relevant Railway Systems disciplines.
Integrated Design Support: Support decision-making for integrated design solutions in Signaling and SCADA.
Feasibility & Responsibility: Ensure feasibility of modifications and clarify responsibilities among involved parties.
Construction & T&C Support: Provide interface-related support to construction and testing & commissioning managers.
Client Coordination: Collaborate with the Project Technical Manager and Project Engineering Manager to coordinate with the client for design approvals and communicate technical feedback to the Engineering team.
Stakeholder Coordination: Manage internal and external interface coordination with stakeholders including the project manager, core team, client, offshore engineering and system interface teams.
Design Reviews: Organize and lead design review workshops with interface parties and clients.
Coordination: Initiate and manage technical meetings to coordinate interface activities.
Contractual Consistency: Ensure interface consistency with contract requirements and project needs.
Stakeholder Agreement: Manage interface definitions and secure stakeholder agreement and client approvals.
Quality & Delivery: Ensure progress and delivery meet quality, cost, and delivery (QCD) targets and align with company best practices.
Performance measurements:
Definition, development, and timely follow-up of Interface Control Documents (ICDs) in line with project planning.
Effective coordination with design delivery teams.
Collaboration with Combined Services Drawings (CSD) and BIM teams.
Clear and consistent reporting of progress and interface issues.
Understanding of multidisciplinary constraints and integration needs.
Familiarity with and application of configuration management principles.
On-time delivery of interface documents (ICDs, IRS) per project schedule.
Timely and effective resolution of interface issues.
High-quality coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
Compliance with safety, technical, and contractual standards.
Support during integration, testing, and commissioning phases.
Proactive management of interface-related risks and design changes.
Educational Requirements
MAIN REQUIRED COMPETENCES
Mandatory:
B.Sc. in Electrical, Mechanical or Industrial Engineering
Desirable:
M.Sc. in Electrical, Mechanical or Industrial
M.Sc. in System Engineering
Degree in Signaling competency
Experience
Mandatory:
Minimum of 5 Years of professional experience in Engineering / Technical functions
3 years’ experience Rail Transit systems Projects and/or in management of systems interfaces
Desirable:
Broad Knowledge of urban / railway systems
3 Professional experience in Railway Signaling
Behavioral Competencies
Fluent in English and Hebrew
Ability to adapt to multi-disciplinary environments
Problem resolution skills
Result oriented mindset
Ability to work under stringent timelines
Technically skilled and experienced in working with teams across multiple disciplines.
Able to ensure a proper application Disciplined Processes to deliver complex engineering
Capability to take decision
Act as a Team Player
Good co-ordination and communication skills
Location: The position is located in northern Israel (Haifa area).

job.title: IT/OT & Infrastructure Project Manager
job.snippet:
Ready to bridge the gap between IT infrastructure and industrial operations?
We’re looking for an
IT/OT & Infrastructure Project Manager
to lead technology projects across manufacturing facilities for a leading nationwide organization.
This role combines hands-on technical understanding of IT and OT environments with project leadership, infrastructure planning, cybersecurity, and collaboration with diverse stakeholders.
What will you do?
Lead IT/OT infrastructure projects across the company’s manufacturing facilities.
Identify and address infrastructure and cybersecurity gaps in production environments.
Support the implementation of new equipment and production lines.
Plan infrastructure and integrate industrial equipment into OT networks.
Work closely with maintenance managers, technical managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
Collaborate with international suppliers, leading technical discussions in English and driving alignment across teams.
What are we looking for?
3+ years of experience working with PLCs, industrial communication protocols, and HMI/SCADA systems.

job.snippet:
חברת Commit מגייסת אינטגרטור/ית תקשורת לניהול תשתיות תקשורת ו-Linux.
התפקיד כולל אחריות על תכנון, יישום ותחזוקה של מערכות תקשורת, Linux ואבטחת מידע מתקדמות. כולל שימוש בטכנולוגיות חדשות, שמירה על ביצועים אופטימליים ופתרון בעיות מורכבות בתחום התקשורת.
תחומי אחריות:
ביצוע אינטגרציה והטמעה של נתבי ומתגי תקשורת.
הגדרה ואופטימיזציה של פרוטוקולי ניתוב כגון OSPF, BGP, MPLS, Multicast.
ניטור ביצועי הרשת, פתרון תקלות ואיתור בעיות לשיפור היעילות.
עבודה בשיתוף פעולה עם צוותים נוספים להבטחת יציבות ואבטחת מערכות התקשורת.
סיוע צמוד לצוותי פיתוח בתחום התקשורת ופרוטוקולי תקשורת.
דרישות התפקיד:
ניסיון מוכח בתחום ארכיטקטורת תקשורת– חובה
מומחיות בפרוטוקולי ניתוב (OSPF, BGP,PIM, MPLS, Multicast, TCP\IP, RIP) – חובה
ידע ועבודה עם Linux (התקנה, scripts וכד)- חובה
לידע בתיכנות ב bash, python, בC++ - יתרון
הסמכה של Checkpoint או Fortinet – יתרון
הסמכת CCNA – חובה; הסמכת CCNP – יתרון
סיווג ביטחוני בתוקף – יתרון
ידע במערכות ניטור וניהול רשת (Spectrum, Zabbix, ACS/ISE) – יתרון
היכרות עם עולמות הסיסטם והווירטואליזציה – יתרון
ניסיון בעבודה עם רשתות ביטחוניות – יתרון

job.title: Technical Project Manager & Integration Specialist
job.snippet:
We are looking for a Technical Project Manager & Integration Specialist to join a complex technological environment within the financial sector.
This role combines end-to-end project management, systems analysis, application and infrastructure integration, production support, and close collaboration with multiple internal teams and external vendors.
Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end technology projects in a complex enterprise environment.
Perform systems analysis and translate business needs into technical requirements.
Manage integrations and ongoing work with external vendors.
Build and manage project plans, priorities, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
Handle and investigate application and infrastructure issues in Production environments.
Manage operational controls and analyze system processes.
Work closely with business users, development teams, QA, infrastructure teams, and additional stakeholders.
Support and monitor batch processes and production systems.
Requirements
At least 3 years of experience in technology project management – required.
At least 3 years of experience in systems analysis – required.
At least 3 years of hands-on experience with Control-M – required.
At least 3 years of experience operating and supporting open systems and related tools – required.
At least 3 years of experience working with SQL / SQL Plus – required.
Experience working in Production environments and handling technical incidents – required.
Strong ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Availability to work outside standard business hours when required due to production incidents.
Advantage
Experience with SQL Developer, WinSCP, and PuTTY.
Familiarity with UNIX environments.
Experience with Oracle DB.
Familiarity with Mainframe environments.
Experience with JCL, DB2, COBOL, Natural, or Adabas.
Experience with financial systems.
Familiarity with Capital Markets systems and processes.
🏠 Hybrid model: 4 days on-site, 1 day remote
As part of the recruitment process, candidates will be required to complete a computerized reliability assessment and interview.

job.title: Senior Field Application Engineer
job.snippet:
Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc.
People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip’s nationally-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the
Aggregate System
and it’s won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence.
Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you.
Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await!
Job Description
This position offers the opportunity to shape leading-edge data-center networking platforms and work directly with strategic customers on complex, high-value designs. You will combine system architecture, customer advocacy and hands-on laboratory work across Ethernet switching, timing and synchronization, PCIe connectivity, network-interface and management-controller solutions.
More details on the expectations and responsibilities in this position:
Own technical engagement for selected strategic and key accounts, building trusted relationships with customer architects, hardware, software and validation teams.
Proactively identify customer requirements, risks and support gaps; define action plans, maintain clear ownership and drive technical issues, escalations and commitments to timely closure.
Promote and architect Microchip networking solutions for data-center platforms, translating system requirements into appropriate Ethernet switch, PHY, network-interface, timing and connectivity solutions.
Support the complete customer design cycle, including architecture reviews, schematic reviews, device configuration, board bring-up, interoperability testing, validation, debug and production readiness.
Configure and validate complex Ethernet switch profiles, including VLANs, quality of service, traffic management, redundancy, security, TSN and precision timing functions.
Develop and execute laboratory demonstrations and proofs of concept that integrate switches, NICs, management interfaces, PCIe-connected devices, firmware and software in Linux-based systems.
Work closely with internal applications, product, software, sales and marketing teams, providing concise status, technical evidence and customer priorities to accelerate resolution and design wins.
Deliver customer and channel-partner technical training, workshops and product demonstrations.
Travel within Israel as required to support customer engagements, design reviews and laboratory activity.
Requirements/Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electronics, computer engineering or a closely related discipline; an advanced degree is advantageous.
Minimum 10 years of relevant applications engineering, systems engineering or hardware/software design experience, including substantial customer-facing support for complex semiconductor or networking solutions.
Demonstrated experience supporting strategic or key accounts through architecture, design, bring-up, validation, escalation and production phases.
Competencies
Deep knowledge of Ethernet switching and networking.
Hands-on expertise with TSN, PTP, transparent clocks and relevant timing profiles.
Proven ability to create, manage, deploy and debug Ethernet switch profiles and configurations.
Experience with high-speed board design and debug.
Working knowledge of PCI Express architecture, enumeration, switches, endpoints, NIC integration and Linux drivers; practical PCIe laboratory and troubleshooting experience is desirable.
Experience with USB and PCIe-USB bridge devices is advantageous.
Strong hands-on laboratory skills, including board bring-up, validation planning, protocol analysis, fault isolation and evidence-based problem reporting.
Familiarity with embedded Linux, firmware, drivers, boot flows and collaboration across hardware, software and validation teams.
Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics for engineering and business audiences.
Fluent spoken and written Hebrew and English.
Travel Time
0% - 25%
To all recruitment agencies
:
Microchip Technology Inc.
does not
accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our recruiting team or other Microchip employees. Microchip is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
3 years of experience in project management, web technologies and data analysis.
Ability to communicate in English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.
Preferred qualifications:
Experience with coding in languages such as Python, C++ or Java, and familiarity with SQL/MySQL and Unix/Linux operating systems/commands.
Demonstrated ability to adapt your message to the technical level of the audience and comfort presenting technical materials to groups of any size and background.
Excellent business communication, problem-solving and investigative, and presentation skills with an ability to communicate in Hebrew fluently to support client relationship management in this region.
Excellent collaboration skills for working across geographically dispersed functions.
Excellent data analysis and good data-driven decision-making skills.
About The Job
As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for the technical relationship of our largest advertising clients and/or product partners. You will lead cross-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.
You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.
gTech Ads Sellside takes a customer centric, creative, and collaborative approach to provide foundational services and forward-looking business solutions to advertiser and publisher customers. Through technical implementations, optimizations, and key solutions, gTech Ads Sellside's product/solution experts help customers attain their business goals while building long-term capabilities.
Responsibilities
Help partners in their day-to-day issues by providing consultation, delivering innovative and scalable solutions, and conducting technical troubleshooting to their problems and pain points. Advocate new product features and ensure the prompt and proper resolution of technical issues.
Assist clients in the adoption of new products via upgrades and migrations to develop their long-term success and improve product offerings by providing client feedback on features to Product Management and Engineering.
Guarantee the technical aspects of client integrations (both new and ongoing) by providing necessary documentation and technical guidance. Present in front of small or mid-sized groups of internal stakeholders and customers.
Analyze and optimize the development of existing clients to ensure their success with the Google suite of products for partners.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

job.title: Infrastructure Project Manager
job.snippet:
Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
The Role
Your Role
As an IT Infrastructure Project Manager at Kyndryl, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of complex, business-critical infrastructure initiatives for enterprise customers. You will own the full project lifecycle—from initiation, requirements definition, and financial planning through technical implementation, migration, transition to operations, and formal closure. This role bridges strategic delivery with technical precision, ensuring infrastructure modernizations align directly with functional system requirements and customer operational standards.
Our target candidate combines robust project management capabilities with strong IT systems analysis expertise. Rather than merely managing schedules, you will dive into technical system specifications, analyze architecture dependencies, evaluate constraints across legacy and modern platforms, and guide cross-functional teams in deploying resilient, secure, and scalable enterprise technology solutions.
What You Will Do
Lead end-to-end IT infrastructure projects, managing scope, integrated schedules, budgets, risk mitigation, and quality deliverables.
Conduct detailed IT systems analysis to evaluate functional requirements, technical dependencies, and system integration touchpoints across diverse infrastructure environments.
Coordinate multidisciplinary delivery teams across cloud, data centers, networks, storage, backup, systems engineering, and cybersecurity.
Oversee critical infrastructure migrations, hardware/software refreshes, and data center transformations with zero unplanned impact on client operations.
Formulate structured risk, issue, and change management strategies to proactively resolve technical hurdles and keep delivery on track.
Plan and manage the operational handover process, ensuring technical readiness, comprehensive system documentation, and effective knowledge transfer.
Serve as the primary delivery and technical liaison for client executives, solution architects, operations leads, and third-party vendors.
Prepare and present transparent, data-driven project progress, risk assessments, and financial reports to senior management and key stakeholders.
Your Future at Kyndryl
Becoming an IT Infrastructure Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications. You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas, or move vertically into senior leadership or specialized domain roles. There are many different types and flavors of roles at Kyndryl, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.
Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Required Skills and Experience
Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
3+ years of experience leading complex, medium-to-large enterprise IT infrastructure projects throughout the full delivery lifecycle.
Proven background in IT systems analysis, including translating complex technical architectures, integration requirements, and system specifications into actionable delivery plans.
Strong domain comprehension of core enterprise IT infrastructure (e.g., servers, networking, data centers, hybrid cloud, storage, and disaster recovery).
Demonstrated experience managing project financials, resource allocation, critical-path dependencies, and comprehensive risk mitigation strategies.
Proven track record managing client relationships, technology partners, system integrators, and external subcontractors.
Excellent cross-functional leadership, negotiation, and communication skills in English, with experience presenting to senior leadership.
Preferred Skills and Experience
Hands-on experience or certifications in business/systems analysis (such as CBAP, PMI-PBA, or equivalent practical systems analysis background).
Practical understanding of ITIL frameworks and IT Service Management (ITSM) workflows.
Experience delivering infrastructure modernizations, data center consolidations, or migrations to public/hybrid cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Familiarity with enterprise cybersecurity principles, high-availability architecture, and Business Continuity Planning (BCP).
Being You
The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
Get Referred!
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

job.title: מנהל/ת תקשורת שיווקית
job.snippet:
תיאור המשרה
אנו מחפשים מנהל/ת תקשורת שיווקית, בעל/ת שליטה גבוהה בעברית ובאנגלית, להצטרפות לצוות מחלקת פיתוח המשאבים.
התפקיד משלב חשיבה אסטרטגית עם יכולת ביצוע עצמאית.
תחומי אחריות עיקריים:
• ייזום, פיתוח והובלת קמפיינים ופעילויות תקשורת ייעודיות לתורמים, במטרה לחזק את הקשר עם תורמים קיימים ולעודד מעורבות מתמשכת.
• ניהול הנוכחות הדיגיטלית, לרבות אתר האינטרנט, רשתות חברתיות, דיוור אלקטרוני, ניוזלטרים ותקשורת שוטפת עם תורמים.
• עבודה שוטפת מול ספקים חיצוניים, בהם מעצבים גרפיים, צלמים, מפיקי וידאו ובתי דפוס, תוך הקפדה על איכות התוצרים ועמידה בלוחות זמנים.
• אחריות כוללת על המיתוג, המסרים והתכנים התקשורתיים עבור אירועי תורמים, מצגות, חומרי שיווק, פרסומים, יחסי ציבור וערוצים דיגיטליים, תוך הבטחת אחידות, איכות ואפקטיביות שיווקית של המחלקה
• מתן מענה תקשורתי ושיווקי למנהל/ת פיתוח המשאבים ולצוות גיוס התרומות, לרבות הכנת מצגות, מסמכי רקע, חומרים שיווקיים ותכנים מקצועיים המותאמים לתורמים ולשותפים פוטנציאליים.
אודות רעות
עמותת רעות הינה עמותה ותיקה המפעילה את בית החולים השיקומי רעות תל אביב מהמובילים בישראל. במסגרת ההיערכות להקמת קמפוס חדש בשדה דב, וקמפיין גיוס המשאבים הנדרש למימושו, אנו פועלים לחיזוק מערך התקשורת השיווקית, במטרה להציג את העשייה שלנו בצורה מיטבית, להעמיק את הקשר עם תורמים ולהגביר את החשיפה והנראות של המרכז הרפואי
דרישות התפקיד
• ניסיון של לפחות 5 שנים בתחומי השיווק, התקשורת או התוכן. ניסיון במגזר השלישי, במערכת הבריאות או בתחום הפילנתרופיה – יתרון.
• עברית ברמת שפת אם ואנגלית ברמה גבוהה מאוד, בכתב ובעל פה.
• יכולת כתיבה, עריכה וניסוח ברמה גבוהה, לרבות עיבוד מידע מורכב והפיכתו לתוכן ברור, מדויק ומשכנע המותאם לקהלי יעד שונים.
• אוריינות דיגיטלית גבוהה וניסיון בניהול אתרי אינטרנט, רשתות חברתיות ובשימוש בכלים בסיסיים לניתוח נתונים ומדידת ביצועים.
• יכולות ארגון ותכנון גבוהות, ירידה לפרטים וניהול מספר משימות ופרויקטים במקביל.
• גישה מעשית ויוזמת, יכולת עבודה עצמאית לצד שיתוף פעולה בצוות קטן ודינמי.
• יכולת עבודה בסביבה מרובת משימות, תחת לחץ ולוחות זמנים קצרים, תוך קביעת סדרי עדיפויות ושמירה על איכות עבודה גבוהה.
• היכרות עם תוכנות וכלי עיצוב כגון Canva ו-Adobe – יתרון. נדרשת יכולת להנחות מעצבים מקצועיים ולנהל את עבודתם.
לשליחת קוח - https://app.civi.co.il/promo/id=654715&src=2002

job.title: Head of Infrastructure Branch
job.snippet:
Your role will include:
The role includes overall responsibility for the planning, establishment, operation, and security of the institute's technological infrastructure array.
Key areas of responsibility:
Leading, guiding, and professionally developing a team of approximately 40 infrastructure staff (communications, servers, information security, high-performance computing, and telephony).
Managing infrastructure architecture, business continuity, and availability.
Leading infrastructure projects from the specification stage through implementation, managing procurement budgets, working with vendors, and managing service contracts.
Providing technological and architectural solutions for the complex requirements of research laboratories, including high-performance computing (HPC).
Skills and abilities:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Software Engineering / Industrial Engineering and Management (Information Systems track), or a graduate of a technological unit in the military - required.
At least 10 years of experience as an infrastructure professional in complex enterprise environments.
At least 5 years of direct managerial experience leading infrastructure teams.
Experience managing virtualization environments.
In-depth proficiency in leading cloud environments and hybrid architectures.
Experience managing advanced storage systems.
Experience with communications infrastructure and information security systems.
Experience with high-performance computing systems.
Experience working with vendors.
Broad systemic and technological vision alongside the ability to dive into details.
Excellent interpersonal skills, a strong service orientation, and the ability to work across multiple interfaces.
Ability to work under pressure, manage crises, and solve complex problems.
Very high level of English (reading, writing, and speaking).

job.snippet:

By
Radio Ink
September 23, 2026
0

Radio Ink
is seeking a part-time, fully remote Editorial Assistant to support its daily digital coverage and monthly print production, as our publication continues expanding its newsroom workflow and organizational infrastructure.
The Editorial Assistant will focus on writing and publishing daily news stories, with a focus on clean, accurate articles aligned with
Radio Ink
’s style. The role also includes monitoring and sourcing industry news, identifying developing stories across regulatory, corporate, measurement, and technology sectors, and flagging items that require coverage.
In addition to daily digital production, the position will assist with organizational aspects of
Radio Ink
’s monthly print magazine. Responsibilities may include tracking editorial assets, organizing contributor materials, helping manage deadlines, and maintaining structured workflows that support long-form feature development and special issues.
This is a remote role with flexible scheduling, though responsiveness to breaking industry developments is expected. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced news environment with tight turnaround times and minimal supervision.
Applicants should demonstrate strong headline writing ability, clean news judgment, and a working understanding of WordPress and SEO best practices. Experience with press releases, sourcing industry stories, and maintaining factual accuracy is essential. Familiarity with the radio, audio, podcasting, or media industries is highly preferred but not required for candidates with strong trade journalism instincts.
The Editorial Assistant will work directly with the Editor-in-Chief and gain exposure to high-level industry news, executive interviews, and other major coverage throughout the year.
Interested candidates should submit a résumé and at least two writing samples demonstrating news or trade-style reporting to ccoats@radioink.com.

job.title: Performance Video Editor & Creator
job.snippet:
Who We Are:
Outlook Amusements operates a leading B2C consumer marketplace through its flagship brand, California Psychics. For over 30 years, the company has been dedicated to connecting individuals with trusted, expert guidance. Through personalized psychic readings and life guidance delivered by top-rated professional advisors, we help people gain clarity, confidence, and direction at meaningful moments in their lives.
What We’re Looking For:
We're looking for a Performance Video Editor and Creator to join our team. In this role, you'll be the lead and central force behind every piece of video content we run in paid social. This isn't a support role. You'll own the craft, the creative thinking, and the connection between what you make and what actually performs.
You'll work closely with performance marketing and creative to turn ideas into videos, turn data into decisions, and turn winners into iterations- fast.
What You’ll Do:
Edit and produce video creative for performance campaigns across paid social channels
Generate video content using AI tools, including creating videos from scratch
Take winning creatives and iterate on them quickly to extend their performance
Come up with original creative concepts and ideas for performance-driven video content
Think beyond the edit. Understand what drives results and adjust accordingly
Own the full video pipeline as the sole video professional on the team
What You’ll Need to be Successful:
5+ years of experience
in video editing, with a strong portfolio to show it
Proven experience editing video for
performance / paid social campaigns
Hands-on experience generating video using AI tools
A sharp creative mind. You don't just execute ideas, you bring your own!
A genuine interest in business impact. You care whether the video actually works, not just how it looks
A positive, passionate personality with real hunger. Your energy matches the ambition of the team and elevates those around you
Bonus points if you have experience editing video for TV Commercials!
Working Conditions:
Continuous work on a personal computer.
Ability to work from home including stable internet connection.
Ability to commute to Petach Tikva office twice per week. (Note: office will move to Ra'anana in the near future)
Occasional international travel to headquarter office in Los Angeles.
Outlook Amusements Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal civil rights laws.

job.title: Mobile Apps Venture Lead | Product, Growth & Monetization
job.snippet:
Mobile Apps Business Unit Lead | Publishing & Monetization
Location:
Central Israel
Job Type:
Full-time
Seniority:
Entrepreneurial Leadership
About the Role
We are looking for an exceptional, entrepreneurial professional to establish and lead a new mobile applications business from the ground up.
This is a unique opportunity for a former Founder or Co-Founder who has gained professional experience in leading technology companies, built an independent venture, and is now ready for the next challenge.
You will work directly with the CEO of an established technology company, combining entrepreneurial freedom and ownership with the resources and infrastructure of an existing business.
We are looking for someone with strong business instincts, deep knowledge of the mobile apps ecosystem, and the ability to transform innovative ideas into scalable products and profitable business opportunities.
This is a hands-on builder's role, not a traditional management position. You will identify opportunities, develop new concepts, and take full ownership of execution from idea to launch and growth.
Key Responsibilities
Business Development & Leadership
Build and lead a new mobile applications business unit from scratch.
Identify new business opportunities, innovative product concepts, and scalable business models.
Define business strategy, operational processes, partnerships, and growth plans.
Take ownership of business performance, revenue generation, and profitability.
Build and develop teams and operational capabilities as the business grows.
Product Innovation & Execution
Identify market trends and opportunities across mobile gaming, utilities, and consumer applications.
Develop and validate new product ideas with strong commercial potential.
Lead projects end-to-end, from initial concept through product development, launch, and scaling.
Work closely with Product, Development, and Growth teams to bring new applications to market.
Drive innovation, experimentation, and continuous business improvement.
Mobile Publishing & Monetization
Develop and execute monetization strategies across mobile applications.
Work with mobile advertising networks, mediation platforms, and programmatic partners.
Identify opportunities to maximize revenue through advertising, subscriptions, in-app purchases, and hybrid monetization models.
Analyze product performance, user behavior, retention, LTV, and monetization metrics.
Identify opportunities to scale successful applications and expand the product portfolio.
Business Leadership & CEO Collaboration
Work directly with the CEO on business strategy, innovation, and execution.
Independently lead initiatives while aligning with the company's broader objectives.
Present new business opportunities, strategic recommendations, and growth plans.
Take full ownership of execution, problem-solving, and measurable business results.
Collaborate effectively with internal teams and stakeholders.
Requirements
Previous experience as a Founder or Co-Founder of a technology venture – mandatory.
Strong professional background in established Mobile Apps, Gaming, or Consumer Technology companies – mandatory.
Solid experience in Mobile App Publishing, Product Development, and Monetization – mandatory.
Proven ability to build and execute projects independently, from concept to launch.
Strong understanding of the mobile apps ecosystem, including product, UA, growth, and monetization.
Hands-on knowledge of mobile advertising, mediation platforms, ad networks, and revenue optimization.
Strong product orientation and commercial understanding.
Excellent analytical, strategic, and problem-solving skills.
Innovative mindset with the ability to identify new opportunities and turn ideas into action.
Strong execution capabilities and a hands-on, entrepreneurial approach.
Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with senior leadership.
High level of commitment, accountability, reliability, and personal ownership.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Fluent English.
Advantages
Experience in Mobile Gaming, Utilities, or ad-supported consumer applications.
Previous experience independently developing and launching mobile apps.
Experience managing an app portfolio or mobile publishing business.
Familiarity with AppLovin MAX, Unity LevelPlay, Google AdMob, and other monetization platforms.
Experience building teams or business operations from scratch.
Experience with advertising, subscriptions, and in-app purchase monetization models.
The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for a highly driven entrepreneur who combines experience from established technology companies with the mindset and practical experience of building an independent venture.
Someone who:
Has already founded a business and understands what it takes to build something from scratch.
Brings strong professional experience from successful Mobile Apps or Gaming companies.
Has deep knowledge of mobile products, publishing, and monetization.
Is creative, innovative, commercially minded, and constantly identifies new opportunities.
Knows how to take ideas from concept to execution and deliver measurable results.
Is highly independent, committed, proactive, and reliable.
Can work closely with a CEO while maintaining strong ownership and accountability.
Thrives in an entrepreneurial environment and enjoys building new businesses.
If you've already built something of your own and are ready for your next opportunity to build again, this time with the backing of an established company, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Statistical Programming Assistant
job.snippet:
The Conference on Jewish Material Claims Against Germany (Claims Conference), a nonprofit organization with offices in New York, Israel, Germany and Austria, secures material compensation for Holocaust survivors around the world. Founded in 1951 by representatives of 23 major international Jewish organizations, the Claims Conference negotiates for and disburses funds to individual survivors and organizations and seeks the return of Jewish property stolen during the Holocaust. As a result of negotiations with the Claims Conference since 1952, the German government has paid more than $95 billion in indemnification to individuals for suffering and losses resulting from persecution by the Nazis. For 2025, the Claims Conference distributed approximately $530 million in compensation for survivors globally and $960 million for survivors’ welfare needs such as home care, medicine and food.
The role supports research on Holocaust survivor demography and population studies through statistical programming, data preparation, and analysis in R. The position involves working closely with senior research staff on active projects, including constructing and cleaning complex datasets, implementing statistical models, and producing reproducible research outputs.
This is a part time (15 to 20 hours per week), fully remote position based in Israel.
Reports to:
Demographer (based in New York)
Responsibilities:
Clean, restructure, and validate research data
Write and maintain
R code
for data preparation and applied statistical modeling
Prepare datasets for statistical analysis and modeling
Develop reproducible analysis workflows, including documented R scripts and organized outputs
Prepare summary tables, statistical results, and visualizations
Assist with data extraction and manipulation using SQL databases
Collaborate with senior research staff to support ongoing research activities
Requirements:
Currently studying toward, or recently completed, a degree in statistics, biostatistics, econometrics, demography, public health, quantitative social sciences, or a related field
Proficiency in R for statistical computing, including data manipulation, tidyverse tools, and modelling functions
Coursework in regression analysis and statistical inference
Experience cleaning and preparing data for analysis
Strong analytical skills, accuracy, and attention to detail
Ability to work independently and collaboratively
Advantages:
Experience applying statistical models
Familiarity with relational databases and SQL queries
Experience working with longitudinal or administrative data
Interest in Holocaust studies, Jewish studies, history, demography, or population research
Additional Information:
This position offers practical, mentored research experience, with an emphasis on statistical inference, modelling, and careful data preparation. It does not focus on machine learning engineering, business intelligence dashboards, product analytics, or AI development.

job.title: Wireless Platform Architect
job.snippet:
Back to careers
Description
About the Business Unit:
Ceva is at the forefront of the Smart Edge revolution, with innovative state-of-the-art Silicon and Software solutions that enable products to Connect, Sense and Infer.
Within the Wireless Internet of Things Business Unit (WIoT BU), we are offering you a unique opportunity to shape the future of connected devices. Our advanced wireless technologies, including Bluetooth, Wi-Fi UWB, and 5G Cellular IoT, are integrated into over a Billion devices annually.
﻿About The Role
As a Wireless Platform Architect, you will play a key role in defining the architecture of Ceva's next-generation Radio Subsystem (RSS) platforms for wireless technologies including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and UWB. You will take end-to-end responsibility on the system-level architecture of a complete wireless communication subsystem, including system spec, requirements for implementation teams, definition of interfaces and testing concept.
You will work closely with multidisciplinary development teams and directly with customers, from early system architecture and trade-off analysis through implementation, integration, validation and productization.
﻿Responsibilities
Define the RSS end-to-end architecture and HW/SW partitioning, including interfaces between the radio, PHY, MAC, CPU/MCU, memories, PMU, clock and reset management (CRM) and other subsystem components.
Define architecture and operational mechanisms for multi-protocol operation and interoperability, including HW interfaces, state machines, control flows and operation sequences.
Define sleep/wake-up modes, testability, security and debug.
Drive PPA optimization and competitive benchmarking of the RSS, with particular focus on low-power operation, silicon area and overall system efficiency.
Work closely with RF, PHY/algorithm, HW, SW/firmware, verification and integration teams, from early system studies and architecture definition through RTL/FPGA validation and system bring-up.
Work directly with customers during technical engagements to define the RSS integration into their SoC and support customers throughout SoC integration, validation and productization, addressing system-level architecture, interoperability and integration challenges.
Requirements
B.Sc. or M.Sc in Electrical Engineering
Proven experience in system and architecture definition for hardware based wireless communication systems
Experience in wireless communication standards (such as WiFi/BT/Cellular/UWB etc.)
Strong understanding of low-power design and system architecture
Good understanding of SoC architecture and IPs integration, including system interfaces, memory, interrupts, clocks, resets and power domains
Deep understanding of VLSI/ASIC development processes and methodologies
Good understanding of ASIC productization and system bring-up flows
Strong technical leadership skills with the ability to drive architectural decisions
Team player with good communication skills
Strong customer-facing technical skills, with the ability to translate customer requirements and SoC constraints into system architecture
Flexibility and innovation mindset
Advantages
Knowledge in RF integration, control and calibrations
Knowledge in Signal Processing and PHY architecture
Knowledge in MAC layer Architecture
Experience with embedded processors/MCUs and low-level firmware architecture
Experience in lab work, Silicon validation and bring-up

job.title: ראש/ת צוות תשתיות אינטרנט ואבטחת מידע
job.snippet:
קצת על התפקיד למרכז טכנולוגיות מידע ITC דרוש/ה ראש/ת צוות תשתיות אינטרנט ואבטחת מידע התפקיד כולל:
תכנון, ארכיטקטורה ויישום של תשתיות אינטרנט (רשתות LAN/WAN, VPN, חיבורים ל-Internet, SD-WAN, MPLS) בארגון.
הובלת פרויקטים לשדרוג, קונסולידציה והרחבת תשתיות גלישה ואבטחת מידע
אחריות על אבטחת מידע ברמת תשתיות: ניהול חומות אש, IDS/IPS, מערכות DLP, תצורת Zero-Trust, ותגובה לאירועי סייבר.
בקרת איכות ו-Compliance -וידוא עמידה בתקני ISO 27001, NIST, PCI-DSS, GDPR ו-Regulations מקומיים.
ניהול תהליכי שינוי (Change Management) ו-Configuration Management (CMDB) לשמירה על יציבות המערכת.
הטמעת טכנולוגיות חדשות - Cloud-Networking, SD-WAN, Zero-Trust Network Access (ZTNA), SASE, Automation/Orchestration (Ansible, Terraform). מה אנחנו מחפשים
הסמכות: Checkpoint (CCSE/CCSA), Palo Alto (PCNSA/PCNSE), Forcepoint (CFCE/CFCE-Advanced) – יתרון
ניהול תשתיות רשת ואבטחת מידע בארגון בגודל בינוני - חובה
4 שנות ניסיון בתפקידי ניהול בינוניים בתחום הרשתות וה-Security - חובה
הובלת פרויקטים של שינוי תשתיות בקנה מידה ארגוני בינונים - חובה
תכנון רשתות, firewall, IDS/IPS, VPN, PKI, SIEM - חובה
ניסיון מעשי ב-Checkpoint, Palo Alto Networks, ו-Forcepoint (הקמה, ניהול, חקירה וtuning) - חובה
ניסיון בעבודה במוסדות גדולים/בינלאומיים (בנק, תקשורת, ממשלה) - יתרון
5 שנים, כולל ניסיון בהטמעת מודולים של SASE /Zero-Trust - יתרון
הסמכות מקצועיות:CISSP, CCNP Security, CCIE Routing & Switching, TOGAF, PMP, ITIL v4 – יתרון
אולי יעניין אותך לדעת אתם עומדים להוביל את “לב” הרשת של הארגון – צוות של 4 מומחים בתשתיות אינטרנט ואבטחת מידע. בתור ראש צוות תשתיות אינטרנט ואבטחת מידע, תתכננו, תיישמו ותשמרו על רשתות LAN/WAN, , חיבורי Cloud, וVPN, ותהיו אחראים על חומות אש,Checkpoint, Palo Alto,Networks וForcepoint. תצפו, תנתחו ותגיבו לאיום בזמן אמת, ותוודאו שהארגון עומד בתקני ISO27001, NIST, PCI.DSS וGDPR. במילים אחרות – אתם הקו הראשון שמגן על העסק שלנו ומבטיח שהקשר הדיגיטלי של העובדים, הלקוחות והשותפים פועל ללא הפרעות.

job.title: ראש מדור קיטלוג ספרייה
job.company: Yad Vashem, the World Holocaust Remembrance Center
job.snippet:
ראש מדור קטלוג ומפתוח מוביל את תחום הארגון הביבליוגרפי בספרייה, תוך קביעת סטנדרטים מקצועיים עדכניים, התאמה לשיטות מובילות בעולם ופיקוח על איכות העבודה. הובלת ממשקי הפעולה של קטלוג הספרייה מול אגף טכנולוגיות מידע לצורך קטלוג והנגשה מיטביים ועדכניים של האוסף. התפקיד כולל ניהול הצוות, הובלת תהליכי עבודה מתקדמים המבטיחים אחידות, דיוק ומצוינות מקצועית. התפקיד כולל ביצוע משימות נוספות עפ"י צרכי היחידה.
תחומי אחריות
•
פיתוח מתודולוגיות ותהליכי עבודה
•
עדכון תהליכי ונהלי קטלוג ומפתוח ספרייתיים תוך התאמתם לשיטות קטלוג בינ"ל מקובלות (LC), לרשומות קטלוגיות עולמיות ולתזאורוס מותאם.
•
ייעוץ להנהלת הספרייה בתחום הקטלוג המיפתוח והמיון והטמעת נהלי עבודה עדכניים.
•
ניהול ממשק הפעולה מול אגף טכנולוגיות מידע בתחומי הקטלוג הספרייתי ותוך אפיון הצרכים המקצועיים ממערכת הקטלוג.
•
ניהול ממשקי הפעולה השוטפים מול התחומים המקבילים בספרייה – פיתוח ובחירה, רכש, השאלה.
•
התעדכנות ולמידה לצורך התאמת תהליכי הקטלוג למגמות עולמיות והטמעתן.
•
ניהול קשר שוטף עם ספריות מובילות בארץ ובעולם לצורך התעדכנות, למידה והתאמת ממשקים (ULI)
•
סיוע באיוש דלפק ההשאלה באולם הקריאה, בהתאם לצורך.
•
קטלוג ומיון
•
קטלוג, מפתוח ומיון כותרים בשפות שונות.
•
טיוב ובקרת תזאורוס הספרייה תוך התאמתו למתווה עדכני
•
ניהול צוות ובקרה על ביצוע
•
ניהול שוטף של צוות המקטלגים, לרבות חלוקת עבודה, למידה שוטפת ועדכון נהלי עבודה לפי שיטות קטלוג בינ"ל, ועוד.
•
הטמעת תהליכי ונהלי העבודה המעודכנים ע"י צוות המקטלגים ובקרתם.
•
ריכוז נתונים והפקת דו"חות
•
הפקת דו"חות קבועים ומשתנים בהתאם לצורך.
•
ייצוא דו"חות תקופתיים לצורך הסבתם לקטלוג הלאומי ULI, בקרה על אופן הטמעת הנתונים.
