job.title: Design Lead, Social (Remote)
job.snippet:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
We're hiring a Design Lead, Social to shape how people discover Forbes Advisor through paid social and what happens after they click.
You'll design the full experience: the Meta ad or social creative, the landing page, and the quiz, comparison, assessment or partner experience that follows. You're a senior digital designer with strong product instincts and excellent visual craft. You can design an experience end to end, and you understand what makes something stop the scroll, communicate quickly and feel credible in-feed.
AI is already part of how you work. You use it to explore ideas, create visual directions, prototype interactions and get testable experiences in front of people quickly. Give you an ambiguous brief and you'll come back with several genuinely different creative and experience directions that can be tested before they require full engineering time.
You'll work closely with Paid Social, Growth, Product, Engineering and Data. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Head of Design. You'll be based in a UK or US time zone with regular overlap with CST.
Responsibilities
Design full experiences from social. Create landing pages, listicles, comparison pages, quizzes, assessments, calculators and partner experiences for people arriving from paid social. Make them mobile first, quick to understand and built around one clear action.
Concept the creative that leads there. Work with Paid Social and Demand Gen on social creative, bringing genuinely different visual and conceptual routes rather than variations of one idea.
Connect the ad to the destination. Design the creative and post-click experience as one system, so the promise, message and visual language carry through.
Work faster with AI. Use AI to explore ideas, prototype experiences and produce creative. Turn approaches that work into repeatable workflows the wider team can use.
Design from what you learn. Work with Data and Paid Social to understand how experiences and creative perform, and use those learnings to shape the next iteration.
Build reusable systems. Create components, page patterns and creative frameworks that make each new experiment faster without lowering quality.
Raise the design bar. Mentor designers on visual craft, designing for paid traffic and AI-assisted workflows, and help set standards as the team grows.
Requirements
8+ years in product, digital or experience design, with meaningful work in growth, acquisition or consumer experiences
A strong portfolio showing end-to-end digital experiences and excellent visual design, including typography, hierarchy, composition, art direction, mobile design and conversion-focused work
Experience designing for paid traffic, with examples of how performance or experimentation changed your design decisions.
Working knowledge of demand generation and performance marketing, including funnels, CTR, CPL, CPA and creative testing
Strong product and interaction design fundamentals, particularly for mobile and conversion-focused experiences
A clear view on where AI improves the work and where it doesn't
Confidence presenting work and explaining design decisions to marketing, product, engineering and data partners
Nice To Haves
Paid social creative for Meta that ran, with an understanding of what you learned from the results
Working knowledge of demand gen and performance metrics such as CTR, CPL, CPA and creative testing
Experience building working prototypes with tools like Claude Code, Cursor or v0
Experience with AI image or video tools such as Higgsfield, Runway, Midjourney or Krea
Motion or short-form video using After Effects, Premiere, CapCut or similar
Front-end familiarity with HTML, CSS, React or similar
Lead gen, affiliate, financial services or comparison marketplace experience
Forbes Advisor provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

job.title: Head of Product, AI Therapy
job.snippet:
About Us
OurRitual is a fast-growing digital platform reshaping how relationship therapy works. We combine expert-led therapy sessions with AI-powered support to create a blended experience — where clinical depth and intelligent technology weave together into something neither could deliver alone. A therapist brings depth. AI brings continuity. Together, they reshape what relationship support feels like in the 167 hours between sessions.
We call it Continuous Therapy. We've reached product-market fit with strong growth, exceptional engagement, and retention that breaks the category. We have 200+ expert therapists on the platform and the largest dataset of clinically-annotated couples therapy sessions in existence. We're pre-Series A, at the stage where AI moves from feature to foundation.
Role Overview
As a Head of Product — AI Therapy, you will own how AI and clinical expertise come together across the product to create a new kind of therapy experience. This role sits at the intersection of consumer product, AI technology, and clinical science — defining what intelligent relationship support looks like when it's grounded in real therapeutic data and validated by real clinicians.
You'll design the conversational AI that supports users between sessions — emotional processing, conversation preparation, reflections, personalized guidance. You'll build the intelligence layer that turns therapy session data into structured relationship context, so every interaction feels informed by the couple's actual journey. And you'll push into open space — new product surfaces, new modes of support, new ways to make therapists more effective — because the category is being created now and the playbook doesn't exist.
This is a hands-on role that requires balancing vision with execution, working closely with our clinical lead, AI engineers, and design team to ship products where every word matters — because people are vulnerable when they use them. In regular collaboration with founders and clinical leadership, you'll shape the AI therapy strategy and help define the future of continuous, tech-enabled relationship support.
Key Responsibilities
AI Product Definition
Own the AI therapy product surface — conversational flows, tone, behavioral rules, guardrails, and prompt engineering for between-session support
Define how AI shows up across modes: emotional processing, conversation preparation, reflections, personalized guidance
Drive the user-facing AI experience from spec to ship — ensuring it feels warm, safe, and clinically grounded
Intelligence Infrastructure
Define how therapy session data becomes structured relationship context — extraction logic, confidence scoring, lifecycle management, recommendation systems
Build the intelligence layer that makes AI interactions feel informed by the couple's history and therapeutic journey
Shape content recommendation and insight delivery systems
Clinical-Product Integration
Partner with clinical lead and therapist network to validate every AI behavior before it reaches users
Translate therapeutic frameworks into product specs that engineers can build from
Design expert-in-the-loop workflows and crisis safety protocols
Ensure what ships is therapeutically sound, not just technically impressive
New Product Surfaces
Identify and develop new AI-powered experiences — adaptive insights, tools for therapists, modes of support that don't exist yet
Run POCs with real users, define acceptance criteria, measure outcomes, iterate
Collaborate with consumer product initiatives to ensure AI and human experiences are seamlessly aligned
Skills & Qualifications
5+ years of product management in consumer products, with real AI/ML experience
Hands-on LLM product work — prompt engineering, model behavior, shipping AI that needs to be safe and reliable
Genuine interest in therapy, mental health, or emotional wellbeing — you understand why clinical grounding matters and why this space demands more care than most
Strong spec-writing — translating complex behavioral and clinical requirements into clear, buildable definitions
Cross-functional fluency — comfortable going deep with engineers on architecture, with clinicians on therapeutic frameworks, with designers on experience
Builder mentality — energized by defining problems, not just executing against a predetermined roadmap
Fluent English
Nice-to-Have Skills
Health-tech, therapy-tech, or regulated consumer product experience
Conversational AI background — designing conversation flows, managing AI tone and personality
Personal experience with therapy (individual or couples) — it gives intuition that's hard to teach
0-to-1 product track record at early-stage companies
Experience with clinical validation workflows or expert-in-the-loop AI systems
Why This Role
Therapy is about to look very different — not because AI replaces therapists, but because people expect more than a weekly hour can deliver. This is a rare opportunity to define how AI and clinical expertise blend together to support relationships at scale. You'll work with a dataset that doesn't exist anywhere else, building products that couldn't be built at any other company. If you care about building AI that genuinely helps people in their most vulnerable moments, this is it.

job.title: Product Manager - AI SW Infrastructure (AI Software Stack / Compiler / Platform) - IL
job.snippet:
We’re a fast-moving, US-Israeli AI startup building next-generation infrastructure for the world’s most demanding AI workloads. Our mission is to accelerate the future of intelligence and make it ubiquitously accessible by delivering full stack custom AI servers optimized for large-scale inference and training.
Backed by top-tier investors and led by industry veterans, we’re scaling rapidly. We seek forward-thinking engineers and operators who thrive in a collaborative environment and excel at solving complex challenges from first principles. If you want to build infrastructure that fundamentally changes what the world can accomplish with AI, come join us!
﻿About The Position
﻿
We are building the next generation of AI infrastructure-from custom silicon to the servers and systems that power the world's largest AI models. Our vertically integrated approach enables us to optimize every layer of the AI compute stack, delivering breakthrough performance, efficiency, and scalability.
We’re looking for a visionary, highly technical Senior Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of data center infrastructure, server-grade hardware and software, systems engineering, and AI to lead our AI software stack, compiler platform, and server system software.
This role is responsible for defining and delivering the software ecosystem that makes Majestic's system completely seamless for developers and cloud infrastructure teams. You will own the compiler roadmap, runtime engines, and framework integrations that translate standard deep learning model representations into highly optimized execution paths on the Ignite APU.
﻿Responsibilities
﻿
Translate customer, engineering, and business requirements into detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), technical specifications, and feature definitions.
Develop detailed product schedules, milestone plans, and release timelines while managing dependencies across multiple engineering organizations.
Compiler Pipeline and Toolchain Roadmap: Define requirements for the software and AI model compilation toolchain
Framework Integration and Interoperability: Lead product partnerships and technical integrations with major machine learning frameworks and runtimes, ensuring native support for PyTorch, JAX, vLLM, SGLang, and Hugging Face Optimum without requiring customer code modifications.
High-Performance Kernel Optimization Roadmap: Define performance optimization roadmap for low-level operator libraries, including BLAS, custom OpenAI Triton kernels
Scale-Out and Clustering Orchestration: Define requirements for clustering and multi-node scale-out configurations, ensuring seamless execution across scale-out setups utilizing SLURM, Ray, LMCache, etc.
Developer Platform Usability: Act as the primary advocate for developer experience, monitoring how software compiles and executes in customer sandboxes, and proactively removing the need for manual memory management scripts, custom compiler hacks, or API wrappers.
Requirements:
Education: Master of Science (M.Sc.) or Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or Physics is a strict, non-negotiable requirement.
AI Software Stack Expertise: Minimum of 5 to 8 years of experience in product management or software systems engineering, with a proven track record of shipping compiler technologies, deep learning frameworks, or developer platform tools.
Parallel Programming Fluency: Deep theoretical and practical understanding of CUDA, Triton, high-performance C++ DSP libraries, and multi-threaded parallel computation paradigms.
Scale-Out Infrastructure Knowledge: Demonstrated familiarity with HPC scale-out infrastructures, distributed memory architectures, and networking protocols designed for high-performance clustering.
Prior experience at accelerated software, cloud, or startup organizations building complex AI compute systems, such as NVIDIA, Meta, Google, AWS, SambaNova, Cerebras, Groq, or Lightning AI.
﻿Preferred Qualifications
﻿
MBA or equivalent experience in technology commercialization or product strategy.
Active contributions to open-source AI infrastructure projects, compilers (MLIR/LLVM), or performance optimization libraries.
Direct experience working inside a frontier AI lab or foundation model organization (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Google DeepMind) developing large-scale distributed systems.
We seek smart, curious, self-driven individuals who enjoy creative problem-solving and continuous learning. Even if you don't meet all requirements, we'd love to hear from you if you have the mindset to tackle complex challenges.
Majestic Labs is an equal opportunity employer deeply committed to diversity of background and thought. If you are ready to dare greatly, learn from mistakes, engage in vigorous debates, and help create a step-function shift in human technical capability, we want to meet you!

job.title: Sales Operations Specialist
job.snippet:
Cye is seeking a Sales Operations Specialist to help support our sales team as we manage incredible growth and new vertical expansion. As a Sales Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for assisting sales leadership with driving operational excellence for Cye. You will also cover the day-to-day administration of Cye’s sales team and operational tasks.
This role is a business partner in the sales organization, enabling revenue growth and increasing sales productivity by providing effective methodologies, efficient processes, value-added information, and sales tools.
Responsibilities
Oversee the process of commercial contracts (NDA, SOW, MSA, Partner agreements) by handling necessary agreements and working with the sales, legal, and finance teams.
Support day-to-day administration of the global sales team and operational tasks. (such as, Support Opportunity and Deal Management, Manage customer and partner onboarding activities)
Act as the sales interface for finance, legal, marketing, and services departments by supporting different GTM initiatives, projects, and tasks.
Assist sales leaders with pipeline and opportunity inspection and validation.
Organize, support, and manage E2E Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) - data preparation, reporting, and providing actionable summaries and next steps.
Manage and maintain sales data in Salesforce, CRM, and other sales tools.
Conduct regular pipeline and activity reviews with Sales team and maintain daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports and KPIs.
Proactively identify operational gaps, data-quality issues, process inefficiencies, and opportunities for automation or standardization.
Own and maintain the Sales Ops knowledge base, including policies, procedures, templates, onboarding materials, training resources, and best practices.
Assist with onboarding and training of new sales representatives.
Qualifications
1-3 years of experience in sales operations in a global company.
English - native or near-native level, with full professional proficiency in both written and verbal communication (must).
Experience working with commercial contracts (a legal background, as a paralegal or qualified attorney, is an advantage).
Strong administrative and organizational skills.
Ability to understand the strategic goals of the sales department and support them effectively.
Strong problem-solving skills and process optimization mindset.
Results-driven mentality, with the ability to prioritize and drive tasks to completion.
Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
Ability to adapt to shifting priorities and a fast-paced environment.
Passion for innovation and process improvement to maximize efficiency.
Familiarity with Salesforce and/ or CPQ tool - an advantage.
Analytical skills and comfort working with Excel and reports
Willingness to work flexible hours to support our global team.
Cye helps security and risk leaders gain a clear, defensible view of their cyber exposure, grounded in financial impact and real-world attack paths. By continuously quantifying exposure and validating it in context, organizations can establish a strong baseline, prioritize decisions with confidence, and track measurable reduction over time.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

job.title: Sales Operations - HPE
job.snippet:
Sales Operations Specialist
Location: Israel
Why Ingram Micro
Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem.
With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business-to-business technology experts.
Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart.
Here, we believe we grow further, together, empowering talented people to innovate, lead, and create meaningful impact while shaping the future of technology.
The Opportunity
As a
Sales Operations Specialist
, you'll play a critical role in supporting sales performance by maintaining sales processes, reporting, and operational excellence that enable business growth. Working closely with sales, business, and cross-functional teams, you'll help ensure accurate data, efficient workflows, and actionable insights that drive results.
Top success factors:
Strong analytical and organizational skills
Action-oriented approach with attention to detail
Ability to collaborate effectively and support customer-focused outcomes.
What You'll Accomplish
Support sales operations activities, including customer sales order life cycle.
Manage and maintain inventory levels and interface with our local warehouse
Partner with sales teams, management, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely execution of customer and business requirements.
Generate reports and analyze sales trends, pipeline activity, and operational metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
Support sales automation tools, forecasting activities, and process enhancements that improve productivity and efficiency.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process gaps and recommending practical solutions.
What Sets You Apart
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Experience in Sales Operations, Sales Support, Sales Administration, Business Analysis, Reporting, or a related commercial environment.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and familiarity with CRM, ERP, or sales management platforms.
Ability to interpret data, communicate insights clearly, and collaborate effectively across multiple teams.
Demonstrated eagerness to learn, develop professionally, and contribute to a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.
What's In It For You
The opportunity to build a strong foundation in sales operations within a global technology leader.
Exposure to industry-leading vendors, innovative technologies, and diverse go-to-market strategies.
Collaboration with experienced professionals who support learning, development, and career growth.
A dynamic and inclusive environment where your contributions help improve business performance and customer success.
At Ingram Micro, we invest in your future. Through continuous learning, leadership opportunities, and a commitment to fostering innovation, we ensure every team member thrives in their career journey.
If you're enthusiastic, motivated, and ready for a new challenge, we'd love to hear from you. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, even if your experience doesn't match every qualification.
Let's shape tomorrow.
Your ambition empowers tomorrow's technology, today.

job.title: Contract, Bid & Proposals Specialist
job.snippet:
A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our dynamic Gas Services Sales Operations team, where you will play a crucial role in ensuring business continuity across the Nordics, Western, and South West Europe sub-region. You will lead the charge in Bid and Proposal Management, Contract Administration and Negotiation, and Sales Operations Support, ensuring a seamless pre-sales and contracting lifecycle. Imagine developing compelling proposals and negotiating contracts that align with our business objectives while leveraging your analytical skills and technical writing expertise. Your contributions will directly support our sales goals and drive data-based decision-making across the region, utilizing your knowledge of Power BI and interest in AI.
How You’ll Make An Impact
You will develop pre-sales contract strategies in collaboration with sales, marketing, and technical teams.
You will structure and prepare comprehensive proposals, bid documents, and responses to tenders, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
You will negotiate contract terms and conditions with external customers, aligning them with our business objectives.
You will maintain accurate records of all bids, proposals, and contracts in the CRM system, analyzing key business metrics to support the sales team.
You will contribute to process improvement initiatives within the sales operations function, enhancing overall efficiency.
What You Bring
You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Law, Engineering, or a related field.
You have proven experience in contract management, bid preparation, or a similar sales operations role, ideally at the P2 level.
You possess strong analytical skills and a keen interest in data analysis, particularly with Power BI and Salesforce.
You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment, demonstrating cultural awareness and teamwork.
You have approximately 2 years of experience in similar positions, showcasing your ability to work independently and manage complex tasks.
About The Team
Our team specializes in providing services for small gas turbines, organized into two groups: Client Managers who engage directly with customers and back-office professionals who prepare offers and manage internal systems. We pride ourselves on our structured and organized approach, ensuring that all proposals and documentation are meticulously handled. As part of our team, you will interact with various internal stakeholders and clients, contributing to a collaborative and efficient work environment.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With over 100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one-sixth of the world’s electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: Siemens Energy Careers
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
Rewards/Benefits
Here are examples of the rewards and benefits Siemens Energy offers:
Opportunities to work with a global team
Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
Medical benefits
Remote/Flexible work
Time off/Paid holidays and parental leave
Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform
Access to a variety of employee resource groups

job.title: Commission Analyst
job.snippet:
We're expanding our Commissions team and looking for a sharp, detail-oriented, data-driven Commission Analyst to join us.
You'll sit at the intersection of two worlds: the business side that designs comp plans and the technical side that builds the models calculating payouts. You'll be the translator who turns plan logic into technical spec (and back), while also keeping data accurate, calculations on time, and payouts right.
What You’ll Do
Act as the connective layer between Sales Comp plan and the team building the payout calculation model
Translate comp plan rules, exceptions, and edge cases into clear, technically implementable logic, and vice versa
Team up with analysts on commission calculations and payouts
Sync source data, generate reports, process account/contract changes
Implement approved comp adjustments and exceptions with precision
QA calculations, give payroll files a final check before sign off
Get ahead of cycle close: prep and validate data, partner with RevOps on completeness
Build dashboards and reports tracking payout trends, attainment, exceptions
Surface insights beyond the numbers to shape commission policy and process
Develop and maintain AI augmented economic models
Drive process improvements for efficiency and controls
What You Have
3+ years in commission processing, finance ops, or revenue ops
Prior exposure to sales compensation or incentive plan administration
Comfort as a go between for business stakeholders and technical builders
Strong technical capabilities, high level Excel and familiarity with BI tools
Strong SQL skills, experience with cloud data warehouses like Athena or BigQuery
Sharp attention to detail, ownership of a recurring, deadline driven process
Ability to prioritize when month/quarter end volume ramps up
Strong written/verbal communication across business and technical audiences
Genuine interest in AI tools and data automation
Bonus Points
Experience specifying or QAing a commission/payout calculation engine
Understanding of SaaS models and ARR mechanics
Jira or similar ticketing system experience
Salesforce or other CRM proficiency
Python for data analysis, automation, and modeling
AI/ML tool design or implementation in finance
Being introduced by an AppsFlyer team member
As a global company operating from 25 offices across 19 countries, we reflect the human mosaic of the diverse and multicultural world in which we live. We ensure equal opportunities for all of our employees and promote the recruitment of diverse talents to our global teams without consideration of race, gender, culture, or sexual orientation. We value and encourage curiosity, diversity, and innovation from all our employees, customers, and partners.
“As a Customer Obsessed company, we must first be Employee Obsessed. We need to make sure that we provide the team with the tools and resources they need to go All-In.” Oren Kaniel, CEO.

job.title: sales operations
job.snippet:
Company Description
C.R.G. Electronics Ltd. is a technology solutions provider with over 35 years of experience serving the Israeli computing, electronics, and software industries. The company represents and distributes leading global semiconductor manufacturers, electronics component suppliers, and computing module and system vendors, offering customers a broad range of high-quality solutions. C.R.G. Electronics is known for deep technical expertise and strong industry knowledge, enabling exceptional customer support and demand creation for partner solutions. The organization collaborates closely with manufacturers, designers, and distributors to advance design innovation and drive revenue growth in fields such as AI hardware, data infrastructure, memory, connectivity, mixed signal, and computing solutions. Located in Karmiel with a sales and marketing branch in Petah Tikva, C.R.G. serves both established and emerging markets across Israel.
Role Description
This is a full-time hybrid Sales Operations role based in Caesarea, with the flexibility to work from home part of the time. The Sales Operations professional will support the sales team by managing and optimizing sales processes, maintaining accurate sales data and reports, and coordinating between sales, marketing, and operations. Daily responsibilities include handling CRM updates, tracking pipeline and forecast accuracy, preparing sales performance dashboards, and supporting order management and customer follow-up activities. The role also involves improving workflows, supporting account planning. The individual will contribute to continuous process improvements that enhance visibility, decision-making, and revenue growth.
Qualifications
Strong analytical skills, including data analysis, reporting, and attention to detail.
Effective communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across sales, marketing, and operations teams.
Customer service skills, with a focus on responsiveness, professionalism, and relationship management.
Experience in sales and sales operations, including pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM usage.
Proficiency with CRM and sales tools , and MS Excel or other data tools.
Organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
Experience in electronics, semiconductors, or technology distribution is an advantage.
Relevant academic background in Business, Industrial Engineering, Economics, or related field is preferred.
Comfort working in a hybrid model from Caesarea, including both office-based and remote work.

Join our Commercial team in a key headquarters role, leading the development of commercial programs across channels — from planning and execution follow-up to post-activity learnings and continuous improvement.
In this role, you’ll bring strong field understanding, connect closely with retailers and commercial teams, and build practical tools and initiatives that support the company’s business goals — while operating in line with company policies, internal compliance standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
What You’ll Do
Identify commercial opportunities by understanding market dynamics, channel developments, retailer needs, and field team insights.

Conduct weekly field visits, both independently and together with field employees, to identify opportunities from the field.
Promote field team initiatives with headquarters stakeholders, including legal approvals, compliance reviews, and additional internal alignments.

Continuously explore innovative ways to improve work processes and develop new tools that support business goals.

5 years of experience in Sales Management, Promotion Team Management, and/or Trade Marketing in large companies.

Relevant academic degree.

job.title: Collection & Revenue Operations Specialist
job.snippet:
🚀
Collection Specialist
In this role, you will take ownership of customer billing and collections, monitor outstanding balances, perform account reconciliations, and work closely with internal stakeholders and global customers to ensure timely payments and accurate financial records.
This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, global environment, requiring strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to independently manage multiple customer accounts and priorities.
🌟
Why You’ll Love Working at Moonshot
Flexible Hybrid Culture: 2 days a week from our sea-view Tel Aviv HQ, the rest from wherever you do your best work.
Perks & Benefits: 6 extended long weekends a year, vibrant happy hours, and exclusive company events.
✅
What We’re Looking For?
Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business Administration or Bookkeeping certification
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with internal teams and customers.
A detail-oriented problem solver who takes ownership and follows tasks through to completion.
High proficiency in MS Excel and AI tools.
Strong analytical skills to work with financial data and reports.
Excellent written and verbal communication in English.
👥
Who You Are
A proactive and service-oriented collections professional.
A structured and organized self-starter.
A detail-oriented problem solver who takes ownership and follows tasks through to completion.
A solutions-focused team player who performs well in a fast-paced environment.
📌 What You’ll Do
Issue accurate, timely customer invoices and manage billing inquiries.
Own collections end-to-end: track receivables, follow up proactively, accelerate payments, and flag risks.
Reconcile incoming payments and keep AR clean.
Partner with BizDev teams to resolve customer issues and accelerate collections.
Identify opportunities to improve collections processes and increase operational efficiency.
Communicate with customers to resolve payment discrepancies.
🌕
About Moonshot
Moonshot is a leading Ad Tech company on a mission to help people make smarter, faster, and more confident purchasing decisions. Through data-driven technology, advanced marketing strategies, and deep market insights, we connect millions of consumers worldwide with the best products, services, and deals tailored to their needs.

job.title: Senior Revenue Controller
job.snippet:
Join the future of mobility. Help build the platform that's changing how cities move.
NoTraffic is the world’s leading mobility platform
, transforming intersections into connected infrastructure that improves flow, boosts safety, and prepares cities for the autonomous era.
We are looking for a hands-on
Senior Revenue Controller
to join our Finance team and take ownership of the operational accounting for revenue, COGS, inventory and related finance-operation processes.
Your day to day will look like:
Own the monthly close for revenue, COGS, inventory and accounts receivable, including reconciliations, reserves, cut-off procedures and gross-margin analysis.
Implement and maintain revenue-recognition and contract-accounting policies, including contract and sales-order reviews, multi-component transactions, allocation of consideration, billing terms and deferred revenue.
Partner with Sales on contract terms, billing arrangements and non-standard transactions to ensure appropriate accounting treatment and support effective deal execution.
Work closely with Supply Chain throughout the inventory lifecycle, including inventory costing, reconciliations, reserves, movements and controls.
Proactively identify the need for changes in accounting treatments, estimates, cost-allocation methodologies or capitalization policies as the business and operating model evolve.
Support the development and implementation of new revenue streams and transaction structures by defining the required accounting, billing, tax, systems and control processes.
Prepare transfer-pricing calculations and true-ups, and coordinate the related intercompany billing and supporting documentation.
Own US sales-tax reporting, including reconciliations and coordination with external advisors.
Lead the company’s collection process in collaboration with Sales, including AR aging reviews, customer follow-up, dispute escalation, credit-risk monitoring and bad-debt analysis.
Maintain the integrity of revenue, COGS, inventory, margin and AR data used by FP&A, and communicate accounting developments that may affect budgets and forecasts.
Provide management with relevant analysis of revenue, gross margin, inventory and accounts receivable
Support ad hoc projects, reporting and analyses.
Implement appropriate AI-enabled processes to improve efficiency, data quality documentation and controls
Requirements:
CPA (internship in big 4)
At least eight years of relevant accounting experience, including significant responsibility for revenue accounting and monthly-close processes in a multinational complex environment.
Strong knowledge of US GAAP and revenue-recognition principles, including ASC 606.
Strong Excel skills and experience working with ERP systems; NetSuite experience is strongly preferred.
Experience with US sales tax, transfer pricing, hardware and recurring-revenue models is an advantage.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional process improvements and implement effective financial controls.
Fluent written and verbal English.

job.title: Renewals Manager
job.snippet:
About Us
Panorays is a company dedicated to reducing supply chain cyber risk so companies worldwide can quickly and securely do business together. We provide a comprehensive third-party cybersecurity solution that creates a new business world where cybersecurity isn’t just a necessary business cost but an integral driver of growth. With Panorays, our customers’ defenses constantly evolve with their risk landscape, enabling companies to scale confidently with a solution that grows as they do.
About The Role
The ideal Renewals Manager is a commercially sharp, process-oriented owner of the renewal who understands how security and risk teams budget for, justify, and buy a third-party risk program. You treat every renewal as the moment the customer re-confirms the value of Panorays, not as paperwork. You bring a track record of closing a high volume of renewals on time and at the right price, the discipline to run a forecast that holds, and a customer-first approach, with an interest in growing within a dynamic, fast-growing cybersecurity company.
A Renewals Manager owns the renewal for Panorays’ commercial customers, from quote to close, starting 120 days before the renewal date. The Renewals Manager secures up-for-renewal revenue, reduces renewal risk, and works closely with Customer Success Managers, Account Managers, Support, Finance, Legal, and Sales Operations.
Work Days: Monday–Friday, [U.S. / EMEA] business hours.
Own the quote-to-close process for a book of commercial renewals, starting 120 days before the renewal date and closing in Salesforce on or before it.
Achieve or exceed quarterly renewal targets for retention, price increase, and multi-year term extension.
Run every renewal to the Panorays renewal workflow: take the CSM handoff at 120 days (health summary, risk flags, expansion context), build a renewal plan covering terms, pricing, and products, issue the proposal, negotiate, and close.
Partner with the CSM to assess customer health, choose the right renewal path, and agree action plans that raise utilization ahead of the renewal.
Articulate the value of renewing to security leaders and procurement alike, and handle objections on price, scope, and term.
Apply the standard renewal price increase as the default on every renewal, and escalate exceptions early with a clear business case.
Identify at-risk renewals well before the renewal date, escalate to the right people, and mitigate contraction and churn with the CSM, Support, and, where needed, Product.
Keep the renewal forecast accurate: update Salesforce monthly from 120 days out and weekly once the renewal is in quarter, with every forecast stage evidenced by the customer.
Structure multi-year, co-termed and multi-currency renewals, and work with Legal and Finance on terms, quotes, purchase orders, invoicing and collections.
Experience & Skills
2-5 years of experience in renewals, account management, customer success, or sales for B2B SaaS, preferably cybersecurity.
Proven track record of meeting or exceeding a renewal or retention quota.
Experience running a high volume of renewals at once, staying organized at scale and through end-of-quarter peaks.
Strong negotiation skills, including price increases, multi-year terms, complex licence agreements, and working with customer procurement teams.
A solid understanding of SaaS pricing and contract models, and the ability to learn Panorays’ offering and pricing quickly.
Forecasting discipline in Salesforce, with accurate, current opportunity records - a must.
Commercial and numerical fluency: ARR, GRR, NRR, contract terms and renewal economics.
High level of verbal and written communication skills in English, across email, video calls, presentations and proposals - a must.
Ability to close with integrity and independence, and to work as part of a team in an entrepreneurial environment.
Bonus / Preferred
Experience in third-party risk management (TPRM), security ratings, GRC, or cybersecurity.
Experience renewing with regulated industries such as financial services and their procurement processes.
Experience with channel or partner-sourced renewals.
Experience building a renewals function, playbook, or digital renewal motion.
Experience with quoting / CPQ and contract tools.
Experience with customer success and conversation-intelligence tools such as Planhat and Gong, or similar.

job.title: Operations Specialist
job.snippet:
About Nebius
Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
About The Role
The Operations Specialist is responsible for coordinating and managing end-to-end expense, payment, and documentation processes to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant processing of company purchases.
This role acts as a key operational partner across finance, procurement, legal, compliance, accounting, treasury, and logistics teams. The position requires strong attention to detail, the ability to work independently within established frameworks, and a proactive approach to improving operational workflows.
______________________________________________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
Support procurement-related processes, including purchase requests, purchase orders, vendor onboarding, and coordination between requestors, procurement, finance, and suppliers.
Take responsibility for document management involving internal teams and external contractors, ensuring accurate creation, version control, and secure storage
Coordinate agreements, reconciliations, reports, and other operational documents for internal and external counterparties
Process reports and verify that they are complete, accurate, and correctly formatted according to internal standards
Work closely with Accounts Payable teams to support transaction processing and resolve discrepancies
Interact with cross-functional teams, including Legal and Accounting, to address operational issues and ensure smooth workflows
Advise internal stakeholders on transaction processing requirements, documentation standards, and operational procedures
Participate in special projects and cross-functional initiatives as required
Must-have Requirements
Key Qualifications & Experience
1-2 years of experience in procurement operations, purchasing administration, finance operations, or a related operational role, with understanding of end-to-end procurement and purchase-to-pay (P2P) processes.
Experience with document management and operational workflows involving internal teams and external counterparties
Working knowledge of accounts payable processes
Ability to review, and maintain agreements and supporting documentation
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams such as Legal, Accounting, and Finance
Strong attention to detail and ability to ensure accuracy and consistency in documentation and reporting
Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities within established procedures
Clear written and verbal communication skills
Experience with ERP, finance, or document management systems
Fluent English
Preferred Qualifications
Strong Excel or spreadsheet-based tracking and reporting skills
Experience participating in process improvement or special projects
Competencies & Behavioral Traits
Structured, organized and detail-oriented
Strong sense of ownership for assigned processes
Comfortable coordinating across teams and priorities
Process-improvement mindset within defined frameworks
Proactive, solution-oriented approach to operational issues
Ability to understand operational and financial processes, identify gaps, and proactively follow through to completion
Self-driven and accountable, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage competing priorities effectively
Benefits & Perks
Competitive compensation
Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams
What's It Like To Work At Nebius
Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI
Equal Opportunity Statement
Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.
If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

job.title: מתאם/ת סחר ומכירות
job.snippet:
מחפשים תפקיד מגוון שמשלב אנשים, דאטה ותהליכים מסחריים?
הצטרפו אלינו לתפקיד מרכזי בתפעול פעילות הסחר והמכירות, בעבודה שוטפת עם סוכני השטח, לקוחות ומחלקות החברה.
מה כולל התפקיד?
• תפעול הזמנות לקוחות ומעקב אחר אספקות.
• עדכון מחירונים, מבצעים ונתוני מוצרים במערכות.
• תמיכה שוטפת בסוכני המכירות ועבודה מול לקוחות ורשתות קמעונאיות.
• תיאום מול לוגיסטיקה והנהלת חשבונות בנושאי הזמנות, החזרות וזיכויים.
• עבודה שוטפת עם דאטה מסחרי: הפקת דוחות, הצלבת נתונים וניתוח מכירות ועמידה ביעדים.
• זיהוי מגמות, פערים וחריגות והפקת תובנות לתמיכה בפעילות הסחר והמכירות.
מה אנחנו מחפשים?
• ניסיון בתיאום סחר, תפעול מכירות או בק אופיס מסחרי.
• יכולת ניתוח נתונים, הבנה מספרית ויכולת להפיק מסקנות ותובנות מדאטה.
• שליטה טובה מאוד ב־Excel, לרבות נוסחאות, הצלבת נתונים ועבודה עם דוחות.
• ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכת ERP; ניסיון ב־Priority — יתרון משמעותי.
• ניסיון בחברת מוצרי צריכה או בעבודה מול רשתות קמעונאיות — יתרון משמעותי.
• סדר ודיוק, אחריות ויכולת לתעדף משימות ולעקוב אחר הטיפול בהן עד לסגירה.
• יחסי אנוש טובים, תודעת שירות ויכולת עבודה בשיתוף פעולה.
המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

job.snippet:
רכז/ת תפעול פיתוח עסקי
היקף משרה: מלאה, מיקום: נתניה
מחפשים תפקיד שנמצא בלב העשייה העסקית?בתפקיד תהיה לך אחריות על התפעול השוטף של פעילות הפיתוח העסקי בכמיפל, עבודה מול מפיצים, יצרנים וממשקים רבים בתוך החברה, ניהול תוכניות עבודה והזמנות, זיהוי חסמים והנעת תהליכים קדימה.זה תפקיד למי שאוהב.ת לחבר בין אנשים, משימות ותהליכים, לעשות סדר בתוך הרבה ממשקים ולוודא שהדברים באמת קורים, בזמן ובאיכות.תחומי אחריות
•
ניהול הזמנות, תחזיות ומלאי
•
עבודה שוטפת מול ספקים, מפיצים וממשקים פנים ארגוניים
•
הרצת תוכניות עבודה, משימות ועמידה בלוחות זמנים
•
מעקב אחר ייצור, משלוחים והשקות
•
זיהוי חסמים ושיפור תהליכי עבודה
•
תמיכה בפיתוח והשקת מוצרים חדשים
•
מחקר שוק ואיתור הזדמנויות עסקיות
•
יצירת קשר עם לידים ושותפים עסקיים
דרישות התפקיד
• תואר ראשון – חובה.
• אנגלית ברמה גבוהה מאוד.
• עברית ברמה גבוהה.
• שליטה ב־Excel, Canva ובשימוש בכלי AI.
• יכולת עבודה עם מספר משימות וממשקים במקביל.
כישורים נדרשים
• סדר, דיוק, שירותיות, יוזמה, יחסי אנוש מעולים ויכולת עבודה עצמאית עד לסגירת משימות.
• ניסיון בעבודה עם פלטפורמות לניהול פרויקטים – יתרון.
• יכולת ניתוח נתונים, הסקת מסקנות והצגת המלצות ברורות.

job.title: Operations Coordinator & Customer Success
job.snippet:
We’re Hiring! Operations & Customer Success Coordinator
At Naviteq, we provide DevOps and cloud services to technology companies.
We’re looking for a proactive, people-oriented
Operations & Customer Success Coordinator
to join our team!
This is a diverse, hands-on role that combines
customer and employee relations, sales support, business operations, and administration.
You’ll work closely with customers, employees, and internal teams, support our cloud partnerships with AWS and Oracle, and help keep our day-to-day operations running smoothly.
🔹 What you’ll do:
🤝
Customer & Employee Relations
- Build strong relationships, stay connected, understand needs, and follow through on requests and issues.
📈
Sales Support
- Coordinate meetings, track business opportunities, update systems, and support ongoing sales activities.
☁️
Cloud Partner Operations
- Coordinate our AWS and Oracle partnerships, including certifications, deal registrations, incentives, and day to day activities.
🗂️
Business & Employee Operations
- Support employee onboarding, maintain company systems and records, and coordinate equipment, travel, events, and other administrative activities.
✅
Coordination & Follow-up
– Keep tasks, processes, and deadlines organized, making sure things get done.
🔹 What we’re looking for:
✔️ Experience in customer-facing, coordination, or business operations roles.
✔️ Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a genuine service-oriented approach.
✔️ Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
✔️ A proactive, hands-on attitude, independence, and a strong sense of ownership.
✔️ Confidence working with digital tools and business systems.
✔️ Excellent Hebrew and English; Russian is an advantage.
Nice to have:
B2B experience, a background in a tech company, familiarity with DevOps, cloud or IT, and experience with monday.com, CRM systems, or HiBob.
💡
Who will thrive in this role?
Someone who genuinely enjoys working with people, loves variety, takes ownership, and is just as comfortable building relationships as handling the small but important details that keep everything moving.
📍
Full-time | Hybrid work model
📩 Interested, or know someone who could be a great fit? We'd love to hear from you! Send us your CV or reach out directly.

job.title: Product Licensing Coordinator
job.snippet:
Who is PMI Kids’ World?
PMI Kids’ World, an internationally recognized name for trending children’s merchandise and toys, has led the market for over 30 years. The company is one of the top three leading gaming manufacturers worldwide, having collaborated with notable brands such as Disney, Universal Studios, UEFA, FIFA, Nickelodeon, Paramount, Sega, and Epic Games. PMI Kids' World creates its successful product lines through in-depth marketing research to identify the latest and hottest trends. Our operations are founded on four key assets: worldwide merchandising rights, development expertise, manufacturing capabilities, and broad global distribution.
About the Role
We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Product Licensing Coordinator to manage product approvals, project timelines, and international trade show preparations.
This is a hands-on, fast-paced role that involves coordinating multiple projects simultaneously, managing approval processes, and ensuring that products, samples, and materials are ready on time. You will work closely with designers, factories, and international licensors, helping ensure that every stage of the process runs smoothly and according to schedule.
The ideal candidate is an excellent multitasker who can prioritize competing demands, stay on top of tight deadlines, and maintain a high level of accuracy while managing several moving parts at once.
Position Details
Type:
Full-time, on-site position
Location:
Ramat Ha'Chayal, Tel Aviv
Working hours: Monday - Friday
Key Responsibilities
Coordinate new product series from initial concepts through product development and final licensor approval.
Manage day-to-day communication with major international licensors and brand partners, including Disney, NBCUniversal, Paramount, and others.
Work closely with designers and the Product Development team to review/submit products, communicate feedback, and implement requested changes.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously, tracking deadlines, approvals, and production milestones to ensure everything stays on schedule.
Proactively follow up with internal teams, licensors, factories, and suppliers to prevent delays.
Prioritize tasks effectively and respond quickly to changing requirements, urgent requests, and tight timelines.
Coordinate the planning and preparation of international trade shows, exhibitions, and product showcases.
Manage product sample requirements, preparation, organization, and international shipments for trade shows.
Liaise with factories, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure that samples, products, and presentation materials are ready on time.
Skills
Experience in project coordination/product development/licensing/trade show coordination. (Strong Advantage)
Strong multitasking and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage several projects and competing deadlines simultaneously.
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
Comfortable communicating with international partners and collaborating with creative and operational teams.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.
If you are a hardworking person with the above skill set and are looking for an exciting work opportunity in a global company, please apply now or email eden@pmitoys.com

job.title: RevOps Expert
job.snippet:
אנו מגייסים RevOps ורכז/ת מכרזים לתפקיד מגוון הכולל תמיכה במנהלי לקוחות, בקרה עסקית ותפעולית, תמיכה בתהליכי מכרזים ושיפור תהליכים.
התפקיד כולל עבודה שוטפת מול ממשקים פנים ארגוניים ולקוחות, ניתוח נתונים, הפקת דוחות והנעת תהליכים רוחביים.
תחומי אחריות:
הכנת הצעות מחיר, נתונים למצגות הנהלה, בקרה על רווחיות ותקציבים וניהול נתוני פרויקטים והזמנות.
תמיכה בלקוחות בנושאי כספים וחיובים.
איתור וניתוח מכרזים והובלת תהליך הכנת המענים מול הממשקים הרלוונטיים.
ניהול ותחזוקת נתונים במערכות CRM, כולל HubSpot- פתיחת הזדמנויות, דשבורדים, דוחות והדרכות משתמשים.
עבודה עם מערכות תפעוליות כגון Priority, Jira, כולל בקרה תקציבית על פרויקטים, הזמנות וחשבוניות.
פיתוח דוחות ודשבורדים, שיפור איכות הנתונים ותמיכה בקבלת החלטות באמצעות ניתוח נתונים.
קידום אוטומציות, הטמעת כלים ומערכות חדשות ובניית תהליכי עבודה רוחביים וסטנדרטיזציה.
Requirements:
דרישות חובה
תואר ראשון במנהל עסקים/תעשייה וניהול.
יכולת ארגון, סדר וניהול מספר משימות במקביל.
ירידה לפרטים ויכולת עבודה בסביבה מרובת ממשקים.
עצמאות, אחריות אישית ויכולת להניע תהליכים.
כישורי תקשורת בינאישית גבוהים ויכולת עבודה מול לקוחות וממשקים פנים־ארגוניים.
שליטה מלאה ב־Microsoft Office, בדגש על Excel, Word ו־PowerPoint.
יתרון
ניסיון באופרציה, PMO, תיאום פרויקטים או תפקיד אדמיניסטרטיבי/תפעולי.
ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות CRM, HubSpot או Priority.
ניסיון עם מערכות לניהול משימות ופרויקטים כגון Jira.
היכרות עם תהליכי מכרזים במגזר הציבורי והבטחוני.

job.title: PMO TENDERS
job.snippet:
Waxman Group is Israel’s leading company in infrastructure, construction, and complex civil engineering.
We specialize in the planning, management, and execution of national-scale mega-projects that reshape the country’s landscape, redefine its skyline, and build the strategic infrastructure of tomorrow. The Group manages a diverse portfolio of complex projects – from commercial and residential towers to transportation infrastructure, energy, and advanced urban development – all at the core of national activity, impacting the lives of millions of people every day.
Responsibilities
The role involves playing a central part in managing the process of preparing requests for proposals (RFPs) from contractors, including the creation of bills of quantities and cost estimates. It entails in-depth cost analysis, the development of submission strategies, consideration of technological aspects, and maintaining a comprehensive, big-picture view of the project.
This is an excellent opportunity for a significant professional leap, offering genuine growth potential toward leading company-wide processes.
Tender Management and Pricing: Conducting in-depth reviews of tender documents, plans, and technical specifications; assisting in the preparation of bills of quantities and cost estimates.
Interface and Schedule Management: Coordinating and synchronizing the tender process with the company’s project management teams, planners, and consultants.
Cost Analysis: Managing and updating the organizational price database and performing sensitivity analyses.
Documentation and Lessons Learned: Assisting the project manager in tracking and reviewing tender outcomes.
Requirements
Degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Construction, Architecture, or Industrial Engineering & Management – Mandatory.
Approximately 2 years of experience in a Tenders/Pricing department within a contracting or engineering firm – Mandatory.
Proven experience in cost analysis, pricing of line items, and comparing subcontractors.
Excellent proficiency in Excel – Mandatory.
Excellent proficiency in BIM and Revit software – A significant advantage.
Familiarity with pricing/project management software.
Highly driven, proactive, possessing a sharp commercial and economic mindset, combined with a keen eye for detail and precision.
Excellent interpersonal skills; ability to work both independently and as part of a team within a dynamic, fast-paced environment with tight deadlines.
Why take your next step at Waxman Group?
Unlimited learning and personal development: We believe in your growth. Our in-house academy offers a wide range of courses, professional training, advanced seminars, and personal development programs that give you the tools to lead and to stay at the forefront of the industry.
A top-tier employee experience, social life, and welfare: We work hard here — and celebrate even harder. Our package includes lavish company events, an unforgettable annual company retreat, toasts and get-togethers, birthday and personal milestone celebrations, and especially generous gifts for the holidays and special occasions.
Impact on national mega-projects: You will have the opportunity to work at the very heart of the most complex and influential engineering and infrastructure projects in Israel, and to leave a personal mark on the face of the country.
The stability of a large company with the agility of a start-up: A precise balance between strong financial backing, job security, and stability, and a dynamic, fast-paced, bureaucracy-free work environment that encourages initiative and out-of-the-box thinking.
A down-to-earth organizational culture: We combine uncompromising professionalism with a warm, supportive, family atmosphere. Our managers and colleagues are true partners — approachable, always with an open door, and genuinely collaborative both in the office and in the field.
This position is open to women and men alike.
Location
The company's office in Bnei Brak, on the border with Ramat Gan

job.title: Sales Operations Analyst, AWS Israel ENT & PS
job.snippet:
Description
AWS is seeking a talented Sales Operations Analyst to join Israel Sales Strategy and Operations team.
This role will be responsible for supporting the operations and rhythm of the business activities like business reviews, pipeline and forecast. Providing reporting and insights. Managing sales planning which include territory formations, quota and account movements. The role works closely with Sales managers as well as Sales Strategy & Operations leaders, and is analytical in nature and require a person willing to "role up their sleeves" to solve revenue routing issues and re-route accounts to the right owner. Work with AWS business leaders to define and answer key business questions, then work backwards to deliver meaningful insights to streamline the decision making process.
The successful candidate will be a fast learner, proactive, detailed, structured and motivated person with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal end-users and cross-functional teams to solve problems and implement new solutions. You should be passionate about creating simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems while setting high standards. Your deep operational and analytical skills, and focus on our core operational inputs will make you a critical partner to sales and sales operations leaders as you help them prioritize initiatives, identify gaps in process and performance, and remove barriers to execution.
We are looking for a candidate with a strong AI experience, who is used to building tools and agents to automate processes.
Key job responsibilities
Manage key sales support systems and processes required to meet the growth of the business and achieve revenue attainment and market development objectives
Partner closely with the Sales Operations Leads to set ambitious yet achievable goals for the sales organization, then put a framework in place to report, analyze and measure progress against them
Manage territories, accounts, revenue flow, and quota for the sales teams
Develop relationships and work with sales, regional sales operations, and other stakeholders to create and refine the tools and processes needed to drive productivity increases
Operate as the local focal point for the company's account management roles (including revenue routing, segmentation, exceptions, etc.)
Prepare ad hoc analysis
participate in strategic projects
Create metrics, processes and mechanisms
Own the quantitative performance analysis of our sales team, to improve Sales Excellence and productivity
Use AI tools to automate sales operations processes
About The Team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic Qualifications
5+ years of Microsoft Excel experience
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent
Strong AI background building tools and agents to automate and improve processes.
Preferred Qualifications
5+ years of finance, business management and sales operations experience
Experience working within a high-growth, technology company
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: Supply Planner
job.snippet:
שטראוס מגייסת מתכנן.ת אספקות
איך יראה היום שלך?
בניית תוכניות אספקה אופטימליות בהתאם לתחזיות הביקוש וליכולות האספקה בטווחי זמן שונים.
ניהול מלאי חומרי הגלם והאריזות תוך עמידה ביעדי המלאי.
ניהול תרחישים וקבלת החלטות במצבי קונפליקט בין ביקושים, אספקות, תפעול, רכש ולוגיסטיקה.
עבודה שוטפת מול התפ"י המפעלי, רכש ולוגיסטיקה לצורך בחינת ישימות תוכניות האספקה.
הובלת שגרות ותהליכי S&OP תוך ראייה רחבה של כלל שרשרת הערך הארגונית.
זיהוי והנעה של מהלכי שיפור מתמיד בתהליכי עבודה ובפתרונות תכנוניים.
ניהול שותפויות וממשקי עבודה עם מגוון בעלי עניין בארגון.
מה חשוב להביא איתך?
תואר ראשון בהנדסת תעשייה וניהול, כלכלה או מנהל עסקים.
3-5 שנות ניסיון בתכנון או בתפקיד מקביל בתחום שרשרת האספקה או האופרציה.
היכרות עם סביבה תפעולית, שיווקית ומכירתית והבנת השפעת שרשרת האספקה על התחומים השונים.
ניסיון בהובלת תהליכים מולטי-דיסציפלינריים.
ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות ERP וכלי תכנון מתקדמים, עדיפות ל-SAP.
Excel ברמה גבוהה.
אנגלית ברמה טובה.
למה שטראוס?
שטראוס רואה חשיבות רבה לתכנון מדויק ויעיל לאורך כל שרשרת האספקה, מתוך הבנה שהחלטות תכנון משפיעות באופן ישיר על היכולת לתת מענה ללקוחות ולצרכנים. תפקיד ה-Supply Planning Manager בשטראוס הוא חלק משמעותי בחיבור בין ביקושים, תפעול, רכש ולוגיסטיקה ובהבטחת איזון מיטבי לאורך שרשרת הערך. העשייה בתפקיד מחברת בין חשיבה אנליטית, קבלת החלטות והובלת שותפויות עסקיות מול מגוון ממשקים בארגון.

אחריות על איכות השירות, שביעות רצון הלקוחות והשותפים
הובלת תהליכי בטיחות, איכות ועמידה בדרישות הרגולציה ונהלי החברה
הטמעת תהליכי עבודה במרחב ושיפור מתמיד לאיכות הביצוע .

ניסיון בניהול מנהלים ובפיתוח שדרת ניהול - חובה.
ניסיון בניהול מערך תפעולי רחב, מדדים, תקציבים ותוכניות עבודה.
ניסיון מחברת מוצרי צריכה - יתרון משמעותי.

job.snippet:
מנהל/ת לוגיסטיקה ותפעול | E-commerce 🚀
לחברת E-commerce צומחת ודינמית בתחום ה-Beauty & Wellness דרוש/ה
מנהל/ת לוגיסטיקה ותפעול
לתפקיד מרכזי עם אחריות על הפעילות הלוגיסטית בארץ ובחו"ל.
אנחנו מחפשים איש/אשת תפעול עם גישה מעשית (Hands-on), יכולת להניע תהליכים ואנשים, לפתור בעיות בזמן אמת ולשפר באופן מתמיד את היעילות התפעולית.
זו הזדמנות להצטרף לחברה בצמיחה, לקחת אחריות אמיתית ולהשפיע על הדרך שבה הדברים עובדים.
מה כולל התפקיד?
ניהול הפעילות השוטפת מול מרכזים לוגיסטיים חיצוניים (3PL), חברות שילוח והפצה וספקים בארץ ובחו"ל.
אחריות על תהליכי ההזמנות, המשלוחים והאספקות, תוך עמידה ביעדי שירות (SLA).
ניהול ובקרת מלאי, ספירות מלאי, טיפול בפערים ואיזון מלאים בין אתרים.
בקרה על איכות הליקוט, ההפצה וההחזרות, ומתן פתרונות לחריגות תפעוליות.
הובלת ההיערכות הלוגיסטית להשקת מוצרים חדשים, כולל ניהול מק"טים, ברקודים ונתוני מוצר.
ניתוח נתונים ומדדי ביצוע (KPIs), זיהוי צווארי בקבוק והובלת תהליכי התייעלות ושיפור.
עבודה שוטפת מול ממשקים פנימיים, בהם שירות לקוחות, רכש ופיתוח מוצר.
מה אנחנו מחפשים?
2–5 שנות ניסיון בתפקידי לוגיסטיקה ותפעול – חובה.
ניסיון מוכח בעבודה מול מרלו"גים חיצוניים (3PL), חברות שילוח והפצה – חובה.
ניסיון מעשי בניהול מלאי, ספירות מלאי ובקרות תפעוליות.
שליטה טובה ב-Excel, יכולת ניתוח נתונים ועבודה עם דוחות ומדדים.
אוריינטציה טכנולוגית ויכולת למידה מהירה של מערכות תפעוליות.
יכולת עבודה עצמאית, הנעת ממשקים וספקים ופתרון בעיות בזמן אמת.
סדר, דיוק, יוזמה, אחריות אישית גבוהה וגישת Hands-on אמיתית.
יתרון משמעותי
ניסיון מחברות E-commerce או מוצרי צריכה.
היכרות עם Shopify, מערכות ERP, Mantis או Monday.
ניסיון בעבודה מול מרכזים לוגיסטיים בחו"ל ותהליכי יבוא ויצוא.
תואר רלוונטי בלוגיסטיקה, ניהול או כלכלה.
אם אתם אוהבים להיות בלב העשייה, לקחת אחריות, להניע תהליכים ולראות את ההשפעה של העבודה שלכם בשטח – נשמח להכיר!
המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.
חדדי את שפת החברה והקהלקצרי כפילויות באנגלית

job.title: Planning Manager
job.snippet:
About the Role
ZutaCore is looking for an experienced
Planning Manager
to lead and develop the company’s end-to-end Planning and Production Control function.
The role owns the planning cycle across
Demand Planning, Material Planning/MRP, Production Planning, and Production Control
, ensuring alignment between business demand, material availability, and production execution.
We are looking for a hands-on planning leader with a strong manufacturing and materials background who can establish robust processes, bring structure to a dynamic environment, and build scalable planning capabilities as the company grows.
Responsibilities
Lead and develop the
Planning and Production Control
function across Demand Planning, Material Planning/MRP, Production Planning, and Production Control.
Own the end-to-end planning cycle, from demand signals and forecasts through material requirements and production execution.
Translate customer demand, forecasts, and business priorities into executable material and production plans.
Drive
MRP, material availability, shortage management, inventory planning, and production planning
.
Develop and maintain production and material plans aligned with business priorities, capacity, and customer requirements.
Identify planning constraints, shortages, risks, and bottlenecks and drive cross-functional resolution.
Establish and continuously improve standardized and scalable planning processes, methodologies, KPIs, and reporting.
Work closely with
S&OP
to align demand, supply, capacity, and priorities while maintaining ownership of operational planning.
Partner with Procurement, Operations, NPI, Engineering, Quality, Sales, and Finance to ensure effective execution of the plan.
Lead and develop the Planning team, establishing clear responsibilities, priorities, and performance standards.
Requirements
7+ years of experience in Planning, Supply Chain, or Operations within a manufacturing environment
, including significant hands-on planning experience.
Proven experience managing
Material Planning/MRP, Production Planning, and Demand Planning
.
Strong understanding of
MRP, production planning, inventory management, shortage management, and Production Control
.
Previous experience
managing and developing a Planning team
.
Strong experience working with
ERP/MRP systems
in a manufacturing environment.
Experience working with
complex BOMs and internal and/or outsourced manufacturing
.
Experience working with multiple suppliers, material constraints, and changing operational priorities.
Proven ability to
build, improve, and standardize planning processes
in a dynamic and rapidly changing environment.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership skills.
Excellent communication skills in both
Hebrew and English
.
Advantages
Experience in
electronics, multidisciplinary hardware, or complex assembly environments
.
Experience in
high-mix / low-volume manufacturing environments
.
Experience with
Oracle, NetSuite, SAP, or similar ERP systems
.
Experience working with
S&OP processes
.

job.title: Manufacturing Execution & Systems Eng
job.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Rehovot,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
As a Manufacturing Engineer, you are responsible for developing and maintaining methods, operating sequences, and processes in the fabrication of parts, components, subassemblies, and final assemblies. You'll work closely with other engineering functions to coordinate the release of product improvements and new products, and you'll use engineering principles to estimate and reduce manufacturing costs, improve product quality, determine time standards, and make recommendations for tooling and process requirements. Your expertise in lean principles, automation, and continuous improvement will be instrumental in driving operational excellence and achieving higher levels of productivity and cost-effectiveness. You'll develop and use test procedures, evaluate test results, and assess work methods, procedures, and policies to identify root cause issues and solutions that ensure operational success.
Manufacturing Systems & Operational Excellence TL
We are looking for a strong operational leader to lead our Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Technical Documentation, and Operational Excellence team. In this role, you will own the connection between manufacturing systems, production execution, and technical documentation while leading a multidisciplinary team responsible for process execution, system improvements, technical writing, data integrity, and operational excellence initiatives
Key Responsibilities
Lead and develop a team responsible for MES processes, operational excellence initiatives, reporting, and manufacturing systems support.
Drive manufacturing process improvements and system enhancements.
Lead cross-functional initiatives focused on MES, Automation, Data Analytics, and Operational Excellence across Operations and Engineering organizations.
Ensure data integrity and process compliance across manufacturing systems.
Develop KPIs, dashboards, and analytics tools (Power BI / Tableau).
Drive AI and automation initiatives to improve productivity.
Collaborate with global teams in the US and India.
Lead the Technical Writing team from hiring and onboarding through performance, quality, and execution excellence.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering & Management, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
Leadership experience in manufacturing, operations, manufacturing systems, or operational excellence.
4+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing, operations, manufacturing systems, or operational excellence.

job.title: Logistics Coordinator
job.snippet:
We are looking for a Logistics Coordinator who will play a key role in having the requested equipment available in the demand export location on commercial demand for the lowest cost. In addition, his/ her role is to analyze and to take corrective actions in case of wrong data or changes in trends.
Major areas of responsibility
Equipment Control
• Monitor regional container inventory across ports, terminals, depots, and inland locations.
• Analyze equipment supply and demand to ensure optimal container availability.
• Execute equipment positioning and repositioning plans to balance regional inventories.
• Identify equipment shortages and surpluses and recommend corrective actions.
• Support empty equipment optimization initiatives to improve utilization and reduce costs.
Budget Control
• Monitor container repair activities and ensure compliance with company standards.
• Review and approve estimates according to company guidelines.
• Track expenses and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
• Coordinate with depots, surveyors, and service providers regarding repair activities.
• Support M&R budget control and performance monitoring.
Reporting, Analysis & Projects
• Prepare and maintain operational reports and KPI dashboards using BI and logistics systems.
• Analyze equipment performance, inventory trends, and operational data.
• Support forecasting and decision-making processes through data analysis.
• Identify operational improvement opportunities and recommend solutions.
• Participate in regional logistics projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in economics - A Must
• Previous student experience in the field - An advantage
• Strong analytical skills
• Extensive knowledge of Microsoft office (Excel)
• High level of English in speaking and writing- a must
• Capable to work under high pressure
