job.title: Amazon Marketplace Manager  (Tel Aviv)
job.snippet:
Amazon Marketplace Manager (Tel Aviv)
A fast-growing international company of direct-to-consumer beauty & personal care brands, is looking for a sharp, hands-on
Amazon Marketplace Manager
to take full ownership of our Amazon sales channel and drive its next phase of growth.
In this role, you’ll combine commercial strategy with day-to-day execution—from PPC oversight, content, and pricing to inventory planning and performance analysis. You’ll work closely with our internal Growth, Creative, Finance, and Supply Chain teams (as well as external PPC partners) to maximize channel revenue, brand presence, and overall profitability.
What You’ll Do:
*
Own the Channel
: Lead end-to-end operations and strategic growth for our Amazon account.
*
Drive Revenue & Profitability:
Set targets, hit key commercial KPIs, and optimize margins.
*
Elevate Listings & Content:
Manage listing optimizations, SEO, A+ Content, storefronts, pricing, promotions, and new product launches.
*
Oversee PPC Strategy:
Guide ad priorities, monitor campaign performance alongside internal teams or external agencies, and ensure ad spend drives profitable growth.
*
Analyze & Optimize:
Deep-dive into sales data, traffic, conversions, search rankings, and competitor trends to pinpoint new growth opportunities.
*
Manage Inventory Flow
: Partner with Supply Chain to forecast demand, plan stock replenishment, and avoid stockouts or excess inventory.
*
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Team up with Growth, Creative, Finance, and CS to execute continuous improvements and elevate the overall customer experience.
What You’ll Bring to the Table:
*
4+ years of hands-on Amazon experience
: Proven track record in managing and scaling Amazon channels end-to-end (experience in Consumer Goods / Beauty / E-commerce is a huge plus!).
*
Commercial & Data Mindset
: Highly analytical—you love digging into the numbers and know how to turn insights into revenue.
* PPC & Advertising : Strong grasp of Amazon PPC/Ads strategies; you know how to set performance targets and maximize ROI.
* A proactive, self-motivated team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and knows how to push projects forward.

איך יראה היום שלך?
מתן מענה מקצועי לבעיות טכנולוגיות במוצרים ובתהליכי הייצור

job.title: שף/ית תפעולי/ת רשתי/ת | NONO GROUP
job.snippet:
We’re looking for a
Regional Operations Chef
to join our group and lead the culinary and operational standards across our kitchens. This is a key role with broad responsibility for professional standards, food quality, and operational processes across all group locations.
What will you do?
• Provide ongoing professional guidance to Kitchen Managers and lead them toward achieving operational goals and standards
• Conduct professional audits across locations, identify gaps, and lead improvement and efficiency initiatives
• Oversee
Food Cost and Labor Cost
across the group
• Maintain high and consistent culinary standards across all group locations
• Implement and monitor quality, hygiene, and food safety procedures
• Develop and improve operational processes, reduce waste, and increase productivity
• Lead culinary development, introduce new dishes, and update menus
• Train, mentor, and develop Kitchen Managers and kitchen teams
• Work closely with group management, restaurant managers, and other operational teams
What are we looking for?
• Significant experience as a
Senior Chef, Regional Chef, Operations Chef, or in a similar role
• Proven experience managing and leading multiple kitchens or locations simultaneously
• Strong understanding of
Food Cost and Labor Cost
• Experience developing standards, procedures, and workflows at a multi-location level
• Strong leadership, management, and team motivation skills
• A strategic, system-wide perspective combined with strong attention to detail
• Strong business and operational mindset alongside a passion for the culinary world
• Willingness to work in a dynamic environment and travel between group locations
The position is open to all genders

job.title: מומחה/ית מערכות אוטומציה 17870 Logistics Automation Systems Specialist
job.snippet:
חברת CBC ISRAEL, יצרנית ומשווקת המותגים המובילים קוקה-קולה, קרלסברג, נביעות ועוד, מגייסת מומחה.ית מערכות אוטומציה לוגיסטיות לתפקיד משמעותי בפרויקט חדשני ומתקדם במפעל אשקלון.
טעימה מהתפקיד:
• הובלת כלל היבטי התוכנה, המערכות והאינטגרציה בפרויקט לוגיסטי מורכב, משלב האפיון ועד העלייה לאוויר והייצוב.

• אחריות על הגדרת ממשקים, תרחישי עבודה וזרימות מידע בין המערכות השונות.
• הובלת אפיון תהליכים עסקיים והגדרת דרישות מערכת.
• זיהוי ותיעוד פערים בין מערכות ותהליכים והובלת פתרונות מתאימים.
• תיאום וניהול העבודה מול ספקי תוכנה ואוטומציה, תוך מעקב אחר תכולות, לוחות זמנים ותלויות.
• הובלת ישיבות אינטגרציה ותיאום מול כלל הגורמים המעורבים בפרויקט.
• בניית אסטרטגיית בדיקות והובלת תהליכי קבלה ועלייה לאוויר.
• זיהוי סיכוני אינטגרציה והצפת נושאים קריטיים להנהלת הפרויקט.
דרישות:
תואר בהנדסת תעשייה וניהול, מערכות מידע או הנדסת מכונות.
ניסיון של לפחות 3 שנים בעבודה מול ספקי אוטומציה לוגיסטית בתחומי מערכות מידע ותשתיות.
ניסיון באפיון והטמעת תהליכים לוגיסטיים במערכת SAP EWM.
ניסיון בעבודה מול מערכות WMS/WCS וספקי אוטומציה לוגיסטית.
היכרות עם מערכות אוטומציה לוגיסטיות כגון
Systore, Dematic, Knapp, TGW, SSI Schaefer
או מערכות דומות.
היכרות מעמיקה עם תהליכי אוטומציה לוגיסטיים וממשקים בין מערכות.
זו הזדמנות להשתלב בתפקיד מפתח המשלב טכנולוגיה, חדשנות ותפעול, ולהשפיע על פעילותו של אחד ממרכזי הלוגיסטיקה המתקדמים בישראל.
CBC ישראל מעודדת העסקה מגוונת. המשרה מיועדת לכל המינים והמגדרים.

job.snippet:
קצת על התפקיד למפעל מלמ בחטיבת מערכות טילים וחלל דרוש/ה מהנדס/ת בקרה והנחיה. התפקיד כולל:
פיתוח אלגוריתמים בתחומי הנחיה, בקרת טיסה, שערוך ועיבוד אות בטילאות.
תכן טייסים אוטומטיים לביצועי טיסה מאתגרים תוך התחשבות אינטגרטיבית באילוצי המערכת.
עבודה בשלבי הפיתוח השונים: תיכון מוקדם, ארכיטקטורה, תכן מפורט, בדיקות ואישור לניסוי, פענוח ניסוי וגמר פיתוח עד מערכת מבצעית מה אנחנו מחפשים מה אנחנו מחפשים:
תואר ראשון בהנדסת אווירונאוטיקה/ מכונות/חשמל - חובה
יתרון לבעלי תארים מתקדמים
מימוש אלגוריתמים בשפת C,C++ בסביבת VS.
ניסיון בפיתוח אלגוריתמים – יתרון משמעותי
ניסיון בתחום הבקרה/רובוטיקה/רחפנים/מל"טים – יתרון
ניסיון בעבודה מולטידיסציפלינרית - יתרון
אולי יעניין אותך לדעת חטיבת מערכות טילים וחלל מתכננת, מפתחת ומספקת מגוון פתרונות, מערכות ומוצרים בתחומי מערכות הטילים וטכנולוגיות החלל, התקשורת והניווט. מפעל מלמ הוא המפעל המוביל שלנו בפיתוח, עיצוב והנדסת מערכת. מוצרי מלמ כוללים מערכות הגנה אווירית והגנה מטילים, טכנולוגיות חלל ושיגור, פיקוד ושליטה, תקיפה מדויקת וסימולציות אשר מופקים בעזרת הטכנולוגיות המתקדמות ביותר בעולם. התפקיד בליבת העשייה של מלמ, אשר עוזר בעיצוב המערכת, תכנונה ועד כי מימושה במוצרי החברה. האלגוריתמים המפותחים לוקחים את המערכות המתקדמות בעולם עד קצת גבול היכולת הפיזיקליים ומעבר לו.

job.title: GTM Engineer
job.snippet:
What is this opportunity?
The people who deliver care in our communities and homes do some of the most important work in healthcare. But too often, theyʼre asked to spend their time navigating paperwork, administrative burden, and problems they only discover after something has already gone wrong.
Eleos exists to change that.
Weʼre building the system of action for community-based care - helping behavioral health, hospice, home health, and other care teams spend less time reacting to problems and more time focused on the people they serve.
Powered by our Polaris AI, Eleos works alongside clinicians and their teams to understand whatʼs happening across care in real time and take action before issues become problems, reducing administrative burden, protecting revenue and compliance, and giving care teams more time and capacity to deliver great care.
Our vision is a world where care teams can stay one step ahead, rather than constantly catching up. Weʼre helping shift an entire industry from reactive to proactive, and we need talented people to help us get there.
happening across care in real time and take action before issues become problems, reducing administrative burden, protecting revenue and compliance, and giving care teams more time and capacity to deliver great care.
Our vision is a world where care teams can stay one step ahead, rather than constantly catching up. Weʼre helping shift an entire industry from reactive to proactive, and we need talented people to help us get there.
Who are you?
You are someone who gets energized by turning a messy, manual process into something that runs automatically and at scale. You think in systems — you see how tools, data, and workflows connect across teams, and you know how to design solutions that are coherent. You do not wait for perfect requirements, you move fast but do not compromise on things that matter. You ship, you learn, and you improve. You are excited about doing this work in a behavioral health company where the downstream impact of getting operations right is real.
How will you contribute?
Map current-state processes, identify automation and optimization opportunities, and build end-to-end workflows that reduce manual work and improve consistency across GTM and operations
Develop and deploy AI agents, copilots, and automation tools that support daily operations — integrating AI into existing systems to enhance decision-making and execution, not as a bolt-on layer but as a first-class component
Connect tools, data sources, and workflows across the tech stack to ensure seamless data flow between systems and enable real-time insights and actions
Create scalable frameworks for how workflows are built, maintained, and improved — establishing best practices for automation governance and performance tracking so others can operate and extend what you build
Monitor workflow performance, iterate quickly based on user feedback and operational impact, and translate ambiguous stakeholder problems into structured, executable solutions
Constantly track the AI landscape and new innovations, bringing in best practices, new tools and capabilities that move the needle
Take charge of solution deployment end-to-end from discovery to adoption. Support teams in developing enablement and the incorporation of solutions. The platform only matters if people use it.
What qualifications and skills will help you be successful?
Hands-on experience building production workflows using automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato, or similar
Practical experience applying AI and LLM tools to real operational workflows — including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or open-source models — with at least one deployed example you can speak to concretely
Logical approach, thinking in structured steps and knowing how to break down workflows, sequence them correctly, and designing how they should run before building them.
Comfort working across both technical and non-technical stakeholders and translating between the two
Prioritizing building and shipping over prolonged planning; moving from idea to production quickly.
Driving initiatives forward with minimal oversight; proactively engaging the right stakeholders without being directed to. Taking ownership and leading confidently.
Experience in teaching and change management; treating adoption as part of the job, not an afterthought. Demonstrated patience with others.
2–5 years of relevant experience in workflow automation, AI operations, RevOps, or a technical GTM or systems role
Some nice-to-haves:
Experience with APIs, data pipelines, or low-code / no-code platforms
Exposure to CRM, support, or operational SaaS systems
Background in operations, systems design, or process improvement

You do not wait for perfect requirements, you move fast but do not compromise on things that matter. You ship, you learn, and you improve. You are excited about doing this work in a behavioral health company where the downstream impact of getting operations right is real.
How will you contribute?
Map current-state processes, identify automation and optimization opportunities, and build end-to-end workflows that reduce manual work and improve consistency across GTM and operations
Develop and deploy AI agents, copilots, and automation tools that support daily operations — integrating AI into existing systems to enhance decision-making and execution, not as a bolt-on layer but as a first-class component
Connect tools, data sources, and workflows across the tech stack to ensure seamless data flow between systems and enable real-time insights and actions
Create scalable frameworks for how workflows are built, maintained, and improved — establishing best practices for automation governance and performance tracking so others can operate and extend what you build
Monitor workflow performance, iterate quickly based on user feedback and operational impact, and translate ambiguous stakeholder problems into structured, executable solutions
Constantly track the AI landscape and new innovations, bringing in best practices, new tools and capabilities that move the needle
Take charge of solution deployment end-to-end from discovery to adoption. Support teams in developing enablement and the incorporation of solutions. The platform only matters if people use it.

Hands-on experience building production workflows using automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato, or similar
Practical experience applying AI and LLM tools to real operational workflows — including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or open-source models — with at least one deployed example you can speak to concretely
Logical approach, thinking in structured steps and knowing how to break down workflows, sequence them correctly, and designing how they should run before building them.
Comfort working across both technical and non-technical stakeholders and translating between the two
Prioritizing building and shipping over prolonged planning; moving from idea to production quickly.
Driving initiatives forward with minimal oversight; proactively engaging the right stakeholders without being directed to. Taking ownership and leading confidently.
Experience in teaching and change management; treating adoption as part of the job, not an afterthought. Demonstrated patience with others.
2–5 years of relevant experience in workflow automation, AI operations, RevOps, or a technical GTM or systems role
Some nice-to-haves:
Experience with APIs, data pipelines, or low-code / no-code platforms
Exposure to CRM, support, or operational SaaS systems
Background in operations, systems design, or process improvement

job.title: FlowRx- Senior Automation Engineer / RPA Specialist
job.snippet:
About Us
FlowRx is a newly funded, post-seed AI startup dedicated to making a positive impact on US pharmacies. By building advanced automation technology, we improve connectivity across the healthcare ecosystem and make pharmacies more efficient. We're looking for a creative Senior Automation Engineer / RPA Specialist to help us build an exciting new product that truly does good. If you're ready to lead, innovate, and grow — join us!
About The Role
We aren't just looking for someone to build standard bots; we need a
Senior Automation Engineer
who can build the nervous system of our platform. You will design, architect, and implement high-impact automation workflows that operate flawlessly within Windows/VM environments.
Working directly alongside our product and engineering teams, you will translate complex business logic into elegant, scalable automations and integrate them seamlessly into our client-facing systems. Because you are joining at the ground floor, your architecture decisions will shape the future of our product.
Requirements:
What You’ll Do
Architect & Build: Design and implement robust, scalable automation workflows for complex applications in Windows-based VM environments.
Collaborate & Innovate: Partner closely with product and engineering to define automation requirements and integrate them into our core platform.
Ensure Reliability: Build fault-tolerant systems by implementing advanced error handling, monitoring, and logging to ensure our automations never miss a beat.
Drive Immediate Impact: Deliver fast, high-value automation solutions that directly improve the healthcare ecosystem from day one.
What We’re Looking For
RPA Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with top-tier RPA tools (UiPath is strongly preferred).
Windows Automation Mastery: Proven track record of automating complex, repetitive application tasks within Windows environments.
Technical Agility: You are a fast learner and a natural problem solver who can quickly master new domains, legacy systems, and technical constraints.
Coding Chops: Strong scripting knowledge (e.g., Python, PowerShell) is a massive advantage.
Startup DNA: You are proactive, highly detail-oriented, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment.
Why Join us?
Ground-Floor Opportunity: Join the core technical team of a highly ambitious, stealth-stage startup backed by top-tier venture capital.
Radical Ownership: Own and deliver end-to-end automation solutions from your very first week.
Meaningful Mission: Directly improves the digital health landscape.
Accelerated Growth: A high-velocity environment where your career trajectory scales with the company.

job.title: Finance Operations Coordinator
job.snippet:
Enlight is a leading global renewable energy company, developing, building, owning and operating large-scale solar, wind and energy storage projects across the U.S., Europe and MENA.
We're growing, and looking for talented people to join us on the journey.
We are looking for a
Finance Operations Coordinator
to coordinate day-to-day financial operations across Enlight's European operational companies.
The role involves working closely with global accounting providers, Asset Managers, banks, and Headquarters teams (Treasury Controllers and more) to ensure timely payments, efficient financial processes, and smooth monthly and quarterly closings.
Responsibilities:
Local Accounting & Financial Operations
Coordinate daily activities with local accounting providers across Europe.
Monitor deliverables, deadlines, and service quality.
Support supplier onboarding, purchase orders, and invoice approval workflows.
Payments, Banking & Collections
Coordinate payment processes with accounting providers, Treasury, and authorized approvers.
Track payments, outstanding receivables, and financial process exceptions.
Follow up on operational banking matters and revenue invoicing.
Financial Closing & Compliance
Coordinate monthly and quarterly closing processes and required documentation.
Prepare financial information packages for Asset Managers' review.
Maintain invoice records and coordinate SOX documentation for European and Israeli entities.
Coordinate management fee invoicing and payment follow-up.
Cross-Functional Coordination
Serve as a key operational interface between Asset Management, Finance, Treasury, and external providers.
Track outstanding financial matters and ensure timely follow-up and escalation.
Support financial systems, process improvements, and implementation of approved changes.
Requirements:
Education
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field - an advantage
Experience
2-4 years of experience in finance operations, accounting coordination, financial administration or support financial activities - mandatory.
Experience working with invoices, payments, suppliers, and financial closing processes - mandatory.
Experience working with global entities or external accounting providers - significant advantage.
Experience working with SAP or similar ERP systems - significant advantage.
Experience in Renewable Energy or infrastructure - advantage.
Methodical approach, organizational skills, precision, and the ability to multitask.
Skills & Competencies
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Proactive, service-oriented approach with strong follow-up and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication and cross-functional coordination skills.
Proficiency in Excel and Microsoft Office.
Excellent English, written and spoken - mandatory.
Availability to travel aboard - Quarterly basis.

job.title: CONTRACTS AND ACCOUNTS COORDINATOR
job.snippet:
Waxman Group is Israel’s leading company in infrastructure, construction, and complex civil engineering.
We specialize in the planning, management, and execution of national-scale mega-projects that reshape the country’s landscape, redefine its skyline, and build the strategic infrastructure of tomorrow. The Group manages a diverse portfolio of complex projects – from commercial and residential towers to transportation infrastructure, energy, and advanced urban development – all at the core of national activity, impacting the lives of millions of people every day.
Responsibilities
Coordinating and supporting the accounts payable process, including receiving invoices, performing checks, tracking approvals, and completing the process within the relevant systems
Managing and monitoring the project budget and cash flow, preparing reports, and conducting ongoing controls
Coordinating and handling contracts, quotations, variations, exceptions, and final accounts with relevant stakeholders
Maintaining ongoing communication with Project Managers, developers, contractors, designers, consultants, and authorities, including legal, insurance, and engineering interfaces
Managing calendars, coordinating meetings, and providing ongoing administrative support to the project team
Managing and tracking tasks and processes independently in a multi-interface environment
Requirements
Experience working with Priority – mandatory
Full proficiency in Excel – mandatory
Experience in the construction and/or planning industry and familiarity with Ramdor/Binary systems – a significant advantage
Good command of English – a significant advantage
Training or certification in bookkeeping and/or economics – an advantage
Ability to work independently, with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, process-oriented thinking, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and interfaces
Why take your next step at Waxman Group?
Unlimited learning and personal development: We believe in your growth. Our in-house academy offers a wide range of courses, professional training, advanced seminars, and personal development programs that give you the tools to lead and to stay at the forefront of the industry.
A top-tier employee experience, social life, and welfare: We work hard here — and celebrate even harder. Our package includes lavish company events, an unforgettable annual company retreat, toasts and get-togethers, birthday and personal milestone celebrations, and especially generous gifts for the holidays and special occasions.
Impact on national mega-projects: You will have the opportunity to work at the very heart of the most complex and influential engineering and infrastructure projects in Israel, and to leave a personal mark on the face of the country.
The stability of a large company with the agility of a start-up: A precise balance between strong financial backing, job security, and stability, and a dynamic, fast-paced, bureaucracy-free work environment that encourages initiative and out-of-the-box thinking.
A down-to-earth organizational culture: We combine uncompromising professionalism with a warm, supportive, family atmosphere. Our managers and colleagues are true partners — approachable, always with an open door, and genuinely collaborative both in the office and in the field.
This position is open to women and men alike.
Location
Company Site – Ramat Gan

job.title: Treasury Operations Associate
job.snippet:
About
Candex is a rapidly growing private global B2B fintech company on a mission to reshape the way businesses transact. Our tech-based solution makes purchasing fast and easy for enterprise buyers. Recognized in the ProcureTech 100 for Procurement Innovation, our SaaS Platform and accompanying services completely transform the buying experience for large companies around the globe. Buyers enjoy the simplicity of Candex for their purchases, vendors get paid faster, and procurement teams love the increased control they gain over purchases — Everyone wins!
We serve companies in the Global 2,000 and our existing clients include some of the world’s biggest corporations. We’ve raised over $130M from leading investors including Goldman Sachs, 9Yards Capital, JP Morgan, American Express, Altos, Craft, and NFX. Available in almost 50 countries, Candex is expanding our already robust footprint and is looking for ambitious, fun people to join us on our mission to revolutionize the way businesses engage and pay their suppliers.
Candex is proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified — a reflection of the culture our team has built together.
Candex is seeking an
Treasury Operations Associate
to join our team in Israel. In this role, you will support our global growth by processing and reconciling customer payments across multiple bank accounts, currencies, and entities. You will manage high-volume transactions, perform bank reconciliations, and resolve payment discrepancies by communicating with customer Accounts Payable teams. This position reports to the Treasury Operations Team Lead and plays a key role in supporting our global payment operations.
This position is
hybrid, based in our Israel office, with an expectation of working from the office three times a week.
Key Responsibilities
Process and review a high volume of customer payments.
Perform daily bank reconciliations across multiple bank accounts and currencies.
Create customer deposits and record journal entries in NetSuite.
Communicate with customer Accounts Payable teams to resolve payment discrepancies.
Collaborate with internal teams to resolve complex cases.
Support month-end close by clearing outstanding transactions and coordinating with banks and internal stakeholders.
Requirements
1 – 2 years of relevant experience in Accounts Receivable, Cash Application, Bank Reconciliation, bookkeeping, or a similar financial role.
Strong practical accounting and reconciliation experience.
Ability to learn new systems, processes, and financial workflows quickly.
Comfortable working in a fast-changing environment where processes may evolve frequently.
Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and ability to manage a high volume of transactions.
Experience with NetSuite - advantage.
Advanced level of English proficiency - advantage.
Why Work With Us
We are humble, hungry, intelligent and collaborative. Work alongside teammates who value curiosity, kindness, and shared success.
Competitive Compensation – Earn a salary and benefits that reflect your skills and impact.
Parental Leave – Take meaningful time to bond with your growing family.
Flexible Work Environment – Balance life and work with adaptable schedules.
Global Team + Mindset – Join a diverse, international team that thinks beyond borders.
Tech Setup – Get the gear and support you need to work comfortably.
Professional Development – Grow your skills with training and learning sessions.
Internal Mobility – Explore new global roles and career paths without leaving the company.
Team Outings – Connect and celebrate with colleagues through regular social events.
Our Values
Be a Stickler for Details - we think about the details when making decisions and ensure we haven’t overlooked anything.
Debate, Decide, Deliver - Candexers foster a culture of open debate so we can make the right decision.
Innovate to Simplify - we continuously look for simpler ways to do everything.
Follow Through, Follow Up - we are always moving the ball forward – when we say we will do something, we do it.
Attract & Develop the Best - we expect each hire to raise the bar, and once they start, they should continue to develop their skills with the support of leadership.
Keep an Obsessive Customer Focus - our customers’ satisfaction is our obsession, and we will stop at nothing to make their experience simple & flawless.
Learn & Be Curious - we foster an environment of continual learning and encourage challenging questions and believe curiosity drives innovation and improvement.
Act with Integrity & Professionalism - we act with honesty, transparency, and ethical principles – ensuring our actions align with our values.

job.title: Finance Operations Associate
job.snippet:
We are:
Zota is a payment gateway technology hub, serving as a one stop shop for online businesses, enabling them to accept payments from anyone, anywhere. We are connected to over 1000 financial institutions worldwide, allowing us to centralize a range of global and local payment methods, on one payment page.
About the Opportunity
Discover the opportunity to join our expanding Finance Team at a pioneer FinTech company. We are seeking people who thrive in collaborative environments, are eager to learn and develop careers in a global environment, and appreciate working with cutting edge technology in a vibrant, dynamic setting.
Main responsibilities:
Compile and produce a variety of financial reports that support both internal and external business functions
Analyze financial data to ensure accuracy and alignment with company goals and market trends
Manage and monitor merchant’s financial accounts, ensuring accurate and timely updates to records and balances
Collaborate with cross functional teams to present comprehensive financial analyses and insights
Handle daily correspondence with merchants via Email, Teams, and other communication tools
Support the Finance Team’s ongoing operations by occasionally working weekends and holidays
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
Experience in finance operations, accounting, or payment processing
Strong analytical and numerical skills with high attention to detail.
Excellent Excel and Google Sheets skills
Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks in a fast paced environment.
High level of English (both written and verbal)
A few of our office benefits & perks:
Growth opportunities!
Private chef for breakfast and lunch (including an in-house pastry chef for fresh desserts).
Monthly shiatsu treatments and fully equipped wellness center.
Weekly happy hours.
Annual international company kick off trip & team events.

job.title: Finance Operations Specialist
job.snippet:
Who We Are:
WeSki’s vision is to make it easy for skiers across the globe to book and enjoy their ideal ski trip at the best possible price. As the ultimate ski trip booking platform, WeSki enables everyone to design and book their ideal adventure in just a few clicks - quickly, seamlessly, and affordably.
WeSki’s technology compares millions of combinations of flights, accommodation, transfers, passes, gear, and lessons instantly, saving hours of planning. Each trip is fully customisable, giving customers the flexibility of building it themselves, with the expert protection and support of a holiday provider.
With all trip components automatically linked, customers can relax and enjoy their holiday knowing that all the logistics are taken care of, alongside 24/7 customer service whilst they’re away.
WeSki is an innovative, passionate, and fast-moving company. We partner with over 275 ski resorts across 19 countries and have already sold over 100,000 ski holiday packages to skiers worldwide. We are growing rapidly while maintaining profitability, making this an exciting time to join our Finance team.
Role Overview:
As a Finance Operations Specialist, you will play a key role in keeping WeSki’s day-to-day financial operations running smoothly, accurately, and efficiently.
This is a hands-on operational role with a broad scope, covering supplier payments, customer payments, reconciliations, financial controls, and process management. You’ll work closely with the Head of Finance Operations while independently managing key processes and ensuring they are handled effectively from start to finish.
We’re looking for someone who is comfortable getting into the details, taking ownership of problems, and improving the way things are done. This isn’t a role for someone who simply follows existing processes. We want someone who is curious about how things work, challenges inefficient workflows, and looks for opportunities to use AI, automation, and technology to make our finance operations more efficient and scalable.
The role requires a solid understanding of financial processes, but above all, a strong operational mindset and the ability to independently drive tasks and processes from start to finish.
Responsibilities
Independently manage day-to-day finance operations, including supplier payments, customer payments, reconciliations, and related financial processes.
Review and validate supplier invoices, payment requests, and supporting documentation.
Perform account and payment reconciliations, identify discrepancies, and follow issues through to resolution.
Monitor financial activity and proactively identify missing, incorrect, duplicated, or unexpected transactions.
Work closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve payment and financial issues quickly and effectively.
Maintain accurate financial records and ensure transactions are properly documented and reflected across the relevant systems.
Manage recurring finance processes from start to finish, ensuring they are completed accurately, on time, and in line with established controls and procedures.
Support month-end and other periodic financial activities as needed.
Investigate unexpected financial and operational issues, identify root causes, and drive practical solutions through to resolution.
Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, and bottlenecks across Finance operations, and proactively improve the way we work.
Lead or support the implementation of automation and AI-based solutions to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase efficiency.
Help build, standardise, and document scalable finance processes as WeSki continues to grow.
Support the wider Finance Operations function and take responsibility for ad hoc finance projects and initiatives as needed.
Requirements
3+ years of experience in finance operations, accounts payable/receivebale, accounting, or a similar role.
Solid understanding of core financial processes, including invoices, payments, reconciliations, and basic accounting principles.
Strong attention to detail and a consistently high level of accuracy.
Proven ability to independently manage processes from start to finish.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and find practical solutions.
Highly organised, with the ability to prioritise effectively and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
Good Excel / Google Sheets skills and confidence working with financial data.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
A hands-on, proactive approach and willingness to get into the details.
Technologically curious and comfortable using AI and automation tools, with an interest in finding smarter and more efficient ways to work.
Ability to adapt quickly to changing processes, priorities, and business needs.
Advantages
Experience working in a high-growth startup or fast-paced environment.
Experience in the travel, hospitality, or e-commerce industry.
Experience working with ERP, accounting, payment, or finance systems.
Experience building, improving, or automating financial processes.
Experience using AI tools to improve workflows or automate repetitive tasks.
Experience working with international suppliers, multiple currencies, or cross-border payments.

ביצוע התאמות בנקים, כרטיסי אשראי, ספקים ולקוחות.

עבודה בצוות לצד חשבי/ות שכר ומנהלי/ות חשבונות.
התפקיד מדווח למנהל הכספים של החברה.

עברית ברמה טובה.

job.title: Software Engineer (Core)
job.snippet:
We’re a fast-moving, US-Israeli AI startup building next-generation infrastructure for the world’s most demanding AI workloads. Our mission is to accelerate the future of intelligence and make it ubiquitously accessible by delivering full stack custom AI servers optimized for large-scale inference and training.
Backed by top-tier investors and led by industry veterans, we’re scaling rapidly. We seek forward-thinking engineers and operators who thrive in a collaborative environment and excel at solving complex challenges from first principles. If you want to build infrastructure that fundamentally changes what the world can accomplish with AI, come join us!
About The Position
﻿
We are looking for an experienced, highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to join our core team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining critical components of our AI-driven software stack. You will work on the core interfaces that allow applications, frameworks, and APIs to communicate efficiently and reliably with our hardware. This is a hands-on technical position where you will solve complex problems, optimize for performance, and contribute to the next generation of our technology.
Responsibilities
﻿
Develop and maintain key components of Majestic software stack, including API layers, command submission pipelines, and memory management
Collaborate with hardware architects to influence the design of next-generation chips and ensure a smooth software/hardware co-design
Work with kernel-space driver developers to define and implement the user/kernel interface
Debug complex issues across the entire stack, from user applications to the underlying hardware
Optimize code for maximum performance, throughput, and efficiency
Requirements:
Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field from a recognized university
Proven experience developing software for Linux, with a solid grasp of OS fundamentals like memory management, multi-threading, and inter-process communication
5-10 years of experience in software development
Proven experience in C programming
Knowledge in GPU programming
Excellent communication skills with a strong track record of cross-functional collaboration
Preferred Qualifications
﻿
Experience with Python and C++
Knowledge of GPU or other accelerator architectures (e.g., CUDA, OpenCL, ROCm)
Knowledge of HPC applications development
Experience in linux kernel-space development
We seek smart, curious, self-driven individuals who enjoy creative problem-solving and continuous learning. Even if you don't meet all requirements, we'd love to hear from you if you have the mindset to tackle complex challenges.
Majestic Labs is an equal opportunity employer deeply committed to diversity of background and thought. If you are ready to dare greatly, learn from mistakes, engage in vigorous debates, and help create a step-function shift in human technical capability, we want to meet you!

job.title: Product Manager – AI Consumer Products
job.snippet:
Product Manager – AI Consumer Products
B2C & AI-NATIVE EXPERIENCES
We're looking for a Product Manager to join our team and own a core domain within our B2C product, built primarily for the U.S. market.
This is a hands-on role for an experienced product leader with a strong background in consumer products and real-world experience building AI-native experiences with LLMs and AI agents.
You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and AI teams to define priorities, drive execution, and gradually take broader ownership of your domain and its roadmap as the team grows.
What You'll Do
Own a core product domain and drive it from problem definition through execution and iteration
Build and improve AI-native user experiences powered by LLMs and AI agents
Work hands-on with prompts, conversational flows, model behavior, evaluations, and edge cases
Translate user needs, data, and business goals into clear priorities and product requirements
Partner closely with Engineering and AI teams on technical decisions and trade-offs
Drive cross-functional execution and keep stakeholders aligned around priorities
Make decisions and move work forward in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment
Take increasing ownership of your domain's roadmap as the product and team grow
What We're Looking For
3+ years of Product Management experience in B2C products
Proven experience building LLM- or AI agent-based products for end users
Hands-on experience with prompt design and improving AI behavior as part of the product experience
Experience owning product areas, prioritization, and roadmaps
Strong technical orientation and the ability to work effectively with engineers on complex systems
Excellent written and verbal English
Highly organized, structured, and execution-oriented
Strong ownership and the confidence to make decisions independently
Active, sophisticated use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and similar products
Nice to Have
Experience building products specifically for U.S. consumers
Experience in a fast-paced startup environment

job.title: Software & Firmware Team Manager
job.snippet:
System-Level Architecture: Lead system-level software and firmware architecture, defining core interfaces and communication protocols (APIs, Wireless) between the device, mobile app, and test/manufacturing tools.
Firmware Engineering: Hands-on embedded firmware design.
Cybersecurity: Lead the cybersecurity strategy and implementation across all company products following a Secure by Design approach. Perform cybersecurity risk assessments (Threat Modeling), define encryption mechanisms, secure communication protocols, Secure Boot, and Secure Firmware Over-The-Air (FOTA) updates.
Support the New Product Introduction (NPI) process by developing and maintaining testing infrastructure and production jigs.
Provide ongoing technical support for software/firmware issues arising on the production line.
Write, review, and approve regulatory software documentation throughout the Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC), including Software Requirements Specifications (SRS), Software Design Descriptions (SDD), Traceability Matrices, and Integration Reports.
Agile Project Management: Lead software projects using Agile methodologies—plan, track, and execute day-to-day tasks, milestones, project schedules, and resource allocation aligned with the overall R&D roadmap.
Provide technical leadership, professional mentoring, and hands-on troubleshooting support for complex technical challenges.
Ensure full alignment with international Cybersecurity regulations and guidelines (FDA Cybersecurity Guidance, EU MDR) and follow the Quality Management System (QMS) processes and international medical device standards (IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 60601).
Work closely with Software V&V, Hardware, Mechanical, and QA/RA teams.
Requirements:
B.Sc. in Software Engineering / Computer Science
10+ years of experience in software and firmware development for multidisciplinary systems (integrating hardware, software, mechanics, and sensors), experience in the Medical Device industry – Strong Advantage.
Proven hands-on experience in Embedded C/ C++ development for Microcontrollers (MCU).
Experience with cybersecurity regulatory standards for medical devices, leading Cybersecurity initiatives in embedded or medical device environments (Threat Modeling, encryption, secure architecture).
Strong background in writing in-depth engineering and development documentation.
Team Lead or Tech Lead experience managing engineers – Advantage.
Experience in development and integration of mobile applications/ wireless communication protocols (BLE, Wi-Fi, etc.) – Significant Advantage.
Experience developing test tools, automation, and manufacturing infrastructure (Python, C#, LabVIEW, or similar) – Advantage.
Deep familiarity with medical software development standards: IEC 62304, ISO 14971 (Risk Management), and FDA guidance – Strong Advantage.

job.title: Head of AI
job.snippet:
MAËLYS is a fast-growing global body care brand, built on a proprietary e-commerce platform, deep consumer insights, and a relentless focus on performance. Millions of women worldwide use our products, and we are on a mission to become one of the most influential body care brands globally.
We operate at extreme velocity, with high standards and an obsession with results. We believe in challenging conventional thinking, making data-driven decisions, and moving quickly from idea to execution.
We are looking for a
Head of AI
to build and lead MAËLYS' AI transformation journey, serving as a rare opportunity for a highly strategic and deeply hands-on builder who thrives at the intersection of business, technology, and execution. In this role, you will have the ultimate playground to shape how our entire company operates, influence every major function, and create a lasting competitive advantage for a leading body care brand. Initially operating as an individual contributor partnering closely with the CEO and the Management Team. Over time, you will transition to build and lead a small, high-performing team as AI becomes an increasingly critical capability across our global e-commerce and retail operations.
To thrive in our high-pace environment, you must think like an owner, not a consultant, and be equally comfortable discussing macro business strategy with executives as well as writing code to solve a messy problem yourself. You are someone who embraces ambiguity, enjoys building from scratch, and is completely obsessed with execution. You possess the high emotional intelligence and empathy required to collaborate with non-technical stakeholders and build trust, yet you maintain the thick skin, resilience, and great sense of humor needed to handle direct communication and rapid structural pivots. Most importantly, you maintain an uncompromising commitment to quality and process improvement, ensuring that every automation or workflow you deploy actively drives our core business metrics forward without requiring hand-holding or constant reminders.
Your life at MAËLYS will look like…
-Define and lead the company's AI strategy and execution roadmap.
-Identify the highest-impact opportunities for AI across all business functions.
-Prioritize initiatives based on measurable business value, speed of implementation, and scalability.
-Design, build, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered workflows, tools, automations, and agents.
-Translate business challenges into practical AI solutions that improve performance, efficiency, and decision-making.
-Develop production-ready applications and workflows using modern AI technologies, APIs, agents, and automation frameworks.
-Drive adoption and behavioral change across teams.
-Partner directly with business leaders to identify opportunities and implement solutions.
-Evaluate emerging technologies, models, vendors, and platforms.
-Establish governance, standards, architecture, and best practices for AI development.
-Define and track success metrics for every AI initiative, ensuring measurable impact on growth, productivity, speed, efficiency, or cost.
You will thrive in this role if you have…
-Strong technical foundation in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
-5+ years of experience building technology, data, AI, automation, or software solutions in high-performance environments.
-Proven experience identifying business opportunities and translating them into deployed AI products, agents, automations, or workflows that drive measurable business impact.
-Hands-on experience working with modern generative AI technologies, LLMs, agent frameworks, APIs, embeddings, automation platforms, and production deployments.
-Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, APIs, and data-driven application development.
-Deep understanding of business operations, growth metrics, performance marketing, and operational KPIs.
-Ability to operate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
-Exceptional problem-solving and execution skills.
-Full professional fluency in Hebrew and English.
Strong Advantages:
-Alumni of Unit 8200 or other elite IDF technological units.
-Experience building AI products, internal platforms, or automation systems at scale.
-Experience in high-growth startups, technology companies, consulting firms, or founder-led environments.
-Experience leading cross-functional transformation initiatives.
-Experience hiring and managing technical teams.

job.title: SRE
job.snippet:
Join the technology team of a leading fintech organization and take part in ensuring the stability, reliability, and performance of large-scale, business-critical production systems. As a Technical Integrator SRE, you'll work closely with development, infrastructure, and operations teams, supporting systems throughout the development lifecycle, from early planning and architecture to production operations. You'll play a key role in troubleshooting complex incidents, improving monitoring capabilities, and driving continuous reliability improvements.
What You'll Do:
Serve as a central technical interface between development teams, operations, infrastructure, and external vendors.
Work closely with development teams from early planning and architecture stages to ensure production readiness, monitoring, and system reliability.
Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production incidents across distributed systems and Microservices environments.
Build and maintain monitoring systems, dashboards, and alerts, and lead data-driven Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Drive continuous improvements in system stability, performance, automation, and operational efficiency.
Leverage advanced AI tools such as Claude and Kiro to improve troubleshooting, automation, and reliability workflows.
Requirements:
3+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, Production Engineering, or similar technical roles.
Strong technical background in DevOps, production environments, and complex system troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience with
Splunk and Dynatrace
for production monitoring and troubleshooting.
Experience building and managing monitoring systems, dashboards, and alerts.
Good understanding of software development processes, Microservices architecture, and system integrations.
Experience working with databases such as
MongoDB, DocumentDB, and SQL
.
Familiarity with
AWS and OpenShift (OCP)
environments.
Familiarity with AI development and operations tools such as
Claude or Kiro
- a significant advantage.
Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, independence, and a high sense of ownership.
Excellent communication skills, assertiveness, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ability to work under pressure and availability to support critical production incidents outside regular working hours.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field – an advantage.

job.title: IT Service Specialist
job.snippet:
About etoro:
etoro is the platform where you can trade, invest, save, and spend. Founded in 2007 with the vision of a world where everyone can trade and invest in a simple and transparent way, we've built a regulated, Nasdaq-listed platform used by millions of people in 75 countries.
We believe there is power in shared knowledge. By combining the collective intelligence of our community with AI-powered tools, we've created a collaborative investment community designed to help you grow your knowledge and wealth.
On etoro, you can hold a range of traditional and innovative assets and choose how you invest: trade directly, invest in a portfolio, copy other investors, or invest with an AI agent. Visit our Media Centre for the latest news.
You can find out more about eToro here.
We are constantly growing and are excited to share that we are looking for an It Specialist to join our fantastic team!
What you'll be doing?
Diagnose and resolve IT technical issues involving internet connectivity, Servers issues (VM and cloud), email clients, VPN, and various operating systems.
Leverage AI tools and assistants to streamline support workflows, automate routine tasks, and improve troubleshooting efficiency.
Monitor and resolve customer incidents, ensuring accurate classification and timely updates. Adhere to customer SLAs for swift service restoration. Expertly
Manage users and permissions in Active Directory, AZURE AD, G-suite, Terminal Services, and address hardware, software, and network-related issues.
Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, printers, meeting rooms, and other IT equipment.
Write scripts to optimize automation across the organization.
Troubleshoot software applications and operating system issues for seamless IT operations.
Look for trends occurring in the environment, gather evidence and facts to raise these to the attention of the team, so the problem can be identified and resolved, and future recurring issues can be avoided and collaborate with other IT team members to escalate and resolve complex technical issues.
Create procedures and create new documentation for both technical and end-user roles.
Stay current with the ongoing expansion and development of the company - be aware of system information, changes, and updates.
Provide troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving issues while maximizing customer satisfaction.
Provide comprehensive support to our entire organization, both locally and remotely.
Collaborate with vendors to procure hardware and software solutions as needed.
Stay updated on industry trends and advancements to recommend improvements in IT systems.
Want to join? You'll need:
UP to 3 years of proven experience as an IT Support Specialist or similar role.
Strong technical abilities in diverse technical fields (Windows, Mac environment, Networking, Security and Monitoring System)
Proficient in managing end users and permissions in Active Directory Servers, Office 365, Microsoft Intune, and Azure.
Knowledge of scripting (PowerShell / JSON / Jenkins)
Proven experience with AI tools in daily tasks and workflows.
Experience with managing systems on Virtual platforms (including clouds)
Basic understanding of networking concepts and protocols.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
Experience working with global teams, able to work both independently and collaboratively.
Ability to multitask.
Ability to work effectively under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and consistently meet SLA targets.
Customer-focused with a strong commitment to providing exceptional support.
Team Player.
Our Hiring Philosophy:
At etoro, AI is changing how we build, work and make decisions, and our hiring approach reflects that. We are building an
AI-first organisation
where people are encouraged to use AI thoughtfully.
That starts with
how we hire
. Throughout our recruitment process, we may use AI-enabled tools, including interview notetakers and other technologies that help us capture information accurately, improve consistency and create a better experience for candidates and interviewers. These tools support our feedback and assessment outcomes. Hiring decisions remain grounded in running fair and consistent interview processes, human judgement, critical thinking, and thorough evaluation of experience, ability and motivation that are aligned to our business and role requirements.
We also want candidates to be
comfortable working with AI
. Depending on the role, we may explore how you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, how you think about their opportunities and limitations, and how you would contribute to etoro’s continued AI build-out.
For us, being AI-first is not about replacing human judgement. It is about combining human expertise, creativity and accountability with technology that helps us do our best work and accelerate our growth. In the end, that's what we're hiring for:
human insight, supercharged by AI
.

job.title: IT Operations Manager
job.snippet:
At Autofleet, we're powering the future of mobility by enabling the world's largest fleet operators and transportation providers to optimize operations and launch new mobility services at scale.
As we continue to grow globally, we are looking for an experienced, hands-on IT Manager to own and scale our internal IT operations, infrastructure, and employee technology experience.
About The Role
This is a highly impactful, sole-contributor role responsible for the day-to-day operation, reliability, and scalability of Autofleet's IT environment across offices and remote employees globally.
We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with operational ownership and excellent service orientation. The ideal candidate has experience managing IT infrastructure, networking, endpoint management, SaaS administration, and vendor coordination in a fast-paced environment.
This role will serve as the primary owner of internal IT operations and partner closely with Security, HR, Facilities, external vendors, and our counterparts at Element, our parent company, to ensure alignment across shared systems, infrastructure, and IT initiatives.
Responsibilities
IT Operations & Support
Own internal IT operations and employee technical support globally
Manage onboarding/offboarding processes, endpoint provisioning, and access management
Troubleshoot and resolve escalated hardware, software, connectivity, and infrastructure issues
Establish and improve IT processes, documentation, and support workflows
Network & Infrastructure Management
Manage office network infrastructure, wireless environments, VPN connectivity, and related vendors
Troubleshoot network performance, connectivity, and reliability issues across office and remote environments
Partner with external providers on network architecture, escalations, and ongoing optimization
Support SaaS platforms, identity/access systems, and cloud-managed infrastructure
Endpoint Management
Administer MDM and endpoint management platforms (e.g. Kandji)
Partner closely with Security team on endpoint compliance, VPN/SASE solutions, device security, and access controls
Help implement and maintain IT security best practices and operational policies
Cross-Functional & Vendor Collaboration
Manage relationships with external IT vendors and service providers
Work closely with IT and Security stakeholders at Element to coordinate shared infrastructure, policies, escalations, and support processes
Lead IT improvement initiatives and infrastructure projects
Drive operational maturity, scalability, and reliability across the IT environment
Requirements
5+ years of experience in IT operations, systems administration, or internal IT infrastructure roles
Strong experience supporting macOS environments
Hands-on experience with:
Networking and wireless infrastructure
VPN/SASE technologies
MDM platforms (Kandji, Jamf, etc.)
SaaS administration and identity management
Endpoint security and IT operations best practices
Experience managing external IT vendors and escalations
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across systems, networking, and end-user environments
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Ability to operate independently and take full ownership in a fast-paced environment
Nice to Have
Experience in high-growth startup environments
Familiarity with Fortinet, Google Workspace, or Harmony SASE
Experience supporting hybrid/global teams

This role will serve as the primary owner of internal IT operations and partner closely with Security, HR, Facilities, external vendors, and our counterparts at Element, our parent company, to ensure alignment across shared systems, infrastructure, and IT initiatives.
Responsibilities
IT Operations & Support
Own internal IT operations and employee technical support globally
Manage onboarding/offboarding processes, endpoint provisioning, and access management
Troubleshoot and resolve escalated hardware, software, connectivity, and infrastructure issues
Establish and improve IT processes, documentation, and support workflows
Network & Infrastructure Management
Manage office network infrastructure, wireless environments, VPN connectivity, and related vendors
Troubleshoot network performance, connectivity, and reliability issues across office and remote environments
Partner with external providers on network architecture, escalations, and ongoing optimization
Support SaaS platforms, identity/access systems, and cloud-managed infrastructure

Administer MDM and endpoint management platforms (e.g. Kandji)
Partner closely with Security team on endpoint compliance, VPN/SASE solutions, device security, and access controls
Help implement and maintain IT security best practices and operational policies
Cross-Functional & Vendor Collaboration
Manage relationships with external IT vendors and service providers
Work closely with IT and Security stakeholders at Element to coordinate shared infrastructure, policies, escalations, and support processes
Lead IT improvement initiatives and infrastructure projects
Drive operational maturity, scalability, and reliability across the IT environment
Requirements
5+ years of experience in IT operations, systems administration, or internal IT infrastructure roles
Strong experience supporting macOS environments
Hands-on experience with:
Networking and wireless infrastructure
VPN/SASE technologies
MDM platforms (Kandji, Jamf, etc.)
SaaS administration and identity management
Endpoint security and IT operations best practices
Experience managing external IT vendors and escalations
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across systems, networking, and end-user environments
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Ability to operate independently and take full ownership in a fast-paced environment
Nice to Have
Experience in high-growth startup environments
Familiarity with Fortinet, Google Workspace, or Harmony SASE
Experience supporting hybrid/global teams

job.title: Head of Business Continuity & Processes JB-26802
job.snippet:
About us:
At Cal, we believe in the power of change. We lead innovations and initiate countless transformations.
We are shaping the future of payments, influencing and improving the reality for hundreds of thousands of customers and businesses in Israel.
We believe in our people, encourage professionalism, excellence, personal development
and we're dedicated provide the best employee experience.
We invite you to join the transformation and take part in shaping our shared story.
About the role:
We are looking for a leader to oversee process development, business continuity, working methodologies, and central operations within the OCIO function, which serves as a strategic and managerial arm of the Technology Division’s leadership.
Process Development & Operational Excellence
Analyze and improve business processes, implementing methodologies and solutions to enhance operational efficiency.
Define Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and establish ongoing measurement and monitoring mechanisms.
Business Continuity & Organizational Resilience
Develop, maintain, and implement Business Continuity Plans (BCP), including Business Impact Analysis (BIA), risk assessments, and risk mitigation strategies.
Lead emergency drills, Disaster Recovery (DR) exercises, readiness assessments, and crisis management processes.
Collaborate with regulatory bodies, audit, risk management, and information security teams, and coordinate the company-wide Business Continuity Coordinators Forum through a matrix management approach.
Governance, Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Coordinate reporting processes for senior management and corporate governance forums, including preparation, follow-up, and adherence to deadlines.
Develop organizational policies, procedures, methodologies, and standards, and maintain company-wide procedures.
Monitor objectives, cross-organizational initiatives, and strategic projects.
Manage the division’s interfaces with central corporate functions and organizational control functions, including risk management, legal counsel, and internal audit.
Lead cross-functional collaboration across business, technology, and corporate units.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering and management, Information Systems, or another relevant field- required.
Master’s degree- an advantage.
5+ years of experience in process management, operational excellence, or corporate governance and support functions.
Experience leading cross-functional, organization-wide processes in a large organization, preferably in a financial environment.
Experience managing business continuity, operational risk management, or disaster recovery (DR).
Experience leading transformation, automation, and process improvement projects.
Familiarity with BCP and DR principles and financial industry regulations.
Experience working with Business Intelligence (BI) tools, data analysis, and performance monitoring.
Familiarity with automation technologies and Artificial Intelligence (AI).
Strong strategic and systems-thinking capabilities.
Ability to lead change and drive collaboration across stakeholders without direct authority.
Strong analytical thinking and complex problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills, including the ability to present to senior management.
Proactive, independent, and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to engage and influence stakeholders.

job.snippet:
קצת על התפקיד למפעל רו"ל טכנולוגיות ייצור בחטיבת תעופה דרוש/ה ראש/ת תחום שירות ותפעול לוגיסטיקה התפקיד כולל:
אחריות כוללת על מערך השירות והתפעול הלוגיסטי, לרבות קבלה, קליטה, אחסנה, ניפוק, ליקוט, הכנת אספקות, משלוחים, החזרות, ספירות מלאי ותחזוקת מלאי
אחריות למתן שירות לוגיסטי לקווי העסקים וליחידות הארגוניות, תוך עמידה ברמות שירות, איכות ולוחות זמנים בהתאם ליעדי SLA
ניהול מערכי המחסנים והפעילות הלוגיסטית באתרי החברה ובמרלו"ג חיצוני
ניהול ובקרה של תהליכי העבודה הלוגיסטיים, מדדי ביצוע, תפוקות, זמני טיפול, איכות ורמות שירות
הובלת תהליכי שיפור והתייעלות, קיצור זמני טיפול, הסרת צווארי בקבוק ושיפור ביצועים תפעוליים
ניהול תקציב התחום, בקרה על עלויות תפעוליות ועמידה ביעדי התקציב
ניהול ממשקי עבודה עם רכש, איכות, ביקורת קבלה, ייצור, הנדסה, קווי העסקים, כספים וספקי שירות
אחריות על אמינות המלאי, תקינות הנתונים ויישום בקרות תפעוליות ובקרות מלאי
ניהול מנהלים ועובדים בתחום, הצבת יעדים, פיתוח מנהלים, הכשרות מקצועיות, בקרה וחניכה
אחריות על יישום דרישות הבטיחות, האיכות ונהלי החברה בכלל הפעילות שבאחריות התחום מה אנחנו מחפשים תנאי סף:
בעל/ת אזרחות ישראלית
בעל/ת תואר ראשון אקדמאי/ לוגיסטיקה/ הנדסת תעשייה וניהול/ מנהל עסקים/ כלכלה או תעודת הנדסאי/ת / טכנאי/ת
ניסיון של 6 שנים לפחות בניהול מערך תפעולי או לוגיסטי היקף רחב הכולל: מחסנים, שירותים לוגיסטיים ותהליכי שרשרת אספקה
ניסיון של 5 שנים לפחות בניהול ישיר של צוות המונה 4 עובדים ומעלה
ניסיון בניהול תקציב, מדדי ביצוע ויעדי שירות
שליטה ביישומי Office, בדגש על Excel
שליטה טובה בשפה האנגלית (דיבור, קריאה וכתיבה) קריטריונים נוספים (יתרון):
ניסיון בעבודה עם SAP ומערכות WMS או EWM
ניסיון בהפעלת מערכים לוגיסטיים באמצעות חברות 3PL
ניסיון בניהול ספקים והתקשרויות שירות
ניסיון בסביבה תעשייתית, יצרנית או ביטחונית
יכולת ניתוח נתונים, בניית KPI וקבלת החלטות על בסיס ביצועים
ניסיון בהובלת תהליכי שינוי ובהטמעת מערכות מידע לוגיסטיות קריטריונים מנהיגותיים:
יכולת מנהיגות והאצלת סמכויות
עבודה בגישה מערכתית תוך שיתוף פעולה חוצה חברה
גיבוש אסטרטגיה עסקית וארגונית המובילה לחדשנות טכנולוגית
מנהיגות המקדמת ורותמת תהליכי שינוי תרבותיים וארגוניים
מכוונות להצלחה עסקית הגשת המועמדות ניתנת לביצוע 05/11/2026 בשעה 16:00 הגשת המועמדות כוללת: השבה על השאלון המצורף ועמידה בתנאי הסף. מועמדים/ות מתאימים/ות יזומנו לראיון אישי ובמידת הצורך למבדקי התאמה. הגשת הפנייה מהווה הסכמת המועמד/ת לעריכת בדיקות ומבדקים ככל שיידרשו, כולל תחקיר לסיווג הביטחוני. הוועדה אינה מתחייבת לזמן את כל הפונים/ות לראיון ו/או למבדקים ו/או להמליץ על מועמדותו/ה של מי מהם/ן. הפניה מיועדת לגברים ולנשים כאחד אולי יעניין אותך לדעת חטיבת התעופה של התעשייה האווירית לישראל מעורבת בכל ההיבטים של תעשיית התעופה, החל בתכנון ובפיתוח, עבור דרך הנדסה וייצור של מבנים תעופתיים ומטוסים שלמים, וכלה בבדיקות ובאישורים. חטיבת התעופה של התעשייה האווירית לישראל מעניקה שירותי תחזוקה מקיפים ואיכותיים לכלי טיס, מנועים ורכיבים, תחת קורת גג אחת. שירותים אלה כוללים תחזוקה כבדה, שינויים ושיפורים, שדרוגי מטוסים אזרחיים וצבאיים, וכן את השירות המוביל בעולם, עם למעלה מ-50 שנות ניסיון להסבת מטוסי נוסעים למטוסי מטען.

איסוף נתונים מהשטח לצורך התייעלות וניטור
ביצוע הזמנות רכש - פוליאתילן, גז וכל ציוד מתכלה אחר

ניסיון תעסוקתי משמעותי בעבודת חממות ובגידול ירקות

יכולת תכנון ושיפור תהליכים

job.title: Capacity & Analysis Planner
job.snippet:
Join UCT
and be part of
the fastest-growing sector in the world
! We indirectly touch every semiconductor chip that goes into every smartphone, smart car and device that uses artificial intelligence. This is a critical time for the semiconductor industry and for UCT - as technology evolves, we evolve with it. UCT is a diverse workplace where every talented employee is committed to continuous innovation, challenging the status quo and exceeding customer expectations. If you are a person with a relentless drive to succeed, a strong focus on quality with a passion for success -
join us today!
UCT
is looking for a talented
Capacity & Analysis Planner
to join us in
Israel!
The Planner III is responsible for developing and maintaining production plans and master schedules to meet customer requirements and optimize resource utilization. This role performs advanced planning functions, including simulation modeling, scenario optimization, and capacity analysis, while reconciling material and production conflicts. The Planner III collaborates across engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery, quality compliance, and continuous improvement in a fast-paced, engineer-to-order environment.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Perform simulation modeling and scenario optimization to improve planning accuracy and efficiency.
Prepare and present Rough-Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP) and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) reports to senior management.
Manage production planning and control for assigned lines, ensuring schedule adherence and material availability.
Develop and maintain master production schedules based on engineering plans and specifications.
Create, release, monitor, and close work orders throughout the production cycle.
Analyze labor loading and capacity requirements to ensure schedule feasibility.
Troubleshoot production control issues and implement corrective actions promptly.
Monitor and resolve process shortages to maintain schedule integrity.
Collaborate with engineering, quality, purchasing, and operations to ensure specifications and quality standards are met.
Facilitate operations and material status meetings to communicate priorities and resolve issues.
Coordinate engineering change orders and update schedules accordingly.
Interface with customers as needed to confirm delivery schedules or address concerns.
Knowledge, Skills, Experience:
Expertise in production planning, scheduling, and capacity analysis.
Ability to read and interpret engineering bills of materials (BOM) and technical specifications.
Strong analytical skills for simulation modeling and scenario planning.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for internal and external interactions.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with MRP/ERP systems.
Meeting facilitation and stakeholder management skills to drive alignment and accountability.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in managing complex schedules.
Ability to build effective cross-functional relationships and work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Education, Certifications, Requirements:
5+ years of planning experience with working knowledge of quick-turn, low volume, engineer-to-order production environment.
5+ years of experience using advanced planning tools such as Kinaxis, APO or ASCP.
Ultra Clean Technology is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity and expression, marital status, and any other characteristic protected under laws and regulations.

job.title: Service Center Team Lead
job.snippet:
It provides customers with a comprehensive service, commercial, and operational support layer.
The Service Center is the company's central point of contact for customers on a wide range of matters unrelated to technical service calls. It serves thousands of customers through three channels: WhatsApp, a telephone switchboard, and tasks received from the Digital Center.
Overall responsibility for managing the Service Center's day-to-day operations, ensuring service availability, quality, and efficiency, meeting performance targets, and continuously improving the customer experience and operational processes.
Responsibilities
Team management and leadership: Provide professional guidance, mentoring, and development for team members; onboard and train new employees; conduct performance feedback; and implement uniform professional standards for service delivery.
Service quality and customer experience: Handle complex inquiries and escalations, identify recurring failures, improve response quality, and lead initiatives to increase customer satisfaction.
Commercial and operational support for customers: Be responsible for handling collections, price quotes, activity expansion, and the sale of additional products and services to existing customers (upsell), in line with company policy.
Permissions and digital services management: Be responsible for the processes of opening and managing customer permissions for digital channels.
Company and product process expertise: Consistently instill knowledge in the team on topics such as licensing plan renewals, service contracts, customer installations, price increase processes, and product updates.
Performance monitoring and analysis: Track service metrics, response and handling times, throughput, response quality, customer satisfaction, and commercial activity; generate insights and lead performance improvement plans.
Process optimization and technology implementation: Identify opportunities for automation, digitization, and reduction of manual work; define and implement improvements to work processes and the systems that support service, in cooperation with relevant stakeholders in the organization.
Requirements
Previous experience managing a customer service team, including direct people management, mentoring, training, and motivating employees to meet targets.
Experience managing service operations in a multi-task, multi-channel environment.
Ability to analyze data and performance metrics, generate insights, and lead improvement programs.
Technological orientation and experience working with information systems, service systems, and BI tools.
Ability to lead process improvement, streamline work methods, and implement digital solutions and automation.
Business and numerical acumen, along with the ability to handle complex commercial and operational processes.
Strong service orientation, assertiveness, independence, and the ability to work with many stakeholders across the organization.
Familiarity with the Priority system – a significant advantage.

job.title: קצין בטיחות בתעבורה ומפקח רכב תפעולי
job.snippet:
מי אנחנו
QAS הוקמה בשנת 1996 על ידי Swissport International וחברת כנפיים, ומספקת מגוון רחב של שירותי קרקע בנמלי התעופה בישראל,
לצד הפעלת טרקלין VIP בנמל התעופה בן גוריון. אנו משלבים שירות איכותי, מקצועיות ויעילות תפעולית, ופועלים להרחבת פעילותנו בשווקים נוספים.
על התפקיד
•  ניהול צי רכב הכולל רכבי חברה, רכבי ליסינג ורכבים תפעוליים
•  תכנון ופיקוח על תחזוקה מונעת וטיפולים תקופתיים
•  עבודה שוטפת מול מוסכים, חברות ביטוח וספקי שירות
•  טיפול בתאונות, בתביעות ביטוח ובתקלות טכניות
•  הדרכת עובדים לשימוש נכון ברכבים ולהקפדה על נוהלי בטיחות
•  פיתוח ויישום מדיניות להתייעלות ולחיסכון בעלויות
• עבודה עם מערכות ממוחשבות לניהול צי רכב והפקת דיווחים תקופתיים
דרישות
•  הסמכה כקצין/ת בטיחות בתעבורה
•  ניסיון כמפקח/ת רכב תפעולי
•  כישורי ניהול וארגון ויחסי אנוש מצוינים
•  רקע טכני במכונאות וניסיון בעבודה מול מוסכים
•  ניסיון בשימוש במערכות לניהול נהגים וכלי רכב
•  שליטה באנגלית
•  ניסיון קודם בניהול צי רכב או בתפקיד דומה - יתרון משמעותי
אנו מחויבים לשוויון הזדמנויות בתעסוקה.
כל מועמדת ומועמד יישקלו ללא הבדל גזע, צבע, דת, מין, נטייה מינית, זהות מגדרית, מעמד שירות צבאי או מוגבלות.
