job.title: Infrastructure Engineer – DevOps & Core Systems
job.snippet:
Job Description
Build, operate, and improve production infrastructure, with a focus on AWS, Kubernetes, and CDN and caching systems.
Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across Linux, networking, Kubernetes, and content delivery.
Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management to make deployments consistent and reliable.
Develop monitoring and alerting, investigate production incidents, and implement improvements that prevent recurrence.
Collaborate with development, support, and QA teams to improve infrastructure reliability and performance.
Propose and implement improvements that benefit our infrastructure, teams, and users.
Participate in the team’s on-call rotation to resolve production incidents and restore service availability.
Qualifications
4+ years of experience operating production infrastructure, with strong Linux administration, networking, and troubleshooting skills.
Strong understanding of AWS fundamentals, including compute, networking, load balancing, and auto scaling.
Practical experience administering and troubleshooting production Kubernetes clusters, including cluster upgrades, networking, and scaling.
Experience operating CDN and HTTP caching infrastructure using Varnish, NGINX, or similar technologies, with a solid understanding of HTTP, DNS, TLS, cache behavior, and invalidation.
Experience automating infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Terraform and tools such as Ansible, Chef, or equivalents.
Experience using Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent tools for monitoring, incident investigation, and performance troubleshooting.
Experience with on-premises infrastructure, private clouds, hypervisors, or bare-metal servers is an advantage.
At Wix, we believe our best work happens together. Our work model is fully in person, with 5 days a week from our office. Flexibility remains a core value at Wix and special requests are handled thoughtfully at the team level.
Additional Information
We are Wix’s Infrastructure Guild. We’re at the core of building and maintaining the production and CI/CD environment. Our mission is to improve production performance and resilience to ensure 99.99% uptime for millions of users and drive our developer velocity. We also design, develop and operate cutting-edge services and robust tools for the entire developer community—both Frontend and Backend.
We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Wix was built around the idea that everyone has the right to be successful, online. This same vision defines us as an employer: creating a work environment where everyone is welcome, and anyone has the right to succeed.

job.snippet:
שטראוס מגייסת מנהל.ת תחום שיווק - תפוציפס וצ'יטוס
איך יראה היום שלך?
הובלת תחום תפוצ'יפס וצ'יטוס תוך אחריות עסקית ושיווקית מלאה על שני מותגים מרכזיים.
בניית אסטרטגיה ותוכנית צמיחה רב-שנתית, כולל ניהול מכירות, נתח שוק, רווחיות, תמחור והפצה.
ניהול פורטפוליו המותגים, חיזוק פעילויות הליבה והובלת חדשנות מהרעיון ועד להשקה.
התאמת אסטרטגיית המדיה, התוכן והחדשנות לצרכים וליעדים של כל מותג.
הובלת צוות השיווק, פיתוח עובדים והנעת ממשקים מגוונים להשגת יעדים עסקיים.
עבודה שוטפת עם צוותי מכירות, פיתוח, תפעול, רכש, איכות, מפעלים ושותפים גלובליים.
קבלת החלטות מבוססות נתונים, זיהוי הזדמנויות ופערים והובלת תוכניות פעולה לצמיחה ורווחיות.
המשרה היא החלפה לחל"ד ל9 חודשים
מה חשוב להביא איתך?
לפחות 3 שנות ניסיון משמעותי בניהול שיווק או בתפקיד דומה בעולם מוצרי הצריכה.
ניסיון בניהול מותגים או קטגוריה עם אחריות עסקית רחבה.
ניסיון בהובלת חדשנות, השקות ותהליכים מקצה לקצה.
ניסיון בניהול ופיתוח עובדים.
יכולות עסקיות ואנליטיות לצד ניתוח נתונים והצגת המלצות עסקיות.
יכולת הנעת ממשקים, ניהול קונפליקטים וקבלת החלטות בסביבה דינמית.
תואר ראשון רלוונטי ואנגלית עסקית ברמה גבוהה.
אוריינות דיגיטלית ויכולת עבודה עם כלי AI.
יתרון לניסיון בעבודה מול מכירות, קמעונאים וממשקים גלובליים.
למה שטראוס?
שטראוס רואה חשיבות בבניית מותגים חזקים המשלבים צמיחה עסקית, חדשנות וחיבור אמיתי לצרכנים. מנהל.ת תחום שיווק תפוצ'יפס וצ'יטוס בשטראוס הוא חלק משמעותי בעיצוב עתידם של מותגים מובילים ובהובלת התפתחות הקטגוריה בשוק הישראלי. העשייה בתפקיד מחברת בין חשיבה אסטרטגית, ניהול עסקי, חדשנות והובלת אנשים להשגת השפעה רחבה ומתמשכת.

job.title: Assistant Controller
job.snippet:
About the Position
We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented, and analytical Assistant Controller to join our Finance team.
This is an excellent opportunity for a qualified CPA to take on a key role within the company's finance function, with broad exposure to financial reporting, accounting, tax, budgeting, and financial analysis activities at both the parent company and subsidiary levels.
The position offers significant involvement in the company's financial operations, ongoing interaction with internal and external stakeholders, and participation in various financial and business-related projects.
Key Responsibilities
Financial Reporting & Accounting
Lead and coordinate the preparation of quarterly and annual financial statements for the parent company and its subsidiaries, in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).
Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial information, while maintaining compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
Review accounting records, financial transactions, and supporting documentation to ensure proper financial reporting.
Identify accounting issues and provide professional input on complex accounting matters.
Support the implementation and improvement of financial reporting processes and procedures.
Tax & Audit
Prepare annual corporate tax returns for the parent company and its subsidiaries.
Prepare comprehensive audit working papers and supporting schedules.
Serve as a key point of contact with the external auditors, coordinating audit processes and addressing accounting and reporting inquiries.
Manage ongoing communication with external professional advisors on accounting and tax-related matters.
Management Reporting & Financial Analysis
Prepare monthly management reports, including financial results, variance analyses, and key financial indicators.
Analyze financial performance and identify significant deviations from budget and previous periods.
Provide financial insights and recommendations to support management decision-making.
Assist in preparing financial presentations and reports for management and other relevant stakeholders.
Budgeting & Financial Control
Take an active role in the preparation of the annual budget for the company and its subsidiaries.
Monitor actual financial performance against budget and forecasts, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions where necessary.
Perform ongoing budgetary control over company expenses and operating costs.
Work closely with relevant departments to monitor expenditures, improve cost control, and support efficient resource allocation.
Projects & Additional Responsibilities
Participate in cross-functional financial and business projects.
Conduct financial analyses, economic evaluations, and ad hoc business assessments.
Support the development and implementation of financial processes, controls and reporting tools.
Take part in additional finance-related initiatives as required.
Requirements
Certified Public Accountant (CPA), preferably with experience gained at one of the leading international accounting firms (Big 5) – an advantage.
Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting standards, including IFRS.
Experience in preparing financial statements and working with external auditors – an advantage.
Excellent command of Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint – mandatory.
Strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to interpret financial data and draw meaningful conclusions.
Close attention to detail, accuracy and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with various stakeholders.
A proactive approach, strong sense of ownership, and willingness to take initiative.

job.title: Senior Product Manager - Storage
job.snippet:
We are seeking an experienced
Principal Product Manager
to drive the product roadmap and feature strategy for our high-performance enterprise storage and data management platform. In this high-impact role, you will bridge the gap between enterprise client needs and Core R&D—translating complex pain points into detailed PRDs and technical feature specifications. You will own your product domain end-to-end, balancing roadmap prioritization, pre-sales support, and competitive positioning within large-scale IT ecosystems.
Core Responsibilities
Roadmap & Backlog Ownership:
Direct the strategic product roadmap, feature definition, and backlog prioritization for core components of our enterprise storage platform architecture.
Requirements & Technical PRDs:
Gather, synthesize, and prioritize requirements from Fortune 500 accounts and field teams, authoring comprehensive technical PRDs and conducting hands-on validation.
R&D Partnership:
Collaborate closely with Engineering leadership on release planning, scoping trade-offs, and architecture alignment.
Enablement & Technical Documentation:
Author comprehensive reference architectures, configuration guides, and technical enablement materials for Sales Engineering, Professional Services, and Customer Support.
Product Health Tracking & Market Trends:
Conduct product health tracking and analyze global infrastructure trends (AI/data workloads, cyber resilience, hybrid cloud, SAN/NAS, block and file architectures) to shape long-term strategy.
Field & Analyst Support:
Support enterprise pre-sales engagements, competitive technical positioning, and strategic conversations with industry analysts and C-level stakeholders.
What You’ll Bring
Academic Background:
B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline –
Mandatory
.
5+ years
of dedicated Product Management experience, with a strong emphasis on enterprise storage, data platforms, or cloud infrastructure.
8+ years
of total hands-on experience working directly with data center and enterprise IT infrastructure (Compute, Networking, SAN/NAS, Replication, Backup/Recovery).
Enterprise Customer Focus:
Proven track record of translating complex technical challenges into clear business outcomes for Fortune 500 clients and service providers.
High Ownership:
Self-driven mindset with a demonstrated ability to take complete ownership of complex technical products with minimal supervision.
Communication Mastery:
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, equally effective in deep technical reviews and executive briefings.

job.title: FPGA Engineer
job.company: Sentrycs | Counter-Drone Solutions Adapting at the Speed of Threats
job.snippet:
Sentrycs’ mission is to enable a more drone-empowered future!
How?
With our integrated counter-drone solution, we support law enforcement agencies, prisons, critical infrastructures, airports, mass events, convoys, militarizes, and more, by providing them with 24/7 drone protection. With our fully autonomous, easily portable, and UTM-ready technology, detecting and mitigating unauthorized drones has never been simpler.
We work to keep society protected from unauthorized eyes in the skies so you can remain operational and ensure business continuity on the ground. Let’s build a drone-empowered future together!
As a
Senior FPGA & System Architecture Engineer
, you will drive the end-to-end hardware architecture and implementation of next-generation wireless communications systems. You will lead the design and integration of high-throughput physical layer pipelines across AMD Xilinx RFSoC platforms, high-speed PCIe interfaces, and host GPU acceleration environments—bridging algorithmic signal processing with production-grade SoC hardware infrastructure.
In this role, you will:
Architect & Design: Own the full-chip system architecture on AMD Xilinx RFSoC platforms.
DSP RTL Implementation: Partner directly with Algorithm Engineers to translate floating-point MATLAB/C++ models into fixed-point, resource-optimized, and bit-exact SystemVerilog RTL.
Host & GPU Acceleration Interfacing: Architect and implement high-bandwidth PCIe subsystems connecting the RFSoC to host CPU and GPU accelerators, ensuring deterministic data streaming, low-latency DMA transfers, and reliable link initialization during system boot.
Verification & Hardware Bring-Up: Lead bit-accurate simulation, hardware emulation, and lab bring-up using Vivado, logic analyzers, and RF test equipment to profile throughput, validate timing closure, and eliminate real-time system bottlenecks.
Requirements:
The ideal FPGA engineer who we are looking for should have
SoC & FPGA Mastery: Proven, hands-on experience architecting and delivering production designs on AMD Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ RFSoC or MPSoC platforms.
HDL & RTL Implementation: Expert-level proficiency in synthesizable SystemVerilog or Verilog, with a strong focus on high-speed pipelining, timing closure in congested designs.
Host Interfacing & Data Movement: Demonstrated experience implementing high-bandwidth PCIe subsystems (Gen3/Gen4) and high-throughput DMA engines (e.g., XDMA/QDMA), including link training/enumeration bring-up, boot sequencing, and backpressure management.
Nice to Have
RF-DC Subsystem Integration: Hands-on experience configuring and integrating AMD Xilinx RF-Data Converters (multi-gigasample ADCs/DACs) and their associated digital down/up-conversion chains.
DSP Hardware Design: Strong foundation in implementing fixed-point wireless communications algorithms in FPGA fabric (e.g., polyphase filter banks, multi-rate DDC/DUC, FFT/IFFT, channel estimation, correlation) with efficient DSP slice mapping and dynamic range management.
Driver & Software Alignment: Familiarity with Linux kernel drivers, user-space drivers (VFIO/UIO, DPDK), or embedded software running on the ARM Processing System to coordinate hardware-software control planes.

QC Engineer
Petah Tikva, Israel
About The Position
mPrest is looking for an
Electronics Quality Inspector - QC
(Electronics/Electrical Technician or Practical Engineer).

Perform quality inspections for parts and assemblies according to AS9100/ISO9001 procedures and standards.
Conduct visual inspections based on drawings and engineering requirements.
Perform in-process inspections throughout assembly and testing stages.

Perform First Article Inspection (FAI).
Document inspections, maintain follow-up records, and report non-conformities.

Relevant experience from the Israeli Air Force / Navy – an advantage.
Familiarity and experience working according to quality standards.
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings in both English and Hebrew.
Knowledge of aerospace wiring, IPC certification, or relevant professional courses – an advantage.
High level of technical English proficiency.
Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel to suppliers (approximately 50% of the time).
Experience working with testing and measurement equipment.
Knowledge and experience in performing FAI inspections according to AS9102 – an advantage.
Experience working with PRIORITY ERP system – an advantage.

job.title: Producer / Head of Studio
job.snippet:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Producer / Head of Studio based in Israel.
As Producer / Head of Studio, you will take strategic and operational ownership of the complete game development pipeline, overseeing the creation and delivery of high-quality online slot games. You will lead the end-to-end production lifecycle, from initial concept and creative development through certification, launch and post-launch optimisation. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, you will ensure that each title meets creative, technical, regulatory and commercial objectives. You will play a central role in shaping the studio's game portfolio, developing licensed content and identifying opportunities within the competitive North American gaming market. This leadership position combines creative vision, production excellence and commercial awareness in a dynamic, internationally distributed environment. You will also have the opportunity to build and mentor a growing team while establishing the processes and standards that drive long-term studio success.
Accountabilities
Own the end-to-end production pipeline: Oversee the complete lifecycle of all slot game projects, from initial concept and planning through development, certification, market launch and post-launch optimisation.
Shape the game portfolio: Define and manage the studio's game development slate, identifying themes, features and mechanics that appeal to players in US online and land-based gaming markets.
Lead licensed and branded content production: Manage the development of branded slot titles, coordinate relationships with licensors and oversee brand approval processes to ensure all deliverables meet agreed requirements.
Manage multidisciplinary teams: Coordinate and lead cross-functional workstreams involving game designers, mathematicians, artists, audio specialists, engineers, QA professionals and compliance teams.
Establish production standards: Develop and implement effective production methodologies, documentation processes, quality assurance standards and operational best practices.
Monitor regulatory developments: Stay informed about gaming regulations across US states and Canadian provinces, ensuring that production decisions, game features and content remain aligned with market requirements.
Drive team development: Recruit, manage, mentor and develop talent across different disciplines, building a high-performing team as the studio expands.
Optimise commercial performance: Analyse game performance data and key performance indicators to inform creative decisions, improve game mechanics and maximise the commercial success of published titles.
Manage external partnerships: Collaborate effectively with platform providers, B2B aggregators and other industry partners to support successful game distribution and delivery.
Requirements
Professional experience: At least 7 years of experience in online slot game production, with a proven track record of successfully delivering multiple titles to market.
US market expertise: Demonstrable experience producing online slot content for regulated US gaming markets, with a strong understanding of their commercial and regulatory requirements.
Licensed content production: Previous experience managing branded or licensed slot game projects, including licensor relationships, intellectual property requirements and approval workflows.
Game mechanics expertise: In-depth knowledge of online and land-based slot game mechanics, including hold-and-spin features, linked progressives and other popular gameplay formats.
Analytical capabilities: Ability to interpret game performance data, commercial KPIs and player engagement metrics to guide creative and production decisions.
Leadership experience: Proven ability to manage and lead multidisciplinary game development teams, coordinate complex projects and deliver results across multiple functions.
Mathematical knowledge: Strong understanding of slot game mathematics, including paytable structures, Return to Player (RTP) calculations and volatility profiles, with the ability to review and assess game mathematics.
Industry partnerships: Familiarity with B2B aggregators, game distribution models and platform partners such as Light & Wonder.
Additional market experience: Direct experience producing slot content for US land-based casinos or tribal gaming markets is a strong advantage.
Production methodologies: Knowledge of game localisation processes, international content adaptation and agile production methodologies is preferred.
Leadership qualities: Strong communication, organisational and decision-making skills, combined with a strategic mindset, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Benefits
Competitive salary: Monthly compensation ranging from R100,000 to R150,000, depending on experience and qualifications.
Remote working: Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere globally, offering flexibility and autonomy.
Senior leadership opportunity: Take ownership of the studio's production strategy and play a key role in shaping its creative and operational direction.
International exposure: Work within a UK-based gaming studio serving regulated markets worldwide, with a particular focus on North America.
Creative influence: Contribute directly to the development of original and licensed slot games, influencing the studio's portfolio and product strategy.
Team-building opportunities: Recruit, mentor and develop a multidisciplinary team while helping establish the foundations for future studio growth.
Industry exposure: Collaborate with international gaming partners, licensors and platform providers.
Travel opportunities: International travel as required to support business operations, partnerships and team collaboration.
How Jobgether Works
We use an
AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
Why Apply Through Jobgether?
Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

job.title: Cloud & Integration Engineer
job.snippet:
We are looking for a highly motivated, collaborative
Cloud & Integration Engineer
to join our IT Applications team and play a key role in supporting, optimizing, and evolving our enterprise cloud ecosystem.
In this role, you will manage multi-cloud and on-premises application environments, design and maintain resilient integrations between enterprise business systems, and ensure secure, seamless connectivity across the organization. You will work extensively across
Oracle Fusion Cloud (SaaS), Oracle OCI, Azure, AWS, Snowflake
, modern integration platforms, and emerging AI-driven tooling.
While visual workflow design and middleware (OIC, Power Automate) are central to the role, the position also requires real hands-on scripting and development capabilities to automate processes, handle backend logic, and query databases effectively.
If you are a dedicated team player who thrives on solving complex system challenges, communicates fluently in English, and takes end-to-end ownership of mission-critical platforms, we would love to meet you.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage, operate, and maintain application environments across Multi-Cloud (Oracle OCI, Azure, AWS) and on-premises deployments, supporting enterprise platforms like Oracle Fusion Cloud.
Design, develop, and maintain secure, reliable interfaces and data flows between enterprise systems using platforms such as Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Power Automate, Power Apps, or equivalent middleware.
Manage application lifecycle security, certificate renewals, Single Sign-On (SSO), OAuth/SAML configurations, and secure API gateways in alignment with corporate InfoSec standards.
Proactively monitor system health, troubleshoot complex cross-platform incidents, and drive performance tuning to guarantee high availability and stability.
Partner closely with infrastructure, networking, information security, and application teams, actively contributing to shared team goals and fostering an open, supportive team culture.
Build production scripts and utilities (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to automate operational workflows, integrate AI tools/APIs, and run routine SQL data checks across underlying systems.
About Us:
AudioCodes (Nasdaq: AUDC) is a global leader in enterprise voice technology and Voice AI innovation for the digital workplace and customer experience. We help organizations unlock the full value of voice, transforming every conversation into a strategic asset that drives smarter decisions, better experiences and business growth. Our portfolio spans secure voice infrastructure, unified communications and contact center, with next-generation AI-powered voice solutions. With over 30 years of expertise and presence in more than 100 countries, AudioCodes is trusted by 65 of the Fortune 100 to power intelligent, agile and future-ready interactions across businesses worldwide.
Requirements:
3–5 years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, or enterprise integration/application environments.
Bachelor’s degree (B.A./B.Sc.) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline — OR relevant professional vendor certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, OCI Certified Associate/Professional, OIC Specialist).
Proven hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (OCI, Azure, or AWS), with the aptitude and drive to operate in a multi-cloud landscape.
Strong experience with integration tools (e.g., OIC, Microsoft Power Platform, or equivalent iPaaS). Deep practical knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON, XML, authentication mechanisms, and webhooks.
Solid understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals (VCN/VPC, DNS, routing, firewalls) and identity/access management (IAM, SSO, SSL/TLS certificates).
High proficiency in English (both verbal and written), with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly, write documentation, and collaborate smoothly with international teams and vendors.
Foundational knowledge or practical exposure to AI-assisted development, prompt engineering, or integrating AI services/LLM APIs into enterprise workflows.
In addition to low-code/integration platforms, hands-on scripting/coding ability (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) to build automations, parse data, and interact with APIs directly.
Solid working knowledge of SQL for data validation, querying, and troubleshooting. Hands-on experience with Oracle Database or Snowflake is an advantage.
Additional Information -
This position is offered under an
Outsourcing Services (OS) employment framework
, with employment terms and benefits aligned with market standards.

job.snippet:
למח' מערכות מידע של בית ההשקעות מיטב דרוש/ה מנהל/ת מערך תשתיות.
תיאור התפקיד:
- ניהול והובלת מחלקת התשתיות, לרבות פיתוח מנהלים, בניית יכולות מקצועיות והובלת מצוינות ארגונית ותפעולית
- אחריות ניהולית כוללת על מערך התשתיות הארגוני הכולל צוותי System, DBA, DevOps‏, תשתיות ענן, תקשורת, יישומי אבטחת מידע ומרכז התמיכה (Help Desk וטכנאים)
- גיבוש והובלת אסטרטגיית התשתיות ומפת דרכים טכנולוגית התומכת ביעדים העסקיים של הארגון
- אחריות על זמינות, יציבות, ביצועים, שרידות ורציפות עסקית של מערכות ותשתיות קריטיות
- הובלת פרויקטי תשתית מורכבים, תהליכי מודרניזציה, מעבר לענן, אוטומציה והתייעלות תפעולית
- הובלת תהליכי שיפור מתמיד, אימוץ טכנולוגיות חדשניות וקידום תשתיות התומכות בצרכים העסקיים המשתנים, לרבות אימוץ מאובטח של טכנולוגיות AI
- ניהול סביבות תשתית Cloud ו- On Prem‏ לרבות שרתים, אחסון, וירטואליזציה, גיבויים ותקשורת
- אחריות על יישום, תפעול ותחזוקה של פתרונות אבטחת מידע תשתיתיים, לרבות פתרונות להגנה על יישומי ‪‏AI בשיתוף גורמי אבטחת מידע והסייבר בארגון
- עבודה בשיתוף פעולה הדוק עם יחידות הפיתוח, אבטחת המידע, הסייבר והגורמים העסקיים בארגון

job.title: Head of IT, Infrastructure & Security
job.snippet:
Edikted is a fast-growing fashion brand selling online in the US and UK and through retail stores in the US and London. We have offices in Israel, Los Angeles and China, and a technology group that builds and runs our own internal platform on AWS.
The role
We're growing across four countries, and our IT, security and cloud have grown with us through a strong network of partners and specialists. Now we're looking for the leader who brings it all together into one company-wide function.
You will own IT, infrastructure and security across Edikted and lead our partners and specialists as one team. You set the standards, own the vendors and the budget, and step in hands-on when needed.
What you'll own
End-user IT across all sites:
laptops and devices, device management, Google Workspace and SaaS accounts, helpdesk quality and response times in Israel, the US and China.
Cloud and infrastructure:
our AWS environment, its access, reliability and cost, through the DevOps team.
AI platforms:
operating the AI tools and platforms the company chooses: accounts, access, cost and security settings.
Security and resilience:
turning security policy into day-to-day practice: endpoint protection, access reviews, security awareness, and leading incident response, disaster recovery and business continuity.
Company-wide processes:
onboarding and offboarding (from laptop to cloud access), the inventory of devices and SaaS licenses, and total IT and cloud spend.
Vendors and contracts:
managing our IT partners and contractors, and deciding with management what stays outsourced and what comes in-house.
going forward.
What we're looking for
Must-haves:
Managed cloud infrastructure, or skilled DevOps engineers, with a deep grasp of cloud concepts (AWS preferred).
Owned company-wide security, including disaster recovery and business continuity planning.
Managed IT teams in a multi-site company.
A strategic thinker who still knows the nuts and bolts.
You'll also bring:
7+ years in IT/infrastructure, including 3+ years managing an IT function in a company of roughly 200 to 1,500 people.
Experience managing outsourced partners and contractors, not only in-house staff.
US experience is a strong plus.
Experience with identity and access, device management (Intune, Jamf, Kandji or similar) and Google Workspace; ideally an ISO 27001 / SOC 2 or similar project.
Fluent Hebrew and English.
Nice to have:
Retail or e-commerce background; experience on the services-provider side (MSP).

job.title: Research Engineer - Physical Systems & Data Investigation
job.snippet:
We are a deep-tech startup developing advanced technologies for monitoring, analyzing, and extracting insights from power infrastructure. We are looking for an exceptional physicist or research-oriented engineer with deep intellectual curiosity, strong analytical thinking, and a passion for understanding how complex physical systems truly behave in the real world.
This is not a Data Analyst role, nor is it a traditional Data Scientist position.
We are seeking someone who can take incomplete information, complex field data, and highly uncertain environments and turn them into deep system-level understanding.
The role combines data exploration, physics, systems engineering, AI/ML, and direct interaction with customers and real-world infrastructure. The mission is to identify previously unknown phenomena, investigate anomalies, formulate and validate hypotheses, uncover hidden relationships between diverse measurements, and translate findings into insights that shape the next generation of our products, algorithms, and technology.
This position sits at the forefront of the company's research and learning efforts, working closely with the System Architect and directly influencing engineering decisions, product capabilities, and future technology directions.
What We're Looking For
MSc or higher in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related engineering discipline
Proven ability to understand complex physical systems and derive meaningful insights from data
Experience working with technical datasets, measurement systems, or field-deployed systems
Strong, hands-on experience in AI / Machine Learning with demonstrated practical results
Experience with Python, MATLAB, SQL, or advanced data analysis tools
Ability to lead technical investigations end-to-end, from hypothesis generation through conclusions and actionable recommendations
Ability to work independently in environments characterized by uncertainty, incomplete information, and new challenges
Significant Advantages
Experience with Time Series Analysis
Experience with Root Cause Analysis
Experience with sensing, monitoring, and measurement systems
Experience in energy systems, critical infrastructure, or electric power networks
Familiarity with MV/HV systems
Who Will Thrive in This Role?
People whose professional curiosity drives them every day.
People who enjoy asking questions nobody has asked before, connecting data, physics, and systems engineering, and uncovering insights that directly influence the future of technology and products.

מה תביאו איתכם?
• ניסיון של לפחות שנה בניהול קמפיינים בפלטפורמות Meta ו-Google Ads
• חשיבה אנליטית ורצון להגיע תמיד לעוד אחוז שיפור
• יכולת לנהל כמה לקוחות במקביל בצורה מסודרת ומדויקת
• שליטה באקסל / Google Sheets והפקת דוחות ברורים
• הבנה עמוקה ב-optimization, דאטה וקבלת החלטות מבוססת ביצועים
• יכולת לבנות ולחדד בריפים קריאייטיביים לצוותי תוכן ועיצוב

job.title: Wireless Platform Architect
job.snippet:
About the Business Unit:
Ceva is at the forefront of the Smart Edge revolution, with innovative state-of-the-art Silicon and Software solutions that enable products to Connect, Sense and Infer.
Within the Wireless Internet of Things Business Unit (WIoT BU), we are offering you a unique opportunity to shape the future of connected devices. Our advanced wireless technologies, including Bluetooth, Wi-Fi UWB, and 5G Cellular IoT, are integrated into over a Billion devices annually.
﻿About the role:
As a Wireless Platform Architect, you will play a key role in defining the architecture of Ceva's next-generation Radio Subsystem (RSS) platforms for wireless technologies including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and UWB. You will take end-to-end responsibility on the system-level architecture of a complete wireless communication subsystem, including system spec, requirements for implementation teams, definition of interfaces and testing concept.
You will work closely with multidisciplinary development teams and directly with customers, from early system architecture and trade-off analysis through implementation, integration, validation and productization.
﻿Responsibilities:
Define the RSS end-to-end architecture and HW/SW partitioning, including interfaces between the radio, PHY, MAC, CPU/MCU, memories, PMU, clock and reset management (CRM) and other subsystem components.
Define architecture and operational mechanisms for multi-protocol operation and interoperability, including HW interfaces, state machines, control flows and operation sequences.
Define sleep/wake-up modes, testability, security and debug.
Drive PPA optimization and competitive benchmarking of the RSS, with particular focus on low-power operation, silicon area and overall system efficiency.
Work closely with RF, PHY/algorithm, HW, SW/firmware, verification and integration teams, from early system studies and architecture definition through RTL/FPGA validation and system bring-up.
Work directly with customers during technical engagements to define the RSS integration into their SoC and support customers throughout SoC integration, validation and productization, addressing system-level architecture, interoperability and integration challenges.
Requirements:
B.Sc. or M.Sc in Electrical Engineering
Proven experience in system and architecture definition for hardware based wireless communication systems
Experience in wireless communication standards (such as WiFi/BT/Cellular/UWB etc.)
Strong understanding of low-power design and system architecture
Good understanding of SoC architecture and IPs integration, including system interfaces, memory, interrupts, clocks, resets and power domains
Deep understanding of VLSI/ASIC development processes and methodologies
Good understanding of ASIC productization and system bring-up flows
Strong technical leadership skills with the ability to drive architectural decisions
Team player with good communication skills
Strong customer-facing technical skills, with the ability to translate customer requirements and SoC constraints into system architecture
Flexibility and innovation mindset
Advantages
Knowledge in RF integration, control and calibrations
Knowledge in Signal Processing and PHY architecture
Knowledge in MAC layer Architecture
Experience with embedded processors/MCUs and low-level firmware architecture
Experience in lab work, Silicon validation and bring-up

job.title: Project Manager For The IT Division
job.snippet:
Your role will include:
Responsible for systems analysis and leading cross-organizational technology projects, from requirements gathering through implementation, including projects integrating solutions and products from external vendors.
The role includes, among other things:
Gathering, analyzing, and defining business and technological requirements with clients and stakeholders.
Understanding business processes, analyzing them, and formulating technological solutions that support the organization's needs.
Writing, updating, and maintaining functional specification documents.
Managing and leading projects throughout the entire project lifecycle, from initiation and planning, through development and testing, to go-live and implementation.
Providing professional guidance to development and QA teams, and addressing professional issues during project execution.
Working with vendors and professional stakeholders, including coordinating activities and defining screens and workflows according to project needs.
Managing work interfaces with vendors and internal organizational stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Working in a multi-system, multi-interface, multi-technology environment.
Skills and abilities:
At least 5 years of experience in systems analysis – required (Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Industrial Engineering and Management, Computer Science, or a related field – an advantage).
Experience writing functional specification documents – required.
Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications – required.
Experience working with clients, vendors, development teams, and QA teams – required.
Experience working with complex enterprise systems and managing external vendors – an advantage.
Full proficiency in Hebrew and English.
Broad systems perspective and strong analytical ability.
Ability to lead processes and manage multiple interfaces.
Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
Organized, methodical, and able to work under multiple tasks while meeting deadlines.
Initiative, sense of responsibility, and ability to drive processes forward.
Excellent interpersonal communication, strong people skills, and a high service orientation.

job.title: Full-Stack Developer
job.snippet:
At BOA Ideas, we’ve been crafting smart, scalable web solutions for nearly two decades. We specialize in Shopify development, custom applications, and complex third-party integrations — helping brands build powerful digital commerce experiences.
We’re looking for a talented, experienced, and driven
Full-Stack Developer with deep Shopify expertise
to join our growing team and build industry-leading e-commerce experiences for global brands.
This role is ideal for someone with strong hands-on experience in the Shopify ecosystem — including custom theme development, Shopify APIs, app integrations, and scalable e-commerce architecture.
If you're passionate about clean code, modern technologies, and building high-performing Shopify solutions in a fast-paced agency environment — we’d love to meet you.
﻿
﻿What You’ll Do
Develop scalable Shopify websites and e-commerce experiences
Build and customize Shopify themes using Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
Convert designs into responsive, high-performing storefronts
Develop and maintain third-party integrations and API connections
Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code aligned with development best practices
Collaborate with designers, Project Managers, Customer Success, Webmasters, and leadership teams throughout the project lifecycle
Test, optimize, and continuously improve client solutions
Continuously explore new technologies and recommend improvements to development processes and client solutions
Requirements:
What We’re Looking For:
4+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Developer (working with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS ) — MUST
Hands-on experience with React, Node.js, and Express.js — MUST
Strong hands-on Shopify development experience (Shopify Liquid, Shopify APIs, and third-party integrations)
Proven experience building and customizing Shopify / Shopify Plus stores
Working knowledge of PHP, Laravel, and MySQL
Experience with GitHub and modern development workflows
Hands-on experience using AI tools in your development workflow (LLMs, code assistants, AI APIs, automation tools, etc.)
Experience building responsive, high-performing e-commerce websites
Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong self-management skills
Why Join Us?
Meaningful Impact:
Work on diverse and exciting projects that shape real digital commerce experiences.
Creative Problem-Solving Environment:
Join a team that values smart thinking, initiative, and pushing technical boundaries.
Growth-Focused Culture:
Be part of a fast-growing company where you can shape your role, expand your expertise, and grow alongside the business.
What we stand for:
We believe in strong partnerships, forward-thinking action, and consistently going above and beyond — for our clients and for each other.

job.title: Logistics Specialist
job.snippet:
HiSKY is looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented
Trade & Logistics Specialist
to join our Operations team.
This role combines commercial operations, customer order management, international shipping, and logistics coordination. The ideal candidate is highly organized, service-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple departments in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Work closely with the Sales team to prepare and manage quotations in Priority ERP.
Process customer orders and maintain the company's order backlog, coordinating with Planning, Procurement, and Supply Chain teams to ensure accurate delivery schedules.
Serve as a key point of contact for delivery status updates, working closely with customers and the Project Management team.
Coordinate and manage the Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) process.
Manage international shipping operations, including import, export, drop shipments, customs compliance, and relevant regulatory requirements.
Prepare and maintain shipping documentation, including commercial invoices, delivery notes, airway bills, and other required documents.
Coordinate domestic logistics and transportation activities.
Manage logistics and delivery processes through customer systems, including Rafael and Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI).
Coordinate operations with overseas logistics centers and external service providers.
Requirements
+4 years' experience in logistics, international trade, order management, or a similar operational role.
Experience working with
Priority ERP
– strong advantage.
Knowledge of import/export procedures, international shipping documentation, and customs processes.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a strong customer-service mindset.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments.
Good command of English, both written and spoken.
Experience working with defense industry customers – an advantage.
Why Join HiSKY?
At HiSKY, you'll be part of an innovative technology company developing advanced satellite communication solutions for demanding operational environments.
You'll work closely with multiple teams and play a key role in ensuring smooth commercial and logistics operations, from customer order to final delivery.

job.title: Supply Chain Coordinator
job.snippet:
אנחנו מגייסים: רכז/ת תפעול ולוגיסטיקה (E-commerce Operations & Supply Chain Coordinator) 📦🚀
חברת
Mayven
, מותג אי-קומרס צומח ומוביל בתחום ה-Wellness & Beauty, מחפשת שחקן/ית חיזוק לתחום האופרציה ושרשרת האספקה שלנו!
אם את/ה איש/אשת תפעול Hands-on, בעל/ת הבנה מערכתית עמוקה, יכולת אנליטית חדה וניסיון מוכח בעבודה מול מרלו"גים חיצוניים – מקומך איתנו.
מה כולל התפקיד?
ניהול ובקרת מרלו"ג (3PL):
ניהול שוטף מול המרלו"ג וחברות השילוח, מעקב אחר קליטת מלאי, ליקוט, אריזה ועמידה ביעדי שירות מחמירים (SLA).
ניהול שרשרת אספקה מקצה לקצה:
פיקוח על רמות מלאי, תיאום תנועות מלאי, ספירות תקופתיות ומניעת חוסרים.
הפצה, שילוח ו-Reverse Logistics:
בקרה על זמני אספקה ללקוחות קצה (B2C), פתרון חריגים ועיכובים בזמן אמת, וניהול מערך ההחזרות וה-QA.
ניתוח נתונים ודוחות:
הפקת דוחות ביצועים (KPIs), בקרת חשבוניות לוגיסטיקה וספקים, וניתוח עלויות שילוח.
אינטגרציה וסנכרון מערכות:
עבודה שוטפת מול מערכות ERP, WMS ו-Shopify, כולל פתיחה ועדכון מק"טים.
מה אנחנו מחפשים?
✔️
2–4 שנות ניסיון מעשי
בתפעול לוגיסטי / שרשרת אספקה (Supply Chain).
✔️
ניסיון מוכח בעבודה יומיומית מול מרלו"ג חיצוני (3PL)
וחברות הפצה –
חובה
.
✔️
שליטה גבוהה ב-Excel
(טבלאות ציר / Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, ניתוח נתונים).
✔️
היכרות מעשית עם עולם האי-קומרס (E-commerce / D2C)
– יתרון משמעותי.
✔️ ניסיון עבודה במערכות ERP / WMS / Shopify / Priority.
✔️ ראש גדול, יסודיות ודייקנות, אסרטיביות מול ספקים ויכולת פתרון בעיות בזמן אמת.
תנאי המשרה:
📍 משרדי החברה באפקה, תל אביב.
🕒 משרה מלאה, א'–ה', 09:00–18:00.
💼 כפיפות ישירה לסמנכ"ל אופרציה.
המשרה מיועדת לנשים וגברים כאחד

job.title: Billing Support Specialist
job.snippet:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Billing Support Specialist based in Israel.
As a Billing Support Specialist, you will play an essential role in delivering a seamless billing experience for customers across international markets.
You will manage a wide range of billing-related inquiries, helping technical customers resolve payment issues, invoice discrepancies, and account-related questions.
Working closely with customers and internal engineering teams, you will investigate complex cases and ensure timely, effective resolutions.
Beyond day-to-day support, you will identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to internal workflows, tools, and customer-facing processes.
You will also contribute to product quality by helping reproduce technical issues, develop test cases, and strengthen testing coverage.
This opportunity is ideal for a customer-focused professional who enjoys problem-solving and working in a fast-paced, globally distributed, asynchronous environment.
You will have the autonomy to take ownership of your work while contributing to a product used by a growing international developer community.
Accountabilities
Responsibilities
In this role, you will take ownership of customer billing inquiries while collaborating with technical and business teams to improve support operations. Your main responsibilities will include:
Provide timely initial responses to customer support requests covering billing questions, pre-sales inquiries, usage optimization, and payment disputes.
Investigate and troubleshoot customer-specific billing issues, including failed payments, outstanding invoices, and payment extension requests.
Triage incoming support cases and guide customers toward relevant documentation, previous solutions, code examples, and technical resources.
Escalate complex issues to the appropriate engineering or business teams when additional expertise or intervention is required.
Identify opportunities to develop, adopt, or improve internal tools that increase support efficiency and streamline workflows.
Recognize recurring customer issues and share insights that can contribute to product improvements and better billing experiences.
Reproduce technical issues and create test cases to support troubleshooting and improve test coverage, where applicable.
Collaborate with the Billing Engineering team and other stakeholders to ensure effective communication and resolution of customer concerns.
Requirements
The ideal candidate is an experienced customer support professional with a strong understanding of billing processes and the ability to communicate effectively with technical customers. The following qualifications and skills are expected:
At least 2 years of experience in customer support, including providing billing support to technical customers.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English.
Ability to explain technical concepts and billing-related issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience working with asynchronous communication practices and globally distributed teams.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate issues and identify appropriate solutions.
Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple support cases while maintaining responsiveness and attention to detail.
Familiarity with SQL is considered a plus.
Experience reproducing technical issues, creating test cases, or improving test coverage is an additional advantage.
Benefits
Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere in the world, with a WeWork membership or co-working allowance to support your preferred working environment.
Equity Ownership (ESOP): Receive company equity so you can share in the organization's long-term growth and success.
Technology Allowance: Access a dedicated budget to purchase equipment such as a laptop, monitor, headphones, and other tools needed to work effectively.
Health Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance coverage, with 100% of employee premiums and 80% of dependent premiums covered, regardless of location.
Annual Team Off-Sites: Participate in yearly company-wide gatherings in a different city, offering opportunities for collaboration, connection, and team building.
Flexible Working Arrangements: Benefit from an asynchronous work culture that gives you autonomy over your schedule and daily priorities.
Professional Development: Receive an annual education allowance to invest in courses, books, conferences, and other learning opportunities.
How Jobgether Works
We use an
AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
Why Apply Through Jobgether?
Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. job.title: Head of AI
job.snippet:
MAËLYS is a fast-growing global body care brand, built on a proprietary e-commerce platform, deep consumer insights, and a relentless focus on performance. Millions of women worldwide use our products, and we are on a mission to become one of the most influential body care brands globally.
We operate at extreme velocity, with high standards and an obsession with results. We believe in challenging conventional thinking, making data-driven decisions, and moving quickly from idea to execution.
We are looking for a
Head of AI
to build and lead MAËLYS' AI transformation journey, serving as a rare opportunity for a highly strategic and deeply hands-on builder who thrives at the intersection of business, technology, and execution. In this role, you will have the ultimate playground to shape how our entire company operates, influence every major function, and create a lasting competitive advantage for a leading body care brand. Initially operating as an individual contributor partnering closely with the CEO and the Management Team. Over time, you will transition to build and lead a small, high-performing team as AI becomes an increasingly critical capability across our global e-commerce and retail operations.
To thrive in our high-pace environment, you must think like an owner, not a consultant, and be equally comfortable discussing macro business strategy with executives as well as writing code to solve a messy problem yourself. You are someone who embraces ambiguity, enjoys building from scratch, and is completely obsessed with execution. You possess the high emotional intelligence and empathy required to collaborate with non-technical stakeholders and build trust, yet you maintain the thick skin, resilience, and great sense of humor needed to handle direct communication and rapid structural pivots. Most importantly, you maintain an uncompromising commitment to quality and process improvement, ensuring that every automation or workflow you deploy actively drives our core business metrics forward without requiring hand-holding or constant reminders.
Your life at MAËLYS will look like…
Define and lead the company's AI strategy and execution roadmap.
Identify the highest-impact opportunities for AI across all business functions.
Prioritize initiatives based on measurable business value, speed of implementation, and scalability.
Design, build, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered workflows, tools, automations, and agents.
Translate business challenges into practical AI solutions that improve performance, efficiency, and decision-making.
Develop production-ready applications and workflows using modern AI technologies, APIs, agents, and automation frameworks.
Drive adoption and behavioral change across teams.
Partner directly with business leaders to identify opportunities and implement solutions.
Evaluate emerging technologies, models, vendors, and platforms.
Establish governance, standards, architecture, and best practices for AI development.
Define and track success metrics for every AI initiative, ensuring measurable impact on growth, productivity, speed, efficiency, or cost.
You will thrive in this role if you have…
Strong technical foundation in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
5+ years of experience building technology, data, AI, automation, or software solutions in high-performance environments.
Proven experience identifying business opportunities and translating them into deployed AI products, agents, automations, or workflows that drive measurable business impact.
Hands-on experience working with modern generative AI technologies, LLMs, agent frameworks, APIs, embeddings, automation platforms, and production deployments.
Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, APIs, and data-driven application development.
Deep understanding of business operations, growth metrics, performance marketing, and operational KPIs.
Ability to operate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Exceptional problem-solving and execution skills.
Full professional fluency in Hebrew and English.
Strong Advantages:
Alumni of Unit 8200 or other elite IDF technological units.
Experience building AI products, internal platforms, or automation systems at scale.
Experience in high-growth startups, technology companies, consulting firms, or founder-led environments.
Experience leading cross-functional transformation initiatives.
Experience hiring and managing technical teams.

job.title: Senior Engineer II, Field Service (Engineer in Charge)
job.snippet:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.
For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.
About The Role
We are looking for a Senior Engineer II, Field Service (Engineer in Charge) who will indirectly lead a team of engineers supporting advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment in a high-volume production environment.
This role combines deep technical expertise, leadership, operational ownership, and strategic planning. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving equipment reliability, capacity, uptime, and operational excellence while leading engineers supporting a critical manufacturing area.
Over time, this role may assume responsibility for a fleet of up to
20 production tools
and a team of engineers operating in a 24/7 manufacturing environment.
Key Responsibilities
Equipment & Area Ownership
Own the technical performance, reliability, and operational readiness of a designated equipment area.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on uptime, throughput, quality, and operational efficiency.
Lead complex root cause investigations and implement sustainable engineering solutions.
Develop and execute long-term reliability and performance roadmaps.
Leadership
Indirectly lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers supporting manufacturing operations.
Manage engineering resources across shift-based operations.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, safety, and technical excellence.
Drive talent development, succession planning, and technical competency growth.
Business & Operational Leadership
Partner closely with customers, manufacturing, engineering, and service organizations.
Support factory expansions, capacity growth, and equipment deployment strategies.
Manage operational risks and execute mitigation plans.
Present performance updates, reliability metrics, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership.
Technical Excellence
Serve as the technical authority for the assigned equipment area.
Lead technology introductions, qualifications, and major improvement programs.
Ensure engineering standards and best practices are implemented consistently.

,

עבודה צמודה ואינטגרטיבית מול צוותי Solution Design, Project Delivery וגורמים מקצועיים נוספים בארגון.
ביצוע עבודות Hands-on במעבדות החברה, באתרי החברה ובאתרי לקוחות.
תיעוד מדויק של תקלות, פעולות תחזוקה ופתרונות במערכות הארגון.
הצטרפו אלינו לחברה טכנולוגית מובילה המציעה אופק קידום משמעותי וסביבת עבודה תומכת, בה תוכלו לפתח את כישוריכם המקצועיים ולהשפיע באופן ישיר על הצלחת הארגון.

אנגלית ברמה טובה מאוד
, כולל יכולת קריאה והבנה של מסמכים טכניים – חובה.
ידע או ניסיון בתחום ה-
SATCOM
ו-
RF

ניסיון בעבודה עם ציוד תקשורת, מערכות RF או מערכות לווייניות – יתרון.
אוריינטציה טכנית חזקה ויכולת גבוהה לאבחון ופתרון תקלות מורכבות.
יכולת עבודה עצמאית לצד שיתוף פעולה אפקטיבי כחלק מצוות מקצועי.
נכונות לעבודת Hands-on ולנסיעות לאתרי לקוחות מעת לעת.
נכונות לעבודה במשמרות ובכוננויות בהתאם לצורכי המחלקה והלקוחות.
יכולת עבודה בסביבה דינמית ומתן מענה לתקלות בזמן אמת.

job.title: Director of Engineering
job.snippet:
Riverbed, the leader in AIOps for observability, helps organizations optimize their users’ experiences by leveraging AI automation for the prevention, identification, and resolution of IT issues. With over 20 years of experience in data collection and AI and machine learning, Riverbed’s open and
AI-powered observability platform
and solutions optimize digital experiences and greatly improve IT efficiency. Riverbed also offers industry-leading
Acceleration solutions
that provide fast, agile, secure acceleration of any app, over any network, to users anywhere. Together with our thousands of market-leading customers globally – including 95% of the FORTUNE 100 – we are empowering next-generation digital experiences. Learn more at
riverbed.com
Position
Position
: Director of Engineering
Location
: Hybrid, Hod Hasharon
We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead a group of software engineers responsible for the cloud platform and core services behind our large-scale enterprise SaaS product.
Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will lead engineering managers, drive strategic initiatives, and help shape the future of our platform and engineering practices.
What You Will Do
Lead and develop engineering managers and high-performing teams.
Drive major initiatives including platform modernization and engineering transformations.
Partner with Product Management and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver business outcomes.
Improve engineering effectiveness, software quality, reliability, and operational excellence.
Help define modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted software development.
Recruit, retain, and grow top engineering talent.
What Makes You An Ideal Candidate
A leader who knows how to build strong engineering organizations that deliver through ownership, accountability, and trust
Experience leading multiple engineering teams through engineering managers in a SaaS product organization
Experienced in building and operating modern SaaS platforms at scale, with a strong understanding of cloud architectures and distributed systems
Technically savvy, with the depth and curiosity to understand complex systems, challenge architectural decisions, and help teams navigate technical tradeoffs without needing to be hands-on every day.
A customer-focused leader who measures engineering success through customer value, reliability, velocity, and business impact
Excited by transformation, from platform modernization and better engineering practices to AI-assisted software development
Able to balance long-term strategy with predictable, high-quality execution
What We Offer
Our employee benefits including flexible workplace policies, employee resource groups, learning and development resources, career progression pathways, and community engagement initiatives are some of the reasons why we have had great success in bringing in new talent. In addition, our global employee wellness programs are crafted to support the physical, emotional, and financial well-being of our employees.
Benefits & Perks vary by Country.
About Riverbed
With a 20-year history of innovation, Riverbed is agile and proven—and we continue to disrupt the market with differentiated solutions that help customers deliver secure, seamless digital experiences and accelerate enterprise performance. We are relentlessly customer-first: we listen, learn, and act with urgency to solve real problems and earn trust every day. We pair bold ideas with operational efficiency, simplifying how we work, focusing on what matters most, and delivering with quality and speed. Fueled by a will to win, we set ambitious goals, hold ourselves accountable, and raise the bar through measurable outcomes. At the center of it all are our people—bringing our best selves to work with a shared commitment to excellence, transparency, and open communication. We strive to be an inclusive, fair, and enjoyable workplace where respect and wellbeing are prioritized. We are committed to our people, partners, and customers while supporting the communities where we work and live. It’s the
Power of
WE
that binds us together and drives high-impact success.
Riverbed is an equal employment opportunity/Affirmative Action (EEO/AA) employer and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or child birth (including breast feeding), sexual orientation, genetics, genetic information, marital status, veteran status or any other basis protected by and in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.
Check Us Out On
www.riverbed.com
@LifeAtRiverbed

job.title: Global Shipping Manager
job.snippet:
﻿Company Overview:
Cellebrite’s (Nasdaq: CLBT) mission is to enable its global customers to protect and save lives by enhancing digital investigations and intelligence gathering to accelerate justice in communities around the world. Cellebrite’s AI-powered Digital Investigation Platform enables customers to lawfully access, collect, analyze and share digital evidence in legally sanctioned investigations while preserving data privacy. Thousands of public safety organizations, intelligence agencies and businesses rely on Cellebrite’s digital forensic and investigative solutions—available via cloud, on-premises and hybrid deployments—to close cases faster and safeguard communities. To learn more, visit us at www.cellebrite.com, https://investors.cellebrite.com/investors and find us on social media @Cellebrite.
Position Overview:
The Global Shipping Manager is a key leadership position within our Supply Chain organization. You will own end-to-end execution of all international export and import shipments, ensuring every delivery reaches our customers, labs, and partners worldwide on time, in compliance, and at the right cost.
You will lead the shipping function, manage our 3PL network and freight forwarders, and serve as the focal point to Sales Operations, Product Development, Customs, and HQ.
Key Responsibilities:
End-to-End Shipping Ownership: Own end-to-end planning and execution of all international export and import shipments, coordinating with carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and internal stakeholders.
Trade Compliance & Regulation: Ensure compliance with international shipping regulations, AEO, export/import controls, customs requirements, documentation, and Incoterms across all destinations.
AI-Driven Data Analysis: Analyze large volumes of shipping data using AI and advanced analytics to identify trends, inefficiencies, and cost-saving opportunities, and to build shipping dashboards and forecasts.
Cost Optimization: Lead cost-reduction initiatives through data insights, carrier and forwarder tenders and negotiations, mode and route optimization, and process improvements.
Carrier, Forwarder & 3PL Management: Select, contract, and manage the global carrier and freight forwarder base; run regular performance reviews and SLA governance.
Dangerous Goods: Manage shipping terms and handling of dangerous goods (e.g., lithium batteries), ensuring packaging, labeling, documentation, and carrier requirements are met (IATA/IMDG/ADR).
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales Operations, Customer Support, Product Development, Marketing, IT, Labs, Training, HQ, Finance, Purchasing, and external vendors to support customer commitments and product launches.
Process & Systems Improvement: Drive standardization, automation, and ERP/WMS/TMS integration (e.g., NetSuite) to improve visibility, accuracy, and scalability.
Requirements:
Experience: 5 years of managerial experience as a Shipping Manager in a global, high-volume environment, preferably in a tech hardware company.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or a similar field; relevant certifications (e.g., IATA Dangerous Goods, CSCP) – an advantage.
Strong knowledge of international export/import processes, customs regulations, Incoterms, shipping carriers, and dangerous goods handling.
Analytical Skills: Proven ability to analyze complex datasets, generate insights, and reduce costs, including hands-on use of AI tools and data-driven approaches.
3PL & Vendor Management: Proven experience managing 3PL providers, forwarders, and carriers, including negotiations and performance management.
Technical Expertise: Experience with ERP/CRM systems (NetSuite, Salesforce – an advantage); advanced Excel/BI skills; Python or SQL – an advantage.
Communication: Excellent English (written and verbal) and strong interpersonal skills for working with multiple interfaces globally.
Mindset: Team-oriented, people-focused leader who thrives and delivers under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: System Engineer - Kinetic Drone Interception
job.snippet:
Regulus is an agile defense-tech startup tackling the most complex challenges in counter-drone and uncrewed defense. With hundreds of combat-proven systems deployed by the IDF and global partners, we are now engineering the next generation of C-UxS (Counter-Uncrewed Systems). We leverage advanced electronic warfare and kinetic measures to detect and neutralize hostile threats. If you want to push technological boundaries while safeguarding Israel and our allies, join us at this pivotal stage of our growth.
This is a unique opportunity to join a company at a pivotal growth stage and help shape its products, culture, and future.
We are looking for a
System Engineer
to join our kinetic interception team, in which we are using racer drones for C-UAS interception. This role includes interdisciplinary environment, early stages prototypes, and proof-of-concept studies.
﻿Key Responsibilities
Lead system-level engineering for control software within a kinetic interception (C-UAS) drone platform
Define requirements, architecture, and interfaces across software, hardware, and algorithms
Own hardware configuration and end-to-end system integration (avionics, sensors, computing, communication)
Support early-stage prototyping, bring-up, and proof-of-concept activities
Plan and execute system validation, including lab and flight tests, driving iterative improvements
Requirements:
5+ years of experience in system in which there are closed control loops - Must
Practical experience in real-time systems and embedded hardware - Must
Flight test experience - Advantage
Experience with quadcopter drones or FPV systems - Advantage
Strong ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, align stakeholders, and drive joint execution, while maintaining a high level of ownership and independence in delivering tasks end-to-end.

job.title: Production Integration
job.snippet:
PixelSight is a deep-tech startup that builds vision intelligence systems to tackle one of the hardest problems in perception: early detection of threats drones, boats, and other targets at the edge of what's visible. Our systems are deployed in the field and saving lives.
Pixel Sight produces its systems together with contract manufacturing partners.
In this role you hold the hands-on knowledge of how our systems are built, integrated, tested and repaired. You will support R&D with development builds and upgrades, run RMA repairs, and improve assembly processes at our subcontractors to shorten assembly time, reduce cost and raise output.
You will work on our partners’ production lines to make sure every build meets our standard, and capture that know-how in documents and procedures.
Key responsibilities:
R&D builds and upgrades:
Build development systems and prototypes to R&D requirements
Make changes, adjustments and upgrades to existing systems
Record assembly difficulties and feed design-for-assembly (DFA) improvements back to R&D
Production at subcontractors
Lead integration and assembly of electronic, mechanical and opto-mechanical assemblies on the
subcontractor line, to Pixel Sight work instructions and production documents
Supervise build quality and adherence to quality and safety procedures, including ESD; escalate
deviations
Identify difficulties and bottlenecks on subcontractor lines and drive solutions that improve
speed and quality
Run functional tests and support environmental and vibration tests
Find and fix faults in complex systems, down to component level on electronic boards
Production logistics and records:
Receive parts against purchase orders, kit per work order and run inventory counts
Record serial numbers, component-to-serial links, unit status and shipments in the ERP (Priority)
Flag shortages and material risks to Supply Chain
Work instructions and documentation
Write clear, photo-based assembly instructions for every stage: sequence of operations, tools,
technical notes and in-process checks
Keep work instructions up to date with engineering changes and system versions
Build a library of known faults and repair methods
Assembly efficiency and cost:
Map assembly times and identify complex or repetitive steps
Develop work methods, jigs and aids that shorten assembly time and prevent errors
Evaluate pre-assembly of sub-assemblies, better sequences and simpler processes
keeping quality:
Propose changes to design, sub-assembly split and assembly methods that reduce production
cost
Assembly quality
Define in-process checkpoints at key assembly stages, for approval by Quality Control as part of
the control plan
Identify common assembly errors and develop ways to prevent them
RMA, upgrades and maintenance
Run the RMA process: intake, fault diagnosis, repair and testing before return to use, with
Quality Control on root cause and retest
Requirements:
Practical engineer or certified technician in electronics, electro-mechanics,
mechatronics or electrical engineering
5+ years of hands-on assembly and integration of electro-mechanical systems- Must
Experience in serial production or transfer of products from development to production- Must
Fault finding in complex systems, including component-level debugging of electronic boards
Reads drawings, electrical schematics, BOMs and production documents, including in English
Hands-on with lab and measurement equipment
Comfortable with ERP records and documentation
