job.title: Field Application Engineer
job.snippet:
Field Application Engineer
System Integration | Product Deployment | Technical Support
We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Field Application Engineer to lead integration, deployment, and technical support of an exciting, multidisciplinary Physical AI product.
Join a well-established startup developing advanced mechatronic systems combining mechanics, motion control, electronics, and intelligent software.
The challenge:
•            Lead system integration, bring-up, installation, and commissioning.
•            Troubleshoot complex mechanical, electrical, and software issues.
•            Support product deployment at customer sites worldwide.
•            Work closely with R&D to improve product reliability and performance.
•            Representing the company professionally in the field.
What you bring:
•            Proven experience in system integration, field applications, or multidisciplinary engineering.
•            Strong technical understanding and hands-on troubleshooting skills.
•            Excellent communication, interpersonal skills, and customer orientation.
•            Independent, practical, and solution-oriented approach.
•            Good English and willingness to travel internationally.
•            BSc in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field is an advantage.
Above all, we value strong engineering skills, product understanding, and the ability to make things work.

job.title: מהנדס\ת ביצוע
job.snippet:
אנחנו אנשי העיר, יזמים תל אביבים שבונים את העיר וחיים אותה מאז שנת 2007 . הכוח שמניע אותנו הוא אהבה ענקית לעיר המדהימה הזו – תל אביב. המומחיות שלנו היא התחדשות עירונית בתל אביב יפו שיוצרת קהילה וחוויית מגורים ייחודית. הערכים שלנו הם אהבה, יושרה ותעוזה.אם העיר מרגשת אותך, אם התחדשות עירונית ושינוי חווית החיים בעיר אלו תחומים שמעניינים אותך, אם מעניין אותך לעבוד בחברה דינאמית, חדשנית,   ומתפתחת, שכל יום בה הוא מסעיר אז…
לחברת הביצוע העצמי של אנשי העיר דרוש\ה מהנדס\ת ביצוע לאתרי בנייה בתל אביב.
התפקיד כולל ניהול קבלנים, תפעול האתר ותפקודו, קריאת תוכניות, חישוב כמויות.
העבודה במשרה מלאה באתרי הבנייה בתל אביב  ומתאימה לבוגרי הנדסת בניין שמעוניינים באפשרויות קידום ופיתוח רבות.
דרישות המשרה:
תואר ראשון בהנדסה אזרחית - חובה
ידע באקסל - חובה
יכולת תפקוד גבוהה במצבי לחץ
יחסי אנוש מעולים ויכולת עבודה בצוות
יכולת למידה עצמית גבוהה
המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

job.title: Deputy CDO
job.snippet:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Deputy Chief Data Officer (Deputy CDO) based in Israel.
The Deputy Chief Data Officer will play a central leadership role in driving the execution and strategic development of a global data and analytics function within a product-driven technology organization. Acting as the second-in-command to the Chief Data Officer, you will oversee key initiatives spanning data engineering, machine learning, product and marketing analytics, UX research, and experimentation. This position combines strategic leadership with hands-on operational ownership, ensuring that complex cross-functional projects translate into measurable business outcomes. Working directly with C-level executives and business leaders, you will shape priorities, allocate resources, and improve organizational performance. You will also strengthen team leadership, establish effective operating processes, and ensure the reliability and scalability of data platforms. This is an opportunity to grow into a Chief Data Officer position while directly influencing business performance and long-term strategy.
Accountabilities
The Deputy CDO will take ownership of execution across the Research Center, translating strategic priorities into measurable results while ensuring operational excellence, effective resource management, and strong collaboration across teams.
Strategic Initiative Leadership: Lead selected strategic initiatives from business case development and prioritization through implementation and measurable business impact. Ensure projects align with organizational objectives and deliver tangible value.
Executive Stakeholder Management: Collaborate directly with C-level executives and business leaders to align priorities, negotiate resources and timelines, and manage strategic trade-offs using data-driven arguments and financial insights.
Cross-Functional Project Execution: Oversee major initiatives across data and analytics, including data platform development, BigQuery migration, complex machine learning projects, experimentation processes, AI-powered analytics, UX research, and data quality improvements.
Project Delivery and Issue Resolution: Identify and resolve delivery bottlenecks across teams. Clarify project scope, assign ownership, establish next steps, address dependencies, and escalate risks early to ensure initiatives progress successfully.
Resource and Backlog Management: Manage capacity, resources, and backlogs across multiple teams. Prioritize initiatives according to business value, coordinate dependencies between ML, backend, product, and analytics teams, and reassess or discontinue projects that fail to deliver expected results.
Operational Management and Governance: Establish and maintain the operating framework for the Research Center, including monthly business reviews, quarterly planning, project reviews, retrospectives, commitment tracking, escalation procedures, and centralized performance dashboards.
Business Impact and ROI Measurement: Translate strategic initiatives into measurable business objectives, expected benefits, and financial outcomes. Monitor ROI and actual performance against plans, ensuring that delivery success is measured by business impact rather than task completion alone.
Team Leadership and Development: Support and strengthen team leads across Product Analytics, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, and UX Research. Help them define objectives, prioritize work, improve management practices, provide constructive feedback, and develop their leadership capabilities.
Operational Performance: Oversee the operational health of the data function, monitoring data freshness, platform uptime, ML infrastructure stability, delivery predictability, and experimentation throughput.
Strategic and Organizational Continuity: Act as a trusted partner and successor to the CDO, maintaining the ability to assume responsibility for the entire data function when required.
Requirements
The ideal candidate is an experienced data and technology leader with a strong background in product organizations, proven operational execution capabilities, and the ambition to progress into a Chief Data Officer position.
At least 7 years of professional experience in data, analytics, or machine learning within product-focused technology companies.
At least 4 years of leadership experience managing highly skilled specialists, managers, and team leads.
Previous experience as a Chief Data Officer, Deputy CDO, Head of Data, or Head of Analytics within a mid-sized or large product organization is highly desirable.
Strong ambition and readiness to grow into a CDO role, combining strategic vision with hands-on responsibility for day-to-day execution.
Broad understanding of data and research functions, including product and marketing analytics, A/B testing, experimentation, machine learning lifecycles, data platforms, data quality, service-level agreements (SLAs), business intelligence, self-service analytics, and unit economics.
Deep practical expertise in at least one major data domain, supported by the ability to understand and coordinate across the wider data ecosystem.
Proven track record of delivering complex, cross-functional data and machine learning initiatives with measurable business outcomes.
Strong operational management skills, including project planning, work decomposition, resource allocation, backlog prioritization, risk management, and coordination of multiple parallel initiatives.
Business-oriented mindset with the ability to evaluate initiatives through financial metrics, expected benefits, ROI, and measurable business impact.
Strong understanding of the trade-offs between delivery speed, quality, business value, and operational risk.
Demonstrated experience working with and influencing C-level executives, supported by strong analytical reasoning, numerical accuracy, and persuasive communication.
Ability to influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority, build trust through expertise, and manage disagreements constructively.
Highly organized, systematic, disciplined, and persistent, with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and fast-changing environments.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead distributed and multidisciplinary teams.
Fluent in both Russian and English.
Benefits
Remote Work: Fully remote, full-time opportunity with the flexibility to work from anywhere.
Competitive Compensation: Salary range and initial compensation details shared with candidates during the recruitment process, before employment begins.
Annual Leave: 28 calendar days of paid vacation per year.
Wellness Days: 7 additional paid wellness days annually to manage personal matters, rest, and recover without using sick leave.
Family Support: Financial compensation for kindergarten or school fees for employees' children.
Referral Bonuses: Bonuses of up to $5,000 for successfully recommending candidates who join the organization.
Professional Development: 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and industry events.
Language Learning: Corporate discounts for foreign language lessons.
Health Benefits: Up to $1,000 gross per year per employee toward private health insurance or medical expenses for themselves and eligible close family members when corporate medical insurance is unavailable.
Remote Workplace Support: Provision of an equipped workspace and necessary equipment in offices or coworking locations. Employees working elsewhere can receive up to $1,000 gross every three years toward coworking expenses or home-office equipment and internet costs.
Recognition and Rewards: Internal gamified appreciation program allowing employees to earn colleague recognition bonuses and exchange them for merchandise, team-building activities, massage certificates, and other rewards.
International Work Environment: Opportunity to collaborate with a distributed team of experienced professionals across multiple countries.
How Jobgether Works
We use an
AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
Why Apply Through Jobgether?
Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

job.title: R&D Operations Manager
job.snippet:
About the Company
Antidote Health is a tech- driven health insurance company on a mission to make healthcare easy, accessible, and more affordable. We’re rethinking how healthcare works—using technology to remove the friction, complexity, and delays that define the traditional system. Instead of navigating paperwork, long waits, and disconnected experiences, we’re building a simpler, more connected way for people to get care.
Our platform combines health coverage, virtual care, and a modern member experience into one seamless system designed to help people actually use their benefits.
We offer Affordable Care Act (ACA) health plans in Arizona and Ohio, and we’re growing quickly. We’re building a company focused on solving real problems—with real impact on people’s lives.
Position Overview
This is a senior, broad role working closely with the Chief of R&D and the R&D leadership team, and it will shape how R&D scales as we grow. You'll work with engineering and product teams in Israel, Georgia, and the US, and with business stakeholders across the company.
We're looking for an R&D Operations Manager to run how Antidote's R&D organization operates: planning, process, measurement, delivery coordination, and the systems that let a growing organization move fast without breaking. Squad leads own their squads' delivery. You make sure the whole organization works as one. That covers turning priorities into plans, running the leadership operating rhythm, and personally leading the most critical cross-squad initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Leadership Partnership
Partner with the Chief of R&D and R&D leaders to turn vision and priorities into executable plans and represent R&D in cross-functional and leadership forums.
Run R&D's operating rhythm: leadership meetings, agendas, decisions and owners, and follow-up to completion.
Process, Measurement, and Culture
Own the development process end to end, from intake through planning, development, testing, release, and retrospectives, and keep improving it.
Partner with squad leads so each squad tracks, presents, and acts on its own metrics for delivery speed, predictability, and quality, and data-driven improvement part of R&D culture.
Cross-Squad Delivery and Major Projects
Own cross-squad coordination and give leadership one reliable view of what's on track, at risk, or slipping.
Project-manage R&D's most critical initiatives: own the plan, milestones, and deadlines, drive accountability through syncs and follow-ups, run risk and mitigation analysis, and report status to stakeholders.
Reporting and Tooling
Lead a rebuild of how engineering works on Monday.com, aligning it with the process and building squad-level dashboards for delivery speed, quality, and predictability.
Own R&D's KPI reporting, executive updates, and leadership materials.
Qualifications
Required:
10+ years in software or technology companies, including 7+ years in R&D operations, technical program management leadership, or engineering management.
Proven experience working closely with senior R&D leadership, operating across planning, delivery, process, and people.
A track record of leading large cross-functional initiatives with hard deadlines.
Proven experience building processes and metrics across multiple teams that were adopted and measurably improved delivery.
Hands-on experience structuring workflows, automations, and dashboards in a work-management tool for engineering teams.
Monday.com
is strongly preferred.
Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve process, delivery, and efficiency.
A strong technical background. You can engage credibly with engineers and team leads on technical trade-offs.
Executive-level communication and strong professional English for working with US-based leadership.
Preferred:
Regulated industry experience (healthcare, insurance, or fintech).
Distributed teams across time zones.
What Success Looks Like
First month:
Monday rebuilt around the improved process, with squad dashboards live.
First 90 days:
R&D's operating rhythm running, and squads reviewing their own metrics regularly.
6–12 months:
R&D delivers predictably at a larger size, squads run their own metrics, and leadership time has shifted from operations to strategy.
Equal Opportunity Statement
Antidote Health is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, military reserve duty, or any other protected status un

job.snippet:

אפיון ויישום:
אפיון ויישום תהליכים עסקיים במערכת Priority והפיכתם לאפיון ודרישות מערכת.
פיתוח ואינטגרציה:
פיתוח ותחזוקה של מסכים, דוחות, תהליכים, וחוקים עסקיים במערכת Priority, וממשקים בין Priority למערכות חיצוניות כולל קבצים, API ו-EDI.
תחזוקה שוטפת:
אחריות שוטפת על תחזוקת מערכת Priority, שדרוג גרסאות, ניהול משתמשים והרשאות, אבחון וטיפול בתקלות, תיעוד וכו'.
תמיכה ושירות:
תמיכה במשתמשים, טיפול בקריאות שירות בהתאם לרמת הדחיפות ול-SLA מוגדר.

הדרכת משתמשים בנוגע לתהליכים, פונקציונליות ושינויים במערכת.

חובה
.

ניסיון בעבודה עם API, ממשקי קבצים ו-EDI, אוטומציה ודיגיטציה –
חובה
.
BI:
ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות BI וניסיון כמפתח מערכות BI –
יתרון משמעותי
.
בסיסי נתונים:
ידע וניסיון ב-SQL.

הבנה מעמיקה של תהליכים בארגון תעשייתי יצרני והיכולת לתרגם אותם לפתרונות במערכת, לצד יכולת לאתר ולפתור תקלות באופן עצמאי.

תמיכת משתמשים בארץ ובחו"ל (במקרים חריגים גם מעבר לשעות העבודה). אנגלית ברמה גבוהה – דיבור, כתיבה וקריאה.

job.title: HS Chemistry Teacher (August 1, 2027)
job.company: The Walworth Barbour American International School in Israel
job.snippet:
Privacy Policy
Introduction
WBAIS teachers are dedicated to student success, concerned about the physical and emotional well-being of their students, passionate about student learning and excited by the prospect of working within a dynamic and diverse community.
Classroom practices emphasize active, collaborative learning; meaningful application of technology; authentic learning experiences and differentiated instruction to achieve high learning impact.
WBAIS and Israel
Established under the auspices of the American Embassy in 1958, The Walworth Barbour American International School in Israel (WBAIS) is a MSA accredited, fully independent, co-educational Pre-K - 12 international school, which offers a robust program leading to a US high school diploma.
With a present enrollment of approximately 450 students representing over 40 nationalities, WBAIS Israel is a diverse and vibrant community. Approximately 30% of WBAIS students are American, 40% from countries all over the world, and 30% Israeli.
In 2008 WBAIS moved to its current 19-acre campus that opened in 2007 and is located in the town of Even Yehuda, a residential community approximately 20 kilometers north of Tel Aviv. The purpose-built campus includes four separate divisions, a performing arts building with a 400-seat auditorium, full gym, cafeteria, library and media center, athletic fields, tennis and basketball courts, and an olympic-sized pool.
Position Objectives
We are seeking an experienced, student-centered, and dynamic HS teacher who collaborates well with others to support student learning. We are looking for someone who embraces best pedagogical practices, is well versed in NGSS standards, as well as actively contributes to the life and culture of the school beyond the classroom.
Please note, WBAIS does not sponsor B1 visas. As such, only applicants with valid work permits in Israel, or those eligible for SOFA visa status (U.S. citizens) may be considered for employment.
Essential Responsibilities
Teach HS Chemistry and AP Chemistry classes.
Actively engage and contribute to our HS Advisory or iBlock learning programs.
Give timely and actionable feedback to improve student learning.
Mentor, evaluate and assess students.
Effectively collaborate with students, teachers and parents
Foster a positive classroom learning environment
Plan and supervise extra-curricular activities
Position Expectations
Successful candidates will perform each essential responsibility, in addition to the following:
Classroom facilitation – effectively orchestrate a class with high learning impact, by incorporating best practices into the classroom.
Curriculum development – contribute to the development and documenting of curricular documents (unit plans, assessments, standards documentation, etc.).
Communication skills – proactively communicate to integrate all community stakeholders into the learning process.
Classroom technology – be familiar with educational technology such as Google Suite and online learning management systems.
Priority Will Be Given To Candidates Who Have Experience
Serving as an advisor/pastoral care role
Working with students with varying levels of English language fluency
Effectively employing differentiation strategies for high learning impact
Collaborating in a co-teaching model
Teaching in an international school setting
Contributing to student experiences beyond the classroom.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s Degree (Master’s preferred)
Current and valid teaching license
Minimum three years teaching experience in a similar role
Child Protection
WBAIS is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection.
Position Details
Reports to: High School Principal
Job Capacity: 100%
Start Date: Estimated start would be August 1, 2027
Contact Information
Apply @:
https://www.wbais.net/about/employment
Email: wbaisemployment@wbais.net
WBAIS Website: https://www.wbais.net
Phone: +972-9-890-1000 / Fax: +972-9-890-1001
Address: 65 Hashomron St., Even Yehuda, 4051765

job.title: AI Engineer
job.snippet:
We’re using AI to reshape how insurance works and ultimately, how consumers are protected. We work with Fortune 100 insurers to automate their regulatory busywork so they can focus on what matters: insuring people. We’re a team backed by strategic investors, building something meaningful, working hard, and (most days) having fun along the way.
The Role
We are looking for a hands-on, product-oriented AI Engineer who wants to solve deep architectural and  machine learning challenges. You will take ownership of our core AI intelligence layer - orchestrating multi-agent systems, advanced RAG frameworks, and domain-specific LLM reasoning chains designed for complex, high-stakes legal and  regulatory documentation where accuracy, auditability, and performance are critical.
What You’ll Own
AI Architecture & Agent Orchestration:
Own, design, and scale complex AI workflows leveraging  Multi-Agent architectures, RAG, Knowledge Graphs, and structured data extraction.
Model Benchmarking & Evaluation:
Build robust evaluation pipelines, benchmarking tools, and  guardrails to measure and optimize model accuracy, legal reasoning, and factual alignment on  domain-specific datasets.
Production AI Infrastructure:
Act as the technical bridge connecting cutting-edge AI/LLM models  with our distributed backend architecture (Python/TypeScript), ensuring low latency, high  availability, and enterprise auditability.
Product-Driven Execution:
Partner closely with Product, CTO, and R&D leads to rapidly move features from experimental AI capabilities into clean, production-ready systems.
What We’re Looking For
Core Experience:
3+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1-2+ years dedicated to  hands-on AI/LLM engineering in production environments.
Deep AI Stack Knowledge:
Strong practical experience with modern AI technologies - LLMs (API based and open-source), Multi-Agent frameworks, advanced RAG architectures, Vector Databases,  Knowledge Graphs, and prompt engineering/fine-tuning.
Engineering Fundamentals:
Strong familiarity with core backend concepts required for production systems - specifically Concurrency and Parallelism, Networking, Caching (prompt & semantic caching), and API design. Solid understanding of backend architecture, microservices, and data pipelines.
Production & Quality Mindset:
Track record of taking AI models beyond initial prompts/prototypes into reliable, auditable, enterprise-ready features.
Startup DNA:
Comfortable with ambiguity, proactive, high-agency, and thrives in a high-velocity environment without needing detailed specifications to start building.
Why Blaise
You’ll join at a pivotal Series A moment, working directly with Fortune 100 customers in a $2 Trillion industry. You won't be implementing someone else's playbook; you'll be writing it.
We offer clear long-term career growth paths into Product Operations, Marketing Ops / Demand Gen, or RevOps Leadership. If you want to build the operating system of a fast-scaling startup from the ground up, this is that opportunity.

job.title: Operations & Business Control Manager
job.snippet:
A leading
Energy Company
is looking for an experienced
Operations & Business Control Manager
to play a key role in driving operational excellence, business performance, and organizational growth.
This is a high-impact position working closely with the CEO and senior management, offering broad responsibility across operations, logistics, business analysis, process improvement, and strategic decision-making.
Key Responsibilities:
• Lead and manage day-to-day operations and distribution activities
• Oversee inventory management, supply processes, and delivery documentation
• Analyze business performance, pricing strategies, cost structures, and profitability
• Implement and optimize operational processes to improve efficiency and performance
• Work closely with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders
• Ensure data accuracy, maintain information systems, and generate management reports
• Manage and motivate operational teams
• Lead technology-driven initiatives, automation projects, and continuous improvement efforts
Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering & Management, Economics, or a related field
• Minimum of 5 years' experience in Operations, Logistics, or Supply Chain Management
• Proven experience managing employees, inventory, procurement, and business controls
• Strong background in cost analysis, pricing, and process optimization
• Advanced Excel skills and experience working with ERP systems
• Hands-on experience with
Priority ERP
- mandatory
• Strong analytical capabilities, business acumen, and leadership skills
Significant Advantage:
• Experience managing distribution networks and vehicle fleets
• Familiarity with the energy, fuel, transportation, logistics, or hazardous materials sectors
• Experience working with BI and data analytics systems
Location: Ashdod, Israel

job.title: מנהל/ת פרויקטים ולקוחות בכיר/ה – אנרגיה ומים
job.snippet:
PB ישראל היא אחת מחברות ההנדסה המובילות בארץ, המנהלת ומעצבת את תשתיות העתיד של מדינת ישראל.כחלק מקבוצת WSP בעבר, החברה עוסקת בפרויקטים לאומיים רחבי היקף עם למעלה מ-30 שנות ותק ומספקת פתרונות חדשניים, יחד עם מצוינות טכנולוגית וראייה גלובלית. כל זאת לצד היכרות עמוקה עם הצרכים המקומיים.החברה משלבת מומחיות בינלאומית עם ניסיון וידע מקומי ומקדמת את הפרויקטים המשמעותיים ביותר בישראל – החל מהקו האדום של הרכבת הקלה, המטרו ועד לפיתוח תשתיות מתקדמות, תחנות כוח ומערכות אנרגיה.צוות החברה מונה מעל 170 אנשי מקצוע מהמובילים במשק, הפועלים לקידום פתרונות חכמים במגוון תחומים, עם טכנולוגיה מתקדמת וחזון של קיימות המעצבים את פני הארץ לדורות הבאים.
תיאור
לחברת ייעוץ הנדסי דרוש/ה מנהל/ת פרויקטים ולקוחות בכיר/ה בתחום האנרגיה והמים, לתפקיד מרכזי הכולל הובלת פרויקטים מורכבים וניהול לקוחות.
התפקיד משלב ניהול מגוון הנדסי גדול של פרויקטי ייעוץ הנדסי, הובלת צוותים מקצועיים רב־תחומיים וניהול הקשר עם הלקוחות, משלב גיבוש ההצעה והגדרת תכולת השירותים ועד להשלמת הפרויקט.

job.title: R&D Manager – PhD Quantum Optics & Photonics
job.snippet:
R&D Manager - Quantum Optics & Photonics | Binyamina, Israel | On-site
About the Role
A deep-tech company developing a solid-state quantum microprocessor integrated with photonic circuits is seeking an experienced R&D Manager to lead execution across its multidisciplinary R&D organization.
Reporting directly to the CTO, you will translate the technology roadmap into clear work plans and measurable results, managing team leads and engineers across physics, photonics, electro-optics, fabrication and process, systems engineering, and software.
This is a hands-on technical leadership and people-management role with direct responsibility for priorities, schedules, deliverables and working standards. The CTO owns the technological vision, roadmap, architecture an…
Required Qualifications
*
PhD in Physics, Quantum Optics, Photonics, Electrical Engineering
or a closely related field - mandatory.
* 5+ years of industry experience developing advanced quantum, photonic, electro-optical or semiconductor technologies.
* 3+ years of management experience leading multidisciplinary R&D or engineering teams, with direct responsibility for schedules and deliverables.
* Deep expertise in one or more of the following domains:
- Quantum optics and quantum information science.
- Quantum photonics and integrated photonics.
- Semiconductor nanophotonics and solid-state quantum systems, such as diamond color centers.
- Quantum communication and quantum sensing.
* Hands-on experience with advanced optical and electro-optical systems, experimental design, system integration, validation and performance optimization.
* Experience working with semiconductor foundries, photonic fabrication processes and device development.
* A proven record of delivering complex hardware programs on time and to specification, with strong planning, risk management, progress tracking and task-management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, strong documentation skills and fluent English. Hebrew is an advantage.
* Ability to work closely with a CTO, execute an agreed technical direction and communicate risks, concerns and progress transparently.
* Postdoctoral research in quantum optics, quantum information science or quantum photonics.
* R&D leadership experience in a deep-tech, quantum, semiconductor or photonics startup, including scaling from a core group to multiple teams.
* Familiarity with Python, MATLAB, COMSOL, Lumerical or RSoft.
* Experience with configuration management, test and qualification plans, and lab/fab safety and quality practices.
* Publications and patents.

Electrical Department Superintendent
Nephi City is seeking a qualified and experienced leader to direct its municipal electric utility, ensuring safe, reliable, and cost-effective power delivery for the community.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
High school diploma or equivalent.
Completion of a recognized Journeyman Lineman apprenticeship, or equivalent electric utility certification.
At least 6 years of progressively responsible electric utility construction, operation and maintenance experience, including at least 3 years in a supervisory or lead role.
Any equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Experience with overhead and underground distribution systems and with operating bucket trucks, and line trucks.
Valid Utah driver's license and a valid Commercial Driver License (CDL), or ability to obtain a CDL within six months of hire.
Current or obtainable First Aid/CPR and utility safety certifications.
Ability to climb poles, work from aerial devices, work safely around energized equipment and respond to emergencies after hours.
Ability to pass a background check, pre-employment drug screening and driving record review.
Strong knowledge of electric utility construction, operation and maintenance practices.
Ability to read engineering plans, schematics, maps and specifications.
Clear, professional communication with crews, customers, officials and contractors.
Sound judgment and steady leadership, especially in emergencies. Preferred Qualifications
Experience as a lead lineman, foreman, crew leader or utility supervisor.
Associate or bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering technology, utility management, business or a related field.
Municipal or public power experience, including UMPA or other joint action agency membership.
Knowledge of substations, SCADA, AMI, protective relaying, metering and distribution automation.
Experience with budgeting, rate analysis and capital project management.
Working knowledge of GIS, Blue beam software, outage management, and work order software.

job.title: Digital Projects & Assets Manager-5708
job.snippet:
We’re looking for a Digital Projects & Assets Manager to join a growing digital department.
In this role, you’ll lead complex projects across the company’s websites and apps. Your goal is to improve customer journeys and build digital experiences that drive engagement, conversion and sales. You’ll work closely with development teams, UX/UI designers and external vendors, and use data to decide what to build next.
What you’ll do:
Lead digital projects, developments and releases across websites and apps
Plan and improve customer journeys and user experience to increase retention and sales
Analyze performance and conversion funnels using data
Build product pages and sales flows, and manage site content
Manage SEO, analytics and AI vendors, and put their recommendations into action
What we’re looking for:
At least 3 years of experience managing complex digital projects
Strong understanding of customer journeys and user behavior
Hands-on experience with Google Analytics and data analysis (must)
Experience writing business requirements for development teams and working with CMS platforms
Strong analytical and technical skills, and the ability to drive work across multiple stakeholders
Experience with Umbraco is a significant advantage

job.title: Specialist Project Planning & Scheduling
job.snippet:
Discover your exciting role
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company’s long history and keep on leading the way to a better world.
Explore Your Tasks And Responsibilities

job.title: Director of Demand Generation
job.snippet:
Director of Demand Generation | Cybersecurity
Fortis Search is working with a venture-backed cybersecurity startup hiring a Director of Demand Generation to build its US demand engine.
You’ll own the budget, channel strategy and campaigns, with direct responsibility for generating qualified sales meetings and pipeline. There’s investment behind the growth plan and support across marketing and sales to help you deliver it.
We’re looking for someone who has built programmes themselves and can explain the numbers behind their decisions.
The role
Own targets for meetings booked, meetings held and the qualified opportunities they generate.
Track cost per meeting by channel and use the results to decide where to increase, reduce or stop spending.
Build targeted campaigns across paid media, ABM, webinars and events.
Work closely with sales and BDRs on account selection, outreach and follow-up.
Turn account intent and buying signals into measurable meetings and opportunities.
Own demand reporting in HubSpot, including conversion, attribution and campaign performance.
Develop creative campaigns that get enterprise security buyers’ attention and give them a reason to engage.
What we’re looking for
6+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation or performance marketing, including at least two years directly accountable for a meetings or pipeline target.
Experience building demand generation within an early-stage company or lean marketing team.
Clear evidence of personal ownership: the targets you carried, meetings delivered, channel costs and resulting pipeline.
Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager and ABM or intent tools.
An example of a distinctive campaign you conceived and delivered, including the commercial results.
Confidence testing new approaches, stopping underperforming campaigns and reallocating budget.
Strong writing skills and practical use of AI in your daily work.
Cybersecurity experience would be an advantage.
Interested?
Contact Michael Linskey at Fortis Search. Alongside your CV, share a brief example of a campaign you owned—who you targeted, what you spent and what it delivered.
Fortis Search recruits GTM talent for venture-backed cybersecurity companies across the US.

job.title: Senior Software & AI Engineer
job.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Rehovot,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to build the calibration systems software for advanced electron microscope columns.
The rol
e
You will own the architecture, design, and implementation of software that combines scientific computing, image processing, and distributed systems to enable fully automated calibration workflows - working at the intersection of software engineering, physics, and real laboratory hardware, under stringent performance requirements. The team is part of the R&D department
behind a major new product, developing the next generation of software and algorithm solutions that will power Applied Materials' metrology and inspection systems.
What you'll be doing:
Stay deeply hands-on while owning project-level architecture for complex, stateful calibration workflows.
Build end-to-end, full-stack services - from concurrent, iterative hardware control loops up to the operator-facing UI.
Own algorithms end to end - research, design, implement, validate, document, optimize - across numerical methods, computer vision (registration, pattern matching, tracking), and performance-critical real-time image processing.
Apply data science methods to real measurement data: design experiments, analyze results, quantify system performance with sound metrics.
Build and evolve the AI-specific infrastructure of our physics-informed SDLC harness-agents, tools, context and evaluation pipelines.
Develop hardware simulation and monitoring tools that support the team algorithm development and automated testing.
Work closely with physicists to validate and refine calibration workflows and algorithms, and with Product, Design, and other R&D teams to ship them.
What you should have:
5+ years of professional software development
2+ years of R&D experience (algorithms / ML), including end-to-end ownership of meaningful features and projects.
Deep concurrency expertise: designing concurrent execution models, parallelism, and multi-threaded dispatchers - and reasoning about their failure modes, tradeoffs, and performance under load.
Strong system design: microservices and distributed systems, API design, message queues or event streaming (delivery semantics, ordering, failure handling).
Numerical algorithms and optimization, image processing fundamentals, and familiarity with hardware control or instrumentation software.
AI engineering: hands-on experience building with LLMs and agents - prompt and context engineering, tool calling, retrieval, evaluation - and a genuine drive to stay current.
Solid engineering practices: e2e, regression, and automated testing, code review, CI/CD, virtualization (Docker).
A product mindset - you understand customer needs and business impact.
B.Sc. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. Preferred backgrounds: computational physics, applied mathematics, image processing, optics, microscopy, signal processing, numerical analysis.
Nice to have:
M.Sc. in CS, Software Engineering, EE, or a related field.
A proven track record of excellence - academic, military, or professional honors, awards, or recognition for outstanding achievements.
Electron microscopy or semiconductor equipment.
Experience with advanced performance profiling and optimization.
Experience with advanced concurrency models in another backend language (C++, Java, Kotlin, Go, Rust).
Who we are:
Applied Materials Israel is home to the Process Diagnostics and Control business unit (PDC).
Based in Rehovot, we develop, manufacture, and market cutting-edge machine learning and computer vision-based metrology and inspection products that are essential elements in wafer fabrication. By playing a significant role in enabling the production of the next generation of microchips, our expertise enables our customers to transform possibilities into reality.
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
No
Relocation Eligible:
No
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

job.title: Trading System Specialist
job.snippet:
About etoro:
etoro is the platform where you can trade, invest, save, and spend. Founded in 2007 with the vision of a world where everyone can trade and invest in a simple and transparent way, we've built a regulated, Nasdaq-listed platform used by millions of people in 75 countries.
We believe there is power in shared knowledge. By combining the collective intelligence of our community with AI-powered tools, we've created a collaborative investment community designed to help you grow your knowledge and wealth.
On etoro, you can hold a range of traditional and innovative assets and choose how you invest: trade directly, invest in a portfolio, copy other investors, or invest with an AI agent. Visit our Media Centre for the latest news.
You can find out more about eToro here.
eToro | Global Markets & 24/7 Operations
Financial markets never stop moving, and neither do the systems that power trading at eToro. Our Trading Systems team sits at the center of live market activity, supporting trading across global markets, multiple asset classes, execution venues, and both traditional finance (TradFi) and decentralized finance (DeFi) workflows.
We are looking for a Trading System Specialist to join our 24/7 operations team. This is a hands-on role combining trading, markets, technology, AI, and real-time operations. You will follow market conditions and risk, support and execute trading activity within defined procedures, investigate incidents, and help keep our trading operation running smoothly around the clock.
AI is central to how we want the team to work. We are looking for someone who is curious, agile, and comfortable using AI agents, skills, automation, and AI-assisted development to solve problems and build better workflows. You do not need to be a programmer or an experienced trader, but you should be eager to learn markets and technology quickly and turn ideas into practical solutions.
What You'll Do
Monitor and manage real-time trading and production systems across global financial markets, including stocks, FX, commodities, futures, and cryptocurrencies.
Monitor market conditions, pricing, liquidity, trading activity, positions, and risk exposures.
Execute manual trades, adjust hedging parameters within defined bounds, and support trading operations across multiple asset classes and execution venues.
Monitor and support TradFi and DeFi trading workflows, including execution, liquidity, hedging, transaction flows, and settlement across relevant venues and systems.
Make operational adjustments to trading configurations in accordance with established procedures and risk limits.
Investigate trading failures, system alerts, and operational incidents, assess their impact, escalate when necessary, and follow incidents through to resolution.
Maintain operational discipline during live shifts, ensure timely follow-up on outstanding issues, and provide clear handovers to the next shift.
Use AI tools, agents, and automation to investigate problems, analyze data, develop solutions, and improve daily operations.
Build and enhance internal tools, dashboards, integrations, and workflows using AI-assisted development and automation platforms.
Work closely with global teams, including Trading, Risk, Technology, Product, and Operations.
Identify opportunities to improve monitoring, operational efficiency, and system reliability.
Support the continuous expansion of our 24/7 production monitoring capabilities.
Please note: this is a 24/7 shift position that includes nights, weekends, and holidays
Requirements
AI-first mindset: Genuine enthusiasm for AI and a practical understanding of how to use modern AI tools beyond basic chat, including AI agents, skills, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development.
Interest in financial markets: Strong curiosity about capital markets, trading, and financial instruments, from traditional markets to crypto and DeFi. Eagerness to understand how global markets operate and develop practical trading knowledge.
Technical curiosity and resourcefulness: Comfortable exploring new technologies, working with data and systems, and finding creative ways to solve unfamiliar challenges. A software development background is not required.
Agility and fast learning: Ability to quickly adapt, independently learn new tools and concepts, and apply them to real-world challenges.
Strong problem-solving skills: Analytical thinking, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to investigate issues independently while recognizing when to escalate.
Ownership and accountability: A proactive approach, willingness to take responsibility for assigned actions, follow issues through to resolution, and maintain high standards in a live operational environment.
Teamwork and communication: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and cross-functional teams around the world.
Excellent English: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
24/7 shift availability: Willingness to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Data and spreadsheet fluency: Comfortable using Excel or similar tools to investigate, validate, and communicate data in day-to-day operations.
Operational organization and attention to detail: Able to prioritize multiple live issues, keep accurate records, and provide clear, actionable handovers.
Nice to Have
Trading experience: Professional trading experience, experience in a dealing room or financial institution, or active personal trading in financial markets.
Hands-on experience with AI-powered development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or similar platforms.
Experience creating AI agents, custom skills, automated workflows, or integrations between applications and services.
Familiarity with APIs, SQL, Python, scripting, or data analysis tools.
Financial data, BI, or production monitoring exposure: Experience working with raw market or trading data, BI tools, dashboards, monitoring/observability platforms, real-time production systems, or incident management.
Relevant education or practical background: Finance, economics, computer science, information systems, or another relevant field. A specific degree is not required.
Knowledge of financial instruments, trading platforms, pricing, liquidity, hedging, or risk management.
TradFi, crypto, or DeFi exposure: Familiarity with centralized trading venues, crypto markets, decentralized protocols, on-chain transactions, wallets, or settlement processes.
Our Hiring Philosophy:
At etoro, AI is changing how we build, work and make decisions, and our hiring approach reflects that. We are building an
AI-first organisation
where people are encouraged to use AI thoughtfully.
That starts with
how we hire
. Throughout our recruitment process, we may use AI-enabled tools, including interview notetakers and other technologies that help us capture information accurately, improve consistency and create a better experience for candidates and interviewers. These tools support our feedback and assessment outcomes. Hiring decisions remain grounded in running fair and consistent interview processes, human judgement, critical thinking, and thorough evaluation of experience, ability and motivation that are aligned to our business and role requirements.
We also want candidates to be
comfortable working with AI
. Depending on the role, we may explore how you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, how you think about their opportunities and limitations, and how you would contribute to etoro’s continued AI build-out.
For us, being AI-first is not about replacing human judgement. It is about combining human expertise, creativity and accountability with technology that helps us do our best work and accelerate our growth. In the end, that's what we're hiring for:
human insight, supercharged by AI
.

job.title: Senior Manager, Arab Market Business Lead – Israel
job.snippet:
About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything, in over 500 cities in over 30 countries. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash, and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. If you're a self-starter with drive and an entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
About The Role
Israel is one of Wolt's most established markets. Arab-Israeli communities, roughly a fifth of the population, are also one of its largest growth opportunities. We have launched in a growing number of Arab towns and cities and seen strong early traction. Our ambition is much bigger: a leading, scaled business in this market, winning consumers, merchants, and couriers in every region where Arab communities live.
The Senior Manager, Arab Market Business Lead, takes full ownership of Wolt Israel's business in the Arab market, with end-to-end accountability for strategy, growth, and results across consumers, merchants, and couriers. You will lead the existing Arab market team and serve as the link between Wolt Israel's management and this market, translating what works at Wolt in Israel into what works for Arab-Israeli customers, merchants, and couriers.
You will report to the Director of Market Growth, Wolt Israel.
What You’ll Be Doing
Business Ownership and Strategy
Own the Arab market business plan and its results: users, orders, frequency, merchants, and the economics behind them.
Define the strategy: which regions, segments, and categories to prioritize, in what order, and what it takes to win in each. Translate it into clear priorities for each function.
Evaluate performance continuously and adjust based on data, the competitive landscape, and growth potential.
Run a regular operating cadence (weekly performance review, forecasts, OKRs) and hold teams accountable for delivery.
Bring results, risks, and opportunities to Israel leadership, in a form that works for people who don't know the local market.
Team Leadership
Lead the Arab market team: set expectations, build accountability, develop talent, and add capacity as the business scales.
You will lead the sales and account manager teams serving the Arab market, setting commercial priorities, driving performance, and developing the team.
Consumers
Raise penetration, frequency, and retention, and compete directly for share against strong local players.
Merchants
Lead acquisition and growth of local restaurants, retailers, and small and medium businesses. Build the commercial offer, onboarding, and ongoing account management that make a small business choose Wolt and grow with us.
Open the door to larger chain and enterprise partnerships.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Work as a peer with Merchant, Marketing, Operations, Supply, Product, Analytics, Finance, and Legal, and align them behind one plan for the market.
Work closely with Marketing. You are not the marketing manager, but you set the priorities and direction so that campaigns, messaging, and local community presence turn into measurable growth.
Adapt Wolt's Israel playbook to the needs, habits, and expectations of Arab-Israeli customers. Where the playbook doesn't exist, create it.
Market and Network
Know the market in depth: the differences between communities and regions in the North, the Triangle, Jerusalem, the Negev, and mixed cities.
Build and maintain a strong network of community, municipal, business, and civic leaders.
Our Humble Expectations
15+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years of people leadership.
Fluent Hebrew, Arabic, and strong professional English, with the ability to translate local context for a global audience.

Work closely with Marketing. You are not the marketing manager, but you set the priorities and direction so that campaigns, messaging, and local community presence turn into measurable growth.

job.title: Solution Architect (Tiger Team) (f/m/d)
job.snippet:
A Snapshot of Your Day:
The scope will be centered around turning business needs into scalable, practical technology solutions. working closely with
customers and stakeholders to understand their challenges, clarify functional requirements, and translate them into clear technical
architecture and solution designs. collaborate with development teams, provide technical direction, define standards,
and ensure solutions follow the right governance, security, and scalability principles. evaluating where AI and emerging technologies
can create real value, identify relevant use cases and assess their technical and business viability.
The ideal candidate will enjoy working in a diverse team, with excellent communication skills and a genuine passion for teamwork.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Turn customer needs into effective solutions: Partner closely with customers to understand business challenges and translate requirements into practical, scalable solutions using modern technologies.
AI solution experience: Production architecture for machine learning and generative AI solutions, including retrieval-augmented generation, multimodal applications, AI agents, prompt and context engineering, model routing, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Shape scalable system architectures: Design robust architectures using approaches such as microservices, serverless, and proven design patterns to support business growth, flexibility, and long-term maintainability.
Accelerate delivery through Agile ways of working: Enable iterative development, continuous feedback, and ongoing improvement to help teams deliver valuable features faster and with greater predictability.
Create alignment across engineering teams: Bring development, QA, operations, and other stakeholders together around a common technical direction, ensuring smooth integration and effective execution.
Bridge business and technology: Translate strategic business objectives into clear technical requirements and engineering tasks while helping stakeholders understand technical constraints, dependencies, and opportunities.
Drive technical excellence and governance: Define and promote architecture standards, engineering principles, and best practices while ensuring solutions meet relevant regulatory and compliance requirements such as GDPR and SOC 2.
Deliver high-performing and resilient systems: Define and manage targets for availability, latency, scalability, and observability to ensure solutions consistently meet business and customer expectations.
Guide critical technology decisions: Evaluate architectural alternatives and build-versus-buy decisions by balancing scalability, maintainability, time-to-market, technical debt, and long-term business value.
Build reliability into every solution: Design systems with monitoring, alerting, and observability at their core, using technologies such as Prometheus and Grafana to proactively identify and address issues.
Optimize technology investments: Apply FinOps principles to forecast and manage cloud costs across AWS, Azure, or GCP, designing solutions that balance technical performance with cost efficiency.
What You Bring:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
7+ years of industry experience as a Solution Architect or in a similar role.
Strong understanding of system design principles and methodologies.
Knowledge of applied AI technologies and their implementation (e.g. agentic solutions & physical AI).
Experience with Agile methodologies and a collaborative approach to development.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Skills:
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools.
About The Team
In the central Digital Products and Solutions (DPS) organization, our Technology and Innovation department is responsible to implement new and innovative technologies across DPS but also to Siemens Energy.
In DPS, our software products already cover a wide range of categories, and we see many opportunities for growth: Asset Performance Management, Energy Management, Asset Monitoring, Asset Health Prediction, Customer Portal & AI-assisted Applications, Connectivity & Edge, Backend Core / Domain / Platform Services, and Professional Services.
ho is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than
90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community
is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy
transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of
what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus
on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities.
Siemens Energy celebrates character no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
Jobs & Careers: https://jobs.siemens-energy.com

job.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day:
The scope will be centered around turning business needs into scalable, practical technology solutions. working closely with
customers and stakeholders to understand their challenges, clarify functional requirements, and translate them into clear technical
architecture and solution designs. collaborate with development teams, provide technical direction, define standards,
and ensure solutions follow the right governance, security, and scalability principles. evaluating where AI and emerging technologies
can create real value, identify relevant use cases and assess their technical and business viability.
The ideal candidate will enjoy working in a diverse team, with excellent communication skills and a genuine passion for teamwork.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Turn customer needs into effective solutions: Partner closely with customers to understand business challenges and translate requirements into practical, scalable solutions using modern technologies.
AI solution experience: Production architecture for machine learning and generative AI solutions, including retrieval-augmented generation, multimodal applications, AI agents, prompt and context engineering, model routing, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Shape scalable system architectures: Design robust architectures using approaches such as microservices, serverless, and proven design patterns to support business growth, flexibility, and long-term maintainability.
Accelerate delivery through Agile ways of working: Enable iterative development, continuous feedback, and ongoing improvement to help teams deliver valuable features faster and with greater predictability.
Create alignment across engineering teams: Bring development, QA, operations, and other stakeholders together around a common technical direction, ensuring smooth integration and effective execution.
Bridge business and technology: Translate strategic business objectives into clear technical requirements and engineering tasks while helping stakeholders understand technical constraints, dependencies, and opportunities.
Drive technical excellence and governance: Define and promote architecture standards, engineering principles, and best practices while ensuring solutions meet relevant regulatory and compliance requirements such as GDPR and SOC 2.
Deliver high-performing and resilient systems: Define and manage targets for availability, latency, scalability, and observability to ensure solutions consistently meet business and customer expectations.
Guide critical technology decisions: Evaluate architectural alternatives and build-versus-buy decisions by balancing scalability, maintainability, time-to-market, technical debt, and long-term business value.
Build reliability into every solution: Design systems with monitoring, alerting, and observability at their core, using technologies such as Prometheus and Grafana to proactively identify and address issues.
Optimize technology investments: Apply FinOps principles to forecast and manage cloud costs across AWS, Azure, or GCP, designing solutions that balance technical performance with cost efficiency.
What You Bring:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
7+ years of industry experience as a Solution Architect or in a similar role.
Strong understanding of system design principles and methodologies.
Knowledge of applied AI technologies and their implementation (e.g. agentic solutions & physical AI).
Experience with Agile methodologies and a collaborative approach to development.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Skills:
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools.
About The Team
In the central Digital Products and Solutions (DPS) organization, our Technology and Innovation department is responsible to implement new and innovative technologies across DPS but also to Siemens Energy.
In DPS, our software products already cover a wide range of categories, and we see many opportunities for growth: Asset Performance Management, Energy Management, Asset Monitoring, Asset Health Prediction, Customer Portal & AI-assisted Applications, Connectivity & Edge, Backend Core / Domain / Platform Services, and Professional Services.
ho is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than
90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community
is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy
transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of
what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus
on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

job.title: Project Manager - HMO
job.snippet:
Project Manager – HMO Mental Health Initiative
About the Role
This HMO is establishing a strategic partnership aimed at developing and implementing solutions that can create meaningful, system-level impact in mental health.
We are looking for an experienced, execution-oriented Project Manager to take full responsibility for the day-to-day management and execution of this complex, multi-stakeholder initiative.
The PM will be responsible for turning decisions into action — building and managing the project plan, coordinating all relevant stakeholders, managing dependencies and timelines, removing barriers, and ensuring continuous progress from planning through implementation.
Key Responsibilities
End-to-End Delivery: Drive the detailed project plan, milestones, risks, and governance across all workstreams to ensure continuous progress.
Stakeholder & Partner Management: Serve as the central operational focal point, aligning internal teams (clinical, data, tech, legal) and external partners.
Streamline integration and data-access processes for health-tech startups to build a frictionless onboarding pathway within the HMO.
Execution & Scaling: Lead operational execution from solution design and first-move experiments to scaling verified solutions.
Governance & Reporting: Manage committees, progress reviews, action-item tracking, and management reporting.
Requirements
5+ years of PM experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder technology projects, preferably in healthcare, digital health, or regulated sectors.
Proven hands-on track record in data integration, tech adoption, or startup pilots.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills with proven ability to lead and influence without direct authority.
Experience facilitating structured processes and steering committees.
Product management experience.
Excellent written and verbal communication in Hebrew and English.
Advantages: Background in healthcare/mental health systems or clinical background.
The Profile We Are Looking For
A highly organized, proactive and hands-on operator with a strong sense of ownership. Someone who can take a complex initiative with multiple organizations, stakeholders and dependencies and make sure it moves forward, creating structure, driving decisions into action, following up relentlessly and ensuring delivery.
Please note:
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, ethnicity, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, marital status, partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

job.title: סמנכ״ל/ית וראש/ת המטה
job.snippet:
ישראליז מעצבת מחדש את התפיסה של הדור הצעיר בעולם על ישראל דרך מפגש עם הצעירים הישראלים. אנחנו מכשירים מאות אלפי צעירים ישראלים היוצאים לעולם ככוח פעולה של שגרירים המייצרים מיליוני מפגשים אישיים משני תפיסה עם בני גילם.
אנחנו ארגון בצמיחה מטאורית ומחפשים מוביל/ה אסטרטגי/ת, ביצועיסט/ית בעל/ת רעב להצלחה, לבניית התשתית והסטנדרט לעבודה נכונה בארגון. התשתית כוללת אנשים, שיטות עבודה, תכנון ובקרה, ומטרתה שישראליז תפעל באופן היעיל, האיכותי, האימפקטיבי והתקין ביותר.
תיאור התפקיד

job.title: System Engineer
job.snippet:
We are looking for
At Elbit Systems’ Netanya site, C4I and Cyber is looking for a System Engineer – Networks & Communication Systems to join our Engineering Group. In this role, you will take part in the development of advanced communication and networking systems that support mission-critical operational capabilities in Israel and worldwide. If complex multidisciplinary systems, hands-on engineering, and direct impact on cutting-edge defense technologies drive you, this is your opportunity to be part of a highly professional team working on large-scale technological programs.
In this role you will
Perform system engineering activities for complex networked communication systems and applications
Analyze operational and technical requirements and translate them into system-level specifications and solutions
Lead multidisciplinary engineering activities in a matrix environment, coordinating engineering, integration, and testing teams
Support system design and implementation throughout the full project lifecycle, from requirements definition through integration, testing, delivery, and ongoing support
Lead and participate in hands-on integration, troubleshooting, and technical problem-solving activities
Work directly with technical customer representatives in Israel and abroad
Coordinate technical activities with subcontractors and suppliers, including design, implementation, integration, and testing
Maintain a broad system-level perspective while addressing detailed technical and integration challenges
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Communication Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline
At least two years of experience in system engineering, communication systems, data networks, software-intensive systems, or multidisciplinary system development
Experience working with multidisciplinary engineering teams to design, integrate, and validate complex systems - Advantage
Knowledge of IP networking, network architecture, and routing protocols - Advantage
Experience with system integration, laboratory testing, field testing, or technical troubleshooting - Advantage
Background in military or tactical communication systems, including data networks, radios, or C4I systems - Advantage
Strong analytical thinking, technical problem-solving skills, and ability to lead cross-functional activities in a dynamic environment
Strong written and verbal communication skills in Hebrew and English
Occasional travel abroad as part of the role
*Only relevant applications will be answered
#Netanya

job.title: Staff Technical Applications Engineer - Power and Signal Integrity
job.snippet:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent years working in the space where simulation meets real silicon, and you know that power integrity and signal integrity problems do not announce themselves politely. They hide in corner cases, emerge under load, and cost months if caught late. You are the kind of engineer who can look at a customer's design flow, spot the gap, and build a workflow that actually fits how they work, not how a textbook says they should work.
You do not just run tools. You understand what the results mean, why a voltage drop matters at this node but not that one, why electromigration shows up in one block and not another. When a customer says "this does not look right," you know how to debug it, whether the issue is in the netlist, the model, or the analysis setup itself.
Working directly with customers energizes you. You like the problem-solving, the teaching, the moment when an engineering team finally sees why the analysis matters. You are comfortable traveling to customer sites, sitting in their labs, and working through real designs under real pressure. At Synopsys, you will work with semiconductor teams building the next generation of AI, HPC, and mobile chips, and what you help them solve will make it to production.
What You'll Be Doing
Lead technical engagements with semiconductor customers across Israel, including onsite meetings, product demonstrations, workflow evaluations, and solution deployments that directly support active sales opportunities
Analyze customer design environments and engineering workflows to identify gaps, bottlenecks, and opportunities where RedHawk-SC platform can streamline power integrity and signal integrity analysis
Build and demonstrate custom simulation workflows using RedHawk-SC that solve real customer problems, not generic use cases, tailored to IC design, 3DIC integration, and high-speed digital systems
Translate customer technical requirements and pain points into actionable product development requests for engineering teams, ensuring field feedback shapes future releases
Deliver hands-on deployment services and training sessions, from introductory overviews to intermediate deep dives, ensuring customers can independently use the tools after you leave
Collaborate with sales, product management, and R&D teams to position the full ANSYS portfolio and contribute to internal initiatives that improve presales effectiveness and technical enablement
The Impact You Will Have
Accelerate design cycles for leading semiconductor companies by delivering simulation workflows that catch signal integrity and power integrity issues before they reach silicon
Drive software revenue growth by turning complex technical evaluations into successful deployments, proving value in real customer environments rather than controlled demos
Shape future Synopsys/ANSYS product capabilities by serving as the voice of the customer, ensuring R&D teams understand what actually matters in Israel's IC design and 3DIC markets
Build long-term technical credibility with engineering teams at major accounts, becoming the trusted resource they call when a tough problem needs solving
Enable customer engineering teams to work faster and with more confidence by teaching them how to use RedHawk-SC effectively, not just correctly
Reduce time-to-market for next-generation chips by helping customers integrate power and signal integrity analysis earlier in their design workflows
Influence how simulation and analysis tools are adopted across the region, setting the standard for technical excellence in customer-facing engineering
What You'll Need
BSEE, MSEE, or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
2+ years of experience in Power Integrity, Signal Integrity, EMIR analysis, package analysis, IC implementation, or semiconductor applications engineering
Strong understanding of power delivery networks, voltage drop analysis, electromigration, package effects, and system-level integrity challenges
Experience with RedHawk-SC or equivalent commercial EDA solutions
Strong scripting skills in Python, Tcl, Perl, or similar languages
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both engineering teams and technical decision-makers
Customer-facing experience in applications engineering, consulting, technical support, or deployment roles is highly desirable, and experience with advanced-node technologies, chip-package co-analysis, 2.5D/3DIC, or AI/HPC designs is a strong plus
Who You Are
You can walk into a customer meeting with incomplete information, ask the right technical questions, and leave with a clear plan that the customer actually believes in
You know how to explain a complex tradeoff between simulation accuracy and runtime to an engineering manager who needs an answer today, not a lecture
You are comfortable switching between deep technical debugging in the morning and a high-level product positioning conversation in the afternoon without losing your thread
You do not wait for perfect data to make a recommendation. You work with what you have, document your assumptions, and move forward
You treat customer feedback as signal, not noise. When a customer says something does not work the way they expected, you dig in to understand why, even if it means challenging internal assumptions
You are organized enough to manage multiple customer engagements at once, keeping track of commitments, follow-ups, and deliverables without dropping threads
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will be part of the Customer Success Group, specifically supporting the applications engineering team focused on delivering technical solutions and driving customer success across Synopsys' ANSYS product portfolio. You will work closely with customers in Israel and collaborate with R&D, product marketing, and sales teams globally to ensure customers achieve their design goals and successful tapeouts.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
