We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent years working in the space where simulation meets real silicon, and you know that power integrity and signal integrity problems do not announce themselves politely. They hide in corner cases, emerge under load, and cost months if caught late. You are the kind of engineer who can look at a customer's design flow, spot the gap, and build a workflow that actually fits how they work, not how a textbook says they should work.
You do not just run tools. You understand what the results mean, why a voltage drop matters at this node but not that one, why electromigration shows up in one block and not another. When a customer says "this does not look right," you know how to debug it, whether the issue is in the netlist, the model, or the analysis setup itself.
Working directly with customers energizes you. You like the problem-solving, the teaching, the moment when an engineering team finally sees why the analysis matters. You are comfortable traveling to customer sites, sitting in their labs, and working through real designs under real pressure. At Synopsys, you will work with semiconductor teams building the next generation of AI, HPC, and mobile chips, and what you help them solve will make it to production.
What You'll Be Doing
Lead technical engagements with semiconductor customers across Israel, including onsite meetings, product demonstrations, workflow evaluations, and solution deployments that directly support active sales opportunities
Analyze customer design environments and engineering workflows to identify gaps, bottlenecks, and opportunities where RedHawk-SC platform can streamline power integrity and signal integrity analysis
Build and demonstrate custom simulation workflows using RedHawk-SC that solve real customer problems, not generic use cases, tailored to IC design, 3DIC integration, and high-speed digital systems
Translate customer technical requirements and pain points into actionable product development requests for engineering teams, ensuring field feedback shapes future releases
Deliver hands-on deployment services and training sessions, from introductory overviews to intermediate deep dives, ensuring customers can independently use the tools after you leave
Collaborate with sales, product management, and R&D teams to position the full ANSYS portfolio and contribute to internal initiatives that improve presales effectiveness and technical enablement
The Impact You Will Have
Accelerate design cycles for leading semiconductor companies by delivering simulation workflows that catch signal integrity and power integrity issues before they reach silicon
Drive software revenue growth by turning complex technical evaluations into successful deployments, proving value in real customer environments rather than controlled demos
Shape future Synopsys/ANSYS product capabilities by serving as the voice of the customer, ensuring R&D teams understand what actually matters in Israel's IC design and 3DIC markets
Build long-term technical credibility with engineering teams at major accounts, becoming the trusted resource they call when a tough problem needs solving
Enable customer engineering teams to work faster and with more confidence by teaching them how to use RedHawk-SC effectively, not just correctly
Reduce time-to-market for next-generation chips by helping customers integrate power and signal integrity analysis earlier in their design workflows
Influence how simulation and analysis tools are adopted across the region, setting the standard for technical excellence in customer-facing engineering
What You'll Need
BSEE, MSEE, or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
2+ years of experience in Power Integrity, Signal Integrity, EMIR analysis, package analysis, IC implementation, or semiconductor applications engineering
Strong understanding of power delivery networks, voltage drop analysis, electromigration, package effects, and system-level integrity challenges
Experience with RedHawk-SC or equivalent commercial EDA solutions
Strong scripting skills in Python, Tcl, Perl, or similar languages
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both engineering teams and technical decision-makers
Customer-facing experience in applications engineering, consulting, technical support, or deployment roles is highly desirable, and experience with advanced-node technologies, chip-package co-analysis, 2.5D/3DIC, or AI/HPC designs is a strong plus
Who You Are
You can walk into a customer meeting with incomplete information, ask the right technical questions, and leave with a clear plan that the customer actually believes in
You know how to explain a complex tradeoff between simulation accuracy and runtime to an engineering manager who needs an answer today, not a lecture
You are comfortable switching between deep technical debugging in the morning and a high-level product positioning conversation in the afternoon without losing your thread
You do not wait for perfect data to make a recommendation. You work with what you have, document your assumptions, and move forward
You treat customer feedback as signal, not noise. When a customer says something does not work the way they expected, you dig in to understand why, even if it means challenging internal assumptions
You are organized enough to manage multiple customer engagements at once, keeping track of commitments, follow-ups, and deliverables without dropping threads
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will be part of the Customer Success Group, specifically supporting the applications engineering team focused on delivering technical solutions and driving customer success across Synopsys' ANSYS product portfolio. You will work closely with customers in Israel and collaborate with R&D, product marketing, and sales teams globally to ensure customers achieve their design goals and successful tapeouts.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

job.title: Reconciliation Infrastructure Associate
job.snippet:
About Payoneer
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
Reconciliation Infrastructure Associate
Hybrid
Full-time
Role Summary
You will join Payoneer's Reconciliation team as a hands-on owner of BlackLine, the system that reconciles around a million transactions a day from hundreds of data sources. You'll handle day-to-day system support, configure new flows as the business evolves, and work closely with our offshore investigation team and our accounting reconciliation team. This is a role for a systems-minded person with a feel for numbers who thrives in a fast-moving environment and wants to grow at the intersection of finance and technology.
What You'll Do
Own daily BlackLine support: handle tickets, troubleshoot issues and keep reconciliations flowing
Configure and maintain the system to support new flows, products and a fast-changing business
Support our offshore investigation team when data or processes in the system break or go missing
Review system outputs with the accounting reconciliation team, including journal entries
Take part in month, quarter and year-end close activities
Translate business needs into system solutions and lead process improvements and automation
Analyze anomalies, raise red flags and escalate issues when needed
Who You Are
A. in Economics or a related field
2-4 years of experience, beyond a first role
Hands-on experience working with business systems (e.g., ERP, operational or reconciliation systems)
A strong grasp of numbers and a basic understanding of accounting
Fluent English, spoken and written, for daily work with international teams
Able to manage several tasks at once and meet tight deadlines, especially during closing periods
Flexible, resilient under pressure and eager to learn in a dynamic environment
Experience with BlackLine or other reconciliation systems is a strong advantage
Involvement in a system implementation or go-live project is an advantage
The Payoneer Ways of Working
Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.
Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.
Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last.
Build Each Other Up
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

ניהול ופיקוח על כלל קבלני הביצוע/ ספקי השרות העובדים במרחב.

job.title: Integrated Logistic Support- ILS
job.snippet:
חברת רפאל מגייסת מנהל.ת ILS לשלוחה שלה בצפון.
תפקיד מאתגר ומגוון בסביבה טכנולוגית-עסקית מובילה ודינאמית!
קצת על התפקיד:
הובלת תחום ה-ILS (תמיכה כוללת במוצר) בפרויקטים טכנולוגיים מורכבים, כולל ליווי מקצועי של קמפיינים בינ"ל - משלב הקונספט הראשוני, דרך שלבי הפיתוח וההטמעה, ועד למסירה מלאה ללקוח.
אחריות על תכנון, תמחור והגשת הצעות לחבילות של תמיכה לוגיסטית משולבת ותחזוקה רב-שנתית, כחלק מתכולות הפרויקט, בהתאם לדרישות לקוחות בארץ ובחו"ל.
גיבוש והובלת תכנית תמיכה כוללת מהיבטי תפעול, אחזקה וניהול באספקטים הבאים: מדיניות אחזקה, תשתיות, ציוד בדיקה, ציוד תפעול תחזוקה, אריזה, הובלה ושינוע, כוח אדם והדרכה, ספרות טכנית, אספקת חלפים ועוד.
אפיון, ניהול והובלה מקצועית של הצעות מחיר לתמיכה ותחזוקה רב-שנתית הוליסטיות למערכות הלקוח, משלב הייזום ועד להזמנה מהלקוח.
ביצוע ניתוחים לוגיסטיים, כגון: ניתוחי אחזקתיות ותחזוקתיות, זמינות מערכתית, אופטימיזציית חלקי חילוף, ניתוח עלות מחזור חיים.

job.title: Field Operations Specialist - Drone Systems
job.snippet:
Kela is a defense technology startup pioneering next-generation defense technology, from command & control software to complete field-deployed systems. We empower defense organizations with robust, scalable, and secure platforms that integrate diverse sensors and AI to deliver real-time battlefield intelligence. Backed by leading investors, Kela combines Israeli innovation with global mission impact.
We move faster than any defense startup you've worked at, and faster than most commercial ones. Prototypes go from sketch to metal in weeks, not quarters. If that pace sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.
Requirements:
We are looking for a hands-on Field Operations Specialist to own the operational preparation, coordination and execution of flight tests, demonstrations and field activities for drone systems.
The role combines office work and fieldwork, with the balance changing according to company needs, including periods of intensive field activity. All activities take place in Israel.
Responsibilities
Prepare operational readiness plans and execute field activities according to agreed plans and priorities.
Coordinate requirements and resources with development teams, engineers, drone operators and external partners.
Ensure activity sites, equipment, vehicles and infrastructure are ready. Track preparation tasks, identify gaps and drive solutions.
Coordinate transport, equipment and supplies with Logistics and Procurement, with purchasing and warehouse management handled by those teams.
Set up, connect, deploy and operate drone systems and supporting equipment, including ground equipment, communications systems, batteries and control equipment.
Perform checks before and after activities according to procedures, pack down equipment and prepare it for further use.
Provide operational and technical support during flight tests and demonstrations. Troubleshoot basic faults and work with engineering and development teams to resolve complex issues.
Create and maintain procedures and checklists. Document activities, faults and operational gaps, capture lessons learned and follow through on improvements and outstanding tasks.
Requirements
2–4 years of relevant experience in field operations, systems operations or a similar technical operations role. Relevant military experience is fully recognized as equivalent to civilian experience.
Strong planning, organization and coordination skills, with the ability to manage tasks across multiple teams.
Technical aptitude and hands-on experience setting up and operating equipment, performing checks and troubleshooting basic faults.
Independence, initiative and personal ownership, with the ability to drive tasks through to completion.
Strong attention to detail, adaptability and resourcefulness when solving problems in the field.
Good interpersonal skills, a collaborative approach and a willingness to learn and develop.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Good English proficiency.
A valid driving license.
Willingness to perform hands-on fieldwork throughout Israel, including intensive periods and variable working hours.
Advantages
Experience flying drones or operating UAV/UAS systems.
A relevant drone pilot license or certification.
Experience preparing for and supporting flight tests.
Experience in the technology or defense industry, or military experience operating technical systems or coordinating field operations.
Familiarity with command and control systems, communications systems and ground equipment.
A degree in Industrial Engineering and Management, Engineering or a related field.

job.title: Senior System Engineer (520366)
job.snippet:
Company Description
Spear, founded in 2017 and based in Tel Aviv, develops and manufactures the Viper family of advanced Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) for leading defence forces.
As the leading system house in Israel for tactical UAS focusing both on the battalion echelon and submarines, we provide end-to-end system development from concept and design through integration and field testing - delivering AI-powered loitering systems that give any combat unit an “inherent air force” with minimal training.
Our multidisciplinary teams work across hardware, software, computer vision, artificial intelligence, communications, navigation, motion control, and electro-mechanics.
As we continue to grow rapidly, we are looking for talented team players to join our success.
Job Description
We are seeking a
Senior Systems Engineer
for Large-Scale Multidisciplinary Project in the Defence Industry with a strong multidisciplinary background across software, AI, data, sensors, hardware, and mechanical domains, to drive the end-to-end system definition and delivery of a complex, large-scale system of systems, in the defence industry, and in a mission-critical environment.
The senior system engineer will be responsible for defining, specifying, and leading the system architecture, design and interfaces of an advanced armed UAV system, integrating hardware, software, mechanics, control algorithms, mission management capabilities, and payload subsystems.
The role requires strong multidisciplinary systems-level thinking and understanding expertise and leadership across all engineering domains, from concept stage up to field deployment, ensuring robust performance, and driving alignment between R&D, product, validation, and manufacturing teams.
Key Responsibilities
Own system architecture, design, and performance across the product lifecycle - from concept definition through design, integration, validation, and delivery.
translate product requirements into detailed subsystem specifications (avionics, control, communication, payload, armament, mechanics, etc.) and manage them to ensure full traceability and consistency across all disciplines.
Lead system capability development, balancing mission needs, platform constraints, and technology readiness.
Planning and managing the system interfaces to ensure seamless integration and cross-domain coherence between all the disciplines
Work with product management to derive and translate operational and mission needs into system-level specifications and deliverables.
Support development teams throughout design, integration, and verification phases.
Lead system-level integration, ground tests (in the laboratory and in the field), flight tests, and real-world validation.
Support NPI (New Product Introduction) and manufacturing readiness, ensuring design maturity and manufacturability.
Lead and execute system qualification.
Conduct system performance analysis, troubleshoot system-level issues, and propose design improvements as part of CIP (Continuous Improvement Process)
Document and communicate system design rationale, trade-offs, and test results to stakeholders across engineering and operations.
Define and manage system and interface documents (SRS, ICD, ATP, test plans, integration procedures, etc.).
Lead technical reviews (SRR, SDR, PDR, CDR, TRR, etc.)
Participate in safety, reliability, and system certification processes.
Interface and ongoing collaboration with subcontractors and business partners.
Requirements
B.Sc. in Electrical, Software, Mechanical, or Aerospace Engineering - Mandatory
M.E. in Systems Engineering - Advantage
5+ years of demonstrated experience as a Systems Engineer leading complex
multidisciplinary systems
Relevant experience in the
defence industry

involving sensors, embedded computing, AI, communications, and command & control (C2) architectures

omplex defence systems

Experience in leading and supporting field tests and flight tests

system engineering methodologies, as well as reliability and safety principles - Advantage

job.title: Systems & Integration Engineer
job.snippet:
Ottopia Defense | Systems & Operations
Ottopia Defense, part of Ondas, develops teleoperation and Hybrid AI technology for ground vehicles in defense applications. The Systems & Operations department turns this technology into integrated systems that can be deployed, supported, and reproduced.
This role will involve turning hardware and software components into working vehicle and operator systems within the systems engineering team. You will own integration, troubleshooting, and verification, with reproducible configurations and clear handover to system QA and delivery.
What you’ll do
Integrate computing, power, communications, sensors, and vehicle interfaces on the bench and in the field.
Translate system requirements and complex integrations into practical setups and designs.
Isolate and detect faults using measurements, logs and configuration evidence, and verify corrective actions.
Execute integration checks with system QA vectors, record results, and conduct performance research with the responsible engineering teams.
Maintain systems and setup documentation, manufacturing and engineering docs. BOM inputs and controlled hardware and software configurations.
Work with the systems team lead, SW R&D, operations and delivery to prepare repeatable builds and handovers.
What you bring
Practical experience integrating and troubleshooting physical systems that combine hardware and software.
Working understanding of electrical interfaces, computing and networks, with depth in a relevant area.
Ability to read technical diagrams and use measurements to test a diagnosis.
Experience documenting configurations, test results, and issues clearly for others to reproduce.
Clear communication in English and effective collaboration across engineering and operational teams.
How you work matters
We value ownership, integrity, and independent learning. Bring ideas, take responsibility and grow through feedback and shared work. Curiosity, sustained achievement and interests beyond work can add perspective; helping the team succeed is central.
Own commitments, follow issues through and raise risks early.
Learn independently, test assumptions and welcome constructive challenge.
Share knowledge, support colleagues and put the shared result first.
Connect your work to the wider system and act responsibly when priorities change.
Set high standards, show sustained achievement and seek broader responsibility.
An advantage
Experience with vehicles, robotics, embedded systems, rugged hardware or field integration. A relevant engineering degree or practical engineering qualification is an advantage.

job.title: Global Accounting Projects Leader
job.snippet:
Context
With over 7,000 employees, $4 Billion USD sales across 100 countries, ADAMA is a leading crop protection company and part of Syngenta Group. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals and strongly believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce is essential for our success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join our team.
We have an exciting career opportunity for a
Global Accounting Projects Leader
to drive key global finance transformation and accounting initiatives.
The role will lead the implementation of a new financial consolidation system and a standardized global monthly closing process as part of ADAMA’s Global Finance Transformation, strengthen the SOX compliance framework, and lead the implementation of new IFRS standards and reporting requirements across the company.
This position reports to ADAMA’s Global Head of Controlling and Accounting and is located in Airport City, Israel.
The successful candidate will combine strong accounting and financial reporting expertise with systems knowledge, SOX experience and proven project leadership capabilities. The role requires a hands-on leader who can lead a team to translate business and accounting requirements into effective, scalable solutions and drive change across our global organization.
Role Summary
Key Accountabilities
Global Finance Transformation & Systems Implementation
Lead the accounting workstream for the implementation of the Group’s new financial consolidation system, representing Global Accounting throughout the project lifecycle.
Define accounting and business requirements and translate them into system design, processes and functional specifications, in close collaboration with IT, external advisors and implementation partners.
Oversee key implementation activities, including process design, data migration, testing, validation, cutover and go-live readiness.
Lead the design and implementation of a standardized global monthly closing process, promoting consistency, efficiency, timeliness and accuracy across ADAMA.
Lead and contribute to additional Global Accounting projects and finance transformation initiatives and support process improvements.
Group SOX Compliance
Lead SOX compliance across the Group, including implementation and management of SOX processes from end-to-end.
Ensure that SOX requirements are appropriately embedded in new systems, processes and finance transformation initiatives.
Implementation of New Accounting Standards
Lead the assessment and implementation of new IFRS standards and amendments relevant to ADAMA.
Skills, Experience, Education
The ideal candidate will have the following set of experiences and skills:
At least 10 years of experience in finance/accounting roles
Proven Experience with the implementation or transformation of financial systems, preferably consolidation platforms
Strong background in complex group consolidation and financial reporting
Strong knowledge and practical experience in SOX compliance and internal controls over financial reporting
Experience with monthly close processes in a global organization – strong advantage
Proven experience in managing or leading complex, cross-functional projects in a global environment
Experience working with external consultants / system implementation partners
Previous managerial experience
Fluent English and Hebrew
Education & Certifications
Bachelor’s degree in accounting
Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
The ideal candidate will have the following attributes
Gets things done and unafraid to take initiative
Excellent communication, collaboration and relationship building skills to drive change and influence stakeholders
Systematic thinker with strong planning and process orientation
Proven ability to manage complex projects, competing priorities and multiple deadlines in a dynamic, high-pressure environment
Works well in a global multi-cultural environment and builds consensus
Very strong attention to detail and accuracy
Proven managerial and leadership capabilities

job.title: Multidisciplinary & Optics Integrator
job.snippet:
Location:
Migdal HaEmek
Job Type:
Full-time (Willingness to work overtime, second shifts, and Fridays as needed; willingness to travel abroad for installations and technical support)
About The Role
Are you a passionate problem-solver ready to take your technical career to the next level? We are looking for a hands-on, driven
Multidisciplinary & Optics Integrator
to join an innovative team at the forefront of the semiconductor industry.
In this dynamic role, you will work with cutting-edge technology, bring complex multidisciplinary systems to life, and execute precision optical calibrations within our dedicated optics laboratory. If you thrive in high-tech settings, enjoy working across mechanics, electronics, and optics, and are comfortable working with diverse calibration software and test equipment, we would love to hear from you!
Company Overview
A global leader in inspection and metrology systems for the semiconductor industry. The company designs, develops, manufactures, and markets technologically advanced systems worldwide, offering a versatile, stable, and highly successful multidisciplinary work environment.
Key Responsibilities
Perform system-level integration of mechanical, optical, and electronic sub-systems.
Work within the optics laboratory performing complex optical calibrations for advanced, high-precision assemblies.
Operate and work flexibly with a wide range of test equipment (ATE / test benches) featuring various types of optics.
Work with diverse calibration software tools and system control interfaces.
Assemble, calibrate, and execute final system-level testing (Final Testing) of complex multidisciplinary machines.
Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve complex system and sub-assembly issues (Troubleshooting).
Requirements
Education: Practical Engineer degree in Electronics / Mechatronics / Mechanics – Mandatory.
Experience: At least 3 years of industry experience working with multidisciplinary systems (Semiconductor, Medical, Defense, etc.) – Mandatory.
Technical Expertise: Hands-on technical experience at the machine and system level.
Optics Background: Hands-on experience with optical calibrations and working in optics laboratories / clean environments – Strong Advantage.
Software Skills: Proficiency and comfort working with diverse calibration software and diagnostic tools.
Languages: Good English communication skills (reading, writing, and speaking).
Flexibility & Availability:
Willingness to work overtime, second shifts, and Fridays as needed.
Willingness to travel abroad for global installations and technical customer support.

job.title: Electronics Practical Engineer- R&D Team
job.snippet:
Electronics Practical Engineer –
R&D Team
Join Redler Technologies’ R&D Team
Redler Technologies is an established technology company specializing in advanced
motion control, smart energy management, and intelligent protection systems
.
We develop and manufacture advanced solutions for motor control, energy management, and smart protection applications for both the
defence and industrial markets
.
We are looking for a
hands-on Electronics Practical Engineer
to join our R&D team in a diverse technical role involving development support, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of advanced electronic systems.
This is a great opportunity to grow professionally while working closely with experienced engineers on challenging, cutting-edge projects.
What You’ll Do
Provide hands-on support to the R&D team throughout development, integration, and testing processes.
Perform hardware testing and troubleshoot electronic boards and systems.
Analyze hardware failures, perform
Root Cause Analysis
, and propose solutions.
Read and interpret electrical drawings and electronic schematics.
Perform measurements and testing using lab equipment, including
oscilloscopes, DMMs, power supplies, spectrum analyzers
, and other measurement tools.
Conduct laboratory and compliance testing of products and systems.
Support
Verification, Qualification, and Validation
activities.
Document test results, failures, findings, and solutions.
Write and update technical documentation, test instructions, and reports.
Collaborate closely with hardware, software, and system engineers.
What We’re Looking For
Practical Engineer diploma in
Electrical/Electronics Engineering – required
. Candidates with a B.Sc. in Electrical/Electronics Engineering will also be considered.
Good understanding of
analog and digital electronics
.
Ability to read and understand electrical drawings and electronic schematics.
Hands-on experience in
hardware troubleshooting – required
.
Experience working with electronic lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, DMMs, power supplies, spectrum analysers, and similar tools.
Good technical English.
The Right Person for This Role
Strong hands-on technical skills and a practical approach to problem-solving.
Independent learning ability and curiosity for new technologies.
Strong analytical skills, systematic thinking, and attention to detail.
Ability to write and maintain clear technical documentation.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Comfortable working in a dynamic and challenging environment.
What We Offer
Hands-on work with
advanced products and technologies
.
A professional, high-quality, and challenging engineering environment.
Close collaboration with a
multidisciplinary R&D team
.
Exposure to diverse development, integration, and testing activities.
A real opportunity to contribute to the development of new products and
grow professionally within R&D
.
This is a
full-time, on-site position
, Sunday–Thursday, at our offices in the
Kfar Saba Industrial Zone, Israel
.
Looking for a hands-on role where you can learn, develop, and work closely with advanced electronic systems? We’d love to hear from you.
📩 Please send your CV to:
iditlp@redlertechnologies.com

Electronics Practical Engineer –
R&D Team
Join Redler Technologies’ R&D Team
Redler Technologies is an established technology company specializing in advanced
motion control, smart energy management, and intelligent protection systems
.
We develop and manufacture advanced solutions for motor control, energy management, and smart protection applications for both the
defence and industrial markets
.
We are looking for a
hands-on Electronics Practical Engineer
to join our R&D team in a diverse technical role involving development support, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of advanced electronic systems.
This is a great opportunity to grow professionally while working closely with experienced engineers on challenging, cutting-edge projects.
What You’ll Do
Provide hands-on support to the R&D team throughout development, integration, and testing processes.
Perform hardware testing and troubleshoot electronic boards and systems.
Analyze hardware failures, perform
Root Cause Analysis
, and propose solutions.
Read and interpret electrical drawings and electronic schematics.
Perform measurements and testing using lab equipment, including
oscilloscopes, DMMs, power supplies, spectrum analyzers
, and other measurement tools.
Conduct laboratory and compliance testing of products and systems.
Support
Verification, Qualification, and Validation
activities.
Document test results, failures, findings, and solutions.
Write and update technical documentation, test instructions, and reports.
Collaborate closely with hardware, software, and system engineers.
What We’re Looking For
Practical Engineer diploma in
Electrical/Electronics Engineering – required
. Candidates with a B.Sc. in Electrical/Electronics Engineering will also be considered.
Good understanding of
analog and digital electronics
.
Ability to read and understand electrical drawings and electronic schematics.
Hands-on experience in
hardware troubleshooting – required
.
Experience working with electronic lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, DMMs, power supplies, spectrum analysers, and similar tools.
Good technical English.
The Right Person for This Role
Strong hands-on technical skills and a practical approach to problem-solving.
Independent learning ability and curiosity for new technologies.
Strong analytical skills, systematic thinking, and attention to detail.
Ability to write and maintain clear technical documentation.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Comfortable working in a dynamic and challenging environment.
What We Offer
Hands-on work with
advanced products and technologies
.
A professional, high-quality, and challenging engineering environment.
Close collaboration with a
multidisciplinary R&D team
.
Exposure to diverse development, integration, and testing activities.
A real opportunity to contribute to the development of new products and
grow professionally within R&D
.
This is a
full-time, on-site position
, Sunday–Thursday, at our offices in the
Kfar Saba Industrial Zone, Israel
.
Looking for a hands-on role where you can learn, develop, and work closely with advanced electronic systems? We’d love to hear from you.
📩 Please send your CV to:
iditlp@redlertechnologies.com

job.title: מהנדס/ת שירות
job.snippet:
מהנדס/ת שירות ותמיכה הנדסית באתרי ייצור
SMARTSHOOTER מגייסת מהנדס/ת שירות ותמיכה הנדסית לתפקיד טכנולוגי המשלב פעילות בישראל ובאתרי ייצור ואינטגרציה בחו"ל.
התפקיד כולל תמיכה הנדסית וטכנית באתרי ייצור ושירות בארץ ובעולם, פתרון תקלות, ליווי תהליכי הרכבה, אינטגרציה ובדיקות, הכנת חומרי הכשרה לצוותים מקומיים והטמעת תהליכי ייצור ושירות ונהלים בהתאם לדרישות החברה.
תחומי אחריות
מתן תמיכה הנדסית וטכנית שוטפת לאתרי ייצור, הרכבה ואינטגרציה של החברה וקבלני משנה.
ליווי הקמה, הטמעה וייצוב של תהליכי ייצור ובדיקות באתרי ייצור חדשים וקיימים כולל תמיכה בתהליכי NPI.
הכנת חומרי הדרכה, הסמכה וליווי מקצועי של צוותי ייצור, טכנאים ואנשי בדיקות מקומיים.
תמיכה בהתקנה, הפעלה, כיול ותחזוקה של ציוד בדיקה ומערכות בדיקה ייעודיות.
תמיכה ביישום שינויים הנדסיים באתרי הייצור.
עבודה שוטפת מול צוותי הפיתוח, הנדסת הייצור, איכות, תפעול וקבלני משנה בישראל ובחו"ל.
מתן תמיכה מרחוק לאתרי הייצור, לצד נסיעות עבודה בהתאם לצרכים התפעוליים.
Requirements:
תואר ראשון הנדסי רלוונטי - חובה
לפחות 5 שנות ניסיון בתפקיד הנדסי או טכני רלוונטי בסביבת ייצור, אינטגרציה, בדיקות או תמיכה במערכות טכנולוגיות.
ניסיון מוכח בעבודה מעשית (Hands-on) עם מערכות אלקטרו־מכניות או מולטידיסציפלינריות.
ניסיון באיתור, אבחון ופתרון תקלות טכניות ברמת מכלול ומערכת כולל יכולת הדרכה והעברת ידע טכני לצוותים שונים.
יכולת קריאה והבנה של שרטוטים מכניים, סכמות חשמליות ותיעוד טכני.
אנגלית ברמה גבוהה מאוד, כולל יכולת ניהול שיח טכני, הדרכה וכתיבת דוחות.
נכונות לנסיעות עבודה תכופות לחו"ל, לרבות שהייה ממושכת בהתאם לצורכי הפרויקטים.
יתרון משמעותי
ניסיון בהקמת קווי ייצור, העברת ידע טכנולוגי (Transfer of Technology – ToT) והכשרת צוותים.
ניסיון בתעשייה הביטחונית ובמערכות העומדות בדרישות צבאיות.
ניסיון בהדרכת טכנאים, מפעילים וצוותי בדיקות.
היכרות עם מערכות ERP ותהליכי ניהול תצורה ושינויים הנדסיים.

job.title: סטודנט\ית תכנון ובקרה
job.snippet:
אנחנו טבע
אנחנו טבע, חברת ביו-פרמצבטית חדשנית ומובילה, המתבססת על מנוע גנרי ברמה עולמית. בין אם מדובר בחדשנות בתחומי מדעי המוח והאימונולוגיה או אספקת תרופות באיכות גבוהה, אנו מחויבים לתת מענה לצרכי המטופלים עכשיו ובעתיד. כאן, תהיו חלק מתרבות מכילה השואפת למצוינות, המעריכה חשיבה רעננה ושיתופי פעולה. יהיה לך מקום לצמוח, את הגמישות לאזן בין הבית לעבודה, ואת ההזדמנות להשפיע על בריאות טובה יותר ברחבי העולם, ביחד.
איך יראה היום שלך
אחריות שוטפת על תכנון העבודה בכלל המערכות התפעוליות במרכז הלוגיסטי.
ניהול הפעילות הלוגיסטית במערכת WMS, כולל יצירת מנגנוני עבודה בגלי ליקוט בשילוב מערכות האוטומציה Knapp ו־WCS.
תכנון ובקרה על זרימת המשטחים, אחסונם ושליפתם, תוך ביצוע אופטימיזציה של המערכת ואיתור תקלות בזמן אמת.
בקרה וניהול תקלות ותלונות, מתן מענה שוטף לגורמים תפעוליים.
בנייה ויישום דוחות BI לשיפור נראות הנתונים ותהליכי קבלת החלטות.
הרצת מגוון דוחות תפעוליים לצורך זיהוי תקלות, מדידת ביצועים ושיפור תפוקות המערך.
הכישורים והניסיון שיש לך
סטודנט/ית להנדסת תעשייה וניהול / לוגיסטיקה / מנהל עסקים – יתרת לימודים של שנתיים לפחות (חובה)
ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות ממוחשבות, בניית דוחות, חדרי בקרה ובקרה לוגיסטית - יתרון משמעותי
אנגלית ברמה טובה - קריאה, כתיבה ודיבור
יכולת עבודה תחת לחץ ובסביבה מרובת ממשקים
נכונות לעבודה במשמרות (בוקר ערב ולילה ) - לפחות 3 משמרות בשבוע
איך אנחנו דואגים לך
בטבע, בריאות טובה יותר מתחילה מבפנים. מהיום הראשון, מקבלים אצלנו תמיכה בהטבות שנועדו לעזור לך לשגשג בעבודה ומעבר לה. זה כולל חופשה שנתית נדיבה, תוכניות תגמול, גמישות, גישה לתמיכה רפואית מותאמת אישית ודרכים משמעותיות לתרום לקהילה.כשזה מגיע לקריירה שלך, יעודדו אותך לחקור, להתפתח ולעצב את הדרך שלך. "טוויסט", הפלטפורמה הפנימית שלנו לפיתוח קריירה, מעניקה לך גישה למגוון רחב של אפשרויות, החל מתוכניות למידה ופרויקטים קצרי טווח ועד להזדמנויות לצמיחה. כאן, לוקחים חלק מתרבות שמעצימה אותך להשיג את היעדים שלך ולתעדף את הרווחה שלך בכל שלב בדרך.
מדווח ל
Mgr SC Sub-Function
עובד/ת טבע?
יש להגיש מועמדות דרך "טוויסט", הפלטפורמה הפנימית שלנו לפיתוח קריירה.
מחוייבות טבע להזדמנות שווה בתעסוקה / بتكافؤ الفرص
טבע תעשיות פרמצבטיות מחויבת למתן הזדמנות תעסוקה שווה לכל. כחלק ממדיניות ההעסקה הגלובלית של החברה, אנו מחויבים לתת הזדמנות שווה מבלי להתייחס לגיל, גזע, דת, אמונה, צבע עור, מגדר, מוגבלויות, הריון, מצב רפואי, נטייה מינית, זהות או צורת ביטוי מגדרית, מוצא, זהות לאומית או אתנית או כל סטאטוס חוקי אחר הזכאי להגנה תחת החוקים החלים עלינו.

job.title: System Architect
job.snippet:
DRS RADA is a global pioneer of RADAR systems for active military protection, counter-drone applications, critical infrastructure protection, and border surveillance. Join Our Team as a System Architect at DRS RADA Technologies!
The System Architect is the product’s technical authority, translating operational needs into system architecture, leading multidisciplinary decisions, ensuring requirements traceability, optimizing performance, and supporting verification throughout the product lifecycle.
Key responsibilities
Define and maintain the system architecture throughout the product lifecycle.
Translate customer and operational needs into system requirements, architecture, and subsystem allocations.
Define interfaces and design constraints across RF, antenna, hardware, FPGA, software, algorithms, and mechanics.
Lead architecture reviews, trade studies, technical decisions, and cross-disciplinary issue resolution.
Ensure requirements decomposition, verification strategy, compliance, and end-to-end traceability.
Manage system performance budgets and assess the operational impact of design changes.
Requirements
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.
5+ years of experience in System Engineering, System Architecture, or multidisciplinary product development.
Proven experience leading architecture and design of complex multidisciplinary systems.
Strong understanding of radar, RF, signal processing, antennas, and embedded systems.
Experience defining system requirements, interfaces, and verification methodologies.
Experience in the defense industry - advantage.
Proficiency in MATLAB and/or Python.
Excellent technical leadership, presentation, and communication skills.

-מעקב רציף אחר ביצועים דרך האתרים באמצעות מערכות SCADA ופלטפורמות ניטור.

היכרות טובה ושליטה במערכות SCADA/EMS וביכולת קריאת נתוני ניטור.
הבנה של כללי הרשת בישראל, שעות שיא ואילוצי הזרמה.
דיוק, ראייה מערכתית ויכולת עבודה מול ממשקים מרובים.

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
למתקן מוביל להתפלת מים באשדוד, דרוש/ה מפעיל/ת חדר בקרה לצוות התפעול.
אחריות להפעלת המתקן באופן שוטף, עבודה מול מסכים, המבקרים את עבודת התפעול בפרמטרים השונים, קבלת החלטות בזמן אמת ואחריות גבוהה. ניהול הפעילות במתקן בעת תקלה והשתתפות בטיפול בה מול הגורמים השונים. יציאה לשטח המפעל במהלך המשמרת, איתור תקלות בזמן אמת וביצוע משימות בקרה שוטפות.
עבודה בסביבה דינאמית ומאתגרת, בתפקיד המשלב בין עבודת משרד ועבודת שטח.
למתאימים/ות: אורחות מסובסדות + הסעות מאשדוד ואשקלון.
דרישות התפקיד
* עבודה במשמרות - חובה נכונות לעבודה בסופ"ש ובחגים.
* ניטור מסכי הבקרה השונים בחדר הבקרה והפעלת צוותים ומשימות בהתאם לנדרש.
* שילוב של עבודת שטח וביצוע משימות אחזקה קלות ברחבי המפעל.
* ניסיון כמפעיל חדר בקרה במפעל תהליכי - יתרון.
* יכול להתאים להנדסאי מים/קרקע
* נכונות לעבודה בשעות שונות
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

תיאור משרה
גוון גורמים בארגון, בדגש על שטחי הביצוע, בטיחות, רכש כספים ועודניהול חוזי של פעילויות בפרויקטים המשלבים פיתוח, ייצור ותחזוקה.
אחריות לעמידה בתנאי החוזה ומימוש הפרויקט.
ניהול שינויים חוזיים וניהול הקשר עם הלקוח.
אחריות על תכניות עבודה וניהולן, מעקב שוטף מול מובילים, קידום מול גופי הביצוע.
תכנון ובקרה של תקציב ולו"ז הפרויקט, לרבות הזנה למערכות הממוכנות, התראה על חריגות צפויות ודוחות כספיים.
מעקב אחר ביצוע אבני דרך.
אחריות לגבייה, הפקת תעודות משלוח וחשבוניות.
אחריות על לוגיסטיקה של ניסויים וביצוע משלוחים.
הכנה והצגה של דיווחים שוטפים, רבעונייים ושנתיים להנהלת היחידה.

תואר ראשון בהנדסת תעשיה וניהול / כלכלה.
אנגלית ברמה גבוהה מאוד - קריאה, כתיבה ודיבור.
ניסיון והבנה בתהליכי עבודה מול גופי רכש, תפעול, ייצור והנדסה פנים ארגוניים.
ניסיון בתחום ניהול פרויקטים מול לקוח – בהיבטים כגון מימוש חוזה ועמידה באבני דרך, תכנון, בקרה ותפעול של פרויקט.
רקע בתחום הכספים – יתרון.
ניסיון בעבודה מול קבלני משנה – יתרון.

מכרז חיצוני  מס'                                     104/2026
דרוש/ה          מנהל/ת  התכנית הלאומית לילדים ונוער בסיכון (360)
תאריך המכרז                                       23/11/2026
היקף משרה:                                        100%
דירוג : מח"ר                                         דרגה 39-41
המשרה מותנית בתקציב ייעודי
להגשת מועמדות במערכת המקוונת יש ללחוץ כאן
ייעוד:
מנהל התכנית הלאומית ברשות המקומית המתכלל את כל המערכים הרשתיים הנדרשים כדי להבטיח ראיה כוללת של הילדים בסיכון וכל מרכיבי מערך השירותים ברשות המקומית באופן שיטתי, שיתופי, מקצועי, חדשני, אתי ובמסגרת ההנחיות, הדרישות והנהלים של מטה התכנית הלאומית המתפרסמים מעת לעת.
תיאור התפקיד:
ריכוז עבודת  הועדה היישובית, הועדות המקצועיות והצוותים הבין מקצועיים המלווים את המענים.
ריכוז תהליכי המיפוי הנחיית חברי הועדה היישובית והועדות המקצועיות האחראים על הפעלת מענים וכלל אנשי המקצוע ביישוב, בהפעלה ויישום של כלי המיפוי, התכנון הבקרה והמעקב של התוכנית, ולסייע להם לנתח ולהבין את המידע והסוגיות העולות מהם.
סיוע לאחראים על המענים בהקמת המענים וליווי היישום, באופן שוטף על פי המתווים  שנקבעו על ידי התוכנית, ולדאוג לכך שיתבצעו בהשתתפות כלל הגורמים הרלוונטיים ביישוב, תוך לקיחת נקודות המבט שלהם בחשבון.
סיוע במעקב אחר הקמת המענים, התנהלותם ובחינת התוצאות וההשלכות על הילדים ועל מערך השירותים היישובי, ולסייע בפתרון בעיות והסרת חסמים בהקמה ובהפעלה השוטפת של המענים.
סיוע בהבטחת השימוש במשאבים שהוקצו ליישוב בהתאם לתוכניות שגובשו ובמעקב אחר ניצולם.
ריכוז וליווי  מקצועי בדיוני הוועדה היישובית, הוועדות המקצועיות וצוותי הליווי למענים בקביעת יעדים וסדרי עדיפויות וסוגיות וצרכים העולים מהליווי השוטף של הפעלת המענים ובחינת תוצאותיהם.
הכנת תכניות יישוביות, הצעות לשינוי, תכניות ודיווחים תקופתיים על הקמה ויישום המענים לוועדה המחוזית, בתיאום מנהל התוכנית במחוז והממונה על "התחלה טובה".
לסייע בהקניה ובהטמעה ביישוב על ידע ודרכי עבודה בין מקצועיים בתחומי פעולה מרכזיים של התוכנית, בהתאם לצרכים שעולים ביישוב ובתיאום עם תוכניות ההכשרה המופעלות על ידי התוכנית.
לתאם בין כל הגורמים המקצועיים ביישובים הפועלים לקידום ילדים ובני נוער בסיכון, ולפעול לאיגום ולגיוס משאבים על מנת להמשיך ולפתח מענים בהתאם לסדרי העדיפויות.
ביצוע משימות נוספות בהתאם לדרישות הממונים.
דרישות התפקיד
תחומי אחריות :
מופקד על הנחלת התפיסה המקצועית במסגרת כללי התכנית הלאומית ונהליה  * דואג לפעולה סדירה ומועילה של המבנה הבין ארגוני של התכנית ברשות המקומית ולחיזוק הממשקים שבין המחלקות והארגונים השונים הפועלים למען הילדים ברשות המקומית  * דואג להטמעה, חיזוק וסיוע פעיל לעבודה מבוססת מידע, באופן שיאפשר מתן דגש להתבוננות בילדים וללמידה בה הרשות המקומית נענית לצרכיהם ולשינויים החלים במצבם. * דואג לעידוד והרחבת השיח בין הגורמים השונים ברשות המקומית, המכוון להתמודד באופן יעיל עם סוגיות ואתגרים שונים העולים בהקשר לצרכיהם של ילדים ובני נוער בסיכון והוריהם.
דרישות התפקיד

ריכוז עבודת  הועדה היישובית, הועדות המקצועיות והצוותים הבין מקצועיים המלווים את המענים.

סיוע לאחראים על המענים בהקמת המענים וליווי היישום, באופן שוטף על פי המתווים  שנקבעו על ידי התוכנית, ולדאוג לכך שיתבצעו בהשתתפות כלל הגורמים הרלוונטיים ביישוב, תוך לקיחת נקודות המבט שלהם בחשבון.
סיוע במעקב אחר הקמת המענים, התנהלותם ובחינת התוצאות וההשלכות על הילדים ועל מערך השירותים היישובי, ולסייע בפתרון בעיות והסרת חסמים בהקמה ובהפעלה השוטפת של המענים.
סיוע בהבטחת השימוש במשאבים שהוקצו ליישוב בהתאם לתוכניות שגובשו ובמעקב אחר ניצולם.
ריכוז וליווי  מקצועי בדיוני הוועדה היישובית, הוועדות המקצועיות וצוותי הליווי למענים בקביעת יעדים וסדרי עדיפויות וסוגיות וצרכים העולים מהליווי השוטף של הפעלת המענים ובחינת תוצאותיהם.
הכנת תכניות יישוביות, הצעות לשינוי, תכניות ודיווחים תקופתיים על הקמה ויישום המענים לוועדה המחוזית, בתיאום מנהל התוכנית במחוז והממונה על "התחלה טובה".
לסייע בהקניה ובהטמעה ביישוב על ידע ודרכי עבודה בין מקצועיים בתחומי פעולה מרכזיים של התוכנית, בהתאם לצרכים שעולים ביישוב ובתיאום עם תוכניות ההכשרה המופעלות על ידי התוכנית.

הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
* עבודה בצוות גדול במגוון תחומים טכנולוגיים עם ממשקים להנדסה וגופים נוספים.
* ביצוע בחינה לביקורת סופית לחלקים ומוצרים במפעל ובקב"מ.
* ניתוח ממצאי ביקורת, הפקת חריגות, ויישום היתרים הנדסיים/ שינויים.
* הבנה בקריאת שרטוטים.
* הבנה טכנולוגית בפרוק והרכבת מוצרים לבדיקות הידראוליות ומכניות.
* ריכוז וסיכום ממצאי ביקורת, עבודה רבה במערכות מידע ועבודת ניירת של תיעוד הממצאים. נדרש דיוק והקפדה בתיעוד ובהפקת אישורים.

* טכנאי/ת/ הנדסאי/ת- יתרון.

* בעל/ת רקע בתחום האחזקה הטכני- יתרון.
* ידע וניסיון בהפעלה של מכשירי מדידה מדויקים- יתרון.
* ניסיון של שנה לפחות בבחינת קווי ייצור בדיקות לחץ ובחינות קבלה סופיות (יתרון משמעותי למפעל בתחום תעשיות המתכת)- יתרון.
* הבנה בתהליכי ייצור של תעשייה כבדה וקלה בכלל ענפי המתכת- יתרון.
* בעל/ת הכשרה כבוחן מוסמך (או רקע מקביל)- יתרון.
* ידע בתקני ביקורת איכות, שיטות דגימה, שיטות סטטיסטיות- יתרון.
* מיומנות עבודה במערכות מידע לניהול תהליכים בארגונים- יתרון.
* ידע וניסיון בהפעלת תוכנה לניהול והכנה של נתוני בחינה- יתרון.
* יחסי אנוש טובים.
* תודעת שירות גבוהה ויכולת טיפול במס' משימות במקביל תוך ירידה לפרטים.
* נכונות לשעות עבודה גמישות ונוספות.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.snippet:
מנהל/ת פרויקטים ולקוחות בכיר/ה – אנרגיה ומים
PB
איירפורט סיטי
7 שנים ומעלה
משרה מלאה
לפני 3 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
לחברת ייעוץ הנדסי דרוש/ה מנהל/ת פרויקטים ולקוחות בכיר/ה בתחום האנרגיה והמים, לתפקיד מרכזי הכולל הובלת פרויקטים מורכבים וניהול לקוחות.
התפקיד משלב ניהול מגוון הנדסי גדול של פרויקטי ייעוץ הנדסי, הובלת צוותים מקצועיים רב־תחומיים וניהול הקשר עם הלקוחות, משלב גיבוש ההצעה והגדרת תכולת השירותים ועד להשלמת הפרויקט.
ניהול והובלת פרויקטי ייעוץ בתחומי ייצור אנרגיה, תחנות כוח, מערכות אנרגיה, מים והתפלה.
ניהול הקשר השוטף עם לקוחות, הבנת הצרכים והובלת המענה המקצועי והמסחרי.
ניהול שירותי Owner's Engineer, Lender's Technical Advisor (LTA), Technical Advisory, Design Review, תכנון בסיסי וניהול ותיאום תכנון.
אחריות על תכולות העבודה, תקציב, לו"ז, משאבים, תוצרים ואיכות השירות.
גיבוש והובלת צוותי פרויקט רב־תחומיים ושילוב מומחים מקצועיים מישראל וממשרדי החברה בעולם.
ניהול ממשקים עם יזמים, חברות פרויקט, מוסדות פיננסיים, מתכננים, קבלנים, ספקי ציוד ויועצים.
הכנת הצעות, הגדרת Scope of Services, הערכת משאבים ותמחור שירותי ייעוץ.
השתתפות בפיתוח הפעילות העסקית, שימור והרחבת פעילות מול לקוחות קיימים ופיתוח הזדמנויות חדשות.
דרישות התפקיד
מהנדס/ת בעל/ת ניסיון משמעותי בתחום האנרגיה, עדיפות לניסיון בתחנות כוח ופרויקטי ייצור אנרגיה.
ניסיון גם בתחום התפלת מי ים יהווה יתרון משמעותי.
ניסיון מוכח בניהול פרויקטים ולקוחות בחברת ייעוץ הנדסי, Owner's Engineer, Technical Advisor או בסביבה מקצועית דומה.
ניסיון בהובלת צוותים מקצועיים רב־תחומיים וניהול ממשקים רבים.
ראייה הנדסית מערכתית לצד יכולת ניהולית ומסחרית גבוהה.
ניסיון בניהול תקציבים, תכולות עבודה, הצעות ושינויים.
אנגלית ברמה גבוהה וניסיון בעבודה עם לקוחות וצוותים בינלאומיים.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.snippet:
חסוי
רכז/ת בקרת מסמכים
- חסוי -
ראשון לציון
3-4 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 22 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
החברה
קבוצת עיסא חורי - קבלן ראשי בתחומי אנרגיה, תשתיות ותעשייה, עם עשרות שנות ניסיון בהקמת תחנות כוח,
מתקני תעשייה ופרויקטי תשתית לאומיים בישראל ובאזור - מגייסת Document Controller לפרויקט הקמה גדול בתשתיות.
בפרויקט בהיקף כזה, מסמכים הם עמוד השדרה: כל שרטוט, מפרט ואישור חייבים להגיע לאדם הנכון, בגרסה הנכונה ובזמן. מחפשים מישהו/י מסודר/ת ומדויק/ת שיחזיק/תחזיק את זרימת המידע של הפרויקט כולו, בסביבה בינלאומית ודינמית.
תיאור התפקיד
ניהול מערך המסמכים
• הקמה וניהול של מערך בקרת המסמכים בפרויקט: מבנה תיקיות, קידוד, נומרטורים ונהלי עבודה
• ניהול מסמכי הנדסה ושרטוטים לאורך כל מחזור החיים: קליטה, הפצה, מעקב גרסאות (Revisions) וארכוב
• תפעול מערכת ניהול מסמכים (EDMS) ושמירה על סדר, עדכניות ושלמות המידע
Transmittals ותקשורת
• הכנה ומעקב אחר Transmittals מול הלקוח, היועצים, קבלני המשנה והספקים
• ניהול רישום התכתבויות (Correspondence Register) ומכתבים יוצאים ונכנסים
• מעקב אחר סטטוס אישורים, הערות (Comments) וסבבי תיקון, ותזכורת לגורמים הרלוונטיים
דיווח ובקרה

• הכנת חשבונות חלקיים ללקוח ומעקב אחר גבייה
• ליווי ההיבטים הכספיים והחוזיים של התקשרויות, שינויים (Change Orders) ותביעות

• הטמעה ושיפור של תהליכי עבודה, נהלים וכלי בקרה כספית בפרויקט

• פרויקט משמעותי - פרויקט תשתית לאומי בהיקף גדול, שרואים אותו קם מהיסוד

• צמיחה - קבוצה צומחת עם פרויקטים בישראל ובאזור, ואפשרויות קידום
• סביבה מקצועית - עבודה לצד צוות מקצועי ובינלאומי

• משרה מלאה
• עבודה מהמשרד: מתחם ה-1000, שד' הראשונים 23, ראשון לציון
• תנאים מתאימים למועמדים מתאימים

• ניסיון של 5 שנים לפחות כחשב/ת בחברה קבלנית - חובה
• ניסיון בניהול כספי פרויקטים בהיקף של מעל 100 מיליון ₪ - חובה
• ניסיון בניהול ומעקב תקציב פרויקט
• ניסיון בניהול כספים של פרויקטים מורכבים
• הבנה מעמיקה בהתנהלות פרויקטים קבלניים
• הבנה מעמיקה של ההתנהלות מול קבלני משנה
• ניסיון בניהול ומעקב אחר תשלומים והוצאות של פרויקט
• שליטה מלאה ב-Excel ובמערכות ERP
• יתרון: ניסיון בפרויקטי אנרגיה, תשתיות או EPC
• יתרון: מגורים באזור המרכז

job.title: NOC Operator
job.snippet:
Comblack is hiring a
NOC Operator
for a leading financial institution in the Central district!
Looking for an impactful role at the core of a large-scale, advanced technological operation? This is your opportunity to join the NOC team responsible for monitoring, controlling, and operating critical production systems and core infrastructure around the clock.
Key Responsibilities:
Perform real-time 24/7 monitoring, control, and operational support for critical enterprise production systems.
Identify, triage, and handle Tier-1 operational events and system alerts.
Coordinate incident management processes and escalate issues to relevant engineering and infrastructure teams.
Ensure high availability, performance, and stability across the organization's computing environments.
What Are We Looking For?
Hands-on experience in operations, monitoring, and control of IT systems in an Enterprise environment – Must.
Working knowledge of operating systems: Windows, Linux, and Unix – Must.
Strong ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced, multitasking environment – Must.
Experience working with Splunk – Significant advantage.
Why Comblack?
Comblack is a company dedicated to creating accurate and meaningful connections between people and the right opportunities. We believe in a personal approach, uncompromising professionalism, and true end-to-end support, for both candidates and clients.
At Comblack, you’ll find a dynamic, supportive, and innovative work environment that encourages initiative, growth, and continuous professional development.

job.title: HR Tech Product Manager
job.snippet:
At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevSecOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate. Our team of industry-leading software security experts is a true pioneer, constantly pushing the boundaries with original research and technological innovation. JFrog is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit, and just all-around great people. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production – a concept we call “liquid software”. Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us on our journey?
We’re transforming how HR operates. You will own the product roadmap for JFrog’s HR technology landscape (Oracle HCM, Greenhouse, and the wider HR tools ecosystem) in partnership with IT, turn manual HR Ops work into automated, AI-powered solutions, and enable HR, employees, and leadership to use AI in their day-to-day work.
As an HR Tech Product Manager at JFrog, you will…
Spearhead innovative HR technology solutions that boost productivity and engagement and deliver measurable business impact
Automate and modernize HR Ops processes (employee lifecycle, contracts, onboarding, reporting) using AI tools, agents, workflows, and integrations
Lead the full product lifecycle for HR tech and AI solutions, from discovery and process redesign to change management, adoption, and value tracking
Own the foundations
Own the functional roadmap and requirements for HR systems and vendors, in partnership with IT, who own architecture, integrations, security, SLAs, and uptime
Build and ship AI and automation solutions on IT-approved platforms and within AI governance, with IT security review before go-live
Provide operational support to HR teams and business partners, automating wherever possible
Build strategic relationships across HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Acquisition, L&D, Compensation & Benefits), IT, and external vendors
To be an HR Tech Product Manager at JFrog you need…
4+ years of experience in HRIS, HR Operations, HR Tech, or automation roles, ideally in a global, fast-paced organization
Hands-on experience building automations or AI solutions (e.g., LLMs, AI agents, no-code/low-code platforms, scripting, APIs)
Experience in change management and process redesign for non-technical users
Experience managing vendors and roadmaps, and building relationships across stakeholders
Ability to teach and inspire non-technical users at every level
Data-driven, detail-oriented, and proactive, with strong problem-solving skills and a curiosity for the AI landscape
Fluent English (written and verbal)

job.title: AI First DevOps Engineer
job.snippet:
Tomorrow.io's Engineering department is focused on building life-changing software and products at scale, from infrastructure that handles massive amounts of data to outstanding customer-centric user experiences in B2B, B2C and B2D products that change billions of lives worldwide.
We're looking for a DevOps Engineer to power the reliability, security, and efficiency of the world's most impactful weather platform. You'll build self-service platforms that give developers and weather scientists true independence, weave AI into how we operate, and work side-by-side with R&D to push performance and scale further. You'll evolve our cloud infrastructure to match the pace of the business, hold the line on cost, and stay close to production through on-call. The people who thrive here bring a product mindset, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and leave the people and systems around them better than they found them.
As a DevOps Engineer at Tomorrow.io, you'll:
Evolve and maintain our cloud infrastructure, delivery and observability - and the self-service platforms above them - so they serve our business strategy and let scientists and developers work on their own as we grow at scaleDevelop and adopt tools, with AI at the center, that make development and operations processes measurably more efficientPartner with the engineering teams behind the Tomorrow.io platform and its API to improve service performance, reliability, scale, security and costKeep production available to its SLOs - taking your turn on the on-call rotation and following each incident through to whatever stops it from happening againWork as part of the team: share what you know, learn from the people around you, and help us keep improving how we work together
What you bring:
4+ years
as a DevOps / Platform Engineer, including
2+ years
hands-on with a major cloud (GCP, AWS or Azure) and with IaC such as Terraform (Crossplane or another Kubernetes-native approach is a plus)
Production Kubernetes depth - containerized deployments, scheduling, resource management and real troubleshooting - plus CI/CD pipelines you've built and owned end to end with modern tooling and advanced deployment methodologies
Experience implementing and customizing monitoring and observability systems (Datadog, Grafana + Loki, Prometheus, ELK)
Software engineering craft and the judgment to review, debug and improve what an agent produces
Hands-on use of AI tooling in your engineering work - shaping and extending it (agents, rules, integrations), not only consuming it
A product mindset and a deep sense of responsibility for service reliability: you build internal tools from developer feedback, measure success with clear metrics and KPIs, and treat production as yours to care forCuriosity, adaptability and a bias for action in a high-velocity, changing environment - with communication that connects infrastructure work to business impact and brings R&D stakeholders together around shared goals
So if you're passionate about optimizing development processes and curious about how systems work behind the scenes, if continuous improvement is a way of life and automation is your tool of choice, this is the place for you. You'll help teams deliver faster and more safely, working with some of the sharpest minds in the industry on complex, high-scale problems, as we build the world's most trusted weather platform for millions of people every day. You'll grow quickly here, in both technical depth and responsibility, in a culture where engineers truly care for their production workloads end to end.
If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. Tomorrow.io is on a mission to build a special company. To achieve our goal, we are focused on hiring people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.
___________________________________________________________________________________________

We grow fast and move faster but we always see people first. Each person has their own career growth path for we believe that the only way for the company to grow is if you grow.

Experience with ERP and accounting systems.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and familiarity with data analysis and financial reporting tools.
Strong analytical skills and financial acumen.
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Business-oriented mindset and problem-solving abilities.

High attention to detail and accuracy.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Business-oriented mindset and problem-solving abilities.

job.title: Applications Engineer – Verification & AI Solutions
job.snippet:
We Are: At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
You Are: You are a motivated and technically strong Application Engineer with a passion for verification flows, AI and agentic solutions, and customer enablement. You enjoy working hands-on with advanced verification tools and thrive in environments where learning, collaboration, and problem-solving are key. With a solid foundation in ASIC design and verification concepts, you are eager to deepen your expertise and apply it in real-world customer engagements.
You are comfortable working in Unix-based environments, writing TCL scripts, and navigating complex verification flows. Curious and adaptable, you enjoy learning from experienced colleagues and collaborating closely with customers to help them succeed. You communicate clearly, approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset, and take pride in delivering high-quality technical support.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Supporting customers by enabling and troubleshooting software verification flows
Deploying Synopsys advanced AI and agentic solutions for software verification in customer environments, including setup, execution, and analysis
Collaborating with the R&D team on the development of new agentic solutions for software verification, providing customer feedback, use cases, and field insights
Running and supporting Synopsys verification and debug flows, including setup, execution, and analysis
Assisting customers with tool usage, flow understanding, and best practices for software verification
Working closely with experienced Application Engineers to learn customer environments and project requirements
Analyzing design and verification issues and providing clear, practical guidance to resolve technical challenges
Collaborating with internal Synopsys teams to escalate, track, and resolve tool or flow-related issues
Contributing to continuous improvement of verification flows, methodologies, and customer support processes
The Impact You Will Have:
Supporting key global accounts by ensuring successful adoption and usage of Synopsys verification tools and AI and agentic solutions
Helping customers achieve efficient, high-quality software verification using industry-leading technology and AI solutions.
Strengthening Synopsys’ reputation as a trusted technical partner through responsive and knowledgeable support
Accelerating customer productivity by enabling smooth verification flows and effective problem resolution
Contributing to long-term customer success and satisfaction in advanced ASIC designs
What You’ll Need:
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
Understanding of ASIC design and verification concepts and the software verification flow
Hands-on experience or familiarity with SystemVerilog , UVM and verification methodology.
Working knowledge of Unix/Linux environments
1-3 years of experience in relevant field
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to learn complex tools and flows quickly
Advantage: knowledge of or experience with AI and agentic solutions and workflows
Who You Are:
Technically curious and eager to learn from experienced engineers
Customer-focused with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
A clear communicator who can explain technical concepts effectively
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
Detail-oriented, yet able to understand the broader design and customer context
Adaptable and positive when facing new challenges
The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:
You’ll join a skilled and collaborative Application Engineering team, focused on supporting software verification flows and Synopsys verification tools, including advanced AI and agentic solutions. The team works closely with customers, R&D, and global support organizations to ensure successful tool adoption and project execution, and to help shape new agentic solutions for software verification. You’ll be supported by experienced AEs who are committed to mentoring, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence, helping you grow while delivering real impact to customers worldwide.
Rewards and Benefits:
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

job.title: Video Editor & AI Generator
job.snippet:
Company Description
Reuveni Pridan IPG is a professional services firm specializing in intellectual property, legal, and business strategy solutions for clients across diverse industries. The organization supports innovative companies and entrepreneurs by helping them protect, manage, and leverage their ideas and brands. Team members collaborate closely with clients to provide tailored, high-quality services that blend legal, creative, and commercial insight. Working at Reuveni Pridan IPG offers exposure to a dynamic environment where technology, creativity, and business intersect. The firm values professionalism, integrity, and continuous learning.
Role Description
The Video Editor & AI Generator will be responsible for producing, editing, and enhancing video content that supports the firm’s marketing, training, and client-facing initiatives. Day-to-day tasks include editing raw footage, applying color grading, adding motion graphics, and integrating visual elements aligned with brand guidelines. The role will also involve using AI tools to generate and optimize video assets, templates, and visual content, as well as collaborating with marketing and legal teams to transform complex concepts into clear visual narratives. This is a full-time, on-site role based in the Tel Aviv District, Israel, requiring close coordination with colleagues and stakeholders to meet deadlines and maintain high production standards.
Qualifications
Strong skills in Video Production and Video Editing, including handling footage from various sources and formats.
Proficiency in Video Color Grading to ensure consistent, high-quality visual look and feel.
Ability to create and integrate Motion Graphics and Graphics to enhance storytelling and brand communication.
Experience with AI-based tools for video and visual content generation or optimization.
Familiarity with industry-standard editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or similar).
Attention to detail, strong visual sense, and ability to follow brand guidelines and project briefs.
Effective communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in an on-site team environment.
Relevant education or training in film, media, design, or a related field; prior experience in a professional editing role is an advantage.

Infrastructure & Compute
FinOps (Compute-Cost-Optimization) Specialist
FinOps Specialists control and optimize the costs of computing resources.
Apply for this roleManage an applicationBack to careers
Overview
FinOps Specialists control and optimize the costs of computing resources.
Responsibilities
Establish cost visibility and accountability models: Develop cost metrics such as cost per request or per user.
Identify cost drivers and waste patterns: Analyze usage patterns to detect inefficiencies.
Produce cost performance reports: Prepare regular cost reporting and recommend improvements.
Run optimization cycles: Implement rightsizing and scheduling to reduce costs.
Operate anomaly detection: Create alerts for unusual spending patterns.
Support budgeting and forecasting: Provide cost estimates and collaborate with finance teams.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in finance, business, or computer science.
Experience in cost analysis, budgeting, and cloud resource management.

job.title: HVAC Technician
job.snippet:
At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
Job Description
Responsibility for HVAC systems and handling air conditioning malfunctions
Supervision and process control, including managing and overseeing contractors and vendors, ensuring work quality and compliance with site safety and security procedures
Operation of infrastructure and HVAC-related projects
Proven experience and broad knowledge in operating and managing BMS systems
Performing preventive and corrective maintenance for HVAC systems, diagnosing faults, conducting repairs, and maintaining systems and infrastructure
Providing fast and effective response to critical malfunctions, including 24/7 availability in urgent cases
Documenting actions in fault management systems and maintenance reports
Qualifications
Certified HVAC technician with a valid electrical license for HVAC systems
Certified electrician license – an advantage
Knowledge of ESG standards and energy efficiency in HVAC systems
At least 8 years of proven experience in industrial HVAC systems, cooling towers, water condensation systems, server rooms, VRF systems, and building management systems
Ability to work in a computerized environment, including management systems and Office applications
Good level of English
High responsibility and reliability

job.title: Network Operations Technician
job.snippet:
Network Operations & Control Technician | ITOC | Tel Aviv
Looking to develop your IT career in a complex enterprise technology environment?
A leading financial organization in
Tel Aviv, Israel
is looking for a
Network Operations & Control Technician
to join its ITOC team, responsible for monitoring, operating, and controlling critical IT systems and infrastructure.
This hands-on role involves monitoring enterprise systems, troubleshooting technical incidents, coordinating production changes, and supporting the integration of new technologies.
You'll work in a dynamic, multi-system environment with opportunities for professional development and career growth.
What You'll Do
Monitor, operate, and control critical IT systems and infrastructure.
Identify, investigate, and escalate technical incidents according to severity.
Execute and coordinate changes in production environments.
Monitor system availability, stability, and operational performance.
Work with Windows, Unix, and Linux environments.
Operate and monitor virtualized infrastructure and Kubernetes environments.
Support network infrastructure and information security equipment.
Assist with the onboarding and operation of new systems and technologies.
Provide technical support to internal stakeholders.
Perform Tier 1 operational activities across multiple enterprise systems.
Mandatory Requirements
Technical training or experience in IT systems operations and monitoring.
Familiarity with Windows, Unix, and Linux.
Familiarity with virtualized infrastructure and Kubernetes.
Familiarity with networking infrastructure and information security equipment.
Strong learning ability and systems thinking.
Ability to work under pressure in a dynamic operational environment.
Responsibility, commitment, and strong teamwork skills.
Availability for 24/7 rotating shifts, including Fridays and Saturday evenings.
For students: at least 2 years of studies remaining.
Advantages
Experience with Splunk or Dynatrace.
Knowledge of Cloud operations.
Familiarity with Mainframe environments.
Background in Systems Analysis or Software Development.
Working Hours & Conditions
Location: Tel Aviv, Israel.
Workplace Type: On-site only. No hybrid work.
Six working days per week, with rotating morning, afternoon, and night shifts.
Morning shifts: 07:00–14:00/15:00.
Afternoon shifts: 13:00/14:00–19:00/21:00.
Night shifts: 21:00–06:00/07:00.
Shifts include Fridays and Saturday evenings.
Interested in building your career in enterprise IT operations? Apply now!

job.title: Construction Project Manager
job.snippet:
Summary
In Places, we don’t sit back and let things happen; we make things happen, and we do this in service to all Apple employees, business units, and customers. Our team is a diverse and nimble group that manages Apple’s retail stores, workplaces, and workplace services. We develop and manage Apple’s global real estate portfolio, lead all related capital construction projects, provide outstanding facilities and site services, develop and lead sustainability initiatives to reduce the environmental impact of all Apple facilities, including commute and renewable energy programs, and do everything we can to ensure the health and safety of all Apple personnel, facilities, and customers in our facilities around the world.
As part of our Places Construction team, you’ll play a significant role in transforming spaces into functional corporate offices and product development centers. We’re seeking a motivated and experienced Construction Project Manager to own delivery of our key capital projects, including high-design workplaces and technically complex laboratory fit-outs. This role calls for a blend of skills — the ability to execute an elevated design vision with attention to detail, solid technical knowledge, and strong project management discipline.
Description
As a Construction Project Manager supporting the Israel market, you’ll be a key point of contact for project delivery, taking complex projects from initial concept through due diligence, design, construction, commissioning, and handover across sites in Israel, primarily in Herzliya, Haifa, and Jerusalem.
You’ll own ambiguous challenges as they arise, drive cross-functional alignment, and help enforce quality, schedule, and cost controls. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who coordinates effectively with a diverse group of stakeholders — including leadership, internal R&D/engineering partners, architects and the Global Design Team, engineers, corporate procurement, global security, IT & AV teams, vendors, suppliers, and general contractors — to deliver functional, high-quality spaces on time and within budget.
Responsibilities
Scope & Strategy: Translate end-user and scientific requirements into actionable design criteria, defining project scope, milestones, and deliverables in partnership with key stakeholders. Use Apple devices, iOS, and internal software within Apple’s environment and network.
Planning & Procurement: Develop project execution plans (budgets, schedules, risk mitigation) and lead selection and management of architects, third-party PM and supervision firms, engineers, general contractors, and specialty trade vendors.
Design & Technical Integration: Oversee the design development process to preserve architectural intent while coordinating complex MEP and process utility systems critical to lab environments (e.g., HVAC, process piping/gases, clean dry air, tooling hookups, high-voltage capacity, UPS and generators).
Site Leadership & Craftsmanship: Serve as the on-site owner’s representative, monitoring work progress, identifying risks, and upholding standards for health, safety, schedule discipline, and finish quality befitting Apple’s high-design environments.
Project Controls & Financials: Manage project budgets, cost forecasting, contractor billing, and change orders, proactively flagging and addressing cost and schedule variances.
Permitting & Compliance: Lead local authority approvals, environmental health and safety requirements, and municipal permitting processes.
Handover & Operational Readiness: Coordinate transitions to facilities and end-users, including commissioning, punch lists, occupancy permits, and documentation handover (as-builts, warranties, O&M).
Provide internal project reports in the formats required by the organization.
Join calls and meetings across time zones (e.g., US PDT/EDT, EMEA) as needed to engage with teams, stakeholders, and managers abroad.
Minimum Qualifications
8+ years of progressive project management experience delivering complex, multi-million-dollar capital construction projects
Experience managing technically complex tenant improvements
Experience delivering high-design corporate workplaces where aesthetic quality and architectural finishes were paramount
Experience across full project lifecycles: due diligence, programming, design management, municipal permitting, site fit-out execution, commissioning, and financial closeout
Experience with contract negotiations, budget forecasting, and change order review
Flexibility to travel to project sites, vendor locations, and regional offices as required
Fluency in Hebrew and English — speaking, reading, writing, and working in both languages
Ability to work in Herzliya five days a week, with ability to travel within the country (e.g., Jerusalem, Haifa) as needed
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or equivalent practical experience
Ability to navigate ambiguous, fast-paced environments and help resolve complex project trade-offs
Experience managing third-party PM and supervision firms as a client representative
Proactive mindset — identifies potential constructibility or schedule risks before they affect field operations and develops mitigation plans
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical construction issues clearly to non-technical stakeholders
At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.
