job.snippet:
משרד פרסום מוביל וחדשני מחפש
מנהל/ת קריאייטיב
עם תשוקה ליצירתיות, להצטרף לצוות המנצח שלנו. אם אתם אוהבים לנהל קמפיינים מקיפים ולעבוד עם לקוחות מוכרים, זו ההזדמנות שלכם להוביל את הקריאייטיב של אשכול לקוחות מרתק.
התפקיד כולל עבודה במחלקה דינמית המונה צוות מגוון של קופירייטרים, ארט דירקטורים, מעצבים ומנהלי סושיאל. המשרד מתמחה ביצירת פרסומות 360 מעלות לקשת רחבה של לקוחות מובילים, תוך דגש על חדשנות ויצירתיות בלתי מתפשרת.
תחומי האחריות:
ניהול והובלת אסטרטגיית הקריאייטיב עבור אשכול לקוחות.
פיקוח והכוונה של צוות הקריאייטיב (קופי, ארט, מעצב, מנהלי סושיאל).
פיתוח והצגת קונספטים קריאייטיביים ללקוחות קיימים ולמכרזים חדשים.
ניהול פרויקטים מול לקוחות גדולים ומוכרים, תוך עמידה בלוחות זמנים ויעדים.
הבטחת איכות ויצירתיות בפרסומות 360 מעלות.
שמירה על קשר רציף עם הלקוחות והבנת צרכיהם.
אנו מציעים סביבת עבודה תומכת ומאתגרת, עם הזדמנויות רבות לצמיחה מקצועית ואישית, לצד עבודה על קמפיינים משמעותיים ופורצי דרך.

Overview

תקציבאים/ות
שמעוניינים להיות בלב הפרסום, להשפיע ולהוביל קמפיינים של מותגי העל בישראל.
אם עולם הפרסום הוא התשוקה שלך, אם אתה מונע מאהבה ליצירתיות, חדשנות ויחסי לקוחות מעולים – המקום שלך איתנו! כסוכנות הפרסום הגדולה והמובילה בישראל, אנו מציעים הזדמנות ייחודית להיחשף לאתגרים חדשים מדי יום, להוביל קמפיינים פורצי דרך ולעבוד עם המותגים הגדולים והמשפיעים ביותר בישראל.

job.title: POS T&C Technician
job.snippet:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
PURPOSE OF THE JOB:
The Power Supply T&C Technician is responsible for executing all Test & Commissioning activities related to power supply systems at the project site. The role ensures that all equipment and systems are installed, tested, and commissioned in accordance with engineering specifications, safety standards, and project requirements.
MAIN RESPONSABILITIES :
Key Accountabilities:
Execute on-site testing and commissioning of power supply systems (MV/LV equipment, traction systems, transformers, protection systems, control and automation).
Perform functional tests, insulation/megger tests, continuity checks, torque verifications, and panel energization procedures.
Ensure compliance with engineering documentation, FAT/SAT procedures, technical standards, and QCD criteria.
Clear and Exhaustive understanding of the Customer Acceptance Criteria.
Manage the development and supply of test procedures, facilities and tools for RS sites and depots
Ensure that test procedures and tools configuration are managed during the project lifecycle
Define the Standard Operating Procedures with reference time and monitor deviations
Continuously optimizing SOP’s.
Implement REX (Return of Experience) from Test & Commissioning phase of the project.
Ensure Interface and perfect working relationship with engineering project team, Site Industrial, Warranty Implementation team, Site Logistics and Industrial Support to Warranty teams, Quality, Site Validation team.
Support the T&C Operations team, for the implementation and execution of the Testing Procedures.
Implement and deploy methods and tools and best practices pointed out at group level.
Provide technical support to installation and site teams regarding electrical design issues, system interfaces, and test readiness.
Coordinate with Power Supply Engineering, Project Management, Suppliers, Subcontractors, and Field Operations teams.
Participate in troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective action implementation.
Prepare test procedures, checklists, T&C reports, NCRs, and as-built test documentation.
Ensure proper configuration management and version control of T&C documents.
Submit T&C deliverables for approval according to project quality requirements.
Ensure all site activities comply with EHS standards, electrical work regulations, and client requirements.
Participate in site safety briefings, toolbox talks, and risk assessments.
MAIN REQUIRED COMPETENCES:
Educational Requirements:
Mandatory:
Practical Engineer/ Technician in Electrical Engineering or related field.
Valid electrical work license “Electrical Practical Engineer “/ ” Electrical Technician”
Driver License
Strong communication, autonomy, rigor, and safety mindset.
Good knowledge of English language (read, written, spoken).
Desirable:
Railway and Power supply systems knowledge
Any other additional language is an asset
Experience:
Mandatory:
Minimum 2-3 years’ experience in Testing & Commissioning of Electrical, Control, onboard communications & network systems within process industry, railways or factory automation
Strong knowledge of MV/LV systems, traction power, substations, control panels, and electrical commissioning.
Hands-on experience with instrumentation, testing methods, and diagnostic tools.
Ability to interpret electrical schematics, SLDs, protection diagrams, and installation drawings.
Excellent communication, autonomy, and problem-solving abilities.
Fluent in English language
Competencies & Skills
Have a good technical level in electrical, electronic, mechanical and networks domains
Understanding of Lean approach for Industrialization
Result-driven mindset
Ability to foster communications between multiple stakeholders (product engineering, manufacturing engineering, industrial functions…)
Ability for problem-solving and efficient decision-making in complex environment
Ability to work across sites/functions in a multi-cultural environment
Team spirit approach and good communication skills
You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
Important to note
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

job.title: Motion & Control Supplier Engineer
job.snippet:
Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Location:
Rehovot,ISR
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
Job Description: Motion & Control Supplier Engineer
Enable robust high-volume manufacturing through technical leadership of strategic suppliers and support of complex motion systems throughout their lifecycle.
What you'll be doing?
Lead supplier engineering activities for precision motion systems, stages, bearings, motors, encoders, and related assemblies.
Support NPI transitions from R&D to manufacturing at global suppliers.
Drive supplier qualifications, process validations, and production readiness activities.
Investigate and resolve supplier quality issues using structured problem-solving methodologies.
Conduct supplier audits and identify opportunities for process improvements.
Support production ramp-ups while ensuring process control, traceability, and product quality.
Work closely with R&D, Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain teams.
Lead technical projects to improve supplier performance, capacity, quality, and efficiency.
Manage technical escalations and drive corrective actions to closure.
What's in it for you?
Exposure to cutting-edge semiconductor equipment and precision motion technologies.
Opportunity to lead critical supplier development and NPI activities.
Work with global suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Influence manufacturing strategies and supplier roadmaps.
Take part in complex engineering challenges and high-impact projects.
What you should have?
B.Sc. in Mechanical, Mechatronics or Electrical Engineering - Must
5+ years of engineering experience - Must
Experience working with external suppliers and manufacturing environments – Must
Experience in semiconductor equipment industry - Advantage
Experience with motion systems, stages, bearings, motors, encoders, or automation equipment - Advantage
Experience conducting supplier audits and supporting production ramp-ups- Advantage
Strong technical understanding of precision mechanical or electromechanical systems.
Experience with Root Cause Analysis, 8D, FMEA, and problem-solving methodologies.
Strong communication and project management skills.
Willingness to travel internationally as needed.
Who we are?
Applied Materials Israel
is home to the Process Diagnostics and Control business unit (PDC). Based in Rehovot, we develop, manufacture and market cutting-edge machine learning and computer vision-based metrology and inspection products that are essential elements in wafer fabrication. By playing a significant role in enabling the production of the next generation of microchips, our expertise enables our customers to transform possibilities into reality.
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
Yes, 25% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
No
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

job.title: SOC Quality and Reliability Engineer, Google Cloud
job.snippet:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
Haifa, Israel; Tel Aviv, Israel
.
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of experience in IC silicon quality or reliability.
Experience leading the product reliability lifecycle from post-tapeout through high-volume manufacturing.
Experience with semiconductor complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) technology, device physics, and failure mechanisms.
Preferred qualifications:
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or related field.
Expertise in statistical data analysis using tools such as JMP, Python, or JSL.
Knowledge of design-for-reliability (DfR) rules and implementation techniques.
Familiarity with electrical failure analysis (EFA) and physical failure analysis (PFA) techniques.
Track record with silicon reliability on process nodes and advanced packaging technologies.
About The Job
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.
Google’s data centers are the most advanced in the world. In this role, you will help build the SoC’s that power these data centers by driving quality and reliability processes from the integrated circuit perspective. You will create silicon and follow it into the field (and back) to drive improvements for the next generations of chips.
You will have an understanding of IC flows, wafer processing, testing, qualification, yield, reliability, and failure analysis. You will work with various cross functional teams to develop quality and reliability specifications, develop and deploy design guidelines, and develop and execute and test plans. Within the larger organization you will collaborate with global hardware quality and reliability teams, silicon design, validation and engineering teams.
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
Responsibilities
Drive the strategic definition and development of design-for-reliability (DfR) guidelines, collaborating with cross-functional subject matter experts to integrate reliability into early design stages.
Define and lead the development of qualification hardware and test methodologies, managing internal teams and external vendors to ensure silicon and package verification.
Execute comprehensive silicon and package qualification programs (including high-temperature operating life (HTOL), early life failure rate (ELFR), electrostatic discharge/latch-up (ESD/LU), biased highly accelerated stress test (b/HAST), etc.) and conduct failure analysis to resolve quality issues.
Extract and analyze data from qualification programs, high-volume manufacturing, and field returns to identify failure mechanisms and trends for yield and reliability optimization.
Develop and implement physics-based statistical Quality and Reliability models (e.g., ELF, time-dependent dielectric breakdown (TDDB), negative bias temperature instability (NBTI) to predict device failure mechanisms and lifetime behaviors.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

job.title: Junior Data Operations
job.snippet:
Who We Are
Thing Or Two is a global performance marketing agency specializing in mobile growth and user acquisition.
With teams across Israel, Spain, South Korea, the United States, and Latin America, we help leading apps and brands scale through data-driven marketing, proprietary technology, and strong industry relationships.
We are looking for a Junior Campaign Manager to join our growing team. This role sits at the center of our operation, connecting publishers, traffic sources, advertisers, and internal teams to maximize campaign performance and revenue growth. We are also open to considering non-junior candidates, for example, those with around 1 to 3 years of experience.
If you enjoy working with numbers, negotiating deals, solving problems, and building strong business relationships, we'd love to meet you.
What You'll do
Own the day-to-day management and optimization of performance marketing campaigns.
Work closely with publishers and traffic partners to scale volume and improve performance.
Negotiate payouts, caps, traffic allocations, and campaign opportunities.
Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers and traffic sources.
Collaborate with internal Account Managers to align campaign goals and execution.
Analyze campaign performance and identify growth opportunities.
Monitor KPIs including revenue, profit, conversion rates, EPC, ROI, and traffic quality.
Launch new campaigns, offers, and traffic integrations through our proprietary platform.
Identify underperforming traffic and implement optimization strategies.
Act as the bridge between external partners and internal stakeholders.
Proactively solve delivery, performance, and scaling challenges.
Contribute new ideas, industry insights, and best practices to improve company performance.
What we're Looking For
Requirements:
Experience working with publishers, affiliates, ad networks, DSPs, or performance traffic sources. (A PLUS)
Strong analytical and data-driven mindset.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
Strong negotiation skills and commercial awareness.
Ability to work independently and take ownership.
Comfortable making decisions based on data.
Fluent English, both written and verbal.
Big Advantages:
Experience managing CPI, CPA, CPL, CPS, or ROAS campaigns.
Experience with mobile attribution platforms such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, or Singular.
Experience working with BI tools, SQL, Excel, or data analysis platforms.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
Technical understanding of tracking, postbacks, APIs, and attribution flows.
Who you are
Results-oriented.
Natural persuasive and comfortable negotiating.
Likeable and relationship-driven, yet capable of pushing conversations forward when needed.
Curious about data and motivated by performance.
Highly organized and detail-oriented.
Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Resourceful, proactive, and accountable.
Someone who doesn't wait for opportunities; you create them.Success In
Succes in This Role Looks Like
Growing publisher activity and revenue.
Securing better commercial terms and higher margins.
Scaling winning campaigns efficiently.
Building long-term publisher relationships.
Becoming a trusted partner for both external traffic sources and internal account teams.
Consistently finding new opportunities.

job.title: ראש/ת תחום מערכות כוח
job.snippet:
קצת על התפקיד למפעל הנדסה ומערכות בחטיבת אלתא דרוש/ה ראש/ת תחום מערכות כוח במינהל מערכות כוח והינע. התחום עוסק בפיתוח ייצור ואספקה של מערכות כוח וגנרציה, מערכות גיבוי אנרגיה, לוחות חלוקה PDB וספקי כוח מול יצרנים שונים בארץ ובעולם. מערכות הכוח מזינות את מערכות המכ"ם בהספקים שונים לפי דרישות. הפלטפורמות עליהם מורכבות המערכות ברובן הינן קרקעיות, ימיות, מוטסות. התפקיד כולל:
ניהול התחום והעובדים ודיווח לראש המינהל
שותפות מלאה הנדסית וניהולית בסגל מנהל כוח והינע
השתתפות באיפיון וארכיטקטורת שדרת הכוח של המכ"ם
ניהול הפרויקטים השונים לפי הסכמים ותוכניות עבודה תוך עמידה ביעדים
ביצוע והטמעת תהליכים הנדסיים כגון FRB, NPI, חקירות כשל, מו"פ וחדשנות
ניהול תהליכי הפיתוח, הייצור והאיכות אצל יצרנים וקבלני משנה בארץ ובעולם
ניהול ממשק עבודה הדוק עם תחומים מקבילים באלתא, הנדסה מכנית, איכות, ביקורת, הנדסת מערכת ועוד
ניהול התקציב התחומי, תקציב השעות והעלויות הכספיות
דיווח סטטוס פרויקטים להנדסה ולמפעלים העסקיים מה אנחנו מחפשים תנאי סף:
בעל/ת אזרחות ישראלית
בעל/ת תואר ראשון בהנדסת חשמל ואלקטרוניקה
ניסיון של 3 שנים לפחות בניהול צוות עובדים
ניסיון של 3 שנים לפחות בניהול תהליכי פיתוח וייצור אצל יצרנים קריטריונים נוספים (יתרון):
היכרות עם מערכות אלתא
היכרות עם תהליכי הפיתוח, האיכות והביקורת באלתא
ניסיון הנדסי במערכות כוח או ספקי כוח עתירי אנרגיה
התמחות במערכות הספק זרם חזק קריטריונים מנהיגותיים:
יכולת מנהיגות מאפשרת ומעצימה המעודדת פיתוח עובדים שיח גיוון והאצלת סמכויות
מכוונות לעמידה ביעדי הלו"ז האיכות והמחיר עליהם התחייב התחום
עבודה בגישה מערכתית תוך שת"פ בתוך המנהל ומחוצה לו
גיבוש אסטרטגיה טכנולוגית המובילה לחדשנות הגשת המועמדות ניתנת לביצוע 19/11/2026 בשעה 16:00 הגשת המועמדות כוללת: השבה על השאלון המצורף ועמידה בתנאי הסף. מועמדים/ות מתאימים/ות יזומנו לראיון אישי ובמידת הצורך למבדקי התאמה. הגשת הפנייה מהווה הסכמת המועמד/ת לעריכת בדיקות ומבדקים ככל שיידרשו, כולל תחקיר לסיווג הביטחוני. הוועדה אינה מתחייבת לזמן את כל הפונים/ות לראיון ו/או למבדקים ו/או להמליץ על מועמדותו/ה של מי מהם/ן. הפניה מיועדת לגברים ולנשים כאחד אולי יעניין אותך לדעת מפעל הנדסה ומערכות הוא חלק מחטיבת אלתא בתעשייה האווירית, ועוסק בפיתוח ובייצור של חומרה אלקטרונית, מערכות מיקרוגל ומכניקה עבור כלל מערכות אלתא. מדובר במפעל שנמצא בליבת העשייה הטכנולוגית של החטיבה, ומשלב מגוון רחב של דיסציפלינות הנדסיות – אלקטרוניקה, חומרה, RF, מכניקה, הנדסת ייצור ואינטגרציה. העבודה במפעל מאפשרת לקחת חלק בתהליכים הנדסיים מורכבים, החל משלב הפיתוח והתכנון, דרך העברה מפיתוח לייצור ועד לשילוב המערכות. זו הזדמנות לעבוד בסביבה טכנולוגית מתקדמת, עם ממשקים מקצועיים מגוונים, על מוצרים ומערכות בעלי משמעות ביטחונית אמיתית.

job.title: Sales Operations
job.snippet:
Description
Business Development Operations
builds the operating system behind Elsight’s business development team—the tools, data, processes, and working rhythms that turn activity into coordinated execution and help us reach our revenue goals. You will create the foundation that enables the team to move faster, make better decisions, and follow through consistently. This is a builder role for someone who enjoys starting with a blank page, making sense of complexity, and creating practical ways of working. You’ll shape how the function operates as we scale—bringing clarity, visibility, and ownership without adding unnecessary bureaucracy—so our business development team can spend more time with customers and partners and less time navigating friction.
Who are we?
Elsight builds the technology that keeps autonomous systems connected and mission-ready—anywhere, across air, land, and maritime domains. Our Halo platform is already field-proven across more than 500,000 operational hours and trusted by 80+ customers worldwide, from defense forces to commercial operators. We took a bold idea and turned it into a proven public company (ASX: ELS) at the forefront of the autonomy revolution. With 10x year-over-year revenue growth and rapid global expansion, we're scaling fast—and we're just getting started. Join us to work on hard, meaningful problems alongside people who care about getting them right, and to help shape one of the defining technology shifts of the decade.
You will…
Build and continuously improve the processes, tools, and working rhythms that power our business development organization.
Design a clear operating flow from initial opportunity through qualification, ownership, follow-up, and handoff—making sure promising conversations turn into action.
Own the quality and structure of our CRM and business development data, creating a reliable source of truth for the team.
Develop practical dashboards, reporting, and forecasting that give leadership clear visibility into pipeline health, priorities, progress, and risks.
Create effective planning and review cadences that keep a global team aligned without adding unnecessary meetings or bureaucracy.
Connect business development with Product, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and field teams so information flows quickly and commitments are followed through.
Build the operational foundation for customer, partner, and OEM activity, including clear ownership, next steps, enablement, and measurable outcomes.
Identify friction and gaps in how we work, get to the root cause, and implement solutions that help the team move faster and make better decisions.
Document playbooks and standards that make successful ways of working repeatable as the company and team grow.
Requirements:
Apply if you have…
2-3 years of experience in business development operations, sales operations, revenue operations, or a similar role in a fast-growing B2B organization.
A track record of building practical processes, systems, and operating rhythms from the ground up—not just maintaining existing ones.
Strong hands-on experience with CRM platforms (HubSpot) and the ability to design clear data structures, workflows, governance, and adoption standards.
Experience developing pipeline reporting, dashboards, forecasting, and performance insights that leaders and teams can act on.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn incomplete or complex information into clear priorities and practical solutions.
Strong project management and execution skills, including the ability to coordinate cross-functional initiatives, clarify ownership, and drive follow-through.
Clear, concise communication skills and the confidence to work effectively with senior leaders and globally distributed teams.
A collaborative, service-oriented mindset—you enjoy enabling others while constructively challenging habits that create friction or slow the team down.
High ownership, attention to detail, and sound judgment, with the ability to balance structure and speed in a rapidly changing environment.
Professional fluency in English.
If you’ve made it this far and are excited about the opportunity, don’t let a few unchecked boxes hold you back. If you believe you’re a strong fit for the role, we’d love to hear from you.

Operations & Back Office Coordinator
to join an established engineering and technology company specializing in advanced solutions for the electronics industry.

Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel.
Experience with Priority ERP – an advantage.
Independent, service-oriented, and proactive approach.
Location:
Petah Tikva, on-site

Part-time position, 6 hours per day.

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
משרד אדריכלים יוקרתי בקיסריה מגייס הנדסאי/ת אדריכלות בעל/ת ניסיון לתפקיד מפתח איכותי, המשלב ניהול פרויקטים, סדר וידע מקצועי, עם שכר גבוה במיוחד!
תיאור תפקיד:
- אחריות מלאה על ניהול פרויקטים משלב הפתיחה ועד למסירת התוכניות.
- ניהול תהליכים שוטף ומקצה לקצה במערכת Monday.com.
- הכנת תוכניות ושרטוטים ב-AutoCAD וטיפול מקצועי בתיקי רישוי, היתרים והגשות מול הרשויות.
- עבודה צמודה מול יועצים, ספקים ולקוחות, כולל תיאום פגישות שוטף.
- השתלבות במשרד צומח ויציב המציע הזדמנות מקצועית לטווח ארוך.
שכר ותנאים:
- שכר : 12,000 למשרה מלאה - שכר משתנה בהתאם להיקף המשרה.
- ימים א-ה, משרה מלאה.
- עבודה מהמשרד בקיסריה, עם אפשרות לשילוב עבודה מהבית.
-  מיקום: קיסריה
דרישות התפקיד
- השכלה כהנדסאי/ת אדריכלות.
- ניסיון מוכח של שנתיים לפחות במשרד שעסק ברישוי , התרי בנייה (בתחומי האדריכלות, עיצוב הפנים או התכנון) - חובה.
- נכונות ומוכנות לעבודה בתור פרילנסר או שכיר.
- שליטה מלאה ב-AutoCAD והבנה מעמיקה בהיתרי בנייה ורישוי
- ניסיון ב-Revit, SketchUp או Canva - יתרון משמעותי.
- "ראש גדול", יכולת ניהול עצמאית של מספר משימות במקביל ואוריינטציה טכנולוגית גבוהה.
שליחת קורות חיים או הגשת מועמדות מהווה הסכמה לכך שחברת ג׳וב ספייס בע״מ תשמור ותשתמש בפרטיך, לרבות למטרת פנייה אליך בנוגע למשרות נוספות ודומות ולהעברת פרטיך למעסיקים פוטנציאליים בעתיד.
השימוש במידע ייעשה בהתאם למדיניות הפרטיות של החברה ובה גם מידע על זכויותיך.
ניתן לסרב לשימוש עתידי כאמור במידע בשליחת ״תמחקו אותי״ או לפנות בכל שאלה או בקשה בנושא לכתובת privacy@jobspacepro.com.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.snippet:
א
טכנאי/ת שטח למערכות פינוי אשפה פנאומטיות
אלונטק
פתח תקווה
ללא נסיון
משרה מלאה
לפני 6 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
אלונטק מתמחה במערכות פינוי אשפה פנאומטיות בפרויקטי מגורים מובילים בישראל. אנחנו מגייסים טכנאי/ת שטח לצוות השירות והתחזוקה.
תיאור התפקיד:
תחזוקה שוטפת ומונעת של מערכות אשפה פנאומטיות באתרי לקוחות.
איתור ותיקון תקלות מכניות, חשמליות ופנאומטיות.
טיפול בדחסניות, בוכנות, מנועים, חיישנים ומכלולים מכניים.
מתן שירות מקצועי ואדיב ללקוחות בשטח.
חשוב לנו לומר מראש: העבודה כוללת עבודה פיזית בחדרי אשפה ובסביבה שאינה תמיד נקייה. לצד זה תפגשו טכנולוגיה מתקדמת, אפשרויות להתקדמות ופיתוח אישי, אתגרים מקצועיים מגוונים וסיפוק אמיתי מפתרון תקלות בשטח.
אנחנו מציעים:
הכשרה מקצועית מלאה, ללא צורך בניסיון קודם בתחום
רכב חברה צמוד
משרה מלאה ויציבה
רכישת מקצוע ייחודי
דרישות התפקיד

נכונות לעבודת שטח וניידות בין אתרים
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.title: Engine Technician
job.snippet:
About the Role
Lowental Hybrid is looking for an Engine Technician to join its engineering team. In this hands-on role, you will build and assemble engines and hybrid propulsion systems for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), prepare them for testing, conduct ground runs and acceptance tests, and maintain the engine test cell.
You will work closely with mechanical and electrical engineers, helping turn designs into hardware and verify how it performs in the test cell.
Responsibilities
Assemble engines and install them in the test cell.
Carry out engine runs and tests in accordance with test procedures.
Troubleshoot faults and perform routine maintenance on engines and the test cell.
Document engine runs and follow safety procedures.
Minimum Qualifications
Training as an automotive or aircraft mechanic, or equivalent technical training.
Ability to read engineering drawings and use measuring tools.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with UAV engines or two-stroke engines.
Experience working in an engine test cell or with a dynamometer.
Familiarity with electronic fuel injection (EFI) and basic electrical systems.

Machine Operator / Integrator
for a diverse role that includes operating production presses, conducting tests for consumables, developing inks according to specifications, and handling the preparation and filling of ink orders for customers.

Operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of HP Indigo printing presses
Performing quality tests for consumables according to guidelines and procedures
Developing and adjusting inks based on customer requirements or internal specifications
Preparing and filling inks for customer orders according to defined standards
Accurate documentation of work processes, test results, and customer orders
Collaborating with engineering, quality assurance, and production teams
Participating in initiatives to improve processes, efficiency, and quality

Proven experience working in a production line environment, preferably with multidisciplinary systems
Familiarity with inks and consumables – Advantage
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings
Experience writing technical reports and documenting issues – Mandatory
Familiarity with continuous improvement processes
Attention to detail, high responsibility, service-oriented approach, and ability to work independently and in a team

job.title: International eCommerce Director
job.snippet:
We are looking for a senior ecommerce leader to own the international direct-to-consumer business of a successful global consumer brand.
This is a director-level role with full business ownership: revenue, profitability and customer experience across the brand's international online stores, in multiple markets worldwide. You will set the multi-market strategy and growth roadmap, lead a team of managers and specialists alongside external partners, and stay close enough to the data, the funnel and the partners to drive results market by market.
What you will own:
The international D2C P&L: business plan and forecast per market, cost and profitability management, and investment allocation by potential and return
The commercial plan for the online stores: launches, assortment, merchandising and promotions, together with demand and inventory planning
The international store setup: localization, pricing, payments and compliance to one global standard
The customer journey end to end, conversion optimization and testing
CRM, loyalty and retention programs that grow customer lifetime value
Paid media, SEO and AI discoverability
Selection and management of agencies and partners
KPIs and per-market reporting to senior management
Team:
You will lead an in-house team of managers and specialists together with external partners as one integrated team, and own its structure, objectives, performance, recruitment and development.
Must have:
8+ years in ecommerce / D2C, including at least 3 years managing a team with P&L accountability
Proven ownership of a multi-market D2C P&L across several international markets
Deep hands-on experience with Shopify (Shopify Plus an advantage) in multi-store or multi-market setups
Strong track record in performance marketing, CRO and lifecycle marketing, with a data-driven approach
Experience leading in-house teams and external agencies at scale
Fluency with ecommerce metrics and tools (GA4, Shopify analytics)
Excellent English and strong senior-level stakeholder management
Nice to have:
Background in premium consumer brands
Experience with international SEO and AI/answer-engine visibility
Experience in a global company with local market teams
To apply, send your CV to jobs@banani-hr.com, job number 742582.

job.title: משרת אחראי/ת כספים, גבייה וחשבונות פרויקטים למחלקת הכספים במשרד דוד מהנדסים
job.snippet:
משרת אחראי/ת כספים, גבייה וחשבונות פרויקטים למחלקת הכספים במשרד דוד מהנדסים
/
משרה מס' 115
תיאור התפקיד:
מחלקת הכספים בחברתנו מתרחבת, ואנו מחפשים איש/אשת מקצוע חזק/ה, אסרטיבי/ת ודקדקן/ית, לטיפול במערך הצעות המחיר, החשבונות והגבייה עבור עבודות ושינויים בפרויקטים השונים של החברה.
תחומי אחריות מרכזיים
:
ניהול מחזור החשבון מקצה לקצה – משלב הגשת הצעת המחיר, דרך מעקב אחר אישורים והפקת החשבון, ועד לגבייה בפועל.
חקירה וניתוח מעמיק של נתונים, לרבות חשבונות שלא שולמו, איתור שורש הבעיה ופתרונה.
גביית חשבונות ועמידה ביעדי הגבייה כפי שיוגדרו על ידי החברה.
עבודה שוטפת מול לקוחות פנימיים וחיצוניים.
דרישות התפקיד:
·
ניסיון מקצועי של שנתיים לפחות בגבייה / כלכלת פרויקטים (עדיפות לרקע בענף הנדל"ן, הבנייה או ניהול פרויקטים).
·
תואר ראשון בכלכלה / מנהל עסקים / משפטים – יתרון.
·
שליטה טובה בתוכנות Office, לרבות Excel.
·
שליטה ב־Monday – יתרון.
כישורים ומיומנויות נדרשים:
·
אסרטיביות, יכולת ורבלית גבוהה, כושר שכנוע ויחסי אנוש מעולים.
·
יסודיות ויכולת ניתוח נתונים – ראש גדול שמחפש פתרונות ולא רק מציף בעיות.
·
יכולת עבודה עצמאית ובצוות – ניהול עצמי של משימות ולוחות זמנים, בקרה וקידום תהליכים מתחילתם ועד סופם.
מה אנחנו מציעים?
·
סביבת עבודה דינמית, מקצועית ויציבה.
·
תפקיד מרכזי עם השפעה ישירה על הצלחת החברה.
·
תנאים מתגמלים למתאימים/ות.
אופן הגשת מועמדות:
יש לשלוח קורות חיים לכתובת המייל: Jobs@davideng.co.il
.
שימו לב: רק פניות מתאימות ייענו.
הצטרפו אלינו וקחו חלק בהובלת עולם ההנדסה בעתיד!

Electrical Department Superintendent
Nephi City is seeking a qualified and experienced leader to direct its municipal electric utility, ensuring safe, reliable, and cost-effective power delivery for the community.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
High school diploma or equivalent.
Completion of a recognized Journeyman Lineman apprenticeship, or equivalent electric utility certification.
At least 6 years of progressively responsible electric utility construction, operation and maintenance experience, including at least 3 years in a supervisory or lead role.
Any equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Experience with overhead and underground distribution systems and with operating bucket trucks, and line trucks.
Valid Utah driver's license and a valid Commercial Driver License (CDL), or ability to obtain a CDL within six months of hire.
Current or obtainable First Aid/CPR and utility safety certifications.
Ability to climb poles, work from aerial devices, work safely around energized equipment and respond to emergencies after hours.
Ability to pass a background check, pre-employment drug screening and driving record review.
Strong knowledge of electric utility construction, operation and maintenance practices.
Ability to read engineering plans, schematics, maps and specifications.
Clear, professional communication with crews, customers, officials and contractors.
Sound judgment and steady leadership, especially in emergencies. Preferred Qualifications
Experience as a lead lineman, foreman, crew leader or utility supervisor.
Associate or bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering technology, utility management, business or a related field.
Municipal or public power experience, including UMPA or other joint action agency membership.
Knowledge of substations, SCADA, AMI, protective relaying, metering and distribution automation.
Experience with budgeting, rate analysis and capital project management.
Working knowledge of GIS, Blue beam software, outage management, and work order software.

job.title: Ad Operations Manager
job.snippet:
Company Description
Benefit Media Group is a marketing performance agency that specializes in high-end, tech-savvy digital media solutions tailored to the modern, complex digital ecosystem. The company helps brands and agencies grow by mastering advanced, personalized programmatic and data-driven strategies for the new-media era. Its team leverages deep industry knowledge, extensive experience, and hands-on best practices to provide clients with a strong competitive advantage. Beyond programmatic media buying, Benefit Media Group partners with a wide range of businesses to strengthen branding strategies and create distinctive, recognizable brand identities.
Role Description
The Ad Operations Manager is a full-time, hybrid role based in Israel, combining on-site collaboration with the option to work from home part of the time. In this position, the Ad Operations Manager oversees end-to-end campaign setup, trafficking, and optimization across programmatic and other digital channels, ensuring accurate implementation of targeting, tracking, and creative assets. The role includes monitoring campaign performance, identifying issues, troubleshooting delivery and technical problems, and collaborating with account managers, media buyers, and analytics teams to improve results. The Ad Operations Manager will manage ad platforms and ad servers, maintain documentation and process standards, and contribute to workflow automation and efficiency. The role also involves regular reporting, quality assurance, and participation in strategy discussions to align operations with client goals and evolving market needs.
Qualifications
Proficiency in digital ad operations, including campaign trafficking, ad server management, and QA of tags, pixels, and creatives.
Experience with programmatic platforms (e.g., DSPs), audience targeting, and data-driven optimization techniques.
Strong analytical skills, including working with performance data, troubleshooting delivery issues, and interpreting reports.
Solid understanding of digital marketing concepts such as attribution, brand awareness, performance marketing, and conversion tracking.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously.
Clear, professional communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical, creative, and client-facing teams.
Comfort with technology and tools used in ad operations, including spreadsheets, project management platforms, and analytics dashboards.
Relevant experience in ad operations, media buying, or digital campaign management; agency or performance marketing background is an advantage.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (such as Business, Marketing, Communications, Information Systems) or equivalent practical experience.
Fluency in English for day-to-day operations; additional language skills and familiarity with the Israeli digital market are beneficial.

job.title: Product Manager
job.snippet:
About WEKA
WEKA is redefining the enterprise data stack for the age of AI. Our platform enables the world’s most advanced organizations to run high-performance workloads - from large-scale model training to real-time inference - faster and more efficiently.
WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company on a hyper-growth trajectory. We’ve raised $375M in capital with dozens of world-class venture capital and strategic investors. We help the world’s largest and most innovative enterprises and research organizations, including 12 of the Fortune 50, achieve discoveries, insights, and business outcomes faster and more sustainably. We’re passionate about solving our customers’ most complex data challenges to accelerate intelligent innovation and business value. If you share our passion, we invite you to join us on this exciting journey.
The Role
This Is a Rare Opportunity To
Have a direct impact on AI performance and GPU efficiency at scale
Combine deep technical thinking with product ownership
Own product decisions that influence real-world system behavior
As a Product Manager at WEKA, you will define how next-generation AI workloads interact with high-performance storage and networking systems.
This is a
deep-tech product role at the core of our platform
, where your decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and efficiency across large-scale AI environments.
You’ll operate at the intersection of
product, distributed systems, and hardware-aware infrastructure
- shaping how modern data platforms are built and optimized.
What You'll Do
Define and execute product strategy for WEKA’s platform and infrastructure layer
Own the product roadmap - balancing innovation, performance, and customer needs
Work closely with engineering to design and deliver high-performance capabilities
Translate complex technical challenges into clear product decisions and priorities
Partner with customers and internal teams to understand real-world use cases and constraints
Stay ahead of trends in storage, networking, and distributed systems
Collaborate with top engineers, architects, and customers solving cutting-edge challenges
What You Bring
You’re a product thinker with a strong technical foundation, who enjoys going deep into complex systems.
You might come from one (or more) of these backgrounds:
Product Manager in infrastructure / platform / deep-tech domains
Software Engineer or Architect who transitioned into product
Sales Engineer highly experienced with storage, networking, or distributed systems
Your Experience Includes
Experience in one or more of the following:
Storage systems (e.g., NVMe, SSDs, RAID)
Networking / high-performance protocols (e.g., RDMA, DPDK)
Distributed systems / infrastructure platforms
Ability to work closely with engineering on complex technical challenges
Strong communication skills - able to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience driving product decisions in fast-paced environments
Nice to Have
Familiarity with technologies like RDMA (InfiniBand, RoCE), GPUDirect Storage, or kernel-bypass networking
Understanding of performance optimization (latency, throughput, IOPS)
Experience with large-scale data or AI infrastructure

job.title: Solution Architect Digital Products (f/m/d)
job.snippet:
A Snapshot of Your Day
As a Solution Architect for Digital Products, you start your day with a stand-up meeting with global teams from Florida to India, discussing project statuses and dependencies. You translate complex business needs into clear architectural frameworks and actionable roadmaps, ensuring alignment with product owners and stakeholders. Throughout the day, you lead design reviews and technical workshops, mentoring engineering teams to maintain high software quality standards. You also engage in strategic discussions on scalable architectures for front-end, back-end, and IoT services, effectively communicating technical concepts to diverse audiences. Your role is dynamic, balancing multiple priorities while fostering a culture of innovation and excellence.
How You’ll Make An Impact
Take ownership for large programs with 15+ global (Florida to India) development teams, mitigate and drive cross team dependencies, set standards for the solution, technical decision-making and risk management
Translate business needs into target architectures, reference patterns, technology standards, and actionable roadmaps for products and services.
Close collaboration with Product Owners, Architects, and key stakeholders to align technical solutions with business objectives
Leadership and mentoring of multiple, global software development teams for large solutions
Architecture of scalable front-end, back-end, and IoT platform services as the digital backbone for customer solutions
Coach engineering teams through design reviews, technical workshops, proofs of concept, and production readiness assessments while promoting high software quality and operational excellence.
Communicate complex architecture topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and build a trustful relationship with many business stakeholder groups.
What You Bring
A master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, combined with extensive experience in software development and architecture.
Extensive hands-on experience in software development, including data structures, SQL, and time-series data
Practical expertise in Docker, Kubernetes, DevOps practices, and the design and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines
Proven knowledge of security best practices, microservice and monolithic architectures, scalable and distributed systems, SaaS solutions, testing frameworks, QA principles, and documentation standards
Analytical, proactive, and ownership-driven mindset
Certifications like AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional and Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert are preferred
Longstanding experience in architecture or technical leadership role, ideally across multiple products, platforms, or business domains.
Hands-on understanding of modern solution delivery, including generative AI, data platforms, cloud-native systems, and software engineering practices.
Strong systems thinking and sound judgment when balancing speed, quality, security, cost, maintainability, and business value.
About The Team
Siemens Energy “Digital Products and Solutions” team (DPS) supports all SE Business Areas in their growth of their digital business. We consult, design and develop tailored solutions for the customer market, based on their specific technical and commercial constraints. Samples can be found here: Digital services (siemens-energy.com)
Our second mission is to professionalize, automate and standardize software development in Siemens Energy.
In the central Digital Products and Solutions (DPS) organization, our Technology and Innovation department is responsible to implement new and innovative technologies across DPS but also to Siemens Energy.
In DPS, our software products already cover a wide range of categories, and we see many opportunities for growth: Asset Performance Management, Energy Management, Asset Monitoring, Asset Health Prediction, Customer Portal & AI-assisted Applications, Connectivity & Edge, Backend Core / Domain / Platform Services, and Professional Services.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
Rewards/Benefits
In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical
We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Longstanding experience in architecture or technical leadership role, ideally across multiple products, platforms, or business domains.

Strong systems thinking and sound judgment when balancing speed, quality, security, cost, maintainability, and business value.

job.title: Data Scientist
job.snippet:
Data Scientist – AI & Real-World Evidence
Based at Schneider Children’s Medical Center
Why This Role Matters
Children are not small adults, yet much of the medicine they receive was never designed or tested with them in mind. Drugs, medical devices, and increasingly AI-based tools reach the market and the clinic after being developed and validated almost entirely on adult data, and children are left to benefit from them, or be harmed by them, without the evidence to know which. We want to change that reality. This role exists to build the evidence that children deserve: rigorous, real-world, and grounded in data from children themselves.
About the Role
We are seeking a Data Scientist to lead work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, multimodal clinical data, and real-world evidence, as part of a team working to heal today’s children and create tomorrow’s healthy adults. This is a hands-on role at a leading children’s hospital, combining advanced modeling, rigorous research methods, and close collaboration with clinicians, researchers, and industry partners.
The role has two connected missions.
The first is to lead real-world evidence studies in collaboration with pharmaceutical, medical device, and technology companies, including multimodal studies and the evaluation of AI-based medical devices in real clinical settings. The second is to evaluate data platforms and technologies for organizing, integrating, and analyzing multimodal clinical data for research. Both missions share a single goal: to determine, rigorously and independently, what AI and real-world data can actually deliver for children’s health.
Requirements
The role is intended for candidates with a master’s degree or PhD in data science, computer science, biostatistics, or another relevant quantitative field, with proven experience leading applied research or AI projects in healthcare, from the initial question through to deliverables. We are looking for strong hands-on experience developing and validating machine learning models on medical data, including deep learning, along with high proficiency in Python and SQL. Experience working with large clinical databases and longitudinal data is required, including data processing, integration, quality control, and handling missing data, as is experience working with more than one data modality.
Candidates should bring a solid grounding in statistics and observational study design, including an understanding of bias and confounding, and the ability to critically evaluate AI systems and data products rather than take their outputs at face value. We expect well-documented, reproducible work, the ability to quickly learn new clinical domains and translate clinical and research needs into a work plan, and strong scientific and critical thinking, independence, initiative, teamwork, and excellent English.
Above all, we are looking for someone who can move forward even when the need is not yet well defined: asking the right questions, understanding the possibilities and limitations of data and technology, and choosing the right research approach.
Significant Advantages
Significant advantage will be given to experience in the pharmaceutical, medical device, or digital health industry, or at a CRO, or in leading studies in collaboration with such companies. Additional advantages include experience with the regulatory and evidence requirements for AI-based medical devices; experience in RWE, pharmacoepidemiology, and causal inference, including matching and weighting methods; experience with large language models, foundation models, or multimodal model architectures; experience evaluating clinical data platforms or data technologies; and familiarity with medical data standards and terminologies such as OMOP, FHIR, ICD, and ATC.

job.title: Research Student (PHD) Or Fellows
job.snippet:
Open Call for PhD Students and Postdoctoral Researchers
Music, Science, Engineering & Medicine | Technion, Haifa, Israel
I invite prospective PhD students and postdoctoral researchers to work with me at the Technion – Israel Institute of Technology. I welcome musicians interested in studying how performance communicates meaning, as well as researchers in science, engineering, and medicine who see music as a way to investigate the mind, brain, and body.
The Technion is a research university in Haifa that brings engineering, science, medicine, and the humanities and arts together on one campus. As Associate Professor of Creative Arts in the Department of Humanities and Arts, I bring the perspective of a concert pianist, composer, and improviser to collaborations with scientific and clinical researchers.
Research areas
Music communication, live performance, and audience experience
Music perception and cognition, including attention, memory, emotion, and imagination
Music and the brain, including the neural basis of listening and performance
Musical interpretation, expressive choices, and individual performance signatures
Improvisation, cognitive flexibility, creativity, and decision-making
Music and AI, including computational analysis of performance and physiological responses to music
Musical expertise, motor control, biomedical engineering, and neurorehabilitation
Original proposals connecting music with other fields are also welcome.
Responsibilities and measures of success
PhD students will develop a focused research question under my supervision, select methods suited to it, and carry the study through to a dissertation. Depending on the project, this might involve designing a listening experiment, analysing performances or audience responses, or working with physiological data.
Postdoctoral researchers will take the lead on a defined project, contribute expertise from their own discipline, and work with collaborators to bring findings to publication. At both levels, success means producing original, rigorous research and communicating what it contributes to the fields involved.
Qualifications
I welcome applicants with a relevant background in music, the humanities, psychology, neuroscience, computer science, engineering, medicine, or a related field. I am particularly interested in the expertise you would bring to a specific question, whether through artistic practice, experimental design, qualitative research, clinical work, or data analysis. Postdoctoral applicants should hold a PhD by the start of the appointment.
How to apply
Email your CV, a 1–2 page statement outlining your proposed research and relevant experience, and examples of your work to oritw@technion.ac.il. Examples may include publications, recordings, or research projects. Please use the subject line
Application – Research Collaboration
and specify whether you are applying for doctoral or postdoctoral research. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
Full call and application details

Associate Professor of Creative Arts
Technion – Israel Institute of Technology

job.title: Technical Solutions Consultant, gTech Ads Sellside (English)
job.snippet:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
3 years of experience in project management, web technologies and data analysis.
Ability to communicate in English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.
Preferred qualifications:
Experience with coding in languages such as Python, C++ or Java, and familiarity with SQL/MySQL and Unix/Linux operating systems/commands.
Demonstrated ability to adapt your message to the technical level of the audience and comfort presenting technical materials to groups of any size and background.
Excellent business communication, problem-solving and investigative, and presentation skills with an ability to communicate in Hebrew fluently to support client relationship management in this region.
Excellent collaboration skills for working across geographically dispersed functions.
Excellent data analysis and good data-driven decision-making skills.
About The Job
As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for the technical relationship of our largest advertising clients and/or product partners. You will lead cross-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.
You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.
gTech Ads Sellside takes a customer centric, creative, and collaborative approach to provide foundational services and forward-looking business solutions to advertiser and publisher customers. Through technical implementations, optimizations, and key solutions, gTech Ads Sellside's product/solution experts help customers attain their business goals while building long-term capabilities.
Responsibilities
Help partners in their day-to-day issues by providing consultation, delivering innovative and scalable solutions, and conducting technical troubleshooting to their problems and pain points. Advocate new product features and ensure the prompt and proper resolution of technical issues.
Assist clients in the adoption of new products via upgrades and migrations to develop their long-term success and improve product offerings by providing client feedback on features to Product Management and Engineering.
Guarantee the technical aspects of client integrations (both new and ongoing) by providing necessary documentation and technical guidance. Present in front of small or mid-sized groups of internal stakeholders and customers.
Analyze and optimize the development of existing clients to ensure their success with the Google suite of products for partners.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

job.title: Senior Planner
job.snippet:
A rapidly growing and successful defense technology company is looking for a
Senior Planner
to join its Operations team.
This is a key role for an experienced planning professional looking to make a real impact in a fast-paced, growing environment, with the flexibility to work from home one day per week after the first three months.
Responsibilities:
Lead end-to-end planning activities across supply, materials, inventory, and production
Translate forecasts, sales trends, and business requirements into actionable operational plans
Manage and optimize MRP and ERP-based planning processes
Monitor inventory levels, material availability, open orders, and supply risks
Coordinate with suppliers, procurement, logistics, warehouses, and internal stakeholders locally and globally
Track production plans, shipment timelines, replenishment, and material availability
Maintain and optimize planning parameters within the ERP system, including lead times, MOQ, safety stock, and reorder points
Support forecasting, purchasing, inventory optimization, and supply planning processes
Identify operational gaps, delays, risks, and bottlenecks, and drive corrective actions
Develop and maintain planning reports, KPIs, and operational analyses
Drive process improvements and support the development of scalable planning and operational processes
Partner with cross-functional teams to improve planning accuracy, efficiency, and overall operational performance
Requirements:
5+ years of experience in Planning, Supply Chain, or Operations
Experience working in a manufacturing or industrial environment
Proven experience with forecasting, supply planning, inventory, and logistics
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
Excellent understanding of operational processes and supply chain dynamics
Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP systems; NetSuite is a strong advantage
Advanced Excel skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
Strong ownership, attention to detail, and cross-functional communication skills
High level of written and spoken English

job.title: Senior Information Systems Engineer AI & Automation
job.snippet:
We are looking for a highly experienced and innovative Senior Information Systems Engineer - AI & Automation to join our Information Systems department. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role within a team responsible for managing, maintaining, and evolving a portfolio of enterprise IS platforms.
In this role, you will be at the forefront of driving AI adoption and automation across our Information Systems landscape. Approximately 80% of your time will be spent on hands-on engineering, integration development, and platform optimization, while the remaining 20% will focus on strategic thinking — identifying opportunities, evaluating emerging technologies, and shaping the IS roadmap for AI-driven innovation.
We are seeking a seasoned professional with a proven track record of delivering results in complex IS environments. This is not an entry-level position — we need someone who has accumulated significant experience across IS platforms, integrations, and AI technologies, and who brings a strong sense of ownership, initiative, and a forward-thinking mindset.
What will your job look like?
Design, implement, and maintain AI-powered solutions and automation workflows across enterprise IS platforms.
Evaluate, pilot, and deploy emerging AI tools and technologies to enhance IS capabilities, streamline processes, and improve operational efficiency.
Lead cross-functional IS projects from requirements gathering through delivery, ensuring timely execution and alignment with business objectives.
Develop and maintain custom scripts, connectors, and technical solutions to bridge gaps between platforms and enable seamless data flow.
Continuously monitor the AI and IS technology landscape, proactively identifying opportunities for innovation and improvement.
Contribute to the definition of IS standards, best practices, and architectural guidelines for AI and automation adoption.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and translate them into scalable, AI-enhanced IS solutions.
Document technical designs, integration architectures, and operational procedures to ensure knowledge transfer and continuity.
All you need is:
Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Industrial Engineering & Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in Information Systems engineering, administration, or a comparable role in enterprise environments.
Proven experience with Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence, and related tools) and familiarity with project/work management platforms such as Asana and Monday.com.
Demonstrated knowledge and hands-on experience with AI technologies, tools, and frameworks as applied to Information Systems — including AI-driven automation, intelligent workflows, and AI-assisted development.
Strong experience with integration platforms (e.g., Workato, N8N, or equivalent) and a solid understanding of APIs, webhooks, and data orchestration patterns.
Solid coding and scripting abilities with the capacity to develop, debug, and maintain custom integrations, automation scripts, and technical solutions.
Proven ability to independently manage and deliver IS projects end-to-end, including planning, stakeholder coordination, risk management, and execution.
A strong track record of identifying opportunities for improvement, proposing innovative solutions, and driving change within an IS organization.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Highly autonomous, proactive, and reliable — able to take ownership of initiatives and deliver results with minimal supervision.
Nice to have:
Experience with additional IS platforms beyond the Atlassian ecosystem (e.g., ServiceNow, Salesforce, or ERP systems).
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-based IS architectures.
Experience with scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, or Groovy in the context of IS automation.
Experience working in large-scale, global enterprise environments with complex IS ecosystems.

job.title: Senior Research Engineer
job.snippet:
We built an agentic platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketers, and major brands like Spotify, TED, NBC, Netflix, and Disney capture and create high quality audio and video content with ease.
The traditional production process is slow and never built for today's scale. Riverside's technology streamlines the entire content production process, turning real conversations into professional grade videos, podcasts, webinars, livestreams, and whatever comes next.
About The Innovation Team
At Riverside, the Innovation team is all about pushing the limits of AI to transform content creation. We work on everything from enhancing audio and video quality to automating production with machine learning, NLP, and computer vision. Whether it’s real-time rendering, intelligent editing, or new ways to process media, we turn cutting-edge research into practical tools that creators rely on. If you’re excited about shaping the future of media tech, you’ll fit right in.
On your day to day
We are looking for a brilliant and highly motivated AI Engineer with a focus on NLP to join our team that is revolutionizing how audio and video content is transcribed, analyzed, understood, and edited. You will work closely with our product and other engineering teams, as your research and development will serve as the core of the most cutting-edge features of our mobile and web applications. You will conduct research, identify trends, and explore new methodologies to enhance the performance, efficiency, and scalability of our AI systems, while leveraging the latest tech to push the boundaries of innovation in product and bring the most value to our customers.
Requirements:
What Will Make You Stand Out?
M.Sc. or PhD. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field
5+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying machine learning models into production
Strong background in ML, Deep Learning or NLP
Experience in leveraging large-scale compute resources, including distributed GPUs, to train, test, and evaluate models
Hands-on experience fine-tuning models and RL-based post-training
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, and experience with relevant libraries and frameworks (OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.)
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

job.title: Game Delivery Specialist
job.snippet:
The Games Delivery Specialist is responsible for ensuring customer-specific game adaptations are efficiently communicated, documented, and implemented within an iLottery gaming studio. This role serves as the bridge between Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and the delivery team. It converts game specifications into actionable requirements to ensure successful game deliveries that meet customer expectations.
What You'll Do
Customer Requirements Analysis
Partner with Customer Success Managers to gather and understand detailed game specifications for each customer.
Ensure clear communication to address specification updates or clarifications promptly.
User Story Creation
Convert customer-specific game requirements into detailed, actionable user stories using Agile methodologies.
Define and document clear acceptance criteria to align with customer expectations and internal standards.
Collaboration with the Delivery Team
Work closely with developers, QA specialists, and designers to ensure user stories are accurately implemented.
Act as the primary contact for clarifications and follow-ups during the development lifecycle.
Documentation and Tracking
Maintain detailed and organized documentation of all game specifications and corresponding user stories.
Monitor the progress of user stories to ensure timely and accurate delivery to customers.
Quality Assurance Support
Collaborate with QA teams to validate that the delivered games meet the outlined customer requirements.
Assist in identifying and resolving any gaps or issues in the final product.
Process Improvement
Proactively suggest and implement enhancements to the processes for capturing customer requirements and developing user stories.
Contribute to improving overall efficiency and collaboration between CSMs, delivery teams, and other stakeholders.
What We're Looking For
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Experience:
1 year in a related role, such as Product Owner, Delivery Specialist, or Business Analyst in the gaming, software, or iLottery industry.
Agile development experience is highly preferred.
Skills:
Strong analytical and organizational skills with a detail-oriented mindset.
Attention to detail
Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities for cross-functional collaboration.
Proficiency in project management tools like Jira, Trello, Monday.com or similar platforms for managing user stories and tracking progress.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively in a dynamic environment.
This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.
Compensation Philosophy
We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.
Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.
Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

הצטרפו למפעל
MRO
מוביל בחטיבת התעופה שלנו, בתפקיד קריטי כ
משפצ/ת מיסבים ואטמי פחם
. תפקיד זה מהווה נדבך חיוני בתחזוקת מנועי תעופה מתקדמים, ומציע סביבת עבודה מאתגרת, טכנית ומדויקת.
כחלק מצוות מקצועי ומסור, תיקחו חלק פעיל בתהליכי שיפוץ קריטיים המבטיחים את בטיחותם וביצועיהם של מנועי סילון, תוך עמידה בלתי מתפשרת בתקני איכות ובטיחות בינלאומיים מחמירים. התפקיד דורש הבנה טכנית מעמיקה, יכולת קריאת שרטוטים ואנגלית ברמה גבוהה.
תחומי האחריות:
ביצוע שיפוץ, בדיקה והחלפה של מיסבים ואטמי פחם במנועי תעופה שונים.
עבודה קפדנית בהתאם לנהלי היצרן הספציפיים ותקני איכות ובטיחות מחמירים.
קריאה והבנת שרטוטים טכניים מורכבים לצורך ביצוע עבודה מדויקת.
הבנת אנגלית מקצועית ברמה גבוהה לצורך עבודה עם מפרטים טכניים והוראות.
שיתוף פעולה הדוק ועבודת צוות שוטפת להשגת יעדי המפעל.
זוהי הזדמנות מצוינת לצמוח מקצועית, לרכוש הסמכות ורישיונות ייחודיים בתחום התעופה, ולהיות חלק מצוות המקבל החלטות חשובות במפעל MRO פורץ דרך.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.snippet:
About the Role
CONTROP is looking for a highly skilled and motivated Senior Software Engineer to join our Software Department and take a significant role in developing advanced, multidisciplinary electro-optical systems.
We are looking for more than an experienced developer. We seek a strong software engineer who combines deep technical expertise, excellent engineering fundamentals, a proactive mindset, and the ability to positively influence the technical direction and engineering practices of the team.
The ideal candidate is passionate about building high-quality software, embraces AI-powered development methodologies, and enjoys sharing knowledge, solving complex challenges, and driving technical excellence.
Key Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain complex software solutions using modern C++.
• Take end-to-end ownership of software features, from architecture and detailed design through implementation, testing, integration, and delivery.
• Contribute to software architecture, technical design decisions, and long-term maintainability.
• Leverage AI-powered development tools and methodologies to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and development efficiency.
• Champion modern software engineering practices, including clean code, code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration.
• Take an active role in establishing high engineering standards and fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
Must-Have Qualifications
• B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering from a recognized academic university, with a strong foundation in computer science and software engineering principles.
• At least 5 years of hands-on software development experience, including significant professional experience with C++.
• Strong proficiency in modern C++, object-oriented design, software architecture, and design patterns.
• Experience with Windows and Linux based software development
• Proven experience developing, debugging, and maintaining complex production-grade software systems.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools as an integral part of professional software development, including code generation, refactoring, debugging, test generation, or code review.
• Strong analytical skills, independent problem-solving capabilities, and sound technical judgment.
• Experience collaborating through code reviews, technical discussions, and cross-functional development.
• Excellent communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.
Advantages
• Familiarity with AI coding agents, AI-enabled engineering workflows, and secure use of AI tools in software development.
• Experience developing software for real-time, embedded, or performance-critical systems.
• Experience with additional programming languages, particularly C# and Python.
• Familiarity with computer vision, image processing, video pipelines, or electro-optical systems.
• Experience in multidisciplinary R&D environments involving hardware and software integration.
• Experience with Python, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development toolchains.
What Makes You a Great Fit
• You take ownership rather than wait for detailed instructions.
• You naturally raise the engineering standards of the teams you work with.
• You enjoy helping other engineers succeed and sharing your expertise.
• You can balance hands-on coding with broader technical thinking.
• You challenge existing approaches constructively and turn ideas into practical improvements.
• You are curious, adaptable, and eager to explore how AI is transforming professional software engineering
.
Join CONTROP and help us build the next generation of advanced software solutions, while

חברת פז, מהחברות הגדולות והמובילות במשק הישראלי, מגייסת עובדים/ות לתפקיד משרדי משמעותי, מאתגר ודינמי

תכנון וניהול סידורי עבודה לנהגי הפצה.
שליטה ובקרה על מלאי הדלקים ופעילות ההפצה.
עבודה שוטפת מול נהגים ולקוחות.
פתרון בעיות וקבלת החלטות בזמן אמת.

אחריות אישית גבוהה, ראש גדול ואסרטיביות.
יכולת עבודה תחת לחץ ופתרון בעיות.
שירותיות ויחסי אנוש מצוינים.
ניסיון בתחום התפעול או ההפצה - יתרון.
הזדמנות להשתלב בחברה גדולה, יציבה ומסודרת, וליהנות מביטחון תעסוקתי לטווח ארוך!
