הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
לחברה מובילה בתחום המטבחים והנגרות דרוש/ה מנהל/ת שירות לקוחות ומתאמי מתקינים לתפקיד מרכזי המשלב שירות, תיאום, ניהול ממשקים וליווי לקוחות לאורך תהליך ההתקנה.
אם אתם מגיעים מעולם המטבחים, הנגרות או השירות ואוהבים לעבוד מול אנשים – זו ההזדמנות שלכם!
תיאור התפקיד:
- ניהול מערך שירות הלקוחות ומתן מענה מקצועי ואיכותי.
- תיאום וניהול יומני מתקינים.
- ליווי הלקוחות משלב תיאום ההתקנה ועד לסיום התהליך.
- עבודה שוטפת מול מתקינים, צוותי ייצור, ספקים וגורמים פנימיים.
- טיפול בפניות, תקלות ומתן פתרונות בזמן אמת.
- תיאום מועדי התקנה ומעקב אחר ביצוע.
- עבודה בסביבה ממוחשבת ובשיתוף פעולה עם מחלקות החברה.
שכר ותנאים:
- שכר גלובלי מתגמל: בעלי ניסיון בסיסי כ-12,000 ₪, בעלי ניסיון משמעותי 13,000-13,500 ₪ (בהתאם לניסיון ולכישורים).
- משרה מלאה, ימים א'-ה', 08:00-17:00 (ללא ימי שישי).
- תנאים סוציאליים מלאים.
- עבודה בחברה יציבה ומובילה בסביבה מקצועית, משפחתית ונעימה, עם אפשרויות להתפתחות מקצועית לטווח ארוך.
- מיקום: מעלה אדומים
דרישות התפקיד
- ניסיון קודם בשירות הלקוחות – חובה.
-ניסיון קודם בתחום המטבחים/הנגרות/טכני/כלי עבודה -יתרון משמעותי
- שליטה בסיסית ביישומי מחשב
- ניסיון בחברות מטבחים או בניהול שירות בתחום המטבחים – יתרון משמעותי.
- ניסיון בעבודה מול מתקינים – יתרון.
שליחת קורות חיים או הגשת מועמדות מהווה הסכמה לכך שחברת ג׳וב ספייס בע״מ תשמור ותשתמש בפרטיך, לרבות למטרת פנייה אליך בנוגע למשרות נוספות ודומות ולהעברת פרטיך למעסיקים פוטנציאליים בעתיד.
השימוש במידע ייעשה בהתאם למדיניות הפרטיות של החברה ובה גם מידע על זכויותיך.
ניתן לסרב לשימוש עתידי כאמור במידע בשליחת ״תמחקו אותי״ או לפנות בכל שאלה או בקשה בנושא לכתובת privacy@jobspacepro.com.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

הגשה

הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
חברה טכנולוגית מובילה מגייסת אינטגרטור/ית מערכות מנוסה לתפקיד הנדסי-מערכתי מאתגר, המשלב בין עולמות הפיתוח, הניסויים, התקשורת והחומרה.
התפקיד כולל תכנון וביצוע אינטגרציה של תתי-מערכות מורכבות משלבי הפיתוח ועד הייצור, איתור ופתרון תקלות, כתיבת מפרטי בדיקות והובלת ניסויי שטח להוכחת ביצועים.
הזדמנות מעולה לאנשי/נשות טכנולוגיה עם ראייה מערכתית רחבה שרוצים להוביל פרויקטים בחזית הטכנולוגיה.
דרישות התפקיד
תואר בהנדסה / תעודת הנדסאי באחד מהתחומים:אלקטרוניקה, חשמל, תוכנה או מדעי המחשב  - חובה.
3+ שנות ניסיון מקצועי באינטגרציה מערכתית ו/או ניסויים במערכות מורכבות - חובה.
בוגר/ת יחידה צבאית טכנולוגית/ניסויית (פיתוח, אינטגרציה, ל"א, תקשורת, מכ"ם) - חובה.
ניסיון מוכח בפרוטוקולי תקשורת ורשת (TCP/IP, UDP, RS422, SNMP, REST API, 1553) ועבודה עם כלי Sniffer - חובה.
שנתיים לפחות בתחומי RF, ל"א, סיגינט או מכ"ם, כולל הפעלת ציוד RF (כגון Spectrum Analyzer, Oscilloscope) - יתרון משמעותי.
ניסיון בכתיבת סקריפטים (Python, C#, Bash, Matlab) ועבודה בסביבת Linux - יתרון.
היכרות עם כלי ניהול תקלות ותרחישי בדיקות (JIRA / TFS) ושימוש בכלי AI - יתרון.
אנגלית ברמה טובה (קריאה וכתיבה) - חובה.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

בהתאם לחוק הגנת הפרטיות -
במסגרת הגשת המועמדות למכרז כוח אדם, חברת הגיחון אוספת מידע אישי על המועמד, לרבות פרטי זיהוי וקשר, קורות חיים, השכלה, ניסיון מקצועי, המלצות ומידע הנמסר במסגרת הליך המיון. מסירת המידע תלויה ברצונו של המועמד, אולם ללא מסירת המידע הנדרש לא ניתן יהיה לבחון את מועמדותו. המידע ישמש לצורך ניהול הליך המכרז, בחינת ההתאמה לתפקיד, קבלת החלטה ותיעוד ההליך, ועשוי להימסר לחברי ועדת המכרזים, לספקי מיון והשמה הפועלים מטעם חברת הגיחון ולגורמים המוסמכים לקבלו לפי דין. המידע יישמר בהתאם להוראות הדין ולמדיניות חברת הגיחון. המועמד רשאי לבקש לעיין במידע עליו ולתקנו בהתאם לחוק הגנת הפרטיות באמצעות פנייה
מועד אחרון להגשת טפסי מועמדות עד יום שלישי, 27.10.2026, טז' בחשוון תשפ"ז.

חיפה

משרה מלאה

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
קליטה ישירה לחברה עם תנאים מעולים!
הובלה מקצועית של צוות מכונאים, תוך עבודה שוטפת לצד הצוות, תיאום משימות ומתן מענה מקצועי, לשם הבטחת זמינות ותקינות ציוד המפעל.
תחומי אחריות:
הובלת צוות האחזקה במחלקה, כולל תכנון, בקרה ופיתוח מקצועי של הצוות.
ביצוע משימות אחזקה שונות עפ"י תכנון וצורכי המפעלים עם דגש על בטיחות, איכות ומקצועיות.
תמיכה וליווי מקצועי בתהליכי קליטה של ציוד חדש ובשדרוג ציוד ומערכות קיימות.
אחריות כוללת על תקינות, כשירות ואמינות ציוד המפעל.
יזום, הובלה ושיפור מתמיד של מדדי האחזקה במפעל (זמינות, אמינות, זמני תגובה ועלויות).
היקף המשרה ושעות העבודה:
משרה מלאה בימים א'-ה' בין השעות 07:00-16:00 כולל נכונות לשעות נוספות, עבודה בימי שישי והקפצות בהתאם לצורכי המפעל.
דרישות התפקיד
הנדסאי/ת מכונות- חובה
ניסיון של 6-10 שנים בתעשייה- חובה
ניסיון ניהולי בתפקיד ר"צ- חובה
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.title: עובד.ת חדר בקרה - NOC תמסורת
job.snippet:
Company Description
IBC | UNLIMITED – Israel Broadband Company is a national communications provider focused on designing and deploying an advanced optical fiber internet network across Israel.
Role Description
The עובד.ת חדר בקרה - NOC תמסורת is a full-time, on-site role based in Bnei Brak. This position is responsible for monitoring the transmission and fiber network in the Network Operations Center (NOC), identifying irregularities, and responding to alerts to maintain high service availability. The role includes performing real-time troubleshooting of network events, coordinating incident resolution with internal teams and external partners, and escalating issues according to established procedures. The employee will handle technical support tasks related to transmission and network equipment, document incidents and actions in monitoring and ticketing systems, and contribute to continuous improvement of NOC processes. The role requires working in shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to ensure 24/7 operational coverage.
Qualifications
Strong Network Operations Center (NOC) experience, including monitoring complex transmission and fiber networks.
Proficiency in Troubleshooting and Technical Support for communication and networking equipment.
Knowledge of Network Administration and Computer Network Operations in IP-based and transmission environments.
Ability to work in a shift-based, 24/7 operational setting and respond calmly under pressure.
Familiarity with network monitoring tools, ticketing systems, and incident management procedures.
Relevant technical training or certification in networking/communications (e.g., CCNA or equivalent) is an advantage.
Prior experience in telecom, ISP, or infrastructure environments is beneficial.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and clear written and verbal communication in Hebrew; English at a working level is an advantage.

job.title: SOC Manager
job.snippet:
About the Role
The Information Technology Center (ITC) is seeking an experienced SOC Manager to lead its Security Operations Center and oversee the organization’s end-to-end cyber defense operations.
The role includes full responsibility for the organization’s 24/7/365 cyber threat detection, monitoring, investigation, and incident response capabilities, ensuring the operational protection of its information assets and infrastructure.
Responsibilities
Take end-to-end ownership of the organization’s 24/7/365 cyber detection, monitoring, investigation, and incident response operations.
Lead and manage the SOC team, including recruitment, training, mentoring, shift management, and operational work routines.

job.title: Senior Algorithms & Software Engineer – UAV Communications | RADBEAM
job.snippet:
We’re hiring: Senior Algorithms & Software Engineer – UAV Communications | RADBEAM
RADBEAM develops long-range wireless data links for UAVs, delivering robust connectivity in challenging environments through beamforming and intelligent, data-driven link control.
We’re a small, hands-on team with long-term backing from established owners and investors. As one of our first technical hires, you’ll work directly with the CTO and help shape our technology.
Your Challenge: From Algorithms to Real-World Performance
Develop and validate link algorithms and the software that powers them, taking ideas from simulation to code running on the radio and building test setups to evaluate performance in the lab and in the field.
What you’ll do:
Develop algorithms and software for wireless communication systems, including link optimization, DSP, beamforming, mesh networking, and embedded software.
Build neural network models to support real-time link decisions using test and field data.
Develop automated test infrastructure for lab experiments, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and field trials.
Analyze test and field data to identify performance bottlenecks and drive improvements.
Collaborate with the hardware team on platform bring-up, integration, and system-level debugging.
Use AI-assisted engineering tools in your everyday workflow.
What were looking for:
5+ years of experience developing algorithms or software for hardware-based systems.
BSc or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Strong C/C++ and Python skills.
A background in wireless communications or DSP.
Experience building neural networks or data-driven models that inform decisions based on measured data.
A practical, analytical mindset and the ability to own problems from investigation through implementation.
Bonus points for:
MSc or PhD in a relevant field.
Experience with RF systems, networking, or communication protocols such as MAVLink.
Experience with embedded Linux, firmware, FPGA, or hardware-in-the-loop testing.
Experience with drones or robotics.

job.title: Product Manager
job.snippet:
About Us
Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.
Backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV Partners with $100M in Series B funding, we’re building a fast-growing, revenue-generating company working with Fortune 500 customers globally
About The Role
As an AI Product Manager on our team, you’ll work directly with customers and internal teams to define, scope, and deliver AI-powered solutions using Unframe’s platform. You’ll bridge product thinking with real-world use cases, enabling fast, reliable delivery of custom solutions built on a shared core. We work on-site from our Tel Aviv office, collaborating closely across engineering, product, and AI to move fast and build with purpose.
This is an opportunity to work with top-tier global customers and solve real, high-impact problems.
What You’ll Do
Translate customer problems into structured solution plans using Unframe.ai’s platform
Own the delivery of end-to-end projects in collaboration with engineers and AI specialists.
Write detailed specs and define prompt/context structures for solution logic.
Prioritize requirements and manage tradeoffs across speed, stability, and scope.
Work closely with the Platform team to surface reusable product patterns.
Serve as the voice of the user — from enterprise operators to domain experts.
What We Are Looking For
4+ years of experience in product management or technical delivery roles.
Experience working closely with engineering teams and technical products.
Ability to manage complex projects with multiple moving parts.
Strong written communication, systems thinking, and attention to detail.
Fluent English speaker - written and verbal communication must be excellent.
Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with evolving requirements.
Why Join Us
At Unframe, you’ll work on real AI products used by real customers, not experiments or demos. This role offers a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of customer problems, product strategy, and AI execution, with true ownership over solutions from idea to delivery. You’ll collaborate with strong engineers and AI specialists, influence how our platform evolves, and help shape reusable product capabilities as we scale. If you’re motivated by impact, complexity, and building practical AI systems that actually ship, you’ll find this role both challenging and rewarding.

job.title: מנהל.ת בקרת איכות לאביב מליסרון
job.snippet:
תיאור המשרה
תחומי אחריות עיקריים בתפקיד
הקמה ופיתוח של מערך בקרת האיכות בחברה
כתיבה, גיבוש ועדכון של מתודות ביצוע, נהלי עבודה, צ'קליסטים וטפסי בקרה למלאכות השונות
הגדרת סטנדרטים ודרישות איכות אחידים לפרויקטי החברה
הטמעת תהליכי בקרת איכות בקרב מנהלי הפרויקטים, מהנדסי הביצוע ומנהלי העבודה
ביצוע בקרות שוטפות באתרי החברה ובחינת איכות הביצוע והתאמתו לתוכניות, למפרטים, לדרישות החברה ולתקנים הרלוונטיים
ליווי ואישור פתיחת מלאכות חדשות והגדרת נקודות בקרה לאורך תהליך הביצוע
איתור ליקויים ואי-התאמות, תיעודם ומעקב אחר הטיפול והתיקון
יצירת אחידות ושיתוף ידע מקצועי בין הפרויקטים, במטרה למנוע הישנות של כשלים
ליווי מקצועי של צוותי הביצוע וקבלני המשנה בנושאי איכות ושיטות ביצוע
בניית תמונת מצב ודיווח להנהלה על רמת האיכות בפרויקטים, פערים מרכזיים ונושאים הדורשים טיפול
הכנת תקצירים ודוחות לישיבות מהנדסים, בקרה תקציבית ועוד
דרישות
מהנדס/ת אזרחי/ת / מהנדס/ת בניין או הנדסאי/ת בניין- חובה
הכשרות מקצועיות בתחום בקרת איכות בבנייה – יתרון
חמש שנות ניסיון לפחות בענף הבנייה למגורים, עם ניסיון משמעותי בביצוע ו/או בקרת איכות בפרויקטים למגורים - חובה
ניסיון בכתיבת מתודות ביצוע, נהלים ותהליכי בקרת איכות
היכרות מעמיקה עם תהליכי ביצוע, מפרטים, תוכניות ותקנים בתחום הבנייה
ניסיון בעבודה עם קבלנים וקבלני משנה
יכולת גבוהה להוביל תהליכים באופן עצמאי ולהקים תחום מאפס
יכולת לרתום ממשקים ולהטמיע שיטות עבודה בקרב צוותי ביצוע
ראייה מערכתית לצד יכולת ירידה לפרטים ועבודה מעשית בשטח
יסודיות, סדר, אחריות ויכולת מעקב ובקרה
יכולת ניסוח גבוהה בכתב
להגשת קורות חיים

job.title: Manager, Facilities
job.snippet:
Join UCT
and be part of
the fastest-growing sector in the world
! We indirectly touch every semiconductor chip that goes into every smartphone, smart car, and device that uses artificial intelligence. This is a critical time for the semiconductor industry and for UCT - as technology evolves, we evolve with it. UCT is a diverse workplace where every talented employee is committed to continuous innovation, challenging the status quo and exceeding customer expectations. If you are a person with a relentless drive to succeed, a strong focus on quality with a passion for success –
join us today!
UCT
is looking for a talented
Manager, Facilities
to join us in
Israel!
The Manager, Facilities is responsible for ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of facility infrastructure and building systems that support business operations. This role leads preventive and predictive maintenance programs, manages contractors and technical service providers, and ensures compliance with regulatory, environmental, and safety requirements. By overseeing critical systems including compressed air, cooling, HVAC, and fire protection, the manager minimizes downtime, optimizes asset performance, and supports operational continuity. The role also drives maintenance planning, project execution, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance facility performance, safety, and cost effectiveness.
Required Skills:
Ability to cope with stressful situations, assertiveness and excellent interpersonal skills.
Certified electrician license required
Experience in managing contractors / direct employees - significant advantage
Ability to lead tasks with interfaces while prioritizing tasks according to defined work methods.
Working in a computerized environment, familiarity with LEAN methodology.
Planning and control: projects & preventive/ predictive maintenance.
Defining a field of activity
Responsibility for performing preventive maintenance/breakdown for the following infrastructure systems:
Compressed air systems.
Fire extinguishing and fire detection systems.
Factory cooling systems + air conditioners in the company's offices.
Compliance with regulatory and safety standards for systems with the support of the Safety Department.
Work interfaces
Reports to the Maintenance Manager.
External and internal service contractors.
Infrastructure department team management.
Working together with the safety and maintenance department.
Ultra Clean Technology is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity and expression, marital status, and any other characteristic protected under laws and regulations.

job.title: Regional Service Manager - Israel
job.snippet:
Your mission
We are seeking an experienced Regional Service Manager to lead Sungrow’s service operations in Israel. In this role, you will be responsible for managing technical services for advanced renewable energy solutions, acting as a senior escalation point for customers, and leading service teams and partners in a fast-growing global organization.
This is a challenging and rewarding position with long-term growth opportunities within Sungrow.
Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is an Electrical Technician or Electrical Engineer with strong hands-on experience and proven leadership skills. You excel in high-pressure environments, take ownership, and have a strong customer-oriented mindset. High-level Hebrew and English proficiency is required, along with willingness to travel and perform on-call duties.
Responsibilities
Lead and manage service operations for Sungrow customers in Israel.
Act as the main escalation point for customer issues and critical situations.
Drive high service standards, customer satisfaction, and brand reputation.
Manage commissioning-related service projects.
Lead Field Service Teams during troubleshooting, failure analysis, and corrective maintenance.
Recruit, train, supervise, and perform quality reviews of service teams and Service Partners.
Define, document, and enforce operational procedures and best practices.
Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations.
Collaborate closely with EMEA Service Management and internal stakeholders.
Manage customer contracts and SLAs.
Support Sales activities and participate in exhibitions when required.
Ensure service documentation and processes are kept up to date.
Your profile
Education as practical Electrical Engineer or Electrical Engineer, with a robust understanding of AC/DC, Low/Medium Voltage systems, and valid electrical license (3x250A or higher) - a must!
Proven record and minimum 1 year of experience commissioning PV inverters in utility-scale projects- a must!
Strong knowledge and practical experience with RS485, Modbus TCP/IP, and networking- a must!
Several years of experience in a similar service or technical leadership role.
Proven leadership skills with the ability to manage, train, and supervise teams or service partners.
Experience working with contracts, including SLAs.
Experience establishing and implementing operational processes.
Hands-on technical and on-site experience.
Basic project management skills.
Knowledge of local Health and Safety regulations.
Hebrew at a high level and English at least C1.
Strong communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Willingness to travel and take on-call responsibilities.
Why us?
Why Sungrow Israel?
Industry Leadership: Be part of a company that’s driving the future of renewable energy and shaping a more sustainable world.
Exceptional Work Environment: Collaborate with top professionals in a supportive and dynamic culture.
Excellent Terms and Conditions: We offer competitive compensation packages and outstanding benefits that rank among the best in the industry.
Growth Opportunities: From career development to skill-building, Sungrow Israel provides the tools and support you need to succeed. We’re proud of the culture we’ve built, where innovation meets opportunity, and we’d love for you to be part.
Join us in
shaping and
revolutionizing
the renewable energy landscape
and
be a part of the journey in delivering successful projects, contributing to our organizational growth.
About Us
We are a green tech company with young creative minds.
We are fighting every day to make our mission happen –
Clean Power for All
!
With 870+GW of clean power presently installed worldwide, we are on the road to success!
Welcome at Sungrow
Founded in 1997 by University Professor Cao Renxian, Sungrow is a leader in the research and development of solar inverters with the largest dedicated R&D team in the industry and a broad product portfolio offering PV inverter solutions and energy storage systems for utility-scale, commercial & industrial, and residential applications, as well as internationally recognized floating PV plant solutions, NEV driving solutions, EV charging solutions and renewable hydrogen production systems.
Want to know more? Check out what working with us is like!

job.title: מהנדס.ת חשמל לייעוץ ובקרה בתחום האנרגיה
job.snippet:
Company Description
Bar-Dov Engineering & Management LTD, part of the Paz Group, is a leading consultancy and project management company in Israel’s energy sector. With over 15 years of experience and roots going back more than 40 years in the Israeli electricity and energy market, the company supports projects from feasibility studies and conceptual design through construction supervision and commissioning. Bar-Dov specializes in cogeneration, conventional and combined-cycle power plants, electrical transportation, power grid infrastructure, and renewable energy technologies including PV, thermo-solar, and wind. As part of the Paz Group, Bar-Dov delivers innovative, sustainable solutions that support the evolving needs of the energy industry and Israel’s future energy landscape. The company is headquartered in Herzliya and works with a range of public and private sector partners.
Role Description
This is a full-time hybrid role for an Electrical Engineer specializing in energy consulting and control, based in Herzliya. The role includes performing technical analyses, preparing professional reports, specifications, and engineering documentation, perform as a Landers technical adviser. The engineer will review and validate designs, participate in feasibility studies, support permitting processes, and provide technical support throughout project execution. Day-to-day work involves collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, coordinating with clients, contractors, and regulators, and participating in site visits and inspections. The engineer will also contribute to optimizing energy efficiency, grid integration solutions, and implementation of relevant standards and safety regulations.
Qualifications
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, specializing in power engineering, with an Engineer-Electrician license – required
Experience related to renewable energy, energy generation, energy efficiency, and/or power grid infrastructure – required
Excellent writing skills for preparing professional opinions, documents, etc. – required
Experience working with regulators and decision-makers – an advantage
High level of English
Full-time position
Willingness to work mainly on-site at the company’s offices in Herzliya Pituach

job.title: Industrial Electrician
job.snippet:
Join UCT
and be part of
the fastest-growing sector in the world
! We indirectly touch every semiconductor chip that goes into every smartphone, smart car, and device that uses artificial intelligence. This is a critical time for the semiconductor industry and for UCT - as technology evolves, we evolve with it. UCT is a diverse workplace where every talented employee is committed to continuous innovation, challenging the status quo and exceeding customer expectations. If you are a person with a relentless drive to succeed, a strong focus on quality with a passion for success –
join us today!
UCT
is looking for a talented
Electrician
(Technician IV) to join us in
Israel!
The Technician IV supports manufacturing reliability and efficiency by executing preventive and corrective maintenance across plant equipment and facilities. This role performs advanced mechanical and electrical troubleshooting, monitors equipment performance, and intervenes to prevent downtime. By maintaining accurate records in the maintenance management system, collaborating with cross‑functional teams and equipment suppliers, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives, the Technician IV helps ensure safe, reliable operations and sustained equipment performance.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Carry out the execution of the planned preventive maintenance and unplanned work as it arises.
Providing maintenance support, entering data, updating equipment records, produce performance reports and participating in continuous improvement projects.
Mechanical and electrical troubleshooting.
Closely monitor lines and machine performances and intervene as soon as any deterioration in performance occurs.
Work closely with other teams and functions to improve reliability and performance.
As part of the technical Maintenance team, work with equipment suppliers on new equipment and installations and modifications.
Update the maintenance management system (Limble), records of all changes, store transactions made, and work carried out.
Maintain the plant facilities and services, including compressed air, water treatment and chemical treatment systems and air scrubber system.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
Previous experience in manufacturing is essential preferably in semiconductor, medical or pharma industries.
Strong mechanical background.
Some electrical background is an advantage but not essential.
Trades/Diploma qualifications required with min 5 years' experience.
Good team player and self-motivated with ability to work on own project while supporting all other departments.
Ability to read schematic drawings.
Available for call out duties and / or overtime when required.
Electrical License.
Knowledge in hydraulics, pneumatics, Advantage.
Ability to read electrical drawings.
Independent learning ability, willingness to work overtime.
2 years of industry experience.
Ability to work under stressful conditions and challenging schedules.
Environmental Exposure
Required to wear personal protective equipment.
Subject to hazards including electrical current, moving mechanical parts, exposure to chemicals, and debris.
Required to have visual acuity to perform assigned tasks.
Education & Experience
Electrical license
Practical Engineer / Mechanical Technician-Advantage
Ultra Clean Technology is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religious belief, age, sexual orientation, disability, civil status, membership of the traveling community, gender, family status, and any other characteristic protected under laws and regulations.

job.title: Senior Cyber Security Engineer
job.snippet:
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Senior Information Security Specialist to join our Global IT & Cyber department. The role designs, implements, operates and continuously improves security controls across on-premises data centers and cloud environments, with a strong focus on asset protection, operational resilience and regulatory compliance in a global financial environment.
Responsibilities:
Global Infrastructure & SOC Operations:
• Secure AvaTrade's global infrastructure (on-premises and cloud)
• Improve and support SOC operations, detection workflows and incident response
• Operate and continuously enhance IT and cybersecurity tools and platforms
• Collaborate with IT, DevOps and Security teams to ensure alignment with ITGC and security best practices
Security Engineering:
• Configure, troubleshoot and maintain security solutions, including:
o Firewalls (FortiGate)
o Web Application Firewalls (WAF)
o Network Access Control (NAC)
o Endpoint security platforms
o Mail gateways
o DLP solutions
o DDoS protection services
o AI security controls (AI gateway, DLP for AI prompts, AI usage monitoring)
Linux & Windows System Security:
• Perform OS-level security hardening, patching and configuration management
• Troubleshoot security-related system incidents
• Ensure OS configurations align with internal security baselines and compliance standards
AWS Cloud Security & Governance:
• Implement and maintain AWS Identity & Access hardening:
o IAM roles, policies and least-privilege access
o IAM Identity Center (SSO) with MFA
o IAM Access Analyzer
• Manage AWS Organizations and Service Control Policies (SCPs)
• Operate AWS Config for compliance and drift detection
Logging, Detection & Monitoring
• Operate and enhance security monitoring and detection services (GuardDuty)
• Centralize security logs and alerts using CloudWatch, EventBridge and S3
• Ensure full traceability of security-relevant events across cloud and on-prem environments
Microsoft Defender XDR:
• Operate and tune the Microsoft Defender XDR suite:
o Defender for Endpoint (EDR, attack surface reduction, device isolation)
o Defender for Office 365 (phishing, safe links and attachments)
o Defender for Identity and Defender for Cloud Apps
o Defender for Cloud (posture management across Azure, AWS and multi-cloud)
• Triage and investigate Defender incidents and alerts, and run advanced hunting with KQL
• Drive remediation through Defender Vulnerability Management and Secure Score
Mobile & Endpoint Device Management (MDM):
• Manage Windows, macOS, iOS and Android devices with Microsoft Intune
• Enforce device compliance policies tied to Entra ID Conditional Access
• Manage device enrollment (Windows Autopilot, Apple Business Manager)
• Enforce disk encryption (BitLocker, FileVault), OS update rings and security baselines
• Protect corporate data on BYOD devices with app protection policies (MAM)
• Handle lost or compromised devices: remote lock, wipe and retire
Data Protection & Cloud Protection:
• Enforce data protection and encryption using AWS KMS, Secrets Manager and ACM
• Operate Route 53 DNS logging and Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall
• Enable VPC Flow Logs
• Implement AWS WAF and DDoS protection mechanisms
Infrastructure as Code, Vulnerability & Compliance
• Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
• Use Git-based workflows for infrastructure and security configuration
• Enforce policy-as-code, peer review and auditable change control
• Maintain vulnerability management processes and ensure continuous remediation
• Contribute to security policies, procedures and audit documentation
Security Automation & AI Agents:
• Design, build and maintain AI agents that support daily security operations: alert triage, incident enrichment and investigation, vulnerability prioritization and compliance reporting
• Integrate agents with security platforms (Defender, Intune, FortiGate, AWS/OCI, SIEM) through their APIs
• Ensure agents run securely: least-privilege access, human approval for impactful actions, full logging and audit trail
Requirements:
Mandatory
• Minimum 4 years of hands-on Linux and Windows OS system administration experience
• Hands-on experience with firewalls (FortiGate)
• Experience with Web Application Firewalls (WAF)
• Experience with Network Access Control (NAC)
• Experience with security monitoring tools and SOC operations
• Hands-on experience with AWS security services:
o IAM
o AWS Organizations
o AWS Config
o CloudTrail
• Fortinet NSE4 or NSE5 (minimum)
• High-level English, written and verbal, for work with global teams, vendors and auditors
Advantage
• Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) IAM experience – IAM policies, compartments, Identity Domains, dynamic groups and least-privilege access
• Hands-on Microsoft Defender XDR experience (Endpoint, Office 365, Identity, Cloud Apps, Cloud), including KQL advanced hunting
• MDM experience with Microsoft Intune – compliance, Conditional Access, Autopilot, app protection policies
• Experience building AI agents that automate day-to-day security work (alert triage, investigation, reporting, remediation workflows), using LLM APIs and agent frameworks with Python
• Higher-level Fortinet certification (NSE6 / NSE7)
• Azure security experience
• Advanced Terraform experience
• Scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
• Penetration testing knowledge
• Experience supporting audits and regulatory compliance
Why Join AvaTrade
• Operate in a global, regulated financial environment
• Own and influence system and cloud security architecture
• Work with enterprise-scale infrastructure and modern security tooling
• High-impact senior technical role with real ownership

job.title: Junior Treasury Analyst
job.snippet:
Find your Z Factor.
Join ZIM, where you can make an impact, take on meaningful challenges, and grow both personally and professionally in an innovative global company.
We’re looking for a
Treasury Analyst
that will be responsible for Analysis and overseeing the global cash position and company cash flow, promoting transparency, cash visibility, efficiency, cash concentration, and supporting treasury projects.
Key Responsibilities:
Analysis
Perform analysis of global cash position, view trends, concentration and flows in order to create the foundation for global cash pooling mechanism.
Monitoring minimum cash position in countries. Reviewing and adjusting such levels in order to optimize subsidiaries cash usage and transfers to HO.
Categorizing actual cash transactions globally based on HO guidelines
Direct interaction with subsidiaries and regions in order to understand their cash flow needs and cash transfers to HO
Daily management of the HO actual cash flow includes continuous work interfaces between subsidiaries and head office units, including risk analysis
Daily analysis Cash view in in TMS system
Preparation of short and long-term cash flow forecast, considering several scenarios. Analyze and compare between versions. Including ongoing communication with Budget division, Comptroller unit, Finance and Banking departments etc.
Assisting in quarterly closing process including preparation of presentations to the management
Propose solutions and action plans to problems and challenges, conduct risk assessments as needed.
Support Treasury future projects (Cash flow forecast and Cash pooling)
Support project planning and management, including plan, scope, timelines, budget, and resource allocation.
Monitor project progress and adjust as needed.
Payment process backup and support
Preparing payment runs, bank transfers
Monitoring weekly payment plan Vs available cash
Compliance and Reporting
Ensure adherence to financial regulations (SOX) and internal controls
Requirements:
As our
Treasury Analyst
you’ll need to have:
Bachelors in economics/ business management/ Accounting
Past record as analyst in a global company (1-2 years)
Proven experience in data analysis
High level of control in Office tools, Excel and Power point in particular.
Proven experience in managing projects, preferably in a financial or treasury environment
Systems oriented and Strong interest in AI-driven solutions
High level of English language (Speaking, reading and writing). Knowledge of other languages is an advantage.
SAP experience – advantage
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
Past experienced with cash flow preparation – advantage
People oriented. Motivate people

Technical projects, personal or academic, especially ones combining software and hardware (microcontrollers, drones, sensors, communication)
Curiosity and the ability to learn independently
Good academic achievements
Teamwork and good communication

job.title: Power Delivery Design Engineer, Google Cloud
job.snippet:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
Tel Aviv, Israel; Haifa, Israel
.
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
4 years of experience in power delivery network design and verification in nodes technologies.
Experience with Electromigration (EM)/IR tools (e.g., RedHawk-SC, Totem, Voltus, Spice).
Experience scripting in TCL, Python, or C++.
Preferred qualifications:
Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
Experience with power components, modeling/trees/network design.
Experience in battery droop mitigation, overcurrent protection, thermal shutdown.
Experience in power consumption estimation/calculation of System-on-a-Chip (SoC).
Familiarity with low power design techniques (e.g., power/voltage domain design, clock gating, power gating, dynamic voltage frequency scaling).
About The Job
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.
In this role, you will collaborate with functional design, Design for Testing (DFT), architecture, and packaging engineers. You will solve technical problems with innovative micro-architecture and practical logic circuits solutions, while evaluating design options with optimized performance, and power.
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
Responsibilities
Define and drive the implementation of physical design methodologies. Define the physical design related rule sets for the functional design engineers.
Work closely with power architects and produce detailed trade-off analysis of impact of Power Delivery Network (PDN) on different use-case power.
Work on system and block level simulations (e.g., IR drop, electromigration).
Take ownership of one or more physical design partitions or top level.
Drive to the closure of timing and power consumption of the design. Contribute to design methodology, libraries, and code review.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

job.title: Production Manager
job.snippet:
Airobotics develops autonomous drone platforms designed for mission-critical industrial use. Our systems operate continuously, autonomously, and safely — combining aerospace-grade hardware with AI-based autonomy, sensing, and operational reliability.
We are seeking an experienced
Production Manager
to lead the company’s full production activities, across both internal production lines and subcontracted manufacturing. This leader will be responsible for ensuring that all production operations function effectively and deliver the company’s products on time and at the required quality level. The Director of Production will also play a key role in transforming engineering designs, prototypes, and development-stage configurations into products with stable, measurable, and repeatable production processes.
Responsibilities:
Lead the company’s production activities, including in-house production lines and subcontracted manufacturing.
Own production execution and delivery across the company’s different products and production programs.
Ensure production operations meet required timelines, quality standards, and delivery commitments.
Manage, monitor, and improve the performance of internal production teams and external production lines.
Support the transition of products from development into production, including production readiness, build processes, documentation, testing, and configuration control.
Work closely with Supply Chain to ensure production execution is aligned with the approved supply plan, material availability, and delivery priorities.
Act as the central execution owner for production, identifying gaps, removing blockers, and driving cross-functional alignment.
Establish production routines, performance tracking, reporting methods, and escalation processes for both internal and external production activities.
Drive continuous improvement in production stability, throughput, quality, transparency, and operational predictability.
Requirements:
5+ years experience managing production in a technology company developing multi-disciplinary systems.
5+ years experience leading the production of complex products involving hardware, electronics, mechanics, integration, and testing.
Proven experience scaling a company from early-stage / startup phases into high-volume production.
Experience managing subcontracted production with local and international contract manufacturers.
Experience transitioning products from development into production, including NPI processes, production processes, production documentation, quality, and configuration control.
High management capabilities, strong interpersonal skills, experience leading managers, and ability to operate in a dynamic and changing environment.
Ability to dive into technical details, provide creative solutions, and maintain a broad operational and systems-level perspective.
Strong organizational commitment and ability to work effectively as part of a team.
Fluent English — speaking, reading, and writing.
UAV / autonomous systems background - Advantage

job.title: Capacity & Analysis Planner
job.snippet:
Join UCT
and be part of
the fastest-growing sector in the world
! We indirectly touch every semiconductor chip that goes into every smartphone, smart car and device that uses artificial intelligence. This is a critical time for the semiconductor industry and for UCT - as technology evolves, we evolve with it. UCT is a diverse workplace where every talented employee is committed to continuous innovation, challenging the status quo and exceeding customer expectations. If you are a person with a relentless drive to succeed, a strong focus on quality with a passion for success –
join us today!
UCT
is looking for a talented
Capacity & Analysis Planner
to join us in
Israel!
The Planner III is responsible for developing and maintaining production plans and master schedules to meet customer requirements and optimize resource utilization. This role performs advanced planning functions, including simulation modeling, scenario optimization, and capacity analysis, while reconciling material and production conflicts. The Planner III collaborates across engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery, quality compliance, and continuous improvement in a fast-paced, engineer-to-order environment.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Perform simulation modeling and scenario optimization to improve planning accuracy and efficiency.
Prepare and present Rough-Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP) and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) reports to senior management.
Manage production planning and control for assigned lines, ensuring schedule adherence and material availability.
Develop and maintain master production schedules based on engineering plans and specifications.
Create, release, monitor, and close work orders throughout the production cycle.
Analyze labor loading and capacity requirements to ensure schedule feasibility.
Troubleshoot production control issues and implement corrective actions promptly.
Monitor and resolve process shortages to maintain schedule integrity.
Collaborate with engineering, quality, purchasing, and operations to ensure specifications and quality standards are met.
Facilitate operations and material status meetings to communicate priorities and resolve issues.
Coordinate engineering change orders and update schedules accordingly.
Interface with customers as needed to confirm delivery schedules or address concerns.
Knowledge, Skills, Experience:
Expertise in production planning, scheduling, and capacity analysis.
Ability to read and interpret engineering bills of materials (BOM) and technical specifications.
Strong analytical skills for simulation modeling and scenario planning.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for internal and external interactions.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with MRP/ERP systems.
Meeting facilitation and stakeholder management skills to drive alignment and accountability.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in managing complex schedules.
Ability to build effective cross-functional relationships and work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Education, Certifications, Requirements:
5+ years of planning experience with working knowledge of quick-turn, low volume, engineer-to-order production environment.
5+ years of experience using advanced planning tools such as Kinaxis, APO or ASCP.
Ultra Clean Technology is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity and expression, marital status, and any other characteristic protected under laws and regulations.

job.title: Embedded SW Engineer
job.snippet:
Alma, a Sisram Medical company, is a global leader in medical-aesthetic technologies, with over 25 years of experience in energy-based devices (EBD). Over the years, Alma has evolved into an integrated aesthetic and wellness ecosystem that combines medical devices, injectables, diagnostics, and personalized skincare. The company operates in a dynamic, innovation-driven environment, merging advanced technology with deep clinical understanding to create holistic solutions for aesthetic clinics. Alma’s headquarters are in Caesarea, Israel, with business operations in more than 100 countries worldwide.
The Embedded SW engineer will own the development of MCU and other controllers SW component.
Will define the specification and design of the component.
Will write code and perform verification activities.
Will analyze and resolve issues coming from the field and internal customers (production, service)
Will improve the development process by integrating tools and methodologies.
Requirements:
Over 5 years in Embedded SW development - mandatory
Experience with ST microcontroller – big advantage
Experience in a medical device company, including familiarity with SW development standards (e.g., IEC 62304) and design controls – mandatory
Multidisciplinary experience – mandatory
B.Sc. in computer science or equivalent practical experience
Proficient English (verbal and written)
Proficient in C/C++, RTOS, and standard embedded debugging and version-control tools (e.g., Git)
Able to work 4 days a week on site in Cesaria.
Can do attitude, collaborate with team members
Process oriented
Owner mind set – takes a feature from requirements to production and on market support

job.title: Production Planner
job.snippet:
Join UCT
and be part of
the fastest-growing sector in the world
! We indirectly touch every semiconductor chip that goes into every smartphone, smart car and device that uses artificial intelligence. This is a critical time for the semiconductor industry and for UCT - as technology evolves, we evolve with it. UCT is a diverse workplace where every talented employee is committed to continuous innovation, challenging the status quo and exceeding customer expectations. If you are a person with a relentless drive to succeed, a strong focus on quality with a passion for success –
join us today!
UCT
is looking for a talented
Production Planner
to join us in
Israel!
The Planner III is responsible for developing and maintaining production plans and master schedules to meet customer requirements and optimize resource utilization. This role performs advanced planning functions, including simulation modeling, scenario optimization, and capacity analysis, while reconciling material and production conflicts. The Planner III collaborates across engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery, quality compliance, and continuous improvement in a fast-paced, engineer-to-order environment.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Perform simulation modeling and scenario optimization to improve planning accuracy and efficiency.
Prepare and present Rough-Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP) and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) reports to senior management.
Manage production planning and control for assigned lines, ensuring schedule adherence and material availability.
Develop and maintain master production schedules based on engineering plans and specifications.
Create, release, monitor, and close work orders throughout the production cycle.
Analyze labor loading and capacity requirements to ensure schedule feasibility.
Troubleshoot production control issues and implement corrective actions promptly.
Monitor and resolve process shortages to maintain schedule integrity.
Collaborate with engineering, quality, purchasing, and operations to ensure specifications and quality standards are met.
Facilitate operations and material status meetings to communicate priorities and resolve issues.
Coordinate engineering change orders and update schedules accordingly.
Interface with customers as needed to confirm delivery schedules or address concerns.
Knowledge, Skills, Experience:
Expertise in production planning, scheduling, and capacity analysis.
Ability to read and interpret engineering bills of materials (BOM) and technical specifications.
Strong analytical skills for simulation modeling and scenario planning.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for internal and external interactions.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with MRP/ERP systems.
Meeting facilitation and stakeholder management skills to drive alignment and accountability.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in managing complex schedules.
Ability to build effective cross-functional relationships and work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Education, Certifications, Requirements:
5+ years of planning experience with working knowledge of quick-turn, low volume, engineer-to-order production environment.
5+ years of experience using advanced planning tools such as Kinaxis, APO or ASCP.
Ultra Clean Technology is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity and expression, marital status, and any other characteristic protected under laws and regulations.

job.title: Global Logistics Specialist
job.snippet:
A global company is seeking an experienced International Shipping & Logistics Specialist to take ownership of complex international shipments across air and ocean freight. The role involves end-to-end shipment management, working with international logistics partners, and ensuring efficient, timely, and compliant import and export operations worldwide.
Key Responsibilities
Manage international import and export shipments, including air and ocean freight.
Coordinate Express, Air & Sea Freight, and cross-border Drop Shipments.
Handle specialized cargo, including oversized shipments, Dangerous Goods (DG), and explosive materials, ensuring full compliance with applicable regulations.
Work directly with global freight forwarders, customs brokers, airlines, shipping lines, and international logistics partners.
Manage shipping documentation, customs clearance processes, import/export permits, and regulatory requirements.
Obtain and compare freight quotations, optimize shipping routes, and manage logistics costs.
Track shipments, resolve operational challenges, and ensure timely deliveries.
Requirements
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in international shipping, freight forwarding, or global logistics.
Strong knowledge of air and ocean freight operations, import/export procedures, and customs clearance processes.
Solid understanding of international trade terms (INCOTERMS).
Familiarity with international shipping documentation, including AWB, BOL, Commercial Invoices, and Packing Lists.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Advantages
Experience handling Dangerous Goods, explosive materials, and oversized or specialized cargo.
Previous experience working with international freight forwarders or global logistics providers.
Experience in the technology, aerospace, or defense industries.

job.title: Technical Drone Operator
job.snippet:
Pixel Sight, a company developing advanced electro-optical systems, is looking for a technical Drone Operator to join its operations team.
This is a dynamic, hands-on role combining FPV drone operations, field trials, complex technological systems, and a wide range of operational activities.
We are looking for an experienced drone operator with proven FPV flying skills, strong technical capabilities, independence, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced technological environment.
Key Responsibilities
Operate FPV drones and other UAV platforms during field trials, testing, and data collection activities.
Prepare, operate, test, and integrate electro-optical and other complex technological systems.
Plan and execute field trials, demonstrations, and technical activities in Israel and abroad.
Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, providing real-time solutions.
Prepare, configure, and maintain drones, equipment, systems, and infrastructure for field operations.
Support R&D activities, component testing, and system integration alongside engineering teams.
Provide occasional support for production, assembly, and system testing activities as needed.
Improve operational processes and collaborate with internal teams and external partners.
This position requires Flexibility to work irregular hours and willingness to participate in field activities and
travel in Israel and abroad.
Requirements:
Must Have
Proven hands-on experience operating and flying FPV drones.
Valid drone pilot license issued by the Israeli Civil Aviation Authority (CAAI), covering UAV operations up to 25 kg.
Extensive practical experience in the UAV/drone field, including drone operations, preparation, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience working with technological systems, hardware, or electronic equipment.
Strong technical aptitude and the ability to independently diagnose and resolve technical
Fast learning ability, initiative, personal responsibility, and independence.
Experience working in a dynamic operational environment with changing priorities.
Flexibility to work irregular hours and willingness to participate in field activities and
travel in Israel and abroad.
Strong teamwork and interpersonal communication skills.
Good command of English.

job.title: Senior ML Performance Engineer, Annapurna Labs
job.snippet:
Description
Our team is responsible for the AWS Neuron software stack, which powers Generative AI and other advanced ML workloads on AWS's custom-built ML accelerators — Inferentia and Trainium. These accelerators deliver best-in-class performance and cost-efficiency for ML inference and training in the cloud.
We're Building a New Core Group Of Engineers In TLV (Tel Aviv) To Drive Innovation In ML Systems Performance And Software. As a Machine Learning Performance Engineer, You'll Help Shape The Direction Of The Team From The Ground Up And Work On
Optimizing system performance across the entire ML software stack
Analyzing high-performance ML workloads running on Annapurna hardware
Developing high-performance kernels for critical ML operations
Enhancing the Neuron SDK to improve developer experience and system capabilities
Collaborating across Compiler, Frameworks, and Hardware teams to maximize end-to-end performance
As part of the Performance Engineering Team, you'll contribute to projects involving instruction scheduling, memory management, parallelism, kernel optimization, and compiler enhancements to maximize end-to-end performance.
This is a unique opportunity to be at the intersection of ML and systems within AWS, helping to build the future of AI infrastructure — right here in Tel Aviv.
Key job responsibilities
Our Engineers Collaborate Across Diverse Teams, Projects, And Environments To Have a Firsthand Impact On Our Global Customer Base. You Will
Solve challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, at every layer of the stack.
Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions to transform service performance, durability, cost, and security.
Research implementations that deliver the best possible experiences for customers.
A day in the life
As You Design And Code Solutions To Help Our Team Drive Efficiencies In Software Architecture, You’ll Create Metrics, Implement Automation And Other Improvements, And Resolve The Root Cause Of Software Defects. You’ll Also
Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base.
Participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
Work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input.
Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.
Considering the technical requirements of this role, and to ensure fair and equal candidate consideration, we are conducting full interview loops. If you meet the basic qualifications, and the team is interested in moving forward, we will be in touch to coordinate your interviews.
About The Team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic Qualifications
BS degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related field
6+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
Proficiency with 1 or more of the following programming languages: Python(preferred), C++
Experience working with PyTorch, TensorFlow, and/or JAX
3+ years of experience in performance engineering for accelerated computing
Preferred Qualifications
Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
Experience developing compiler optimization, kernel writing or hardware-software co-design
Experience in performance optimizations of LLM, Vision or other deep-learning models
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: Paid Social Specialist
job.snippet:
Kick-start your career in the online gaming world and experience the very latest in technology and innovation.
Who We Are
We’re Super Group, the NYSE-listed digital gaming company behind some of the world’s leading Sports and iGaming brands, including Betway and Jackpot City. We’re a powerhouse built on decades of expertise across 22 countries – and with over 2,800 bright minds, we’re changing the game for good. Our mission is to give our customers a superclass entertainment experience.
Who We’re Looking For
We’re on a thrilling journey of growth and innovation, and we need passionate, driven individuals to join us. At Super Group, every day is action-packed, and we expect you to bring your A-game. In return, you’ll find a supportive environment where your skills can flourish and your career can soar.
Ready to become a game-changer? Supercharge your career with us and be part of something extraordinary.
Why we need you
We’re building experiences that wow our customers – and that starts with bold, curious people who want to do work that matters.
If you’re hungry to grow, excited by impact and ready for a challenge that will supercharge your career, this could be your moment.
As our
Paid Social Specialist
, you’ll play a key part to support the execution, testing, and reporting of paid social campaigns across multiple platforms. This role is ideal for someone early in their media buying career who has exposure to iGaming, Nutra, Dating, or Gaming verticals and is eager to develop performance marketing expertise. Your drive and ideas will help us move faster, improve smarter, and stay ahead of the game.
What You’ll Do
You’ll take ownership of work that gives us our competitive edge, including:
Assist with campaign setup and execution across paid social platforms, including Meta (Facebook & Instagram), TikTok, and other relevant channels
Support ad creative testing, audience testing, and budget pacing following predefined strategies
Monitor campaign performance and flag trends, issues, or opportunities
Compile and maintain campaign reports, dashboards, and performance summaries
Perform basic optimisations (e.g., pausing underperforming ads, adjusting budgets, refreshing creatives) under guidance
Ensure accurate tracking and tagging are in place (pixels, events, UTMs)
Collaborate with creative, tracking, and analytics teams to support campaign success
Stay up to date with platform updates, ad formats, and paid social best practices
This list covers your core responsibilities – with plenty of room to stretch, explore and take on new challenges as we grow.
What You’ll Bring
You’re someone who brings:
Clear, confident communication (written and verbal), and the ability to breakdown complex ideas
A collaborative mindset, working smoothly with cross‑functional teams to hit shared goals
Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects without dropping the ball
Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to high‑quality work
Adaptability – you stay sharp, productive and positive in fast‑moving environments
Experience in paid social media buying or digital performance marketing
Exposure to performance-driven verticals such as iGaming, Nutra, Dating, or Gaming
Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager
Basic understanding of key KPIs (CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPM, CVR)
Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail
Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, and reporting tools
Good organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks
Desirable Skills You’ve Got Up Your Sleeve
It would be great if you also have some of the following skills:
In-depth knowledge of sports betting markets, including odds calculation, betting types and market trends
Previous experience in the online gaming or casino industry, with a strong understanding of player behaviour and industry regulations
Familiarity with gambling regulations and compliance requirements in various jurisdictions, ensuring adherence to legal standards
Experience in developing and executing customer retention strategies
Experience working in fast-paced, performance-focused environments
Basic knowledge of tracking tools (e.g., Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, GTM)
Exposure to international campaigns and multiple geographies
Interest in growth marketing and paid user acquisition
Our values are non-negotiables
Our culture is underpinned by core values that are linked to key behavioural competencies. Along with the below behavioural competencies, these are essential for all employees in order for you to embed in and drive our culture forward.
These Competencies Are
Adaptability
Ownership and accountability
Initiating action
Resilience
Team orientation
Integrity
Innovation
What You’ll Get Back
We invest in your growth and wellbeing, so you can bring your best:
Supergrowth is real here. Our learning and development programmes give you the tools, training and opportunities to level up fast.
Your progress matters. Our Performance tool ensures you get meaningful feedback to support your development and superdrive your career.
Support that has your back. Our Employee Assistance Programme offers resources for you and your family.
Life Insurance
Private Healthcare
Leadership Training
Keren Hishtalmut (Education/Study Fund)
Ready to feel superclass?
At Super Group, your experience matters. We’re honest, fair, and focused on helping you succeed – and your work will have real impact from day one.
Game on!

job.title: Product Manager- Retail Media
job.snippet:
Cust2Mate is a global leader in smart-cart platforms, transforming in-store shopping through digitalization and personalization. Our award-winning Smart Carts, trusted by leading grocery chains, elevate the customer experience, optimize store operations, and bridge online and physical retail.
Role Overview:
As a Product Manager at Cust2Mate, you will own the R&D’s Retail Media roadmap execution of products enabling retailers to monetize their in-store digital touchpoints through retail media solutions.
You will collaborate closely with Business stakeholders, Retail Media partners, Marketing leaders and Cust2Mate’s software, data, and business teams to deliver advertising and analytics capabilities that transform how brands interact with shoppers inside physical stores.
Key Responsibilities:
Execute the product strategy for Cust2Mate’s Retail Media platform, integrating in-store advertising, campaign management, and data-driven insights.
Work with software and hardware teams to enhance the Smart Cart platform’s advertising capabilities.
Develop tools and APIs for campaign management, ad delivery, targeting, and measurement.
Collaborate with data teams to create robust reporting dashboards and attribution models for brands and retailers.
Partner with business development and sales teams to support go-to-market initiatives.
Define key metrics and success criteria for retail media performance and monetization impact.
Ensure an excellent user and advertiser experience by applying best UX and data-driven practices.
Communicate roadmap progress and insights to senior leadership and stakeholders.
Requirements:
7+ years of experience in product management, with at least 3 years in ad tech or retail media.
Understanding of the retail ecosystem is a plus.
Proven experience delivering digital advertising or monetization platforms.
Excellent analytical skills and data-driven decision-making abilities.
Experience in fast-paced startup or growth environments is a plus.
Fluent English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage.

job.title: Assembly Technician, Medical Device (Catheter) Lab
job.snippet:
Background
Spinodal is an early-stage medical device company developing Intracardiac Omnidirectional Robotic Navigation Technology. The company’s technology is multidisciplinary and consists of micro-mechanics, microfluidic, micro-electronics, hardware, signal processing, software and algorithms.
The Role
You’ll assemble our catheter prototypes by hand, working closely with our R&D engineers. This is precision work at a small scale: you’ll handle thin-walled polymer tubing, micro-components and fine bonding processes, often under a microscope. You will take key role in defining assembly-aid tools and fixtures and integrating them in manufacturing instructions. Your work will go straight into bench testing, preclinical studies and our upcoming clinical builds.

Assemble catheter sub-assemblies and full devices following work instructions and drawings
Work with thin-walled polymer tubing, mandrels, heat-shrink, laser-cut metal tubes and micro-components
Do precision bonding (UV-cure adhesives), reflow and lamination, cutting, and visual and dimensional inspection
Keep accurate build records and traceability, following good documentation practices
Help write and improve assembly procedures, fixtures and work instructions
Report problems and suggest process improvements to the engineering team
Keep the lab organized and clean, and help with material inventory
Qualifications
Team player that contributes self-expertise to team discussions
2+ years of hands-on assembly experience in medical devices, ideally catheters, tubing or other minimally invasive devices
Excellent manual dexterity and comfort working under a microscope for long periods
Experience with UV bonding, heat-shrink or reflow processes (a strong advantage)
Ability to read technical drawings and follow detailed written procedures
Familiarity with ISO 13485 or a GMP / cleanroom environment (an advantage)
Precise, patient and organized, with a strong sense of quality
Good Hebrew, and working English
A self-starter who enjoys the pace and variety of an early-stage startup

job.title: GenAI & Data Project Manager
job.snippet:
We Are KPMG Israel.
KPMG Israel is more than a professional services firm, we are a community of people driven by impact.
As part of a leading global network, we partner with the most influential organizations to drive large-scale business and technology transformation, combining strategic thinking, innovation, and advanced technologies.
Guided by integrity, excellence, and forward thinking, we help organizations navigate complexity and create real change.
Our people are at the center, with space to lead, experiment, and grow in a dynamic and collaborative environment that connects personal development with meaningful impact on the future of business and society.
Role Overview
We are looking for a
Data & AI Project Manager
to lead the delivery of AI and Generative AI-based solutions for our clients. In this role, you will own projects end-to-end – from initial scoping and requirements definition through development, deployment, and continuous improvement.
This role is well-suited for a technically oriented project or product manager who enjoys working at the intersection of data, AI, engineering, and business, and who thrives in fast-paced, complex environments.
Responsibilities
Lead the full lifecycle of AI and data projects, from ideation and design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
Translate business and user needs into clear system requirements, technical specifications, and structured delivery plans.
Define project scope, priorities, milestones, and deliverables, ensuring execution on time, within scope, and within budget.
Collaborate closely with development, data, and infrastructure teams to support efficient delivery and resolve technical dependencies.
Drive alignment between technical solutions and business objectives, ensuring delivered solutions generate tangible client value.
Manage multiple stakeholders on both client and internal sides, maintaining clear communication and expectations.
Support the design of intuitive, user-centered AI solutions and workflows.
Identify risks, manage trade-offs, and proactively address challenges throughout the project lifecycle.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree (B.Sc) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in project or product management, with hands-on involvement in data, AI, or technology-driven initiatives.
Strong understanding of data architectures, data pipelines, analytics frameworks, and AI-driven systems.
Proven experience delivering AI or Generative AI solutions into production environments.
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, structured communication for non-technical stakeholders.
Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects with strong organizational and execution skills.
Analytical mindset with the ability to make data-driven decisions and assess trade-offs.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
High level of ownership, independence, and ability to perform in dynamic, fast-paced environments.
Nice to Have
Background in AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics projects.
Experience working in consulting or client-facing delivery roles.
Familiarity with cloud platforms and modern AI tooling.
Diversity & Inclusion
KPMG Israel is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe diversity strengthens teams and drives better outcomes, and we encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The position is open to all.

הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.

לחברה מובילה בתחום האנרגיה המתחדשת בישראל, המפעילה צי רחב של מתקנים סולאריים ומערכות אגירה בפריסה ארצית, אנו מחפשים מפעיל/ת לחדר הבקרה במטה החברה.
זהו תפקיד מרכזי עם השפעה ישירה על ביצועי הנכסים המניבים של החברה, המשלב ניטור ובקרה בזמן אמת עם ניתוח ביצועים שוטף של מערכות PV ואגירה.

ניטור ובקרה שוטפים של מתקנים סולאריים ומערכות אגירה, על גגות ובקרקע, ברחבי הארץ
מעקב שוטף אחר מצב הטעינה, הספקי הטעינה והפריקה וזמינות מערכות האגירה לאורך היום
זיהוי תקלות וחריגות, קבלת החלטות בזמן אמת ועבודה מול צוותי שטח וספקים לפתרונן
עבודה עם מערכות SCADA ופלטפורמות ניטור מתקדמות
הפקת דוחות ייצור יומיים, שבועיים וחודשיים ומעקב אחר מדדי ביצוע
זיהוי מגמות ירידה בביצועים והצעת פתרונות לשיפור
מעקב אחר עמידה ביעדי הייצור והזמינות של הנכסים
דרישות התפקיד
תואר אקדמי או הנדסאי בחשמל, אלקטרוניקה, תעשייה וניהול, אנרגיה או מערכות בקרה - חובה
ניסיון בעבודה בחדר בקרה, בניטור מערכות או בתפעול מערכות טכנולוגיות - חובה
יכולת עבודה גבוהה עם Excel וניתוח נתונים - חובה
יתרונות משמעותיים
ניסיון בניטור מערכות סולאריות ואו מערכות אגירה
היכרות עם מערכות SCADA או EMS
הבנה של משק החשמל בישראל: שעות שיא, תעריפים ואילוצי הזרמה
ניסיון בהפקת דוחות ביצוע ועבודה עם מדדי KPI
כישורים אישיים
חשיבה אנליטית, דיוק ותשומת לב לפרטים
יכולת קבלת החלטות תחת לחץ וריבוי משימות
עבודה שיטתית ומסודרת
יכולת עבודה עצמאית וכחלק מצוות
כישורי תקשורת טובים
מה מציעה המשרה?
תפקיד מרכזי בחברת אנרגיה מתחדשת בצמיחה מהירה
עבודה עם טכנולוגיות מתקדמות בתחום הסולארי והאגירה

job.title: דרוש/ה מפעיל/ת שירות בקרת מבנה BMS
job.snippet:
דרוש/ה מפעיל/ת שירות בקרת מבנה BMS
קבוצת שיכון ובינוי
מספר מקומות
איירפורט סיטי
ראשון לציון
1-2 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 5 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
לתחום בקרת המבנה דרוש/ה הנדסאי/ת שירות לתפקיד שטח הכולל מתן שירות, תחזוקה, איתור וטיפול בתקלות במערכות BMS ובמערכות אלקטרומכניות במבנים ובמתקנים.
תיאור התפקיד:
•	מתן שירות ותחזוקה שוטפת למערכות בקרת מבנה (BMS) קיימות.
•	ניטור מערכות הבקרה, זיהוי תקלות וחריגות וביצוע אבחון ראשוני.
•	איתור וטיפול בתקלות במערכות בקרה, תקשורת, בקרים וציוד קצה.
•	ביצוע פעולות הפעלה, כיבוי, איפוס, שינוי פרמטרים וכיול בהתאם לצורך.
•	עבודה מול מערכות HVAC, מיזוג אוויר, אוורור, חשמל ומערכות אלקטרומכניות.
•	ניתוח נתונים, מגמות והתראות ממערכות הבקרה לצורך איתור תקלות ושיפור תפקוד המערכות.
•	ביצוע בדיקות תקינות ותחזוקה מונעת וטיפול בתקלות בשטח.
•	קריאת שרטוטים, סכמות חשמל, תרשימי בקרה לצורך איתור תקלות וטיפול במערכות.
•	עבודה מול לקוחות, אנשי אחזקה, קבלנים וממשקים מקצועיים באתר.
•	תיעוד פעולות השירות, תקלות והטיפול בהן במערכות החברה.
•	מתן מענה מקצועי ומהיר לקריאות שירות באתרי הלקוחות.
דרישות התפקיד
•	הנדסאי/ת בקרה, חשמל, מכשור ובקרה או תחום רלוונטי.
•	ניסיון בתחום בקרת מבנה / BMS – יתרון משמעותי.
•	היכרות עם מערכות HVAC, מיזוג אוויר ואוורור.
•	ידע והבנה במערכות חשמל ולוחות חשמל.
•	ניסיון באיתור תקלות במערכות בקרה וציוד אלקטרומכני – יתרון.
•	היכרות עם בקרים, תקשורת ומערכות שליטה ובקרה.
•	ידע וניסיון בעבודה עם בקרים מתוצרת ABB – יתרון משמעותי.
•	היכרות עם תוכנת ZENON – יתרון.
•	יכולת קריאה והבנה של שרטוטים טכניים, סכמות בקרה ותרשימי P&ID.
•	שליטה טובה בסביבה ממוחשבת.
•	יכולת עבודה עצמאית בשטח ומתן שירות ללקוחות.
•	אחריות, שירותיות, סדר ויכולת פתרון בעיות.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

A global semiconductor company located in Northern Israel is looking for an experienced Integrator to join its engineering team.
Key Responsibilities:
Integrate mechanical, optical, and electronic subsystems at the machine level.
Assemble, integrate, and calibrate complex multidisciplinary systems.
Perform final system-level testing and ensure system functionality.
Troubleshoot technical issues, analyze system failures, and implement solutions.
Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
דרישות התפקיד
Practical Engineer degree in Electronics/Mechatronics/Mechanics - mandatory.
At least two years of experience in the industry with multidisciplinary systems (semiconductor companies, medical companies, defense companies, etc.).
Hands-on technical experience at machine/system level
Good English skills (reading, writing, and speaking)
Willingness to work overtime ,second shift and on Fridays as needed
Willingness to travel abroad for installations and technical support
