job.title: דרוש/ה הנדסאי/ת טכני למחלקת משאבות וכיבוי אש
job.snippet:
ל
דרוש/ה הנדסאי/ת טכני למחלקת משאבות וכיבוי אש
לימאן משאבי אנוש
אשדוד
1-2 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 20 דקות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
לחברה מובילה בתחומה, דרוש/ה הנדסאי/ת טכני/ת לתפקיד המשלב שטח, עבודה מול לקוחות וליווי טכני מקצועי במחלקת משאבות ומערכות כיבוי אש.
-ליווי טכני ושירות: מתן מענה מקצועי (טלפוני ופרונטלי) ללקוחות החברה, כולל הגעה לאתרי לקוח במידת הצורך.
-אבחון ופתרון תקלות: ביצוע דיאגנוזה ראשונית לסוג התקלה מול הלקוח והצעת פתרונות מתאימים.
-ניהול תהליך המכירה: הכנת הצעות מחיר מקצועיות ומכירת מוצרי החברה וחלקי חילוף.
-תיאום ובקרה: פתיחת קריאות שירות מול צוות הטכנאים בבית המלאכה וליווי התהליך עד לסיום הטיפול לשביעות רצון הלקוח.
תנאי המשרה:
-שעות עבודה: 08:00–17:00 (נדרשת נכונות לשעות נוספות בהתאם לצורך).
-הטבות: ארוחות מסובסדות  ורכב צמוד (שווי מס על חשבון העובד).
דרישות התפקיד
-השכלה: הנדסאי/ת מכונות / מים או תואר ראשון בקרקע ומים – חובה.
-ניסיון והבנה טכנית: ידע בתשתיות מים, מערכות זרימה, השקיה או מגופים – יתרון משמעותי.
-קריאת תוכניות: יכולת מוכחת בקריאת שרטוטים טכניים והבנת מפרטים (כולל מפרטים באנגלית).
-שפות: עברית ברמת שפת אם, אנגלית ברמה גבוהה מאוד.
-יישומי מחשב: שליטה מלאה בתוכנות Office. הכרות עם תוכנת Priority – יתרון.
-רישיון נהיגה: חובה.
כישורים נדרשים:
-יכולת עבודה עצמאית לצד עבודה בצוות.
-יחסי אנוש מעולים ותודעת שירות גבוהה.
-סדר, ארגון ויכולת עמידה בלחץ ובלוחות זמנים.
-אחריות אישית והתמדה.
-כפיפות: מנהל/ת מחלקת משאבות וכיבוי אש.
המשרה פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

מערכת נתוני אשראי הינה מערכת לאומית מרכזית התומכת בפעילות האשראי הקמעונאי במשק ומהווה תשתית חיונית לקידום התחרות, השקיפות והנגישות לאשראי. מדור ניהול תהליכים ובקרה אחראי על ניהול, תפעול ובקרה של פעילות המערכת וממשקיה, תוך הבטחת רציפות תפקודית, עמידה ברמות השירות ויישום דרישות רגולציה, אבטחת מידע והגנת פרטיות.
במסגרת התפקיד נדרשת הובלת תהליכים רוחביים, ניהול ממשקים וספקים, וקידום שיפור מתמיד של תהליכי העבודה והפעילות העסקית של המערכת. כמו כן, נדרשת הבנה טכנולוגית ותפעולית רחבה, ניסיון מקצועי רלוונטי משמעותי והיכרות מעמיקה עם תהליכי עבודה רוחביים במערכות מידע, לרבות נושאים טכנולוגיים תשתיתיים ואפליקטיביים.
תיאור התפקיד:
1. ניהול ובקרת התפעול השוטף והתקין של מערכת נתוני אשראי, על כלל רכיביה וממשקיה.
2. ניהול צוות התפעול והספקים הפועלים במערכת, לרבות הכוונה מקצועית, בקרה ומעקב אחר ביצועים.
3. תמיכה בפעילות השוטפת של המערכת וטיפול בתקלות ובאירועי כשל.
4. ניהול ובקרה של מוקדי התפעול של המערכת (NOC, AOC ומוקד לקוחות) ואתרי המחשב, לרבות ממשק מקצועי שוטף עם מוקד ה-SOC של אגף הסייבר, להבטחת רציפות תפקודית ואבטחת מידע.
5. אחריות תפעולית וניהולית כוללת על אתרי הפעילות של המערכת ברחבי הארץ, לרבות סניפי הבנק בירושלים ותל אביב, אתר הגיבוי במרכז הארץ, המוקד הטלפוני בבאר שבע, ואתרי לשכות האשראי ומקורות המידע. התפקיד כולל נוכחות פיזית באתרי הפעילות בהתאם לצורך, לשם הבטחת רציפות תפעולית ותפקוד תקין של המערכת.
6. אחריות לבקרה על תחומי הגנת הפרטיות ואבטחת המידע במערכת מטעם מנהלת המאגר.
7. היכרות והבנה מעמיקה של התהליכים העסקיים במערכת, מקומה בשוק הפיננסי והשירות הניתן לאזרח.
8. ריכוז ניהול גרסאות, תרגילי DR ואירועים תפעוליים נוספים.
9. תיאום ועבודה מול ממשקים פנימיים וחיצוניים מרובים (מקורות מידע, נותני אשראי, לשכות, רגולטורים ועוד) .
10. הובלת פורומים מקצועיים ותיאום תכניות עבודה מול כלל הגורמים המעורבים בפעילות המערכת.
11. ייזום, הקמה, שיפור וטיוב של תהליכי עבודה, בקרות, נהלים ודיווחים.
12. מעקב ובקרה אחר עמידת המערכת ביעדי השירות שנקבעו לה.
13. בנייה, ניהול ובקרה של תכניות עבודה הנגזרות מפעילות המערכת ומשימות האגף.
14. קליטה, היערכות וניהול היבטי התפעול של מערכות, שירותים ותהליכים חדשים.
15. נדרשת זמינות מעבר לשעות העבודה המקובלות, בהתאם לצורכי המערכת והתפקיד, ובפרט בעת אירועים תפעוליים חריגים, תקלות או משימות דחופות.
דרישות התפקיד
תנאי סף:
1. תואר ראשון מוכר רלוונטי.
2. שליטה מלאה בשפה העברית וידיעה טובה של השפה האנגלית.
3. שש שנות ניסיון מקצועי רלוונטי.
4. לפחות שנתיים ניסיון מוכח בניהול עובדים.
הכישורים הנדרשים:
1. ניסיון בהובלה וניהול של פרויקטים טכנולוגיים רוחביים.
2. ניסיון בניהול ספקי מיקור חוץ.
3. היכרות עם ניהול ותפעול מוקדי שירות לקוחות.
4. ניסיון בפיתוח ותחזוקה של מערכות או תהליכים טכנולוגיים – יתרון.
5. ניסיון בניהול תקציב בהיקפים משמעותיים – יתרון.
6. הסמכות טכנולוגיות רלוונטיות – יתרון.
7. ראייה מערכתית, יכולת בקרה וירידה לפרטים.
8. יכולת עבודה תחת לחץ ובסביבה מרובת ממשקים.
9. כושר ביטוי גבוה ויחסי אנוש מצוינים.
10. נכונות וזמינות לעבודה מעבר לשעות העבודה המקובלות, בהתאם לצורכי המערכת.
הערות:
- כל האמור בלשון זכר, מתייחס גם ללשון נקבה.
- רק פניות מתאימות ייענו.
- לצורך קבלת התפקיד יידרשו המועמדים/ות לעבור מבחנים.
- העיסוק והדרגה יקבעו בהתאם לכישורי המועמד/ת.
- הבנק ישקול בחיוב מתן העדפה לאוכלוסיות הזכאיות לייצוג הולם, בהתאם לכללים המקובלים, ולפיכך המועמד/ת רשאי/ת לציין זאת בשדה הייעודי בטופס הגשת המועמדות.
- הבנק שומר את המידע בהתאם להוראות חוק הגנת הפרטיות ולפי כל דין. לפרטים ולמידע בנושא הגנת הפרטיות ניתן לפנות לכתובת מייל privacy.protection@boi.org.il .
בכל פנייה לבנק ישראל יש לציין את מס' המשרה המבוקשת 84/26 (5334).

job.title: Senior ML Engineer, Search Optimization (Agentic Search)
job.snippet:
Job Description
About Nebius
Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
The Product
In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.
We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.
The Role
As a Senior ML Engineer focused on Search Optimization, you will work on improving the quality of our search product across the all parts of the search stack.
You will work on problems such as query understanding, query reformulation and expansion, retrieval, ranking, reranking, and result selection. Your goal will be to identify where search quality is lost, develop better approaches, and turn them into measurable improvements in production.
This is an applied ML and information-retrieval role combining experimentation with production impact. You will work with real-world queries, large-scale search systems, and evaluation signals to improve relevance, recall, freshness, and overall result quality.
In this position, your responsibility will be to
Design, implement, and operate the retrieval system for a search vertical
Connect and tune the data pipeline, from ingestion to relevance tuning
Build knowledge-graph and entity-resolution layers: entity linking / NER, ontologies, and graph databases (Neo4j or similar)
Develop structured-extraction pipelines over messy, unstructured domain data
Reason about freshness and trust: model how confident we are in a fact and how stale it has become before we serve it
Define evaluation and quality metrics for relevance and drive measurable improvements
Collaborate with crawling, indexing, and ML teams to ensure retrieval and ranking requirements are met
Enable safe experimentation with retrieval, ranking, and extraction strategies
You may be a good fit if you have
6+ years of software engineering experience, some of it in search / information retrieval
Strong IR fundamentals: inverted indexes, BM25/TF-IDF, query understanding, ranking, and evaluation (nDCG/MRR/recall@k)
Experience with vector & hybrid retrieval: ANN, dense+sparse fusion, embeddings models
Experience building structured extraction over messy/unstructured domain data
Fluent in Python and comfortable with systems-level performance work
Strong candidates may also have experience with
Knowledge graphs: entity resolution, entity linking / NER, graph DBs (Neo4j), ontologies / schema design
Owning relevance / ranking for a real product and improving it against IR metrics
Data quality, truth discovery, or systems that decide how much to trust a piece of information
Published work on IR, ranking, or knowledge graphs
Benefits & Perks
Competitive compensation
Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams
What's it like to work at Nebius
Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI
Equal Opportunity Statement
Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.
If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

job.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
job.snippet:
Lead AI & Automation Engineer
Summit Real Estate Group
ABOUT THE ROLE
Summit is an international real estate group operating in Israel, the United States, and Germany. We're building the group's technology and AI foundation from the ground up, and we're looking for the person to lead it: someone who sees a business problem and turns it into a working system, without waiting to be told what to do.
This is a hands-on role with full ownership. You'll start with the foundations (infrastructure, backend, and integrations), then build internal applications, automations, and an AI-powered "company brain" over the company's data. The initial focus is our U.S. operation, including travel to New York, expanding over time across the entire group, working closely with senior leadership.
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
• Can-do attitude: you look for the solution, not the reason something can't be done.
• Fast, self-directed learner: you pick up a new technology, an unfamiliar system, or a new business domain on your own, and put it to real use.
• Drive to lead: you take initiative, set direction, move people and processes forward, and want to build and lead a team over time.
• Ownership: you own what you build end to end, from idea to development to operation to business result.
• A bridge between business and technology: you speak both. You understand what the assets, finance, and operations teams need, and translate it into the right solution.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN
Leadership & Ownership
• Lead the group's technology and AI roadmap, in coordination with senior leadership.
• Collect and prioritize requests from every department by business value, and deliver them end to end.
• Over time, build and lead a team, including hiring in New York.
Gatekeeper for Vendors & Platforms
• Act as the gatekeeper for vendors and consultants: vetting proposals, challenging estimates, making build-vs-buy decisions, and overseeing quality and cost.
• Develop deep knowledge of the company's platforms, especially Yardi: integrations, data flow, and the automations built on top of them.
• Choose tools and architecture suited to the size of the company, without technology for its own sake.
Product & AI
• Define and build solutions as products: problem definition, users, MVP, measurement, and continuous improvement.
• Build the "company brain": a central knowledge layer over documents, deals, and operational data for search, summarization, and decision support.
• Integrate AI and agents into operational workflows and automations that save meaningful time.
Infrastructure & Security
• Build stable, scale-ready infrastructure that serves as the base for all systems.
• Own data security and integrity, including resident and financial data.
REQUIREMENTS
Required
• Hands-on experience building and shipping production systems and integrations.
• Experience integrating AI / LLMs in real applications (RAG, agents, automations, or similar).
• Product skills: defining needs, prioritization, MVP, and user-focused thinking.
• Strong understanding of enterprise platforms and SaaS, and experience working with vendors.
• A business head: you build for outcomes and ROI, and work effectively with non-technical stakeholders and leadership.
• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP).
• Excellent English, written and spoken.
• Willingness to travel to New York several times a year.
Preferred
• Backend development experience, ideally with Python (a strong plus).
• Experience building an internal knowledge system or AI assistant.
• Familiarity with Yardi, or real estate and property management experience.
• SQL and data engineering; DevOps / CI-CD.
• Experience with AI-assisted development tools; Microsoft 365 / SharePoint.
• Experience leading people or projects.
Be the first to build the technology and AI foundation of a growing international real estate group, with a direct line to leadership, real impact on the business, and full ownership of what you create.
Summit is an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: Hardware Manufacturing Integrator
job.snippet:
Description -
We are looking for an
experienced Integrator
to join our production line for industrial digital printing machines.
This role involves working in a multidisciplinary environment, integrating, maintaining, and troubleshooting advanced printing systems that include mechanical, electrical, electronic, laser, and pneumatic components.
If you have strong technical capabilities, a creative mindset, and the ability to solve problems in real time - we would love to hear from you.
Key Responsibilities
Perform complex integration and assembly processes on industrial digital printing machines within the production line
Troubleshoot and resolve real-time issues across multidisciplinary systems (mechanical, electrical, electronic, pneumatic, and laser)
Disassemble and reassemble components for repair and maintenance purposes
Document failures and write detailed technical reports on troubleshooting processes and implemented solutions
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Quality, and Logistics to improve processes and ensure smooth operations
Use advanced diagnostic tools and technical equipment to identify and resolve system issues
Requirements
Proven experience working in a production line environment, preferably with multidisciplinary systems
Hands-on knowledge in the following areas: electrical systems, electronics, mechanics, laser, and pneumatics
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and electrical schematics
Experience writing technical reports and documenting issues – mandatory
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure
Excellent teamwork and interpersonal skills with the ability to work across multiple interfaces
Education
Technician / Practical Engineer degree in relevant fields (Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation & Control)

job.title: Sodastream: Chief of Staff to the CEO
job.snippet:
Overview (English)
At Sodastream, part of PepsiCo, we’re looking for a highly independent and strategic
Chief of Staff to the CEO
to help shape and advance the company’s strategic agenda and drive key business priorities from strategy through execution.
Reporting directly to the CEO, the Chief of Staff will serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner, connecting long-term strategy with near-term business priorities and execution.
The role will play a key part in shaping priorities, driving strategic and cross-functional initiatives, and supporting effective decision-making across the organization.
This role requires strong business judgment, strategic thinking, and a high degree of independence, combined with the ability to drive execution and work effectively with senior leaders across functions and geographies.
Responsibilities (English)
Partner with the CEO to define, prioritize, and advance the company’s strategic agenda, translating strategic direction into clear priorities, initiatives, and measurable outcomes.
Support the CEO in evaluating competing priorities and business trade-offs, ensuring organizational resources and leadership attention remain focused on the areas with the greatest business impact.
Conduct strategic analyses of business performance, market trends, and consumer dynamics to identify growth opportunities and areas for improvement.
Lead the CEO Office operating rhythm, including leadership team meetings, business reviews, governance forums, strategic offsites, and follow-up mechanisms that drive accountability and action.
Drive cross-functional initiatives on behalf of the CEO, translating business challenges into structured workplans, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes, while addressing dependencies and barriers as needed.
Ensure the CEO’s agenda and priorities are aligned with key strategic and business objectives, using sound judgment to navigate competing priorities in close collaboration with the Executive Assistant.
Prepare high-quality executive materials, including strategic narratives, decision papers, leadership presentations, briefing notes, and business updates.

job.title: Senior Product Manager & AI Builder- 245038
job.snippet:
We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to build AI-powered products for enterprise finance teams. You’ll own the product strategy and roadmap across payments, treasury, financial operations, and ERP integrations, and prototype AI capabilities alongside Engineering, Design, and Data.
What you’ll do
Lead customer discovery with finance and operations teams. Map workflows, approval paths, exception handling, and integration points to identify where AI can improve how the work gets done.
Design, prototype, and validate GenAI capabilities such as agents, copilots, and workflow automation. Define how they access data, interact with enterprise systems, and hand off decisions that require human review.
Translate customer needs into product requirements and technical specifications covering API integrations, data models, permissions, and acceptance criteria.
Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, and business teams to move validated prototypes into production and guide customer rollout.
Define success metrics for output quality, adoption, and business impact. Use customer feedback and product data to prioritize what ships next.
What you’ll bring
5+ years of product management experience in fintech, payments, treasury, financial operations, ERP, or enterprise B2B SaaS.
End-to-end product ownership, from strategy, roadmap, and customer interviews through launch, adoption, and measurement.
Hands-on experience prototyping with GenAI platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini, and a concrete example of an AI application, agent, copilot, or automation workflow you helped build and bring into production.
Technical fluency in APIs, system integrations, data models, and enterprise software architecture.
Experience translating complex customer workflows into clear requirements and working through trade-offs with engineering teams.
Nice to have
Experience with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Lovable, Bolt, Replit, or similar tools.
Familiarity with agent architectures, MCP, RAG, workflow orchestration, or prompt engineering.
Experience integrating with SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Priority, or Microsoft Dynamics.
Full-time | Hybrid

job.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
job.snippet:
A leading engineering company in the energy sector is developing advanced systems for deep geothermal drilling. The company focuses on designing and building complex mechanical systems that operate in extreme environments, combining hands-on development, prototyping, and full system ownership from concept to field deployment.
The company is seeking a
Senior Mechanical Engineer
to take ownership of the design and development of large-scale drilling systems, working in a highly hands-on environment with end-to-end responsibility.
Join us and help build the future of deep geothermal energy.
Responsibilities
Lead mechanical design of drilling systems
Design large mechanical assemblies including energy transmission, thermal management, and fluid-flow systems
Perform structural analysis and FEA
Apply DFM principles and optimize for manufacturability and cost
Plan and execute lab and field testing
Work closely with multidisciplinary teams (thermal, RF, fluid) on system integration
Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturers in Israel and abroad
Maintain full engineering documentation throughout development cycles
Support field validation activities at the company's testing sites, including periodic travel to the U.S.
Requirements:
5+ years of mechanical design experience
Strong proficiency in SolidWorks or similar CAD tools
Proven experience designing and building complex mechanical systems
Ability to work independently in fast-moving, early-stage environments
Willingness to travel periodically to the company's testing site in the U.S. as part of field testing and validation activities.
Hands-on experience with hardware assembly and testing – advantage
Experience with high-power thermal systems – advantage
Experience with fluid-flow / hydraulic systems – advantage

job.title: People Tech Product Manager
job.snippet:
About the Role:
We recently implemented SuccessFactors and are now focused on enhancing and scaling our HR systems at monday.com. As a People Tech Product Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring our HR technology operates efficiently and evolves with the organization’s needs. This hands-on role involves managing daily system operations, data integrity, configuration, troubleshooting, and supporting new HRIS implementations. You will build deep expertise in HRIS systems and become a trusted owner of our core HR technology infrastructure.
Responsibilities:
Data Management & Configuration (Approximately 70% of your time)
Prepare, validate, and upload employee data into HRIS systems and related tools, proactively troubleshooting and resolving data quality issues in collaboration with HR and IT teams.
Configure and maintain HRIS modules by setting up workflows, approvals, permissions, and business rules. Support and document new modules as they are introduced, ensuring system hygiene and up-to-date documentation.
Project Support (Approximately 30% of your time)
Assist with the rollout and integration of new HRIS modules and related systems. Participate in testing, documentation, and cross-team coordination to ensure smooth implementation.
Troubleshoot and resolve HRIS-related issues, taking ownership of system debugging and problem-solving. Learn about system integration points and data flows between platforms.
Requirements:
1–3 years of hands-on experience working in HRIS systems (such as SuccessFactors, Workday, or similar), including data uploads, configuration, and/or system maintenance.
Basic understanding of HR processes and the supporting technology landscape.
Excellent attention to detail with a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and resolve technical issues.
Effective communication skills, able to clearly explain technical matters to HR and IT stakeholders.
Eagerness to learn, with an openness to new tools and processes and a proactive approach to asking questions and closing knowledge gaps.
Nice-to-Haves:
Direct experience with SuccessFactors modules.
Background in data validation and cleansing.
Familiarity with system integrations and data flows.
Experience with platforms like Ashby or other HR tools.
Education in Industrial Engineering or Information Systems.
Experience working in a fast-growing company.

job.title: Industry Lead - Healthcare
job.snippet:
About The Role
Wonderful’s owner of a healthcare vertical, bringing together deep industry expertise and a clear perspective on how AI and agentic capabilities can transform the sector.
You will connect the dots across go-to-market, deployment, product, and marketing to identify where AI can create the most value. Working closely with GMs globally, you will shape account strategies, support strategic customer engagements, and raise the bar across deployments by scaling industry knowledge, learnings, and best practices.
This is a fully remote role that allows you to work from anywhere and requires significant travel.
What You’ll Do
Shape the vertical strategy: develop a clear view of where AI and agentic capabilities drive the most value, including high-impact use cases, industry trends and emerging opportunities
Own the commercial go-to-market offering: bring together the strongest use cases, agents, integrations, and customer references into a compelling, reusable industry offering across product, marketing, and sales
Drive account strategy with GMs: partner with GMs on priority accounts, shaping and challenging account plans, identifying opportunities, and developing strategic approaches to customers
Support strategic customer engagements: join C-level meetings, pitches, workshops and deployment reviews to bring industry credibility
Connect teams and scale learnings: align go-to-market, deployment, product, and marketing; translate deployment insights into stronger sales propositions, playbooks, and product priorities
Build the industry community: establish a network of industry champions across markets to share success stories and lessons learned
What we’re looking for
Deep industry expertise: 10+ years of industry experience, with a strong understanding of industry dynamics, key processes, and business value drivers, able to speak to a customer with specifics
AI-driven mindset: strong understanding of AI and agentic technologies, with the ability to translate capabilities into tangible business value and challenge traditional industry approaches
Strong strategic background: experience in a top-tier strategy consultancy or a strategic, industry-focused role at a fast-growing technology company
Executive presence: experience engaging senior executives and influencing customer decisions
Cross-functional leadership: ability to connect teams and drive initiatives across geographies and functions
End-to-end perspective: comfortable working across the customer lifecycle, from shaping opportunities and go-to-market strategy to driving value through deployment
How success is measured
How effectively GMs win and grow accounts in the vertical.
Candidate Privacy Notice

job.title: Contracts Coordinator
job.snippet:
A leading infrastructure and construction company is looking for a
Contracts Coordinator
to join its legal team and take an active role in managing the company's contractual and commercial processes.
This is an excellent opportunity for candidates with experience in contracts, insurance, tenders, legal operations, procurement, or commercial administration who are looking to expand their expertise within a dynamic project-based environment.
Key Responsibilities
Manage the company's guarantees process, including issuance, renewals, amendments, tracking, and releases.
Review contracts and commercial agreements with clients, subcontractors, and suppliers, and coordinate comments prior to execution.
Manage insurance certificates and ensure compliance with contractual requirements.
Monitor claims, legal matters, and correspondence with external legal counsel.
Maintain contract databases, key milestones, and contractual obligations.
Work closely with project managers, procurement, finance, and external stakeholders.
Requirements
At least 2 years of experience in contracts administration, legal coordination, insurance, tenders, procurement, or a similar role.
Familiarity with commercial agreements, guarantees, insurance documentation, or contract management processes.
Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
High level of ownership, initiative, and professional maturity.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
Advantages
Israeli Bar membership.
Experience with public tenders and public sector contracts.
Background in construction, infrastructure, engineering, insurance, legal services, or procurement environments.
What We're Looking For
A sharp, detail-oriented professional with strong analytical thinking, excellent organizational abilities, and a proactive approach. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting complex projects and ensuring smooth contractual operations across the organization.
📍
Location:
Tel Aviv
🕒
Position Type:
Full-Time
📩 Interested candidates are invited to apply and submit their CV for consideration.

job.title: Service Operations Specialist
job.snippet:
BioCatch is the leader in Behavioral Biometrics, a technology that leverages machine learning to analyze an online user’s physical and cognitive digital behavior to protect individuals online. BioCatch’s mission is to unlock the power of behavior and deliver actionable insights to create a digital world where identity, trust and ease seamlessly co-exist. Today, BioCatch counts over 35 of the top 100 global banks as customers who use BioCatch solutions to fight fraud, drive digital transformation, and accelerate business growth. BioCatch’s Client Innovation Board, an industry-led initiative including American Express, Barclays, Citi Ventures, and National Australia Bank, helps BioCatch to identify creative and cutting-edge ways to leverage the unique attributes of behavior for fraud prevention. With over a decade of analyzing data, more than 80 registered patents, and unparalleled experience, BioCatch continues to innovate to solve tomorrow’s problems. For more information, please visit www.biocatch.com.
Come join the dynamic BioCatch Operations group and play a key role in facilitating and managing our most crucial service-related processes. Let your skill shine and be part of a team that ensures BioCatch’s service continuity while delivering a seamless top-class service to our valued customers.
What You’ll Do:
Own and lead the Incident Management process at BioCatch.
Work continuously with our Tech Support group and all its interfaces to obtain flawless incident management handling and recovery.
Maintain the Incident Management protocols and documentation
Produce customer-facing formal RCA reports based on internal reports and technical information
Take part in the Incident Manager on-call duty, and orchestrate incidents’ handling in Production
Review SLA data and produce monthly and quarterly SLA reports
Serve as an infrastructure liaison of the Operations group
Enrich our tutorial documents, to nurture increased efficiency of incidents’ investigation and recovery.
Work closely and follow up with our developers and technical teams to solve detected problems and improve our product and infrastructure.
Communicate and follow up with our customers about the progress of committed improvements and fixes as part of the RCA conclusions.
Attend war room meetings and retro.
Requirements:
2+ years of experience managing Production incidents in a SaaS organization
ITIL processes familiarity, especially Incident Management, RCA, and Problem Management
A relevant technological, scientific, or engineering degree
Technical skills and knowledge (monitoring, troubleshooting, log reading, SQL, etc.).
Customer-facing skills.
Cloud infrastructure management or maintenance experience
Excellent written and spoken English level
Matrix management skills
Knowledge of customer service principles and practices
ITIL certification – an advantage.

job.title: Technical Program & Deployment Manager
job.snippet:
Company Description
Sensorz provides an open software platform for real-time detection, classification, and geolocation of RF signals, enabling rapid responses to RF events. The platform supports a wide range of defense applications, including spectral monitoring of borders, critical infrastructure, and sensitive assets, as well as spectrum management in contested environments. Using advanced algorithms and highly efficient data handling, Sensorz is optimized for flexible deployment on mobile platforms such as UAVs, naval vessels, and ground vehicles. Beyond defense, the platform is also used in airports and seaports to detect unauthorized transmitters and interference that could affect essential communications. Sensorz offers opportunities to work on mission-critical technology with real-world impact across security and transportation domains.
The Role
Sensorz is seeking a hands-on Technical Program & Deployment Manager to lead customer delivery, implementation and operational deployment programs worldwide, with current focus on Africa and India. This role combines end-to-end program ownership, customer leadership and the ability to work directly with field teams and technical systems.
Key Responsibilities
Own international deployment programs from planning and installation through integration, acceptance, training and ongoing operations.
Lead and coordinate delivery teams, field engineers, partners and customer stakeholders; manage schedules, milestones, risks and escalations.
Drive hands-on field activities, including system setup, RF/cellular data collection, testing, troubleshooting and technical reporting.
Work closely with engineering and product teams to resolve issues, improve delivery processes and ensure customer success.
Serve as the primary technical and operational interface with customers, including telecom operators and regulatory organizations.
Required Qualifications
Proven experience leading complex, multidisciplinary technical deployments and customer-facing projects, with strong hands-on capabilities.
Strong cellular telecommunications background, especially RAN, radio coverage, network performance and QoS; experience in coverage or QoS teams strongly preferred.
Solid understanding of RF, cellular measurements and KPIs, telecom networks, IP networking and field troubleshooting.
Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage multiple workstreams independently and deliver results in challenging field environments.
Fluent French, English and Hebrew — all mandatory.
Based in Israel and willing to travel frequently to international deployment sites.
Advantages
Experience with spectrum monitoring, RF sensing, telecom regulators, mobile network operators or projects in Africa and India.
Full-time | Reports to COO

Using advanced algorithms and highly efficient data handling, Sensorz is optimized for flexible deployment on mobile platforms such as UAVs, naval vessels, and ground vehicles. Beyond defense, the platform is also used in airports and seaports to detect unauthorized transmitters and interference that could affect essential communications. Sensorz offers opportunities to work on mission-critical technology with real-world impact across security and transportation domains.
The Role
Sensorz is seeking a hands-on Technical Program & Deployment Manager to lead customer delivery, implementation and operational deployment programs worldwide, with current focus on Africa and India. This role combines end-to-end program ownership, customer leadership and the ability to work directly with field teams and technical systems.
Key Responsibilities
Own international deployment programs from planning and installation through integration, acceptance, training and ongoing operations.
Lead and coordinate delivery teams, field engineers, partners and customer stakeholders; manage schedules, milestones, risks and escalations.
Drive hands-on field activities, including system setup, RF/cellular data collection, testing, troubleshooting and technical reporting.
Work closely with engineering and product teams to resolve issues, improve delivery processes and ensure customer success.
Serve as the primary technical and operational interface with customers, including telecom operators and regulatory organizations.
Required Qualifications
Proven experience leading complex, multidisciplinary technical deployments and customer-facing projects, with strong hands-on capabilities.
Strong cellular telecommunications background, especially RAN, radio coverage, network performance and QoS; experience in coverage or QoS teams strongly preferred.
Solid understanding of RF, cellular measurements and KPIs, telecom networks, IP networking and field troubleshooting.
Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage multiple workstreams independently and deliver results in challenging field environments.
Fluent French, English and Hebrew — all mandatory.
Based in Israel and willing to travel frequently to international deployment sites.
Advantages
Experience with spectrum monitoring, RF sensing, telecom regulators, mobile network operators or projects in Africa and India.
Full-time | Reports to COO

job.title: Industry Lead - Energy, Utilities and Industrials
job.snippet:
About The Role
Wonderful’s owner of a energy, utilities and industrials vertical, bringing together deep industry expertise and a clear perspective on how AI and agentic capabilities can transform the sector.
You will connect the dots across go-to-market, deployment, product, and marketing to identify where AI can create the most value. Working closely with GMs globally, you will shape account strategies, support strategic customer engagements, and raise the bar across deployments by scaling industry knowledge, learnings, and best practices.
This is a fully remote role that allows you to work from anywhere and requires significant travel.
What You’ll Do
Shape the vertical strategy: develop a clear view of where AI and agentic capabilities drive the most value, including high-impact use cases, industry trends and emerging opportunities
Own the commercial go-to-market offering: bring together the strongest use cases, agents, integrations, and customer references into a compelling, reusable industry offering across product, marketing, and sales
Drive account strategy with GMs: partner with GMs on priority accounts, shaping and challenging account plans, identifying opportunities, and developing strategic approaches to customers
Support strategic customer engagements: join C-level meetings, pitches, workshops and deployment reviews to bring industry credibility
Connect teams and scale learnings: align go-to-market, deployment, product, and marketing; translate deployment insights into stronger sales propositions, playbooks, and product priorities
Build the industry community: establish a network of industry champions across markets to share success stories and lessons learned
What we’re looking for
Deep industry expertise: 10+ years of industry experience, with a strong understanding of industry dynamics, key processes, and business value drivers, able to speak to a customer with specifics
AI-driven mindset: strong understanding of AI and agentic technologies, with the ability to translate capabilities into tangible business value and challenge traditional industry approaches
Strong strategic background: experience in a top-tier strategy consultancy or a strategic, industry-focused role at a fast-growing technology company
Executive presence: experience engaging senior executives and influencing customer decisions
Cross-functional leadership: ability to connect teams and drive initiatives across geographies and functions
End-to-end perspective: comfortable working across the customer lifecycle, from shaping opportunities and go-to-market strategy to driving value through deployment
How success is measured
How effectively GMs win and grow accounts in the vertical.
Candidate Privacy Notice

job.title: Trade Manager
job.snippet:
Company Description
Best מרקט is a growing supermarket chain focused on delivering quality products and value-driven services to its customers.
Role Description
We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Trade Manager to lead and manage the food product category across our retail chain.
The role involves full responsibility for the management of the food category, from identifying new suppliers and products to negotiating commercial terms, developing an attractive product assortment, and overseeing profitability, promotions, and inventory management.
The ideal candidate combines strong commercial awareness, excellent negotiation skills, and a data-driven approach to category management.
Qualifications
* At least 3 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, or trade management within the food retail industry.
* Proven experience as a Buyer, Senior Buyer, or Trade Manager.
* Demonstrated experience in commercial negotiations and supplier management.
* Strong analytical skills and a high level of proficiency in data analysis.
* Strong understanding of retail operations, pricing, margins, and profitability.
* Excellent commercial judgment and business-oriented thinking.
* Strong organizational skills, independence, and ability to manage multiple priorities.

job.title: Mechanical Assembler
job.snippet:
לחברה ביטחונית מובילה בחזית הטכנולוגיה, אנו מגייסים טכנאי/ת הרכבות מכאניות לתחום הלוויינים ומערכות החלל.
העבודה באזור המרכז
לא מדובר בפס ייצור שגרתי או רוטיני – אלא בעבודה על מערכות ייחודיות, מורכבות ומגוונות, הדורשות ירידה לפרטים, יכולת אלתור וגמישות מחשבתית ברמה גבוהה מאוד.
מה כולל התפקיד?
ביצוע הרכבות מכאניות מדויקות ומורכבות של תת-מערכות ומכלולים לעולם הלוויינים.
עבודה שוטפת ומדויקת מול שרטוטים מכאניים מורכבים והוראות עבודה באנגלית טכנית.
יישום תהליכי הדבקה מתקדמים, עבודה עם דבקים ייעודיים לתנאי חלל ומינוני חומר קפדניים.
הידוק ברגים באמצעות מדי מומנט (מומנטי פיתול / טורקים) על פי מפרטים קפדניים.
שילוב והרכבה של מנגנונים עדינים, גלגלי שיניים ומערכות הנעה זעירות.
עבודה עם כלי מדידה ומכשירי בדיקה מדויקים לאימות איכות ההרכבה.
תפקיד דינמי עם אופק התפתחות מקצועי נרחב בתוך החברה.
מה אנחנו מחפשים?
ניסיון מעשי כטכנאי/ת הרכבות מכאניות מדויקות
(עדיפות ליוצאי תעשיות ביטחוניות / תעופה וחלל / אופטיקה / מכשור רפואי).
קריאה והבנה של שרטוטים מכאניים מורכבים
– חובה.
אנגלית טכנית ברמה טובה מאוד
(קריאת מפרטים, שרטוטים ונהלי עבודה) – חובה.
היכרות וניסיון מעשי בעבודה עם:
תהליכי הדבקה וחומרי הדבקה שונים.
עבודה עם מדי מומנט (טורק).
מנגנונים מכאניים עדינים / גלגלי שיניים.
כלי מדידה וציוד בדיקה.
גמישות מחשבתית ויכולת פתרון בעיות
(הרכבות יוניק משתנות ולא עבודה שבלונית).
דיוק, סבלנות, פדנטיות ויכולת עבודה תחת תקנים מחמירים (סביבת חדר נקי – יתרון).

job.title: Senior Real-Time SW Engineer
job.snippet:
Quantum Machines is a global leader in hybrid control systems for quantum computing, a field on the verge of exponential growth.
Our innovative hardware and software offer a groundbreaking approach to controlling quantum computers, scaling from individual qubits to arrays of thousands.
At the heart of QM is a passionate, ambitious team committed to transforming the construction and operation of quantum computers. Our deep understanding of customer needs drives us to deliver unmatched solutions in this revolutionary field.
We are looking for a highly skilled
Real-Time C++ Engineer
who embodies ambition and positivity — someone who takes ownership of complex, performance-critical problems and collaborates effectively with remote and on-site teams to meet and exceed our objectives and fulfill the evolving needs of our expanding customer base.
The Real-Time C++ component is at the core of our Quantum Orchestration Platform — it serves as the driver for the Pulse Processing Unit (PPU), our proprietary VLSI-based engine. This component is responsible for preparing, loading, and launching the execution of quantum-computing workloads, operating at extreme performance levels to maximize hardware utilization and minimize software overhead.
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain the real-time C++ layer that drives the Pulse Processing Unit (PPU), QM's proprietary VLSI-based processor.
Design and implement high-performance software for preparing, loading, and launching quantum-computing workloads with minimal latency and maximal hardware utilization.
Drive relentless optimization of the software stack to minimize SW overhead in the critical path, ensuring the hardware operates at peak throughput.
Collaborate closely with VLSI, compiler, and architecture teams to ensure seamless software-hardware integration across the quantum control stack.
Contribute hands-on to the codebase — designing, implementing, reviewing, debugging, and profiling performance-critical code paths.
Uphold the team's engineering standards, code quality practices, and performance benchmarking methodologies, and help raise the bar over time.
Participate in technical planning and roadmap discussions, aligning your work with product and customer needs.
Requirements:
At least 5 years of hands-on C++ development experience in performance-critical or real-time systems — Must.
BSc. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a relevant technical field (advanced degrees are an advantage) — Must.
Deep understanding of systems programming, memory management, concurrency, and low-level optimization techniques — Must.
Experience with profiling, benchmarking, and performance tuning of latency-sensitive software — Must.
Experience developing drivers or software interfacing with VLSI, hardware accelerators, or embedded processors — Advantage.
Experience working in a multidisciplinary environment alongside hardware, VLSI, and algorithm teams — Advantage.

ב.א מיקרוגלים
, מקבוצת
Commit
, המתמחה בפיתוח וייצור מערכות אלקטרוניות מתקדמות, מגייסת

להצטרפות לצוות הייצור שלנו.

חיווט והרכבת מכלולים אלקטרוניים, רתמות וצב"דים.
ייצור כבלים ורתמות בהתאם לשרטוטים, תיקי ייצור ותקני IPC.
ביצוע הלחמות, קרימפינג והרכבות אלקטרוניות.
עבודה עם קונקטורים צבאיים ותעופתיים.
ביצוע בדיקות איכות עצמאיות, בדיקות רציפות (Continuity) ובדיקות חשמליות.
דיווח ותיעוד במערכות הארגון.
עבודה בהתאם לנהלי איכות ו-ESD.
עמידה ביעדי ייצור ולוחות זמנים.

דרישות התפקיד
לפחות 3 שנות ניסיון בחיווט והרכבת מכלולים אלקטרוניים, רתמות וצב"דים.
ניסיון בקריאת שרטוטים חשמליים ומכניים.
הסמכה לתקני IPC בתחום החיווט וההרכבות האלקטרוניות – יתרון משמעותי.
ניסיון בעבודה עם קונקטורים צבאיים ותעופתיים כגון D38999 ו-Micro-D.
ניסיון בביצוע הלחמות וקרימפינג בהתאם לתקני IPC.
היכרות עם תהליכי בקרת איכות וביצוע ביקורת עצמית.
ניסיון בעבודה עם כלי חיווט, כלי קרימפ וכלי הכנסת והוצאת פינים.
ניסיון בחיווט כבלי RF וקואקס – יתרון.
מיומנויות אישיות
אחריות אישית ומקצועית גבוהה.
סדר, ארגון ודיוק בפרטים.
יכולת עבודה עצמאית לצד עבודת צוות.
יחסי אנוש מצוינים וגישה חיובית.
יכולת ניהול משימות מקצה לקצה.

job.title: Assembly Technician
job.snippet:
What we are looking for:
The production team at Nova is looking for Assembly Technician to join the team and work on state of the art tools in the semiconductor industry.
You’ll be joining the RMA Production group. In this role, you will be responsible for manufacturing the company’s products while ensuring the highest standards of quality and timely delivery.
As part of your job, you will interact and work with the integration and Engineering departments to troubleshoot complicated mechanical and optical problems to produce the measurement unit.
We invite you to join our dreamers and winners! Brilliant high- aimers who see impossible as the starting point to exciting challenges and work together in multidisciplinary global teams to find answers.
What will you be doing:
Assembly and test systems containing optical, mechanical and electrical components in accordance with Nova’s Delivery plan.
Working in an organized way using digital procedures and flow management system.
Strive to high Quality in all production aspects and on time delivery.
Always striving to reduce cycle time and improve working process.
Actively involved in Transfer to Production (TTP) projects.
Collaborate with assembly team members to produce measurement unit.
Working in a clean room environment
Requirements:
Hands on experience with sub assembly phases and modules.
Technical understanding of assembly, calibrations and testing measurement systems.
Fast learner with trouble shouting skills.
Experience with optical and mechanical assemblies –
an advantage.
Experience with basic integration of electrooptic, motion-controlled assemblies –
an advantage
.
That special something you bring in:
Good verbal communication skills.
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Self-motivation.
Get to know us better:
Nova (NASDAQ: NVMI) is a global company and a leading provider of innovative metrology solutions for process control in semiconductor manufacturing.
With a team of ~1200 people in three R&D centers and 27 field offices, we bring insights into the world’s most advanced industry. We leverage multiple technology fields such as physics, optics, chemistry, and algorithms to develop hardware and software solutions that measure almost every advanced computer chip built in the world.
Nova dives deep into dimensions and layers at the atomic level to extract unique insights and provide our customers with crucial decision-making data, managing critical challenges by providing unique, differentiated solutions.
Our outstanding people-focused and innovative
culture means every person at Nova has the power to make an impact and significantly redefine what people can achieve through technology.
Join us if you are
A dreamer and brilliant high aimer who sees the impossible as the starting point and loves working in a multidisciplinary global team to create innovative breakthroughs.
If you need assistance due to a disability, you may contact us at
talent@novami.com

job.snippet:
חסוי
לחברה מובילה בתחומה דרוש/ה מתאם/ת יבוא
- חסוי -
ראש העין
3-4 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 8 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
לחברה מובילה וגדולה בתחומה דרוש/ה מתאם/ת ייבוא לניהול ותפעול שוטף של תהליכי ייבוא מקצה לקצה.
התפקיד כולל עבודה יומיומית מול ספקים וגורמי לוגיסטיקה בארץ ובחו"ל, מעקב צמוד אחר משלוחים ופתרון בעיות תפעוליות בזמן אמת.
תיאור התפקיד ותחומי אחריות:
* תפעול שרשרת הייבוא- תפעול ומעקב שוטף אחר הזמנות רכש ומשלוחים (ים ואוויר) משלב היציאה ועד הגעתם ליעד.
* עבודה שוטפת ויומיומית מול ספקים בחו"ל, משלחים ועמילי מכס.
* הפקת הצעות מחיר מחברות שילוח, עבודה במערכת חשבשבת.
* עבודה מול עמילי מכס- טיפול במסמכי יבוא (שטרי מטען, תקינותם, ובדיקה ואישור של רשומון הייבוא מול עמילי המכס.
* זיהוי עיכובים או שינויים בלוחות זמנים, ומתן פתרונות תפעוליים מהירים בזמן אמת.
* עבודה צמודה ומעקב שוטף מול קניינים המחלקה  הכספים והשירות בחברה.
משרה מלאה ימים א-ה 8:00-17:00
מיקום: ראש העין
דרישות התפקיד
* ניסיון של 3-5 שנים לפחות בתפקיד דומה - חובה
* אנגלית ברמה גבוהה מאוד (קריאה, כתיבה ודיבור) - חובה.
* מערכות מידע - שליטה מלאה ביישומי Office עם דגש על Excel ו - Outlook - חובה.
* מערכת ERP - ניסיון עבודה במערכת חשבשבת - יתרון משמעותי.
* יכולת ארגון גבוהה, סדר, ירידה לפרטים ודיוק, לצד יכולת ניהול עצמי של משימות ולוחות זמנים צפופים.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

job.title: הנדסאי.ת אדריכלות | בני ברק / ירושלים
job.snippet:
הנדסאי.ת אדריכלות | בני ברק / ירושלים
מסד גרופ
מספר מקומות
בני ברק
ירושלים
1-2 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 8 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
קבוצת מסד היא החברה המובילה בישראל בתחום בקרת התכנון ואיכות הבנייה. כבר למעלה מ-20 שנה אנו מלווים את חברות היזום, הבנייה והתכנון מהמובילות במשק, תוך הקפדה על סטנדרטים מקצועיים גבוהים, חדשנות ומצוינות. אצלנו תיהנו מסביבת עבודה מקצועית, תומכת ומלמדת, עם הזדמנות אמיתית להתפתח ולהעמיק את הידע בעולם התכנון והבנייה.
אנחנו מגייסים הנדסאיות.ים אדריכלות למחלקת מפרטי המכר – תפקיד מקצועי ומגוון בעולם התכנון והבנייה, הכולל עבודה על פרויקטי מגורים, הכנת מפרטים וליווי הלקוחות לאורך התהליך.
אם את.ה אוהב.ת תוכניות, דיוק, עבודה מסודרת וגם נהנה.ית מתקשורת עם אנשים – אנחנו מחפשים אותך.
מה כולל התפקיד?
הכנת מפרטי מכר לפרויקטים בתחום המגורים.
עבודה שוטפת עם תוכניות אדריכליות ומסמכי הפרויקט.
בדיקה והתאמה בין התוכניות, המפרט והדרישות המקצועיות.
עבודה עם חומרי גמר, פרטי דירות ואלמנטים שונים בפרויקט.
איתור אי-התאמות, השלמת פרטים ועדכון המפרטים בהתאם לשינויים בפרויקט.
ניהול תיקי לקוחות וליווי הפרויקט מול הלקוח לאורך תהליך העבודה.
קשר שוטף וישיר עם לקוחות, מענה לשאלות ומתן מענה מקצועי בהתאם לצורכי הפרויקט.
עבודה מול אדריכלים, יועצים וגורמים מקצועיים נוספים.
מעקב אחר משימות, לוחות זמנים וסטטוס הפרויקט.
למידה והעמקה בתהליכי התכנון והבנייה של פרויקטים למגורים
דרישות התפקיד
הנדסאי.ת אדריכלות – חובה.
ניסיון בעבודה עם תוכניות אדריכליות – יתרון משמעותי.
ניסיון במשרד אדריכלים, חברת בנייה/יזמות או בתחום דומה – יתרון.
שליטה בקריאת תוכניות והבנה מרחבית.
יכולת ירידה לפרטים, סדר ודיוק.
שירותיות ויכולת תקשורת טובה מול לקוחות.
יכולת עבודה עצמאית לצד עבודת צוות.
אחריות, יסודיות ורצון ללמוד ולהתמקצע
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
רוצה ללמוד איך לעבוד מול היזמים והאדריכלים המובילים בישראל?
קבוצת מסד מגייסת הנדסאי/ת אדריכלות לבקרת תוכניות!
מי אנחנו?
קבוצת מסד היא החברה המובילה בישראל בתחום בקרת התכנון ואיכות הבנייה. כבר למעלה מ-20 שנה שאנחנו מלווים את חברות היזום, הבנייה והתכנון מהשורה הראשונה במשק, תוך הובלת סטנדרטים מקצועיים גבוהים, חדשנות ומצוינות.
אצלנו תיהנו מסביבת עבודה מקצועית, תומכת ומלמדת, שתעניק לכם מקפצה מקצועית אדירה, הזדמנות אמיתית להתפתח ולצבור ניסיון מעשי בעבודה מול מנהלי הפרויקטים, האדריכלים והיזמים הגדולים בארץ!

job.title: PMO – AI Data Center
job.snippet: Description: We are seeking a PMO to join this dedicated data center task force. The PMO will serve as a central function within the task force, acting as a key integrator across all project workstreams and stakeholders.  In this role, the PMO will hold the full project view of mega-scale data center projects, from site development, zoning and permitting, through design and engineering, to construction, commissioning and handover. The PMO will oversee integrated project schedules and deliverables control, and drive reporting, data management and performance visibility across all workstreams.  The PMO will work closely with a large, multidisciplinary group, including designers, team leaders, project managers, engineering teams, consultants, contractors, suppliers and senior management, to ensure alignment, transparency, and informed decision-making, supporting the successful delivery of projects in accordance with contractual milestones and strategic objectives.  | Responsibilities: Develop, maintain, and oversee detailed project schedules from early development, zoning and permitting through design, construction, commissioning, and handover to client and O&M  Monitor overall project and portfolio progress, identifying risks, delays, and mitigation strategies  Perform schedule analysis, critical path analysis, and progress tracking across projects  Lead deliverables control across all workstreams, tracking design packages, permit and zoning submissions, contractor and supplier submittals, review cycles and approvals against project milestones  Lead the preparation of management reports, dashboards, deliverables status, and performance insights  Maintain and enhance BI tools, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and timely updates  Provide structured updates and key insights to management to support decision-making  ordinate inputs across engineering, procurement, construction, and subcontractors to ensure alignment  Support change management and development of recovery plans when required  Capture, document, and implement lessons learned across projects to drive continuous improvement  Support the development, standardization, and enforcing  of data center specific company and departmental procedures, tools, and best practices  Drive standardization of planning, reporting, and control processes within the department  Lead project deliverables planning and control across all workstreams, including establishing submission plans, defining milestones and target dates, assigning responsible stakeholders, monitoring progress of all project deliverables, identifying gaps and delays, and driving corrective actions to ensure timely completion and alignment with project objectives. | Requirements: Academic degree or professional certificate studies in Engineering, Construction Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, combined with solid hands-on experience  Proven experience in a PMO, Planning, or Project Controls role within construction projects (renewable energy – advantage)  Experience with data center projects – advantage  Strong knowledge with MS Project  Good understanding of construction methodologies and the full project lifecycle, including design, permitting and zoning  Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into insights  Ability to work both independently and within a multidisciplinary team  Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills  Experience with reporting tools and BI platforms (e.g., Power BI) – advantage  Experience with deliverables or document control systems (e.g., Aconex, Procore) – advantage  Experience with AI tools - advantage

job.title: NOC Operator
job.snippet:
NOC Operator | IT Operations & Monitoring | 24/7 Shifts
Already have NOC experience? Take the next step in enterprise IT operations and monitoring.
A leading organization in Central Israel is looking for an experienced
NOC Operator
to monitor and operate critical IT systems, identify operational issues, and help maintain system availability around the clock.
This role is designed for professionals with previous NOC experience who are comfortable working in a 24/7 operational environment, monitoring system processes, providing first-level incident response, and escalating technical issues when needed.
You'll work in a structured operations environment, ensuring that essential computing systems and processes continue running smoothly.
What You'll Do
Continuously monitor the organization's central computing systems.
Track system processes, scheduled operations, and ongoing system activities.
Verify that operational processes are running correctly and receiving the resources they require.
Provide initial Level 1 troubleshooting and incident response.
Identify system anomalies, operational failures, and technical alerts.
Escalate incidents to the appropriate technical teams.
Support the availability and operational continuity of critical IT systems and infrastructure.
Document incidents, troubleshooting activities, and operational events during shifts.
Work in a 24/7 shift-based IT operations environment.
Mandatory Requirements
At least 1 year of professional NOC experience.
Previous technical work experience.
Ability to monitor IT systems and identify technical issues.
Ability to provide initial troubleshooting and first-level incident response.
Ability to work under pressure in an operational environment.
Strong sense of responsibility, organization, and independent working capabilities.
Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
Availability for 24/7 shift work, including weekends.
Advantages
Previous experience as a Computer Operator.
Familiarity with central computing infrastructure.
Previous Level 1 technical support experience.
Experience working with Mainframe systems.
Position Details
Location:
Central Israel
Work Schedule:
24/7 rotating shifts, Sunday through Saturday
Professional Focus:
NOC Operations, IT Monitoring, Incident Response, and Central Computing Systems
If you have NOC experience and enjoy keeping critical IT systems running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: GTM Operations manager
job.snippet:
This is us
Kaltura (NYSE: KLTR) is a global software company on a mission to transform digital experiences from one-way interactions into intelligent, personalized conversations that move people forward.
Founded in 2006, we started by making video more accessible to organizations around the world. Today, we're taking that foundation much further, combining conversational AI, rich media, enterprise knowledge, and data to build a new generation of intelligent digital experiences.
Our technology helps organizations turn their content and knowledge into interactive, AI-powered experiences that can guide customers, train employees, support learners, and engage audiences in real time. From AI agents and personalized learning experiences to digital events, content hubs, and media platforms, we're changing how people interact with technology, and what technology can do for them.
More than 1,000 organizations worldwide rely on Kaltura, reaching over 100 million users at home, at work, and at school.
And the people behind it?
We're a global team of 600+ employees, with offices in New York, London, Singapore, and Tel Aviv, united by a culture of openness, flexibility, and collaboration. Kaltura is a fast-paced environment where ideas are welcome, initiative is encouraged, and there's always something new to build, challenge, or improve. We believe in giving people the freedom to make an impact, the flexibility to balance work and life, and the opportunity to grow as we continue to evolve.
If you don't meet 100% of the requirements below, that's okay. Nobody's perfect!
We believe in hiring people, not just a list of skills. If this sounds like a place where you'd be excited to learn, contribute, and make an impact, we'd love to hear from you.
Requirements:
The role:
Kaltura is looking for a Go-to-Market Operations Manager to build and run the outbound engine behind our sales organization. You will sit within Revenue Operations and work hand in hand with our SDR teams and our salespeople to turn outbound from a set of activities into a structured, measurable, scalable motion.
This is a hands-on, high-impact role with real ownership. You will own the processes, tools and data that help SDRs and sellers reach the right prospects, with the right message, at the right time, and you will manage the prospect lifecycle from first touch to qualified opportunity.
If you enjoy building structure, know what good outbound looks like, and like working closely with people to make it happen, this role is for you.
The day-to-day
Work with SDR teams and salespeople to design, run and improve a proper outbound motion: target lists, sequences, cadences, messaging and handoffs
Own inbound lead qualification processes for the SDR teams, including routing, SLAs and follow-up
Manage the prospect lifecycle end to end: lead and contact statuses, stages, conversion definitions and handoffs between Marketing, SDR and Sales
Run enrichment processes and keep contact and account data clean
Own and optimize the sales engagement and sequencing stack
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards on outbound activity, conversion and pipeline contribution, and turn the findings into action
Test, measure and refine: run experiments on sequences, segments and channels, and share what works
Train and support SDRs and sellers on tools, processes and best practices
Partner with Marketing, Sales, RevOps and Sales Leadership to keep processes and systems aligned
﻿Ideally, we’re looking for:
At least 3 years of experience in marketing operations, GTM operations or RevOps roles
Hands-on experience with outbound work and a solid understanding of what makes an outbound motion succeed
Experience with enrichment processes and tools such as ZoomInfo
Experience with sequencing and sales engagement tools such as Outreach and AmpleMarket
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work well with SDRs, salespeople and other teams
A can-do approach: you take initiative, find a way to get things done and stay positive under pressure
Ability to bring order, structure and follow-through in a fast-moving environment
These would also be nice:
Experience with CRM systems such as Salesforce and marketing automation platforms
Experience supporting enterprise or global sales teams
Hands-on experience in AI, GenAI and GTM engineering, such as automating outbound and lead workflows
The perks:
Hybrid, flexible work environment
Extended private health (including mental) insurance
Personal and professional development programs
Occasional Cross company long weekends

job.title: Graduate Talent Scientist
job.snippet:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
Our Talent Science team has a mission to ensure that we follow objective, scientifically rigorous and efficient processes to select the very best new colleagues regardless of location, culture or background. We work closely with our key stakeholders to ensure that decisions are being made in the right way and that our hiring model supports the selection of world class talent. We lead an effective hiring ecosystem to deliver talent acquisition excellence. We leverage data to enable evidence-based decisions, weaving behavioural science through our selection process, working closely with our Hiring Leadership team who drive hiring at Canonical.
We are looking for exceptional people to join our team at the entry level. You will possess a psychology based degree with an exceptional academic track record from high school. You will also bring some relevant experience from the field of talent, from either university coursework relating to talent selection or from an internship or first job in a talent team. In this role you will learn how to implement hiring strategies that result in high performance outcomes of our people and contribute to leading our talent agenda.
The suitable candidate will bring an analytical mindset with a high level of curiosity to integrate data to draw insights and outcomes using SQL or Python. You will have the ability to prioritise and deliver work in a fast paced environment with a good level of self motivation and drive to operate in our remote based environment. With a keen interest in the assessment of talent you will demonstrate a passion for understanding human decisions and behaviours. Great communication skills are also key to this role as you will be working closely with senior stakeholders to ensure they stay on track with their hiring targets. Finally, we would like you to bring a passion and interest for technology platforms and automations to help us drive efficiencies in our processes.
Location:
These are remote based positions that are available in the EMEA region.
The role entails
Learning how to assess candidates using behavioural interview techniques.
Gaining a deep appreciation of the use of psychometrics in the workplace.
Working on process and documentation efficiencies that fuel our hiring practices.
Contributing to projects that drive successful hiring outcomes, many of which require advanced analytics skills to integrate data to draw insights.
Building excellent stakeholder relationships to help design and implement solutions to complex problems that ultimately ensure we hire exceptional talent.
Gaining a deep understanding of our systems and platforms to problem solve and support on hiring questions.
Being at the forefront of ticket support and company channel questions, helping to solve issues as you gain a deep understanding of our processes.
What we are looking for in you
Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, with an undergraduate degree in a psychology or people based subject.
Advanced analytical ability to dissect and analyse data using SQL, with Python and/or advanced statistical analysis advantageous.
Exposure to the topic of talent through university degree coursework, a relevant internship or first job.
A passion for working in the technology space with evidence as to why.
Results driven with the ability to work at pace, with strong project management skills to roadmap, plan and deliver objectives working with the team.
Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills.
Drive, ambitious and curiosity to own breakthroughs in the talent field.
Ability to travel internationally 2-4 times a year, for company events, occasionally for two weeks.
Nice-to-have skills
Advanced theory of psychometrics
A deep understanding of the topic of intrinsic motivation
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

job.title: Senior Electrical  Engineer
job.snippet:
אנו מגייסים מהנדס/ת חשמל בכיר/ה
לתפקיד הנדסי מוביל בתכנון תחנות כוח סולאריות ואתרי אגירת אנרגיה, משלב התכנון העקרוני ובחירת הציוד ועד לבדיקות הקבלה, ההרצה וההפעלה.
התפקיד משלב אחריות מקצועית רחבה, פתרון אתגרים הנדסיים מורכבים ועבודה עם צוותי ההנדסה, הרכש, הפיתוח העסקי וניהול הפרויקטים.
מה כולל התפקיד?
• תכנון מערכים עקרוניים ותרשימים חד־קוויים לתחנות כוח סולאריות ולאתרי אגירת אנרגיה.
• הכנת מפרטים טכניים לרכש ציוד חשמלי, לרבות שנאי הספק ולוחות מתח גבוה ונמוך, ובחינה טכנית של הצעות ספקים.
• ביצוע חישובים הנדסיים, ובהם זרמי קצר, תיאום הגנות, קביעת הספקי שנאים וחתכי כבלים.
• תכנון ותיאום מערכי הגנות חשמליות לתחנות ולחיבורן לרשת.
• הובלה והשתתפות בבדיקות קבלה לציוד (FAT/SAT), בהרצה ובהפעלת המתקנים.
• תמיכה מקצועית במערך התפעול ופתרון תקלות חשמל מורכבות.
• הובלת תהליכי סטנדרטיזציה וגיבוש הנחיות הנדסיות כחלק מהטמעת ספר התכנון של החברה.
מה נדרש לתפקיד?
• תואר אקדמי בהנדסת חשמל עם התמחות בזרם חזק ורישיון חשמלאי־מהנדס – חובה.
• לפחות 5 שנות ניסיון בתכנון מערכות זרם חזק במתח גבוה – חובה.
• ניסיון בתכנון תחנות סולאריות ואתרי אגירת אנרגיה – חובה.
• ידע בהגנות חשמליות – חובה.
• אנגלית ברמה גבוהה, לרבות כתיבת מסמכים מקצועיים ועבודה מול ספקים בינלאומיים.
• ניסיון בשימוש ובהטמעת כלי AI לייעול תהליכי העבודה.
יתרונות מקצועיים
• ניסיון בעבודה מול חברת החשמל ומנהל המערכת (נגה), לרבות עבודה במתח עליון – יתרון משמעותי.
• ניסיון בכתיבת מפרטים טכניים לציוד חשמלי, לרבות לוחות מתח גבוה ונמוך ושנאי הספק.
• שליטה בתוכנות תכנון וסימולציה כגון PVsyst, AutoCAD ו־ETAP.
את מי אנחנו מחפשים?
בעל/ת ראייה מערכתית ואסטרטגית, עצמאות מקצועית ויכולת להוביל תהליכים משלב הרעיון ועד ליישום; יכולת לקבל החלטות תחת לחץ, לפתור בעיות מורכבות בשטח ולעבוד בשיתוף פעולה בסביבה מרובת ממשקים ומשימות.
מעוניינים/ות לקחת חלק בעשייה ההנדסית של דוראל? נשמח לקבל את קורות החיים שלכם/ן.
המשרה פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד

job.title: Head of HR & ERP Systems
job.snippet:
Your role will include:
Overall responsibility for the organization’s ERP system and HR systems, including maintenance, stability, continuous improvement, and the development and implementation of new capabilities.
Management and leadership of teams of project managers, implementation and support staff, including setting goals, delegating authority, professional development, mentoring, and employee empowerment.
Formulating and leading annual and multi-year work plans for the domain, in line with business needs, organizational priorities, and the goals of the Information Systems Division.
Overall responsibility for the ERP and HR project portfolio, including project prioritization, resource allocation, monitoring and controlling progress, removing obstacles, and ensuring delivery on goals, within budget and on schedule, through the project managers and implementation teams.
Managerial and strategic leadership of cross-organizational projects and transformation processes in ERP and HR systems, in collaboration with the business units and relevant technology stakeholders.
Responsibility for system stability, operational continuity, service quality, and meeting availability, quality, and timeline targets.
Ongoing work with business units: identifying needs, understanding business processes, and translating them into technological solutions that support the organization’s goals.
Overall responsibility for integrations and interfaces between ERP and HR systems and other enterprise systems.
Management of vendors, budgets, and contracts in the domain, including oversight of performance, service quality, and compliance with commitments.
Promoting professional standards, improving work processes, management methodologies, knowledge management, and continuous improvement.
Identifying and managing systemic and operational risks, making professional and managerial decisions, and leading change processes.
Skills and abilities:
At least 5 years of experience managing an ERP domain in a medium or large organization.
Significant experience working with ERP systems and enterprise HR systems.
In-depth understanding of business processes in finance, procurement, logistics, and human resources.
Proven experience managing and leading professional teams in project management, implementation, development, or support.
Experience managing a project portfolio, providing managerial leadership for complex, cross-organizational projects, and monitoring their performance.
Experience in formulating and managing work plans, prioritizing tasks, and allocating resources.
Proven ability to lead change processes and to motivate employees and organizational stakeholders.
Experience working with vendors, senior business stakeholders, and multiple organizational interfaces.
Experience in budget management and performance control.
Understanding of integrations, interfaces, and systems architecture – an advantage.
Leadership and people management – a manager who develops employees, believes in empowerment, extends trust, delegates authority, and creates a positive and supportive work environment.
Results-oriented management – ability to set clear goals, prioritize tasks, exercise managerial oversight, and drive delivery on time and to a high standard of quality.
Systemic and strategic perspective – ability to understand the broader organizational picture and connect business needs with technological solutions.
Decision-making ability – sound judgment, task prioritization, and resource management in a dynamic environment with many interfaces.
Service orientation and business partnership – ability to build working relationships and collaboration with internal customers.
Excellent interpersonal communication – ability to motivate employees, create partnerships, and influence without direct authority.
Initiative and leading change – proactive thinking, personal accountability, and the ability to drive improvements and change processes.
Management and empowerment capability – balancing professional autonomy for employees with managerial responsibility, oversight, and ensuring goals are met.

job.snippet:
אנחנו מגייסים בוחני חיובים עם תנאים שווים במיוחד
פורסם: 20.9.23
עודכן: 4.1.26
תיאור
תאור התפקיד:
קביעה וחיוב ארנונה לנכסים, כולל עדכון נתוני שומה במערכת.
מתן מענה איכותי ומקצועי בערוצי התקשורת השונים.
ביצוע סיורים וביקורות בנכסים על פי הצורך.
ייצוג העירייה בפני ועדת ערר ובתי משפט.
קיום קשרי עבודה עם גורמים שונים (פנים-ארגוניים וחוץ-ארגוניים).
דרישות המשרה:
השכלה אקדמית, כולל ידע וניסיון בקריאת שרטוטי מבנה.
עבודה במערכות ממוחשבות והפעלת יישומי OFFICE.
תודעת שירות גבוהה ויחסי אנוש טובים.
כושר ביטוי טוב בכתב ובעל-פה.
תנאים:
זכאות להחזר מלא עבור ביטוח רכב שנתי.
זכאות להחזר חודשי עבור הוצאות רכב.
היתכנות לעבודה מהבית, יום בשבוע.
טווח שכר – 7,500-8,000 ₪ ברוטו.
הערות:
המועמדים יישלחו למבחן אמינות
על פי חוק ההנדסאים והטכנאים המוסמכים, התשע"ג2012-" ,הנדסאי" או "טכנאי מוסמך" כהגדרתם בחוק זה פטורים מדרישת השכלה זו.
עיריית תל אביב-יפו מקדמת את עיקרון השוויון והתעסוקה, ובכלל זה שואפת לייצוג הולם ומקנה העדפה לזכאים לכך על פי דין. אם אתה נמנה על אחת הקבוצות הבאות: אתה או שאחד מהוריך נולדו באתיופיה, בן האוכלוסייה הערבית, הדרוזית, או הצ'רקסית, בן האוכלוסייה החרדית, עולה חדש (מי שעלה לישראל בהיותו בגיר וטרם חלפו 12 שנים מיום עלייתו) או שאתה אדם עם מוגבלות כמפורט בסעיף 25.35 בתקשי"ר.
מובהר כי מדובר במשרה שיועמ"ש העירייה קבע לגביה כי נדרשת בדיקת עברו הפלילי של מועמד כתנאי להתמנות לה, וכי אישור היועמ"ש בדבר היעדר הרשעות המונעות לשמש במשרה מהווה תנאי לאיוש המשרה ולמינוי לתפקיד .
הסדרי תנועה וחניה
פרטים נוספים
להגשת מועמדות
להורדה
