job.title: Senior Manager , Analog IP Design , Analog IP Design
job.snippet:
Description
Annapurna Labs, an Amazon company, is seeking an exceptional an exceptional leader to build and lead our next-generation internal Analog IP design team. This is a unique opportunity to create a world-class analog design center from the ground up, developing the critical IP blocks that power all of our custom silicon products, including Graviton (server CPUs), Nitro (networking/security accelerators) and Trainium (machine learning accelerators).
At Annapurna Labs, we think big in both scale and scope. We are building internal capabilities for cutting-edge analog IP that will define the next era of cloud infrastructure silicon. This role is an opportunity to shape the analog IP strategy across all our products and lead the team that delivers it.
Key job responsibilities
Build the team: Recruit, hire, and develop a world-class analog/mixed-signal design team from the ground up. Define the org structure, roles, and growth path.
Define the IP strategy: Own the analog IP roadmap across all Annapurna Labs products. Evaluate build vs. buy decisions and drive internal capability development.
Drive execution: Lead the full design cycle from architecture through silicon validation — spec, schematic, layout, simulation, tapeout, and bring-up.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with SoC architecture, digital design, physical design, DFT, packaging, and system teams to integrate analog IP seamlessly.
Set technical direction: Define design methodologies, flows, and best practices. Evaluate and select EDA tools, PDKs, and foundry processes.
Innovate at scale: Develop IP that is reusable, portable across process nodes, and designed to meet the performance, power, and area (PPA) needs of multiple products simultaneously.
About The Team
Why Annapurna Labs
Annapurna Labs Designs The Silicon That Powers AWS — The World’s Largest Cloud Platform. Our Chips (Graviton, Nitro, Trainium, Inferentia) Serve Millions Of Customers Globally. You Will
Work at the intersection of analog design and hyperscale cloud infrastructure
Build a team and IP portfolio that directly impacts AWS’s competitive edge
Have access to leading-edge process nodes and world-class foundry partnerships
Collaborate with top-tier silicon architects, system designers, and software engineers
See your designs deployed at unprecedented scale — millions of instances worldwide
Basic Qualifications
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.
10+ years of hands-on analog/mixed-signal design experience in advanced CMOS nodes (7nm and below)
5+ years of proven engineering management experience, including building and scaling teams
Deep expertise in one or more: high-speed SerDes/PHY, PLL/DLL, data converters, LDOs/power management, or I/O interfaces
Track record of successful tapeouts and silicon bring-up in volume production
Experience with design methodologies for IP portability and reuse across multiple process nodes
Strong understanding of semiconductor physics, device modeling, and process technology
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with die-to-die interfaces (UCIe, HBI) or advanced packaging (2.5D/3D)
Experience with integrated voltage regulators (IVR) for high-performance compute
Experience leading analog IP development in a hyperscaler or large semiconductor company
Familiarity with GPIO design for multi-standard (LPDDR, PCIe, ETH) compatibility
Background in developing reusable IP platforms with configurable/parameterized architectures
Experience in cloud/data center silicon or high-performance computing
Strong publication record or patents in analog IC design
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: Integrator – LYNX Department
job.snippet:
01 ORIGIN_POINT
About ASIO
ASIO develops combat-proven systems that empower tactical forces at the edge. Combining advanced technology with operational simplicity, our solutions support mission planning, situational awareness, resilient navigation, and more, enabling battalions to operate independently and achieve mission success.
02 BEARING
The Opportunity
We are looking for an Integrator to join the LYNX department's integration team, supporting the development of integrated electro-optical products. This is a hands-on role that combines work in the integration lab, field trials simulating a platoon-based military environment, and customer demonstrations in Israel and abroad.
03 WAYPOINTS
Key Responsibilities
01          Integration and development support: Join the integration team and support the development of integrated electro-optical products, conduct system tests required to support field deployment.
02          Integration, installation and testing: Perform integrations, installation, and configuration of the integrated systems, and carry out Acceptance Test Procedures, fault investigations, and calibrations.
03          V&V support: Support the product's V&V efforts, and improve transfer to production process and ATP testing throughout FULL PRODUCTION.
04          Cross-functional collaboration: Work with development, systems, and engineering teams, as well as with marketing and customers.
05          Demonstrations and training: take part in customer demonstrations in Israel and abroad, be involved in product training across various end users.
06          office and field work: Work on an ongoing basis in the integration lab, alongside work in test fields that simulate a platoon-based military environment.
Requirements:
04 CALIBRATION
What You Bring
+            At least Two years of Techno / operational experience in the military.
+           Intimate familiarity with IDF OLAR device
+             Technical background (technician / operator) with electro-optics devices, electronics, or electromechanics.
+             Ability to identify and analyze problems in complex systems – hardware, software, and optics.
05 SIGNAL_BOOST
Strong Advantages
+            Combat experience as an operational technician of electro-optical systems – a significant advantage.
+            Experience working with complex systems and perform dedicated tests for hardware software and optics, and producing analysis reports.
+            Good familiarity with computer and Android applications.
06 TRUE_NORTH
Why Join ASIO?
Make a real operational impact: Help bring advanced technologies to defense forces operating in the most demanding environments.
Turn innovation into mission capability: Experience cutting-edge technology with real-world operational needs.
Build strategic relationships: Work directly with senior Multidisciplinary experience engineers across significant ecosystem.
Own the journey from opportunity to impact: Join a collaborative, fast-moving team where initiative, accountability, and execution matter.

job.title: GNC Engineer - Guidance, Navigation & Control
job.snippet:
01 ORIGIN_POINT About ASIO
ASIO develops combat-proven systems that empower tactical forces at the edge. Combining advanced technology with operational simplicity, our solutions support mission planning, situational awareness, resilient navigation, and more, enabling battalions to operate independently and achieve mission success.
02 BEARING The Opportunity
We are looking for a hands-on Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) Engineer to own the GNC of a new autonomous airborne system.
This is an opportunity to take a system from proof of concept to an operational product. You will design the guidance, control and navigation algorithms at the heart of the system, develop the calibration and alignment of its navigation system, and keep its performance sharp as the system and its operating conditions evolve. Working closely with systems, software, mechanics and integration teams, you will see your algorithms move from simulation to the lab and into live field trials.
03 WAYPOINTS Key Responsibilities
01 Design guidance and control: Develop guidance laws and flight control algorithms for a new autonomous airborne system, across all flight phases.
02 Build the navigation solution: Develop navigation and state estimation algorithms, including multi-sensor fusion, that deliver an accurate and robust solution under demanding flight conditions.
03 Adapt GNC to every configuration: Update and retune the algorithms as the system evolves, including changes in mass properties, center of gravity, inertia, aerodynamics and operating conditions.
04 Calibrate and align: Develop calibration and alignment algorithms for the navigation system, and define the related procedures for testing and production.
05 Own the GNC baseline: Take over the existing GNC code, master it, and mature it with the software team into robust real-time embedded code.
06 Simulate, test and prove: Build and maintain 6-DOF simulation and Monte Carlo analysis, support SIL/HIL, integration and field tests, analyze flight data and drive accuracy and robustness to the required levels.
07 Drive future improvements: Lead the GNC roadmap for next phases, extending the system's capabilities, operating envelope and performance.
Requirements:
04 CALIBRATION What You Bring
› B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Aerospace, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, with a specialization in control, guidance or navigation.
› At least 7 years of hands-on GNC experience in autonomous airborne systems.
› Strong background in control theory, flight dynamics and guidance laws.
› Proven experience in navigation, sensor fusion and Kalman filter design.
› Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink and in developing 6-DOF simulations and using AI tools.
› Programming skills in C/C++ and Python, and experience taking algorithms from simulation to embedded real-time code.
› A hands-on approach to lab, HIL and field testing, and to flight data analysis.
› Ability to work independently in a small, multidisciplinary team, with strong communication skills.
05 SIGNAL_BOOST Strong Advantages
Vision-aided navigation or guidance.
Aerodynamic modeling using CFD or wind tunnel data.
Taking a defense or aerospace product from prototype to production.
Safety-critical development and aerospace quality standards.
06 TRUE_NORTH Why Join ASIO?
› Own the GNC from day one: Be the GNC lead of a new product and shape the algorithms at its core.
› See your algorithms fly: Move fast from simulation to the lab to live field trials, and see the results of your work in real flights.
› Take a system from POC to product: Play a key role in turning a proven concept into a reliable, producible system.
› Make a real operational impact: Help bring advanced capabilities to forces operating in the most demanding environments.
› Join a hands-on team: Work in a collaborative, fast-moving team where initiative, accountability and execution matter.

job.title: Senior QA Engineer – Outdoor Test Lead-
job.snippet:
Parallel Wireless is reimagining mobile networks with innovative, energy-efficient Open RAN solutions. Join us as we lead the future of telecommunications, driving innovation through green and sustainable networks . Learn more about our mission, vision and values .
People come to work at Parallel Wireless because we are building the future of telecom. They stay because they are challenged and driven by an incredible product and team. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, and our culture fosters an atmosphere of empowerment, trust, respect, and communication.
Lead the outdoor (field) test activities for Parallel Wireless's wireless telecom and cloud-based 4G/5G ORAN solutions.
The work location is in Israel and combines hands-on testing at outdoor sites in the field with lab work and close collaboration with R&D, product and test engineers across Parallel Wireless sites.
As the senior engineer on the team, you'll own the outdoor test domain end-to-end — from defining the field test strategy and building the outdoor setups, through running drive and walk tests on live deployments, to analyzing RF/KPI results and driving issues to root cause with R&D. You will also mentor the team's junior test engineers and represent the outdoor test activity in front of customers during field trials and acceptance.
The position is based at our offices in Tzemach.
Job Responsibilities:
Lead and own the outdoor/field test activities of the team: plan, schedule and execute drive tests, walk tests and field trials of Parallel Wireless 4G/5G ORAN products (radio units, DU/CU and core) in real-world outdoor deployments.
Define the outdoor test strategy, test plans, test cases and acceptance criteria covering coverage, capacity, throughput, latency, mobility (handover/cell reselection), interference and KPI benchmarking against 3GPP and customer requirements.
Design and build outdoor end-to-end test setups: site survey and selection, antenna and RF path, backhaul, power, GPS/timing, UE fleet and measurement tools.
Execute field measurement campaigns with drive-test tools and scanners, and analyze RF and performance KPIs (RSRP, RSRQ, SINR, throughput, BLER, latency, call/session drops, handover success rate).
Analyze and debug UE, RAN and core logs collected in the field and resolve issues in outdoor setups (For Ex: UE/mobile issues, RF/antenna/fiber connectivity, backhaul, power and timing, etc.); isolate RF, baseband, configuration and software issues and drive them to root cause together with R&D.
Analyze, reproduce and validate customer field-found defects and take part in customer trials and field acceptance tests.
Produce clear field test reports and KPI summaries and present findings to R&D, product management and customers.
Mentor and guide junior test engineers; review their test plans, setups and results.
Suggest improvements and changes to the product in order to improve customer experience.
Automation:
Define requirements for automating field data collection, KPI post-processing and reporting
Work with the Automation Infra engineers to integrate outdoor test results into the test framework
Review and consolidate future automation requirements and enhancements for outdoor testing
Job Requirements:
5+ years of hands-on experience in cellular (LTE / 5G NR) outdoor and field testing – drive testing, field trials or RF network optimization.
Proven experience leading field test campaigns and coordinating cross-functional teams (R&D, field technicians, customers).
Strong RF fundamentals: link budget, propagation, antennas, interference, coverage and capacity planning.
Hands-on experience with drive-test tools and scanners (Ex: TEMS, Nemo, XCAL, Rohde & Schwarz ROMES/TSMx, PCTEL) and post-processing tools.
Experience analyzing UE and eNB/gNB logs (Ex: QXDM/QCAT, Wireshark, vendor trace tools) and understanding of architecture and call flows.
Understanding of 3GPP standards covering PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS, S1AP/NGAP and X2AP/XnAP protocols, including mobility procedures.
Experience with RF test equipment (spectrum/network analyzers, power meters, attenuators) and lab tools (Ex: Azimuth, TM500, Amarisoft).
Python and Shell scripting for log parsing and KPI analysis.
Knowledge of handling and troubleshooting User Equipment (Mobiles), SIM installation, etc.
Ability to work outdoors at remote sites, a valid driver's license and willingness to travel locally and abroad as needed.
Experience in using test management and bug-tracking tools (Ex: JIRA).
Nice to have:
Familiarity with ORAN architecture (O-RU, O-DU, O-CU) and multi-vendor interoperability testing.
Experience with network planning and GIS tools (Ex: Atoll, Planet, Google Earth, QGIS).
Experience working with mobile operators on field acceptance and Tier 1 trials.
Experience with LAN/WAN, Routing protocols – L2 and L3, TCP/IP, QoS.
Knowledge of Linux/UNIX-based platforms, Docker and Kubernetes.
Knowledge of automation frameworks, preferably Pytest
Education:
Bachelor degree in Electrical, Electronic Communications/Computer Science Engineering
Parallel Wireless is expanding the ecosystem for Open RAN with the GreenRAN™ energy-efficient Hardware-Agnostic technology. Deployed worldwide, our comprehensive 2G/3G/4G/5G Macro RAN solutions enhance network security while reducing operating expenses. As pioneers of Open RAN, we prioritize innovation, flexibility, and sustainability to help build a more connected, and green networks. Headquartered in the USA with global R&D centers, we are proud to serve over 60 customers worldwide and have been recognized with over 100 industry awards. Our mission is to accelerate GSMA’s
Mobile Net Zero initiative
by reducing TCO and driving innovation across the telecom ecosystem.Learn more at www.parallelwireless.com .

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams representing all backgrounds, with a wide range of perspectives, and empowering industry-leading skills. Lead the outdoor (field) test activities for Parallel Wireless's wireless telecom and cloud-based 4G/5G ORAN solutions.
The work location is in Israel and combines hands-on testing at outdoor sites in the field with lab work and close collaboration with R&D, product and test engineers across Parallel Wireless sites.
As the senior engineer on the team, you'll own the outdoor test domain end-to-end — from defining the field test strategy and building the outdoor setups, through running drive and walk tests on live deployments, to analyzing RF/KPI results and driving issues to root cause with R&D. You will also mentor the team's junior test engineers and represent the outdoor test activity in front of customers during field trials and acceptance.
The position is based at our offices in Tzemach.
Job Responsibilities:
Lead and own the outdoor/field test activities of the team: plan, schedule and execute drive tests, walk tests and field trials of Parallel Wireless 4G/5G ORAN products (radio units, DU/CU and core) in real-world outdoor deployments.
Define the outdoor test strategy, test plans, test cases and acceptance criteria covering coverage, capacity, throughput, latency, mobility (handover/cell reselection), interference and KPI benchmarking against 3GPP and customer requirements.
Design and build outdoor end-to-end test setups: site survey and selection, antenna and RF path, backhaul, power, GPS/timing, UE fleet and measurement tools.
Execute field measurement campaigns with drive-test tools and scanners, and analyze RF and performance KPIs (RSRP, RSRQ, SINR, throughput, BLER, latency, call/session drops, handover success rate).
Analyze and debug UE, RAN and core logs collected in the field and resolve issues in outdoor setups (For Ex: UE/mobile issues, RF/antenna/fiber connectivity, backhaul, power and timing, etc.); isolate RF, baseband, configuration and software issues and drive them to root cause together with R&D.
Analyze, reproduce and validate customer field-found defects and take part in customer trials and field acceptance tests.
Produce clear field test reports and KPI summaries and present findings to R&D, product management and customers.
Mentor and guide junior test engineers; review their test plans, setups and results.
Suggest improvements and changes to the product in order to improve customer experience.
Automation:
Define requirements for automating field data collection, KPI post-processing and reporting
Work with the Automation Infra engineers to integrate outdoor test results into the test framework
Review and consolidate future automation requirements and enhancements for outdoor testing
Job Requirements:
5+ years of hands-on experience in cellular (LTE / 5G NR) outdoor and field testing – drive testing, field trials or RF network optimization.
Proven experience leading field test campaigns and coordinating cross-functional teams (R&D, field technicians, customers).
Strong RF fundamentals: link budget, propagation, antennas, interference, coverage and capacity planning.
Hands-on experience with drive-test tools and scanners (Ex: TEMS, Nemo, XCAL, Rohde & Schwarz ROMES/TSMx, PCTEL) and post-processing tools.
Experience analyzing UE and eNB/gNB logs (Ex: QXDM/QCAT, Wireshark, vendor trace tools) and understanding of architecture and call flows.
Understanding of 3GPP standards covering PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS, S1AP/NGAP and X2AP/XnAP protocols, including mobility procedures.
Experience with RF test equipment (spectrum/network analyzers, power meters, attenuators) and lab tools (Ex: Azimuth, TM500, Amarisoft).
Python and Shell scripting for log parsing and KPI analysis.
Knowledge of handling and troubleshooting User Equipment (Mobiles), SIM installation, etc.
Ability to work outdoors at remote sites, a valid driver's license and willingness to travel locally and abroad as needed.
Experience in using test management and bug-tracking tools (Ex: JIRA).
Nice to have:
Familiarity with ORAN architecture (O-RU, O-DU, O-CU) and multi-vendor interoperability testing.
Experience with network planning and GIS tools (Ex: Atoll, Planet, Google Earth, QGIS).
Experience working with mobile operators on field acceptance and Tier 1 trials.
Experience with LAN/WAN, Routing protocols – L2 and L3, TCP/IP, QoS.
Knowledge of Linux/UNIX-based platforms, Docker and Kubernetes.
Knowledge of automation frameworks, preferably Pytest
Education:
Bachelor degree in Electrical, Electronic Communications/Computer Science Engineering

job.title: Social Acquisition Manager
job.snippet:
🌟 About The Role
The Social Acquisition Manager is a core driver of our growth engine, responsible for planning, executing, and scaling high-performance paid social campaigns globally. This role sits at the intersection of data, creative, and strategy, owning the full lifecycle of campaigns from ideation to optimization.
You’ll be expected to think like an owner: treating budgets as your own, constantly testing new angles, and identifying scalable opportunities. This is a hands-on role for someone who lives and breathes performance marketing, thrives on data, and leverages AI tools to move faster and smarter.
🌕 About Moonshot
Moonshot is a global leader in the ad-tech and performance marketing industry. Powered by our proprietary AI technology, we connect online consumers across multiple sectors with the vendors whose products best fit their needs. Our expertise spans Ad-Tech, iGaming, and Fintech, allowing us to operate at the forefront of some of the most exciting and competitive industries in the world.
Requirements:
✅
What We’re Looking For?
2–5 years of hands-on experience managing paid social campaigns (Meta is a must; TikTok is a strong advantage).
Proven track record of scaling campaigns with measurable results in global markets.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.
Creative thinker with a deep understanding of what makes high-performing ads.
High level of ownership and accountability, treats budgets as if they were personal funds.
AI-first mindset with hands-on experience using AI tools to enhance performance and productivity.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
Experience in highly competitive verticals (e.g., iGaming, casino, sports betting, fintech) is a strong advantage.
🧩 Who Are You?
You're a performance-driven marketer who combines analytical thinking with creative intuition. You’re curious, resourceful, and constantly testing new ideas. You don’t just run campaigns, you look for ways to scale them. You move fast, communicate clearly, and take full ownership of your work. You embrace AI, think outside the box, and are always pushing for better results.
Responsibilities:
What You’ll Be Doing?
Own and manage paid social campaigns across platforms (Meta, TikTok, Youtube, and others), from setup to scaling.
Analyze performance data deeply to identify trends, insights, and growth opportunities, and act on them quickly.
Develop and test creative strategies, angles, and messaging tailored to different audiences and markets.
Work closely with creative teams to ideate, brief, and iterate on high-performing ad creatives.
Continuously optimize campaigns (bidding, targeting, funnels, creatives) to maximize ROI and efficiency.
Manage and allocate budgets responsibly, with a strong focus on profitability and scalability.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve workflows, analysis, and creative output.
Stay on top of industry trends, platform changes, and emerging opportunities in paid social.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Data, and Marketing teams to align on growth initiatives.

מנהל/ת מחלקת חירום, ביטחון וביטחון מים, סייבר ובקר/ית בטיחות
לתאגיד המים והביוב האזורי – יובלים בשומרון (2003) בע"מ דרוש/ה מנהל/ת מחלקת חירום וביטחון מים, סייבר ובקר/ית בטיחות. המודעה מופנית לנשים ולגברים כאחד.
1.   תיאור התפקיד:
ניהול, תכנון והובלת מערך החירום והביטחון של התאגיד בשגרה ובחירום, בהתאם להנחיות רשות המים ולדרישות הדין החלות על התאגיד.
גיבוש, עדכון ויישום של תכניות היערכות לחירום, תרחישי ייחוס, נהלים, פקודות פעולה ותכניות לרציפות תפקודית ולאספקת מים וביוב בעת משבר.
ניהול המוכנות לאירועי פגיעה במים, זיהום או חשד לזיהום מים, הפסקות מים ממושכות, תקלות במערכות מים וביוב, פגעי טבע ואירועים ביטחוניים.
ניהול מלאי וציוד החירום ובקרת כשירותם, לרבות אמצעי אספקת מים חלופית, אמצעי קשר, גיבוי וציוד ייעודי, בתיאום עם אגף ההנדסה והתפעול.
אחריות לתכנון ולביצוע תרגילים, הדרכות, הכשרות וביקורות מוכנות, לרבות הפקת לקחים ומעקב אחר תיקון פערים.
לשמש כממונה/ת הביטחון וביטחון המים של התאגיד, בכפוף לדרישות הכשירות, למינויים ולאישורים הנדרשים לפי דין והנחיות הגורמים המוסמכים.
אחריות על סקרי איומים וסיכונים, מיגון מתקנים, בקרת גישה, אבטחה פיזית ושמירה על מתקני מים וביוב ותשתיות חיוניות.

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
דרוש/ה בקר/ית מחסן ותפעול – HFD חולון
לחברת HFD, המובילה בתחום הלוגיסטיקה והמשלוחים, דרוש/ה בקר/ית מחסן אנרגטי/ת ומסודר/ת להשתלבות בצוות התפעול של המרכז הלוגיסטי בחולון.
התפקיד מהווה צומת מרכזי בשרשרת ההפצה ומשלב עבודה דינמית בשטח לצד בקרה ממוחשבת.
מה כולל התפקיד?
ניהול הפצה: קבלת נהגים, ביצוע זיכויים ומעקב אחר החזרות.
בקרת מלאי ומשלוחים: פיקוח שוטף על תנועת החבילות במחסן והבטחת הגעתן ליעד.
תפעול מערך האונליין: מיון, סידור והכנת חבילות להפצה מהירה.
ניתוח דוחות: עבודה מול מערכות מידע, מעקב אחר נתונים תפעוליים והפקת דוחות בקרה.
תנאי המשרה:
מיקום: חולון.
ימים ושעות: א'-ה', 06:00-16:00/ 05:30-15:30 (אידיאלי למי שאוהב/ת להתחיל מוקדם ולסיים מוקדם!).
ימי שישי: לסירוגין, 07:00-11:00.
דרישות התפקיד
יכולת עבודה תחת לחץ: התנהלות יעילה בסביבה דינמית ומהירה.
סדר וארגון ברמה גבוהה: יכולת דיוק וירידה לפרטים הקטנים.
זיקה טכנולוגית: שליטה ביישומי מחשב (נכונות לעבודה אינטנסיבית על מערכות החברה).
ניסיון קודם: ניסיון מעולם השילוח, ההפצה או המחסן – יתרון משמעותי.

job.title: דרוש/ה הנדסאי/ת חשמל בתחנת הכח אורות יוסף
job.snippet:
ת
דרוש/ה הנדסאי/ת חשמל בתחנת הכח אורות יוסף
תחנת כח אורות יוסף
רמת חובב
3-4 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 6 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
בימים אלה אנו מחפשים הנדסאי/ת חשמל  לתחנת הכוח אורות יוסף - (רמת חובב),
במשרה מלאה ובזמינות מידית, בכפיפות לראש מדור חשמל.
•	הכרת המערכות החשמליות והמסדרים בתחנת כח.
•	ניסיון באחזקת מע' חשמליות.
•	תפעול ותחזוקה של מערכות חשמל מתח נמוך/גבוה
•	איתור, אבחון וטיפול בתקלות חשמל
•	ביצוע עבודות אחזקה מונעת ושבר
•	קריאת תוכניות חשמל ושרטוטים
•	עבודה בהתאם לנהלי בטיחות ורגולציה מחמירה
•	שיתוף פעולה עם צוותי תפעול, מכונאים ומהנדסים
•	ידע בקריאת שרטוטים טכניים
דרישות התפקיד
דרישות התפקיד
•	הנדסאי/ת חשמל – חובה
•	רישיון חשמלאי מוסמך / ראשי – יתרון
•	ניסיון בעבודה במתקני תעשייה / תחנות כוח – יתרון משמעותי
•	עבודה כוננויות (במידת הצורך)
•	יכולת עבודה בצוות, אחריות וראש גדול
דרישות נוספות
?	חיבור לתחום האנרגיה
?	חריצות, ונכונות לעבודה מאומצת
?	זמינות לעבודה בשעות לא שגרתיות (התחנה פועלת 24/7, כולל שבתות וחגים)
?	פרואקטיביות, יוזמה ויכולת הנעת תהליכים עצמאית
?	חוש טכני מפותח
?	יכולת ניהול והובלת צוות בסביבה מאתגרת
?	עבודה בממשקים רבים מול מנהלי התחנה השונים
?	דיוק ויכולת ירידה לפרטים הקטנים
?	יכולת עבודה כחלק מצוות
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

חשמל ואלקטרוניקה

job.title: עובד/ת אחזקה
job.snippet:
עובד/ת אחזקה
קבוצת דנאל
רמת גן
ללא נסיון
משרה מלאה
לפני 29 דקות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
מחפש/ת תפקיד עם עשייה בשטח, אחריות ועבודה בסביבה מקצועית ויציבה?
קבוצת דנאל מגייסת עובד/ת אחזקה למשרדי ההנהלה במתחם הבורסה ברמת גן.
אם יש לך חוש טכני, גישה שירותית ויכולת לעבוד באופן עצמאי, נשמח לצרף אותך לצוות שלנו.
מה כולל התפקיד?
ביצוע עבודות אחזקה שוטפות במשרדי ההנהלה ובסניפי הקבוצה ברחבי הארץ
טיפול בתקלות תחזוקה ותפעול שוטף של המבנים
הובלה והעברת ציוד, ריהוט ועמדות עבודה בהתאם לצורכי הארגון
עבודה מול ספקים וגורמים שונים בארגון
יציאה לסניפים ברחבי הארץ לצורך ביצוע משימות אחזקה ותפעול
למה כדאי להצטרף אלינו?
קבוצת דנאל היא אחת הקבוצות המובילות בישראל בתחומי משאבי האנוש, הבריאות והסיעוד.
אצלנו תיהנה/י מיציבות תעסוקתית, סביבת עבודה משפחתית ותומכת ותנאים מצוינים.
מה אנחנו מציעים?
קרן השתלמות
ארוחות מסובסדות
נופש חברה שנתי
מגוון הטבות ופעילויות רווחה
סביבת עבודה יציבה ונעימה
אפשרויות להתפתחות לאורך זמן בארגון מוביל
דרישות התפקיד

נכונות לנסיעות ברחבי הארץ במסגרת התפקיד - חובה

אחריות, שירותיות ויכולת עבודה עצמאית
יחסי אנוש מצוינים וראש גדול

job.title: Senior Global Talent Acquisition Partner - Italy
job.snippet: Description: At Enlight, we are shaping a future powered by clean, affordable energy. Founded in 2008, Enlight is an Israeli-founded, publicly traded global renewable energy company and independent power producer, with operations across Europe, the United States, and MENA. We develop, finance, construct, own, and operate utility-scale solar, wind, and energy storage projects – combining entrepreneurial thinking, deep expertise, and exceptional execution to accelerate the energy transition. As we've grown, we've stayed true to the entrepreneurial mindset that got us here. We move fast, embrace challenges, and empower people to take ownership. We thrive in a dynamic environment where execution moves quickly, collaboration is essential, and smart decisions keep us moving toward our long-term goals. We're looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to join our global HR team, based in Milan or Madrid , and play a key role in supporting Enlight's continued growth across Europe. This role is ideal for an experienced recruiter who already knows the renewable energy industry, understands its talent landscape, and knows how to identify and attract the people who drive the development, construction, and operation of large-scale energy projects. You'll own end-to-end recruitment across European markets, partnering closely with business leaders and hiring managers across different countries and functions. Beyond managing recruitment processes, you'll bring industry knowledge, market insights, and proactive sourcing capabilities to help us identify exceptional talent and build the teams behind our European growth. You'll be joining an HR team headquartered in Israel, with its core members currently working remotely from Israel. As we expand our presence in Europe, you'll be an important part of building our local TA capabilities while working closely with the Israeli team and stakeholders across the business. We're looking for a recruiter at heart – someone who combines strong execution with business partnership, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-moving, international environment. | Responsibilities: Own end-to-end recruitment processes supporting business growth across Europe, partnering with hiring managers in multiple European countries to define hiring needs and deliver high-quality recruitment outcomes. Lead recruitment across diverse functions, with a particular focus on renewable energy-related roles, including Engineering, Project Development, Construction, Asset Management, Operations, Finance, Commercial, and Corporate functions. Build proactive talent pipelines through advanced sourcing, market mapping, networking, competitor intelligence, and creative outreach strategies. Leverage your knowledge of the renewable energy industry to identify relevant talent pools, understand market dynamics, and advise hiring managers on talent availability and recruitment strategies. Act as a trusted talent advisor and business partner, building strong relationships with stakeholders, challenging assumptions when needed, and driving effective hiring decisions. Manage multiple priorities across different countries and business units, making thoughtful trade-offs and adjusting recruitment strategies as business needs evolve. Work closely with the HR team based in Israel, maintaining strong communication and collaboration across a geographically distributed team. Use recruiting technology, LinkedIn Recruiter, and AI tools to improve sourcing effectiveness, efficiency, and candidate engagement. Continuously improve recruitment processes and strengthen the candidate and hiring manager experience. | Requirements: 5+ years of full-cycle recruitment experience , ideally in an international, fast-growing organization or a specialized recruitment agency. At least 3 years of hands-on recruitment experience in the renewable energy sector , either in-house at a renewable energy company or within a recruitment agency specializing in renewable energy, energy, or infrastructure. Good understanding of the renewable energy talent landscape, with exposure to roles across areas such as Project Development, Engineering, Construction, Asset Management, or Operations. Proven experience recruiting across multiple European countries and partnering with hiring managers in international environments. Strong sourcing capabilities and a proactive, pipeline-first mindset, including experience with market mapping and talent intelligence. A strong business partner who builds trust, influences stakeholders, provides market insights, and drives hiring processes forward. Fluent English is essential , both written and spoken, with the ability to work confidently with senior stakeholders in an international business environment. Fluency in at least one of the following languages is required: Italian or Spanish. Fluency in both is a strong advantage. Comfortable working as part of a geographically distributed team, collaborating remotely with colleagues and stakeholders primarily based in Israel. Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving environment, managing multiple priorities while maintaining momentum and quality. Curious about recruiting technology and comfortable leveraging AI tools when they help you work smarter. Location: Milan, Italy or Madrid, Spain.

job.snippet:
We are looking for a Junior SecOps to join our Information Systems team in a global organization.
The role includes monitoring, handling, and investigating information security incidents, operating security solutions, and continuously improving security controls across the organization.
You will work closely with users, IT teams, vendors, and external SOC providers, while helping reduce the organization’s attack surface and strengthen its overall security posture. An empty job that is used for creating requisitions 'from scratch'.
Key Responsibilities:
Receive security alerts and provide initial response to cyber incidents
Investigate information security incidents, analyze findings, and document the response
Work closely with external SOC providers and internal teams
Handle security alerts from Microsoft Defender
Investigate malware, unauthorized installations, unusual file sharing, and suspicious endpoint activity
Support attack surface reduction activities, system hardening, and security policy updates
Identify vulnerabilities and follow up on remediation activities
Analyze suspicious emails, phishing attempts, and malicious website alerts
Support phishing simulations and security awareness activities
Assist with vendor security assessments, security questionnaires, and IT procurement processes
Requirements:
1-2 years of hands-on experience in Information Security, SOC or SecOps
Experience investigating and handling security alerts and incidents
Understanding of Incident Response principles
Good understanding of networking, Windows environments, Active Directory, and cloud services
Ability to analyze logs and identify unusual or suspicious activity
Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks in a dynamic environment
Strong documentation skills and a service-oriented approach when working with users and technical teams
High level of English
Familiarity with EDR/XDR security solutions, especially Microsoft Defender

job.snippet:

Responsibility for month-end close processes and financial reporting within a global group.
Ownership of key accounting domains, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, and royalties.

job.title: Dir/Sr Dir R&D Biochemist/Bioengineer
job.snippet:
Company Description:
Genopore is focused on developing the future of protein identification and quantification with AI for analysis, building innovative technologies that advance how proteins are detected, characterized, and understood. The company combines biochemistry, bioengineering, and advanced analytics to create platforms that can transform biological research and clinical applications. Team members collaborate across disciplines to solve complex scientific and engineering challenges with direct impact on life sciences and healthcare. Genopore offers an environment where scientific curiosity, rigorous experimentation, and practical innovation come together to drive meaningful progress in protein analysis.
Role Description:
We are looking for a Dr/Sr Dir R&D with a background in biochemistry / biophysics / bioengineering to bridge interdisciplinary gaps and play a key role in the integration of our single molecule protein identification nano-sensor device as well as lead the pre-processing of protein samples to be characterized by the nanopore sensor.
The position requires:
Leading and defining the protein sample preparation to adapt the sample to Genopore’s fluorescent labeling protocol, using knowledge in analytical biochemistry, proteins and nucleic acids conjugation, sample purification and sample characterization.
Leading and defining the customer protein identification and sample conditions requirements.
Leading and defining the performance, measurement and analysis capabilities of single molecule (DNA, protein) fluorescence measurements.
Understanding of the nanopore sensor semi-conductor chip characterization, integration with a microfluidic housing, and measurement data analysis.
Essential Skills
PhD in Biochemistry, Molecular biology or bioengineering with relevant experience in commercial consumable and/or device product development from inception to commercial product.
At least 5 years of experience working on a wet bench to create and implement biochemical protocols and use analytical methods related to proteins and/or DNA.
Ability to plan, quickly implement, optimize and quantify biochemical protocols.
Good knowledge of state-of-the-art biomolecular separation/purification methods.
Experience in working with clinical sample sources.
Experience with optical microscopy, lasers, filters, fluorescence detection.
Solid understanding of the biophysics associated with fluorescence-based detection.
Great organizational skills and strong aptitude for research-based planning and execution.
Desired Skills
Experience and knowledge of protein purification methods including IMAC, SEC, IEX, etc.
Experience with protein extraction from sources like tissue, saliva, blood, bacteria, etc.
Experience working with recombinant protein expression.
Experience with single molecule measurement.
Experience with microfluidics.
Experience with lab automation and coding in Python
Location and Contact Details
Genopore is located at Merck Inter-lab technological incubator, Yavne
Please apply and send CV to careers@genopore.com

job.title: Applications Engineering, Engineer
job.snippet:
We Are:
At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
You Are:
You are a motivated and technically strong Application Engineer with a passion for digital backend design flows and customer enablement. You enjoy working hands-on with advanced implementation tools and thrive in environments where learning, collaboration, and problem-solving are key. With a solid foundation in VLSI concepts and backend flows, you are eager to deepen your expertise and apply it in real-world customer engagements.
You are comfortable working in Unix-based environments, writing TCL scripts, and navigating complex design flows. Curious and adaptable, you enjoy learning from experienced colleagues and collaborating closely with customers to help them succeed. You communicate clearly, approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset, and take pride in delivering high-quality technical support.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Supporting customers by enabling and troubleshooting the digital BE design flow
Running and supporting Fusion Compiler (FC) implementation flows, including setup, execution, and analysis
Assisting customers with tool usage, flow understanding, and best practices for backend implementation
Working closely with experienced Application Engineers to learn customer environments and project requirements
Analyzing design issues and providing clear, practical guidance to resolve technical challenges
Collaborating with internal Synopsys teams to escalate, track, and resolve tool or flow-related issues
Contributing to continuous improvement of backend flows, methodologies, and customer support processes
The Impact You Will Have:
Supporting key global accounts by ensuring successful adoption and usage of Synopsys backend tools
Helping customers achieve efficient, high-quality digital implementations using industry-leading technology
Strengthening Synopsys’ reputation as a trusted technical partner through responsive and knowledgeable support
Accelerating customer productivity by enabling smooth backend flows and effective problem resolution
Contributing to long-term customer success and satisfaction in advanced VLSI designs
What You’ll Need:
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
Strong understanding of VLSI concepts and the digital backend (BE) design flow
Hands-on experience or familiarity with Fusion Compiler (FC) implementation
Working knowledge of Unix/Linux environments
Experience with or willingness to learn TCL scripting
1-3 years of experience in relevant field
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to learn complex tools and flows quickly
Who You Are:
Technically curious and eager to learn from experienced engineers
Customer-focused with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
A clear communicator who can explain technical concepts effectively
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
Detail-oriented, yet able to understand the broader design and customer context
Adaptable and positive when facing new challenges
The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:
You’ll join a skilled and collaborative Application Engineering team, focused on supporting backend design flows and Synopsys implementation tools. The team works closely with customers, R&D, and global support organizations to ensure successful tool adoption and project execution. You’ll be supported by experienced AEs who are committed to mentoring, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence, helping you grow while delivering real impact to customers worldwide.
Rewards and Benefits:
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

ניתוח תקלות מורכבות ומתמשכות, זיהוי Root Cause והובלת פתרונות טכניים בשיתוף Engineering, Maintenance, Commissioning וגורמי מומחה נוספים.

מעקב אחר תקלות חוזרות וזיהוי מגמות לצורך שיפור זמינות ואמינות המערכות.

job.title: Product Manager
job.snippet:
Reshet 13 is Hiring: Product Manager - Website & CMS
The Reshet 13 website is one of Israel's leading news and content sites, and its content management system (CMS) is the core infrastructure behind its day-to-day operation, from real-time publishing and updating of content by the newsroom to managing the VOD content library and advertising.
The renewed Reshet 13 is looking for a Product Manager to be the full owner of the website and CMS. The role is responsible for shaping product strategy, leading development processes, and delivering on goals and results.
This is a high-impact role. It combines leading the user experience for millions of users with improving and streamlining the workflows of one of Israel's largest media organizations.
Responsibilities
Manage and lead the Reshet 13 website and content management system (CMS) as products, including setting strategy, building the roadmap, and prioritizing tasks.
Drive growth and continuous improvement in product metrics, and initiate and launch new features.
Improve the browsing experience and content and video consumption on the site.
Improve and streamline the newsroom's and editors' tools and workflows through the CMS.
Lead upgrade, development, and implementation of content systems and infrastructure.
Lead monetization and advertising on the site.
Work closely day to day with development and UI/UX teams, from idea and specification through launch.
Specify complex processes and features, and write detailed, professional specification and documentation.
Analyze data and usage metrics, produce insights, and make data-driven product decisions.
Lead innovative initiatives in video, personalization, and AI.
Work regularly with product managers of the other platforms, the newsroom, and the content, marketing, and sales teams.
Requirements
At least 3 years of product management experience at media organizations or with journalism systems - required.
Experience working closely day to day with development and UI/UX teams - required.
Experience specifying complex processes and writing specification and documentation - required.
Strong ability to read, understand, and analyze data - required.
Experience working with content management systems of media organizations or publishers, particularly WordPress or Umbraco - required.
Familiarity with Figma, Jira, NPAW, Google Analytics, and Chartbeat - a significant advantage.
Experience in product management for video on websites - a significant advantage.
Experience with personalization and AI systems - an advantage.
Experience in monetization and managing advertising systems on websites - an advantage.
Familiarity with SEO and website performance.
High-level English, written and spoken.
Highly motivated, proactive, and independent, able to take full ownership of a product.
Position:
Full-time.
Location:
Reshet 13 offices, Ramat HaHayal, Tel Aviv (No Hybrid)

job.title: ראש.ת צוות תשתיות מחשוב ואבטחת מידע
job.snippet:
על פלסן
פלסן היא חברה גלובלית מובילה בפיתוח ובייצור פתרונות מיגון ושרידות מתקדמים עבור כוחות ביטחון ברחבי העולם. אנו פועלים בסביבה תעשייתית וטכנולוגית מורכבת, עם למעלה מ־40 שנות ניסיון, חדשנות ועשייה משמעותית.
לאגף מערכות המידע שלנו בקיבוץ סאסא דרוש.ה
ראש.ת צוות תשתיות מחשוב ואבטחת מידע
, לתפקיד ניהולי ומקצועי המשלב הובלת צוות, אחריות על התשתיות הטכנולוגיות של הארגון והובלת תחום אבטחת המידע.
התפקיד כולל ניהול צוותי התשתיות, הסיסטם, אבטחת המידע והתמיכה, לצד הובלת פרויקטים רוחביים, קבלת החלטות טכנולוגיות ושותפות בבניית האסטרטגיה המקצועית של הארגון.
מיקום המשרה: קיבוץ סאסא, הגליל העליון.
תחומי אחריות
ניהול והובלת צוותי תשתיות, סיסטם, אבטחת מידע ותמיכה במשתמשים.
אחריות מקצועית על תשתיות המחשוב, התקשורת והסיסטם בארגון.
הובלת תחום אבטחת המידע, לרבות יישום מדיניות, נהלים ודרישות רגולציה ותקינה.
ניהול מערך ה־Help Desk ומעבדת המחשוב ומתן מענה לצורכי המשתמשים בארגון.
הובלת פרויקטים טכנולוגיים רוחביים משלב האפיון והתכנון ועד להטמעה.
תכנון ויישום פתרונות טכנולוגיים בהתאם לצרכים העסקיים והארגוניים.
בחינת כלים ומערכות חדשות ובניית תכנית להתפתחות טכנולוגית.
תעדוף משימות ופרויקטים, הקצאת משאבים ומעקב אחר ביצוע.
פיתוח מקצועי, הכשרה וחניכה של חברי הצוות.
מתן ייעוץ מקצועי וקבלת החלטות בתחומי האחריות.
דרישות התפקיד
ניסיון של שלוש שנים לפחות בניהול עובדים – חובה.
לפחות שלוש שנות ניסיון מעשי Hands-on בתחומי תשתיות, סיסטם, תקשורת או אבטחת מידע – חובה.
ידע מעמיק במערכות תשתית ואבטחת מידע – חובה.
ניסיון בניהול והובלת פרויקטים טכנולוגיים.
ניסיון בהדרכה, חניכה ופיתוח מקצועי של עובדים.
תואר ראשון או הסמכות מקצועיות רלוונטיות בתחומי רשתות, סיסטם ואבטחת מידע – יתרון משמעותי.
יכולת קבלת החלטות, ראייה מערכתית וגמישות מחשבתית.
תקשורת בין־אישית גבוהה, שירותיות ויכולת עבודה עם ממשקים רבים.
אמינות, יושרה ודיסקרטיות.
מיקום המשרה: קיבוץ סאסא, הגליל העליון.
About Plasan
Plasan is a global leader in the development and manufacturing of advanced protection and survivability solutions for security and defense forces around the world. We operate in a complex industrial and technological environment, backed by more than 40 years of experience, innovation, and meaningful work.
Our Information Systems division, located at
Kibbutz Sasa in the Upper Galilee
, is looking for an
IT Infrastructure & Information Security Team Leader
for a managerial and professional role that combines team leadership, responsibility for the organization’s technology infrastructure, and leadership of the information security domain.
The role includes managing the infrastructure, system administration, information security, and IT support teams, while leading cross-organizational technology projects, making key technological decisions, and contributing to the organization’s professional and technological strategy.
Location: Kibbutz Sasa, Upper Galilee, Israel.
Responsibilities
Manage and lead the IT infrastructure, system administration, information security, and user support teams.
Take professional ownership of the organization’s IT infrastructure, communication networks, and system environments.
Lead the information security domain, including implementation of policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and relevant standards.
Manage the Help Desk and IT lab, ensuring effective support for users across the organization.
Lead cross-organizational technology projects from requirements definition and planning through implementation.
Plan and implement technology solutions aligned with business and organizational needs.
Evaluate new technologies, tools, and systems and build plans for the organization’s technological development.
Prioritize tasks and projects, allocate resources, and monitor execution.
Support the professional development, training, and mentoring of team members.
Provide professional guidance and make decisions within the team’s areas of responsibility.
Requirements
At least
3 years of experience managing employees
– required.
At least
3 years of hands-on experience
in IT infrastructure, system administration, networking, or information security – required.
Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure and information security systems – required.
Experience managing and leading technology projects.
Experience training, mentoring, and professionally developing employees.
Bachelor’s degree or relevant professional certifications in networking, system administration, or information security – a significant advantage.
Strong decision-making skills, a broad systems perspective, and the ability to adapt to changing requirements.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, a service-oriented approach, and the ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders.
High level of integrity, reliability, and discretion.
Location: Kibbutz Sasa, Upper Galilee, Israel.

job.title: Client Solutions Manager, Performance Advertising
job.snippet:
Opera is looking for a commercially driven and client-focused Client Solutions Manager to support the growth of our Performance Advertising business in Israel and the US.
Working closely with Sales, Ad Operations, and other internal teams, you will manage and develop relationships with both new, promising leads and prospects and also an established portfolio of advertisers, ensuring smooth onboarding, strong campaign performance and long-term client success. You will combine account management expertise with a proactive sales approach, identifying growth opportunities, strengthening client partnerships, and driving revenue growth across new leads and existing accounts. This is a hands-on, client-facing role offering the opportunity to work directly with advertisers, build meaningful business relationships, and contribute to the continued growth of Opera's advertising business.
Role & Responsibilities:
Manage and develop relationships with an existing portfolio of advertisers, acting as their primary point of contact and ensuring strong engagement, satisfaction, and long-term retention.
Identify and pursue account growth opportunities through proactive client engagement, upselling, cross-selling, and expanding existing advertising partnerships.
Work closely with advertisers to understand their business objectives, campaign performance, and acquisition goals, providing recommendations that support measurable results.
Collaborate with Sales, Ad Operations, and internal stakeholders to coordinate campaign execution, address client needs, resolve challenges, and ensure a consistent client experience.
Proactively source, pitch, and close new advertiser partnerships, managing the commercial cycle from initial outreach and negotiation through campaign launch.
Build and maintain strong client relationships through regular communication, business reviews, and in-person meetings, including travel when required to support strategic accounts and business development opportunities.
Job Requirements:
5+ years of experience in account management, client solutions, customer success, or business development within AdTech, performance advertising, or programmatic advertising.
Strong understanding of performance advertising, DSP platforms, digital customer acquisition, and campaign performance metrics, including CPA, CPI, and ROAS.
Proven experience managing and growing advertiser accounts, with the ability to identify commercial opportunities, strengthen client relationships, and contribute to revenue growth.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with a consultative, commercially driven approach to working with advertisers and internal stakeholders.
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple accounts, prioritize opportunities, and travel for client meetings as required.
What’s On Offer:
At Opera, you’ll join a diverse and inclusive team of experienced, supportive professionals who value creativity and collaboration. We work in a flat structure with short decision-making paths, giving you the opportunity to take ownership of advertiser relationships, develop strategic partnerships, and contribute directly to the growth of our performance advertising business.
Interested?
We’d love to hear from you! Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply soon. Please submit your CV in English. Have questions about our recruitment process, remote work, or benefits? Check out our FAQ page for more details.

job.title: Construction Project Manager
job.snippet:
Bagira is a leader in the field of training and simulation systems worldwide, is seeking an experienced Construction Project Manager to lead the end-to-end design and construction of simulation sites in Israel and abroad.
This hands-on role combines architectural and infrastructure planning, drafting, project management, contractor coordination, and on-site supervision-from initial requirements through site handover and readiness for system installation.
Manage simulation-site construction projects from requirements definition and planning through execution, commissioning, and handover.
Translate technical and operational system requirements into construction, layout, and infrastructure plans.
Prepare site layouts, construction drawings, and detailed plans using AutoCAD.
Plan and coordinate site requirements, including electrical systems, communications, HVAC, lighting, acoustics, safety, accessibility, and related infrastructure.
Prepare and manage contractor tender documents, evaluate bids, and support the contractor selection process.
Coordinate and manage architects, structural engineers, professional consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
Develop and monitor project schedules, budgets, work plans, and milestones.
Supervise on-site construction activities and ensure compliance with approved plans, technical requirements, quality standards, schedules, and budgets.
Identify design and execution gaps and provide practical solutions during construction.
Conduct inspections, manage punch lists, and follow up on corrective work.
Ensure site readiness for the installation, integration, and commissioning of simulation systems. Collaborate with internal engineering, technical, operational, and project teams, as well as customers and local partners in Israel and abroad.
Take full responsibility for obtaining all required occupancy permits, approvals, certificates, “as made” drawing package, and sign-offs from professional engineers and the relevant authorities prior to project completion and handover.
Requirements:
B.Sc. in Civil Engineering or Architecture, or a relevant practical engineering qualification.
Up to 5 years of hands-on experience in on-site supervision of construction projects, from initial planning through completion and handover.
Experience in the design, construction, and on-site supervision of similar facilities abroad-such as simulation sites, training centers, control rooms, technology-intensive facilities, or defence facilities-an advantage.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, including the preparation of site layouts, construction drawings, and detailed execution plans.
Proven experience coordinating architectural, construction, and infrastructure plans and working with contractors, suppliers, engineers, architects, and professional consultants.
Experience preparing and reviewing technical specifications, bills of quantities, cost estimates, project schedules, and contractor proposals.
Strong project management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholders, budgets, schedules, and priorities independently.
High-level English, including the ability to work with technical documentation and communicate in an international environment.
Willingness to travel to project sites in Israel and abroad.
Valid driving licence and access to a private vehicle.

job.title: ADMS Solution Integrator
job.snippet:
Job Description Summary
Bietet Know-how für nachhaltigen Kundenerfolg und Wachstum im Post-Sales-Kundenlebenszyklus durch Schulung, professionellen Service, technischen Support, Verlängerungen, Erreichung von Ergebnissen, Bindung, Erweiterung und Kundenbetreuung mit digitalem Fokus. Verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung des Abteilungsbetriebs oder konzentriert sich auf die Ausführung von beruflichen Tätigkeiten innerhalb einer technischen Disziplin.Hat eine gewisse Autonomie, wird jedoch von festgelegten Richtlinien oder der Überprüfung der Endergebnisse geleitet.
Die Stelle ermöglicht die Änderung von Arbeitsabläufen und Praktiken, sofern die Endergebnisse den Standards der Akzeptanz (Qualität, Umfang, Aktualität usw.) entsprechen.
Job Description
Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten
Tragen zur Implementierung von MES-Lösungen unter Verwendung der Software-Suite bei. Übernehmen während des gesamten Lebenszyklus der Projekte die Verantwortung für technische Leistungen. Beteiligen sich während des gesamten Lebenszyklus von zugewiesenen Projekten an Entscheidungen bezüglich Architektur, Design und Funktionalität, um Programme hinsichtlich Budget, Zeit und Kundenerwartungen innerhalb des vorgegebenen Rahmens zu halten. Arbeiten eng mit dem Kunden zusammen, um dessen Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und Strategien zu entwickeln, die mittels Standortbewertungen auf seine Organisation zugeschnitten sind. Geben zudem während des Implementierungsprozesses gegenüber Kunden Standardempfehlungen zu Workflow, Anwendung, Benutzeroberfläche, Berichten, Tests und Uploads ab. Tragen die Verantwortung für die Bereitschaft und den Support für die Inbetriebnahme sowie für die Nachuntersuchungen und müssen mit internen Teammitgliedern und Kunden zusammenarbeiten, um die Kundenzufriedenheit zu gewährleisten
Nutzt vertiefte Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin sowie analytisches Denken und technische Erfahrung zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien.
Hat Kenntnisse über Best Practices und darüber, wie sich der eigene Bereich in andere integriert; ist sich des Wettbewerbs und der Faktoren bewusst, die das Unternehmen auf dem Markt auszeichnen
Nutzt ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, um kompliziertere Herstellungsprozesse mit technischer Vielfalt und/oder voneinander abhängigen Produktionszyklen anzugehen.Verwendet technische Erfahrung und analytisches Denken.Verwendet mehrere interne und begrenzte externe Quellen außerhalb der eigenen Teams, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Dient als Ressource für Kollegen mit weniger Erfahrung.Kann kleine Projekte mit geringen Risiken und Ressourcenanforderungen leiten.Erklärt Informationen; Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten, um Teammitglieder zu einem Konsens über Themen innerhalb des Feldes zu bewegen.Vermittelt Leistungserwartungen und kann vertrauliche Themen behandeln.
Grundqualifikationen
Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).
Gewünschte Eigenschaften
Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.
Additional Information
The job is open to men and women equally
Relocation Assistance Provided:
No

job.title: Industrial Designer | Product Development & Manufacturing
job.snippet:
Love turning creative ideas into real, manufacturable products?
We're looking for an experienced, hands-on
Industrial Designer
to join a product development team in Herzliya.
If you enjoy combining creativity with technical thinking, working on products from initial concepts to production-ready designs, and solving real manufacturing challenges, this could be your next opportunity.
What You'll Do
Lead the planning and development of new products, from initial concepts to detailed production specifications.
Create 3D models and develop designs with a strong focus on manufacturability (DFM).
Work with manufacturing technologies including plastic injection molding, CNC machining, and 3D printing.
Collaborate closely with the development team to ensure technical feasibility, quality, and timely execution.
Apply analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to improve product functionality and production efficiency.
What We're Looking For
Bachelor's degree in Industrial Design from a recognized academic institution – a must.
At least 5 years of hands-on experience in product development and design for manufacturing.
Proven experience in plastic product design and planning – a must.
Proficiency in
SolidWorks
.
Familiarity with plastic injection molding, CNC machining, and 3D printing.
Strong technical planning, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Interest in the engineering and manufacturing aspects of product development.
Ability to work independently, take ownership, and manage technical tasks.
Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.
Excellent organizational skills and the ability to meet challenging project timelines.
High proficiency in written and spoken English.
Nice to Have
Experience with KeyShot, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
Why This Role?
An opportunity to take an active part in product development, combine creative design with technical execution, and work on the challenges of turning concepts into manufacturable products.
Ready to turn great ideas into real products?
We'd love to hear from you!
Apply Now

job.title: Senior Big Data & AI Engineer / Technical Lead
job.snippet:
We are looking for a hands-on, high-profile Senior Big Data & AI Engineer / Technical Lead to join our core engineering team in Israel. In this role, you will take technical ownership over mission-critical data initiatives, driving complex data architectures from concept to production.
In this role, you will design and execute advanced data workflows, build scalable architectures across modern data warehouses, implement AI agents, and expand our machine learning capabilities. We need someone who can combine deep algorithmic and backend engineering capabilities with a sharp focus on execution, delivery, and solving complex architectural challenges.
Reporting directly to Datonics CTO, you will play a central, high-impact role in shaping our core data pipelines, partner integrations, and proprietary audience graph solutions.
We work in a flexible hybrid model (2 days a week from our office).
What we are looking for:
5+ years of hands-on experience in Big Data / Data Engineering or Backend Engineering with a deep focus on large-scale data architectures.
Proven track record of writing and optimizing complex queries and data models in Snowflake and/or Google BigQuery.
High proficiency in Python (and/or Scala/Java) for data processing, automation, and API integrations.
Hand On experience working with machine learning algorithms (specifically Lookalike/classification modeling) and building AI agents / LLM integrations for real-world production tasks.
Background in AdTech - Advantage
Self-directed mindset with the ability to lead technical tasks from scratch, architect solutions independently, and make sound technical decisions.
Strong communication skills in English and Hebrew, with the ability to articulate technical tradeoffs clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
What you'll be doing:
Complex Data Querying & Graph Modeling:
Author, optimize, and execute efficient, high-volume queries in Snowflake and Google BigQuery.
Connect disparate graph dumps (households, consumer profiles, C2C linkages, and email histories) into robust hierarchical structures that mirror and enhance our graph service capabilities.
Partner Integrations & Pipeline Architecture:
Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable, and secure data flows between external strategic partners and the Datonics ecosystem.
Define and manage end-to-end data ingestion, transformation, and streaming mechanisms to support real-time and batch requirements.
Applied AI & Agent Development:
Architect, build, and deploy intelligent AI agents capable of ingesting web page URLs and classifying them into standardized IAB categories.
Evaluate and integrate LLMs/ML models and prompt frameworks into automated, production-grade pipelines.
Audience Modeling & Machine Learning:
Leverage ML algorithms to build, optimize, and test scalable Lookalike audience segments derived from first-party (1P) data.
Partner with internal stakeholders to translate product and business data requirements into high-performance algorithmic solutions.
Technical Ownership & Best Practices:
Set high standards for data quality, code review, testing, performance tuning, and technical documentation across all data initiatives.

job.title: Logistics Coordinator
job.snippet:
This is an NBN Connect post on behalf of another organization.
About the Role
We are looking for an organized, detail-oriented, and proactive
Logistics Coordinator
to join our team in Jerusalem. In this role, you will manage hotel reservations, transportation logistics, updating the CRM, invoice intake and daily administrative tasks.
You will work closely with suppliers across Israel to ensure seamless execution of travel itineraries, while providing real-time problem-solving to ensure a smooth client experience.
Key Responsibilities
Reservations Management:
Daily booking, modification, and confirmation of hotel accommodation and bus/transportation schedules across Israel.
CRM & Data Maintenance:
Maintain precise, up-to-date entries in our CRM system (client itineraries, supplier confirmations, and special requests)
Ensure clear data transfer between operations and external partners.
Financial & Invoice Oversight:
Coordinate with the finance department to process and verify invoicing and billing needs.
Issue Management & On-Call Support:
On occasion, handle after-hours operational issues to support on-the-ground staff, bus drivers, and international clients.
Requirements & Qualifications
Language Skills:
Native level fluency in both
English and Hebrew
Experience:
1–3 years of experience in logistics, operations, travel agency work, or hospitality management.
Tech Savvy:
Strong proficiency with CRM software, MS Office (Excel/Word), and Google Workspace.
Communication:
Exceptional phone, email, and interpersonal skills with a service-oriented mindset for international clientele.
Problem-Solving:
Strong negotiation skills, composure under pressure, and the ability to solve time-sensitive logistics issues independently.
Availability:
Must be able to work onsite in Jerusalem (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM) and be accessible outside regular office hours for urgent operational matters.

job.title: AI Builder
job.snippet:
Join Noma Security and help shape the future of AI security in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.
Noma is building the first comprehensive AI Security and Governance Platform, helping organizations adopt AI and LLMs with confidence and control. As AI becomes core to modern enterprises, we provide seamless visibility and protection across the entire AI lifecycle. Our team works at the intersection of AI, security, and cloud, shaping a new category in a rapidly evolving market. At Noma, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while working with exceptional people on technology that truly matters.
We’re looking for an
AI Builder
to serve as the technical backbone of Noma’s internal AI function. You’ll build the LLM-powered agents, automation pipelines, integrations, and infrastructure that teams across the company rely on every day.
This is a rare opportunity to build a new function from the ground up within a company where the work can have an immediate and meaningful impact. You’ll create systems such as tools that help Sales track competitive deals in real time, pipelines that automatically turn customer calls into Salesforce updates, and agents that identify competitor activity and deliver actionable insights directly to Slack.
This is a highly hands-on role with true end-to-end ownership-from translating business needs into focused technical solutions to deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving production systems.
🛠️
What You’ll Do:
Build AI-Powered Agents and Automations
Design and build LLM-powered agents, automation pipelines, and backend services used across the organization.
Develop complex integrations that bring together data from multiple internal and external systems.
Build custom MCP servers and other infrastructure required to support scalable internal AI workflows.
Turn fuzzy business needs into practical, focused, and maintainable technical solutions.
Own the Internal AI Infrastructure
Harden and maintain Noma’s existing MCP Gateway ecosystem.
Improve reliability, error handling, authentication, secrets management, and versioning.
Implement secure, vault-based credential management and strong security practices across production automations.
Build infrastructure that enables agents and workflows to operate reliably at scale.
Drive Production Readiness and Reliability
Own the deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and reliability of agents and automations in production.
Build evaluation frameworks, test sets, and monitoring processes to measure accuracy, precision, recall, hallucination rates, and overall agent performance.
Identify regressions and continuously improve the quality and stability of production workflows.
Troubleshoot failures across integrations, models, APIs, and automation pipelines.
Drive Adoption and Business Impact
Partner closely with the AI Product Manager and teams across the organization to understand their workflows and challenges.
Ensure the solutions we build are adopted and deliver measurable value—not just technically functional.
Gather feedback from end users, iterate quickly, and continuously improve the ROI of internal AI systems.
Help teams across Noma incorporate AI effectively into the way they work.
✅
What You Bring:
3–5 years of software engineering or hands-on development experience.
Strong Python skills and experience writing clean, maintainable, production-grade code.
Hands-on experience working with LLM APIs such as Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or similar.
Experience building integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, and asynchronous pipelines.
Experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar.
Hands-on experience with MCP and building or integrating MCP servers.
Experience evaluating LLM or agent performance in production, including building evaluation harnesses or test sets to identify regressions.
Understanding of secrets management, credential handling, and security best practices for production automations.
Ability to work independently and own projects end-to-end.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn ambiguous requirements into practical technical solutions.
🎯
Who You Are:
Genuinely excited about AI and actively following developments in the space.
Adaptable by default-you learn quickly, pivot when needed, and don’t become overly attached to a specific tool or approach.
You ship quickly, gather feedback, and iterate.
You care about the end user and business impact, not only the technology.
Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment without an established playbook.
Highly accountable, hands-on, and motivated by building something from the ground up.
💡
Nice to Haves:
Background in cybersecurity or enterprise B2B SaaS.
Experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent.
Experience building internal developer platforms or company-wide automation infrastructure.
Familiarity with Salesforce, Slack, and other common enterprise systems.
Experience driving internal adoption of AI tools and measuring their business impact.
💙
Perks & Benefits:
Located in a prime area with easy access to public transportation, near the Hashalom train station and the Light Rail.
A bright, spacious, dog-friendly office that makes you smile the moment you walk in 🐶
Team bonding activities, company retreats, happy hours, and holiday gifts.
Pilates classes at the office 💪🧘‍♀️
Never hungry: Monthly lunch budget, dinners provided, and a fully stocked kitchen 🍽️
A warm, supportive, and people-first company culture.
Pension and Keren Hishtalmut (advanced training fund).
A global work environment with teams across Tel Aviv, the US, the Netherlands, and London.
Options that let you share in Noma’s growth and success.
