job.description:
Join Noma Security and help shape the future of AI security in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.
Noma is building the first comprehensive AI Security and Governance Platform, helping organizations adopt AI and LLMs with confidence and control. As AI becomes core to modern enterprises, we provide seamless visibility and protection across the entire AI lifecycle. Our team works at the intersection of AI, security, and cloud, shaping a new category in a rapidly evolving market. At Noma, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while working with exceptional people on technology that truly matters.
We’re looking for an
AI Builder
to serve as the technical backbone of Noma’s internal AI function. You’ll build the LLM-powered agents, automation pipelines, integrations, and infrastructure that teams across the company rely on every day.
This is a rare opportunity to build a new function from the ground up within a company where the work can have an immediate and meaningful impact. You’ll create systems such as tools that help Sales track competitive deals in real time, pipelines that automatically turn customer calls into Salesforce updates, and agents that identify competitor activity and deliver actionable insights directly to Slack.
This is a highly hands-on role with true end-to-end ownership-from translating business needs into focused technical solutions to deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving production systems.
🛠️
What You’ll Do:
Build AI-Powered Agents and Automations
Design and build LLM-powered agents, automation pipelines, and backend services used across the organization.
Develop complex integrations that bring together data from multiple internal and external systems.
Build custom MCP servers and other infrastructure required to support scalable internal AI workflows.
Turn fuzzy business needs into practical, focused, and maintainable technical solutions.
Own the Internal AI Infrastructure
Harden and maintain Noma’s existing MCP Gateway ecosystem.
Improve reliability, error handling, authentication, secrets management, and versioning.
Implement secure, vault-based credential management and strong security practices across production automations.
Build infrastructure that enables agents and workflows to operate reliably at scale.
Drive Production Readiness and Reliability
Own the deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and reliability of agents and automations in production.
Build evaluation frameworks, test sets, and monitoring processes to measure accuracy, precision, recall, hallucination rates, and overall agent performance.
Identify regressions and continuously improve the quality and stability of production workflows.
Troubleshoot failures across integrations, models, APIs, and automation pipelines.
Drive Adoption and Business Impact
Partner closely with the AI Product Manager and teams across the organization to understand their workflows and challenges.
Ensure the solutions we build are adopted and deliver measurable value—not just technically functional.
Gather feedback from end users, iterate quickly, and continuously improve the ROI of internal AI systems.
Help teams across Noma incorporate AI effectively into the way they work.
✅
What You Bring:
3–5 years of software engineering or hands-on development experience.
Strong Python skills and experience writing clean, maintainable, production-grade code.
Hands-on experience working with LLM APIs such as Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or similar.
Experience building integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, and asynchronous pipelines.
Experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar.
Hands-on experience with MCP and building or integrating MCP servers.
Experience evaluating LLM or agent performance in production, including building evaluation harnesses or test sets to identify regressions.
Understanding of secrets management, credential handling, and security best practices for production automations.
Ability to work independently and own projects end-to-end.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn ambiguous requirements into practical technical solutions.
🎯
Who You Are:
Genuinely excited about AI and actively following developments in the space.
Adaptable by default-you learn quickly, pivot when needed, and don’t become overly attached to a specific tool or approach.
You ship quickly, gather feedback, and iterate.
You care about the end user and business impact, not only the technology.
Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment without an established playbook.
Highly accountable, hands-on, and motivated by building something from the ground up.
💡
Nice to Haves:
Background in cybersecurity or enterprise B2B SaaS.
Experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent.
Experience building internal developer platforms or company-wide automation infrastructure.
Familiarity with Salesforce, Slack, and other common enterprise systems.
Experience driving internal adoption of AI tools and measuring their business impact.
💙
Perks & Benefits:
Located in a prime area with easy access to public transportation, near the Hashalom train station and the Light Rail.
A bright, spacious, dog-friendly office that makes you smile the moment you walk in 🐶
Team bonding activities, company retreats, happy hours, and holiday gifts.
Pilates classes at the office 💪🧘‍♀️
Never hungry: Monthly lunch budget, dinners provided, and a fully stocked kitchen 🍽️
A warm, supportive, and people-first company culture.
Pension and Keren Hishtalmut (advanced training fund).
A global work environment with teams across Tel Aviv, the US, the Netherlands, and London.
Options that let you share in Noma’s growth and success.

job.title: AD OPERATIONS MANAGER
job.snippet:
AD OPERATIONS MANAGER?
WE WANT YOU!
ISRAEL
We’re looking for a data-driven, detail-oriented Ad Operations Manager with analytical expertise to support business teams and build insights based on tracking and reporting.
About Us
Anzu is the most advanced intrinsic in-game ad solution for mobile, PC, and console. Anzu’s in-game ads put players first and help advertisers reach audiences programmatically in a highly engaging way. A patented 3D ad tracking engine, the first to bring viewability measurement in-game, partnerships with trusted AdTech vendors, and compliant with the industry measurement standards outlined by the MRC and IAB make Anzu the preferred in-game advertising partner for brands and agencies worldwide.
Anzu helps game developers monetize their titles with ad placements that complement the gameplay. By monetizing the entire game session, developers benefit from consistent and reliable revenue streams. Supporting all major and custom-built game engines and a full-stack ad monetization solution that provides complete control over ad placements makes Anzu the preferred in-game ad monetization partner for developers worldwide.
Backed by Sony Innovation Fund, NBCUniversal, Samsung Next, Bandai Namco Entertainment 021 Fund, WPP, PayPal Ventures, and many other prominent investors, Anzu is on a mission to make advertising in games better. Better for brands, better for game developers, and better for gamers. Learn more.
WHAT WILL YOU DO?
Manage and monitor programmatic performance regularly, striving to consistently refine tactics and produce exceptional results for our customers
Provide regular reports (weekly, monthly, and quarterly) for the internal and external teams with goals, performance, and insights
Contribute to developing new strategies to improve our performance across the board
Work closely and collaborate with the product, data, and finance teams on feature requests, product enhancements, and data analytics reports
Onboard new supply partners utilizing Prebid and oRTB protocols
WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?
3+ years of experience in an ad operations role from a global ad-tech company
Proven experience with operating within SSPs\exchanges and a deep understanding of the programmatic ecosystem
Hands-on management of large-scale budgets
Analytical skills, with high proficiency in MS Excel (Must!) and Google applications
Experience in onboarding new supply and demand partners, including integration, discrepancies, and resolving issues yourself
Excellent written and verbal English for effective collaboration with team members and stakeholders
Attention to detail and the ability to quickly master multiple dashboards and tools
Excellent self-learning capabilities, strong quantitative and analytical skills
WHY ANZU?
Industry-leading global company in the in-game advertising market
Exciting opportunity to dive into the popular worlds of gaming, esports, and advertising
Central HQ in Tel Aviv, with hybrid working and remote teams around the globe
Great opportunity for professional growth across multiple areas of expertise, working with cutting-edge technologies
Work with AAA and indie gaming studios to make gaming a better place
Equal opportunity employer with an inclusive environment for all employees
Competitive salary packages
And much, much more…
INTERESTED?
PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV BELOW.
APPLY HERE
Upload Cv

job.title: מנהל/ת תפעול ומלאי TAKEANAP
job.snippet:
Operations & Inventory Manager
אנחנו מחפשים מנהל/ת תפעול ומלאי עם יכולת ניהולית גבוהה, חשיבה מערכתית, הבנה מסחרית ויכולת להוביל תהליכים מקצה לקצה.
התפקיד משלב ניהול מלאי, רכש, שרשרת אספקה, מחסן ולוגיסטיקה, בסביבת Retail ו־E-commerce דינמית וצומחת.
תחומי אחריות
אחריות כוללת על מערך המלאי של החברה, משלב תכנון ההזמנות ועד לאספקה ללקוחות ולחנויות.
ניתוח נתוני מכירות ומלאי, קצב מכירה, חוסרים, עודפים ומלאי איטי.
תכנון מלאי עתידי, תחזיות ביקוש והמלצות להזמנות רכש בהתאם לצורכי החברה.

job.title: Product Manager
job.snippet:
About REAL
REAL is building an AI Execution Platform for enterprise real estate organizations.
Our platform transforms fragmented business and financial data into connected intelligence, enabling customers to automate complex workflows, improve operational accuracy, and make better business decisions.
At REAL, you'll work with cutting-edge AI technology, enterprise customers, and a product that is redefining how CRE organizations operate.
REAL Values
Ownership: We take responsibility and move decisively
Clarity: We simplify complexity to deliver meaningful impact
Accuracy: Precision matters in everything we build
Velocity: We work with urgency and intent
Partnership: We collaborate closely with customers and teammates
Role Overview
We're looking for a Product Manager who loves solving complex problems, building intuitive products, and turning cutting-edge AI capabilities into real business value.
At REAL, you'll work at the intersection of AI, data, user experience, and enterprise real estate, lease and accounting, construction & architecture, and facilities, shaping how some of the world's largest organizations interact with their data and execute critical business workflows.
This is a highly hands-on role with real ownership and impact. You'll lead product features end-to-end, work directly with customers to understand their challenges, and collaborate closely with engineering and design to turn complex requirements into simple, powerful product experiences.
We're looking for someone who brings a strong foundation in at least one of three areas: data-intensive products, UX-driven product development, or deep industry knowledge in commercial real estate (CRE) / PropTech.
You should know the CRE market. What matters most is how fast you learn: you pick up new domains quickly, ask the right questions, and turn what you learn into a product.
What You'll Do
Own product features end-to-end - from discovery and problem definition through design, development, launch, and continuous improvement, balancing speed and quality in a fast-paced, iterative environment
Turn complex customer workflows into intuitive solutions - understand business processes, data structures, and customer needs, translating them into clear, scalable product experiences
Lead proactive product discovery - engage directly with customers and prospects through user interviews, validation, outbound outreach, and ongoing conversations to identify needs and new opportunities
Leverage AI tools and technologies - build AI-powered product experiences and use AI tools for prototyping, research, and faster product development
Collaborate closely with design and engineering - define user journeys, detailed product requirements, business logic, edge cases, and system behavior, using prototypes to bring ideas to life
Make data-driven product decisions - analyze product usage, customer feedback, and industry insights to prioritize improvements and deliver measurable impact
Requirements
What We're Looking For
3-5 years of experience in Product Management, preferably in a B2B, SaaS, or enterprise technology environment, or in industries related to architecture, construction, real estate, or design
Strong expertise in the following areas:
Bringing product vision to execution
Data & Analytics: Experience with data-intensive products, complex datasets, analytics, or data-driven workflows
CRE / PropTech: Hands-on background in the real estate world: enterprise real estate, lease and accounting, construction, architecture, engineering, facilities. You understand how they run day to day
UX & Product Experience: Strong UX orientation and ability to design intuitive user journeys and simplify complex interactions
Strong AI and data-driven orientation - a must. Hands-on experience with AI tools, product analytics platforms (Mixpanel, Heap, or similar), and prototyping tools (Figma, v0, Lovable, or similar)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex customer workflows and translate business needs into clear break down complex systems into clear product logic
Customer-centric and collaborative mindset, with experience working directly with customers, engineering, and design teams
Strong ownership and execution skills, high attention to detail, and excellent English communication skills

job.title: Head of Learning Development & Innovation
job.snippet:
Key Responsibilities
Lead the organization's Learning Innovation, Research & Development strategy, shaping the future of organizational learning and capability building.
Design and implement innovative learning concepts, methodologies, and ecosystems, with a focus on Knowledge Management, Learning Management Systems (LMS), Digital Learning Environments, Simulations, and Experiential Learning, aligned with organizational needs and global learning trends.
Conduct strategic research to identify emerging technologies, learning methodologies, and best practices, driving continuous innovation across the learning function.
Evaluate, introduce, and integrate advanced learning technologies and tools that enhance employee development and organizational performance.
Identify, engage, and manage external experts and strategic partners to implement innovative learning solutions.
Lead and cultivate the organization's Learning Innovation Community, overseeing its professional development and ongoing activities.
Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise learning systems, including requirements definition, implementation, adoption, change management, and continuous improvement, while collaborating closely with technology and business stakeholders.
Foster a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and knowledge sharing through cross-functional collaboration and organizational partnerships.
Requirements
Minimum of 10 years of leadership experience.
At least 7 years of experience managing technology-driven projects, including digital transformation or enterprise learning technologies.
Minimum of 5 years of experience leading cross-functional organizational initiatives and change management programs.
Bachelor's degree required; a degree in Technology, Business Administration, Innovation, Entrepreneurship, or a related field is preferred.
Hands-on experience in developing learning materials or Learning Management System (LMS) technologies - An advantage.
Location:
Central Israel
Employment Type:
Full-time

job.title: 24333 - Hardware Validation & Testing (Lab Technician)
job.snippet:
QualityAI is the leading AI-first quality engineering company. We deliver end-to-end quality management services across the business and technology life cycle for enterprise customers who need certainty at Go-Live.
We build and test services and products using AI, working across data, models, platforms, devices, and infrastructure to ensure those systems perform as expected at scale.
Your next career move starts here: Hardware Validation & Testing (Lab Technician) – Hertzliya
This role focuses on lab operations management, hardware bringup, and equipment maintenance.
Responsibilities
Manage and organize laboratory equipment, components, and supplies, ensuring an efficient and safe working environment.
Set up and configure new hardware platforms, including board and device bring-up.
Install, configure, and validate hardware, software, firmware, and operating systems.
Perform device driver validation, system calibration, and functional testing.
Execute test procedures, analyze results, and troubleshoot setup and configuration issues.
Maintain laboratory equipment, inventory, and asset tracking documentation.
Monitor stock levels and coordinate equipment and component replenishment.
Manage remote lab configurations and ensure system functionality.
Requirements
At least 2 years of hands-on experience in a laboratory or technical environment.
Practical experience managing equipment, organizing lab setups, and maintaining laboratory operations.
Experience setting up RF systems in the communications field.
Experience installing and configuring hardware boards and operating systems (no soldering required).
Experience verifying installations, executing test procedures, and analyzing test results.
Strong technical orientation and hands-on approach, combining laboratory work with remote DevOps-style environment management.
Experience with remote lab management and troubleshooting.
Practical Engineering diploma (Handasai) in Electronics, Communications, or a related field.
Experience in laboratory operations and equipment configuration. - Advantage.
Experience with remote control systems. - Advantage.
Familiarity with basic automation tools. - Advantage.
Why should you join us?
Grow your career in a stable, innovative environment
Collaborate closely with clients to deliver smart, high-quality solutions
Make an impact in a dynamic, learning-driven environment
Be part of a human, value-driven organization that care

job.snippet:

בינת סמך

חולון

הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
בינת סמך מגייסת ממונה/ת תחבורה ציבורית ורשויות לחדר הבקרה של חברת נתיבי איילון בחולון + חיפה.
התפקיד כולל ניהול, בקרה וסנכרון בזמן אמת של מערך התחבורה הציבורית והממשק מול הרשויות המקומיות, במטרה להבטיח זרימת תנועה מיטבית ומתן מענה מהיר לאירועים חריגים.
תחומי אחריות מרכזיים:
• ניהול ובקרה בזמן אמת: ניטור מערכי התחבורה הציבורית וצירי התנועה המרכזיים באמצעות מערכות טכנולוגיות מתקדמות.
• תיאום מול גורמים חיצוניים: עבודה שוטפת מול מפעילי תחבורה ציבורית, רשויות מקומיות, משטרת ישראל וגורמי חירום.
• ניהול אירועי תנועה: מתן מענה ופתרונות תפעוליים מידיים לעיכובים, חסימות, עבודות בכביש או אירועים חריגים בצירי התחבורה הציבורית.
• הפקת דוחות וניתוח נתונים: מעקב אחר מדדי ביצוע (KPIs) של התחבורה הציבורית והכנת דוחות תקופתיים לשיפור השירות.
• עבודה במשמרות: התפקיד מבוצע בחדר בקרה פעיל ודורש נכונות לעבודה במשמרות (כולל לילות וסופי שבוע).
* העבודה ממוקמת בחולון ובחיפה בסמוך לתחבורה ציבורית ורכבת
? משרה מלאה בין הימים א-ה
? שכר גבוה + אש"ל יומי ישירות למשכורת
דרישות התפקיד
• השכלה: תואר אקדמי רלוונטי (גיאוגרפיה, לוגיסטיקה, הנדסת תעשייה וניהול/תנועה, או תחום משיק) - יתרון משמעותי.
• ניסיון מקצועי: ניסיון קודם של שנתיים לפחות בעבודה בחדרי בקרה, מוקדים מבצעיים, או ניהול מערכי תפעול/לוגיסטיקה/תחבורה.
• היכרות עם עולם התחבורה: הבנה והיכרות עם מערכות תחבורה ציבורית, הסדרי תנועה וממשקי עבודה מול רשויות - יתרון.
• מיומנויות מחשב: שליטה מצוינת ביישומי Office ומערכות טכנולוגיות מורכבות (מערכות שו"ב, GIS וכדומה).
• תכונות אישיות: יכולת עבודה תחת לחץ, קבלת החלטות מהירה, כושר ביטוי גבוה ויחסי אנוש מעולים.
• זמינות: נכונות לעבודה דינמית במשמרות 24/7.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
התפקיד כולל אחריות על תכנון, תיאום וביצוע בדיקות מערכת ואינטגרציה בפרויקט תחבורתי מורכב, החל משלב שילוב תתי-המערכות ועד לאימות ביצועי המערכת לקראת מסירתה למפעיל.
במסגרת התפקיד:
כתיבת נהלי בדיקות מערכת.
תכנון, תיאום וביצוע בדיקות אינטגרציה ומערכת באתר הפרויקט.
ניתוח תוצאות בדיקה והפקת דוחות מקצועיים.
איתור, תחקור ומעקב אחר תקלות עד לסגירתן.
עבודה מול ממשקים רבים בתחומי החשמל, האיתות, התקשורת והתפעול.
תיעוד וניהול תצורות המערכת לאורך שלבי הבדיקות השונים.
תמיכה בפעילויות אינטגרציה ובדיקות של תתי-המערכות.
יישום נהלים, שיטות עבודה וכלי בדיקה בהתאם לסטנדרטים הנדרשים.
דרישות התפקיד
חובה:
תואר ראשון בהנדסה.
לפחות 3 שנות ניסיון בתחום הרכבות.
או
לפחות 5 שנות ניסיון בתחום Testing & Commissioning (בדיקות והפעלה).
אנגלית ברמה גבוהה (קריאה, כתיבה ודיבור).
עברית ברמה גבוהה.
יכולת עבודה בסביבה טכנית מורכבת ורבת ממשקים.
יתרון:
תואר בהנדסת חשמל ו/או מכונות.
ניסיון בבדיקות ואינטגרציה של מערכות רכבת.
היכרות עם אחד או יותר מהתחומים הבאים:
Rolling Stock
Power Supply
Signaling
SCADA
Telecom
AVLS
ניסיון באיתור תקלות (Troubleshooting) במערכות מורכבות.
יכולת קריאת שרטוטים וסכמות טכניות.
ניסיון בעבודה עם ציוד בדיקה ומדידה.
היכרות עם תקני בטיחות, בריאות ואיכות סביבה באתרי הקמה.
כישורים אישיים:
עבודת צוות ויחסי אנוש מצוינים.
יכולת הובלה והנעת ממשקים.
חשיבה אנליטית ויכולת פתרון בעיות.
סדר, ארגון וירידה לפרטים.
יכולת עבודה תחת לחץ ועמידה בלוחות זמנים.
גמישות ויכולת הסתגלות לסביבה דינמית.

הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
לחברה טכנולוגית  העוסקת בפיתוח מערכות אוויריות לשוק הביטחוני והאזרחי,
דרוש/ה מהנדס/ת אלקטרוניקה מנוסה
תפקיד פיתוח חומרה מקצה לקצה.
עבודה במטה החברה באזור חיפה והקריות
תיאור התפקיד
אחריות מלאה על פיתוח חומרה, משלב הקונספט והתכנון ועד לייצור סדרתי.
תכנון סכמות למעגלים אנלוגיים ודיגיטליים, ספקי כוח מסוג LDO ו־DC/DC וממשקים אלקטרוניים.
תכנון ועריכת כרטיסים אלקטרוניים (PCB Layout), כולל Placement, Routing, Stack-up ודרישות DFM.
בחירת רכיבים אלקטרוניים על בסיס Datasheets, זמינות, מחזור חיי מוצר ושיקולי אמינות.
ביצוע Bring-up, בדיקות חומרה ואיתור תקלות (Debug) במעבדה.
הכנת תיעוד הנדסי, לרבות BOM, ICD ומסמכי ECO/ECN.
השתתפות בסקרי תכן (Design Reviews).
עבודה בצוות פיתוח רב־תחומי בשיתוף מהנדסי מכניקה ותוכנה.
דרישות התפקיד
תואר ראשון בהנדסת חשמל או אלקטרוניקה – חובה.
ניסיון של 5 שנים לפחות בתכנון כרטיסים אלקטרוניים – חובה.
ניסיון מוכח בפיתוח כרטיסים מקצה לקצה, כולל Schematics, PCB Layout ו־Bring-up – חובה.
ניסיון בתכנון מעגלים אנלוגיים ודיגיטליים, ספקי כוח וממשקים – חובה.
ניסיון מעשי ב־PCB Layout, לרבות Stack-up ו־DFM – חובה.
שליטה מלאה בתוכנת Altium Designer – חובה.
ניסיון בבחירת רכיבים לפי Datasheets, Derating, Lifecycle ו־Availability – חובה.
ניסיון בביצוע Debug ובדיקות חומרה באמצעות Oscilloscope, DMM, ספקי כוח ו־Logic Analyzer – חובה.
ניסיון בהכנת תיעוד הנדסי מסוג BOM, ICD ו־ECO/ECN – חובה.
יכולת הובלה עצמאית של פרויקט חומרה משלב Concept ועד ייצור סדרתי – חובה.
אנגלית טכנית ברמה גבוהה – חובה.
ניסיון בתכנון כרטיסים למערכות מוטסות, רחפנים או כטב"מים, תוך התייחסות ל־EMC, משקל ותנאי סביבה – יתרון משמעותי.
ניסיון בתכנון כרטיסים מבוססי מיקרו־בקרים STM32 או TI – יתרון.
ניסיון בתכנון מעגלי RF או מעגלים להנעת מנועים – יתרון.
ניסיון בעבודה עם PADS – יתרון.

job.title: Procurement Director
job.snippet: Description: We are looking for an experienced Procurement Director to lead our Procurement team and drive complex procurement and contracting activities across large-scale projects. The Procurement Director will work closely with Project Management, Engineering, Legal, Finance and other key stakeholders to ensure procurement activities are aligned with project schedules, commercial objectives, technical requirements and company governance. | Responsibilities: Team Leadership & Management Lead, manage, coach and develop the Procurement team. Allocate procurement resources and priorities across projects and procurement packages. Manage team workload based on project priorities, schedules, procurement complexity and commercial risk. Support Procurement Leads in complex negotiations, contractual matters and supplier-related challenges. Drive a high level of ownership, commercial awareness, quality and attention to detail across the team. Establish clear objectives, responsibilities and performance expectations within the Procurement team. Project Procurement & Contracting Oversee end-to-end procurement processes, from procurement strategy and market engagement through RFx, evaluation, negotiation, approval, contract award and handover to project execution. Lead and support major commercial and contractual negotiations with suppliers and manufacturers. Review and challenge sourcing strategies, bid evaluations, commercial recommendations and contractual positions. Support Procurement Leads and project teams in resolving complex procurement and commercial issues during project execution. Ensure procurement activities are aligned with technical requirements, project schedules, budgets and commercial objectives. Commercial & Contractual Risk Management Identify, assess and manage key commercial and contractual risks, including: Pricing and indexation Payment terms and payment milestones Delivery and schedule obligations Delay and performance remedies Warranties Performance requirements and guarantees Liability and contractual limitations Bank guarantees and other security instruments Scope definition and changes Termination provisions Supplier-performance and dependency risks Work closely with Legal, Engineering and Project teams to ensure appropriate contractual protection and balanced risk allocation. Escalate material commercial and contractual risks to management with clear recommendations and mitigation measures. Procurement Governance & Strategy Ensure compliance with company procurement policies, governance and approval processes. Review major procurement strategies and supplier-selection recommendations before management approval. Develop and improve procurement processes, tools, templates and controls. Support strategic sourcing initiatives, framework arrangements and long-term supplier strategies. Provide management with clear commercial assessments, procurement status, key risks and recommendations. Supplier Management Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key local and international suppliers and manufacturers. Lead senior-level supplier discussions, negotiations and commercial escalations when required. Monitor supplier performance and support resolution of material commercial or contractual issues. Identify supplier dependencies, concentration risks and alternative sourcing opportunities. Support the development of long-term and preferred-supplier relationships where commercially beneficial. Cross-Functional Leadership Work closely with Project Management, Engineering, Legal, Finance and other relevant stakeholders. Ensure alignment between procurement strategy, technical requirements, project schedule, budget and contractual strategy. Facilitate commercial decision-making across multiple functions. | Requirements: Significant experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, contracting and commercial negotiations, preferably within a complex project environment. Proven experience in managing, mentoring and developing procurement professionals. Strong hands-on experience managing end-to-end procurement processes. Demonstrated experience leading complex and high-value commercial negotiations. Strong experience negotiating Supply Agreements with suppliers and manufacturers. Strong understanding of commercial contracts, contractual risk allocation and supplier management. Proven ability to identify commercial risks and convert them into effective negotiation and contractual positions. Strong experience with RFx processes, supplier evaluation, commercial comparison, negotiation and contract award. Strong stakeholder-management capabilities and ability to work effectively across Engineering, Legal, Finance, Project Management and senior management. Strong analytical and commercial decision-making capabilities. Ability to manage multiple complex procurement processes simultaneously while maintaining a high level of attention to detail. Strong leadership, communication, negotiation and influencing skills. Excellent English communication skills. Preferred Experience Experience within renewable energy, energy, infrastructure, industrial, manufacturing, or other complex project environments. Experience procuring major equipment, technical packages, materials and related services. Experience negotiating complex Supply Agreements with international suppliers and manufacturers. Experience working with global supply markets and international supplier organizations. Experience managing commercial terms related to pricing, payment terms, delivery, warranties, liabilities, guarantees, performance obligations and supplier risk. Experience developing strategic sourcing approaches and long-term supplier relationships. Experience implementing procurement governance, processes, tools and performance controls.

job.title: רכז/ת תחום תכנון תשתיות
job.snippet:
למרכז הרפואי שיבא דרוש/ה רכז/ת תחום תכנון תשתיות
תיאור התפקיד:
תיאום כלל תהליכי התכנון האדריכלי, ההנדסי והתפעולי של הפרויקט.
ניהול אדמיניסטרטיבי, בדגש כתיבת מסמכים, תיאום בין משרדי, אדריכלים, עו"ד, עיריית ב"ש, שיבא ועוד.
ניהול תהליך הצעות מחיר ליועצים ועוד.
ריכוז מענה לשאלות, עדכון לוחות זמנים בנושא תכנון וגאנט.
תחומי אחריות:
תיאום תהליכי תכנון:
ריכוז ישיבות תכנון, הכנת סיכומי דיונים והפצתם, ניהול ממשקי עבודה בין דיסציפלינות שונות, ובקרה על התקדמות התכנון בהתאם ללוחות זמנים.
ריכוז וניהול תהליכי מכרזים:
פרסום, תיאום ומעקב אחר מכרזים מול כלל הגורמים הרלוונטיים – כולל יועצים, קבלנים וספקים. ריכוז הצעות מחיר, בדיקתן והשוואתן, והפקת מסמכי סיכום והמלצות
ניהול קשר עם יועצים ומתכננים:
מענה לפניות מקצועיות, תיאום פגישות עבודה, ריכוז מידע והבטחת זרימת עבודה תקינה בין כלל הגורמים המקצועיים
בקרה תכנונית ומסמכים:
ביצוע אינטגרציה של עדכונים בין תוכנית אב, פרוגרמה, פתרונות לוגיסטיים צרכים קליניים ולוגיסטיים, מסמכי מכרזים, תכניות עבודה ושרטוטים. שמירה על עדכניות ואחידות המסמכים בקרב כלל הגורמים המעורבים
ידע תפעולי ותכנוני יישומי:
יישום ידע בתחום תכנון ותפעול בתי חולים, כולל הבנה של תהליכי זרימה תפעולית, דרישות רגולטוריות, עקרונות תכנון רפואי, ותיאום בין צורכי המשתמשים לבין פתרונות תכנוניים, פתרונות לוגיסטיים , פרסום RFI על פי צורך ועוד
בקרה על עמידה בלוחות זמנים ותקציב:
תיאום מול מערכות ניהול הפרויקט לצורך מעקב אחרי אבני דרך, ניהול סיכונים, והצפת פערים בזמן אמת
*משרה מלאה*
דרישות התפקיד:
השכלה אקדמית רלוונטית - תואר ראשון לפחות: כלכלה / מנהל עסקים / מנהל מערכות בריאות / הנדסה / ניהול פרויקטים / תעשייה וניהול
ניסיון של 3 שנים לפחות בתכנון, ניהול או ליווי פרויקטים בתחום הבינוי / תשתיות / תכנון פיזי / הנדסה
ניסיון בעבודה מול רשויות תכנון, יועצים, קבלנים וכורמים רגולטוריים
ניסיון בהובלת תהליכים מורכבים מול מספר רב של ממשקים פנימיים וחיוניים - יתרון משמעותי
כישורי תיאום גבוהים, חשיבה מערכתית רחבה
כישורי כתיבה וניסוח ברמה גבוהה מאוד בעברית (באנגלית - יתרון)
תקשורת בין-אישית מצוינת, יכולת הובלה לצד עבודה בצוות
יכולת עבודה בתנאי לחץ וריבוי משימות
שליטה מלאה בתוכנות Office, בדגש על PowerPoint ו-Excel

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Integrations - AI/ML
job.snippet:
The Connectors team is the bridge between ClickHouse and the broader ecosystem. We build and maintain the integrations that make ClickHouse accessible to millions of developers, data practitioners, and AI agents worldwide, from high-level data visualization plugins (Tableau, PowerBI, Superset, Metabase) to connectors for data frameworks (Apache Spark, Flink, Kafka Connect, Fivetran), orchestration platforms, and AI tooling.
Our work directly shapes how companies process massive datasets: real-time analytics platforms that ingest millions of events per second, observability systems that monitor global infrastructure, and, increasingly, AI-powered data applications that redefine how teams work with data. We collaborate closely with the open-source community, internal teams, and enterprise users to ensure ClickHouse integrations set the standard for performance, reliability, and developer experience.
About The Role
As a
Senior Software Engineer specializing in the AI & ML ecosystem
, you'll be a core contributor owning and evolving critical parts of ClickHouse's AI ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of high-performance database engineering and developer experience. You'll craft tools that enable Engineers and Data Scientists to harness ClickHouse's speed and scale in the frameworks they already use.
We're looking for someone who has firsthand experience as an AI & MLEngineer or Data Scientist. The data practitioner's world is shifting rapidly: databases are no longer just query targets, but they're becoming active participants in AI-powered workflows, serving as vector stores for RAG pipelines, backends for LLM-powered agents, and real-time feature stores for ML inference. You understand these workflows not from the outside, but because you've operated within them. You don't just build integrations, you bring product-level insight into what we should build and why.
You'll own the full lifecycle of key AI/ML integrations, driving architecture, performance, and feature direction across
AI & LLM Ecosystem:
LangChain, LlamaIndex, n8n, and broader AI tooling: embedding pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation with ClickHouse as a vector store, ML feature stores, and LLM-powered data applications.

תפקיד זה מהווה הזדמנות ייחודית לעבוד בחזית הטכנולוגיה, תוך שילוב עמוק בין אופטיקה, מכניקה ואלקטרוניקה, והוא קריטי להצלחת הפרויקטים החדשניים שלנו. הצוות שלנו עוסק בפיתוח וייצור מערכות מורכבות, הדורשות רמת דיוק ואיכות בלתי מתפשרת.

שילוב מערכות מורכבות המשלבות רכיבים מכניים, אופטיים ואלקטרוניים.

זיהוי תקלות, ניתוח כשלים ומתן פתרונות בשיתוף פעולה עם צוותי ההנדסה.

job.title: FinOps Analyst
job.company: Miracle FinOps & TEM services By Tamar
job.snippet:
Company Description
Miracle is the leading FinOps Services company in Israel, based on the latest STKI report. We specialize in TEM & FinOps services, focusing on Business Process, Data Analysis, Expense Management, Invoices Processing, Cost Optimizing, Cost Reduction, Team Management & Training, and Budget Management in the domains of Telecom Expense Management and Public Cloud. Our Miracle Expenses Management solution is designed to drive significant cost reduction for enterprises by improving visibility, control, and employee experience.
Role Description
This is a full-time hybrid role as a Junior FinOps Analyst at Miracle FinOps & TEM Services by Tamar, focused on the Public Cloud domain. This is a junior position only, designed for candidates with up to 1.5 years of experience. This role is not suited for experienced or senior candidates. Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure is required, and we provide full, hands-on training in FinOps practices and Miracle’s methodologies, so no prior FinOps background is required. We’re looking for someone early in their career, analytically minded, and with a strong service-oriented approach, who is eager to learn and grow within the FinOps field.
As a Junior FinOps Analyst, you will support our FinOps processes for enterprise customers, including cloud cost visibility, cost allocation, cost optimization, budgeting, and reporting. The role also involves customer success, including managing customer meetings and following up on action items and recommendations. Client service is a key part of this position. This is a hybrid role, based in the Tel Aviv District, Israel.
Responsibilities
Support Cloud Billing Analysis: help analyze and verify billing and usage data from AWS, Azure and GCP
Assist with Cost Allocation: help map cloud costs to business units, projects and cost centers, including tagging review and improvement
Support Cost Optimization: help identify savings opportunities such as rightsizing, idle and unused resources, and storage optimization
Assist with Commitment Management: help analyze Reserved Instances, Savings Plans and other commitment opportunities
Assist in Anomaly Detection: monitor cloud spend and help identify unexpected cost spikes and their root causes
Support Budgeting & Forecasting: help track cloud spend against budgets and support forecasting processes
Help build and maintain FinOps Analytics, Reports, and Dashboards, including trend analysis and cost-vs-budget comparisons
Support customer success processes: manage and coordinate customer meetings, track action items, follow up on recommendations, and maintain strong client relationships
Learn and apply Miracle’s methodologies as part of our internal training program
Some workdays may be performed on-site at client offices, as needed
Qualifications
Up to 1.5 years of experience. This is a junior role, and we will provide all necessary FinOps training
Hands-on experience working with AWS or Azure (
must
)
Strong analytical skills
Experience with Excel
Attention to detail
Excellent quantitative and problem-solving abilities
Good written and verbal communication skills, as client-facing communication is important
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage follow-ups and multiple tasks
Ability to work independently and remotely
Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field
Advantages
Experience with GCP
Familiarity with cloud cost tools (AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, etc.)

job.title: Field Services Engineer
job.snippet:
About the job
Field Service Engineer (FSE) Job description:
responsible for providing on-site support, maintenance, and repair services for the multi-disciplinary, high-accuracy ultrasound scanners provided by ScanMaster worldwide.
Key Responsibilities and Duties
Installation and Commissioning: Traveling to customer sites to install, configure, calibrate, and test new or existing equipment and systems, ensuring they operate correctly and are set up.
Troubleshooting and Repair: Diagnosing and resolving complex mechanical, electrical, or software issues with existing equipment, in response to service calls. This involves using specialized tools and interpreting technical schematics.
Preventive Maintenance: Performing scheduled maintenance, inspections, and upgrades to ensure long-term reliability and prevent future malfunctions.
Technical Support and Training: Providing customers with technical guidance, answering product-related questions, and training end-users (and/or agents) in the proper operation and basic maintenance of the equipment.
Mechanic Geometrical Measurements: Performing mechanical geometrical measurements for UT systems includes implementing a 3D laser & correction table, or using Granit with a dial indicator.
UT Electronic Calibration: Performing Electronic (RF Amplitude and Signal) Measurements on the company UT equipment, the UPR/RPP, using Scoop Analyser, Signal Generator & Attenuator.
Documentation and Reporting: Maintaining detailed records of all service activities, including repairs performed (Service Calls), parts consumed, time spent, and system performance.
Customer Communication: Acting as a primary technical point of contact, communicating effectively with customers regarding service status, technical issues, recommendations, and billing.
Required Skills and Qualifications:
Technical Skills
Education: BSc in engineering (e.g., Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, or related field), Practical engineer or a relevant associate’s degree/vocational certificate.
Technical Aptitude: Experienced in working with multi-disciplinary systems, including mechanical, electrical, and electronic systems, circuitry, and software/PLC’s (Programmable Logic Controllers), MS Office, CAD tools.
Diagnostics: Proven ability to read and interpret technical drawings and schematics to diagnose complex problems remotely and on-site.
Soft Skills
Communication: Fluently able to communicate in English both in writing and in discussion. Additional languages are an advantage.
Customer Service: Excellent interpersonal skills for working directly with clients/agents and representing the company professionally. The role includes face-to-face, as well as email and phone.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills to resolve issues quickly and effectively under pressure.
Autonomy: Ability to work independently, organize travel schedules and service assignments, and manage time efficiently.
Adaptability: Willingness to travel frequently (locally or internationally, 1-2 weeks per month) and work in various environments, sometimes during flexible or non-standard hours.
Report to:
Service manager
Company Location:
Rosh HaAyin, ISRAEL

job.title: Resource Development Coordinator
job.snippet:
Role Description
תיאור המשרה
The Hannaton Educational Center is a Galilee-based educational organization dedicated to learning, leadership, and social impact. Through education, community-building, and meaningful encounters between diverse populations, we work to strengthen Israeli society. We are seeking a bilingual Resource Development Coordinator to help grow and steward partnerships with donors, foundations, and public funding partners in Israel and abroad.
Position: 80%–100%
Reports to: Director of Resource Development
Start Date: January 1, 2027
Responsibilities
Support the full donor journey—from prospect research and grant writing to stewardship, reporting, and ongoing donor engagement.
Prepare grant proposals, reports, and funding applications for foundations, federations, government agencies, corporations, and individual donors in Israel and abroad.
Research and develop new funding opportunities, with a particular focus on expanding Hannaton's funding partnerships in Israel.
Maintain the donor CRM, ensuring accurate records, tracking, acknowledgments, and reporting.
Assist coordination of donor visits, delegations, fundraising events, and digital fundraising initiatives.
What We Offer
Meaningful work with lasting social impact.
Opportunities for professional growth in fundraising and philanthropy.
A collaborative, people-first culture with supportive leadership and room to grow.
The opportunity to be part of a leading educational organization in Northern Israel, advancing pluralistic Judaism, leadership, and shared society
Job requirements / דרישות המשרה
Requirements
At least one year of experience in fundraising and grant writing in a nonprofit organization (required).
Experience submitting applications through Israeli government systems (e.g., Merkava) is a significant advantage.
Native-level English and excellent Hebrew, with outstanding written and verbal communication skills (required).
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, digital work environments, and CRM systems.
Initiative, independence, excellent interpersonal skills, and a strong service orientation.
Identification with the values of the Hannaton Educational Center is an advantage.

job.title: FW Development Engineer
job.snippet:
Powermat Technologies is seeking a creative, motivated and skilled real-time embedded engineer to join our firmware development team.
The ideal candidate will possess strong problem-solving abilities and passion for developing innovative embedded solutions.
In this role, you will
design, implement and maintain real-time embedded software
for Powermat’s next-generation wireless power products.
You will report directly to the VP of R&D.
Job Responsibilities
Design, develop, improve, and maintain real-time embedded software from concept through production.
Define and implement firm architecture on ARM Cortex-M & STM8 microcontrollers.
Integrate real-time embedded software with external hardware components and complete system products.
Collaborate closely with hardware, systems and QA teams to ensure seamless integration and performance.
Participate in code reviews, debugging and system validation processes.
Create and maintain clear technical documentation for design and code.
Job Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering – Must.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in microcontroller programming (ARM Cortex-M series) – Must.
Proven experience in real-time embedded systems design and low-level hardware interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, etc).
Strong understanding of MCU architecture and system peripherals (ADC, DMA, PWM, TIMERS, GPIO’s, System Clocks, etc.).
Deep knowledge in C programming – Must.
Familiarity with Python and MATLAB – Must.
Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, including coding standards, debugging, version control and documentation practices.
Proficiency in using lab and test equipment (oscilloscope, logic analyzer, power supplies) – Must.
Excellent interpersonal skills: team player, independent, fast learner, hardworking and reliable – Must.
Strong communication skills in both Hebrew and English – written and verbal.
Advantages
Experience in hardware design and power electronics.
Basic knowledge of object-oriented concepts in C or C++.
Familiarity with automotive industry standards such as MISRA-C:2004.
Experience with IAR and/or Keil Embedded Workbench development environments.

job.title: Strategic Consultant | Jerusalem
job.snippet:
Turn strategic analysis into policy that shapes an entire market.
A public-sector organization in Jerusalem is looking for a Strategic Consultant to join a team shaping economic and regulatory policy in the communications sector.
This is an opportunity for an experienced consultant with a strong economic background to move beyond advisory work and take an active role in developing policy, conducting market research and influencing decisions with industry-wide implications.
The role focuses on the economic and regulatory aspects of spectrum allocation and pricing, including examining international models, analyzing market data and developing recommendations that will help shape future policy.
What you’ll do
Conduct economic and strategic research to support policy development.
Examine international regulatory frameworks and compare approaches across countries.
Analyze financial reports, market data and economic trends across companies and industry sectors.
Develop economic assessments, policy recommendations and position papers to support regulatory decisions.
Prepare and present research findings, professional papers and decision-support materials to key stakeholders.
Lead research projects and drive complex processes from initial analysis through to actionable recommendations.
What we’re looking for
Bachelor’s degree.
5+ years of relevant experience, preferably in a strategy or economic consulting firm.
Background in economic analysis, market research, public policy or regulatory consulting.
Strong analytical capabilities, including hands-on data analysis and the ability to independently draw conclusions.
Excellent writing, presentation and communication skills.
Ability to manage research and analysis processes independently and work effectively with multiple stakeholders.

job.title: HPC Operations Engineer
job.snippet:
We are now looking for a HPC Operations Engineer to join our mission and continue improving our HPC infrastructure. A meaningful part of NVIDIA’s strength is our unique and advanced development tools and environments that enable our incredible pace of innovation. We are looking for architects to help us evolve the way our private compute cloud is architected and optimized.
What You’ll Be Doing
Troubleshoot incoming support requests in a large-scale HPC environment.
Contribute improvements to existing deployment automation, configuration management, observability, and operational monitoring and day to day operation through automation.
Ensure compute servers are running an accurate Operating System and configuration.
Address Complex Issues: Perform comprehensive issue resolution from bare metal to application level, ensuring system reliability and efficiency.
Collaborate with specialist teams to drive issues to closure.
Collaborate with domain experts to improve how our chip development process utilizes our infrastructure.
Directly contribute to the overall quality and improve time to market for our next generation chips.
What We Need To See
BS in Computer Science or similar degree or equivalent experience
2+ years of experience Proficient in coordinating Centos/RHEL Linux distributions.
Understating of container technologies like Docker.
Proficiency in Python and UNIX scripting languages such as bash.
Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze sophisticated systems, identify bottlenecks, and implement scalable solutions.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work optimally with teams with varied strengths and individuals.
Proven understanding of cluster configuration managements tools such as Ansible.
Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd
Understanding of key Linux technologies such as NFS, automounter, LDAP, DNS, and TCP/IP networking in Red Hat Linux distribution flavors.
Familiarity with job scheduler administration (e.g. IBM Spectrum LSF or SLURM) and experience building/ operating large scale compute infrastructure.
Knowledge of the FlexLM license management system.
Proficiency in Perl for maintaining legacy automation scripts.
Familiarity with High-Speed Networking (InfiniBand, RDMA, RoCE etc.) and fast, distributed storage systems (Lustre, GPFS, etc.)

job.title: System Administrator
job.snippet:
Senior System Administrator | VMware, Citrix & Microsoft
Take ownership of critical enterprise IT infrastructure and solve complex technical challenges in a 24/7 healthcare environment.
A leading healthcare organization in Southern Israel is looking for an experienced
System Administrator
to join its infrastructure team.
This role focuses on operating, maintaining, upgrading, and improving enterprise IT systems that support essential medical and operational services.
You'll work with
Microsoft technologies, VMware, Citrix, Azure, AWS, PowerShell, storage, and backup infrastructure
, while troubleshooting complex incidents and leading infrastructure projects.
What You'll Do
Operate, maintain, upgrade, and improve critical enterprise IT infrastructure.
Administer Windows Server environments, Active Directory, Group Policy, and DNS.
Manage and maintain enterprise VMware virtualization environments.
Administer, maintain, and support Citrix infrastructure.
Work with Microsoft Azure and AWS cloud environments.
Develop PowerShell scripts and automation solutions.
Monitor system availability, stability, and performance.
Troubleshoot complex Tier 2/3 infrastructure incidents.
Perform Root Cause Analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Work with enterprise storage, backup, and disaster recovery environments.
Lead infrastructure changes, upgrades, and technology projects.
Collaborate with networking, cybersecurity, application, and infrastructure teams.
Coordinate technical activities with vendors and technology providers.
Support operational continuity in a business-critical 24/7 environment.
Mandatory Requirements
At least 3 years of professional experience as a System Administrator in an enterprise organization.
Hands-on experience with Active Directory, GPO, and DNS.
Experience with Windows Server 2019/2022 or newer.
Experience managing enterprise VMware environments.
Experience administering, maintaining, and supporting Citrix environments.
Experience developing PowerShell scripts and automation.
Experience working with both Microsoft Azure and AWS environments.
Strong technical English proficiency.
Proven ability to investigate and resolve complex infrastructure incidents.
Ability to independently manage technical responsibilities and infrastructure tasks end-to-end.
Strong systems thinking, attention to detail, and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure.
Ability to independently lead infrastructure processes and projects.
Strong service orientation and teamwork capabilities.
Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and work outside regular business hours when required.
Advantages
Familiarity with virtual machines, storage, networking, IAM, Entra ID, VPC, VNet, Security Groups, and VPN technologies.
Experience with SCCM, Microsoft Intune, or PDQ.
Experience in healthcare, public sector, or other high-availability enterprise environments.
Experience with physical servers and Dell storage systems.
Familiarity with SAN, NAS, Fibre Channel, iSCSI, and Multipathing.
Experience with backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions.
Professional certifications from Microsoft, VMware, Citrix, AWS, or Azure.
Position Details
Location:
Southern Israel
Employment Type:
Full-time
Operational Environment:
Business-critical IT infrastructure supporting 24/7 operations
Availability:
On-call rotations and occasional work outside regular business hours, as required
If you're an experienced System Administrator who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and taking ownership of critical systems, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: System Administrator
job.snippet:
System Administrator
We're looking for a highly technical, service-oriented
System Administrator
to join our IT & Infrastructure Team, with a focus on enterprise backup, recovery, and virtualization environments.
This role is perfect for someone passionate about building resilient infrastructure, solving complex technical problems, and ensuring business continuity across a large-scale server estate.
The IT team at Iscar supports employees globally – from onboarding to offboarding – and is responsible for managing users' equipment, accounts, licensing, hardware, software, and more.
You'll take a central part in protecting the organization's data and ensuring our systems remain available, recoverable, and secure.
You'll be the frontline of backup and recovery operations, managing and optimizing enterprise backup environments in alignment with predefined SLAs. You'll also monitor, respond to, and manage infrastructure and backup requests through our IT service desk.
Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end operation of enterprise backup environments, including setup, configuration, ongoing management, and monitoring.
Manage, maintain, and optimize large-scale backup and recovery systems based on
Veeam
across hundreds of servers.
Support and administer backup and recovery processes in
VMware / vSAN
environments, with emphasis on backup, restore, and disaster recovery.
Operate and maintain backup and recovery workflows for
AKS and Kasten
, including containerized and cloud-native environments.
Manage backup and recovery processes for
Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Azure IaaS, Windows, and Active Directory
.
Administer and support
Linux
systems as part of the broader infrastructure estate.
Respond to and resolve complex infrastructure and backup issues, escalating as necessary and collaborating with technical teams to ensure effective IT operations.
Collaborate with third-party service providers to resolve outages and service disruptions.
Work closely with infrastructure teams locally and with our companies worldwide.
Support, install, and improve existing systems and services.
Implement and maintain IT best practices by evaluating and adopting new technologies to enhance process improvements and IT capabilities.
Requirements
3–5 years of proven experience
in system administration and enterprise backup in large organizations running
hundreds of servers

required

.

.
Exagrid
administration experience –
significant advantage
.
Familiarity with technical

significant advantage
.
Ability to work independently and resolve complex technical issues, collaborating with infrastructure teams locally and with our companies worldwide.
Good level of
English
– both written and spoken.
Strong service orientation, ownership, and attention to detail.
Location:
This is an onsite position located at our headquarters in Migdal Tefen.

job.title: חשב/ת חברה (Controller)
job.snippet:
אלפא קוסמטיקה מגייסת חשב/ת חברה (Controller)
אלפא קוסמטיקה היא חברה פרטית ישראלית שנוסדה בשנת 1933, המתמחה בייבוא, שיווק והפצה של מותגים בינלאומיים מובילים בתחומי הקוסמטיקה, הבישום, הטיפוח, האופנה והלייף סטייל. בין מותגי הקבוצה ניתן למצוא את NIVEA, Labello, CHANEL, GUERLAIN, Givenchy, Clarins, TOUS, LONGCHAMP, DESIGUAL, BROWNIE ו-BIMBA Y LOLA. הקבוצה מפעילה מערך הפצה עצמאי בפריסה ארצית ומשווקת את מוצריה לרשתות שיווק, לרשתות פארם, לבתי מרקחת ולחנויות מתמחות ברחבי הארץ.
מה כולל התפקיד?
בקרה על הנהלת החשבונות והכנה, ניתוח והפקה של דוחות כספיים וניהוליים חודשיים, רבעוניים ושנתיים.
ניהול ותחזית תזרים מזומנים, ניתוח דוחות מלאי ותמחור.
ניהול הקשר השוטף מול בנקים, רואי חשבון מבקרים, רשויות המס וסוכני ביטוח.
אחריות על דיווחים כספיים, הגשת דוחות וסגירות מול מס הכנסה.
ניהול פוליסות ביטוח, רכוש קבוע, פחת ורווחי הון.
ניהול ספקים בחו"ל, תשלומים וחיובים ומתן מענה פיננסי שוטף.
ליווי מנהלי מותגים וחטיבות בנושאים פיננסיים, לרבות בדיקות כדאיות עסקית.
הובלת תהליכי התייעלות, אוטומציה במערכות ERP והטמעת כלי BI.
דרישות התפקיד
רואה/ת חשבון מוסמך/ת (CPA) – חובה.
ניסיון של 3 שנים לפחות בתפקיד דומה בחברה מסחרית – חובה.
שליטה מצוינת ב-Excel וניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות ERP – חובה; היכרות עם Priority או קו מערכות – יתרון.
היכרות וניסיון בעבודה עם Power BI – יתרון משמעותי.
הבנה מעמיקה בתחומי החשבונאות, המיסוי, הבנקאות והביטוח.
יכולת אנליטית גבוהה, יוזמה ופרואקטיביות, יחסי אנוש מצוינים ויכולת להוביל תהליכים.
היקף המשרה: משרה מלאה מהמשרדים בלבד בפארק תעשיות בר לב (ליד כרמיאל), עם נכונות לשעות נוספות.

job.title: כלכלן.ית FP&A
job.snippet:
כלכלן.ית FP&A
אמרל היא חברה מובילה המספקת שירותים ופתרונות מקצועיים למגוון ארגונים וחברות בתחומי הביטחון, התעשייה, האנרגיה והטכנולוגיה. אנו מזמינים אותך להצטרף לצוות מקצועי, לקחת חלק בפרויקטים משמעותיים ולפתח קריירה בסביבה חדשנית ומאתגרת.
אנחנו מחפשים
כלכלן.ית FP&A
לתפקיד משמעותי הכולל אחריות על ניהול ובקרת תקציב, תכנון פיננסי, ניתוחי כדאיות ותמיכה בקבלת החלטות אסטרטגיות.
מה כולל התפקיד?
בנייה וניהול של תקציבים שנתיים ורב-שנתיים
מעקב שוטף אחר ביצוע התקציב, לרבות הכנסות, הוצאות ועלויות כוח אדם
הכנת תחזיות פיננסיות חודשיות ורבעוניות
הכנת דוחות, דשבורדים וכלי בקרה לצורך ניתוח וקבלת החלטות ניהוליות
הובלת ההיבטים הכלכליים והפיננסיים של מכרזים והצעות עסקיות, לרבות ניתוחי תמחור פרויקטים והערכת עלויות
תמיכה במנהלי יחידות עסקיות באמצעות ניתוחים פיננסיים ותכנון תקציבי
עבודה מול מחלקות שונות בארגון
דרישות התפקיד
תואר ראשון בכלכלה, חשבונאות, מנהל עסקים או תחום רלוונטי
2–5 שנות ניסיון בבקרת תקציב, ניתוח פיננסי, FP&A או תמחור פרויקטים
שליטה גבוהה ב-Excel, כולל נוסחאות מתקדמות, ניתוח נתונים ומידול פיננסי
יכולות אנליטיות גבוהות ותשומת לב מצוינת לפרטים
ניסיון בעבודה עם כלי AI, כלי BI ובבניית דשבורדים
חשוב לדעת
• משרה מלאה
• עבודה היברידית
מה אנחנו מציעים?
• סביבת עבודה מקצועית
• אפשרויות קידום
• הכשרה מקצועית
• תנאים סוציאליים
• אירועי חברה
מיקום
📍 יקנעם

job.title: Head of Customer Care | Volta Solar
job.snippet:
Head of Customer Care | Volta Solar
Location:
Petah Tikva, Israel | Full-time | Hybrid flexibility
About Volta Solar
Volta Solar is an Israeli renewable energy company helping homeowners make the transition to clean, sustainable energy.
We're looking for an experienced, hands-on
Head of Customer Care
to lead our customer care department and ensure an excellent customer experience throughout the residential solar installation journey.
This is an opportunity for a strong people manager who enjoys leading teams, improving operations, and turning challenges into solutions.
What You'll Do
Lead a department of approximately 15 employees, including two team leaders.
Manage, coach, and develop team leaders while building a culture of accountability, teamwork, and customer focus.
Oversee the customer journey from onboarding to successful completion of solar installation projects.
Ensure effective coordination of customer projects, timelines, workloads, and operational processes.
Set clear goals, establish management routines, monitor service KPIs, and improve team performance.
Work closely with internal teams to resolve operational challenges, remove bottlenecks, and keep projects moving forward.
Develop and implement workflows, procedures, and digital tools to improve service quality and operational efficiency.
Balance customer satisfaction, team performance, and day-to-day operational priorities.
What We're Looking For
Proven experience managing customer service or customer care teams in a B2C environment –
Required
.
Experience managing team leaders or managers across multiple teams –
Required
.
Strong hands-on operational management skills.
Experience overseeing complex customer processes, projects, or service operations.
Excellent leadership, coaching, and people development abilities.
Experience defining goals, monitoring KPIs, and driving continuous improvement.
Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Experience working with CRM systems and Microsoft Office.
Technical curiosity and willingness to learn about solar energy and installation processes.
Excellent written and spoken Hebrew.
Why Join Volta Solar?
Lead an established department with real ownership and responsibility.
Make a direct impact on customer experience and operational performance.
Work closely with company leadership.
Join a growing Israeli company with a meaningful environmental mission.
Enjoy a collaborative, practical, and results-driven work environment.
Reporting to:
General Manager
Ready to lead a team and make a difference?
Apply now and join Volta Solar!

job.title: Assistant Controller
job.snippet:
Factory 54
is a global fashion and lifestyle group, headquartered in Tel Aviv and Amsterdam, with extensive operations across Israel and Europe. Part of the Irani Group, Factory 54 is one of Israel’s leading luxury fashion and lifestyle retailers.
The company imports, markets, and operates more than 150 international fashion, footwear, accessories, and beauty brands, alongside a large-scale retail operation that includes flagship stores, a leading E-commerce platform, and a premium customer experience.
Our headquarters includes over 450 employees across technology, digital, E-commerce, marketing, logistics, finance, HR, content, PR, and commercial operations. Nearly all core activities are managed in-house, including an advanced technology team of +30 developers driving innovation and smart retail solutions.
We are looking for an
Assistant Controller
to join our Finance team.
In this role, you will be responsible for the financial closing, reporting, and control processes across the Group's companies, while working closely with both internal and external stakeholders. The position also includes preparing financial statements, performing financial analysis, and supporting process improvement initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Prepare consolidation schedules and support the preparation and analysis of quarterly and annual financial statements.
Assist with and monitor the monthly financial close process, including journal entries, accruals, and account reconciliations.
Work closely with the external auditors throughout the audit process.
Ensure the accuracy and completeness of monthly financial reporting.
Prepare monthly reports for government authorities and banks, as required.
Prepare tax reports for the Group's companies.
Support the implementation and continuous improvement of financial processes and systems.
Assist the Group Controller with ongoing day-to-day financial and accounting activities.
Requirements
Certified Public Accountant (CPA) with
at least 2 years of post-internship experience
-
Required
.
Background in one of the
Big Four accounting firms
-
Retail sector experience is an advantage
.
Experience working with both public and private companies.
Experience preparing consolidated financial statements.
Hands-on experience preparing financial statement supporting schedules from start to finish.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, with
excellent Excel skills
.
Strong interpersonal skills, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment.
Previous experience as an
Assistant Controller
- an advantage.

job.title: SAP Functional Lead - 244681
job.snippet:
SAP Functional Lead - Logistics & Transportation
Airport City area, Israel
A global IT services and consulting company is hiring an SAP Functional Lead to own the functional design and hands-on configuration of enterprise logistics solutions. You’ll lead an implementation workstream from requirements and fit-gap analysis through integration testing, go-live, and hypercare.
What you’ll do
Lead design workshops and translate business requirements into SAP configurations, functional specifications, and test scenarios.
Design transportation workflows across shipment planning and execution, carrier selection, freight charge calculation, and settlement.
Define functional requirements and validate data flows for API and EDI integrations across SAP S/4HANA, SAP EWM, and external logistics providers (3PLs).
Lead SIT and UAT, resolve functional defects with development teams, and guide the workstream through go-live and hypercare.
What you’ll bring
Hands-on experience implementing and configuring SAP logistics solutions, with a track record of leading a functional workstream through go-live.
A strong understanding of transportation processes, including shipment planning, carrier management, and freight settlement.
Experience leading workshops, running fit-gap analysis, and writing functional specifications, configuration documentation, and test scenarios.
Familiarity with API and EDI integrations and experience working with business stakeholders, developers, and external partners.
Strong written and spoken English.
Nice to have
Hands-on experience with SAP Transportation Management (SAP TM).
Experience with SAP S/4HANA or SAP EWM.
Apply with your CV or reach out directly to discuss the role.

job.title: R&D Mechanical Engineer
job.snippet:
R&D Mechanical Engineer
Netafim is the global leader in irrigation solutions for sustainable agriculture. Our R&D department plays a crucial role in driving technological advancements and product innovations, positioning us at the forefront of industry.
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Mechanical Engineer to join our R&D team and contribute to our ongoing success.
Main Responsibilities
Collaborate with the R&D team to generate innovative concepts and ideas for new products & technologies.
Design and conduct experiments and tests to evaluate the mechanical reliability of prototypes.
Incorporate hydraulic principles and fluid dynamics into system designs to achieve optimal water pressure and flow rate.
Analyze and calculate mechanical designs, both for products and new tech- mechanisms.
Perform detailed documentation to track project status and design process.
Design machines/devices to support production of new products.
Requirements:
Bsc. degree in Mechanical Engineering
At least 5 years of mechanical design development experience
Proficiency in using SolidWorks for 3D modeling, simulation, and drawing creation.
Proven experience with products’ detailed design.
Proven experience with technologies search and implement according to needs.
Experience with irrigation systems/agriculture - an advantage
Highly analytical mind, with exceptional problem-solving skills and attention to details.
Project management skills to ensure timely delivery of design milestones.
Good English verbal and written communication skills.

job.title: Internship Software Engineer
job.snippet:
Who We Are
OriginAI is a collaboration between Axon Vision, NVIDIA, and Elbit Systems, established to tackle challenges at the forefront of AI research at national scale.
Located in Ramat Gan, we focus on advancing capabilities in Computer Vision, Speech, and NLP, leveraging cutting-edge hardware and access to the most advanced computing infrastructure in the industry.
About
the Role
We’re opening a unique
one-year, full-time internship program
designed
for B.Sc. Computer
Science
graduates and final-year students who are passionate about
AI and software engineering
.
You’ll join a multidisciplinary R&D team, gain hands-on experience with modern technologies, and contribute to transforming innovative AI research into real-world applications.
This position offers intensive learning, mentorship from senior engineers, and the opportunity to make meaningful technical contributions early in your career.
Responsibilities
As part of the software development team, you will:
Participate in a
scrum team
and collaborate across disciplines (product, research, and infrastructure).
Implement, test, and deploy software features in real projects.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Assist in
proofs of concept (POCs),
AI integrations
, and
technology benchmarking.
Participate in
code reviews
and learn best practices in scalable software development.
Contribute to the
development and deployment of AI models
in real-world systems.
Requirements
B.Sc. in Computer Science
(recent graduate or final-year student completing degree).
Passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and software engineering.
Proficient in Python
and familiar with software development concepts.
Basic knowledge of
web technologies
such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Understanding of
REST APIs
and common
data structures
and algorithms.
Curious, eager to learn new technologies, and motivated to grow in the AI domain.
Strong teamwork, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Nice to Have
Exposure to
Flask, FastAPI
, or similar back-end frameworks.
Basic knowledge of
Docker, Node.js
, or
databases
(SQL/NoSQL).
Interest in AI model inference, computer vision, or machine learning workflows.

job.title: IT & Microsoft Cloud Administrator
job.snippet:
📍 Shoham | Full-time | On-site
We are looking for a
hands-on IT & Microsoft Cloud Administrator
to take ownership of the organization's IT infrastructure and lead the implementation, management, and ongoing development of its
Azure and Microsoft 365 environments.
This role combines cloud administration and infrastructure management with broad responsibility for day-to-day IT operations, serving as the primary technical authority on-site and working closely with employees, management, and external vendors.
Key Responsibilities:
Implement and manage Azure and Microsoft 365 environments, with a focus on Intune and OneDrive.
Manage the site's IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, endpoints, and user support.
Lead and participate in IT infrastructure projects and cloud implementations.
Serve as the primary technical authority on-site, providing advanced support to employees and management.
Drive IT process improvements and automation initiatives.
Requirements:
4+ years
of experience in IT infrastructure and system administration.
Hands-on experience with
Azure and Microsoft 365.
Practical experience with Intune and OneDrive.
Experience working with hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
Proven experience in infrastructure projects and implementations.
Strong troubleshooting, ownership, and communication skills.
Advantages:
PowerShell, Power Platform (Power Apps / Power Automate), and Microsoft certifications.

job.title: Production Manager
job.snippet:
Eitan Medical
is a fast-growing global medical device company, developing and manufacturing innovative drug delivery and infusion solutions across the continuum of care- from the hospital to the home. We are looking for an excellent
Production Manager
to join the
Operations
team.
Job Description:
The
Production Manager
is responsible for leading manufacturing operations in a regulated medical device environment, managing Production Team Leaders and ensuring efficient, high-quality, and compliant production activities.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage and lead Production Team Leaders, including ongoing professional development, performance management, and support.
Oversee the recruitment, onboarding, and integration of production employees.
Manage workforce allocation and production staffing, including employee assignments and transfers between production stations according to operational needs.
Ensure discipline, adherence to procedures, and high professional standards across the production floor.
Manage, develop, and continuously improve manufacturing and Final testing processes.
Own manufacturing processes and ensure operational quality and compliance.
Ensure production activities are performed in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, quality standards, and company procedures.
Work closely and collaboratively with the Quality ang Engineering departments to ensure compliance, address quality issues, and continuously improve production processes.
Drive operational excellence and implement Lean methodologies and continuous improvement initiatives
Direct Manager:
Director of Manufacturing
Requirements:
Education:
B.S.c in engineering or related field
Job skills:
Proven experience working in a regulated environment - mandatory.
2 years of experience in a medical device company - advantage
Large volume manufacturing experience
2-3 years of management experience
Deep familiarity with ISO 13485 and other relevant standards
Familiarity with Lean methodology- an advantage.
Strong people-management skills and experience managing production-floor employees.
Experience with manufacturing and quality documentation - an advantage.
Computer skills:
Full control in all Office programs
hands-on proficiency in SAP ERP System
Personality:
Well organized and paying attention to details
Independent, responsible and patient
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic production environment.
Language skills:
Fluent English - writing and verbal

job.title: ראש צוות הרכבות ידניות
job.snippet:
ראש צוות הרכבות ידניות
- מפעל המים
על החברה:
נטפים הינה חברה גלובלית, חלק מקבוצת "אורביה", תאגיד בינלאומי המונה כ־23,000 עובדים ברחבי העולם. החברה עוסקת בפיתוח וייצור טפטפות ופתרונות השקיה מתקדמים לתעשייה החקלאית, ונחשבת לחברת ההשקיה המובילה בעולם. מעבר לפיתוח ולייצור, נטפים מקימה שדות, מטעים וחממות, מעניקה שירותים לחקלאים, פעילה ומשווקת את מוצריה ליותר מ־100 מדינות ברחבי העולם.
כיום לנטפים 19 מפעלים ו-2 מפעלי מחזור ברחבי העולם, כולל בישראל, ולמעלה מ־33 חברות בנות. בישראל פועלים שלושה אתרי ייצור: חצרים, מגל ויפתח. בנוסף, מטה החברה ממוקם במרכז הארץ, ואתר הייטק נוסף פועל ביקנעם. נטפים מעסיקה כ־5,000 עובדים ברחבי העולם, מתוכם כ־1,000 עובדים בישראל.
מטרת התפקיד:
אחריות לניהול השוטף של רצפת הייצור במפעל המים, הובלת צוותי העבודה לעמידה ביעדי בטיחות, איכות, אספקה ויעילות, תוך פיתוח עובדים, קידום שיפור מתמיד תוך קבלת החלטות שוטפות ומתן מענה לאירועים בזמן אמת.
תחומי אחריות:
תפעול הייצור השוטף במחלקה לעמידה בתוכניות העבודה
ניהול שגרות ניהול ברצפת הייצור (ישיבות בוקר, מעקב ביצועים וטיפול בחריגים)
קביעת סדרי עדיפויות בהתאם לשינויים בתוכנית הייצור ולצרכים העסקיים
ניהול ופיתוח צוותי היצור והטמעת תהליכי עבודה
הטמעת תהליכי אבטחת איכות ותלונות מול רפרנט איכות
סיוע בביצוע בדיקות וניסיונות בשיתוף עם מנהל מוצרים ופיתוח
מתן פתרון טכני לבעיות שוטפות
הובלת תהליכי מצוינות תפעולית ברצפת הייצור
ממשק עבודה מול מחסנים
דרישות התפקיד:
הנדסאי/מהנדס - יתרון
ניסיון בניהול צוותי ייצור או בניהול רצפת ייצור בסביבה תעשייתית
אנגלית טובה
בעל אוריינטציה טכנית
שליטה ב OFFICE
היכרות עםSOLID WORK - יתרון
ניסיון/התמחות בהידראוליקה – יתרון
ידע מקדים בLEAN - יתרון

job.title: Linux Lab Systems Engineer
job.snippet:
Mobileye is seeking a skilled
IT Lab Administrator
to manage and support advanced Linux and Windows computing environments across our laboratories in Jerusalem and on-premises. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining mission-critical lab infrastructure, driving operational efficiency, and collaborating closely with cross-functional IT teams, lab owners, and R&D stakeholders.
What will your job look like?
Install, configure, and maintain physical and virtual Linux servers in on-prem and lab environments.
Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex Linux server, OS, and hardware issues.
Validate technical purchase requests for hardware, software, and specialized lab equipment.
Partner with Core IT teams (Networking, Storage, Systems, and Information Security) for cross-domain diagnostics and escalated troubleshooting.
Maintain solid network fundamentals across switches, DHCP configurations, PXE boot environments, and subnets.
Deploy, configure, and maintain desktop PCs, workstations, NUCs, and peripheral devices.
Manage software installations, user access, and system permissions.
Provide proactive technical support to lab staff, engineering teams, and internal customers.
Leverage scripting, automation, and modern AI productivity tools to streamline lab workflows, documentation, and routine tasks.
All you need is:
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Linux system administration.
Familiarity with tools like Ansible, Docker, Zabbix, and ELK.
Experience with PXE booting, DHCP, image creation, and hardware testing (PCs and NUCs).
Proficiency in Linux virtualization technologies.
Strong scripting and automation skills.
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical problems.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Assertive, curious, and persistent mindset.
Customer-oriented approach.
Proficiency in English.
Nice to have:
Experience with server, GPU, and data center environments.
Relevant certifications.
Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!
