job.title: AI & Image Processing Specialist
job.snippet:
At Agwa, we build autonomous hydroponic growth cabinets that grow fresh greens anywhere. Each unit is packed with cameras and sensors, connected to the cloud, and guided by our Virtual Agronomist: an AI system that monitors plant health, makes growing decisions and alerts when something goes wrong.
What you'll do:
• Own the Virtual Agronomist's algorithmic core, from architecture and model choice through deployment and field performance
• Analyze complex problems end to end and build a clear work plan and roadmap toward a complete solution.
• Develop and improve CNN-based models (classification, detection, segmentation) that assess plant state from images captured in real-world conditions
• Build the data flywheel with our agronomy team: labeling processes, dataset quality, human-in-the-loop decisions, error tracking and retraining
• Combine imaging with sensor data to detect anomalies and support automated decisions
• Deploy algorithms both in the cloud and locally on edge devices
• Work closely with software, hardware, agronomy and product in a small, multidisciplinary R&D team
• Evaluate where LLMs and VLMs can add real value alongside classic algorithms
What we're looking for:
• B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Computer Science or a related field
• 6+ years of hands-on experience in computer vision and algorithm development
• Proven track record of taking deep learning models (CNNs) from research to production
• Strong background in image processing and classic algorithms
• Creative thinker, able to design complex logic to solve complex, real-world problems
• Experience developing and deploying algorithms in cloud environments, on IoT products
• Experience running algorithms locally on edge devices in a Linux environment
• Experience working on multidisciplinary products combining hardware, software and real-world data
• Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks
Big advantages:
• M.Sc. or higher
• Background in electro-optics: cameras, sensors, optics and ISP
• Experience with AWS
• Experience with edge inference optimization
Location: Bar Lev Industrial Park (North), 4 days in the office + 1 day from home.
Please send us your CV to: jobs@agwafarm.com

job.title: Hardware Validation & Automation Student
job.snippet:
A leading Industrial AI company, Augury helps the world’s manufacturers leverage real-time production insights and data to drive new levels of efficiency. By combining predictive and prescriptive technology with operational data and customized AI agents, production teams can improve uptime, reduce costs, and maximize yield and capacity. Our mission is to transform how people and machines work together to push the boundaries of human productivity.
About The Role
We’re looking for a Computer / Electrical engineering student to join our IoT Validation & Automation team.
You’ll help operate our hardware validation lab and grow into building the automation that powers end-to-end HW/FW testing across Augury’s IoT platforms.
You’ll work hands-on with real lab equipment, write and extend Python/Robot Framework tests, and collaborate with Hardware, Embedded Firmware, Linux, and System Engineering.
No prior industry experience is required — we care about strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the drive to learn in a real production lab.
What you’ll do
Support IoT hardware test and validation: automated tests, diagnostic tooling, and lab processes.
Help maintain lab infrastructure: test benches, measurement equipment, calibration workflows, and tools.
Operate lab assets such as SpectraQuest rigs, magnetic Helmholtz coils, power analyzers, and RF chambers — with mentorship.
Execute regression, stress, performance, and multi-revision hardware tests as part of the validation pipeline.
Develop and maintain automated end-to-end test scripts (Python, Robot Framework).
Contribute to lab automation software and pipelines (Python, Jenkins, Docker, Git).
Work with automation infrastructure: APIs, SSH interfaces, databases, and CI/CD flows.
Help validate gateways, sensors, mobile, connectivity, and HW/FW integration scenarios.
Work with hardware, firmware, software, and system engineers on validation workflows.
Write and improve lab procedures, validation notes, and equipment documentation.
Support root-cause investigations and reliability improvements.
What you bring
Currently studying Computer Engineering / Electrical Engineering.
At least 3 semesters remaining before graduation.
Comfortable working AI-native: uses AI coding/assistant tools as part of how you learn, write, and debug — while still owning the fundamentals.
Solid software fundamentals: Python preferred (scripting / OOP coursework or personal projects).
Coursework or strong interest in signal processing, sensors, or embedded/IoT systems.
Comfort learning Linux/Unix, command-line tools, and SSH.
Interest in networking and wireless concepts (Wi-Fi, BLE, cellular — classroom level is fine).
Curiosity about physical hardware and lab work; willingness to learn electronic test equipment.
Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, and ability to work independently with guidance.
No prior industry experience required.
Nice to have
Academic lab experience (electronics, DSP, communications, or mechatronics labs).
Familiarity with test automation ideas or frameworks (Robot Framework or similar).
Knowledge of IoT-related protocols: BLE, MQTT, SSH.
Personal projects involving hardware, Raspberry Pi/Arduino, sensors, or automation scripts.
Any exposure to CI tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) or containers (Docker).
Technologies you’ll work with
Python, Robot Framework, Patrol, Jenkins, Docker, SSH, Git, Postman, MongoDB, Google Cloud Platform, Azure, logic analyzers, RF chambers, Helmholtz coils, spectra/vibration analyzers, power analyzers, and other electronic test equipment.
Benefits
Hybrid student role in Haifa (~100 hours/month, 2 days in office + remote).
Hands-on exposure to industrial IoT hardware and real validation infrastructure.
Mentorship from experienced validation and automation engineers.
Meaningful ownership of automation work that ships into CI and lab practice.
A path to grow into advanced validation, automation, and systems roles.
To apply
Please include your CV, grades transcript, and a short note on relevant coursework, lab work, signal-processing/software projects, or personal automation projects.

We believe in fostering an inclusive environment in which employees feel encouraged to share their unique perspectives, leverage their strengths, and act authentically. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, and we welcome those from all backgrounds and varying experiences. We are committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. job.title: Systems Analyst
job.snippet:
Senior Technical Systems Analyst | APIs, SQL & Kafka
Design complex systems. Solve technical challenges. Lead solutions that support critical healthcare services.
A leading healthcare organization in Central Israel is looking for an experienced
Technical Systems Analyst
to work on complex modules within its Electronic Medical Record (EMR) environment.
This is a primarily hands-on systems analysis role, combining approximately
70% technical and functional systems analysis with 30% technology project leadership
.
You'll analyze complex workflows, design system integrations, write detailed specifications, investigate technical issues, and lead technology initiatives from requirements through production deployment.
The role involves close collaboration with software development, QA, DevOps, infrastructure, information security, and business teams.
What You'll Do
Technical & Functional Systems Analysis
Lead end-to-end systems analysis for complex modules within an Electronic Medical Record environment.
Write detailed functional and technical system specifications.
Analyze complex business and technical requirements and translate them into practical solutions.
Design interfaces and integrations between internal and external systems.
Work with REST APIs and enterprise integration environments.
Analyze relational databases and write complex SQL queries, including advanced JOINs.
Investigate system incidents, application logs, and complex technical processes.
Work with Kafka and messaging-based integration processes.
Collaborate with development, QA, DevOps, and infrastructure teams.
Maintain end-to-end responsibility for assigned systems, modules, and technical processes.
Technology Project Leadership
Lead technology projects from initiation and requirements analysis through implementation and production deployment.
Develop project work plans, prioritize tasks, and manage risks.
Coordinate activities across development, QA, infrastructure, information security, suppliers, and business stakeholders.
Track project progress and address cross-functional dependencies.
Present project status, technical alternatives, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Mandatory Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems Engineering, or Industrial Engineering and Management with a specialization in Information Systems.
At least 4 years of experience analyzing complex information systems.
Proven experience leading at least one technology project end-to-end.
Experience writing both functional and technical system specifications.
Experience designing system interfaces and APIs, including REST APIs.
Strong hands-on SQL experience with relational databases, including complex JOIN queries and advanced data analysis.
Experience investigating system incidents and complex technical processes.
Experience working with Apache Kafka.
Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders without direct managerial authority.
Strong systems thinking combined with attention to technical detail.
Ability to manage priorities and time effectively in a dynamic environment.
Ability to work independently, make decisions, and lead technical initiatives.
Significant Advantages
Experience with clinical systems, healthcare applications, or Electronic Medical Record environments.
Experience in large organizations with complex operational systems and multiple integrations.
Experience in banking or insurance environments.
Experience with Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) technologies.
Professional training in systems analysis.
Position Details
Location:
Central Israel
Employment Type:
Full-time
Work Model:
Hybrid, subject to organizational policy
Role Composition:
Approximately 70% Systems Analysis / 30% Technology Project Leadership
Availability:
Flexibility to support production deployments and critical incidents outside regular working hours when required
If you enjoy deep technical analysis, complex integrations, and leading solutions from design to production, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: ADMS Solution Integrator
job.snippet:
Job Description Summary
GE Digital is the world leader for Grid Software solutions enabling companies world-wide to optimize their control of the Grid and the transformation towards sustainable energy sources. Our teams contribute to major infrastructure projects delivering Transmission, Distribution and Market systems part of the national and regional coordination of electricity on all continents.
In the context of Software Solutions projects execution within the Services organization, the successful candidate will bring his expertise as Solution Integrator to make sure all the various software applications and databases used for a Solution work together without compromising overall information system integrity.
The Solution Integrator Engineer role is an integral part of project teams responsible for delivering best-in-class services, development and project delivery of technical solutions and consultancy to key customer accounts, within the various regions of GE Grid Software Solutions.
Job Description
Responsibilities:
In This Position, You Will
Contribute of the software’s integration in coordination with the Senior Solution Integrator owning the solution in cooperation with the others Solution Integration team members based in France and abroad
Contribute to the configuration management, build and deployment, including integration of customs and customer data model, integration of external systems interface
Collaborate with test management team to proactively ensure that all systems setup and configuration tasks are complete to achieve solution acceptance by customer
Contribute to the delivery of solution level documentation including maintenance documentation and release notes
Work actively on optimization of the deployment process, implementation of Continuous Integration, Continuous Deployment and Test automation processes with the DevOps teams
Support in building excellence in execution through continuous improvement via the adoption of global tools and processes and cost competitiveness actions
Support Local IT Support (e-terra DMS) – e-terra DMS/ADMS applications: distribution power flow, FLISR, Volt/VAR control, switching management; distribution network model management (GIS-to-DMS); Habitat platform basics; core IT administration (Windows Server, VMware, backup/patching) in an OT environment. Distribution operations background a plus.
Qualifications / Essential Criteria
Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.
Ideal subjects: Computer Science, IT Networking, Software Development with willingness to change to Software Integration and Deployment
Fluency in English (speaking, reading, and writing)
Experience with Linux and Windows operating systems and LDAP
Software configuration and deployment management
Applications development using C++, Java languages.
Scripting development using PowerShell or Perl
Relational databases: SQL-Server or Oracle
HW Infrastructure and Virtualization (VMware)
Security: Authentication, Encryption
DevOps and Agile methodology
Experience with Deployment tools as of Docker
Desirable Criteria Or Characteristics
Atlassian suite (JIRA, Confluence)
Web Services (SOAP, REST)
Applications development in IT/Multitier/SOA/Web context
Source Code Management tool (TFS, GitHub, SVN)
Infrastructure As Code: Terraform, Ansible, Artifactory, Docker, Puppet, SSCM
Good communication skills (verbal and written)
Rigorous, methodical, well organized, and self-disciplined
Take initiatives, good trouble-shooter and autonomous
Ability to analyze complex topics and make a verbal/written synthesis
French speaking or understanding
Flexibility to travel to remote site when required
Additional Information
The job is open to men and women equally
Relocation Assistance Provided:
No

job.title: IT Infrastructure Team Leader
job.snippet:
Amarel is looking for an experienced IT Infrastructure Team Leader to lead infrastructure operations, drive technological improvements, and support the organization's ongoing digital transformation.
This role combines technical leadership, team management, and hands-on involvement in infrastructure projects within a complex, multi-site organization.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the IT Infrastructure & Operations team, ensuring high service levels, business continuity, and excellent end-user experience.
Lead infrastructure projects and modernization initiatives across cloud, networking, servers, storage, virtualization, and endpoint management.
Manage and continuously improve the Microsoft 365 environment, Active Directory, Windows Server, and Azure services.
Drive IT infrastructure strategy, architecture, operational excellence, automation, and the adoption of AI-based solutions.
Lead Disaster Recovery (DR) and infrastructure resilience initiatives.
Manage IT vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.
Work closely with Information Security and the external CISO to implement security controls, mitigate risks, and ensure compliance.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to align infrastructure solutions with organizational needs and priorities.
Requirements
4+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure in medium or large organizations.
3+ years of experience leading an IT Infrastructure team or managing infrastructure operations.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft technologies, including Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Windows Server, and Azure.
Broad knowledge of networking, virtualization, storage, backup, cloud, and endpoint management.
Experience leading infrastructure projects, ITSM processes, and working with external vendors.
Understanding of cybersecurity, infrastructure security, and business continuity.
Experience in multi-site organizations – an advantage.
Experience in the defense industry – a significant advantage.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field – an advantage.
Relevant professional certifications – an advantage.

job.title: כלכלן/ית
job.snippet:
קצת על התפקיד לארגון הכספים במטה חטיבת מערכות טילים וחלל דרוש/ה כלכלן/ית פרויקטים. התפקיד כולל:
תמחור והכנת הצעות מחיר.
ליווי הפרויקטים בהיבט הפיננסי, החל משלב הפקת הצעת מחיר, קליטת הזמנות לקוח, התחשבנות, גבייה ועד לסיום הפרויקט.
הכנת תכניות עסקיות ובדיקת כדאיות להשקעות.
עבודה מול גוף הרכש ובדיקת הזמנות.
בקרה תקציבית על פרויקטים- בדיקת רווחיות וחריגות מהתקציב.
מו"מ עם לקוחות וספקים.
שילוב בתהליך הכנת תקציבים פרויקטליים שנתיים ורב-שנתיים.
השתתפות בדיונים עסקיים, התנהלות מול מנהלים מקצועיים. מה אנחנו מחפשים
תואר ראשון בכלכלה/מנהל עסקים/חשבונאות- חובה
תואר שני- יתרון
שנה- שנתיים ניסיון ככלכלן/ית פרויקטים- יתרון
הכרות עם מערכת SAP- יתרון
שליטה מלאה ביישומי OFFICE לרבות EXCEL
בעל/ת יכולת עבודה בצוות
נכונות לעבודה בשעות נוספות לפי הצורך
אולי יעניין אותך לדעת חטיבת מערכות טילים וחלל נחלקת לחמישה מפעלים: הגנה, טילים, חלל, מלמ ותממ - כולם חלוצים, בתחומם ובזכות עצמם, ניצבים בחזית של הטכנולוגיה החדישה ופורצת דרך בעולם. מפעל הגנה מייצר ומספק מערכות הגנה עבור זירות הים והיבשה בהתבסס על ידע מצטבר של עשורים רבים. מזמינים אותך לקחת חלק מרכזי באתגרים העומדים בפנינו ולהיות שותפ/ה מלא/ה לעשייה המדהימה של התעשייה האווירית.

job.title: Global Repair Services & Third-Party Management Specialist
job.snippet:
Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced
GRS Operations & Third-Party Management professional
to support and manage Global Repair Services operations, with a primary focus on
North America and the Americas region
.
The role will be responsible for managing multiple third-party vendors and repair partners, driving operational performance, monitoring KPIs and SLAs, managing inventory and cost performance, and supporting complex operational and customer escalations.
This position requires a strong
North American business orientation
, experience working with U.S.-based customers, vendors and cross-functional teams, and availability to operate primarily during
North American business hours
.
The successful candidate should be highly independent, analytical, and execution-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, translate operational data into management insights, and drive third parties toward measurable performance improvements.
Key Responsibilities
Third-Party & Repair Operations Management
Manage multiple third-party vendors, repair centers and operational partners, primarily across the Americas.
Own the ongoing operational relationship with external partners and serve as the GRS focal point for performance, priorities and escalations.
Monitor vendor performance against agreed KPIs, SLAs, OTD, quality, cost and inventory targets.
Conduct regular operational and business reviews with third parties.
Identify performance gaps, establish corrective actions and follow through to closure.
Coordinate priorities across vendors, customers, CBUs and internal teams.
KPI & Performance Management
Develop, monitor and communicate operational KPIs and management dashboards.
Analyze trends, exceptions and performance gaps across repair, logistics, inventory, SLA and financial metrics.
Drive improvement plans based on KPI performance.
Prepare clear management presentations and executive-level operational reviews.
Convert complex operational data into clear conclusions, risks and recommended actions.
RMA, Repair & Logistics Operations
Support end-to-end RMA and repair operations for customers and internal business units.
Coordinate customer and CBU deliveries and logistical requirements.
Ensure performance against customer SLA and On-Time Delivery (OTD) commitments.
Support material and component availability for repair centers.
Manage priorities and escalations when supply, repair capacity or logistics issues impact customer service.
Support internal RMAs, Capex requirements, and inventory replenishment activities.
Inventory & Cost Management
Monitor inventory levels and replenishment requirements across repair locations.
Support inventory planning and optimization while balancing service levels and financial exposure.
Monitor operational spending and support budget control, forecasting, and cost analysis.
Assess the operational and financial impact of process, sourcing, inventory, and lifecycle decisions.
Identify opportunities for cost reduction without compromising customer support or SLA performance.
Cross-Functional & Lifecycle Management
Work closely with Supply Chain, PLM, NPI, Engineering, Finance, Customer Support and other internal functions.
Support NPI, product lifecycle, LTB/EOL and repair-readiness activities.
Navigate complex cross-functional processes and drive issues toward resolution even when ownership is distributed across several organizations.
Evaluate the operational, inventory and cost implications of lifecycle changes.
Required Skills & Experience
Strong experience in third-party/vendor management, preferably involving multiple service providers or repair partners.
Proven operational experience in the U.S./North American market and strong understanding of working with North American customers, vendors and teams.
Ability and willingness to work primarily in a North American-compatible time zone.
Experience in repair operations, RMA, service logistics, supply chain, depot/repair center operations or similar service operations.
Strong KPI and SLA management capabilities, including performance analysis and corrective-action management.
Strong analytical skills and proven ability to work with large and complex data sets.
Strong inventory management and budget/cost-control orientation.
Excellent presentation skills, including the ability to build and present clear business and operational reviews to management.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and take full ownership of operational issues.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, including the ability to balance customer impact, operational risk and cost.
Ability to manage several priorities, vendors and escalations simultaneously.
Strong customer orientation and professional communication skills.
Excellent written and verbal English.
University degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Previous experience in the telecommunications, networking, electronics repair or technology service industry.
Experience managing outsourced repair operations, contract manufacturers, third-party logistics providers or external service partners.
Knowledge of Nortel, GENBAND, SONUS or Ribbon product environments is highly desirable.
Experience with Repair, NPI, PLM and LTB/EOL lifecycle processes.
Strong Excel/data-analysis capabilities and experience preparing management dashboards and executive presentations.
Key Success Measures
Success in this role will be measured through:
Third-party vendor performance
SLA achievement
On-Time Delivery (OTD)
RMA and repair performance
Inventory performance and availability
Cost and budget performance
Quality and operational compliance
Timely closure of escalations and corrective actions
Quality and accuracy of KPI reporting and management presentations
Customer and internal stakeholder support
Please Note:
'All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, on the basis of disability, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.'

job.title: רכז/ת שירות ותפעול למחלקה הטכנית
job.snippet:
דרוש/ה רכז/ת שירות ותפעול למחלקה הטכנית
מחפש/ת מקום עבודה יציב, עם אנשים טובים ותנאים מצוינים?
יש לך ראש גדול, תודעת שירות גבוהה ויכולת לגרום לדברים לקרות? אנחנו מחפשים אותך!
IBB GROUP
המייצגת בישראל מותגי פרמיום לתינוקות, מגייסת רכז/ת שירות ותפעול לצוות שלנו בהרצליה פיתוח.
אנחנו חברה יציבה שמשקיעה מאוד בעובדים שלה, ומחפשת אנשים איכותיים, אחראיים ומסורים שרוצים למצוא מקום עבודה לטווח ארוך.
מה כולל התפקיד?
ניהול ותיאום תהליכי שירות מול משווקים ולקוחות עסקיים.
פתיחה, טיפול ומעקב אחר קריאות שירות עד לסגירתן.
תיאום תיקונים, החלפות ומשלוחים מול המחלקות השונות.
טיפול בהזמנות, הפקת מסמכים ועבודה מול ספקים וחברות שילוח.
עבודה עם מערכות ממוחשבות, בקרה ומעקב אחר משימות.
אחריות על תהליכים תפעוליים שוטפים ומתן פתרונות בזמן אמת.
זהו תפקיד מגוון ודינמי, המשלב שירות, אדמיניסטרציה ותפעול, עם הרבה עצמאות ואחריות.
את מי אנחנו מחפשים?
ניסיון קודם בשירות, אדמיניסטרציה או תפעול – חובה.
סדר, ארגון ויכולת לנהל כמה משימות במקביל.
ראש גדול, יוזמה ויכולת לפתור בעיות באופן עצמאי.
תודעת שירות גבוהה, סבלנות ויחסי אנוש מצוינים.
שליטה טובה ב-Excel – חובה.
ניסיון ב-SAP – יתרון משמעותי.
רקע טכני או היכרות עם מוצרים טכניים – יתרון.
ומה מחכה לך אצלנו?
שכר מתגמל ותנאים סוציאליים מצוינים.
קרן השתלמות וכרטיס סיבוס.
סביבת עבודה נעימה, איכותית ומשפחתית.
חברה יציבה שמשקיעה בעובדיה ומעריכה אנשים טובים.
עבודה עם מותגים בינלאומיים מובילים ואפשרות להשתלב לטווח ארוך.
מיקום:
הרצליה פיתוח
שעות:
ימים א׳–ה׳, 09:00–18:00, ללא ימי שישי.
קורות חיים למייל
renana@ibb-group.co.il
המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

job.title: Head of Finance - R&D
job.snippet:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Finance – R&D based in Israel.
As Head of Finance – R&D, you will take strategic ownership of the financial infrastructure, treasury operations, and banking ecosystem supporting fast-growing international technology businesses. You will play a key role in building scalable, multi-jurisdictional banking and payment solutions while ensuring financial stability, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency. Working closely with founders and senior leadership, you will oversee multi-currency liquidity, cross-border transactions, financial risk management, and strategic banking partnerships. You will also establish robust financial processes from the ground up and develop a high-performing treasury and finance operations team. This is an opportunity to shape the financial foundations of ambitious digital businesses operating across global markets. The role offers significant autonomy, complex international challenges, and direct influence on business growth and long-term financial performance.
Accountabilities
Design and implement a flexible, multi-jurisdictional banking and payment infrastructure to support international digital businesses with complex compliance requirements.
Identify, negotiate with, and onboard strategic financial partners, including leading banks, Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs), Payment Service Providers (PSPs), custodians, and financial platforms.
Negotiate favorable commercial terms, including transaction fees, payment settlement periods, foreign exchange rates, and hedging solutions.
Establish backup banking relationships and alternative payment channels to ensure uninterrupted transaction processing and operational resilience.
Manage multi-currency liquidity, working capital, cash pooling, and treasury operations across multiple legal entities.
Oversee complex international transfers through SWIFT, SEPA, and ACH networks, optimizing transaction speed, security, and costs.
Monitor and reduce treasury-related expenses, including foreign exchange spreads, acquiring fees, and banking charges.
Coordinate banking due diligence, manage KYC and AML processes, and maintain effective communication with banking compliance and risk management teams.
Ensure long-term stability of banking relationships and payment flows, supporting financial restructurings and corporate changes when required.
Build comprehensive treasury and financial operations processes from the ground up, ensuring scalability and operational transparency.
Partner with founders and senior executives on financial strategy, unit economics, ROI analysis, and financial modeling.
Recruit, develop, and lead a treasury and financial operations team capable of supporting the organization's international growth.
Requirements
At least 5 years of experience in a senior finance leadership position, such as CFO, VP of Finance, or Head of Treasury, preferably within fast-growing businesses.
Proven track record of opening and managing international bank accounts and building payment infrastructure across multiple jurisdictions.
Strong understanding of international AML/KYC standards, cross-border compliance requirements, and the regulatory specificities of different financial jurisdictions.
Hands-on experience managing multi-currency funds, foreign exchange exposure, FX risk, and international settlement instruments.
Demonstrated ability to negotiate banking and payment service agreements and optimize transaction fees and financial operating costs.
Strong knowledge of international payment networks and banking operations, including SWIFT, SEPA, and ACH.
Strategic financial mindset, with the ability to translate complex financial challenges into scalable solutions that support business growth.
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with experience working directly with founders, senior executives, banking partners, and legal teams.
Advanced English proficiency (C1/C2), with the ability to lead complex negotiations and communicate confidently with international financial institutions and legal professionals.
High level of autonomy, strategic thinking, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail.
Benefits
Competitive compensation: Salary conditions are not specified and can be discussed during the recruitment process.
High level of autonomy: Full ownership of the financial and banking infrastructure, with the freedom to make strategic decisions without unnecessary bureaucracy.
Meaningful business impact: Direct involvement in launching and scaling innovative technology businesses with millions of potential users worldwide.
Strong professional environment: Opportunity to collaborate with experienced founders, senior executives, engineers, and marketing specialists.
Access to shared business expertise: Support from specialized teams covering Finance, Legal, HR, IT, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, and other essential business functions.
Professional development: Access to exclusive learning programs, management training, AI-focused initiatives, and professional communities.

job.title: Software Engineer (Generalist), Robotics
job.snippet:
Picker Agrobotics · Ramat Yishai
About us
Picker Agrobotics is an agritech startup developing autonomous robots for harvesting tree fruit. Our robots work in real orchards, with dust, weather and uneven terrain, so our software has to be robust and reliable in the field.
We're an R&D team heading for field pilots and deployment in the next 7–12 months. This is the stage where research code becomes a product, and we're looking for someone to help make that happen.
The role
You'll be the bridge between R&D and deployment, working across algorithmic teams to turn new capabilities into reliable production software.
As part of the process from POC to a deployable product, you'll work on our software infrastructure, tooling and introspection capabilities, and end-to-end user-facing features.
You'll join as our second software engineer, working side by side with the software lead. You'll help shape the architecture, keep the codebase consistent, and guide other team members on where their code belongs. The role is broad, and challenges differ on a daily basis, ranging from writing new features and fixing a broken build to hardware integration and consolidating legacy features into coherent libraries.
Tools and technology
Languages:
Python, C/C++, Bash
Platform:
Linux (Ubuntu), Docker (Compose, Buildx), Git, CMake
Middleware:
ROS2 with DDS
Hardware interfaces:
RS-485/422, CAN bus, EtherCAT, microcontrollers
Cloud:
AWS S3, EC2
What you'll do
Productionize code from other teams, such as ML and control engineering, by reviewing it, structuring it and applying clean code patterns, to ensure correctness and make future expansion easier.
Build new end-to-end features and maintain existing code.
Help consolidate legacy features into well-designed libraries, while keeping the balance between the company's current needs and a fast-paced delivery schedule.
Assist in developing our testing practice, QA methods and CI/CD.
Support the algorithmic teams on system integration and day-to-day issues: builds, environments, containers and middleware.
Take part in field testing, which will increase as we approach deployment.
Who you are
Hands-on team player:
Eager to learn and happy to get your hands dirty, in the code and on the robot.
A clear communicator:
You can explain software engineering ideas to people from other professions in a way that helps them in their work.
Opinionated:
You argue for good structure, and change your mind when someone shows you a better way.
Requirements
Must have (Professional Experience):
A degree in Computer Science / Computer Engineering and at least one year in an industry position, OR equivalent proven hands-on industry experience.
Python (Proven Experience)
– Designed, wrote and delivered deployment-ready code. Deep understanding of data structures, multithreading and OOP best practices.
Linux (Hands On)
– Experience and familiarity with Ubuntu systems, inspection, services and networks. Comfortable using and interacting with terminals.
Git (Proven Experience)
– Strong command of Git versioning and branching. Capable of solving complex Git scenarios.
OOP (Proven Experience)
– Solid grasp of SOLID principles and the fundamental design patterns. Able to extract and redesign scripts into well-structured, reusable code.
Docker (Proficiency)
– Including Docker Compose and Buildx, managing permissions, network definitions, multi-stage builds and image layering.
Hardware integration (Knowledge)
– Our robots connect several computing units with motors, sensors and cameras. You're familiar with one or more communication protocols, such as RS-485/422, CAN bus or EtherCAT. Faced with a new device, you can decipher its datasheet and work out how to communicate with it.
Nice-to-have experience (Professional / Educational):
C++/C (Proficiency)
– Reading and writing code bases, and experience with CMake and build systems on Linux.
Microcontrollers (Knowledge)
– Experience (Professional / Educational).
CI/CD (Knowledge)
– Understanding of, and a desire to learn and develop, testing and deployment practices.
ROS2, including DDS (Familiarity)
– Our product utilizes ROS2 as its main IPC middleware; experience and know-how are a meaningful advantage.
Cloud capabilities (Familiarity)
– Experience working with remote buckets and cloud compute, such as EC2 and AWS S3, is an advantage.
Bash scripting (Familiarity)
– Reading, and guided writing of, scripts for deployment and system management.
Using AI coding agents critically, and working well without them.
What we offer
Growth and learning across software, robotics and hardware.
Early-stage influence:
help set the engineering standards the codebase grows on.
Field work:
take the robot from R&D to deployment and see your code run in the orchard.

job.title: CTO Office Team Member
job.snippet:
CTO
CTO Office Team Member
Tel Aviv Full-time
Description
About Us
Zenity is the leader in AI Agent Security and the first company to bring an agent-centric security platform to market. As enterprises accelerate AI agent adoption, we are establishing the security framework for how AI agents are secured and governed at enterprise scale.
We deliver full-lifecycle visibility, governance, detection, prevention, and response for AI agents from build time to runtime, across SaaS, home-grown platforms, and end-user devices. Backed by $180M+ in total funding, including a $125M Series C led by Norwest, with participation from SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and Microsoft's M12, Zenity is trusted by Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises worldwide.
Join us in shaping how AI agents are secured at enterprise scale.
About The Team
The CTO Office is Zenity’s core discovery engine, dedicated to navigating the rapid evolution in AI agent security and “building the lighthouse.” We are a high-agency team of ICs with integrated Engineering, Research, and Product mindsets. Our mission: incubate new ideas, define the approach to emerging attack classes, and build working POCs that prove technical reality.
Guided by the CTO, Product, and GTM, we validate hard, open problems and actively support the Product organization by opening new development paths and seamlessly handing over advanced capabilities through research, prototyping, and customer validation.
What You’ll Do
Responsibilities
Take an ambiguous security challenge from "this might be possible" to a working POC that proves the Zenity approach, grounded in technical reality.
Research the customer need, cybersecurity gap, and technical feasibility behind an idea before and while you build.
Own the end-to-end execution loop: scope the problem, build the prototype, evaluate it, document the approach, and ship it.
Partner closely with Product, R&D, and GTM. Don’t just write about emerging problems. POC the solutions so customers see something real.
Make the calls on architecture, tooling, and tradeoffs, moving quickly from ambiguity to a tangible prototype.
When a POC succeeds, lead the transition to Engineering and Product so it can receive the resources required for productization.
Stay ahead of the rapid evolution in AI and proactively bring relevant insights into the team.
Requirements
Requirements
Technical execution. Substantial hands-on experience in Engineering or Security Research. You can investigate an unfamiliar problem, form a point of view, and build the solution to prove it works.
AI. Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI agents. You understand how they work, where they fail, and how to reason about them. You are fluent with AI-assisted coding.
Cybersecurity. Strong understanding of attack paths and defensive controls. You can earn credibility with researchers and engineers alike through technical leadership.
Product mindset. You can hold “is this the right thing to build?” in tension with “is this technically feasible?” and decide both. You care about what pain a capability solves.
Agency. Comfortable starting from a blank page, working without a spec, and being the one who defines what “done” looks like. You move fast and tell the story.
Communication. You can explain your reasoning, present prototypes to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and document the work well enough for others to continue it.
Advantages
Experience building or researching cybersecurity products
Experience with AI agents or AI agent security
Experience in an early-stage startup or zero-to-one environment
Previous leadership experience as a team lead or tech lead
Public technical output: blog posts, conference talks, open source contributions, or published papers

job.title: מבקר איכות
job.snippet:
📢
דרוש/ה מבקר/ת איכות למפעל נדין טק בע"מ
📍
מיקום המשרה: עוספיה
חברת
נדין טק
, המתמחה בייצור חלקים מחומרים מרוכבים לתעשיות הביטחוניות והתעופתיות, מגייסת
מבקר/ת איכות
להצטרפות לצוות האיכות במפעל.
תיאור התפקיד:
ביצוע ביקורת איכות לחלקים ולמוצרים בתהליכי הייצור ובשלבים הסופיים.
ביצוע בדיקות ויזואליות וממדיות בהתאם לשרטוטים ולמפרטים טכניים.
זיהוי, תיעוד ודיווח על אי־התאמות.
עבודה מול מחלקות הייצור, ההנדסה והאיכות.
מעקב אחר עמידה בדרישות האיכות ובנהלי החברה.
דרישות התפקיד:
תואר אקדמי רלוונטי – חובה.
ניסיון קודם בביקורת איכות בתעשייה – חובה.
יכולת קריאה והבנה של שרטוטים טכניים – חובה.
היכרות עם כלי מדידה וביצוע ביקורות איכות.
ניסיון בתחום החומרים המרוכבים – יתרון משמעותי.
ניסיון בתעשייה הביטחונית או התעופתית – יתרון.
דיוק, אחריות, יסודיות ויכולת עבודה בצוות.
📩
להגשת מועמדות:
ניתן לשלוח קורות חיים לכתובת: hanan@ntech.co.il
המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

job.title: IT Support Technician
job.snippet:
IT Field Technician | PC & Network Support
Enjoy solving technical problems, working hands-on with IT equipment, and helping users get back to work?
A leading organization in Central Israel is looking for an
IT Field Technician
to provide hands-on technical support across an enterprise IT environment.
This role combines PC troubleshooting, hardware and software installation, endpoint maintenance, basic networking, and on-site user support.
We're looking for someone with previous technical experience in PC support, IT troubleshooting, networking, or technical services who wants to continue developing their skills in a diverse IT environment.
What You'll Do
Diagnose and resolve PC, hardware, and endpoint-related issues.
Install, configure, and maintain desktop and laptop computers.
Troubleshoot printers, peripherals, and workstations.
Install operating systems and software applications.
Work with Windows 10 and Windows 11 environments.
Perform basic tasks involving Windows Server.
Support user accounts and permissions in Active Directory.
Assist users with Microsoft 365 and Office applications.
Troubleshoot basic network and connectivity issues.
Work with IP addressing, DNS, and DHCP.
Provide on-site technical support and resolve user incidents.
Collaborate with other IT professionals to resolve technical issues.
Mandatory Requirements
Previous technical experience in PC support, IT technical support, networking, or technical services.
Familiarity with Windows operating systems and workstations.
Familiarity with Active Directory.
Basic understanding of computer networking and communication technologies.
Strong technical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues independently.
Strong service orientation and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Valid driver's license.
Advantages
Previous experience working in a large organization.
Completion of a technical course in computers, IT, or networking.
Experience with Windows Server.
Familiarity with Microsoft 365.
Previous experience in an on-site or field IT support role.
Position Details
Location:
Central Israel
Employment Type:
Full-time
Role Type:
Field-Based IT Support
Professional Focus:
PC Support, Hardware Troubleshooting, Windows, Active Directory, and Basic Networking
If you have a technical background, enjoy hands-on troubleshooting, and want to grow your IT career, we'd love to hear from you.

קבוצת בנייה מגייסת מתאם תכנון ורישוי לפרויקטים של התחדשות עירונית.
א'-ה' 08:00-17:00 -במשרדי החברה ברעננה עם ביקורים בשטח!! שכר גבוה ומתגמל למתאימים!

- קידום פרויקטים הנדסיים בשלב התכנון והרישוי

- ביקורי תיאום תכנון בשטח

- שכר גבוה ומתגמל למתאימים!
- משרה מלאה, א'-ה' 08:00-17:00, בלי שישי
- עבודה מהמשרד ברעננה, עם ביקורים בשטח
- מיקום: רעננה
דרישות התפקיד
- הנדסאי או מהנדס בבניין או באדריכלות - חובה.
- ניסיון של 3 שנים לפחות בתכנון ורישוי - חובה.
- ניסיון בהתחדשות עירונית - יתרון!
שליחת קורות חיים או הגשת מועמדות מהווה הסכמה לכך שחברת ג׳וב ספייס בע״מ תשמור ותשתמש בפרטיך, לרבות למטרת פנייה אליך בנוגע למשרות נוספות ודומות ולהעברת פרטיך למעסיקים פוטנציאליים בעתיד.

job.title: מנהל.ת בקרה ארגונית
job.snippet:
מנהל.ת בקרה ארגונית
מימון ישיר
פתח תקווה
1-2 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 11 דקות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
אחריות למיפוי, בחינה וקביעת הבקרות התפעוליות המבוצעות בחברה. כולל: מעבר על תהליכים זיהוי צמתים ונושאים שנדרש לבצע עליהם בקרה, בחינה אופן ביצוע הבקרה היעיל ביותר, סנכרון הבקרות מול מנהלי ה SOX ומנהלת הסיכונים. עבודה צמודה מול מנהלי המטות והבקרים באגפים השונים.
ביצוע בקרה אחר ביצוע הבקרות עפ"י הנקבע, זיהוי והצפת דגלים על מורכבות.
הקמת מערכת מידע שתתמוך בניהול השוטף.
תמיכה שוטפת במידה ומשתנות הבקרות / התהליכים
יצירת מפה ארגונית של הסיכונים התפעוליים והבקרות המבוצעות.
דרישות התפקיד
תואר ראשון- חובה, יתרון בהנדסת תעשיה וניהול

• Advantage: Experience in natural gas systems
• Advantage: Use and knowledge of design and construction standards
• Must: Fluent in English and Hebrew languages
• Team player

job.title: מנהל.ת תחום אנרגיה
job.snippet:
א
מנהל.ת תחום אנרגיה
אגד
בית דגן
5-6 שנים
משרה מלאה
לפני 4 שעות
הגשה
רוצה להבין מה במשרה יכול להתאים לך?
הניסיון שלך בעבודה עם אנשים ובמתן שירות יכול להשתלב היטב בדרישות התפקיד.
תיאור משרה
קבוצת אגד מחפשת מנהל.ת תחום אנרגיה בכיר.ה להובלת אחד התחומים האסטרטגיים והמתפתחים ביותר בקבוצה.
מדובר בתפקיד אסטרטגי ובעל השפעה משמעותית ברמת הקבוצה, הכולל אחריות על גיבוש והובלת אסטרטגיית האנרגיה של הארגון .
במסגרת התפקיד תהווה/י סמכות מקצועית ומוקד ידע מרכזי בתחום האנרגיה בקבוצה ותוביל/י גיבוש תוכנית אסטרטגית רב-שנתית בתחומי תשתיות אנרגיה, מערכות טעינה, אגירת אנרגיה, אנרגיות מתחדשות, חוסן אנרגטי ופתרונות טכנולוגיים מתקדמים, לרבות V2G/V2X ושימוש חוזר בסוללות.
התפקיד משלב אסטרטגיה, הנדסה, חשיבה עסקית, רגולציה, חדשנות וניהול פרויקטים מקצה לקצה, תוך עבודה ישירה מול הנהלה בכירה והשפעה משמעותית על קבלת החלטות ברמת הקבוצה.
תיאור התפקיד:
?	ניתוח המצב הקיים בקבוצה מול גורמי תפעול, כספים ונדל"ן, וסנכרון כלל יוזמות האנרגיה תחת אסטרטגיה אחת.
?	אחריות על סטנדרטים ומתודולוגיות בתחום האנרגיה ומיסוד פורום ניהול אנרגיה בקבוצה.
?	מיפוי יסודי של נכסי האנרגיה (חוזי האנרגיה הקיימים, צי חשמלי, תשתיות טעינה, חיבורי חשמל, גגות וסוללות) ליצירת בסיס נתונים ברמת הקבוצה , אחוד וזיהוי פוטנציאל.

•	בקרה ותחזוקת נהלים, עמידה ב- SLA, תחזוקת Runbooks, נהלי SOP/EOP ותרגילי חירום.
•	תיאום הדוק מול צוותי Facilities, צוותי IT NOC וגורמי אבטחה ובטיחות

•	נדרשת אנגלית ברמה גבוהה (עבודה מול מערכות, נהלים וספקים בינלאומיים)
•	ניסיון בעבודה בדאטה סנטר – יתרון משמעותי
•	נדרשת דייקנות וירידה לפרטים, כריזמה ותקשורת בין אישית טובה
•	ראש גדול ואחריות, יכולת קבלת החלטות תחת לחץ
